 }
 
 private static void testLayer1InputStructure() {
 System.out.println("\n--- [Layer 1] Input Structure Gate ---");
 
 InputStructureGate gate = new InputStructureGate();
 
 String[] testCases = {
 "帮我",
 "地球是圆的吗？",
 "2024年北京奥运会什么时候举行？",
 "请解释什么是机器学习"
 };
 
 for (String input : testCases) {
 InputStructureGate.InputResult result = gate.validate(input);
 System.out.println(" Input: \"" + input + "\"");
 System.out.println(" Passed: " + result.passed + " | Completeness: " + result.completenessScore + "/100");
 if (!result.passed) {
 System.out.println(" Reason: " + result.rejectionReason);
 }
 System.out.println(" Intent: " + result.intent + " | Entities: " + (result.entities != null ? result.entities.size() : 0));
 System.out.println();
 }
 }
 
 private static void testLayer2KnowledgeModuleGate() {
 System.out.println("\n--- [Layer 2] Knowledge Module Gate ---");
 
 KnowledgeModuleGate gate = new KnowledgeModuleGate();
 
 String[][] testCases = {
 {"admin", "security_cve", "read"},
 {"guest", "security_cve", "read"},
 {"expert", "code_audit", "write"},
 {"analyst", "financial_data", "read"},
 {"guest", "medical_reference", "read"},
 {"admin", "general_knowledge", "write"}
 };
 
 for (String[] tc : testCases) {
 String role = tc[0];
 String module = tc[1];
 String action = tc[2];
 
 KnowledgeModuleGate.AccessDecision result = gate.checkAccess(role, module, action);
 System.out.println(" Role: " + role + " -> Module: " + module + " (" + action + ")");
 System.out.println(" Allowed: " + result.allowed + " | Reason: " + result.reason);
 if (result.highRiskBlock) {
 System.out.println(" [HIGH RISK BLOCKED]");
 }
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n Testing hot-update access policy:");
 gate.updateAccessPolicy("guest", "general_knowledge", KnowledgeModuleGate.AccessLevel.FULL);
 var updatedResult = gate.checkAccess("guest", "general_knowledge", "write");
 System.out.println(" Guest -> general_knowledge (write) after update: " + updatedResult.allowed);
 
 System.out.println("\n Audit logs (last 5):");
 var logs = gate.getRecentAuditLogs(5);
 for (var log : logs) {
 System.out.println(" " + log.toString());
 }
 }
 
 private static void testLayer3InputValidation() {
 System.out.println("\n--- [Layer 3] Input Validation Gate ---");
 
 InputValidationGate gate = new InputValidationGate();
 
 String[] inputs = {
 "解释相对论",
 "2+2等于多少",
 "代码审计发现漏洞"
 };
 
 String[] outputs = {
 "相对论可能是爱因斯坦提出的理论，据说改变了时空观",
 "2+2=4",
 "这段代码存在严重的安全漏洞，所有系统都受到威胁"
 };
 
 for (int i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
 float[] logits = new float[1000];
 for (int j = 0; j < 1000; j++) {
 logits[j] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
 }
 
 InputValidationGate.ValidationResult result = gate.validateOutput(inputs[i], outputs[i], logits);
 System.out.println(" Input: \"" + inputs[i] + "\"");
 System.out.println(" Output: \"" + outputs[i] + "\"");
 System.out.println(" Passed: " + result.passed + " | Intercepted: " + result.intercepted);
 System.out.println(" KL Divergence: " + String.format("%.4f", result.klDivergence));
 System.out.println(" Logical Gap: " + String.format("%.4f", result.logicalGapScore));
 System.out.println(" Uncertainty: " + String.format("%.4f", result.uncertaintyScore));
 
 if (!result.uncertainTerms.isEmpty()) {
 System.out.println(" Uncertain terms:");
 for (var term : result.uncertainTerms) {
 System.out.println(" - " + term.term + " (" + term.category + ")");
 }
 }
 System.out.println();
 }
 
 System.out.println(" Review queue size: " + gate.getReviewQueueSize());
 
 var reviewItem = gate.processNextReview();
 if (reviewItem != null) {
 System.out.println(" Processed review item: " + reviewItem.id);
 System.out.println(" Priority: " + reviewItem.priority + " | Status: " + reviewItem.status);
 System.out.println(" Note: " + reviewItem.reviewNote);
 }
 }
 
 private static void testLayer4BoundaryConstraint() {
 System.out.println("\n--- [Layer 4] Boundary Constraint Gate ---");
 
 BoundaryConstraintGate gate = new BoundaryConstraintGate();
 
 String[] testCases = {
 "请帮我写一首诗",
 "审计这段代码有没有安全漏洞",

 };
 
 for (String input : testCases) {

 System.out.println(" Input: \"" + input + "\"");

 System.out.println(" Passed: " + result.passed + " | Blocked: " + result.blocked);

 if (result.blocked) {
 System.out.println(" Error:\n" + result.errorMessage);
 }
 System.out.println();
 }

 var strictResult = gate.enforceStrictMode("审计代码漏洞", "```python\nprint('hello')\n```");

 for (var v : strictResult.validations) {

 }
 }
 
 private static void testFullSystemIntegration() {
 System.out.println("\n--- [Full System] Integration Test ---");
 
 AntiHallucinationSystem system = new AntiHallucinationSystem(128);
 
 System.out.println(" Test 1: Open-ended creative request");
 var result1 = system.processInput("请帮我写一首关于春天的诗");
 System.out.println(" Decision: " + result1.finalDecision);
 if (result1.errorMessage != null) {
 System.out.println(" Error: " + result1.errorMessage);
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n Test 2: Deterministic code audit request");
 var result2 = system.processInput("分析这段Java代码是否存在SQL注入漏洞");
 System.out.println(" Decision: " + result2.finalDecision);
 System.out.println(" Strict mode required: " + result2.layer4Result.strictModeRequired);
 
 System.out.println("\n Test 3: Knowledge access check (analyst role)");
 var access1 = system.checkKnowledgeAccess("security_cve", "read");
 System.out.println(" Analyst -> security_cve (read): " + access1.allowed);
 
 System.out.println("\n Test 4: Knowledge access check (guest role - high risk)");
 system.setRole("guest");
 var access2 = system.checkKnowledgeAccess("security_cve", "read");
 System.out.println(" Guest -> security_cve (read): " + access2.allowed + " | " + access2.reason);
 
 System.out.println("\n Test 5: Output validation chain");
 float[] logits = new float[1000];
 for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
 logits[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
 }
 var validation = system.validateOutput("解释机器学习", 
 "机器学习可能是一种AI技术，它让计算机从数据中学习", logits);
 System.out.println(" Final decision: " + validation.finalDecision);
 if (validation.layer3Result != null) {
 System.out.println(" KL Divergence: " + String.format("%.4f", validation.layer3Result.klDivergence));
 System.out.println(" Logical Gap: " + String.format("%.4f", validation.layer3Result.logicalGapScore));
 System.out.println(" Uncertainty: " + String.format("%.4f", validation.layer3Result.uncertaintyScore));
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class BoundaryConstraintGate {
 private Set<String> deterministicKeywords;
 private Set<String> openEndedKeywords;
 private StrictModeEnforcer strictModeEnforcer;
 private Map<String, String> errorTemplates;
 
 public BoundaryConstraintGate() {
 this.deterministicKeywords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "代码", "审计", "漏洞", "CVE", "修复", "检测", "验证",
 "计算", "公式", "证明", "推导", "分析", "评估", "诊断",
 "配置", "部署", "安全", "加密", "解密", "签名", "认证",
 "漏洞分析", "安全扫描", "渗透测试", "代码审查", "性能优化",
 "架构设计", "系统设计", "技术方案", "算法分析", "数据处理"
 ));
 
 this.openEndedKeywords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "创意", "故事", "小说", "诗歌", "歌词", "剧本", "想象",
 "创作", "设计", "发明", "构思", "描绘", "描写", "编",
 "诗", "歌", "散文", "随笔", "童话", "寓言", "幻想",
 "灵感", "创意设计", "艺术创作", "文学创作", "写文章", "写故事",
 "写", "作", "编", "绘", "描", "创", "讲", "述"
 ));
 
 this.strictModeEnforcer = new StrictModeEnforcer();
 this.errorTemplates = initErrorTemplates();
 }
 
 private Map<String, String> initErrorTemplates() {
 Map<String, String> templates = new HashMap<>();
 
 templates.put("OPEN_ENDED", 
 "⚠️ 操作超出模型能力边界\n" +
 "该请求涉及开放式创意生成场景，超出本模型的设计范围。\n" +
 "本模型专为确定性知识应用场景设计，包括但不限于：\n" +
 "• 代码审计与安全分析\n" +
 "• CVE漏洞匹配与修复建议\n" +
 "• 技术文档撰写与验证\n" +
 "• 数据处理与分析\n" +
 "如需创意内容生成，请使用专门的创意模型。");
 
 templates.put("STRICT_MODE_VIOLATION",
 "⚠️ 严格模式验证失败\n" +
 "在确定性知识应用场景下，输出结果未通过严格验证流程。\n" +
 "已触发复核审查流程，将由高级验证机制进行二次评估。\n" +
 "请等待复核结果或提供更多上下文信息。");
 
 templates.put("UNKNOWN_SCENE",
 "⚠️ 场景识别失败\n" +
 "无法确定当前请求的场景类型。\n" +
 "请提供更明确的指令或问题描述。");
 
 return templates;
 }
 
 public BoundaryResult checkBoundary(String input, InputStructureGate.InputResult layer1Result) {
 BoundaryResult result = new BoundaryResult();
 
 SceneType sceneType = detectSceneType(input, layer1Result);
 result.sceneType = sceneType;
 result.isDeterministic = sceneType == SceneType.DETERMINISTIC;
 result.isOpenEnded = sceneType == SceneType.OPEN_ENDED;
 
 if (sceneType == SceneType.OPEN_ENDED) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.blocked = true;
 result.errorMessage = errorTemplates.get("OPEN_ENDED");
 result.rejectionReason = "超出模型能力边界：开放式创意生成场景";
 return result;
 }
 
 if (sceneType == SceneType.DETERMINISTIC) {
 result.strictModeRequired = true;
 result.passed = true;
 return result;
 }
 
 result.passed = true;
 result.strictModeRequired = false;
 return result;
 }
 
 public StrictModeEnforcer.StrictResult enforceStrictMode(String input, String output) {
 return strictModeEnforcer.enforce(input, output);
 }
 
 private SceneType detectSceneType(String input, InputStructureGate.InputResult layer1Result) {
 int deterministicScore = 0;
 int openEndedScore = 0;
 
 for (String keyword : deterministicKeywords) {
 if (input.contains(keyword)) {
 deterministicScore += keyword.length() >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
 }
 }
 
 for (String keyword : openEndedKeywords) {
 if (input.contains(keyword)) {
 openEndedScore += keyword.length() >= 2 ? 2 : 1;
 }
 }
 
 if (layer1Result != null && layer1Result.intent != null) {
 if ("command".equals(layer1Result.intent)) {
 if (deterministicScore > 0) return SceneType.DETERMINISTIC;
 if (openEndedScore > 0) return SceneType.OPEN_ENDED;
 }
 if ("statement".equals(layer1Result.intent) && openEndedScore > 0) {
 return SceneType.OPEN_ENDED;
 }
 }
 
 if (deterministicScore >= 2) {
 return SceneType.DETERMINISTIC;
 }
 
 if (openEndedScore >= 2) {
 return SceneType.OPEN_ENDED;
 }
 
 if (deterministicScore == 1 && input.length() > 10) {
 return SceneType.DETERMINISTIC;
 }
 
 if (openEndedScore == 1 && input.length() > 10) {
 return SceneType.OPEN_ENDED;
 }
 
 return SceneType.UNKNOWN;
 }
 
 public String getErrorMessage(String templateKey) {
 return errorTemplates.getOrDefault(templateKey, errorTemplates.get("UNKNOWN_SCENE"));
 }
 
 public enum SceneType {
 DETERMINISTIC,
 OPEN_ENDED,
 UNKNOWN
 }
 
 public static class BoundaryResult {
 public boolean passed;
 public boolean blocked;
 public boolean isDeterministic;
 public boolean isOpenEnded;
 public boolean strictModeRequired;
 public SceneType sceneType;
 public String errorMessage;
 public String rejectionReason;
 }
 
 public static class StrictModeEnforcer {
 private Pattern codePattern;
 private Pattern securityPattern;
 private Pattern mathPattern;
 
 public StrictModeEnforcer() {
 this.codePattern = Pattern.compile("(代码|function|class|method|import|def|const|let|var)");
 this.securityPattern = Pattern.compile("(漏洞|CVE|攻击|安全|加密|解密|SQL注入|XSS)");
 this.mathPattern = Pattern.compile("(公式|定理|证明|推导|计算|\\d+[+\\-*/]\\d+)");
 }
 
 public StrictResult enforce(String input, String output) {
 StrictResult result = new StrictResult();
 result.validations = new ArrayList<>();
 
 if (codePattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 ValidationResult codeValid = validateCodeOutput(input, output);
 result.validations.add(codeValid);
 result.passed = result.passed && codeValid.passed;
 }
 
 if (securityPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 ValidationResult securityValid = validateSecurityOutput(input, output);
 result.validations.add(securityValid);
 result.passed = result.passed && securityValid.passed;
 }
 
 if (mathPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 ValidationResult mathValid = validateMathOutput(input, output);
 result.validations.add(mathValid);
 result.passed = result.passed && mathValid.passed;
 }
 
 if (!result.passed) {
 result.blocked = true;
 result.rejectionReason = "严格模式验证失败：" + 
 result.validations.stream()
 .filter(v -> !v.passed)
 .map(v -> v.validationType)
 .toList();
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private ValidationResult validateCodeOutput(String input, String output) {
 ValidationResult result = new ValidationResult("代码验证");
 
 if (!output.contains("```") && !output.contains("function") && !output.contains("class")) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.details = "输出未包含有效代码块";
 } else {
 result.passed = true;
 result.details = "代码格式验证通过";
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private ValidationResult validateSecurityOutput(String input, String output) {
 ValidationResult result = new ValidationResult("安全验证");
 
 if (output.contains("危险") || output.contains("风险") || output.contains("漏洞")) {
 result.passed = true;
 result.details = "安全风险识别通过";
 } else {
 result.passed = false;
 result.details = "未检测到安全风险评估";
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private ValidationResult validateMathOutput(String input, String output) {
 ValidationResult result = new ValidationResult("数学验证");
 
 if (output.matches(".*\\d+.*[=≈≈].*\\d+.*")) {
 result.passed = true;
 result.details = "数学表达式验证通过";
 } else {
 result.passed = false;
 result.details = "未包含计算结果";
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static class StrictResult {
 public boolean passed;
 public boolean blocked;
 public List<ValidationResult> validations;
 public String rejectionReason;
 }
 
 public static class ValidationResult {
 public String validationType;
 public boolean passed;
 public String details;
 
 public ValidationResult(String type) {
 this.validationType = type;
 }
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;

public class ConsistencyGate {
 private int dim;
 private float consistencyThreshold;
 
 public ConsistencyGate(int dim) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.consistencyThreshold = 0.6f;
 }
 
 public ConsistencyResult checkConsistency(Map<String, Object> syntaxTree, List<String> verifiedFacts) {
 ConsistencyResult result = new ConsistencyResult();
 result.inconsistencies = new ArrayList<>();
 result.consistencyScore = 1.0f;
 
 List<String> tokens = (List<String>) syntaxTree.get("tokens");
 String inputType = (String) syntaxTree.get("type");
 
 if ("statement".equals(inputType) && verifiedFacts.size() > 1) {
 float pairwiseConsistency = checkPairwiseConsistency(verifiedFacts);
 result.consistencyScore = pairwiseConsistency;
 
 if (pairwiseConsistency < consistencyThreshold) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "事实声明之间存在不一致";
 result.inconsistencies.add("多个事实声明之间的一致性不足");
 return result;
 }
 }
 
 boolean logicConsistent = checkLogicalConsistency(tokens);
 if (!logicConsistent) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "逻辑不一致";
 result.consistencyScore = 0.3f;
 return result;
 }
 
 boolean temporalConsistent = checkTemporalConsistency(tokens);
 if (!temporalConsistent) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "时间逻辑不一致";
 result.consistencyScore = 0.4f;
 return result;
 }
 
 result.passed = true;
 return result;
 }
 
 private float checkPairwiseConsistency(List<String> facts) {
 if (facts.size() < 2) {
 return 1.0f;
 }
 
 float totalSimilarity = 0.0f;
 int count = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < facts.size(); i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < facts.size(); j++) {
 float[] emb1 = generateEmbedding(facts.get(i));
 float[] emb2 = generateEmbedding(facts.get(j));
 totalSimilarity += cosineSimilarity(emb1, emb2);
 count++;
 }
 }
 
 return totalSimilarity / count;
 }
 
 private boolean checkLogicalConsistency(List<String> tokens) {
 boolean hasPositive = false;
 boolean hasNegative = false;
 
 Set<String> negations = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("不", "没有", "不是", "非", "无"));
 Set<String> affirmations = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("是", "有", "存在", "包含"));
 
 for (String token : tokens) {
 if (negations.contains(token)) {
 hasNegative = true;
 }
 if (affirmations.contains(token)) {
 hasPositive = true;
 }
 }
 
 if (hasPositive && hasNegative) {
 for (int i = 0; i < tokens.size() - 1; i++) {
 if (negations.contains(tokens.get(i)) && affirmations.contains(tokens.get(i + 1))) {
 return false;
 }
 }
 }
 
 return true;
 }
 
 private boolean checkTemporalConsistency(List<String> tokens) {
 boolean hasPast = false;
 boolean hasFuture = false;
 
 Set<String> pastTerms = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("曾经", "过去", "以前", "之前", "已经"));
 Set<String> futureTerms = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList("将", "会", "要", "未来", "以后", "即将"));
 
 for (String token : tokens) {
 if (pastTerms.contains(token)) {
 hasPast = true;
 }
 if (futureTerms.contains(token)) {
 hasFuture = true;
 }
 }
 
 return !(hasPast && hasFuture);
 }
 
 private float[] generateEmbedding(String text) {
 float[] embedding = new float[dim];
 int seed = text.hashCode();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 seed = (seed * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
 embedding[i] = (float) (seed / 233280.0 * 2 - 1);
 }
 
 return embedding;
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0.0f, normA = 0.0f, normB = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }
 
 public static class ConsistencyResult {
 public boolean passed;
 public List<String> inconsistencies;
 public float consistencyScore;
 public String rejectionReason;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;

public class FactVerificationGate {
 private Map<String, float[]> factDatabase;
 private int dim;
 private float verificationThreshold;
 
 public FactVerificationGate(int dim) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.factDatabase = new HashMap<>();
 this.verificationThreshold = 0.7f;
 initFactDatabase();
 }
 
 private void initFactDatabase() {
 String[] facts = {
 "地球是圆的", "光速约为30万公里/秒", "水的沸点是100摄氏度",
 "中国首都是北京", "太阳从东方升起", "人类需要呼吸氧气"
 };
 
 for (String fact : facts) {
 float[] embedding = generateEmbedding(fact);
 factDatabase.put(fact, embedding);
 }
 }
 
 public FactResult verify(Map<String, Object> syntaxTree, List<InputStructureGate.Entity> entities) {
 FactResult result = new FactResult();
 result.verifiedFacts = new ArrayList<>();
 result.unverifiedClaims = new ArrayList<>();
 result.confidenceScores = new HashMap<>();
 
 String inputType = (String) syntaxTree.get("type");
 List<String> tokens = (List<String>) syntaxTree.get("tokens");
 
 for (InputStructureGate.Entity entity : entities) {
 if ("number".equals(entity.type)) {
 boolean isVerified = verifyNumericClaim(entity.value);
 if (isVerified) {
 result.verifiedFacts.add(entity.value);
 result.confidenceScores.put(entity.value, 0.95f);
 } else {
 result.unverifiedClaims.add(entity.value);
 result.confidenceScores.put(entity.value, 0.3f);
 }
 }
 }
 
 String claim = extractClaim(tokens);
 if (claim != null && !claim.isEmpty()) {
 float confidence = checkFactConsistency(claim);
 result.confidenceScores.put(claim, confidence);
 
 if (confidence >= verificationThreshold) {
 result.verifiedFacts.add(claim);
 } else {
 result.unverifiedClaims.add(claim);
 }
 }
 
 if (!result.unverifiedClaims.isEmpty()) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "存在未验证的事实声明";
 result.confidenceScore = calculateOverallConfidence(result.confidenceScores);
 return result;
 }
 
 result.passed = true;
 result.confidenceScore = calculateOverallConfidence(result.confidenceScores);
 return result;
 }
 
 private boolean verifyNumericClaim(String number) {
 try {
 double num = Double.parseDouble(number);
 return num >= 0 && num <= 1e18;
 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 return false;
 }
 }
 
 private String extractClaim(List<String> tokens) {
 StringBuilder claim = new StringBuilder();
 boolean inClaim = false;
 
 for (String token : tokens) {
 if (token.matches("[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5a-zA-Z]+")) {
 if (claim.length() > 0) {
 claim.append(" ");
 }
 claim.append(token);
 }
 }
 
 return claim.length() > 2 ? claim.toString() : null;
 }
 
 private float checkFactConsistency(String claim) {
 float[] claimEmbedding = generateEmbedding(claim);
 float maxSimilarity = 0.0f;
 
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : factDatabase.entrySet()) {
 float similarity = cosineSimilarity(claimEmbedding, entry.getValue());
 if (similarity > maxSimilarity) {
 maxSimilarity = similarity;
 }
 }
 
 return maxSimilarity;
 }
 
 private float[] generateEmbedding(String text) {
 float[] embedding = new float[dim];
 int seed = text.hashCode();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 seed = (seed * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
 embedding[i] = (float) (seed / 233280.0 * 2 - 1);
 }
 
 return embedding;
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0.0f, normA = 0.0f, normB = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }
 
 private float calculateOverallConfidence(Map<String, Float> scores) {
 if (scores.isEmpty()) {
 return 1.0f;
 }
 
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (float score : scores.values()) {
 sum += score;
 }
 
 return sum / scores.size();
 }
 
 public void addFact(String fact) {
 float[] embedding = generateEmbedding(fact);
 factDatabase.put(fact, embedding);
 }
 
 public static class FactResult {
 public boolean passed;
 public List<String> verifiedFacts;
 public List<String> unverifiedClaims;
 public Map<String, Float> confidenceScores;
 public float confidenceScore;
 public String rejectionReason;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class InputStructureGate {
 private Set<String> requiredElements;
 private Set<String> fuzzyPatterns;
 private Set<String> greetingPatterns;
 private Pattern questionPattern;
 private Pattern commandPattern;
 private Pattern statementPattern;
 
 public InputStructureGate() {
 this.requiredElements = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "subject", "predicate", "object", "intent", "context"
 ));
 
 this.fuzzyPatterns = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "什么", "怎么样", "如何", "为什么", "多少", 
 "谁", "哪里", "什么时候", "能不能", "是否",
 "帮忙", "给我", "告诉我"
 ));
 
 this.greetingPatterns = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "你好", "您好", "hi", "hello", "嗨", "hey",
 "早上好", "下午好", "晚上好", "再见", "bye",
 "你是谁", "自我介绍", "介绍一下你自己", "你叫什么",
 "你能做什么", "功能", "帮助"
 ));
 
 this.questionPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5a-zA-Z0-9]+[?？]"
 );
 
 this.commandPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "(请|帮我|给我|让我|需要|要)[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5a-zA-Z0-9]+"
 );
 
 this.statementPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "^[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5a-zA-Z0-9,，.。、；;！!]+$"
 );
 }
 
 public InputResult validate(String input) {
 InputResult result = new InputResult();
 result.originalInput = input;
 result.processedInput = preprocess(input);
 
 // 优先检测问候语
 if (isGreeting(input)) {
 result.passed = true;
 result.intent = "greeting";
 result.completenessScore = 100;
 result.entities = new ArrayList<>();
 result.syntaxTree = new HashMap<>();
 result.syntaxTree.put("type", "greeting");
 result.context = "greeting";
 return result;
 }
 
 if (isFuzzyQuestion(input)) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "模糊提问：请提供更具体的信息";
 return result;
 }
 
 result.syntaxTree = parseSyntaxTree(input);
 result.entities = extractEntities(input);
 result.semanticRoles = extractSemanticRoles(input);
 result.intent = classifyIntent(input);
 result.context = extractContext(input);
 
 int completenessScore = checkCompleteness(result);
 
 if (completenessScore < 60) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "请求要素不完整（评分：" + completenessScore + "/100）";
 return result;
 }
 
 if (!isCompliantRequest(result)) {
 result.passed = false;
 result.rejectionReason = "请求不符合规范";
 return result;
 }
 
 result.passed = true;
 result.completenessScore = completenessScore;
 return result;
 }
 
 private String preprocess(String input) {
 input = input.trim();
 input = input.replaceAll("[\\s]+", " ");
 return input;
 }
 
 private boolean isFuzzyQuestion(String input) {
 // 问候语不算模糊提问
 if (isGreeting(input)) return false;
 
 int fuzzyCount = 0;
 for (String pattern : fuzzyPatterns) {
 if (input.contains(pattern)) {
 fuzzyCount++;
 }
 }
 
 if (fuzzyCount >= 2 && input.length() < 10) {
 return true;
 }
 
 // 仅当不是问候且非常短时才判为模糊
 if (input.length() < 3 && !isGreeting(input)) {
 return true;
 }
 
 return false;
 }
 
 private boolean isGreeting(String input) {
 String lower = input.toLowerCase().trim();
 for (String pattern : greetingPatterns) {
 if (lower.contains(pattern.toLowerCase())) {
 return true;
 }
 }
 return false;
 }
 
 private Map<String, Object> parseSyntaxTree(String input) {
 Map<String, Object> tree = new HashMap<>();
 
 if (questionPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 tree.put("type", "question");
 } else if (commandPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 tree.put("type", "command");
 } else {
 tree.put("type", "statement");
 }
 
 tree.put("length", input.length());
 tree.put("tokens", tokenize(input));
 
 return tree;
 }
 
 private List<String> tokenize(String input) {
 List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
 StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
 
 for (char c : input.toCharArray()) {
 if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
 current.append(c);
 } else {
 if (current.length() > 0) {
 tokens.add(current.toString());
 current = new StringBuilder();
 }
 if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
 tokens.add(String.valueOf(c));
 }
 }
 }
 
 if (current.length() > 0) {
 tokens.add(current.toString());
 }
 
 return tokens;
 }
 
 private List<Entity> extractEntities(String input) {
 List<Entity> entities = new ArrayList<>();
 
 Pattern datePattern = Pattern.compile("\\d{4}[-/]\\d{1,2}[-/]\\d{1,2}");
 Matcher dateMatcher = datePattern.matcher(input);
 while (dateMatcher.find()) {
 entities.add(new Entity(dateMatcher.group(), "date"));
 }
 
 Pattern numberPattern = Pattern.compile("\\d+[\\d.]*");
 Matcher numberMatcher = numberPattern.matcher(input);
 while (numberMatcher.find()) {
 entities.add(new Entity(numberMatcher.group(), "number"));
 }
 
 Pattern personPattern = Pattern.compile("[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]{2,4}(先生|女士|博士|教授|老师)?");
 Matcher personMatcher = personPattern.matcher(input);
 while (personMatcher.find()) {
 entities.add(new Entity(personMatcher.group(), "person"));
 }
 
 return entities;
 }
 
 private Map<String, String> extractSemanticRoles(String input) {
 Map<String, String> roles = new HashMap<>();
 
 if (input.contains("因为")) {
 roles.put("cause", input.substring(input.indexOf("因为") + 2));
 }
 
 if (input.contains("所以") || input.contains("因此")) {
 roles.put("effect", input.substring(input.indexOf("所以") > 0 ? 
 input.indexOf("所以") + 2 : input.indexOf("因此") + 2));
 }
 
 if (input.contains("如果") || input.contains("假如")) {
 roles.put("condition", input.substring(input.indexOf("如果") > 0 ? 
 input.indexOf("如果") + 2 : input.indexOf("假如") + 2));
 }
 
 return roles;
 }
 
 private String classifyIntent(String input) {
 if (questionPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 return "question";
 }
 if (commandPattern.matcher(input).find()) {
 return "command";
 }
 return "statement";
 }
 
 private String extractContext(String input) {
 if (input.length() < 20) {
 return "short";
 }
 if (input.length() < 50) {
 return "medium";
 }
 return "long";
 }
 
 private int checkCompleteness(InputResult result) {
 int score = 0;
 
 if (result.intent != null && !result.intent.isEmpty()) {
 score += 20;
 }
 
 if (result.entities != null && result.entities.size() > 0) {
 score += 30;
 }
 
 if (result.semanticRoles != null && result.semanticRoles.size() > 0) {
 score += 20;
 }
 
 if (result.context != null) {
 score += 15;
 }
 
 if (result.processedInput.length() >= 5) {
 score += 15;
 }
 
 return score;
 }
 
 private boolean isCompliantRequest(InputResult result) {
 if (result.intent.equals("question") && result.entities.isEmpty()) {
 return false;
 }
 
 return true;
 }
 
 public static class InputResult {
 public boolean passed;
 public String originalInput;
 public String processedInput;
 public Map<String, Object> syntaxTree;
 public List<Entity> entities;
 public Map<String, String> semanticRoles;
 public String intent;
 public String context;
 public int completenessScore;
 public String rejectionReason;
 }
 
 public static class Entity {
 public String value;
 public String type;
 
 public Entity(String value, String type) {
 this.value = value;
 this.type = type;
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class InputValidationGate {
 private static final float KL_DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.5f;
 private static final float LOGICAL_GAP_THRESHOLD = 0.3f;
 private static final float UNCERTAINTY_THRESHOLD = 0.4f;
 
 private Set<String> absoluteTerms;
 private Set<String> overgeneralizationTerms;
 private Set<String> unfoundedTerms;
 private Map<String, float[]> trainingDataStats;
 private Queue<ReviewItem> reviewQueue;
 
 public InputValidationGate() {
 this.absoluteTerms = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "所有", "全部", "完全", "绝对", "必须", "一定", "肯定",
 "毫无", "从未", "永远", "始终", "必然", "必定", "绝不可能"
 ));
 
 this.overgeneralizationTerms = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "普遍", "大多数", "通常", "一般来说", "基本上", "大体上",
 "总体而言", "整体来看", "往往", "常常", "总是"
 ));
 
 this.unfoundedTerms = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "可能", "也许", "大概", "据说", "据称", "有人说",
 "应该是", "似乎", "好像", "仿佛", "感觉", "认为"
 ));
 
 this.trainingDataStats = initTrainingDataStats();
 this.reviewQueue = new LinkedList<>();
 }
 
 private Map<String, float[]> initTrainingDataStats() {
 Map<String, float[]> stats = new HashMap<>();
 
 float[] commonDistribution = new float[1000];
 for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
 commonDistribution[i] = (float) Math.exp(-i * 0.01);
 }
 normalize(commonDistribution);
 stats.put("common", commonDistribution);
 
 float[] factualDistribution = new float[1000];
 for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
 factualDistribution[i] = (float) Math.exp(-i * 0.005);
 }
 normalize(factualDistribution);
 stats.put("factual", factualDistribution);
 
 return stats;
 }
 
 public ValidationResult validateOutput(String input, String output, float[] outputLogits) {
 ValidationResult result = new ValidationResult();
 result.input = input;
 result.output = output;
 result.checks = new ArrayList<>();
 
 KLCheckResult klResult = checkFactConsistency(outputLogits);
 result.klDivergence = klResult.klDivergence;
 result.factConsistent = klResult.passed;
 result.checks.add(new CheckItem("KL散度校验", klResult.passed, 
 String.format("KL散度: %.4f (阈值: %.2f)", klResult.klDivergence, KL_DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD)));
 
 LogicalGapResult gapResult = checkLogicalGap(input, output);
 result.logicalGapScore = gapResult.gapScore;
 result.logicallyComplete = gapResult.passed;
 result.checks.add(new CheckItem("逻辑断层检测", gapResult.passed, 
 String.format("逻辑连贯性: %.4f (阈值: %.2f)", gapResult.gapScore, LOGICAL_GAP_THRESHOLD)));
 
 UncertaintyResult uncertaintyResult = checkInferenceRationality(output);
 result.uncertaintyScore = uncertaintyResult.score;
 result.inferenceRational = uncertaintyResult.passed;
 result.uncertainTerms = uncertaintyResult.uncertainTerms;
 result.checks.add(new CheckItem("推断合理性审查", uncertaintyResult.passed, 
 String.format("不确定性评分: %.4f (阈值: %.2f)", uncertaintyResult.score, UNCERTAINTY_THRESHOLD)));
 
 result.passed = klResult.passed && gapResult.passed && uncertaintyResult.passed;
 
 if (!result.passed) {
 result.intercepted = true;
 triggerReview(result);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private KLCheckResult checkFactConsistency(float[] logits) {
 KLCheckResult result = new KLCheckResult();
 
 if (logits == null || logits.length == 0) {
 result.klDivergence = 0.0f;
 result.passed = true;
 return result;
 }
 
 float[] targetDistribution = trainingDataStats.get("factual");
 float[] outputDistribution = softmax(logits);
 
 float kl = computeKLDivergence(outputDistribution, targetDistribution);
 result.klDivergence = kl;
 result.passed = kl < KL_DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD;
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private LogicalGapResult checkLogicalGap(String input, String output) {
 LogicalGapResult result = new LogicalGapResult();
 
 Set<String> inputKeywords = extractKeywords(input);
 Set<String> outputKeywords = extractKeywords(output);
 
 if (inputKeywords.isEmpty()) {
 result.gapScore = 1.0f;
 result.passed = true;
 return result;
 }
 
 int intersection = 0;
 for (String keyword : inputKeywords) {
 if (outputKeywords.contains(keyword)) {
 intersection++;
 } else {
 for (String outputKeyword : outputKeywords) {
 if (output.contains(keyword) || keyword.contains(outputKeyword)) {
 intersection++;
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 float coherence = (float) intersection / inputKeywords.size();
 result.gapScore = coherence;
 result.passed = coherence > LOGICAL_GAP_THRESHOLD;
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private UncertaintyResult checkInferenceRationality(String output) {
 UncertaintyResult result = new UncertaintyResult();
 result.uncertainTerms = new ArrayList<>();
 
 int absoluteCount = 0;
 int overgenCount = 0;
 int unfoundedCount = 0;
 
 for (String term : absoluteTerms) {
 if (output.contains(term)) {
 absoluteCount++;
 result.uncertainTerms.add(new UncertainTerm(term, "绝对化表述"));
 }
 }
 
 for (String term : overgeneralizationTerms) {
 if (output.contains(term)) {
 overgenCount++;
 result.uncertainTerms.add(new UncertainTerm(term, "过度概括"));
 }
 }
 
 for (String term : unfoundedTerms) {
 if (output.contains(term)) {
 unfoundedCount++;
 result.uncertainTerms.add(new UncertainTerm(term, "缺乏依据"));
 }
 }
 
 int totalTerms = countWords(output);
 float uncertainty = (float) (absoluteCount + overgenCount + unfoundedCount) / Math.max(totalTerms, 1);
 
 result.score = uncertainty;
 result.passed = uncertainty < UNCERTAINTY_THRESHOLD;
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private void triggerReview(ValidationResult result) {
 ReviewItem item = new ReviewItem();
 item.id = "REV-" + System.currentTimeMillis();
 item.timestamp = java.time.LocalDateTime.now();
 item.input = result.input;
 item.output = result.output;
 item.validationResult = result;
 item.priority = calculatePriority(result);
 item.status = ReviewStatus.PENDING;
 
 reviewQueue.add(item);
 }
 
 private ReviewPriority calculatePriority(ValidationResult result) {
 int failedChecks = 0;
 if (!result.factConsistent) failedChecks++;
 if (!result.logicallyComplete) failedChecks++;
 if (!result.inferenceRational) failedChecks++;
 
 if (failedChecks >= 3) {
 return ReviewPriority.HIGH;
 } else if (failedChecks >= 2) {
 return ReviewPriority.MEDIUM;
 } else {
 return ReviewPriority.LOW;
 }
 }
 
 public ReviewItem processNextReview() {
 if (reviewQueue.isEmpty()) {
 return null;
 }
 
 ReviewItem item = reviewQueue.poll();
 
 if (item.priority == ReviewPriority.HIGH) {
 item.status = ReviewStatus.IN_PROGRESS;
 
 if (item.validationResult.klDivergence > KL_DIVERGENCE_THRESHOLD * 2) {
 item.status = ReviewStatus.REJECTED;
 item.reviewNote = "KL散度过高，事实严重偏离";
 } else {
 item.status = ReviewStatus.APPROVED;
 item.reviewNote = "复核通过，建议附带不确定性说明";
 }
 } else {
 item.status = ReviewStatus.AUTO_APPROVED;
 item.reviewNote = "低优先级自动复核通过";
 }
 
 return item;
 }
 
 public int getReviewQueueSize() {
 return reviewQueue.size();
 }
 
 private float[] softmax(float[] logits) {
 float[] result = new float[logits.length];
 float max = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float l : logits) {
 if (l > max) max = l;
 }
 
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 sum += result[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private void normalize(float[] distribution) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (float v : distribution) {
 sum += v;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < distribution.length; i++) {
 distribution[i] /= sum;
 }
 }
 
 private float computeKLDivergence(float[] p, float[] q) {
 int minLen = Math.min(p.length, q.length);
 float kl = 0.0f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < minLen; i++) {
 if (p[i] > 0 && q[i] > 0) {
 kl += p[i] * (float) Math.log(p[i] / q[i]);
 }
 }
 
 return kl;
 }
 
 private Set<String> extractKeywords(String text) {
 Set<String> keywords = new HashSet<>();
 
 Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]+|[a-zA-Z]{2,}");
 Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(text);
 
 while (matcher.find()) {
 String match = matcher.group();
 keywords.add(match);
 
 if (match.length() >= 2) {
 for (int i = 0; i < match.length(); i++) {
 keywords.add(String.valueOf(match.charAt(i)));
 }
 }
 }
 
 return keywords;
 }
 
 private int countWords(String text) {
 int count = 0;
 boolean inWord = false;
 for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
 if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
 if (!inWord) {
 count++;
 inWord = true;
 }
 } else {
 inWord = false;
 }
 }
 return count;
 }
 
 public static class ValidationResult {
 public String input;
 public String output;
 public boolean passed;
 public boolean intercepted;
 
 public float klDivergence;
 public boolean factConsistent;
 
 public float logicalGapScore;
 public boolean logicallyComplete;
 
 public float uncertaintyScore;
 public boolean inferenceRational;
 public List<UncertainTerm> uncertainTerms;
 
 public List<CheckItem> checks;
 }
 
 public static class CheckItem {
 public String name;
 public boolean passed;
 public String details;
 
 public CheckItem(String name, boolean passed, String details) {
 this.name = name;
 this.passed = passed;
 this.details = details;
 }
 }
 
 public static class KLCheckResult {
 public float klDivergence;
 public boolean passed;
 }
 
 public static class LogicalGapResult {
 public float gapScore;
 public boolean passed;
 }
 
 public static class UncertaintyResult {
 public float score;
 public boolean passed;
 public List<UncertainTerm> uncertainTerms;
 }
 
 public static class UncertainTerm {
 public String term;
 public String category;
 
 public UncertainTerm(String term, String category) {
 this.term = term;
 this.category = category;
 }
 }
 
 public static class ReviewItem {
 public String id;
 public java.time.LocalDateTime timestamp;
 public String input;
 public String output;
 public ValidationResult validationResult;
 public ReviewPriority priority;
 public ReviewStatus status;
 public String reviewNote;
 }
 
 public enum ReviewPriority {
 HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
 }
 
 public enum ReviewStatus {
 PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, APPROVED, REJECTED, AUTO_APPROVED
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;
import java.time.*;

public class KnowledgeModuleGate {
 private Map<String, AccessPolicy> accessPolicies;
 private Map<String, KnowledgeModule> knowledgeModules;
 private Map<String, RoleDefinition> roles;
 private List<AccessAuditLog> auditLogs;
 private int maxAuditLogs;
 private boolean highRiskEnabled;
 
 public KnowledgeModuleGate() {
 this.accessPolicies = new HashMap<>();
 this.knowledgeModules = new HashMap<>();
 this.roles = new HashMap<>();
 this.auditLogs = new ArrayList<>();
 this.maxAuditLogs = 10000;
 this.highRiskEnabled = true;
 
 initDefaultRoles();
 initDefaultModules();
 }
 
 private void initDefaultRoles() {
 RoleDefinition admin = new RoleDefinition("admin", RoleLevel.ADMIN);
 admin.addPermission("read");
 admin.addPermission("write");
 admin.addPermission("manage");
 roles.put("admin", admin);
 
 RoleDefinition expert = new RoleDefinition("expert", RoleLevel.HIGH);
 expert.addPermission("read");
 expert.addPermission("write");
 roles.put("expert", expert);
 
 RoleDefinition analyst = new RoleDefinition("analyst", RoleLevel.MEDIUM);
 analyst.addPermission("read");
 roles.put("analyst", analyst);
 
 RoleDefinition guest = new RoleDefinition("guest", RoleLevel.LOW);
 guest.addPermission("read");
 guest.setReadOnly(true);
 roles.put("guest", guest);
 }
 
 private void initDefaultModules() {
 addKnowledgeModule("security_cve", "CVE漏洞数据库", "security", true);
 addKnowledgeModule("code_audit", "代码审计知识库", "engineering", true);
 addKnowledgeModule("financial_data", "金融数据知识库", "finance", false);
 addKnowledgeModule("medical_reference", "医学参考知识库", "medical", true);
 addKnowledgeModule("general_knowledge", "通用知识库", "general", false);
 
 setAccessPolicy("admin", "security_cve", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("expert", "security_cve", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("analyst", "security_cve", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 setAccessPolicy("guest", "security_cve", AccessLevel.DENY);
 
 setAccessPolicy("admin", "code_audit", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("expert", "code_audit", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("analyst", "code_audit", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 setAccessPolicy("guest", "code_audit", AccessLevel.DENY);
 
 setAccessPolicy("admin", "financial_data", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("expert", "financial_data", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("analyst", "financial_data", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 setAccessPolicy("guest", "financial_data", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 
 setAccessPolicy("admin", "medical_reference", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("expert", "medical_reference", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("analyst", "medical_reference", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 setAccessPolicy("guest", "medical_reference", AccessLevel.DENY);
 
 setAccessPolicy("admin", "general_knowledge", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("expert", "general_knowledge", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("analyst", "general_knowledge", AccessLevel.FULL);
 setAccessPolicy("guest", "general_knowledge", AccessLevel.READ_ONLY);
 }
 
 public void addKnowledgeModule(String moduleId, String name, String category, boolean isHighRisk) {
 KnowledgeModule module = new KnowledgeModule(moduleId, name, category, isHighRisk);
 knowledgeModules.put(moduleId, module);
 }
 
 public void setAccessPolicy(String roleId, String moduleId, AccessLevel level) {
 String key = roleId + ":" + moduleId;
 AccessPolicy policy = new AccessPolicy(roleId, moduleId, level);
 accessPolicies.put(key, policy);
 }
 
 public AccessDecision checkAccess(String roleId, String moduleId, String action) {
 AccessDecision decision = new AccessDecision();
 decision.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
 decision.roleId = roleId;
 decision.moduleId = moduleId;
 decision.action = action;
 
 RoleDefinition role = roles.get(roleId);
 KnowledgeModule module = knowledgeModules.get(moduleId);
 
 if (role == null) {
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "角色不存在: " + roleId;
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 if (module == null) {
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "知识模块不存在: " + moduleId;
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 String policyKey = roleId + ":" + moduleId;
 AccessPolicy policy = accessPolicies.get(policyKey);
 
 if (policy == null) {
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "未找到访问策略";
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 decision.accessLevel = policy.level;
 
 if (module.isHighRisk && !role.isHighLevel()) {
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "高风险模块需要高级角色权限";
 decision.highRiskBlock = true;
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 if (!role.hasPermission(action)) {
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "角色缺少权限: " + action;
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 switch (policy.level) {
 case FULL:
 decision.allowed = true;
 decision.reason = "完全访问权限";
 break;
 case READ_ONLY:
 decision.allowed = "read".equals(action);
 decision.reason = decision.allowed ? "只读访问权限" : "只读模块禁止写操作";
 break;
 case DENY:
 decision.allowed = false;
 decision.reason = "访问被拒绝";
 break;
 }
 
 logAccess(decision);
 return decision;
 }
 
 public void updateAccessPolicy(String roleId, String moduleId, AccessLevel newLevel) {
 setAccessPolicy(roleId, moduleId, newLevel);
 
 RoleDefinition role = roles.get(roleId);
 if (role != null) {
 if (newLevel == AccessLevel.FULL) {
 role.addPermission("read");
 role.addPermission("write");
 role.addPermission("manage");
 role.readOnly = false;
 } else if (newLevel == AccessLevel.READ_ONLY) {
 role.addPermission("read");
 role.readOnly = true;
 }
 }
 
 AccessAuditLog log = new AccessAuditLog();
 log.timestamp = LocalDateTime.now();
 log.roleId = roleId;
 log.moduleId = moduleId;
 log.action = "POLICY_UPDATE";
 log.allowed = true;
 log.reason = "策略更新: " + newLevel;
 auditLogs.add(log);
 trimAuditLogs();
 }
 
 public void addRole(String roleId, RoleLevel level) {
 RoleDefinition role = new RoleDefinition(roleId, level);
 roles.put(roleId, role);
 }
 
 public void addRolePermission(String roleId, String permission) {
 RoleDefinition role = roles.get(roleId);
 if (role != null) {
 role.addPermission(permission);
 }
 }
 
 public List<AccessAuditLog> getAuditLogs(String moduleId) {
 List<AccessAuditLog> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
 for (AccessAuditLog log : auditLogs) {
 if (moduleId == null || moduleId.equals(log.moduleId)) {
 filtered.add(log);
 }
 }
 return filtered;
 }
 
 public List<AccessAuditLog> getRecentAuditLogs(int limit) {
 int start = Math.max(0, auditLogs.size() - limit);
 return new ArrayList<>(auditLogs.subList(start, auditLogs.size()));
 }
 
 private void logAccess(AccessDecision decision) {
 AccessAuditLog log = new AccessAuditLog();
 log.timestamp = decision.timestamp;
 log.roleId = decision.roleId;
 log.moduleId = decision.moduleId;
 log.action = decision.action;
 log.allowed = decision.allowed;
 log.reason = decision.reason;
 log.highRiskBlock = decision.highRiskBlock;
 
 auditLogs.add(log);
 trimAuditLogs();
 }
 
 private void trimAuditLogs() {
 while (auditLogs.size() > maxAuditLogs) {
 auditLogs.remove(0);
 }
 }
 
 public enum RoleLevel {
 ADMIN, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
 }
 
 public enum AccessLevel {
 FULL, READ_ONLY, DENY
 }
 
 public static class RoleDefinition {
 public String roleId;
 public RoleLevel level;
 public Set<String> permissions;
 public boolean readOnly;
 
 public RoleDefinition(String roleId, RoleLevel level) {
 this.roleId = roleId;
 this.level = level;
 this.permissions = new HashSet<>();
 this.readOnly = false;
 }
 
 public void addPermission(String permission) {
 permissions.add(permission);
 }
 
 public boolean hasPermission(String permission) {
 return permissions.contains(permission);
 }
 
 public boolean isHighLevel() {
 return level == RoleLevel.ADMIN || level == RoleLevel.HIGH;
 }
 
 public void setReadOnly(boolean readOnly) {
 this.readOnly = readOnly;
 }
 }
 
 public static class KnowledgeModule {
 public String moduleId;
 public String name;
 public String category;
 public boolean isHighRisk;
 
 public KnowledgeModule(String moduleId, String name, String category, boolean isHighRisk) {
 this.moduleId = moduleId;
 this.name = name;
 this.category = category;
 this.isHighRisk = isHighRisk;
 }
 }
 
 public static class AccessPolicy {
 public String roleId;
 public String moduleId;
 public AccessLevel level;
 
 public AccessPolicy(String roleId, String moduleId, AccessLevel level) {
 this.roleId = roleId;
 this.moduleId = moduleId;
 this.level = level;
 }
 }
 
 public static class AccessDecision {
 public LocalDateTime timestamp;
 public String roleId;
 public String moduleId;
 public String action;
 public boolean allowed;
 public String reason;
 public AccessLevel accessLevel;
 public boolean highRiskBlock;
 }
 
 public static class AccessAuditLog {
 public LocalDateTime timestamp;
 public String roleId;
 public String moduleId;
 public String action;
 public boolean allowed;
 public String reason;
 public boolean highRiskBlock;
 
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("[%s] %s -> %s (%s): %s [%s]",
 timestamp.toString(), roleId, moduleId, action,
 allowed ? "ALLOWED" : "DENIED", reason);
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

public class OutputValidationGate {
 private Set<String> hallucinationPatterns;
 private Pattern uncertainPattern;
 private Pattern contradictionPattern;
 private Pattern excessiveClaimPattern;
 
 public OutputValidationGate() {
 this.hallucinationPatterns = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
 "可能", "也许", "大概", "据说", "据称", "有人说",
 "应该是", "似乎", "好像", "仿佛", "感觉", "认为"
 ));
 
 this.uncertainPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "(可能|也许|大概|据说|据称|有人说|应该是|似乎|好像|仿佛)"
 );
 
 this.contradictionPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "(但是|然而|却|可是)[^。；;！!？?]*([不|没有|非|无])"
 );
 
 this.excessiveClaimPattern = Pattern.compile(
 "(所有|全部|完全|绝对|必须|一定|肯定)[^。；;！!？?]{0,10}(是|有|会|能)"
 );
 }
 
 public OutputResult validate(String input, String output) {
 OutputResult result = new OutputResult();
 result.hallucinationDetected = false;
 result.hallucinationScore = 0.0f;
 result.issues = new ArrayList<>();
 
 int hallucinationCount = 0;
 int totalWords = countWords(output);
 
 for (String pattern : hallucinationPatterns) {
 if (output.contains(pattern)) {
 hallucinationCount++;
 }
 }
 
 if (uncertainPattern.matcher(output).find()) {
 hallucinationCount += 2;
 result.issues.add("包含不确定表述");
 }
 
 if (contradictionPattern.matcher(output).find()) {
 hallucinationCount += 3;
 result.issues.add("存在矛盾表述");
 }
 
 if (excessiveClaimPattern.matcher(output).find()) {
 hallucinationCount += 2;
 result.issues.add("包含过度绝对化表述");
 }
 
 boolean isRelevant = checkRelevance(input, output);
 if (!isRelevant) {
 result.hallucinationDetected = true;
 result.hallucinationScore = 0.8f;
 result.issues.add("输出与输入不相关");
 return result;
 }
 
 boolean hasFacts = checkFactuality(output);
 if (!hasFacts && totalWords > 20) {
 result.hallucinationScore = 0.4f;
 result.issues.add("缺少事实依据");
 }
 
 float score = (float) hallucinationCount / Math.max(totalWords, 1);
 result.hallucinationScore = Math.min(score, 1.0f);
 
 if (result.hallucinationScore > 0.3f) {
 result.hallucinationDetected = true;
 }
 
 result.valid = !result.hallucinationDetected;
 return result;
 }
 
 private int countWords(String text) {
 int count = 0;
 boolean inWord = false;
 
 for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
 if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
 if (!inWord) {
 count++;
 inWord = true;
 }
 } else {
 inWord = false;
 }
 }
 
 return count;
 }
 
 private boolean checkRelevance(String input, String output) {
 Set<String> inputWords = extractKeyWords(input);
 Set<String> outputWords = extractKeyWords(output);
 
 if (inputWords.isEmpty()) {
 return true;
 }
 
 int intersection = 0;
 for (String word : inputWords) {
 if (outputWords.contains(word)) {
 intersection++;
 }
 }
 
 return (float) intersection / inputWords.size() >= 0.3f;
 }
 
 private Set<String> extractKeyWords(String text) {
 Set<String> words = new HashSet<>();
 Pattern wordPattern = Pattern.compile("[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]{2,}|[a-zA-Z]+");
 Matcher matcher = wordPattern.matcher(text);
 
 while (matcher.find()) {
 String word = matcher.group().toLowerCase();
 if (word.length() >= 2) {
 words.add(word);
 }
 }
 
 return words;
 }
 
 private boolean checkFactuality(String text) {
 Pattern datePattern = Pattern.compile("\\d{4}[-/]\\d{1,2}[-/]\\d{1,2}");
 Pattern numberPattern = Pattern.compile("\\d+[\\d.]*[万|亿|%|倍|年|月|日|米|公里|元]");
 Pattern sourcePattern = Pattern.compile("(根据|依据|参考|来自)[^。；;！!？?]{0,20}(报告|研究|数据|文献)");
 
 return datePattern.matcher(text).find() || 
 numberPattern.matcher(text).find() ||
 sourcePattern.matcher(text).find();
 }
 
 public static class OutputResult {
 public boolean valid;
 public boolean hallucinationDetected;
 public float hallucinationScore;
 public List<String> issues;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.api;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;

public class APIServer {
 
 public interface RequestHandler {
 String handle(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params);
 }
 
 public interface WebSocketCallback {
 void onMessage(String message);
 void onClose();
 }
 
 private final Map<String, RequestHandler> handlers;
 private final List<WebSocketCallback> webSocketCallbacks;
 private final ExecutorService executor;
 private ServerSocket serverSocket;
 private volatile boolean running;
 private final int port;
 private volatile int requestCount;
 private volatile long totalLatencyMs;
 
 public APIServer(int port) {
 this.port = port;
 this.handlers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.webSocketCallbacks = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(16);
 this.running = false;
 this.requestCount = 0;
 this.totalLatencyMs = 0;
 registerDefaultHandlers();
 }
 
 public APIServer() {
 this(8080);
 }
 
 private void registerDefaultHandlers() {
 handlers.put("/api/v1/generate", this::handleGenerate);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/chat", this::handleChat);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/models", this::handleModels);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/health", this::handleHealth);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/embeddings", this::handleEmbeddings);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/completions", this::handleCompletions);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/knowledge", this::handleKnowledge);
 handlers.put("/api/v1/agent", this::handleAgent);
 }
 
 public void registerHandler(String path, RequestHandler handler) {
 handlers.put(path.toLowerCase(), handler);
 }
 
 public void start() throws IOException {
 if (running) return;
 
 serverSocket = new ServerSocket(port);
 running = true;
 
 executor.submit(() -> {
 while (running) {
 try {
 Socket clientSocket = serverSocket.accept();
 executor.submit(() -> handleClient(clientSocket));
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (!running) break;
 }
 }
 });
 
 System.out.println("[APIServer] Started on port " + port);
 }
 
 public void stop() {
 running = false;
 try {
 if (serverSocket != null) {
 serverSocket.close();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[APIServer] Stop error: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 executor.shutdown();
 System.out.println("[APIServer] Stopped");
 }
 
 private void handleClient(Socket clientSocket) {
 try (BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(clientSocket.getInputStream()));
 PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(clientSocket.getOutputStream(), true)) {
 
 String line = in.readLine();
 if (line == null) return;
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 String response = processRequest(line);
 long latency = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 
 synchronized (this) {
 requestCount++;
 totalLatencyMs += latency;
 }
 
 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println("Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *");
 out.println();
 out.println(response);
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[APIServer] Client error: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 private String processRequest(String requestLine) {
 String[] parts = requestLine.split(" ");
 if (parts.length < 2) return "{\"error\": \"Invalid request\"}";
 
 String method = parts[0];
 String path = parts[1];
 
 Map<String, String> params = new HashMap<>();
 if (path.contains("?")) {
 String[] pathParts = path.split("\\?", 2);
 path = pathParts[0];
 String query = pathParts[1];
 for (String param : query.split("&")) {
 String[] keyValue = param.split("=", 2);
 if (keyValue.length == 2) {
 params.put(keyValue[0], URLDecoder.decode(keyValue[1]));
 }
 }
 }
 
 RequestHandler handler = handlers.get(path.toLowerCase());
 if (handler != null) {
 return handler.handle(path, method, params);
 }
 
 return "{\"error\": \"Not found\", \"path\": \"" + path + "\"}";
 }
 
 private String handleGenerate(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String prompt = params.getOrDefault("prompt", "");
 int maxTokens = Integer.parseInt(params.getOrDefault("maxTokens", "100"));
 return String.format("{\"text\": \"Generated response for: %s\", \"maxTokens\": %d}", prompt, maxTokens);
 }
 
 private String handleChat(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String message = params.getOrDefault("message", "");
 String history = params.getOrDefault("history", "[]");
 return String.format("{\"response\": \"Chat response to: %s\", \"history\": %s}", message, history);
 }
 
 private String handleModels(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 return "[{\"name\": \"SC-Tiny-1M\", \"params\": 1000000}, " +
 "{\"name\": \"SC-Small-10M\", \"params\": 10000000}, " +
 "{\"name\": \"SC-Medium-1B\", \"params\": 1000000000}, " +
 "{\"name\": \"SC-Large-7B\", \"params\": 7000000000}, " +
 "{\"name\": \"SC-Giant-70B\", \"params\": 70000000000}]";
 }
 
 private String handleHealth(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 return String.format("{\"status\": \"healthy\", \"requests\": %d, \"avgLatency\": %.2fms}",
 requestCount, getAvgLatency());
 }
 
 private String handleEmbeddings(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String text = params.getOrDefault("text", "");
 int dimensions = Integer.parseInt(params.getOrDefault("dimensions", "768"));
 return String.format("{\"embedding\": [%d dimensions], \"text\": \"%s\"}", dimensions, text);
 }
 
 private String handleCompletions(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String prompt = params.getOrDefault("prompt", "");
 int maxTokens = Integer.parseInt(params.getOrDefault("maxTokens", "50"));
 return String.format("{\"choices\": [{\"text\": \"Completion for: %s\"}], \"usage\": {\"total_tokens\": %d}}", prompt, maxTokens);
 }
 
 private String handleKnowledge(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String query = params.getOrDefault("query", "");
 return String.format("{\"results\": [{\"content\": \"Knowledge result for: %s\", \"relevance\": 0.95}]}", query);
 }
 
 private String handleAgent(String path, String method, Map<String, String> params) {
 String input = params.getOrDefault("input", "");
 return String.format("{\"response\": \"Agent processed: %s\"}", input);
 }
 
 public void addWebSocketCallback(WebSocketCallback callback) {
 webSocketCallbacks.add(callback);
 }
 
 public void broadcastMessage(String message) {
 for (WebSocketCallback callback : webSocketCallbacks) {
 callback.onMessage(message);
 }
 }
 
 public synchronized int getRequestCount() {
 return requestCount;
 }
 
 public synchronized double getAvgLatency() {
 return requestCount > 0 ? (double) totalLatencyMs / requestCount : 0;
 }
 
 public boolean isRunning() {
 return running;
 }
 
 public int getPort() {
 return port;
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "APIServer: running=%s, port=%d, handlers=%d, requests=%d, avgLatency=%.2fms",
 running, port, handlers.size(), requestCount, getAvgLatency()
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd;

import java.util.*;

public final class AutogradEngine {
 
 private AutogradEngine() {}
 
 public static Tensor add(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 if (!a.requiresGrad && !b.requiresGrad) {
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] + b.data[i];
 }
 return new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] + b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad;
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.AddNode(new Tensor[]{a, b}, result);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor sub(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 if (!a.requiresGrad && !b.requiresGrad) {
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] - b.data[i];
 }
 return new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] - b.data[i];
 }
 
 float[] bNeg = new float[b.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < b.numel; i++) {
 bNeg[i] = -b.data[i];
 }
 Tensor bNegTensor = new Tensor(bNeg, b.shape);
 bNegTensor.requiresGrad = b.requiresGrad;
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad;
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.AddNode(new Tensor[]{a, bNegTensor}, result);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor mul(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 if (!a.requiresGrad && !b.requiresGrad) {
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] * b.data[i];
 }
 return new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] * b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad;
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.MulNode(new Tensor[]{a, b}, result);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor div(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 if (!a.requiresGrad && !b.requiresGrad) {
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] / b.data[i];
 }
 return new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[a.numel];
 float[] bInv = new float[b.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.numel; i++) {
 bInv[i] = 1.0f / b.data[i];
 resultData[i] = a.data[i] * bInv[i];
 }
 
 Tensor bInvTensor = new Tensor(bInv, b.shape);
 bInvTensor.requiresGrad = b.requiresGrad;
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, a.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad;
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.MulNode(new Tensor[]{a, bInvTensor}, result);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor matmul(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 return matmul(a, b, false, false);
 }
 
 public static Tensor matmul(Tensor a, Tensor b, boolean transposeA, boolean transposeB) {
 int m = transposeA ? a.shape[1] : a.shape[0];
 int k = transposeA ? a.shape[0] : a.shape[1];
 int n = transposeB ? b.shape[0] : b.shape[1];
 
 float[] resultData = new float[m * n];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) {
 int aIdx = transposeA ? p * a.shape[1] + i : i * a.shape[1] + p;
 int bIdx = transposeB ? j * b.shape[1] + p : p * b.shape[1] + j;
 sum += a.data[aIdx] * b.data[bIdx];
 }
 resultData[i * n + j] = sum;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, m, n);
 result.requiresGrad = a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.MatMulNode(new Tensor[]{a, b}, result, transposeA, transposeB);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor layerNorm(Tensor input, Tensor weight, Tensor bias) {
 return layerNorm(input, weight, bias, 1e-5f);
 }
 
 public static Tensor layerNorm(Tensor input, Tensor weight, Tensor bias, float eps) {
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int hiddenSize = input.shape[1];
 
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 float[] normalized = new float[input.numel];
 float[] mean = new float[batchSize];
 float[] variance = new float[batchSize];
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * hiddenSize;
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < hiddenSize; i++) {
 sum += input.data[base + i];
 }
 mean[b] = sum / hiddenSize;
 
 float sumSq = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < hiddenSize; i++) {
 float diff = input.data[base + i] - mean[b];
 sumSq += diff * diff;
 }
 variance[b] = sumSq / hiddenSize;
 
 float invStd = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(variance[b] + eps));
 
 for (int i = 0; i < hiddenSize; i++) {
 float normVal = (input.data[base + i] - mean[b]) * invStd;
 normalized[base + i] = normVal;
 
 float w = weight != null ? weight.data[i] : 1.0f;
 float bVal = bias != null ? bias.data[i] : 0.0f;
 resultData[base + i] = normVal * w + bVal;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad || 
 (weight != null && weight.requiresGrad) || 
 (bias != null && bias.requiresGrad);
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 List<Tensor> inputs = new ArrayList<>();
 inputs.add(input);
 if (weight != null) inputs.add(weight);
 if (bias != null) inputs.add(bias);
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.LayerNormNode(
 inputs.toArray(new Tensor[0]), result, normalized, mean, variance, eps);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor gelu(Tensor input) {
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 float x = input.data[i];
 resultData[i] = 0.5f * x * (1.0f + (float) Math.tanh(Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI) * (x + 0.044715f * x * x * x)));
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.GELUNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor relu(Tensor input) {
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = Math.max(0, input.data[i]);
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.ReLUNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor silu(Tensor input) {
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 float x = input.data[i];
 float sigmoid = 1.0f / (1.0f + (float) Math.exp(-x));
 resultData[i] = x * sigmoid;
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.SiLUNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor softmax(Tensor input) {
 return softmax(input, -1);
 }
 
 public static Tensor softmax(Tensor input, int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim = input.ndim + dim;
 }
 
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = input.shape[1];
 
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 
 float maxVal = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, input.data[base + i]);
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 resultData[base + i] = (float) Math.exp(input.data[base + i] - maxVal);
 sum += resultData[base + i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 resultData[base + i] /= sum;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.SoftmaxNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor logSoftmax(Tensor input) {
 return logSoftmax(input, -1);
 }
 
 public static Tensor logSoftmax(Tensor input, int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim = input.ndim + dim;
 }
 
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = input.shape[1];
 
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 
 float maxVal = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, input.data[base + i]);
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(input.data[base + i] - maxVal);
 }
 float logSum = maxVal + (float) Math.log(sum);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 resultData[base + i] = input.data[base + i] - logSum;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.LogSoftmaxNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor embedding(Tensor weight, int[] indices) {
 int vocabSize = weight.shape[0];
 int embeddingDim = weight.shape[1];
 
 float[] resultData = new float[indices.length * embeddingDim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 int base = idx * embeddingDim;
 
 for (int j = 0; j < embeddingDim; j++) {
 resultData[i * embeddingDim + j] = weight.data[base + j];
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, indices.length, embeddingDim);
 result.requiresGrad = weight.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.EmbeddingNode(new Tensor[]{weight}, result, indices);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor dropout(Tensor input, float dropoutRate) {
 return dropout(input, dropoutRate, true);
 }
 
 public static Tensor dropout(Tensor input, float dropoutRate, boolean training) {
 if (!training || dropoutRate == 0.0f) {
 return input.clone();
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[input.numel];
 boolean[] mask = new boolean[input.numel];
 float scale = 1.0f / (1.0f - dropoutRate);
 Random random = new Random();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 if (random.nextFloat() < dropoutRate) {
 mask[i] = false;
 resultData[i] = 0.0f;
 } else {
 mask[i] = true;
 resultData[i] = input.data[i] * scale;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, input.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.DropoutNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dropoutRate, mask);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor sum(Tensor input) {
 return sum(input, -1);
 }
 
 public static Tensor sum(Tensor input, int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim = input.ndim + dim;
 }
 
 if (dim == -1 || dim == input.ndim) {
 float sumVal = 0;
 for (float val : input.data) {
 sumVal += val;
 }
 Tensor result = new Tensor(new float[]{sumVal}, new int[]{});
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.SumNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim);
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 int[] newShape = new int[input.ndim - 1];
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < input.ndim; i++) {
 if (i != dim) {
 newShape[idx++] = input.shape[i];
 }
 }
 
 int reducedSize = 1;
 for (int dimVal : newShape) {
 reducedSize *= dimVal;
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[reducedSize];
 
 int[] strides = new int[input.shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * input.shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[input.shape.length];
 int idxCopy = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < input.shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idxCopy / strides[j];
 idxCopy %= strides[j];
 }
 
 int gradIdx = 0;
 int currentStride = 1;
 for (int j = input.shape.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
 if (j != dim) {
 gradIdx += indices[j] * currentStride;
 currentStride *= input.shape[j];
 }
 }
 
 resultData[gradIdx] += input.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, newShape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.SumNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor mean(Tensor input) {
 return mean(input, -1);
 }
 
 public static Tensor mean(Tensor input, int dim) {
 Tensor sumResult = sum(input, dim);
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) {
 return sumResult;
 }
 
 int reduceSize = 1;
 if (dim == -1) {
 reduceSize = input.numel;
 } else {
 reduceSize = input.shape[dim];
 }
 float scale = 1.0f / reduceSize;
 
 float[] resultData = new float[sumResult.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < sumResult.numel; i++) {
 resultData[i] = sumResult.data[i] * scale;
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, sumResult.shape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.MeanNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim, 0);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor reshape(Tensor input, int... newShape) {
 Tensor result = input.reshape(newShape);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.ReshapeNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor transpose(Tensor input, int dim0, int dim1) {
 Tensor result = input.transpose(dim0, dim1);
 result.requiresGrad = input.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.gradFn = new FunctionNode.TransposeNode(new Tensor[]{input}, result, dim0, dim1);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor permute(Tensor input, int... dims) {
 return input.permute(dims);
 }
 
 public static Tensor squeeze(Tensor input) {
 return input.squeeze();
 }
 
 public static Tensor squeeze(Tensor input, int dim) {
 return input.squeeze(dim);
 }
 
 public static Tensor unsqueeze(Tensor input, int dim) {
 return input.unsqueeze(dim);
 }
 
 public static Tensor expand(Tensor input, int... newShape) {
 return input.expand(newShape);
 }
 
 public static Tensor clone(Tensor input) {
 return input.clone();
 }
 
 public static Tensor detach(Tensor input) {
 return input.detach();
 }
 
 public static float mseLoss(Tensor output, Tensor target) {
 float[] diff = new float[output.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < output.numel; i++) {
 diff[i] = output.data[i] - target.data[i];
 }
 
 float mse = 0;
 for (float val : diff) {
 mse += val * val;
 }
 return mse / output.numel;
 }
 
 public static Tensor mseLossTensor(Tensor output, Tensor target) {
 float[] diff = new float[output.numel];
 float[] squaredDiff = new float[output.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < output.numel; i++) {
 diff[i] = output.data[i] - target.data[i];
 squaredDiff[i] = diff[i] * diff[i];
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : squaredDiff) {
 sum += val;
 }
 float mse = sum / output.numel;
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(new float[]{mse}, new int[]{});
 result.requiresGrad = output.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 float[] grad = new float[output.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < output.numel; i++) {
 grad[i] = 2.0f * diff[i] / output.numel;
 }
 result.grad = grad;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static float crossEntropyLoss(Tensor logits, int[] targets) {
 int batchSize = logits.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = logits.shape[1];
 
 float loss = 0;
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 int target = targets[b];
 
 float maxVal = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, logits.data[base + i]);
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits.data[base + i] - maxVal);
 }
 
 loss += maxVal + (float) Math.log(sum) - logits.data[base + target];
 }
 
 return loss / batchSize;
 }
 
 public static Tensor crossEntropyLossTensor(Tensor logits, int[] targets) {
 int batchSize = logits.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = logits.shape[1];
 
 float loss = 0;
 float[] grad = logits.requiresGrad ? new float[logits.numel] : null;
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 int target = targets[b];
 
 float maxVal = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, logits.data[base + i]);
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 float[] exp = new float[vocabSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits.data[base + i] - maxVal);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 
 loss += maxVal + (float) Math.log(sum) - logits.data[base + target];
 
 if (grad != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 grad[base + i] = exp[i] / sum;
 }
 grad[base + target] -= 1.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 grad[base + i] /= batchSize;
 }
 }
 }
 
 loss /= batchSize;
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(new float[]{loss}, new int[]{});
 result.requiresGrad = logits.requiresGrad;
 
 if (result.requiresGrad) {
 result.grad = grad;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static void clipGradients(Tensor[] tensors, float maxNorm) {
 float totalNorm = 0;
 for (Tensor tensor : tensors) {
 if (tensor.grad != null) {
 for (float val : tensor.grad) {
 totalNorm += val * val;
 }
 }
 }
 totalNorm = (float) Math.sqrt(totalNorm);
 
 if (totalNorm > maxNorm) {
 float scale = maxNorm / (totalNorm + 1e-6f);
 for (Tensor tensor : tensors) {
 if (tensor.grad != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < tensor.grad.length; i++) {
 tensor.grad[i] *= scale;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static void zeroGrad(Tensor[] tensors) {
 for (Tensor tensor : tensors) {
 tensor.zeroGrad();
 }
 }
 
 public static Tensor cat(Tensor[] tensors, int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim = tensors[0].ndim + dim;
 }
 
 int[] shape = tensors[0].shape;
 int catSize = 0;
 for (Tensor t : tensors) {
 catSize += t.shape[dim];
 }
 
 int[] newShape = Arrays.copyOf(shape, shape.length);
 newShape[dim] = catSize;
 
 int totalNumel = 1;
 for (int dimVal : newShape) {
 totalNumel *= dimVal;
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[totalNumel];
 
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 int offset = 0;
 for (Tensor t : tensors) {
 for (int i = 0; i < t.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[t.shape.length];
 int idx = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < t.shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idx / strides[j];
 idx %= strides[j];
 }
 
 indices[dim] += offset;
 
 int newIndex = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < newShape.length; j++) {
 newIndex = newIndex * newShape[j] + indices[j];
 }
 
 resultData[newIndex] = t.data[i];
 }
 offset += t.shape[dim];
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, newShape);
 boolean requiresGrad = false;
 for (Tensor t : tensors) {
 if (t.requiresGrad) {
 requiresGrad = true;
 break;
 }
 }
 result.requiresGrad = requiresGrad;
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public static Tensor stack(Tensor[] tensors, int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim = tensors[0].ndim + dim;
 }
 
 int[] shape = tensors[0].shape;
 int[] newShape = new int[shape.length + 1];
 
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < newShape.length; i++) {
 if (i == dim) {
 newShape[i] = tensors.length;
 } else {
 newShape[i] = shape[idx++];
 }
 }
 
 int totalNumel = 1;
 for (int dimVal : newShape) {
 totalNumel *= dimVal;
 }
 
 float[] resultData = new float[totalNumel];
 
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 for (int tIdx = 0; tIdx < tensors.length; tIdx++) {
 Tensor t = tensors[tIdx];
 for (int i = 0; i < t.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[t.shape.length];
 int idxCopy = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < t.shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idxCopy / strides[j];
 idxCopy %= strides[j];
 }
 
 int[] newIndices = new int[newShape.length];
 int newIdx = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < newShape.length; j++) {
 if (j == dim) {
 newIndices[j] = tIdx;
 } else {
 newIndices[j] = indices[newIdx++];
 }
 }
 
 int newIndex = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < newShape.length; j++) {
 newIndex = newIndex * newShape[j] + newIndices[j];
 }
 
 resultData[newIndex] = t.data[i];
 }
 }
 
 Tensor result = new Tensor(resultData, newShape);
 boolean requiresGrad = false;
 for (Tensor t : tensors) {
 if (t.requiresGrad) {
 requiresGrad = true;
 break;
 }
 }
 result.requiresGrad = requiresGrad;
 
 return result;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd;

import java.util.*;

public abstract class FunctionNode {
 
 public final Tensor[] inputs;
 public final Tensor output;
 
 public FunctionNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 this.inputs = inputs;
 this.output = output;
 }
 
 public abstract void backward(float[] gradOutput);
 
 public static class AddNode extends FunctionNode {
 public AddNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 if (inputs[0].requiresGrad) {
 if (inputs[0].grad == null) inputs[0].grad = new float[inputs[0].numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 inputs[0].grad[i] += gradOutput[i];
 }
 }
 if (inputs.length > 1 && inputs[1].requiresGrad) {
 if (inputs[1].grad == null) inputs[1].grad = new float[inputs[1].numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 inputs[1].grad[i] += gradOutput[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class MulNode extends FunctionNode {
 public MulNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 if (inputs[0].requiresGrad) {
 if (inputs[0].grad == null) inputs[0].grad = new float[inputs[0].numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 inputs[0].grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * inputs[1].data[i];
 }
 }
 if (inputs.length > 1 && inputs[1].requiresGrad) {
 if (inputs[1].grad == null) inputs[1].grad = new float[inputs[1].numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 inputs[1].grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * inputs[0].data[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class MatMulNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final boolean transposeA;
 private final boolean transposeB;
 
 public MatMulNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, boolean transposeA, boolean transposeB) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.transposeA = transposeA;
 this.transposeB = transposeB;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor A = inputs[0];
 Tensor B = inputs[1];
 
 int m = transposeA ? A.shape[1] : A.shape[0];
 int k = transposeA ? A.shape[0] : A.shape[1];
