 int n = transposeB ? B.shape[0] : B.shape[1];
 
 if (A.requiresGrad) {
 if (A.grad == null) A.grad = new float[A.numel];
 float[] gradA = new float[A.numel];
 
 float[] B_T = new float[B.numel];
 if (transposeB) {
 System.arraycopy(B.data, 0, B_T, 0, B.numel);
 } else {
 for (int i = 0; i < B.shape[0]; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < B.shape[1]; j++) {
 B_T[j * B.shape[0] + i] = B.data[i * B.shape[1] + j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
 int outIdx = i * n + j;
 int bIdx = p * n + j;
 int aIdx = transposeA ? p * m + i : i * k + p;
 gradA[aIdx] += gradOutput[outIdx] * B_T[bIdx];
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < A.numel; i++) {
 A.grad[i] += gradA[i];
 }
 }
 
 if (B.requiresGrad) {
 if (B.grad == null) B.grad = new float[B.numel];
 float[] gradB = new float[B.numel];
 
 float[] A_T = new float[A.numel];
 if (transposeA) {
 System.arraycopy(A.data, 0, A_T, 0, A.numel);
 } else {
 for (int i = 0; i < A.shape[0]; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < A.shape[1]; j++) {
 A_T[j * A.shape[0] + i] = A.data[i * A.shape[1] + j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int p = 0; p < k; p++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 int outIdx = i * n + j;
 int aIdx = p * m + i;
 int bIdx = transposeB ? j * k + p : p * n + j;
 gradB[bIdx] += gradOutput[outIdx] * A_T[aIdx];
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < B.numel; i++) {
 B.grad[i] += gradB[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class LayerNormNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final float[] normalized;
 private final float[] mean;
 private final float[] variance;
 private final float eps;
 
 public LayerNormNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, float[] normalized, float[] mean, float[] variance, float eps) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.normalized = normalized;
 this.mean = mean;
 this.variance = variance;
 this.eps = eps;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 Tensor weight = inputs.length > 1 ? inputs[1] : null;
 Tensor bias = inputs.length > 2 ? inputs[2] : null;
 
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int hiddenSize = input.shape[1];
 
 float[] gradX = new float[input.numel];
 float[] gradW = weight != null && weight.requiresGrad ? new float[weight.numel] : null;
 float[] gradB = bias != null && bias.requiresGrad ? new float[bias.numel] : null;
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * hiddenSize;
 
 float meanGrad = 0;
 float varGrad = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < hiddenSize; i++) {
 float w = weight != null ? weight.data[i] : 1.0f;
 float g = gradOutput[base + i];
 
 if (gradW != null) {
 gradW[i] += g * normalized[base + i];
 }
 if (gradB != null) {
 gradB[i] += g;
 }
 
 float xMinusMean = input.data[base + i] - mean[b];
 float invStd = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(variance[b] + eps));
 
 float gradNorm = g * w;
 float gradVarTerm = gradNorm * xMinusMean * (-0.5f) * (float) Math.pow(variance[b] + eps, -1.5);
 float gradMeanTerm = gradNorm * (-invStd);
 
 gradX[base + i] = gradNorm * invStd;
 
 for (int j = 0; j < hiddenSize; j++) {
 gradX[base + i] += gradVarTerm * (2.0f / hiddenSize) * (input.data[base + j] - mean[b]) * (i == j ? 1 : 0);
 }
 gradX[base + i] += gradMeanTerm * (1.0f / hiddenSize);
 
 meanGrad += gradMeanTerm + gradVarTerm * (-2.0f / hiddenSize) * (input.data[base + i] - mean[b]);
 varGrad += gradVarTerm;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < hiddenSize; i++) {
 gradX[base + i] += meanGrad * (1.0f / hiddenSize);
 }
 }
 
 if (input.requiresGrad) {
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 input.grad[i] += gradX[i];
 }
 }
 
 if (gradW != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weight.numel; i++) {
 weight.grad[i] += gradW[i];
 }
 }
 
 if (gradB != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < bias.numel; i++) {
 bias.grad[i] += gradB[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class GELUNode extends FunctionNode {
 public GELUNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (input.requiresGrad) {
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 float x = input.data[i];
 float cdf = 0.5f * (1.0f + (float) Math.tanh(Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI) * (x + 0.044715f * x * x * x)));
 float pdf = (float) (Math.exp(-x * x / 2.0) / Math.sqrt(2.0 * Math.PI));
 float grad = cdf + x * pdf * (float) Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI) * (1.0f + 0.134145f * x * x);
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * grad;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class ReLUNode extends FunctionNode {
 public ReLUNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (input.requiresGrad) {
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * (input.data[i] > 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class SiLUNode extends FunctionNode {
 public SiLUNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (input.requiresGrad) {
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 float x = input.data[i];
 float sigmoid = 1.0f / (1.0f + (float) Math.exp(-x));
 float grad = sigmoid * (1.0f + x * (1.0f - sigmoid));
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * grad;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class SoftmaxNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int dim;
 
 public SoftmaxNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int dim) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dim = dim;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = input.shape[1];
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float p = output.data[base + i];
 float gradSum = 0;
 
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 float grad = (i == j ? p * (1 - p) : -p * output.data[base + j]);
 gradSum += gradOutput[base + j] * grad;
 }
 
 input.grad[base + i] += gradSum;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class LogSoftmaxNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int dim;
 
 public LogSoftmaxNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int dim) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dim = dim;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 int batchSize = input.shape[0];
 int vocabSize = input.shape[1];
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int base = b * vocabSize;
 
 float[] softmax = new float[vocabSize];
 float maxVal = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 maxVal = Math.max(maxVal, input.data[base + i]);
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 softmax[i] = (float) Math.exp(input.data[base + i] - maxVal);
 sum += softmax[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 softmax[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float gradSum = gradOutput[base + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 gradSum -= gradOutput[base + j] * softmax[j];
 }
 input.grad[base + i] += gradSum;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class EmbeddingNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int[] indices;
 
 public EmbeddingNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int[] indices) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.indices = indices;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor weight = inputs[0];
 
 if (!weight.requiresGrad) return;
 if (weight.grad == null) weight.grad = new float[weight.numel];
 
 int embeddingDim = weight.shape[1];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 int base = idx * embeddingDim;
 
 for (int j = 0; j < embeddingDim; j++) {
 weight.grad[base + j] += gradOutput[i * embeddingDim + j];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class DropoutNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final float dropoutRate;
 private final boolean[] mask;
 
 public DropoutNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, float dropoutRate, boolean[] mask) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dropoutRate = dropoutRate;
 this.mask = mask;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 float scale = 1.0f / (1.0f - dropoutRate);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[i] * (mask[i] ? scale : 0.0f);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class SumNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int dim;
 
 public SumNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int dim) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dim = dim;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 int[] shape = input.shape;
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 if (dim == -1 || dim == input.ndim) {
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[0];
 }
 } else {
 int reducedSize = 1;
 for (int i = 0; i < shape.length; i++) {
 if (i != dim) reducedSize *= shape[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[shape.length];
 int idx = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idx / strides[j];
 idx %= strides[j];
 }
 
 int gradIdx = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < shape.length; j++) {
 if (j != dim) gradIdx = gradIdx * (j < dim ? shape[j] : shape[j]) + indices[j];
 }
 
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[gradIdx];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class MeanNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int dim;
 private final int keepDim;
 
 public MeanNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int dim, int keepDim) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dim = dim;
 this.keepDim = keepDim;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 int reduceSize = 1;
 if (dim == -1) {
 reduceSize = input.numel;
 } else {
 reduceSize = input.shape[dim];
 }
 float scale = 1.0f / reduceSize;
 
 if (dim == -1) {
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[0] * scale;
 }
 } else {
 int[] shape = input.shape;
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 int reducedSize = 1;
 for (int i = 0; i < shape.length; i++) {
 if (i != dim) reducedSize *= shape[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[shape.length];
 int idx = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idx / strides[j];
 idx %= strides[j];
 }
 
 int gradIdx = 0;
 int currentStride = 1;
 for (int j = shape.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
 if (j != dim) {
 gradIdx += indices[j] * currentStride;
 currentStride *= shape[j];
 }
 }
 
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[gradIdx] * scale;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class ReshapeNode extends FunctionNode {
 public ReshapeNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output) {
 super(inputs, output);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 System.arraycopy(gradOutput, 0, input.grad, 0, input.numel);
 }
 }
 
 public static class TransposeNode extends FunctionNode {
 private final int dim0;
 private final int dim1;
 
 public TransposeNode(Tensor[] inputs, Tensor output, int dim0, int dim1) {
 super(inputs, output);
 this.dim0 = dim0;
 this.dim1 = dim1;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 Tensor input = inputs[0];
 
 if (!input.requiresGrad) return;
 if (input.grad == null) input.grad = new float[input.numel];
 
 int[] shape = input.shape;
 int[] newShape = Arrays.copyOf(shape, shape.length);
 int temp = newShape[dim0];
 newShape[dim0] = newShape[dim1];
 newShape[dim1] = temp;
 
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 
 int[] newStrides = new int[newShape.length];
 newStrides[newStrides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = newStrides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 newStrides[i] = newStrides[i + 1] * newShape[i + 1];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < input.numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = new int[shape.length];
 int idx = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < shape.length; j++) {
 indices[j] = idx / strides[j];
 idx %= strides[j];
 }
 
 int[] transposedIndices = Arrays.copyOf(indices, indices.length);
 int tempIdx = transposedIndices[dim0];
 transposedIndices[dim0] = transposedIndices[dim1];
 transposedIndices[dim1] = tempIdx;
 
 int newIndex = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < newShape.length; j++) {
 newIndex += transposedIndices[j] * newStrides[j];
 }
 
 input.grad[i] += gradOutput[newIndex];
 }
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public class Tensor {
 
 public final float[] data;
 public float[] grad;
 public boolean requiresGrad;
 public FunctionNode gradFn;
 public final int[] shape;
 public final int ndim;
 public final int numel;
 
 private static final AtomicLong idCounter = new AtomicLong(0);
 public final long id;
 
 public Tensor(float[] data, int... shape) {
 this.data = data;
 this.shape = shape;
 this.ndim = shape.length;
 this.numel = computeNumel(shape);
 this.requiresGrad = false;
 this.grad = null;
 this.gradFn = null;
 this.id = idCounter.incrementAndGet();
 
 if (data.length != numel) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Data length " + data.length + " does not match shape " + Arrays.toString(shape));
 }
 }
 
 public Tensor(float[] data, boolean requiresGrad, int... shape) {
 this(data, shape);
 this.requiresGrad = requiresGrad;
 if (requiresGrad) {
 this.grad = new float[numel];
 }
 }
 
 private int computeNumel(int[] shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 return numel;
 }
 
 public static Tensor zeros(int... shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 return new Tensor(new float[numel], shape);
 }
 
 public static Tensor zeros(boolean requiresGrad, int... shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 return new Tensor(new float[numel], requiresGrad, shape);
 }
 
 public static Tensor ones(int... shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 float[] data = new float[numel];
 Arrays.fill(data, 1.0f);
 return new Tensor(data, shape);
 }
 
 public static Tensor randn(int... shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 float[] data = new float[numel];
 Random random = new Random();
 for (int i = 0; i < numel; i++) {
 data[i] = (float) random.nextGaussian();
 }
 return new Tensor(data, shape);
 }
 
 public static Tensor randn(boolean requiresGrad, int... shape) {
 int numel = 1;
 for (int dim : shape) {
 numel *= dim;
 }
 float[] data = new float[numel];
 Random random = new Random();
 for (int i = 0; i < numel; i++) {
 data[i] = (float) random.nextGaussian();
 }
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, shape);
 }
 
 public Tensor clone() {
 float[] newData = Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length);
 Tensor result = new Tensor(newData, shape);
 result.requiresGrad = this.requiresGrad;
 if (this.grad != null) {
 result.grad = Arrays.copyOf(this.grad, this.grad.length);
 }
 result.gradFn = this.gradFn;
 return result;
 }
 
 public Tensor detach() {
 float[] newData = Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length);
 return new Tensor(newData, shape);
 }
 
 public void backward() {
 backward(null);
 }
 
 public void backward(Tensor gradient) {
 if (!requiresGrad) {
 return;
 }
 
 if (gradient == null) {
 if (numel == 1) {
 gradient = ones(shape);
 } else {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gradient must be provided for non-scalar tensor");
 }
 }
 
 if (grad == null) {
 grad = new float[numel];
 }
 System.arraycopy(gradient.data, 0, grad, 0, numel);
 
 List<Tensor> visited = new ArrayList<>();
 Stack<Tensor> stack = new Stack<>();
 stack.push(this);
 
 while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
 Tensor t = stack.peek();
 
 if (t.gradFn == null || visited.contains(t)) {
 stack.pop();
 continue;
 }
 
 visited.add(t);
 
 for (Tensor input : t.gradFn.inputs) {
 if (input.requiresGrad && !visited.contains(input)) {
 stack.push(input);
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = visited.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 Tensor t = visited.get(i);
 if (t.gradFn != null) {
 t.gradFn.backward(t.grad);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void zeroGrad() {
 if (grad != null) {
 Arrays.fill(grad, 0.0f);
 }
 }
 
 public float norm() {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : data) {
 sum += val * val;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }
 
 public float gradNorm() {
 if (grad == null) return 0;
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : grad) {
 sum += val * val;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }
 
 public float mean() {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : data) {
 sum += val;
 }
 return sum / numel;
 }
 
 public float sum() {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : data) {
 sum += val;
 }
 return sum;
 }
 
 public float max() {
 float max = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float val : data) {
 max = Math.max(max, val);
 }
 return max;
 }
 
 public float min() {
 float min = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float val : data) {
 min = Math.min(min, val);
 }
 return min;
 }
 
 public Tensor reshape(int... newShape) {
 int newNumel = 1;
 for (int dim : newShape) {
 if (dim == -1) continue;
 newNumel *= dim;
 }
 
 int negIdx = -1;
 for (int i = 0; i < newShape.length; i++) {
 if (newShape[i] == -1) {
 negIdx = i;
 break;
 }
 }
 
 if (negIdx != -1) {
 int[] finalShape = new int[newShape.length];
 System.arraycopy(newShape, 0, finalShape, 0, newShape.length);
 finalShape[negIdx] = numel / newNumel;
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, finalShape);
 }
 
 if (newNumel != numel) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot reshape tensor of size " + numel + " to " + Arrays.toString(newShape));
 }
 
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor view(int... newShape) {
 return reshape(newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor transpose(int dim0, int dim1) {
 if (dim0 < 0 || dim0 >= ndim || dim1 < 0 || dim1 >= ndim) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid dimensions");
 }
 
 int[] newShape = Arrays.copyOf(shape, shape.length);
 int temp = newShape[dim0];
 newShape[dim0] = newShape[dim1];
 newShape[dim1] = temp;
 
 float[] newData = new float[numel];
 
 int[] strides = computeStrides(shape);
 int[] newStrides = computeStrides(newShape);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = unravelIndex(i, shape);
 int[] transposedIndices = Arrays.copyOf(indices, indices.length);
 int tempIdx = transposedIndices[dim0];
 transposedIndices[dim0] = transposedIndices[dim1];
 transposedIndices[dim1] = tempIdx;
 
 int newIndex = ravelIndex(transposedIndices, newStrides);
 newData[newIndex] = data[i];
 }
 
 return new Tensor(newData, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 private int[] computeStrides(int[] shape) {
 int[] strides = new int[shape.length];
 strides[strides.length - 1] = 1;
 for (int i = strides.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
 strides[i] = strides[i + 1] * shape[i + 1];
 }
 return strides;
 }
 
 private int[] unravelIndex(int index, int[] shape) {
 int[] indices = new int[shape.length];
 int[] strides = computeStrides(shape);
 for (int i = 0; i < shape.length; i++) {
 indices[i] = index / strides[i];
 index %= strides[i];
 }
 return indices;
 }
 
 private int ravelIndex(int[] indices, int[] strides) {
 int index = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
 index += indices[i] * strides[i];
 }
 return index;
 }
 
 public Tensor permute(int... dims) {
 if (dims.length != ndim) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of dimensions must match");
 }
 
 int[] newShape = new int[ndim];
 for (int i = 0; i < ndim; i++) {
 newShape[i] = shape[dims[i]];
 }
 
 float[] newData = new float[numel];
 int[] strides = computeStrides(shape);
 int[] newStrides = computeStrides(newShape);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numel; i++) {
 int[] indices = unravelIndex(i, shape);
 int[] permutedIndices = new int[ndim];
 for (int j = 0; j < ndim; j++) {
 permutedIndices[j] = indices[dims[j]];
 }
 int newIndex = ravelIndex(permutedIndices, newStrides);
 newData[newIndex] = data[i];
 }
 
 return new Tensor(newData, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor squeeze() {
 List<Integer> newShapeList = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int dim : shape) {
 if (dim != 1) {
 newShapeList.add(dim);
 }
 }
 
 int[] newShape = new int[newShapeList.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < newShape.length; i++) {
 newShape[i] = newShapeList.get(i);
 }
 
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor squeeze(int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim += ndim;
 }
 
 if (shape[dim] != 1) {
 return this;
 }
 
 int[] newShape = new int[ndim - 1];
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < ndim; i++) {
 if (i != dim) {
 newShape[idx++] = shape[i];
 }
 }
 
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor unsqueeze(int dim) {
 if (dim < 0) {
 dim += ndim + 1;
 }
 
 int[] newShape = new int[ndim + 1];
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < ndim + 1; i++) {
 if (i == dim) {
 newShape[i] = 1;
 } else {
 newShape[i] = shape[idx++];
 }
 }
 
 return new Tensor(data, requiresGrad, newShape);
 }
 
 public Tensor expand(int... newShape) {
 if (newShape.length < ndim) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("New shape must have at least " + ndim + " dimensions");
 }
 
 int[] expandedShape = new int[newShape.length];
 int offset = newShape.length - ndim;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < ndim; i++) {
 int originalDim = shape[i];
 int newDim = newShape[i + offset];
 
 if (originalDim != 1 && originalDim != newDim) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot expand dimension " + i + " from " + originalDim + " to " + newDim);
 }
 
 expandedShape[i + offset] = newDim;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < offset; i++) {
 expandedShape[i] = newShape[i];
 }
 
 int expandedNumel = 1;
 for (int dim : expandedShape) {
 expandedNumel *= dim;
 }
 
 float[] newData = new float[expandedNumel];
 int[] strides = computeStrides(shape);
 int[] expandedStrides = computeStrides(expandedShape);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < expandedNumel; i++) {
 int[] indices = unravelIndex(i, expandedShape);
 int[] originalIndices = new int[ndim];
 
 for (int j = 0; j < ndim; j++) {
 originalIndices[j] = indices[j + offset] % shape[j];
 }
 
 int originalIndex = ravelIndex(originalIndices, strides);
 newData[i] = data[originalIndex];
 }
 
 return new Tensor(newData, requiresGrad, expandedShape);
 }
 
 public int get(int... indices) {
 int[] strides = computeStrides(shape);
 int index = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < indices.length; i++) {
 index += indices[i] * strides[i];
 }
 return index;
 }
 
 public float getValue(int... indices) {
 return data[get(indices)];
 }
 
 public void setValue(float value, int... indices) {
 data[get(indices)] = value;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("Tensor(id=").append(id).append(", shape=").append(Arrays.toString(shape));
 sb.append(", requiresGrad=").append(requiresGrad).append(")\n");
 
 int displaySize = Math.min(20, numel);
 sb.append("Data: [");
 for (int i = 0; i < displaySize; i++) {
 sb.append(String.format("%.4f", data[i]));
 if (i < displaySize - 1) {
 sb.append(", ");
 }
 }
 if (numel > displaySize) {
 sb.append(", ...");
 }
 sb.append("]");
 
 if (grad != null) {
 sb.append("\nGrad: [");
 for (int i = 0; i < displaySize; i++) {
 sb.append(String.format("%.4f", grad[i]));
 if (i < displaySize - 1) {
 sb.append(", ");
 }
 }
 if (numel > displaySize) {
 sb.append(", ...");
 }
 sb.append("]");
 }
 
 return sb.toString();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.automl;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class AutoML {

 private final ModelSelector modelSelector;
 private final HyperparameterTuner hpTuner;
 private final ArchitectureSearch archSearch;
 private final EvaluationMetric metric;
 private final ExecutorService executor;

 public AutoML() {
 this.modelSelector = new ModelSelector();
 this.hpTuner = new HyperparameterTuner();
 this.archSearch = new ArchitectureSearch();
 this.metric = new EvaluationMetric();
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors());
 }

 public ModelCandidate findBestModel(Dataset dataset, TaskType task) {
 SearchSpace space = defineSearchSpace(task);
 List<ModelCandidate> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 100; iteration++) {
 ModelCandidate candidate = archSearch.sample(space);
 float score = evaluate(candidate, dataset, task);
 candidate.setScore(score);
 candidates.add(candidate);
 
 if (iteration % 10 == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[AutoML] Iteration %d: Best score = %.4f%n", 
 iteration, candidates.stream().mapToDouble(ModelCandidate::getScore).max().orElse(0));
 }
 }
 
 return candidates.stream()
 .max(Comparator.comparingDouble(ModelCandidate::getScore))
 .orElse(null);
 }

 public SearchSpace defineSearchSpace(TaskType task) {
 SearchSpace space = new SearchSpace();
 
 switch (task) {
 case TEXT_GENERATION:
 space.addParam("dModel", new IntRange(64, 512));
 space.addParam("nHeads", new IntRange(1, 8));
 space.addParam("nLayers", new IntRange(1, 6));
 space.addParam("learningRate", new FloatRange(1e-5f, 1e-3f));
 break;
 case IMAGE_CLASSIFICATION:
 space.addParam("filters", new IntRange(32, 512));
 space.addParam("kernelSize", new IntRange(3, 7));
 space.addParam("nLayers", new IntRange(3, 10));
 break;
 case QUESTION_ANSWERING:
 space.addParam("dModel", new IntRange(128, 768));
 space.addParam("nHeads", new IntRange(4, 12));
 space.addParam("contextWindow", new IntRange(128, 512));
 break;
 default:
 space.addParam("dModel", new IntRange(64, 256));
 space.addParam("nLayers", new IntRange(1, 4));
 }
 
 return space;
 }

 private float evaluate(ModelCandidate candidate, Dataset dataset, TaskType task) {
 CompletableFuture<Float> future = executor.submit(() -> {
 float score = 0;
 int samples = Math.min(100, dataset.size());
 
 for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
 float[] input = dataset.getInput(i);
 float[] target = dataset.getTarget(i);
 
 float[] output = candidate.getModel().forward(input);
 score += metric.compute(output, target);
 }
 
 return score / samples;
 });
 
 try {
 return future.get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 return Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 executor.shutdown();
 }

 public enum TaskType {
 TEXT_GENERATION,
 IMAGE_CLASSIFICATION,
 QUESTION_ANSWERING,
 MACHINE_TRANSLATION,
 OBJECT_DETECTION,
 RECOMMENDATION
 }

 public static class ModelSelector {
 private final Map<TaskType, List<ModelTemplate>> modelTemplates;
 
 public ModelSelector() {
 modelTemplates = new HashMap<>();
 modelTemplates.put(TaskType.TEXT_GENERATION, Arrays.asList(
 new ModelTemplate("Transformer", Arrays.asList("dModel", "nHeads", "nLayers")),
 new ModelTemplate("LSTM", Arrays.asList("hiddenSize", "nLayers")),
 new ModelTemplate("SimpCore", Arrays.asList("dModel", "nBases", "nHeads"))
 ));
 modelTemplates.put(TaskType.IMAGE_CLASSIFICATION, Arrays.asList(
 new ModelTemplate("ResNet", Arrays.asList("filters", "nLayers")),
 new ModelTemplate("CNN", Arrays.asList("filters", "kernelSize"))
 ));
 }
 
 public List<ModelTemplate> getTemplates(TaskType task) {
 return modelTemplates.getOrDefault(task, Collections.emptyList());
 }
 }

 public static class ModelTemplate {
 private final String name;
 private final List<String> parameters;
 
 public ModelTemplate(String name, List<String> parameters) {
 this.name = name;
 this.parameters = parameters;
 }
 
 public String getName() { return name; }
 public List<String> getParameters() { return parameters; }
 }

 public static class HyperparameterTuner {
 public Map<String, Object> tune(Map<String, ParameterRange> searchSpace, 
 Dataset dataset, TaskType task) {
 List<Map<String, Object>> configurations = generateConfigurations(searchSpace, 50);
 Map<String, Object> bestConfig = null;
 float bestScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 for (Map<String, Object> config : configurations) {
 float score = evaluateConfiguration(config, dataset, task);
 if (score > bestScore) {
 bestScore = score;
 bestConfig = config;
 }
 }
 
 return bestConfig;
 }
 
 private List<Map<String, Object>> generateConfigurations(
 Map<String, ParameterRange> searchSpace, int count) {
 List<Map<String, Object>> configs = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 Map<String, Object> config = new HashMap<>();
 for (Map.Entry<String, ParameterRange> entry : searchSpace.entrySet()) {
 config.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue().sample());
 }
 configs.add(config);
 }
 
 return configs;
 }
 
 private float evaluateConfiguration(Map<String, Object> config, 
 Dataset dataset, TaskType task) {
 return new Random().nextFloat();
 }
 }

 public static class ArchitectureSearch {
 public ModelCandidate sample(SearchSpace space) {
 Map<String, Object> params = space.sample();
 ModelCandidate candidate = new ModelCandidate(params);
 return candidate;
 }
 }

 public static class SearchSpace {
 private final Map<String, ParameterRange> params = new HashMap<>();
 
 public void addParam(String name, ParameterRange range) {
 params.put(name, range);
 }
 
 public Map<String, Object> sample() {
 Map<String, Object> sample = new HashMap<>();
 for (Map.Entry<String, ParameterRange> entry : params.entrySet()) {
 sample.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue().sample());
 }
 return sample;
 }
 
 public void update(Map<String, Object> params, float score) {
 }
 
 public Map<String, ParameterRange> getParams() {
 return params;
 }
 }

 public static abstract class ParameterRange {
 public abstract Object sample();
 }

 public static class IntRange extends ParameterRange {
 private final int min;
 private final int max;
 
 public IntRange(int min, int max) {
 this.min = min;
 this.max = max;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Object sample() {
 return new Random().nextInt(max - min + 1) + min;
 }
 }

 public static class FloatRange extends ParameterRange {
 private final float min;
 private final float max;
 
 public FloatRange(float min, float max) {
 this.min = min;
 this.max = max;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Object sample() {
 return min + new Random().nextFloat() * (max - min);
 }
 }

 public static class EvaluationMetric {
 public float compute(float[] output, float[] target) {
 float score = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(output.length, target.length); i++) {
 score += Math.abs(output[i] - target[i]);
 }
 return -score;
 }
 }

 public static class ModelCandidate {
 private final Map<String, Object> parameters;
 private float score;
 private Model model;
 
 public ModelCandidate(Map<String, Object> parameters) {
 this.parameters = parameters;
 this.score = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 this.model = createModel(parameters);
 }
 
 private Model createModel(Map<String, Object> parameters) {
 return new Model();
 }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getParameters() {
 return parameters;
 }
 
 public float getScore() {
 return score;
 }
 
 public void setScore(float score) {
 this.score = score;
 }
 
 public Model getModel() {
 return model;
 }
 }

 public static class Model {
 public float[] forward(float[] input) {
 return new float[1];
 }
 }

 public static class Dataset {
 private final List<float[]> inputs = new ArrayList<>();
 private final List<float[]> targets = new ArrayList<>();
 
 public void add(float[] input, float[] target) {
 inputs.add(input);
 targets.add(target);
 }
 
 public int size() {
 return inputs.size();
 }
 
 public float[] getInput(int index) {
 return inputs.get(index);
 }
 
 public float[] getTarget(int index) {
 return targets.get(index);
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.benchmark;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryManager;

import java.util.Random;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class BenchmarkRunner {

 private static final Random RANDOM = new Random(42);
 private static final int WARMUP_ITERATIONS = 10;
 private static final int MEASURE_ITERATIONS = 50;

 public static BenchmarkResult runMatmulBenchmark(int M, int K, int N) {
 float[] A = generateRandomArray(M * K);
 float[] B = generateRandomArray(K * N);

 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 }

 long totalTime = 0;
 float[] result = null;
 for (int i = 0; i < MEASURE_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 result = MatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 long end = System.nanoTime();
 totalTime += end - start;
 }

 double avgTimeMs = (totalTime / (double) MEASURE_ITERATIONS) / 1_000_000;
 double gflops = calculateGFLOPS(M, K, N, avgTimeMs);

 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "Matmul " + M + "x" + K + "x" + N,
 avgTimeMs,
 gflops,
 M * K * N * 2L,
 result.length * Float.BYTES
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult runSoftmaxBenchmark(int size) {
 float[] logits = generateRandomArray(size);

 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.softmax(logits);
 }

 long totalTime = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < MEASURE_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 MatrixOperations.softmax(logits);
 long end = System.nanoTime();
 totalTime += end - start;
 }

 double avgTimeMs = (totalTime / (double) MEASURE_ITERATIONS) / 1_000_000;

 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "Softmax " + size,
 avgTimeMs,
 size / avgTimeMs / 1_000_000,
 size,
 size * Float.BYTES
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult runReLUABenchmark(int size) {
 float[] x = generateRandomArray(size);

 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.relu(x);
 }

 long totalTime = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < MEASURE_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 MatrixOperations.relu(x);
 long end = System.nanoTime();
 totalTime += end - start;
 }

 double avgTimeMs = (totalTime / (double) MEASURE_ITERATIONS) / 1_000_000;

 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "ReLU " + size,
 avgTimeMs,
 size / avgTimeMs / 1_000_000,
 size,
 size * Float.BYTES
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkSuiteResult runAllBenchmarks() {
 BenchmarkSuiteResult suite = new BenchmarkSuiteResult();

 suite.addResult(runMatmulBenchmark(128, 128, 128));
 suite.addResult(runMatmulBenchmark(256, 256, 256));
 suite.addResult(runMatmulBenchmark(512, 512, 512));
 suite.addResult(runMatmulBenchmark(1024, 1024, 1024));
 suite.addResult(runMatmulBenchmark(2048, 2048, 2048));

 suite.addResult(runSoftmaxBenchmark(1024));
 suite.addResult(runSoftmaxBenchmark(4096));
 suite.addResult(runSoftmaxBenchmark(16384));

 suite.addResult(runReLUABenchmark(1_000_000));
 suite.addResult(runReLUABenchmark(10_000_000));

 return suite;
 }

 private static float[] generateRandomArray(int size) {
 float[] array = new float[size];
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 array[i] = (RANDOM.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2;
 }
 return array;
 }

 private static double calculateGFLOPS(int M, int K, int N, double timeMs) {
 long operations = (long) M * K * N * 2;
 return operations / timeMs / 1_000_000_000;
 }

 public record BenchmarkResult(
 String name,
 double avgTimeMs,
 double throughput,
 long operations,
 long memoryBytes
 ) {
 public String format() {
 return String.format(
 "%-30s | Time: %.4f ms | Throughput: %.4f | Ops: %,d | Memory: %,d bytes",
 name, avgTimeMs, throughput, operations, memoryBytes
 );
 }
 }

 public static class BenchmarkSuiteResult {
 private final java.util.List<BenchmarkResult> results = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 private long startTime;
 private long endTime;

 public void start() {
 startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }

 public void end() {
 endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }

 public void addResult(BenchmarkResult result) {
 results.add(result);
 }

 public java.util.List<BenchmarkResult> getResults() {
 return results;
 }

 public long getTotalTimeMs() {
 return endTime - startTime;
 }

 public void printReport() {
 System.out.println("=".repeat(120));
 System.out.println("SimpCore Java High Performance Benchmark Report");
 System.out.println("=".repeat(120));
 System.out.println();
 System.out.println("Benchmark Results:");
 System.out.println("-".repeat(120));
 System.out.printf("%-30s | %-15s | %-15s | %-15s | %-15s%n",
 "Benchmark", "Time (ms)", "Throughput", "Operations", "Memory (bytes)");
 System.out.println("-".repeat(120));
 for (BenchmarkResult result : results) {
 System.out.println(result.format());
 }
 System.out.println("-".repeat(120));
 System.out.printf("Total Benchmark Time: %d ms%n", getTotalTimeMs());
 System.out.println();

 MemoryManager.MemoryStats memStats = MemoryManager.getInstance().getStats();
 System.out.println("Memory Statistics:");
 System.out.println("-".repeat(120));
 System.out.printf("Allocated: %,d bytes (%.2f MB)%n",
 memStats.allocatedBytes(), memStats.allocatedBytes() / 1_048_576.0);
 System.out.printf("Peak: %,d bytes (%.2f MB)%n",
 memStats.peakBytes(), memStats.peakBytes() / 1_048_576.0);
 System.out.printf("JVM Total: %,d bytes (%.2f MB)%n",
 memStats.totalMemory(), memStats.totalMemory() / 1_048_576.0);
 System.out.printf("JVM Free: %,d bytes (%.2f MB)%n",
 memStats.freeMemory(), memStats.freeMemory() / 1_048_576.0);
 System.out.println("-".repeat(120));
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) {
 BenchmarkSuiteResult suite = runAllBenchmarks();
 suite.printReport();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.benchmark;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUMatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryManager;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public final class PerformanceBenchmark {

 private static final Random RANDOM = new Random(42);
 private static final int WARMUP_ITERATIONS = 10;
 private static final int BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS = 100;

 private PerformanceBenchmark() {}

 public static BenchmarkResult runAllBenchmarks() {
 List<BenchmarkResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
 
 results.add(benchmarkMatmul(64, 64, 64));
 results.add(benchmarkMatmul(128, 128, 128));
 results.add(benchmarkMatmul(256, 256, 256));
 results.add(benchmarkMatmul(512, 512, 512));
 
 results.add(benchmarkSoftmax(1024));
 results.add(benchmarkSoftmax(4096));
 
 results.add(benchmarkReLU(1000000));
 
 results.add(benchmarkDotProduct(10000));
 
 results.add(benchmarkMemoryAllocation());
 
 return aggregateResults(results);
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult benchmarkMatmul(int M, int K, int N) {
 float[] A = generateRandomArray(M * K);
 float[] B = generateRandomArray(K * N);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 }
 
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 }
 long cpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 float cpuMs = cpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 double cpuGFLOPS = calculateGFLOPS(M, K, N, cpuTime / BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 
 Float gpuMs = null;
 Double gpuGFLOPS = null;
 
 if (GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable()) {
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 }
 
 start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.matmul(A, B, M, K, N);
 }
 long gpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 gpuMs = gpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 gpuGFLOPS = calculateGFLOPS(M, K, N, gpuTime / BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 }
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "Matmul " + M + "x" + K + "x" + N,
 "Matrix Multiplication",
 cpuMs,
 gpuMs,
 cpuGFLOPS,
 gpuGFLOPS
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult benchmarkSoftmax(int size) {
 float[] logits = generateRandomArray(size);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.softmax(logits.clone());
 }
 
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.softmax(logits.clone());
 }
 long cpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 float cpuMs = cpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 
 Float gpuMs = null;
 if (GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable()) {
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.softmax(logits.clone());
 }
 
 start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.softmax(logits.clone());
 }
 long gpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 gpuMs = gpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 }
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "Softmax " + size,
 "Softmax Activation",
 cpuMs,
 gpuMs,
 null,
 null
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult benchmarkReLU(int size) {
 float[] x = generateRandomArray(size);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.relu(x.clone());
 }
 
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.relu(x.clone());
 }
 long cpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 float cpuMs = cpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 
 Float gpuMs = null;
 if (GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable()) {
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.relu(x.clone());
 }
 
 start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.relu(x.clone());
 }
 long gpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 gpuMs = gpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 }
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "ReLU " + size,
 "ReLU Activation",
 cpuMs,
 gpuMs,
 null,
 null
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult benchmarkDotProduct(int size) {
 float[] a = generateRandomArray(size);
 float[] b = generateRandomArray(size);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.dotProduct(a, b);
 }
 
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 MatrixOperations.dotProduct(a, b);
 }
 long cpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 float cpuMs = cpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 
 Float gpuMs = null;
 if (GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable()) {
 for (int i = 0; i < WARMUP_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.dotProduct(a, b);
 }
 
 start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS; i++) {
 GPUMatrixOperations.dotProduct(a, b);
 }
 long gpuTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 gpuMs = gpuTime / (1_000_000.0 * BENCHMARK_ITERATIONS);
 }
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "DotProduct " + size,
 "Dot Product",
 cpuMs,
 gpuMs,
 null,
 null
 );
 }

 public static BenchmarkResult benchmarkMemoryAllocation() {
 MemoryManager memoryManager = MemoryManager.getInstance();
 memoryManager.resetStats();
 
 int iterations = 10000;
 int size = 1024;
 
 long start = System.nanoTime();
 for (int i = 0; i < iterations; i++) {
 float[] array = memoryManager.allocateFloatArray(size);
 memoryManager.release(array);
 }
 long time = System.nanoTime() - start;
 
 float avgTimeNs = time / (float) iterations;
 MemoryManager.MemoryStats stats = memoryManager.getStats();
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "MemoryAllocation",
 "Memory Allocation (" + iterations + " x " + size + ")",
 avgTimeNs / 1000.0f,
 null,
 null,
 null
 );
 }

 private static double calculateGFLOPS(int M, int K, int N, long nanoseconds) {
 double operations = 2.0 * M * K * N;
 double seconds = nanoseconds / 1_000_000_000.0;
 return operations / seconds / 1_000_000_000.0;
 }

 private static float[] generateRandomArray(int size) {
 float[] array = new float[size];
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 array[i] = (RANDOM.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
 }
 return array;
 }

 private static BenchmarkResult aggregateResults(List<BenchmarkResult> results) {
 float totalCpuMs = 0;
 float totalGpuMs = 0;
 int cpuCount = 0;
 int gpuCount = 0;
 
 for (BenchmarkResult result : results) {
 if (result.cpuTimeMs != null) {
 totalCpuMs += result.cpuTimeMs;
 cpuCount++;
 }
 if (result.gpuTimeMs != null) {
 totalGpuMs += result.gpuTimeMs;
 gpuCount++;
 }
 }
 
 return new BenchmarkResult(
 "Aggregate",
 "Overall Performance",
 cpuCount > 0 ? totalCpuMs / cpuCount : null,
 gpuCount > 0 ? totalGpuMs / gpuCount : null,
 null,
 null
 );
 }

 public static void printResults(List<BenchmarkResult> results) {
 System.out.println("\n=== SimpCore Performance Benchmark Results ===");
 System.out.println("==============================================");
 System.out.printf("%-30s %-15s %-15s %-15s %-15s%n",
 "Benchmark", "CPU Time (ms)", "GPU Time (ms)", "CPU GFLOPS", "GPU GFLOPS");
 System.out.println("----------------------------------------------");
 
 for (BenchmarkResult result : results) {
 System.out.printf("%-30s ", result.name);
 System.out.printf("%-15.4f ", result.cpuTimeMs != null ? result.cpuTimeMs : 0);
 System.out.printf("%-15.4f ", result.gpuTimeMs != null ? result.gpuTimeMs : 0);
 System.out.printf("%-15.2f ", result.cpuGFLOPS != null ? result.cpuGFLOPS : 0);
 System.out.printf("%-15.2f%n", result.gpuGFLOPS != null ? result.gpuGFLOPS : 0);
 }
 
 System.out.println("==============================================");
 }

 public static class BenchmarkResult {
 public final String name;
 public final String description;
 public final Float cpuTimeMs;
 public final Float gpuTimeMs;
 public final Double cpuGFLOPS;
 public final Double gpuGFLOPS;
 
 public BenchmarkResult(String name, String description,
 Float cpuTimeMs, Float gpuTimeMs,
 Double cpuGFLOPS, Double gpuGFLOPS) {
 this.name = name;
 this.description = description;
 this.cpuTimeMs = cpuTimeMs;
 this.gpuTimeMs = gpuTimeMs;
 this.cpuGFLOPS = cpuGFLOPS;
 this.gpuGFLOPS = gpuGFLOPS;
 }
 
 public double getSpeedup() {
 if (cpuTimeMs != null && gpuTimeMs != null && gpuTimeMs > 0) {
 return cpuTimeMs / gpuTimeMs;
 }
 return 1.0;
 }
 }
}

 public static void main(String[] args) {
 if (args.length == 0) {
 startInteractiveMode();
 return;
 }
 
 String command = args[0].toLowerCase();
 String[] commandArgs = new String[0];
 if (args.length > 1) {
 commandArgs = new String[args.length - 1];
 System.arraycopy(args, 1, commandArgs, 0, args.length - 1);
 }
 
 executeCommand(command, commandArgs);
 }
 
 private static void startInteractiveMode() {
 System.out.println("SC Architecture CLI - Interactive Mode");
 System.out.println("=======================================");
 System.out.println("Type 'help' for available commands.\n");
 
 Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
 
 while (true) {
 System.out.print("> ");
 String line = scanner.nextLine().trim();
 if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
 
 String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
 String command = parts[0].toLowerCase();
 String[] commandArgs = new String[0];
 if (parts.length > 1) {
 commandArgs = new String[parts.length - 1];
 System.arraycopy(parts, 1, commandArgs, 0, parts.length - 1);
 }
 
 if (command.equals("exit")) {
 System.out.println("Goodbye!");
 break;
 }
 
 executeCommand(command, commandArgs);
 System.out.println();
 }
 
 scanner.close();
 }
 
 private static void executeCommand(String command, String[] args) {
 switch (command) {
 case "help":
 printHelp();
 break;
 case "version":
 printVersion();
 break;
 case "config":
 handleConfig(args);
 break;
 case "train":
 handleTrain(args);
 break;
 case "generate":
 handleGenerate(args);
 break;
 case "benchmark":
 handleBenchmark();
 break;
 case "export":
 handleExport(args);
 break;
 case "import":
 handleImport(args);
 break;
 case "eval":
 handleEval();
 break;
 default:
 System.out.println("Unknown command: " + command);
 System.out.println("Type 'help' for available commands.");
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 联想推理器 — 模拟人类的类比和因果推理能力
 * 
 * 人类思维的核心特征：
 * 1. 语义联想：从一个概念联想到相关概念
 * 2. 类比推理：发现不同领域之间的相似性
 * 3. 因果推理：推断事件之间的因果关系
 * 4. 隐喻理解：理解抽象的比喻和隐喻
 * 
 * 参考论文：
 * - Analogical Reasoning with Large Language Models
 * - Causal Reasoning in Language Models
 */
public class AssociativeReasoner {

 private final int dModel;
 
 /** 联想记忆库 — 存储概念向量 */
 private final List<float[]> conceptMemory;
 private final List<String> conceptLabels;
 
 /** 联想权重 */
 private final float[] wAssociate;
 
 /** 类比映射权重 */
 private final float[] wAnalogy;
 
 /** 因果推理权重 */
 private final float[] wCausal;
 
 /** 联想强度阈值 */
 private final float associationThreshold;
 
 private final Random random;

 public AssociativeReasoner(int dModel) {
 this(dModel, 0.3f);
 }

 public AssociativeReasoner(int dModel, float associationThreshold) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.associationThreshold = associationThreshold;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.conceptMemory = new ArrayList<>();
 this.conceptLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 
 this.wAssociate = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.wAnalogy = new float[2 * dModel * dModel];
 this.wCausal = new float[dModel * dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 initConceptMemory();
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 for (int i = 0; i < wAssociate.length; i++) {
 wAssociate[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wAnalogy.length; i++) {
 wAnalogy[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wCausal.length; i++) {
 wCausal[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 }

 private void initConceptMemory() {
 String[] basicConcepts = {
 "时间", "空间", "因果", "类比", "相似", "差异",
 "整体", "部分", "抽象", "具体", "逻辑", "情感"
 };
 
 for (String concept : basicConcepts) {
 float[] vector = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 vector[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 conceptMemory.add(vector);
 conceptLabels.add(concept);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 语义联想 — 找到与输入最相关的概念
 */
 public List<AssociationResult> associate(float[] input, int topK) {
 float[] transformed = MatrixOperations.matmul(input, wAssociate, 1, dModel, dModel);
 
 List<AssociationResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptMemory.size(); i++) {
 float[] concept = conceptMemory.get(i);
 float similarity = cosineSimilarity(transformed, concept);
 
 if (similarity > associationThreshold) {
 results.add(new AssociationResult(conceptLabels.get(i), similarity, concept));
 }
 }
 
 results.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(b.similarity, a.similarity));
 
 return results.size() > topK ? results.subList(0, topK) : results;
 }

 /**
 * 类比推理 — 发现源域和目标域之间的映射关系
 */
 public float[] analogicalReasoning(float[] source, float[] target) {
 float[] concat = new float[2 * dModel];
 System.arraycopy(source, 0, concat, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(target, 0, concat, dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] analogy = MatrixOperations.matmul(concat, wAnalogy, 1, 2 * dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] result = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[i] = target[i] + analogy[i];
 }
 
 return layerNorm(result);
 }

 /**
 * 因果推理 — 推断事件之间的因果关系
 */
 public float[] causalReasoning(float[] cause) {
 float[] effect = MatrixOperations.matmul(cause, wCausal, 1, dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(effect);
 
 float[] confidence = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 confidence[i] = (float) Math.abs(Math.tanh(normalized[i]));
 }
 
 return normalized;
 }

 /**
 * 多步联想链 — 模拟人类的链式联想思维
 */
 public List<float[]> chainAssociation(float[] input, int steps) {
 List<float[]> chain = new ArrayList<>();
 float[] current = Arrays.copyOf(input, dModel);
 chain.add(Arrays.copyOf(current, dModel));
 
 for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
 List<AssociationResult> associations = associate(current, 1);
 
 if (!associations.isEmpty()) {
 float[] associated = associations.get(0).conceptVector;
 
 float[] next = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 next[i] = current[i] + 0.5f * associated[i];
 }
 
 current = layerNorm(next);
 chain.add(Arrays.copyOf(current, dModel));
 } else {
 break;
 }
 }
 
 return chain;
 }

 /**
 * 添加新概念到联想记忆库
 */
 public void addConcept(String label, float[] vector) {
 conceptMemory.add(Arrays.copyOf(vector, dModel));
 conceptLabels.add(label);
 }

 /**
 * 删除概念
 */
 public void removeConcept(String label) {
 int index = conceptLabels.indexOf(label);
 if (index >= 0) {
 conceptMemory.remove(index);
 conceptLabels.remove(index);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 类比映射 — 将源域的知识映射到目标域
 */
 public float[] mapKnowledge(float[] sourceKnowledge, float[] sourceDomain, float[] targetDomain) {
 float sourceNorm = normalize(sourceDomain);
 float targetNorm = normalize(targetDomain);
 
 float[] direction = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 direction[i] = (targetDomain[i] - sourceDomain[i]) / (sourceNorm + 1e-8f);
 }
 
 float[] mapped = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 mapped[i] = sourceKnowledge[i] + direction[i] * (targetNorm / (sourceNorm + 1e-8f));
 }
 
 return layerNorm(mapped);
 }

 /**
 * 隐喻理解 — 解析隐喻表达
 */
 public float[] understandMetaphor(float[] literalMeaning, float[] context) {
 float[] analogy = analogicalReasoning(literalMeaning, context);
 return layerNorm(analogy);
 }

 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 norm1 += a[i] * a[i];
 norm2 += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 
 return dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 }

 private float normalize(float[] vector) {
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : vector) {
 norm += v * v;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 float[] output = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) * invStd;
 }
 return output;
 }

 public static class AssociationResult {
 public final String label;
 public final float similarity;
 public final float[] conceptVector;
 
 public AssociationResult(String label, float similarity, float[] conceptVector) {
 this.label = label;
 this.similarity = similarity;
 this.conceptVector = conceptVector;
 }
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public float[] getWAssociate() { return wAssociate; }
 public float[] getWAnalogy() { return wAnalogy; }
 public float[] getWCausal() { return wCausal; }
 public float getAssociationThreshold() { return associationThreshold; }
 public List<String> getConceptLabels() { return conceptLabels; }
 public int getConceptCount() { return conceptMemory.size(); }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * 认知度量 — 量化模型的人类化认知水平
 * 
 * 提供一系列度量指标来评估模型在处理信息时
 * 是否表现出类似人类的认知特性。
 * 所有指标返回0到1之间的浮点数。
 */
public final class CognitiveMetrics {

 private CognitiveMetrics() {}

 /**
 * 计算所有认知度量
 * 
 * @param hierarchicalPerception 分层感知模块
 * @param workingMemory 工作记忆控制器
 * @param cognitiveReasoner 认知推理器
 * @param schemaLearning 模式学习模块
 * @param x 当前处理的输入
 * @return 包含所有度量的Map
 */
 public static Map<String, Float> computeMetrics(
 HierarchicalPerceptionModule hierarchicalPerception,
 WorkingMemoryController workingMemory,
 CognitiveReasoner cognitiveReasoner,
 SchemaLearningModule schemaLearning,
 float[] x) {
 
 Map<String, Float> metrics = new HashMap<>();
 
 // 基础认知度量
 metrics.put("abstractionLevel", computeAbstractionLevel(schemaLearning, x));
 metrics.put("contextUtilization", computeContextUtilization(hierarchicalPerception, x));
 metrics.put("reasoningDepth", computeReasoningDepth(cognitiveReasoner));
 metrics.put("memoryUtilization", computeMemoryUtilization(workingMemory));
 
 // 综合认知负载指标
 float cognitiveLoad = computeCognitiveLoad(metrics);
 metrics.put("cognitiveLoad", cognitiveLoad);
 
 // 高级认知度量
 metrics.put("prototypeDiversity", computePrototypeDiversity(schemaLearning));
 metrics.put("memoryConsolidation", computeMemoryConsolidation(workingMemory));
 metrics.put("perceptualEntropy", computePerceptualEntropy(hierarchicalPerception, x));
 
 return metrics;
 }

 /**
 * 抽象层次度量
 * 衡量模型对信息的压缩程度
 * 基于原型激活的离散度和独特性
 * 值越高 = 越抽象
 */
 public static float computeAbstractionLevel(SchemaLearningModule schema, float[] x) {
 if (schema == null || x == null || x.length == 0) return 0.0f;
 
 int[] counts = schema.getActivationCounts();
 if (counts.length == 0) return 0.0f;
 
 // 计算激活分布的熵
 float total = 0;
 for (int c : counts) {
 total += c;
 }
 
 if (total < 1) return 0.0f;
 
 float entropy = 0;
 for (int c : counts) {
 if (c > 0) {
 float p = c / total;
 entropy -= p * (float) (Math.log(p) / Math.log(counts.length));
 }
 }
 
 // 熵越高，原型使用越均匀（表示模型能区分多种模式）
 // 映射到0-1范围
 return Math.min(1.0f, entropy * 2.0f);
 }

 /**
 * 上下文利用度量
 * 衡量模型在多大程度上利用上下文信息
 * 基于分层感知的门控权重分布
 * 值越高 = 上下文利用越好
 */
 public static float computeContextUtilization(HierarchicalPerceptionModule perception, float[] x) {
 if (perception == null || x == null || x.length == 0) return 0.5f;
 
 // 提取门控权重WGate，计算其L2范数
 float[] wGate = perception.getWGate();
 if (wGate == null || wGate.length == 0) return 0.5f;
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : wGate) {
 norm += v * v;
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm / wGate.length);
 
 // 门控权重的标准差越大，表示模型对各粒度的区分越明显
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : wGate) {
 mean += v / wGate.length;
 }
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : wGate) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= wGate.length;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var);
 
 // 综合指标：权重活跃度 + 方差
 float utilization = Math.min(1.0f, (norm + std) * 0.5f);
 return utilization;
 }

 /**
 * 推理深度度量
 * 衡量模型在处理信息时经历的"思考"步骤
 * 值越高 = 推理越深入
 */
 public static float computeReasoningDepth(CognitiveReasoner reasoner) {
 if (reasoner == null) return 0.0f;
 
 int depth = reasoner.getReasoningDepth();
 int defaultSteps = reasoner.getDefaultSteps();
 
 if (defaultSteps <= 0) return 0.0f;
 
 // 实际收敛步数占最大步数的比例
 return Math.min(1.0f, (float) depth / defaultSteps);
 }

 /**
 * 记忆利用率度量
 * 衡量工作记忆的使用程度
 * 值越高 = 记忆利用越充分
 */
 public static float computeMemoryUtilization(WorkingMemoryController memory) {
 if (memory == null) return 0.0f;
 
 return memory.getUtilization();
 }

 /**
 * 综合认知负载度量
 * 加权组合所有子度量
 */
 public static float computeCognitiveLoad(Map<String, Float> metrics) {
 float abstraction = metrics.getOrDefault("abstractionLevel", 0.0f);
 float context = metrics.getOrDefault("contextUtilization", 0.0f);
 float depth = metrics.getOrDefault("reasoningDepth", 0.0f);
 float memory = metrics.getOrDefault("memoryUtilization", 0.0f);
 
 // 加权综合
 return (abstraction * 0.25f + context * 0.25f + depth * 0.25f + memory * 0.25f);
 }

 /**
 * 原型多样性度量
 * 模式学习模块中原型的多样性
 */
 public static float computePrototypeDiversity(SchemaLearningModule schema) {
 if (schema == null) return 0.0f;
 
 float diversity = schema.getPrototypeDiversity();
 return Math.min(1.0f, diversity);
 }

 /**
 * 记忆巩固度量
 * 工作记忆中受保护槽位的比例
 */
 public static float computeMemoryConsolidation(WorkingMemoryController memory) {
 if (memory == null) return 0.0f;
 
 return memory.getProtectedRatio();
 }

 /**
 * 感知熵度量
 * 衡量分层感知输出的信息丰富度
 */
 public static float computePerceptualEntropy(HierarchicalPerceptionModule perception, float[] x) {
 if (perception == null || x == null || x.length == 0) return 0.5f;
 
 // 使用输入x的方差作为信息丰富度的近似
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v / x.length;
 }
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= x.length;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var);
 
 // 映射到0-1范围（假设合理范围在0-5之间）
 return Math.min(1.0f, std * 0.3f);
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * 认知推理器 — 整合所有认知模块的完整类人思维系统
 * 
 * 人类思维的完整流程：
 * 1. 感知输入 → 分层感知模块处理
 * 2. 工作记忆 → 临时存储和检索
 * 3. 思维树搜索 → 多路径探索和评估
 * 4. 联想推理 → 类比和因果推理
 * 5. 自我反思 → 评估和修正
 * 6. 情感决策 → 价值判断和选择
 * 7. 输出响应
 * 
 * 参考论文：
 * - Tree of Thoughts
 * - Reflexion
 * - Analogical Reasoning
 * - Affective Computing
 */
public class CognitiveReasoner {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int defaultSteps;
 
 private final float[] wQuery;
 private final float[] wReason;
 private final float[] wIntegration;
 
 private final float[] layerNormGamma;
 private final float[] layerNormBeta;
 
 private final List<float[]> reasoningPath;
 private final Random random;
 
 /** 子模块 */
 private final TreeOfThought treeOfThought;
 private final ReflexionModule reflexionModule;
 private final AssociativeReasoner associativeReasoner;
 private final EmotionalDecisionEngine emotionEngine;
 private final WorkingMemoryController workingMemory;
 private final HierarchicalPerceptionModule perceptionModule;

 public CognitiveReasoner(int dModel) {
 this(dModel, 3);
 }

 public CognitiveReasoner(int dModel, int defaultSteps) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.defaultSteps = defaultSteps;
 this.reasoningPath = new ArrayList<>();
 this.random = new Random(42);
 
 this.wQuery = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.wReason = new float[2 * dModel * dModel];
 this.wIntegration = new float[5 * dModel * dModel];
 
 this.layerNormGamma = new float[dModel];
 this.layerNormBeta = new float[dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 
 this.treeOfThought = new TreeOfThought(dModel, 5, 3, 0.5f);
 this.reflexionModule = new ReflexionModule(dModel);
 this.associativeReasoner = new AssociativeReasoner(dModel);
 this.emotionEngine = new EmotionalDecisionEngine(dModel);
 this.workingMemory = new WorkingMemoryController(dModel);
 this.perceptionModule = new HierarchicalPerceptionModule(dModel);
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 for (int i = 0; i < wQuery.length; i++) {
 wQuery[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wReason.length; i++) {
 wReason[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wIntegration.length; i++) {
 wIntegration[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 Arrays.fill(layerNormGamma, 1.0f);
 Arrays.fill(layerNormBeta, 0.0f);
 }

 /**
 * 完整推理流程 — 模拟人类思维的完整过程
 */
 public ReasoningResult fullReasoning(float[] input, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 reasoningPath.clear();
 
 float[] currentState = Arrays.copyOf(input, input.length);
 
 float[] perceptionOutput = perceptionModule.forward(currentState, batchSize, seqLen);
 currentState = perceptionOutput;
 reasoningPath.add(Arrays.copyOf(currentState, currentState.length));
 
 float[] query = computeQuery(currentState);
 
 float[] memoryCtx = workingMemory.read(query);
 workingMemory.write(memoryCtx);
 
 float[] thoughtResult = treeOfThought.search(query, 10);
 
 List<AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult> associations = 
 associativeReasoner.associate(thoughtResult, 3);
 
 float[] associatedResult = thoughtResult;
 if (!associations.isEmpty()) {
 float[] bestConcept = associations.get(0).conceptVector;
 associatedResult = associativeReasoner.analogicalReasoning(thoughtResult, bestConcept);
 }
 
 float[] causalResult = associativeReasoner.causalReasoning(associatedResult);
 
 float[] reflectionInput = new float[dModel];
 int offset = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel && offset < causalResult.length; i++) {
 reflectionInput[i] = causalResult[offset++];
 }
 
 float[] correctedResult = reflexionModule.reflectAndCorrect(
 query, reflectionInput, 3, 0.7f);
 
 float[] emotionEnhanced = emotionEngine.emotionEnhancedReasoning(correctedResult);
 
 float[] integrated = integrateAll(
 thoughtResult, associatedResult, causalResult, correctedResult, emotionEnhanced);
 
 float confidence = reflexionModule.evaluate(query, integrated);
 
 return new ReasoningResult(
 integrated, 
 confidence, 
 reasoningPath, 
 associations,
 treeOfThought.getReasoningTrajectory()
 );
 }

 /**
 * 链式推理 — 简化版，适合快速推理
 */
 public float[] reason(float[] input, int steps, WorkingMemoryController memory) {
 reasoningPath.clear();
 int totalSize = input.length;
 
 float[] state = Arrays.copyOf(input, totalSize);
 List<float[]> stepOutputs = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
 float[] query = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i += dModel) {
 float[] slice = Arrays.copyOfRange(state, i, Math.min(i + dModel, totalSize));
 float[] q = MatrixOperations.matmul(slice, wQuery, 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 query[j] += q[j];
 }
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 query[j] /= (totalSize / dModel);
 }
 
 float[] memoryCtx = memory != null ? memory.read(query) : new float[dModel];
 
 float[] newState = new float[totalSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i += dModel) {
 float[] concat = new float[2 * dModel];
 int end = Math.min(i + dModel, totalSize);
 int len = end - i;
 System.arraycopy(state, i, concat, 0, len);
 if (len < dModel) {
 Arrays.fill(concat, len, dModel, 0);
 }
 System.arraycopy(memoryCtx, 0, concat, dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] reasoning = MatrixOperations.matmul(concat, wReason, 1, 2 * dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] combined = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
 combined[j] = state[i + j] + reasoning[j];
 }
 Arrays.fill(combined, len, dModel, 0);
 
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(combined);
 System.arraycopy(normalized, 0, newState, i, len);
 }
 
 state = newState;
 stepOutputs.add(Arrays.copyOf(state, totalSize));
 
 if (memory != null) {
 memory.write(memoryCtx);
 }
 }
 
 reasoningPath.addAll(stepOutputs);
 
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 for (float[] stepOut : stepOutputs) {
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 output[i] += stepOut[i];
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 output[i] /= steps;
 }
 
 return output;
 }

 /**
 * 整合所有模块的输出
 */
 private float[] integrateAll(float[] thought, float[] associated, 
 float[] causal, float[] corrected, float[] emotional) {
 float[] concat = new float[5 * dModel];
 
 int pos = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 concat[pos++] = i < thought.length ? thought[i] : 0;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 concat[pos++] = i < associated.length ? associated[i] : 0;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 concat[pos++] = i < causal.length ? causal[i] : 0;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 concat[pos++] = i < corrected.length ? corrected[i] : 0;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 concat[pos++] = i < emotional.length ? emotional[i] : 0;
 }
 
 float[] integrated = MatrixOperations.matmul(concat, wIntegration, 1, 5 * dModel, dModel);
 
 return layerNorm(integrated);
 }

 /**
 * 计算查询向量
 */
 private float[] computeQuery(float[] state) {
 float[] query = new float[dModel];
 int totalSize = state.length;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i += dModel) {
 float[] slice = Arrays.copyOfRange(state, i, Math.min(i + dModel, totalSize));
 float[] q = MatrixOperations.matmul(slice, wQuery, 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 query[j] += q[j];
 }
 }
 
 int numSlices = (totalSize + dModel - 1) / dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 query[j] /= numSlices;
 }
 
 return query;
 }

 /**
 * 设置情感状态
 */
 public void setEmotion(EmotionalDecisionEngine.Emotion emotion, float intensity) {
 emotionEngine.setEmotion(emotion, intensity);
 }

 /**
 * 设置动机
 */
 public void setMotivation(EmotionalDecisionEngine.Motivation motivation) {
 emotionEngine.setMotivation(motivation);
 }

 /**
 * 添加概念到联想记忆
 */
 public void addConcept(String label, float[] vector) {
 associativeReasoner.addConcept(label, vector);
 }

 /**
 * 获取反思统计
 */
 public ReflexionModule.ReflectionStats getReflectionStats() {
 return reflexionModule.getStats();
 }

 /**
 * 获取当前情感状态
 */
 public EmotionalDecisionEngine.Emotion getCurrentEmotion() {
 return emotionEngine.getCurrentEmotionType();
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x) {
 float mean = 0;
 int len = x.length;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= len;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= len;
 
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 float[] output = new float[len];
 for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 output[i] = layerNormGamma[i % dModel] * (x[i] - mean) * invStd + layerNormBeta[i % dModel];
 }
 return output;
 }

 public static class ReasoningResult {
 public final float[] output;
 public final float confidence;
 public final List<float[]> reasoningPath;
 public final List<AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult> associations;
 public final List<float[]> thoughtTrajectory;
 
 public ReasoningResult(float[] output, float confidence, 
 List<float[]> path, List<AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult> assocs,
 List<float[]> trajectory) {
 this.output = output;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.reasoningPath = path;
 this.associations = assocs;
 this.thoughtTrajectory = trajectory;
 }
 }

 public List<float[]> getReasoningPath() {
 return reasoningPath;
 }

 public int getReasoningDepth() {
 if (reasoningPath.size() < 2) return reasoningPath.size();
 
 for (int i = reasoningPath.size() - 1; i > 0; i--) {
 float[] current = reasoningPath.get(i);
 float[] previous = reasoningPath.get(i - 1);
 
 float diff = 0;
 float norm = 0;
 int minLen = Math.min(current.length, previous.length);
 for (int j = 0; j < minLen; j++) {
 float d = current[j] - previous[j];
 diff += d * d;
 norm += current[j] * current[j];
 }
 float relativeChange = (float) Math.sqrt(diff) / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm) + 1e-8f);
 
 if (relativeChange > 0.01f) {
 return i + 1;
 }
 }
 return 1;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getDefaultSteps() { return defaultSteps; }
 public float[] getWQuery() { return wQuery; }
 public float[] getWReason() { return wReason; }
 public float[] getWIntegration() { return wIntegration; }
 public float[] getLayerNormGamma() { return layerNormGamma; }
 public float[] getLayerNormBeta() { return layerNormBeta; }
 
 public TreeOfThought getTreeOfThought() { return treeOfThought; }
 public ReflexionModule getReflexionModule() { return reflexionModule; }
 public AssociativeReasoner getAssociativeReasoner() { return associativeReasoner; }
 public EmotionalDecisionEngine getEmotionEngine() { return emotionEngine; }
 public WorkingMemoryController getWorkingMemory() { return workingMemory; }
 public HierarchicalPerceptionModule getPerceptionModule() { return perceptionModule; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 情感决策引擎 — 模拟人类的情感驱动决策机制
 * 
 * 人类决策不是完全理性的，而是受情感影响：
 * 1. 动机驱动：内在需求和目标驱动行为
 * 2. 价值判断：基于价值观评估选项
 * 3. 风险偏好：不同情绪状态下的风险承受能力
 * 4. 情绪调节：根据情绪状态调整决策策略
 * 5. 社会偏好：考虑他人和社会规范
 * 
 * 参考论文：
 * - Affective Computing
 * - Emotional Intelligence in AI
 */
public class EmotionalDecisionEngine {

 private final int dModel;
 
 /** 情感状态维度 */
 public enum Emotion {
 HAPPINESS, SADNESS, ANGER, FEAR, SURPRISE, DISGUST, NEUTRAL
 }
 
 /** 动机类型 */
 public enum Motivation {
 SURVIVAL, SOCIAL, ACHIEVEMENT, EXPLORATION, CREATION, RELAXATION
 }
 
 /** 情感权重 — 每种情感对决策的影响 */
 private final float[] emotionWeights;
 
 /** 动机权重 */
 private final float[] motivationWeights;
 
 /** 价值权重 */
 private final float[] valueWeights;
 
 /** 当前情感状态 */
 private float[] currentEmotion;
 
 /** 当前动机 */
 private Motivation currentMotivation;
 
 /** 情绪历史 */
 private final List<float[]> emotionHistory;
 
 /** 情绪衰减率 */
 private final float emotionDecayRate;
 
 /** 风险偏好系数 */
 private float riskPreference;
 
 private final Random random;

 public EmotionalDecisionEngine(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.emotionHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 this.emotionDecayRate = 0.05f;
 this.riskPreference = 0.5f;
 this.currentMotivation = Motivation.ACHIEVEMENT;
 
 this.emotionWeights = new float[dModel];
 this.motivationWeights = new float[Motivation.values().length * dModel];
 this.valueWeights = new float[dModel];
 
 this.currentEmotion = new float[dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 for (int i = 0; i < emotionWeights.length; i++) {
 emotionWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < motivationWeights.length; i++) {
 motivationWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < valueWeights.length; i++) {
 valueWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 
 Arrays.fill(currentEmotion, 0.1f);
 }

 /**
 * 设置情感状态
 */
 public void setEmotion(Emotion emotion, float intensity) {
 float[] emotionVector = new float[dModel];
 float baseValue = intensity * 0.5f;
 
 switch (emotion) {
 case HAPPINESS:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = baseValue * (1 + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.2f);
 }
 break;
 case SADNESS:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = -baseValue * (1 + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.2f);
 }
 break;
 case ANGER:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = baseValue * (random.nextFloat() > 0.5f ? 1 : -1);
 }
 break;
 case FEAR:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = -baseValue * Math.abs(random.nextFloat() - 0.5f);
 }
 break;
 case SURPRISE:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * baseValue * 2;
 }
 break;
 case DISGUST:
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionVector[i] = -baseValue * (0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f);
 }
 break;
 case NEUTRAL:
 Arrays.fill(emotionVector, 0);
 break;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 currentEmotion[i] = (1 - emotionDecayRate) * currentEmotion[i] + emotionDecayRate * emotionVector[i];
 }
 
 emotionHistory.add(Arrays.copyOf(currentEmotion, dModel));
 if (emotionHistory.size() > 100) {
 emotionHistory.remove(0);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 设置当前动机
 */
 public void setMotivation(Motivation motivation) {
 this.currentMotivation = motivation;
 }

 /**
 * 设置风险偏好
 * 0 = 保守, 0.5 = 中性, 1 = 冒险
 */
 public void setRiskPreference(float preference) {
 this.riskPreference = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, preference));
 }

 /**
 * 情感驱动的决策 — 在多个选项中选择最优
 */
 public DecisionResult decide(float[][] options, float[][] optionRisks) {
 float[] scores = new float[options.length];
 
 for (int optIdx = 0; optIdx < options.length; optIdx++) {
 float[] option = options[optIdx];
 
 float valueScore = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 valueScore += option[i] * valueWeights[i];
 }
 
 float emotionScore = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionScore += option[i] * currentEmotion[i] * emotionWeights[i];
 }
 
 float motivationScore = 0;
 int motIdx = currentMotivation.ordinal();
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 motivationScore += option[i] * motivationWeights[motIdx * dModel + i];
 }
 
 float riskScore = 0;
 if (optionRisks != null && optIdx < optionRisks.length) {
 float avgRisk = 0;
 for (float risk : optionRisks[optIdx]) {
 avgRisk += risk;
 }
 avgRisk /= optionRisks[optIdx].length;
 
 riskScore = (riskPreference - avgRisk) * 0.5f;
 }
 
 scores[optIdx] = valueScore + emotionScore + motivationScore + riskScore;
 }
 
 int bestIdx = 0;
 float bestScore = scores[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < scores.length; i++) {
 if (scores[i] > bestScore) {
 bestScore = scores[i];
 bestIdx = i;
 }
 }
 
 float[] certainty = new float[options.length];
 float maxScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 float minScore = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float s : scores) {
 if (s > maxScore) maxScore = s;
 if (s < minScore) minScore = s;
 }
 float range = maxScore - minScore + 1e-8f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++) {
 certainty[i] = (scores[i] - minScore) / range;
 }
 
 return new DecisionResult(bestIdx, scores, certainty);
 }

 /**
 * 情感感知 — 从输入中提取情感信息
 */
 public float[] perceiveEmotion(float[] input) {
 float[] emotionPerception = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionPerception[i] = input[i] * emotionWeights[i];
 }
 
 return layerNorm(emotionPerception);
 }

 /**
 * 情绪调节 — 根据目标情绪调整当前情绪
 */
 public void regulateEmotion(float[] targetEmotion, float strength) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 currentEmotion[i] = (1 - strength) * currentEmotion[i] + strength * targetEmotion[i];
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取情绪状态描述
 */
 public Emotion getCurrentEmotionType() {
 float mean = 0;
 float variance = 0;
 
 for (float v : currentEmotion) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 for (float v : currentEmotion) {
 variance += (v - mean) * (v - mean);
 }
 variance /= dModel;
 
 if (mean > 0.1f && variance < 0.05f) {
 return Emotion.HAPPINESS;
 } else if (mean < -0.1f && variance < 0.05f) {
 return Emotion.SADNESS;
 } else if (variance > 0.1f && mean > 0) {
 return Emotion.ANGER;
 } else if (variance > 0.1f && mean < 0) {
 return Emotion.FEAR;
 } else if (Math.abs(mean) > 0.2f) {
 return Emotion.SURPRISE;
 } else if (mean < -0.05f && variance < 0.03f) {
 return Emotion.DISGUST;
 } else {
 return Emotion.NEUTRAL;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取情绪强度
 */
 public float getEmotionIntensity() {
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : currentEmotion) {
 norm += v * v;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 }

 /**
 * 情感增强推理 — 情绪影响推理过程
 */
 public float[] emotionEnhancedReasoning(float[] input) {
 float[] emotionInfluenced = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 emotionInfluenced[i] = input[i] * (1 + currentEmotion[i] * 0.1f);
 }
 
 return layerNorm(emotionInfluenced);
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 float[] output = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) * invStd;
 }
 return output;
 }

 public static class DecisionResult {
 public final int chosenIndex;
 public final float[] scores;
 public final float[] certainty;
 
 public DecisionResult(int chosen, float[] scores, float[] certainty) {
 this.chosenIndex = chosen;
 this.scores = scores;
 this.certainty = certainty;
 }
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public float[] getCurrentEmotion() { return currentEmotion; }
 public Motivation getCurrentMotivation() { return currentMotivation; }
 public float getRiskPreference() { return riskPreference; }
 public float[] getEmotionWeights() { return emotionWeights; }
 public float[] getMotivationWeights() { return motivationWeights; }
 public float[] getValueWeights() { return valueWeights; }
 public int getEmotionHistorySize() { return emotionHistory.size(); }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * 分层感知模块 — 模拟人类多层次信息处理
 * 
 * 人类视觉/语言处理并非单一粒度，而是同时进行细粒度（局部细节）、
 * 中粒度（短语/局部上下文）和粗粒度（全局语义）的并行处理。
 * 本模块通过可学习的门控机制融合三个粒度的表征。
 */
public class HierarchicalPerceptionModule {

 private final int dModel;
 
 // 细粒度：逐token处理 (W_fine @ x + b_fine)
 private final float[] wFine;
 private final float[] bFine;
 
 // 中粒度：bigram块处理
 private final float[] wMedium;
 
 // 粗粒度：quadgram块处理
 private final float[] wCoarse;
 
 // 门控权重：融合三个粒度的输出
 private final float[] wGate;
 
 // 随机数生成器用于初始化
 private final Random random;
 
 // 梯度累积器
 private final float[] gradWFine;
 private final float[] gradBFine;
 private final float[] gradWMedium;
 private final float[] gradWCoarse;
 private final float[] gradWGate;
 
 private int stepCount;
 private static final int UPDATE_FREQ = 10;
 private static final float LEARNING_RATE = 0.001f;

 public HierarchicalPerceptionModule(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.stepCount = 0;
 
 // 细粒度权重: dModel x dModel
 this.wFine = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.bFine = new float[dModel];
 
 // 中粒度权重: dModel x dModel
 this.wMedium = new float[dModel * dModel];
 
 // 粗粒度权重: dModel x dModel
 this.wCoarse = new float[dModel * dModel];
 
 // 门控权重: 3*dModel x dModel (接收拼接后的三个粒度输出)
