 this.wGate = new float[3 * dModel * dModel];
 
 // 初始化梯度
 this.gradWFine = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.gradBFine = new float[dModel];
 this.gradWMedium = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.gradWCoarse = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.gradWGate = new float[3 * dModel * dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 // 细粒度: 较小初始化
 for (int i = 0; i < wFine.length; i++) {
 wFine[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < bFine.length; i++) {
 bFine[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 
 // 中粒度: 中等初始化
 for (int i = 0; i < wMedium.length; i++) {
 wMedium[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 
 // 粗粒度: 较大初始化 (全局模式更强先验)
 for (int i = 0; i < wCoarse.length; i++) {
 wCoarse[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.08f;
 }
 
 // 门控: 初始偏向细粒度
 for (int i = 0; i < wGate.length; i++) {
 wGate[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.01f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 前向传播：多粒度处理 + 门控融合
 * 
 * fine = W_fine @ x + b_fine
 * medium = AvgPool2(x, 2) -> W_medium -> Upsample
 * coarse = AvgPool2(x, 4) -> W_coarse -> Upsample
 * gate = sigmoid(W_gate @ concat(fine, medium, coarse))
 * output = gate_f * fine + gate_m * medium + gate_c * coarse
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer mem = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] output = mem.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 
 float[] fineOut = mem.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 float[] mediumOut = mem.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 float[] coarseOut = mem.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, offset, offset + dModel);
 
 // 细粒度: 直接逐token变换
 float[] fine = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, wFine, 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 fineOut[offset + i] = fine[i] + bFine[i];
 }
 
 // 中粒度: bigram聚合 -> 变换 -> 上采样
 // 滑窗平均两个相邻token
 int mediumStart = Math.max(0, s - 1);
 int mediumEnd = Math.min(seqLen - 1, s + 1);
 float[] mediumAgg = new float[dModel];
 int mediumCount = 0;
 for (int si = mediumStart; si <= mediumEnd; si++) {
 int off = (b * seqLen + si) * dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mediumAgg[j] += x[off + j];
 }
 mediumCount++;
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mediumAgg[j] /= mediumCount;
 }
 
 float[] medium = MatrixOperations.matmul(mediumAgg, wMedium, 1, dModel, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(medium, 0, mediumOut, offset, dModel);
 
 // 粗粒度: quadgram聚合 -> 变换 -> 上采样
 int coarseStart = Math.max(0, s - 2);
 int coarseEnd = Math.min(seqLen - 1, s + 2);
 float[] coarseAgg = new float[dModel];
 int coarseCount = 0;
 for (int si = coarseStart; si <= coarseEnd; si++) {
 int off = (b * seqLen + si) * dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 coarseAgg[j] += x[off + j];
 }
 coarseCount++;
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 coarseAgg[j] /= coarseCount;
 }
 
 float[] coarse = MatrixOperations.matmul(coarseAgg, wCoarse, 1, dModel, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(coarse, 0, coarseOut, offset, dModel);
 }
 }
 
 // 计算门控权重并融合
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i += dModel) {
 // 拼接三个粒度的输出
 float[] concat = new float[3 * dModel];
 System.arraycopy(fineOut, i, concat, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(mediumOut, i, concat, dModel, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(coarseOut, i, concat, 2 * dModel, dModel);
 
 // gate = sigmoid(W_gate @ concat)
 float[] gateLogits = MatrixOperations.matmul(concat, wGate, 1, 3 * dModel, dModel);
 float[] gate = softmax(gateLogits);
 
 // 加权融合
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float gFine = gate[j];
 float gMedium = gate[(j + dModel / 3) % dModel];
 float gCoarse = gate[(j + 2 * dModel / 3) % dModel];
 // 重新归一化确保和为1
 float sum = gFine + gMedium + gCoarse + 1e-8f;
 output[i + j] = (gFine / sum) * fineOut[i + j] 
 + (gMedium / sum) * mediumOut[i + j] 
 + (gCoarse / sum) * coarseOut[i + j];
 }
 }
 
 mem.releaseFloatArray(fineOut);
 mem.releaseFloatArray(mediumOut);
 mem.releaseFloatArray(coarseOut);
 
 return output;
 }

 private float[] softmax(float[] x) {
 float max = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float v : x) {
 if (v > max) max = v;
 }
 float[] exp = new float[x.length];
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(x[i] - max);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 exp[i] /= sum;
 }
 return exp;
 }

 /**
 * 反向传播 — 计算梯度
 */
 public float[] backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 
 // 简化实现：将dOutput直接传递回输入
 // 实际的梯度计算应包含门控梯度和各粒度路径的梯度
 System.arraycopy(dOutput, 0, dInput, 0, totalSize);
 
 // 累积梯度（简化为梯度下降步）
 stepCount++;
 
 return dInput;
 }

 /**
 * 通过梯度下降更新权重
 */
 public void updateWeights(float[] gradients) {
 if (gradients == null || gradients.length == 0) return;
 
 // 更新细粒度权重
 int gateSize = 3 * dModel * dModel;
 if (gradients.length >= gateSize + dModel * dModel + dModel) {
 int offset = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 wFine[i] -= LEARNING_RATE * gradients[offset + i];
 }
 offset += dModel * dModel;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 bFine[i] -= LEARNING_RATE * gradients[offset + i];
 }
 }
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }

 public float[] getWFine() { return wFine; }
 public float[] getBFine() { return bFine; }
 public float[] getWMedium() { return wMedium; }
 public float[] getWCoarse() { return wCoarse; }
 public float[] getWGate() { return wGate; }
 
 public float[] getGradWFine() { return gradWFine; }
 public float[] getGradBFine() { return gradBFine; }
 public float[] getGradWMedium() { return gradWMedium; }
 public float[] getGradWCoarse() { return gradWCoarse; }
 public float[] getGradWGate() { return gradWGate; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class NeuralMachineInterfaceProtocol {

 public enum ProtocolVersion {
 NMI_1_0("1.0"),
 NMI_1_1("1.1"),
 NMI_2_0("2.0");

 private final String version;

 ProtocolVersion(String version) {
 this.version = version;
 }

 public String getVersion() { return version; }
 }

 public enum MessageType {
 INIT,
 SYNC,
 DATA,
 CONTROL,
 STATUS,
 ERROR,
 ACK,
 NACK
 }

 public enum DataType {
 EEG,
 EMG,
 EOG,
 ECG,
 fMRI,
 BCI_COMMAND,
 FEEDBACK
 }

 public enum ControlCommand {
 START_STREAMING,
 STOP_STREAMING,
 CALIBRATE,
 RESET,
 CONFIGURE,
 QUERY_STATUS
 }

 private final ProtocolVersion version;
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, DataListener> listeners;
 private ServerSocket serverSocket;
 private Socket clientSocket;
 private volatile boolean connected = false;
 private ExecutorService executorService;
 private final Object lock = new Object();

 public NeuralMachineInterfaceProtocol() {
 this.version = ProtocolVersion.NMI_2_0;
 this.listeners = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);
 }

 public void startServer(int port) throws IOException {
 serverSocket = new ServerSocket(port);
 System.out.println("NMI Protocol Server started on port " + port);
 
 executorService.submit(() -> {
 try {
 while (!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
 Socket client = serverSocket.accept();
 synchronized (lock) {
 this.clientSocket = client;
 this.connected = true;
 }
 System.out.println("Client connected: " + client.getInetAddress());
 startMessageLoop(client);
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (!serverSocket.isClosed()) {
 System.err.println("Server error: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 });
 }

 public void connect(String host, int port) throws IOException {
 clientSocket = new Socket(host, port);
 connected = true;
 System.out.println("Connected to NMI server: " + host + ":" + port);
 startMessageLoop(clientSocket);
 }

 private void startMessageLoop(Socket socket) {
 executorService.submit(() -> {
 try (BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(socket.getInputStream()));
 PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(socket.getOutputStream(), true)) {
 
 String line;
 while ((line = in.readLine()) != null) {
 processMessage(line, out);
 }
 
 synchronized (lock) {
 connected = false;
 clientSocket = null;
 }
 System.out.println("Client disconnected");
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Message loop error: " + e.getMessage());
 synchronized (lock) {
 connected = false;
 clientSocket = null;
 }
 }
 });
 }

 private void processMessage(String message, PrintWriter out) {
 try {
 NMIMessage nmiMessage = deserializeMessage(message);
 
 switch (nmiMessage.getMessageType()) {
 case INIT:
 handleInit(nmiMessage, out);
 break;
 case SYNC:
 handleSync(nmiMessage, out);
 break;
 case DATA:
 handleData(nmiMessage);
 break;
 case CONTROL:
 handleControl(nmiMessage, out);
 break;
 case STATUS:
 handleStatus(nmiMessage, out);
 break;
 case ERROR:
 handleError(nmiMessage);
 break;
 case ACK:
 handleAck(nmiMessage);
 break;
 case NACK:
 handleNack(nmiMessage);
 break;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("Failed to process message: " + e.getMessage());
 sendMessage(new NMIMessage(MessageType.ERROR, "Invalid message format"));
 }
 }

 private void handleInit(NMIMessage message, PrintWriter out) {
 System.out.println("Init received: " + message.getPayload());
 sendAck(out, "Initialization complete");
 }

 private void handleSync(NMIMessage message, PrintWriter out) {
 long timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 sendMessage(new NMIMessage(MessageType.SYNC, String.valueOf(timestamp)));
 }

 private void handleData(NMIMessage message) {
 String dataType = message.getHeaders().get("dataType");
 if (dataType != null) {
 DataListener listener = listeners.get(dataType);
 if (listener != null) {
 listener.onDataReceived(message.getPayload());
 }
 }
 }

 private void handleControl(NMIMessage message, PrintWriter out) {
 String command = message.getPayload();
 System.out.println("Control command: " + command);
 
 try {
 ControlCommand cmd = ControlCommand.valueOf(command);
 switch (cmd) {
 case START_STREAMING:
 startStreaming();
 sendAck(out, "Streaming started");
 break;
 case STOP_STREAMING:
 stopStreaming();
 sendAck(out, "Streaming stopped");
 break;
 case CALIBRATE:
 calibrate();
 sendAck(out, "Calibration complete");
 break;
 case RESET:
 reset();
 sendAck(out, "System reset");
 break;
 case CONFIGURE:
 configure(message.getHeaders());
 sendAck(out, "Configuration applied");
 break;
 case QUERY_STATUS:
 sendStatus(out);
 break;
 }
 } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
 sendNack(out, "Unknown command: " + command);
 }
 }

 private void handleStatus(NMIMessage message, PrintWriter out) {
 sendStatus(out);
 }

 private void handleError(NMIMessage message) {
 System.err.println("NMI Error: " + message.getPayload());
 }

 private void handleAck(NMIMessage message) {
 System.out.println("ACK: " + message.getPayload());
 }

 private void handleNack(NMIMessage message) {
 System.err.println("NACK: " + message.getPayload());
 }

 private void sendAck(PrintWriter out, String message) {
 out.println(serializeMessage(new NMIMessage(MessageType.ACK, message)));
 }

 private void sendNack(PrintWriter out, String message) {
 out.println(serializeMessage(new NMIMessage(MessageType.NACK, message)));
 }

 private void sendStatus(PrintWriter out) {
 Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
 headers.put("connected", String.valueOf(connected));
 headers.put("version", version.getVersion());
 headers.put("timestamp", String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis()));
 NMIMessage status = new NMIMessage(MessageType.STATUS, headers, "OK");
 out.println(serializeMessage(status));
 }

 public void sendData(DataType dataType, String data) {
 if (!connected) {
 System.err.println("Not connected");
 return;
 }
 
 Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
 headers.put("dataType", dataType.name());
 headers.put("timestamp", String.valueOf(System.currentTimeMillis()));
 headers.put("length", String.valueOf(data.length()));
 
 NMIMessage message = new NMIMessage(MessageType.DATA, headers, data);
 sendMessage(message);
 }

 public void sendControl(ControlCommand command) {
 sendMessage(new NMIMessage(MessageType.CONTROL, command.name()));
 }

 public void sendMessage(NMIMessage message) {
 synchronized (lock) {
 if (clientSocket != null && connected) {
 try {
 PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(clientSocket.getOutputStream(), true);
 out.println(serializeMessage(message));
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Failed to send message: " + e.getMessage());
 connected = false;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private String serializeMessage(NMIMessage message) {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("NMI/").append(version.getVersion()).append(" ");
 sb.append(message.getMessageType().name()).append("\r\n");
 
 for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : message.getHeaders().entrySet()) {
 sb.append(entry.getKey()).append(": ").append(entry.getValue()).append("\r\n");
 }
 
 sb.append("\r\n");
 sb.append(message.getPayload());
 
 return sb.toString();
 }

 private NMIMessage deserializeMessage(String raw) {
 String[] lines = raw.split("\r\n");
 
 String[] firstLine = lines[0].split(" ");
 String versionStr = firstLine[0].substring(4);
 MessageType type = MessageType.valueOf(firstLine[1]);
 
 Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
 int i = 1;
 while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].isEmpty()) {
 String[] header = lines[i].split(": ", 2);
 if (header.length == 2) {
 headers.put(header[0], header[1]);
 }
 i++;
 }
 
 StringBuilder payload = new StringBuilder();
 for (int j = i + 1; j < lines.length; j++) {
 if (j > i + 1) payload.append("\n");
 payload.append(lines[j]);
 }
 
 return new NMIMessage(type, headers, payload.toString());
 }

 public void addDataListener(DataType dataType, DataListener listener) {
 listeners.put(dataType.name(), listener);
 }

 public void removeDataListener(DataType dataType) {
 listeners.remove(dataType.name());
 }

 private void startStreaming() {
 System.out.println("Starting data streaming...");
 }

 private void stopStreaming() {
 System.out.println("Stopping data streaming...");
 }

 private void calibrate() {
 System.out.println("Calibrating...");
 }

 private void reset() {
 System.out.println("Resetting system...");
 }

 private void configure(Map<String, String> config) {
 System.out.println("Configuring with: " + config);
 }

 public boolean isConnected() {
 return connected;
 }

 public void disconnect() {
 synchronized (lock) {
 connected = false;
 if (clientSocket != null) {
 try {
 clientSocket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 // Ignore
 }
 clientSocket = null;
 }
 if (serverSocket != null) {
 try {
 serverSocket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 // Ignore
 }
 }
 }
 executorService.shutdown();
 }

 public interface DataListener {
 void onDataReceived(String data);
 }

 public static class NMIMessage {
 private final MessageType messageType;
 private final Map<String, String> headers;
 private final String payload;

 public NMIMessage(MessageType messageType, String payload) {
 this(messageType, new HashMap<>(), payload);
 }

 public NMIMessage(MessageType messageType, Map<String, String> headers, String payload) {
 this.messageType = messageType;
 this.headers = headers != null ? headers : new HashMap<>();
 this.payload = payload != null ? payload : "";
 }

 public MessageType getMessageType() { return messageType; }
 public Map<String, String> getHeaders() { return headers; }
 public String getPayload() { return payload; }
 }

 public static class EEGData {
 private final double[] channels;
 private final long timestamp;
 private final float sampleRate;
 private final int channelCount;

 public EEGData(double[] channels, long timestamp, float sampleRate) {
 this.channels = channels;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.sampleRate = sampleRate;
 this.channelCount = channels.length;
 }

 public String toJSON() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("{");
 sb.append("\"type\": \"EEG\",");
 sb.append("\"timestamp\": ").append(timestamp).append(",");
 sb.append("\"sampleRate\": ").append(sampleRate).append(",");
 sb.append("\"channelCount\": ").append(channelCount).append(",");
 sb.append("\"data\": [");
 for (int i = 0; i < channels.length; i++) {
 sb.append(String.format("%.6f", channels[i]));
 if (i < channels.length - 1) sb.append(",");
 }
 sb.append("]");
 sb.append("}");
 return sb.toString();
 }

 public static EEGData fromJSON(String json) {
 int start = json.indexOf("[");
 int end = json.lastIndexOf("]");
 if (start == -1 || end == -1) return null;
 
 String dataStr = json.substring(start + 1, end);
 String[] parts = dataStr.split(",");
 double[] channels = new double[parts.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
 channels[i] = Double.parseDouble(parts[i].trim());
 }
 
 long timestamp = extractLong(json, "timestamp");
 float sampleRate = extractFloat(json, "sampleRate");
 
 return new EEGData(channels, timestamp, sampleRate);
 }

 private static long extractLong(String json, String key) {
 int start = json.indexOf("\"" + key + "\":");
 if (start == -1) return 0;
 start = json.indexOf(":", start + key.length() + 3);
 int end = json.indexOf(",", start + 1);
 if (end == -1) end = json.indexOf("}", start + 1);
 return Long.parseLong(json.substring(start + 1, end).trim());
 }

 private static float extractFloat(String json, String key) {
 int start = json.indexOf("\"" + key + "\":");
 if (start == -1) return 0;
 start = json.indexOf(":", start + key.length() + 3);
 int end = json.indexOf(",", start + 1);
 if (end == -1) end = json.indexOf("}", start + 1);
 return Float.parseFloat(json.substring(start + 1, end).trim());
 }

 public double[] getChannels() { return channels; }
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 public float getSampleRate() { return sampleRate; }
 public int getChannelCount() { return channelCount; }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 自我反思模块 — 模拟人类的元认知能力
 * 
 * 人类的高级认知能力包括：
 * 1. 自我监控：评估自己的思考过程和结果
 * 2. 错误检测：发现推理中的错误和不一致
 * 3. 策略调整：根据评估结果调整推理策略
 * 4. 知识修正：发现知识缺口并主动学习
 * 
 * 参考论文：Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
 */
public class ReflexionModule {

 private final int dModel;
 
 /** 反思评估权重 */
 private final float[] wReflect;
 
 /** 修正权重 */
 private final float[] wCorrect;
 
 /** 知识缺口检测权重 */
 private final float[] wGapDetect;
 
 /** 反思历史 */
 private final List<ReflectionRecord> reflectionHistory;
 
 /** 错误模式库 */
 private final Map<Integer, float[]> errorPatterns;
 
 private final Random random;
 
 /** 反思记录 */
 private static class ReflectionRecord {
 float[] input;
 float[] output;
 float[] correctedOutput;
 float confidence;
 float correctionGain;
 boolean wasCorrected;
 long timestamp;
 
 ReflectionRecord(float[] input, float[] output, float confidence) {
 this.input = input;
 this.output = output;
 this.correctedOutput = null;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.correctionGain = 0;
 this.wasCorrected = false;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }
 }

 public ReflexionModule(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.reflectionHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 this.errorPatterns = new HashMap<>();
 
 this.wReflect = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.wCorrect = new float[2 * dModel * dModel];
 this.wGapDetect = new float[dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 for (int i = 0; i < wReflect.length; i++) {
 wReflect[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wCorrect.length; i++) {
 wCorrect[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wGapDetect.length; i++) {
 wGapDetect[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 评估推理结果的质量
 * 1. 计算置信度
 * 2. 检测错误模式
 * 3. 识别知识缺口
 */
 public float evaluate(float[] input, float[] output) {
 float[] reflect = MatrixOperations.matmul(output, wReflect, 1, dModel, dModel);
 
 float confidence = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 confidence += reflect[i] * output[i];
 }
 confidence = (float) Math.tanh(confidence);
 
 int patternId = detectErrorPattern(output);
 if (patternId != -1) {
 confidence *= 0.5f;
 }
 
 float gapScore = detectKnowledgeGap(input, output);
 if (gapScore > 0.5f) {
 confidence *= (1.0f - gapScore);
 }
 
 reflectionHistory.add(new ReflectionRecord(input, output, confidence));
 
 return confidence;
 }

 /**
 * 检测错误模式
 */
 private int detectErrorPattern(float[] output) {
 for (Map.Entry<Integer, float[]> entry : errorPatterns.entrySet()) {
 float[] pattern = entry.getValue();
 float similarity = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 similarity += output[i] * pattern[i];
 norm1 += output[i] * output[i];
 norm2 += pattern[i] * pattern[i];
 }
 
 float sim = similarity / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 if (sim > 0.7f) {
 return entry.getKey();
 }
 }
 return -1;
 }

 /**
 * 检测知识缺口
 */
 private float detectKnowledgeGap(float[] input, float[] output) {
 float gapScore = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 gapScore += Math.abs(input[i] - output[i]) * wGapDetect[i];
 }
 return (float) Math.tanh(gapScore);
 }

 /**
 * 修正推理结果
 * 如果评估发现问题，尝试修正
 */
 public float[] correct(float[] input, float[] output, float confidenceThreshold) {
 float confidence = evaluate(input, output);
 
 if (confidence >= confidenceThreshold) {
 return output;
 }
 
 float[] corrected = new float[dModel];
 
 float[] concat = new float[2 * dModel];
 System.arraycopy(input, 0, concat, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(output, 0, concat, dModel, dModel);
 
 float[] correction = MatrixOperations.matmul(concat, wCorrect, 1, 2 * dModel, dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 corrected[i] = output[i] + (1.0f - confidence) * correction[i];
 }
 
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(corrected);
 
 if (reflectionHistory.size() > 0) {
 ReflectionRecord last = reflectionHistory.get(reflectionHistory.size() - 1);
 last.correctedOutput = normalized;
 last.wasCorrected = true;
 last.correctionGain = computeCorrectionGain(output, normalized);
 }
 
 return normalized;
 }

 /**
 * 计算修正增益
 */
 private float computeCorrectionGain(float[] original, float[] corrected) {
 float diff = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float d = corrected[i] - original[i];
 diff += d * d;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(diff);
 }

 /**
 * 反思循环 — 迭代修正直到达到满意质量
 */
 public float[] reflectAndCorrect(float[] input, float[] output, int maxIterations, 
 float confidenceThreshold) {
 float[] current = Arrays.copyOf(output, dModel);
 
 for (int iter = 0; iter < maxIterations; iter++) {
 float confidence = evaluate(input, current);
 
 if (confidence >= confidenceThreshold) {
 break;
 }
 
 current = correct(input, current, confidenceThreshold);
 }
 
 return current;
 }

 /**
 * 从历史中学习错误模式
 */
 public void learnErrorPattern(float[] pattern) {
 int id = errorPatterns.size() + 1;
 errorPatterns.put(id, Arrays.copyOf(pattern, dModel));
 }

 /**
 * 获取反思统计
 */
 public ReflectionStats getStats() {
 if (reflectionHistory.isEmpty()) {
 return new ReflectionStats(0, 0, 0, 0);
 }
 
 int total = reflectionHistory.size();
 int corrected = 0;
 float avgConfidence = 0;
 float avgCorrectionGain = 0;
 
 for (ReflectionRecord record : reflectionHistory) {
 avgConfidence += record.confidence;
 if (record.wasCorrected) {
 corrected++;
 avgCorrectionGain += record.correctionGain;
 }
 }
 
 avgConfidence /= total;
 avgCorrectionGain = corrected > 0 ? avgCorrectionGain / corrected : 0;
 
 return new ReflectionStats(total, corrected, avgConfidence, avgCorrectionGain);
 }

 public static class ReflectionStats {
 public final int totalReflections;
 public final int correctedCount;
 public final float avgConfidence;
 public final float avgCorrectionGain;
 
 public ReflectionStats(int total, int corrected, float confidence, float gain) {
 this.totalReflections = total;
 this.correctedCount = corrected;
 this.avgConfidence = confidence;
 this.avgCorrectionGain = gain;
 }
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 float[] output = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) * invStd;
 }
 return output;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public float[] getWReflect() { return wReflect; }
 public float[] getWCorrect() { return wCorrect; }
 public float[] getWGapDetect() { return wGapDetect; }
 public List<ReflectionRecord> getReflectionHistory() { return reflectionHistory; }
 public Map<Integer, float[]> getErrorPatterns() { return errorPatterns; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * 模式学习模块 — 模拟人类从经验中抽象出"图式"(Schema)的能力
 * 
 * 人类认知特性：
 * - 图式抽象：从具体经验中提取通用模式
 * - 原型匹配：新输入与已有原型匹配
 * - 渐进更新：通过移动平均逐步完善原型
 * - 模式引导：匹配的原型指导信息处理
 * 
 * 维护N个可学习的原型向量，每个代表一种常见模式。
 * 给定输入，找到最佳匹配原型并用它增强处理。
 */
public class SchemaLearningModule {

 /** 原型数量 */
 private final int numPrototypes;
 
 /** 原型维度 */
 private final int dModel;
 
 /** 原型矩阵: numPrototypes x dModel */
 private final float[][] prototypes;
 
 /** 每个原型的激活计数 */
 private final int[] activationCounts;
 
 /** 原型学习率 */
 private final float learningRate;
 
 /** 相似度阈值（用于判断是否匹配已有原型） */
 private final float similarityThreshold;
 
 /** 最近激活的原型索引 */
 private int lastActivatedIndex;
 
 private final Random random;

 public SchemaLearningModule(int dModel) {
 this(dModel, 16); // 默认16个原型
 }

 public SchemaLearningModule(int dModel, int numPrototypes) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.numPrototypes = numPrototypes;
 this.prototypes = new float[numPrototypes][dModel];
 this.activationCounts = new int[numPrototypes];
 this.learningRate = 0.01f;
 this.similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
 this.lastActivatedIndex = -1;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 
 initPrototypes();
 }

 /**
 * 初始化原型（使用小随机值）
 */
 private void initPrototypes() {
 for (int i = 0; i < numPrototypes; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 prototypes[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 activationCounts[i] = 0;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 前向传播：模式增强处理
 * output = x + matched_prototype
 * 
 * 首先找到与输入最匹配的原型，
 * 然后将其添加到输入中以增强表示。
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] x) {
 int totalSize = x.length;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 
 // 对整个序列中的每个dModel块应用
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i += dModel) {
 float[] slice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, i, i + dModel);
 
 // 找到最佳匹配原型
 int bestIdx = findBestMatch(slice);
 lastActivatedIndex = bestIdx;
 
 // 更新原型（移动平均）
 updatePrototype(bestIdx, slice);
 
 // output = x + matched_prototype
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[i + j] = slice[j] + prototypes[bestIdx][j];
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }

 /**
 * 查找与输入最匹配的原型（余弦相似度）
 */
 private int findBestMatch(float[] input) {
 int bestIdx = 0;
 float bestSim = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 for (int p = 0; p < numPrototypes; p++) {
 float dot = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dot += input[j] * prototypes[p][j];
 norm1 += input[j] * input[j];
 norm2 += prototypes[p][j] * prototypes[p][j];
 }
 float sim = dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 
 if (sim > bestSim) {
 bestSim = sim;
 bestIdx = p;
 }
 }
 
 return bestIdx;
 }

 /**
 * 更新原型：proto += lr * (input - proto)
 * 仅当相似度超过阈值时才更新
 */
 private void updatePrototype(int idx, float[] input) {
 // 计算当前输入与选中原型的相似度
 float dot = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dot += input[j] * prototypes[idx][j];
 norm1 += input[j] * input[j];
 norm2 += prototypes[idx][j] * prototypes[idx][j];
 }
 float sim = dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 
 if (sim >= similarityThreshold) {
 // 匹配：移动平均更新（强化已有模式）
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 prototypes[idx][j] += learningRate * (input[j] - prototypes[idx][j]);
 }
 activationCounts[idx]++;
 } else {
 // 不匹配：更新最不活跃的原型（探索新模式）
 int leastActive = 0;
 int minCount = activationCounts[0];
 for (int p = 1; p < numPrototypes; p++) {
 if (activationCounts[p] < minCount) {
 minCount = activationCounts[p];
 leastActive = p;
 }
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 prototypes[leastActive][j] += learningRate * 0.5f * (input[j] - prototypes[leastActive][j]);
 }
 }
 }

 /**
 * 返回最后匹配的原型索引
 */
 public int getActivatedSchema(float[] x) {
 if (lastActivatedIndex >= 0) {
 return lastActivatedIndex;
 }
 
 // 如果尚未激活，计算一次匹配
 float[] slice = x.length > dModel ? Arrays.copyOf(x, dModel) : x;
 return findBestMatch(slice);
 }

 /**
 * 反向传播（简化实现）
 */
 public float[] backward(float[] dOutput) {
 // 简化的梯度传递：dOutput直接经过残差连接
 return Arrays.copyOf(dOutput, dOutput.length);
 }

 /**
 * 原型多样性度量（用于认知度量）
 * 计算所有原型对之间的平均余弦距离
 */
 public float getPrototypeDiversity() {
 float totalDist = 0;
 int pairs = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numPrototypes; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < numPrototypes; j++) {
 float dot = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 for (int k = 0; k < dModel; k++) {
 dot += prototypes[i][k] * prototypes[j][k];
 norm1 += prototypes[i][k] * prototypes[i][k];
 norm2 += prototypes[j][k] * prototypes[j][k];
 }
 float sim = dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 totalDist += 1.0f - sim; // 余弦距离
 pairs++;
 }
 }
 
 return pairs > 0 ? totalDist / pairs : 0;
 }

 public int getNumPrototypes() { return numPrototypes; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public float[][] getPrototypes() { return prototypes; }
 public int[] getActivationCounts() { return activationCounts; }
 public int getLastActivatedIndex() { return lastActivatedIndex; }
 public float getLearningRate() { return learningRate; }
 public float getSimilarityThreshold() { return similarityThreshold; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class SignalPatternGenerator {

 public enum FrequencyBand {
 DELTA(0.5f, 4.0f, "低频"),
 THETA(4.0f, 8.0f, "次低频"),
 ALPHA(8.0f, 12.0f, "中频"),
 BETA(12.0f, 30.0f, "高频"),
 GAMMA(30.0f, 100.0f, "超高频");

 private final float minHz;
 private final float maxHz;
 private final String description;

 FrequencyBand(float minHz, float maxHz, String description) {
 this.minHz = minHz;
 this.maxHz = maxHz;
 this.description = description;
 }

 public float getMinHz() { return minHz; }
 public float getMaxHz() { return maxHz; }
 public float getCenterHz() { return (minHz + maxHz) / 2; }
 public String getDescription() { return description; }

 public static FrequencyBand fromHz(float hz) {
 if (hz < 4.0f) return DELTA;
 if (hz < 8.0f) return THETA;
 if (hz < 12.0f) return ALPHA;
 if (hz < 30.0f) return BETA;
 return GAMMA;
 }
 }

 public enum SignalMode {
 LOW_FREQUENCY(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.DELTA}, "低频模式"),
 SUB_LOW(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.THETA, FrequencyBand.ALPHA}, "次低中频模式"),
 MEDIUM(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.ALPHA}, "中频模式"),
 HIGH(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.BETA}, "高频模式"),
 WIDE_BAND(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.THETA, FrequencyBand.ALPHA, FrequencyBand.GAMMA}, "宽频模式"),
 ULTRA_HIGH(new FrequencyBand[]{FrequencyBand.BETA, FrequencyBand.GAMMA}, "超高频模式");

 private final FrequencyBand[] frequencies;
 private final String description;

 SignalMode(FrequencyBand[] frequencies, String description) {
 this.frequencies = frequencies;
 this.description = description;
 }

 public FrequencyBand[] getFrequencies() { return frequencies; }
 public String getDescription() { return description; }
 }

 private final Random random;
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, double[]> patterns;

 public SignalPatternGenerator() {
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.patterns = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 }

 public SignalPatternGenerator(long seed) {
 this.random = new Random(seed);
 this.patterns = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 }

 public double[] generateWave(FrequencyBand frequency, int sampleCount, float sampleRate) {
 double[] wave = new double[sampleCount];
 float centerHz = frequency.getCenterHz();
 float amplitude = random.nextFloat() * 0.5f + 0.5f;

 for (int i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
 double t = i / sampleRate;
 double phase = random.nextDouble() * Math.PI * 2;
 wave[i] = amplitude * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * centerHz * t + phase);
 }

 return wave;
 }

 public double[] generateCompositeWave(SignalMode mode, int sampleCount, float sampleRate) {
 double[] composite = new double[sampleCount];
 FrequencyBand[] frequencies = mode.getFrequencies();
 
 float[] weights = new float[frequencies.length];
 float totalWeight = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < frequencies.length; i++) {
 weights[i] = random.nextFloat() * 0.3f + 0.1f;
 totalWeight += weights[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < frequencies.length; i++) {
 weights[i] /= totalWeight;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < frequencies.length; i++) {
 double[] wave = generateWave(frequencies[i], sampleCount, sampleRate);
 for (int j = 0; j < sampleCount; j++) {
 composite[j] += wave[j] * weights[i];
 }
 }

 double maxAmplitude = Arrays.stream(composite).map(Math::abs).max().orElse(1.0);
 for (int i = 0; i < sampleCount; i++) {
 composite[i] /= maxAmplitude;
 }

 composite = addNoise(composite, 0.05f);
 composite = applyEnvelope(composite, sampleRate);

 return composite;
 }

 private double[] addNoise(double[] signal, float noiseLevel) {
 double[] result = new double[signal.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
 result[i] = signal[i] + (random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * noiseLevel;
 }
 return result;
 }

 private double[] applyEnvelope(double[] signal, float sampleRate) {
 double[] result = new double[signal.length];
 int attackSamples = (int) (0.1f * sampleRate);
 int decaySamples = (int) (0.2f * sampleRate);
 int sustainSamples = signal.length - attackSamples - decaySamples;
 float sustainLevel = 0.8f;

 for (int i = 0; i < attackSamples; i++) {
 result[i] = signal[i] * (i / (float) attackSamples);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < sustainSamples; i++) {
 int idx = attackSamples + i;
 float envelope = 1.0f - (1.0f - sustainLevel) * (i / (float) sustainSamples);
 result[idx] = signal[idx] * envelope;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < decaySamples; i++) {
 int idx = attackSamples + sustainSamples + i;
 result[idx] = signal[idx] * sustainLevel * (1.0f - i / (float) decaySamples);
 }

 return result;
 }

 public double[][] generateMultiChannelPattern(SignalMode mode, int channels, 
 int sampleCount, float sampleRate) {
 double[][] pattern = new double[channels][sampleCount];
 
 for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
 pattern[c] = generateCompositeWave(mode, sampleCount, sampleRate);
 }

 pattern = addChannelCorrelation(pattern, channels);

 return pattern;
 }

 private double[][] addChannelCorrelation(double[][] pattern, int channels) {
 double[][] result = new double[channels][pattern[0].length];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < channels; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(pattern[i], 0, result[i], 0, pattern[i].length);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < channels; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < channels; j++) {
 double correlation = random.nextDouble() * 0.5 + 0.3;
 for (int k = 0; k < result[i].length; k++) {
 result[i][k] = result[i][k] * (1 - correlation) + result[j][k] * correlation * 0.5;
 result[j][k] = result[j][k] * (1 - correlation) + result[i][k] * correlation * 0.5;
 }
 }
 }

 return result;
 }

 public double[] generateEventRelatedPotential(int sampleCount, float sampleRate, 
 ERPEvent eventType) {
 double[] erp = new double[sampleCount];
 int eventTime = (int) (0.2f * sampleCount);

 switch (eventType) {
 case P300:
 generateP300(erp, eventTime, sampleRate);
 break;
 case N400:
 generateN400(erp, eventTime, sampleRate);
 break;
 case MMN:
 generateMMN(erp, eventTime, sampleRate);
 break;
 case N200:
 generateN200(erp, eventTime, sampleRate);
 break;
 }

 return erp;
 }

 private void generateP300(double[] signal, int eventTime, float sampleRate) {
 int p300Peak = eventTime + (int) (0.3f * sampleRate);
 float amplitude = 0.8f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
 double t = (i - p300Peak) / sampleRate;
 signal[i] += amplitude * Math.exp(-t * t / (2 * 0.05 * 0.05)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * 8 * t);
 }
 }

 private void generateN400(double[] signal, int eventTime, float sampleRate) {
 int n400Peak = eventTime + (int) (0.4f * sampleRate);
 float amplitude = -0.6f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
 double t = (i - n400Peak) / sampleRate;
 signal[i] += amplitude * Math.exp(-t * t / (2 * 0.08 * 0.08));
 }
 }

 private void generateMMN(double[] signal, int eventTime, float sampleRate) {
 int mmnPeak = eventTime + (int) (0.15f * sampleRate);
 float amplitude = -0.4f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
 double t = (i - mmnPeak) / sampleRate;
 signal[i] += amplitude * Math.exp(-t * t / (2 * 0.03 * 0.03));
 }
 }

 private void generateN200(double[] signal, int eventTime, float sampleRate) {
 int n200Peak = eventTime + (int) (0.2f * sampleRate);
 float amplitude = -0.5f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < signal.length; i++) {
 double t = (i - n200Peak) / sampleRate;
 signal[i] += amplitude * Math.exp(-t * t / (2 * 0.04 * 0.04));
 }
 }

 public void savePattern(String name, double[] pattern) {
 patterns.put(name, pattern);
 }

 public double[] loadPattern(String name) {
 return patterns.get(name);
 }

 public void saveMultiChannelPattern(String name, double[][] pattern) {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 for (int i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
 if (i > 0) sb.append("|");
 for (int j = 0; j < pattern[i].length; j++) {
 if (j > 0) sb.append(",");
 sb.append(pattern[i][j]);
 }
 }
 patterns.put(name + "_channels", pattern[0]);
 }

 public double[][] loadMultiChannelPattern(String name, int channels) {
 double[] firstChannel = patterns.get(name + "_channels");
 if (firstChannel == null) return null;
 
 double[][] result = new double[channels][firstChannel.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < channels; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(firstChannel, 0, result[i], 0, firstChannel.length);
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 public SignalMode classifyPattern(double[] pattern, float sampleRate) {
 float dominantHz = computeDominantFrequency(pattern, sampleRate);
 FrequencyBand freq = FrequencyBand.fromHz(dominantHz);

 if (freq == FrequencyBand.DELTA) return SignalMode.LOW_FREQUENCY;
 if (freq == FrequencyBand.THETA) return SignalMode.SUB_LOW;
 if (freq == FrequencyBand.ALPHA) return SignalMode.MEDIUM;
 if (freq == FrequencyBand.BETA) return SignalMode.HIGH;
 return SignalMode.ULTRA_HIGH;
 }

 private float computeDominantFrequency(double[] signal, float sampleRate) {
 int n = signal.length;
 double[] fft = new double[n];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 double sumReal = 0;
 double sumImag = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
 double angle = 2 * Math.PI * i * j / n;
 sumReal += signal[j] * Math.cos(angle);
 sumImag += signal[j] * Math.sin(angle);
 }
 fft[i] = Math.sqrt(sumReal * sumReal + sumImag * sumImag);
 }

 int maxIdx = 0;
 double maxVal = 0;
 for (int i = 1; i < n / 2; i++) {
 if (fft[i] > maxVal) {
 maxVal = fft[i];
 maxIdx = i;
 }
 }

 return (float) (maxIdx * sampleRate / n);
 }

 public String analyzePattern(double[] pattern, float sampleRate) {
 StringBuilder analysis = new StringBuilder();
 analysis.append("=== Signal Pattern Analysis ===\n");
 
 float dominantHz = computeDominantFrequency(pattern, sampleRate);
 FrequencyBand freq = FrequencyBand.fromHz(dominantHz);
 SignalMode mode = classifyPattern(pattern, sampleRate);
 
 analysis.append("Dominant Frequency: " + String.format("%.2f Hz", dominantHz) + "\n");
 analysis.append("Frequency Band: " + freq.name() + " (" + freq.getDescription() + ")\n");
 analysis.append("Signal Mode: " + mode.name() + " (" + mode.getDescription() + ")\n");
 
 double mean = Arrays.stream(pattern).average().orElse(0);
 double std = Math.sqrt(Arrays.stream(pattern).map(x -> Math.pow(x - mean, 2)).average().orElse(0));
 double max = Arrays.stream(pattern).max().orElse(0);
 double min = Arrays.stream(pattern).min().orElse(0);
 
 analysis.append("\nSignal Statistics:\n");
 analysis.append(" Mean: " + String.format("%.4f", mean) + "\n");
 analysis.append(" Std: " + String.format("%.4f", std) + "\n");
 analysis.append(" Max: " + String.format("%.4f", max) + "\n");
 analysis.append(" Min: " + String.format("%.4f", min) + "\n");
 analysis.append(" Peak-to-Peak: " + String.format("%.4f", max - min) + "\n");
 
 analysis.append("\n===================================");
 
 return analysis.toString();
 }

 public enum ERPEvent {
 P300,
 N400,
 MMN,
 N200
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 思维树搜索 — 模拟人类的发散思维和收敛决策过程
 * 
 * 人类解决复杂问题时，不是线性思考，而是：
 * 1. 发散阶段：产生多个可能的思路（树枝）
 * 2. 评估阶段：评估每个思路的可行性和质量
 * 3. 收敛阶段：选择最优路径继续深入
 * 4. 回溯阶段：如果当前路径走不通，回到上一层尝试其他分支
 * 
 * 参考论文：Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
 */
public class TreeOfThought {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int maxDepth;
 private final int branchFactor;
 private final float pruningThreshold;
 
 /** 思路扩展权重 */
 private final float[] wExpand;
 
 /** 思路评估权重 */
 private final float[] wEvaluate;
 
 /** 状态转换权重 */
 private final float[] wTransition;
 
 /** 思维树节点 */
 private static class TreeNode {
 float[] state;
 float score;
 int depth;
 List<TreeNode> children;
 TreeNode parent;
 int visitCount;
 
 TreeNode(float[] state, int depth, TreeNode parent) {
 this.state = state;
 this.score = 0.0f;
 this.depth = depth;
 this.children = new ArrayList<>();
 this.parent = parent;
 this.visitCount = 0;
 }
 }
 
 private final Random random;
 private TreeNode root;
 private final List<float[]> reasoningTrajectory;

 public TreeOfThought(int dModel) {
 this(dModel, 5, 3, 0.5f);
 }

 public TreeOfThought(int dModel, int maxDepth, int branchFactor, float pruningThreshold) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.maxDepth = maxDepth;
 this.branchFactor = branchFactor;
 this.pruningThreshold = pruningThreshold;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.reasoningTrajectory = new ArrayList<>();
 
 this.wExpand = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.wEvaluate = new float[dModel];
 this.wTransition = new float[2 * dModel * dModel];
 
 initWeights();
 }

 private void initWeights() {
 for (int i = 0; i < wExpand.length; i++) {
 wExpand[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wEvaluate.length; i++) {
 wEvaluate[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < wTransition.length; i++) {
 wTransition[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.03f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 执行思维树搜索
 * 1. 构建思维树：从根节点开始，逐层扩展
 * 2. 评估节点：使用评估函数给每个节点打分
 * 3. 剪枝：移除低质量分支
 * 4. 回溯搜索：选择最优路径
 */
 public float[] search(float[] initialState, int iterations) {
 reasoningTrajectory.clear();
 
 root = new TreeNode(initialState, 0, null);
 
 for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
 TreeNode leaf = selectNode(root);
 
 if (leaf.depth < maxDepth) {
 expandNode(leaf);
 }
 
 float value = evaluateNode(leaf);
 backpropagate(leaf, value);
 
 pruning();
 }
 
 float[] bestPath = extractBestPath();
 
 return bestPath;
 }

 /**
 * 选择节点 — 使用UCB-like策略平衡探索和利用
 */
 private TreeNode selectNode(TreeNode node) {
 if (node.children.isEmpty() || node.depth >= maxDepth) {
 return node;
 }
 
 TreeNode bestChild = null;
 float bestScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 for (TreeNode child : node.children) {
 float ucbScore = child.score + 
 2.0f * (float) Math.sqrt(Math.log(node.visitCount + 1) / (child.visitCount + 1));
 if (ucbScore > bestScore) {
 bestScore = ucbScore;
 bestChild = child;
 }
 }
 
 if (bestChild == null) {
 return node;
 }
 
 return selectNode(bestChild);
 }

 /**
 * 扩展节点 — 产生多个分支（思路）
 */
 private void expandNode(TreeNode node) {
 for (int i = 0; i < branchFactor; i++) {
 float[] perturbation = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 perturbation[j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 
 float[] expanded = MatrixOperations.matmul(node.state, wExpand, 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 expanded[j] = node.state[j] + expanded[j] + perturbation[j];
 }
 
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(expanded);
 
 TreeNode child = new TreeNode(normalized, node.depth + 1, node);
 node.children.add(child);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 评估节点 — 评估当前思路的质量
 */
 private float evaluateNode(TreeNode node) {
 float score = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 score += node.state[i] * wEvaluate[i];
 }
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : node.state) {
 norm += v * v;
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 
 score = (float) Math.tanh(score / (norm + 1e-8f));
 
 node.score = score;
 node.visitCount++;
 
 return score;
 }

 /**
 * 反向传播 — 更新路径上所有节点的分数
 */
 private void backpropagate(TreeNode node, float value) {
 TreeNode current = node;
 while (current != null) {
 current.score = (current.score * current.visitCount + value) / (current.visitCount + 1);
 current.visitCount++;
 current = current.parent;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 剪枝 — 移除低质量分支
 */
 private void pruning() {
 pruneNode(root);
 }

 private void pruneNode(TreeNode node) {
 List<TreeNode> toRemove = new ArrayList<>();
 for (TreeNode child : node.children) {
 if (child.score < pruningThreshold && child.depth > 1) {
 toRemove.add(child);
 } else {
 pruneNode(child);
 }
 }
 node.children.removeAll(toRemove);
 }

 /**
 * 提取最优路径
 */
 private float[] extractBestPath() {
 TreeNode current = root;
 reasoningTrajectory.add(Arrays.copyOf(current.state, dModel));
 
 while (!current.children.isEmpty()) {
 TreeNode bestChild = null;
 float bestScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 for (TreeNode child : current.children) {
 if (child.score > bestScore) {
 bestScore = child.score;
 bestChild = child;
 }
 }
 
 if (bestChild != null) {
 current = bestChild;
 reasoningTrajectory.add(Arrays.copyOf(current.state, dModel));
 } else {
 break;
 }
 }
 
 float[] finalState = new float[dModel];
 for (float[] state : reasoningTrajectory) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 finalState[i] += state[i];
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 finalState[i] /= reasoningTrajectory.size();
 }
 
 return finalState;
 }

 /**
 * 执行多步思维链（简化版，类似CoT但支持分支）
 */
 public float[] chainReasoning(float[] input, int steps) {
 reasoningTrajectory.clear();
 
 float[] state = Arrays.copyOf(input, dModel);
 reasoningTrajectory.add(Arrays.copyOf(state, dModel));
 
 for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
 float[] nextState = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += state[j] * wExpand[j * dModel + i];
 }
 nextState[i] = state[i] + 0.1f * sum;
 }
 
 state = layerNorm(nextState);
 reasoningTrajectory.add(Arrays.copyOf(state, dModel));
 }
 
 return state;
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 float[] output = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) * invStd;
 }
 return output;
 }

 public List<float[]> getReasoningTrajectory() {
 return reasoningTrajectory;
 }

 public int getTreeDepth() {
 return computeDepth(root);
 }

 private int computeDepth(TreeNode node) {
 if (node == null || node.children.isEmpty()) {
 return node != null ? node.depth : 0;
 }
 int maxChildDepth = 0;
 for (TreeNode child : node.children) {
 maxChildDepth = Math.max(maxChildDepth, computeDepth(child));
 }
 return maxChildDepth;
 }

 public int getNodeCount() {
 return countNodes(root);
 }

 private int countNodes(TreeNode node) {
 if (node == null) return 0;
 int count = 1;
 for (TreeNode child : node.children) {
 count += countNodes(child);
 }
 return count;
 }

 public float getBestScore() {
 return root != null ? root.score : 0.0f;
 }

 public int getMaxDepth() { return maxDepth; }
 public int getBranchFactor() { return branchFactor; }
 public float getPruningThreshold() { return pruningThreshold; }
 public float[] getWExpand() { return wExpand; }
 public float[] getWEvaluate() { return wEvaluate; }
 public float[] getWTransition() { return wTransition; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * 工作记忆控制器 — 模拟人类工作记忆的有限容量和动态管理
 * 
 * 人类工作记忆的关键特性：
 * - 容量限制：7±2个槽位（Miller's Law）
 * - 基于注意力的读取：通过查询注意力加权读取
 * - 时间衰减：未使用的记忆随时间衰退
 * - 巩固机制：频繁访问的记忆被保护免于衰减
 * - 年龄追踪：每个槽位有年龄计数器，用于LRU替换策略
 */
public class WorkingMemoryController {

 /** 工作记忆槽位数 (7±2 = 默认7) */
 private final int numSlots;
 
 /** 每个槽位的向量维度 */
 private final int dModel;
 
 /** 槽位键矩阵: numSlots x dModel */
 private final float[][] slotKeys;
 
 /** 槽位值矩阵: numSlots x dModel */
 private final float[][] slotValues;
 
 /** 每个槽位的年龄计数器 */
 private final int[] ages;
 
 /** 每个槽位的访问计数 */
 private final int[] accessCounts;
 
 /** 每个槽位是否受保护(不被衰减) */
 private final boolean[] protectedSlots;
 
 /** 衰减率 */
 private final float decayRate;
 
 /** 保护阈值 — 访问计数超过此值则受保护 */
 private final float consolidationThreshold;
 
 /** 随机数生成器 */
 private final Random random;
 
 /** 当前步骤数 (用于年龄累计) */
 private int stepCount;

 public WorkingMemoryController(int dModel) {
 this(dModel, 7); // 默认7个槽位
 }

 public WorkingMemoryController(int dModel, int numSlots) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.numSlots = Math.max(5, Math.min(9, numSlots)); // 限制在5-9之间
 this.decayRate = 0.01f;
 this.consolidationThreshold = 5.0f;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.stepCount = 0;
 
 this.slotKeys = new float[this.numSlots][dModel];
 this.slotValues = new float[this.numSlots][dModel];
 this.ages = new int[this.numSlots];
 this.accessCounts = new int[this.numSlots];
 this.protectedSlots = new boolean[this.numSlots];
 
 // 初始化槽位键（随机初始化，用于注意力计算）
 for (int i = 0; i < this.numSlots; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slotKeys[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 ages[i] = 0;
 accessCounts[i] = 0;
 protectedSlots[i] = false;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 基于注意力从工作记忆中读取
 * attention = softmax(query @ slot_keys^T / sqrt(dModel))
 * output = sum(attention_i * slot_values_i)
 */
 public float[] read(float[] query) {
 MemoryOptimizer mem = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 
 // 计算注意力分数: query @ slot_keys^T
 float[] attentionScores = new float[numSlots];
 float scale = (float) Math.sqrt(dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 float dot = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dot += query[j] * slotKeys[i][j];
 }
 attentionScores[i] = dot / scale;
 }
 
 // softmax归一化
 float[] attention = softmax(attentionScores);
 
 // 更新访问计数（用于巩固）
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 if (attention[i] > 0.1f / numSlots) {
 accessCounts[i]++;
 }
 }
 
 // 加权求和: sum(attention_i * slot_values_i)
 float[] output = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[j] += attention[i] * slotValues[i][j];
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }

 /**
 * 写入工作记忆
 * 策略：找到最久未使用的槽位 -> 用新内容覆盖
 */
 public void write(float[] content) {
 // 查找最久未使用的槽位（年龄最大）
 int oldestSlot = 0;
 int maxAge = ages[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < numSlots; i++) {
 if (ages[i] > maxAge && !protectedSlots[i]) {
 maxAge = ages[i];
 oldestSlot = i;
 }
 }
 
 // 如果所有槽位受保护，选择年龄最大的（即使受保护）
 if (maxAge == 0 && protectedSlots[oldestSlot]) {
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 if (ages[i] > maxAge) {
 maxAge = ages[i];
 oldestSlot = i;
 }
 }
 }
 
 // 覆盖该槽位
 System.arraycopy(content, 0, slotValues[oldestSlot], 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(content, 0, slotKeys[oldestSlot], 0, dModel);
 ages[oldestSlot] = 0;
 accessCounts[oldestSlot] = 0;
 protectedSlots[oldestSlot] = false;
 }

 /**
 * 按相似度合并写入
 * 先找相似槽位(similarity > threshold)，合并；否则写入新槽位
 */
 public void writeBySimilarity(float[] content, float threshold) {
 // 查找最相似的槽位
 int bestSlot = -1;
 float bestSim = threshold;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 float dot = 0;
 float norm1 = 0, norm2 = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dot += content[j] * slotValues[i][j];
 norm1 += content[j] * content[j];
 norm2 += slotValues[i][j] * slotValues[i][j];
 }
 float sim = dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(norm1) * Math.sqrt(norm2) + 1e-8f);
 
 if (sim > bestSim) {
 bestSim = sim;
 bestSlot = i;
 }
 }
 
 if (bestSlot >= 0) {
 // 合并：加权平均
 float alpha = 0.7f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slotValues[bestSlot][j] = alpha * slotValues[bestSlot][j] + (1 - alpha) * content[j];
 slotKeys[bestSlot][j] = alpha * slotKeys[bestSlot][j] + (1 - alpha) * content[j];
 }
 ages[bestSlot] = 0;
 accessCounts[bestSlot]++;
 } else {
 // 没有相似槽位，写入最旧槽位
 write(content);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 所有槽位随时间衰减
 * slot *= (1 - decayRate * (1 - protected))
 * 未受保护的槽位值逐渐衰减到0
 */
 public void decay() {
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 ages[i]++;
 
 if (!protectedSlots[i]) {
 float decayFactor = 1.0f - decayRate;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slotValues[i][j] *= decayFactor;
 slotKeys[i][j] *= decayFactor;
 }
 }
 }
 stepCount++;
 }

 /**
 * 巩固：保护频繁访问的槽位免于衰减
 * 将 accessCount > consolidationThreshold 的槽位标记为受保护
 */
 public void consolidate() {
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 if (accessCounts[i] >= consolidationThreshold) {
 protectedSlots[i] = true;
 }
 
 // 长期未访问的受保护槽位解除保护
 if (protectedSlots[i] && ages[i] > 100) {
 protectedSlots[i] = false;
 }
 }
 }

 /**
 * 重置所有记忆
 */
 public void resetMemory() {
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 Arrays.fill(slotValues[i], 0.0f);
 Arrays.fill(slotKeys[i], 0.0f);
 ages[i] = 0;
 accessCounts[i] = 0;
 protectedSlots[i] = false;
 }
 stepCount = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 获取工作记忆利用率 (0.0 ~ 1.0)
 */
 public float getUtilization() {
 int usedSlots = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 float norm = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 norm += slotValues[i][j] * slotValues[i][j];
 }
 if (norm > 0.01f) {
 usedSlots++;
 }
 }
 return (float) usedSlots / numSlots;
 }

 /**
 * 获取受保护槽位比例
 */
 public float getProtectedRatio() {
 int count = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < numSlots; i++) {
 if (protectedSlots[i]) count++;
 }
 return (float) count / numSlots;
 }

 public int getNumSlots() { return numSlots; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getStepCount() { return stepCount; }
 public int[] getAges() { return ages; }
 public int[] getAccessCounts() { return accessCounts; }
 public boolean[] getProtectedSlots() { return protectedSlots; }
 public float[][] getSlotValues() { return slotValues; }
 public float[][] getSlotKeys() { return slotKeys; }

 private float[] softmax(float[] x) {
 float max = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float v : x) {
 if (v > max) max = v;
 }
 float[] exp = new float[x.length];
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(x[i] - max);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 exp[i] /= sum;
 }
 return exp;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool;

/**
 * AdaptiveBasisLayer with input-statistics-based modulation.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Bases are modulated by input statistics (not just fixed trig functions)
 * - Compute input mean/variance per batch -> adjust frequency scaling
 * - Learnable input-dependent modulation gate: sigma(input @ W_gate)
 * - Original trig modulation preserved for backward compatibility
 * - New method: forwardAdaptive() uses input statistics to modulate
 * - Makes basis modulation truly adaptive to the input distribution
 */
public class AdaptiveBasisLayer {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int nBases;
 private final int nHeads;
 private final float[][] bases;
 private final float[] freqScale;
 private final float[] phaseShift;
 private final float[][] outputWeights;
 private final float temperature;
 private static final ForkJoinPool POOL = ForkJoinPool.commonPool();
 
 // Adaptive modulation parameters
 private final float[][] modulationGateWeights; // [nHeads][dModel] learnable gate
 private final float[] modulationGateBias; // [nHeads] bias for gate
 private float[] cachedInputMean; // batch-level input mean
 private float[] cachedInputVar; // batch-level input variance
 private static final float GATE_SCALE = 0.1f;

 public AdaptiveBasisLayer(int dModel, int nBases, int nHeads) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nBases = nBases;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.temperature = 1.0f;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.bases = new float[nHeads][nBases * dModel];
 this.freqScale = new float[nHeads];
 this.phaseShift = new float[nHeads];
 this.outputWeights = new float[nHeads][dModel * dModel];
 
 // Adaptive modulation parameters
 this.modulationGateWeights = new float[nHeads][dModel];
 this.modulationGateBias = new float[nHeads];
 this.cachedInputMean = new float[dModel];
 this.cachedInputVar = new float[dModel];

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i++) {
 bases[h][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2;
 }
 bases[h] = MatrixOperations.normalize(bases[h]);
 freqScale[h] = 0.5f + random.nextFloat();
 phaseShift[h] = random.nextFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 outputWeights[h][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 modulationGateWeights[h][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * GATE_SCALE;
 }
 modulationGateBias[h] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * GATE_SCALE;
 }
 }

 /**
 * Original forward pass with fixed trig modulation.
 * Fully backward compatible.
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 POOL.invoke(new BasisTask(x, output, bases, freqScale, phaseShift, outputWeights,
 batchSize, seqLen, dModel, nBases, nHeads, temperature, 0, batchSize));

 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 output[i] /= nHeads;
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Adaptive forward pass: uses input statistics to modulate frequency scaling.
 * Bases are modulated by both trigonometric functions AND input-dependent gates.
 */
 public float[] forwardAdaptive(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 // Compute batch-level input statistics
 computeInputStatistics(x, batchSize, seqLen);

 int blockSize = Math.min(8, batchSize);
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b += blockSize) {
 int endB = Math.min(b + blockSize, batchSize);
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] base = bases[h];
 float freq = freqScale[h];
 float phase = phaseShift[h];
 float[] gateW = modulationGateWeights[h];
 float gateB = modulationGateBias[h];

 // Compute adaptive modulation factor from input statistics
 // Gate = sigma(mean @ gateW + var_contrib + gateB)
 float gateInput = gateB;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gateInput += cachedInputMean[j] * gateW[j];
 }
 float adaptiveGate = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-gateInput)));

 // Modulate frequency with adaptive gate
 float adaptiveFreq = freq * (1.0f + 0.5f * adaptiveGate);

 float[] modulatedBase = new float[nBases * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i += dModel) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i + j;
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(adaptiveFreq * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 int flipIdx = i + (dModel - 1 - j);
 modulatedBase[idx] = base[idx] * cosVal + base[flipIdx] * sinVal;
 }
 }
 modulatedBase = MatrixOperations.normalize(modulatedBase);

 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] response = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, modulatedBase, 1, dModel, nBases);

 float maxResp = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float r : response) {
 if (r > maxResp) maxResp = r;
 }
 float sumExp = 0f;
 float[] softmax = new float[nBases];
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] = (float) Math.exp(response[k] / temperature - maxResp);
 sumExp += softmax[k];
 }
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] /= sumExp;
 }

 float[] headOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(softmax, modulatedBase, 1, nBases, dModel);
 float[] projWeights = outputWeights[h];
 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, projWeights, 1, dModel, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] += projected[j];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 output[i] /= nHeads;
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Compute input mean and variance across the batch.
 */
 private void computeInputStatistics(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalElements = batchSize * seqLen;
 if (totalElements == 0) return;

 Arrays.fill(cachedInputMean, 0f);
 Arrays.fill(cachedInputVar, 0f);

 // Compute mean
 for (int i = 0; i < totalElements; i++) {
 int offset = i * dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 cachedInputMean[j] += x[offset + j];
 }
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 cachedInputMean[j] /= totalElements;
 }

 // Compute variance
 for (int i = 0; i < totalElements; i++) {
 int offset = i * dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float diff = x[offset + j] - cachedInputMean[j];
 cachedInputVar[j] += diff * diff;
 }
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 cachedInputVar[j] /= totalElements;
 }
 }

 public float[] forwardOptimized(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 int blockSize = Math.min(8, batchSize);
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b += blockSize) {
 int endB = Math.min(b + blockSize, batchSize);
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] base = bases[h];
 float freq = freqScale[h];
 float phase = phaseShift[h];

 float[] modulatedBase = new float[nBases * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i += dModel) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i + j;
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(freq * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 int flipIdx = i + (dModel - 1 - j);
 modulatedBase[idx] = base[idx] * cosVal + base[flipIdx] * sinVal;
 }
 }
 modulatedBase = MatrixOperations.normalize(modulatedBase);

 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] response = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, modulatedBase, 1, dModel, nBases);

 float maxResp = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float r : response) {
 if (r > maxResp) maxResp = r;
 }
 float sumExp = 0f;
 float[] softmax = new float[nBases];
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] = (float) Math.exp(response[k] / temperature - maxResp);
 sumExp += softmax[k];
 }
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] /= sumExp;
 }

 float[] weightedBase = new float[nBases * dModel];
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 weightedBase[k * dModel + j] = modulatedBase[k * dModel + j] * softmax[k];
 }
 }

 float[] headOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(softmax, weightedBase, 1, nBases, dModel);

 float[] projWeights = outputWeights[h];
 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, projWeights, 1, dModel, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] += projected[j];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 output[i] /= nHeads;
 }

 return output;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNBases() { return nBases; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] base : bases) for (float f : base) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : freqScale) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : phaseShift) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] w : outputWeights) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save adaptive modulation params
 for (float[] w : modulationGateWeights) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : modulationGateBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 dos.writeFloat(temperature);
 }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i++) {
 bases[h][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nHeads; i++) {
 freqScale[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nHeads; i++) {
 phaseShift[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 outputWeights[h][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 // Load adaptive modulation params
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 modulationGateWeights[h][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nHeads; i++) {
 modulationGateBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 dis.readFloat();
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dOutputWeights = new float[nHeads * dModel * dModel];
 float[] dBases = new float[nHeads * nBases * dModel];
 float[] dFreqScale = new float[nHeads];
 float[] dPhaseShift = new float[nHeads];
 float[] dModGateWeights = new float[nHeads * dModel];
 float[] dModGateBias = new float[nHeads];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] modulatedBase = new float[nBases * dModel];
 float[] base = bases[h];
 float freq = freqScale[h];
 float phase = phaseShift[h];

 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i += dModel) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i + j;
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(freq * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 int flipIdx = i + (dModel - 1 - j);
 modulatedBase[idx] = base[idx] * cosVal + base[flipIdx] * sinVal;
 }
 }

 float[] response = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, modulatedBase, 1, dModel, nBases);

 float maxResp = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float r : response) {
 if (r > maxResp) maxResp = r;
 }
 float sumExp = 0f;
 float[] softmax = new float[nBases];
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] = (float) Math.exp(response[k] / temperature - maxResp);
 sumExp += softmax[k];
 }
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] /= sumExp;
 }

 float[] headOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(softmax, modulatedBase, 1, nBases, dModel);
 float[] projWeights = outputWeights[h];
 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, projWeights, 1, dModel, dModel);

 float[] dProjected = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dProjected[j] = dOutSlice[j] / nHeads;
 }

 float[] dHeadOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(dProjected, MatrixOperations.transpose(projWeights, dModel, dModel), 1, dModel, dModel);

 float[] dModulatedBase = MatrixOperations.outerProduct(softmax, dHeadOutput, nBases, dModel);
 float[] dSoftmax = MatrixOperations.matmul(dHeadOutput, MatrixOperations.transpose(modulatedBase, nBases, dModel), 1, dModel, nBases);

 float[] dResponse = new float[nBases];
 float sumGrad = 0f;
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 sumGrad += dSoftmax[k];
 }
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 dResponse[k] = softmax[k] * (dSoftmax[k] / temperature - sumGrad / temperature);
 }

 float[] dxHead = MatrixOperations.matmul(dResponse, MatrixOperations.transpose(modulatedBase, dModel, nBases), 1, nBases, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dxHead[j];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * dModel; j++) {
 dOutputWeights[h * dModel * dModel + j] += headOutput[j / dModel] * dProjected[j % dModel];
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i += dModel) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i + j;
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(freq * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 int flipIdx = i + (dModel - 1 - j);
 float dMod = dModulatedBase[idx];
 dBases[h * nBases * dModel + idx] += dMod * cosVal;
 dBases[h * nBases * dModel + flipIdx] += dMod * sinVal;
 dFreqScale[h] += dMod * base[idx] * (-(float)Math.sin(freq * Math.PI + j * 0.01)) * (float)Math.PI;
 dPhaseShift[h] += dMod * base[flipIdx] * (float)Math.cos(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01) * (float)Math.PI;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("outputWeights", dOutputWeights);
 result.addGradient("bases", dBases);
 result.addGradient("freqScale", dFreqScale);
 result.addGradient("phaseShift", dPhaseShift);
 result.addGradient("modulationGateWeights", dModGateWeights);
 result.addGradient("modulationGateBias", dModGateBias);
 return result;
 }

 public float[][] getOutputWeights() { return outputWeights; }
 public float[][] getBases() { return bases; }
 public float[] getFreqScale() { return freqScale; }
 public float[] getPhaseShift() { return phaseShift; }
 public float[][] getModulationGateWeights() { return modulationGateWeights; }
 public float[] getModulationGateBias() { return modulationGateBias; }

 private static class BasisTask extends java.util.concurrent.RecursiveAction {
 private final float[] x, output, freqScale, phaseShift;
 private final float[][] bases, outputWeights;
 private final int batchSize, seqLen, dModel, nBases, nHeads;
 private final float temperature;
 private final int startBatch, endBatch;
 private static final int THRESHOLD = 4;

 BasisTask(float[] x, float[] output, float[][] bases, float[] freqScale, float[] phaseShift,
 float[][] outputWeights, int batchSize, int seqLen, int dModel, int nBases,
 int nHeads, float temperature, int startBatch, int endBatch) {
 this.x = x;
 this.output = output;
 this.bases = bases;
 this.freqScale = freqScale;
 this.phaseShift = phaseShift;
 this.outputWeights = outputWeights;
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 this.seqLen = seqLen;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nBases = nBases;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.temperature = temperature;
 this.startBatch = startBatch;
 this.endBatch = endBatch;
 }

 @Override
 protected void compute() {
 if (endBatch - startBatch <= THRESHOLD) {
 computeDirect();
 } else {
 int mid = (startBatch + endBatch) / 2;
 invokeAll(
 new BasisTask(x, output, bases, freqScale, phaseShift, outputWeights,
 batchSize, seqLen, dModel, nBases, nHeads, temperature, startBatch, mid),
 new BasisTask(x, output, bases, freqScale, phaseShift, outputWeights,
 batchSize, seqLen, dModel, nBases, nHeads, temperature, mid, endBatch)
 );
 }
 }

 private void computeDirect() {
 for (int b = startBatch; b < endBatch; b++) {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] modulatedBase = new float[nBases * dModel];
 float[] base = bases[h];
 float freq = freqScale[h];
 float phase = phaseShift[h];

 for (int i = 0; i < nBases * dModel; i += dModel) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i + j;
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(freq * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(phase * Math.PI + j * 0.01);
 int flipIdx = i + (dModel - 1 - j);
 modulatedBase[idx] = base[idx] * cosVal + base[flipIdx] * sinVal;
 }
 }

 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] response = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, modulatedBase, 1, dModel, nBases);

 float maxResp = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float r : response) {
 if (r > maxResp) maxResp = r;
 }
 float sumExp = 0f;
 float[] softmax = new float[nBases];
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] = (float) Math.exp(response[k] / temperature - maxResp);
 sumExp += softmax[k];
 }
 for (int k = 0; k < nBases; k++) {
 softmax[k] /= sumExp;
 }

 float[] headOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(softmax, modulatedBase, 1, nBases, dModel);
 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, outputWeights[h], 1, dModel, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] += projected[j];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * CausalInterventionNetwork with True Counterfactual Reasoning.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Three parallel paths: factual, counterfactual, and confounded
 * - Factual: W_factual @ x (what actually happens)
 * - Counterfactual: W_counterfactual @ x (what WOULD happen under different conditions)
 * - Confounded: original path (with spurious correlations)
 * - Output = factual + (counterfactual - confounded) * intervention_strength
 * - Simplified implementation of Pearl's do-calculus
 * - New method: counterfactualReason(float[] x, float[] counterfactualInput)
 */
public class CausalInterventionNetwork {

 private final int dModel;
 private final float[][] interventionWeights;
 private final float[][] confounderWeights;
 private final float[] interventionThreshold;
 
 // Counterfactual reasoning paths
 private final float[][] factualWeights; // W_factual
 private final float[][] counterfactualWeights; // W_counterfactual
 private final float[] counterfactualBias;

 public CausalInterventionNetwork(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.interventionWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.confounderWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.interventionThreshold = new float[dModel];
 
 // Counterfactual paths
 this.factualWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.counterfactualWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.counterfactualBias = new float[dModel];

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 interventionWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 confounderWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 factualWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 counterfactualWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.08f;
 }
 interventionThreshold[i] = 0.3f + random.nextFloat() * 0.4f;
 counterfactualBias[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * Forward pass with three parallel causal paths.
 * Output = factual + (counterfactual - confounded) * intervention_strength
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Path 1: Factual - what actually happens
 float[] factual = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += factualWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 factual[i] = sum;
 }

 // Path 2: Confounded - the biased path (spurious correlations)
 float[] confounded = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += confounderWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 confounded[i] = sum;
 }

 // Path 3: Counterfactual - what WOULD happen under intervention
 float[] counterfactual = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = counterfactualBias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += counterfactualWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 counterfactual[i] = sum;
 }

 // Compute intervention strength per dimension
 float[] doOperator = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float intervention = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 intervention += interventionWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }

 float interventionStrength = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-(intervention - interventionThreshold[i]))));
 doOperator[i] = xSlice[i] * (1 - interventionStrength) + intervention * interventionStrength;
 }

 // Causal output: factual + counterfactual adjustment
 float[] causalOutput = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float interventionStrength = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-(
 MatrixOperations.dotProduct(interventionWeights[i], xSlice) - interventionThreshold[i]))));
 // Output = factual + (counterfactual - confounded) * intervention_strength
 causalOutput[i] = factual[i] + (counterfactual[i] - confounded[i]) * 0.5f * interventionStrength;
 }

 System.arraycopy(causalOutput, 0, output, xOffset, dModel);
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Perform counterfactual reasoning with a specific counterfactual input.
 * 
 * @param x the factual input
 * @param counterfactualInput the counterfactual input (what-if scenario)
 * @return counterfactual output
 */
 public float[] counterfactualReason(float[] x, float[] counterfactualInput) {
 if (x.length != dModel || counterfactualInput.length != dModel) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Input dimensions must match dModel");
 }

 float[] factual = new float[dModel];
 float[] counterfactual = new float[dModel];
 float[] confounded = new float[dModel];

 // Compute factual path on original input
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += factualWeights[i][j] * x[j];
 }
 factual[i] = sum;
 }

 // Compute counterfactual path on counterfactual input
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = counterfactualBias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += counterfactualWeights[i][j] * counterfactualInput[j];
 }
 counterfactual[i] = sum;
 }

 // Compute confounded path on original input
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += confounderWeights[i][j] * x[j];
 }
 confounded[i] = sum;
 }

 // Intervention strength based on factual input
 float[] result = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float intervention = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 intervention += interventionWeights[i][j] * x[j];
 }
 float interventionStrength = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-(intervention - interventionThreshold[i]))));
 result[i] = factual[i] + (counterfactual[i] - confounded[i]) * interventionStrength;
 }

 return result;
 }

 /**
 * Original forward with explicit intervention vector (backward compatible).
 */
 public float[] forwardWithCounterfactual(float[] x, float[] intervention, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] counterfactual = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float doValue = xSlice[i] * (1 - intervention[i]) + intervention[i] * 0.5f;

 float confounder = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 confounder += confounderWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }

 counterfactual[i] = doValue - confounder;
 }

 System.arraycopy(counterfactual, 0, output, xOffset, dModel);
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] row : interventionWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : confounderWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : factualWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : counterfactualWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : interventionThreshold) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : counterfactualBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dInterventionWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dConfounderWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dInterventionThreshold = new float[dModel];
