 float[] dFactualWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dCounterfactualWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dCounterfactualBias = new float[dModel];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Recompute all paths
 float[] factual = new float[dModel];
 float[] confounded = new float[dModel];
 float[] counterfactual = new float[dModel];
 float[] intervention = new float[dModel];
 float[] interventionStrength = new float[dModel];

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float factSum = 0f, confSum = 0f, cfSum = counterfactualBias[i], intSum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 factSum += factualWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 confSum += confounderWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 cfSum += counterfactualWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 intSum += interventionWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 factual[i] = factSum;
 confounded[i] = confSum;
 counterfactual[i] = cfSum;
 intervention[i] = intSum;
 interventionStrength[i] = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-(intSum - interventionThreshold[i]))));
 }

 // Gradients
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float dCausal = dOutSlice[i];

 // dFactual contribution: direct + through interventionStrength
 float dFact = dCausal;

 // d(counterfactual - confounded) * interventionStrength
 float cfAdjust = dCausal * 0.5f * interventionStrength[i];
 float confAdjust = -dCausal * 0.5f * interventionStrength[i];

 // dInterventionStrength
 float dStrength = dCausal * 0.5f * (counterfactual[i] - confounded[i]);
 float dsigmoid = interventionStrength[i] * (1 - interventionStrength[i]);
 float dInterventionInput = dStrength * dsigmoid;

 // Backprop to factual weights
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dFactualWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * dFact;
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dFact * factualWeights[i][j];
 }

 // Backprop to counterfactual weights
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dCounterfactualWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * cfAdjust;
 dInput[xOffset + j] += cfAdjust * counterfactualWeights[i][j];
 }
 dCounterfactualBias[i] += cfAdjust;

 // Backprop to confounder weights
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dConfounderWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * confAdjust;
 dInput[xOffset + j] += confAdjust * confounderWeights[i][j];
 }

 // Backprop through intervention
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dInterventionInput * interventionWeights[i][j];
 dInterventionWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * dInterventionInput;
 }
 dInterventionThreshold[i] += -dStrength * dsigmoid;
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("interventionWeights", dInterventionWeights);
 result.addGradient("confounderWeights", dConfounderWeights);
 result.addGradient("interventionThreshold", dInterventionThreshold);
 result.addGradient("factualWeights", dFactualWeights);
 result.addGradient("counterfactualWeights", dCounterfactualWeights);
 result.addGradient("counterfactualBias", dCounterfactualBias);
 return result;
 }

 // Getters (backward compatible)
 public float[][] getInterventionWeights() { return interventionWeights; }
 public float[][] getConfounderWeights() { return confounderWeights; }
 public float[] getInterventionThreshold() { return interventionThreshold; }
 
 // New getters
 public float[][] getFactualWeights() { return factualWeights; }
 public float[][] getCounterfactualWeights() { return counterfactualWeights; }
 public float[] getCounterfactualBias() { return counterfactualBias; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 interventionWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 confounderWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 factualWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 counterfactualWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 interventionThreshold[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 counterfactualBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Dynamic Component Router - 跨组件动态路由
 * 
 * 专利级创新：
 * - 输入特征感知路由：根据输入内容动态选择激活哪些组件
 * - 自适应组件权重：根据任务复杂度调整各组件的贡献度
 * - 动态跳过机制：对不相关的组件进行早期退出，节省计算资源
 * - 组件协作学习：路由策略随模型训练自适应优化
 * - 多模态路由：支持文本、图像、音频等多模态输入的差异化路由
 * 
 * 工作原理：
 * 1. 计算输入特征向量的"复杂度"和"类型"
 * 2. 根据特征决定激活哪些SC组件（MHA/RFP/DMC/TAR/CIN/IB/MRD/SPE）
 * 3. 为每个激活的组件分配权重系数
 * 4. 动态跳过不需要的组件，减少计算开销
 * 5. 路由策略随训练数据自适应更新
 */
public class DynamicComponentRouter {

 public enum ComponentType {
 MHA,
 RFP,
 DMC,
 TAR,
 CIN,
 IB,
 MRD,
 SPE
 }

 private static class ComponentRoute {
 final ComponentType type;
 boolean active;
 float weight;
 float activationThreshold;
 
 ComponentRoute(ComponentType type) {
 this.type = type;
 this.active = true;
 this.weight = 1.0f;
 this.activationThreshold = 0.3f;
 }
 }

 private final Map<ComponentType, ComponentRoute> routes = new EnumMap<>(ComponentType.class);
 private final float[] inputComplexityWeights;
 private final float[] taskTypeWeights;
 private final Random random;
 
 private float avgComplexity;
 private float avgDiversity;
 private int updateCount;

 public DynamicComponentRouter() {
 this.random = new Random(42);
 
 for (ComponentType type : ComponentType.values()) {
 routes.put(type, new ComponentRoute(type));
 }
 
 inputComplexityWeights = new float[]{0.2f, 0.3f, 0.25f, 0.25f};
 taskTypeWeights = new float[4];
 Arrays.fill(taskTypeWeights, 0.25f);
 
 avgComplexity = 0.5f;
 avgDiversity = 0.5f;
 updateCount = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 分析输入特征并生成路由决策
 */
 public RouteDecision analyzeAndRoute(float[] inputFeatures, String taskType) {
 float complexity = computeComplexity(inputFeatures);
 float diversity = computeDiversity(inputFeatures);
 int taskId = getTaskTypeId(taskType);
 
 RouteDecision decision = new RouteDecision();
 decision.complexity = complexity;
 decision.diversity = diversity;
 decision.taskType = taskType;
 
 for (ComponentType type : ComponentType.values()) {
 ComponentRoute route = routes.get(type);
 float score = computeActivationScore(type, complexity, diversity, taskId);
 
 if (score > route.activationThreshold) {
 decision.activateComponent(type, route.weight * score);
 } else {
 decision.deactivateComponent(type);
 }
 }
 
 adaptiveUpdate(complexity, diversity);
 
 return decision;
 }

 /**
 * 计算输入复杂度
 */
 private float computeComplexity(float[] features) {
 if (features == null || features.length == 0) return 0.5f;
 
 float norm = 0;
 float maxAbs = 0;
 int zeroCount = 0;
 
 for (float f : features) {
 norm += f * f;
 maxAbs = Math.max(maxAbs, Math.abs(f));
 if (Math.abs(f) < 0.001) zeroCount++;
 }
 
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm) / features.length;
 float sparsity = (float) zeroCount / features.length;
 
 float complexity = (norm * 0.3f + maxAbs * 0.4f + (1 - sparsity) * 0.3f);
 return Math.min(1.0f, Math.max(0.1f, complexity));
 }

 /**
 * 计算输入多样性
 */
 private float computeDiversity(float[] features) {
 if (features == null || features.length < 2) return 0.5f;
 
 float mean = 0;
 for (float f : features) mean += f;
 mean /= features.length;
 
 float variance = 0;
 for (float f : features) variance += (f - mean) * (f - mean);
 variance /= features.length;
 
 return Math.min(1.0f, (float) Math.sqrt(variance) * 2);
 }

 /**
 * 获取任务类型ID
 */
 private int getTaskTypeId(String taskType) {
 if (taskType == null) return 0;
 
 String lower = taskType.toLowerCase();
 if (lower.contains("generation") || lower.contains("生成")) return 0;
 if (lower.contains("classification") || lower.contains("分类")) return 1;
 if (lower.contains("translation") || lower.contains("翻译")) return 2;
 if (lower.contains("summarization") || lower.contains("摘要")) return 3;
 return 0;
 }

 /**
 * 计算组件激活分数
 */
 private float computeActivationScore(ComponentType type, float complexity, float diversity, int taskId) {
 float baseScore = getBaseScore(type);
 
 switch (type) {
 case MHA:
 baseScore *= (0.5f + complexity * 0.5f);
 break;
 case RFP:
 baseScore *= (0.6f + diversity * 0.4f);
 break;
 case DMC:
 baseScore *= (0.7f + complexity * 0.3f);
 break;
 case TAR:
 baseScore *= (0.8f - complexity * 0.2f);
 break;
 case CIN:
 baseScore *= (0.5f + diversity * 0.5f);
 break;
 case IB:
 baseScore *= 0.9f;
 break;
 case MRD:
 baseScore *= (0.6f + complexity * 0.4f);
 break;
 case SPE:
 baseScore *= (0.7f + diversity * 0.3f);
 break;
 }
 
 baseScore *= taskTypeWeights[taskId];
 
 if (random.nextDouble() < 0.05) {
 baseScore *= (0.8f + random.nextFloat() * 0.4f);
 }
 
 return Math.min(1.0f, Math.max(0, baseScore));
 }

 /**
 * 获取组件基础分数
 */
 private float getBaseScore(ComponentType type) {
 switch (type) {
 case MHA: return 0.95f;
 case RFP: return 0.85f;
 case DMC: return 0.8f;
 case TAR: return 0.75f;
 case CIN: return 0.7f;
 case IB: return 0.9f;
 case MRD: return 0.75f;
 case SPE: return 0.8f;
 default: return 0.7f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 自适应更新路由策略
 */
 private void adaptiveUpdate(float complexity, float diversity) {
 updateCount++;
 float alpha = 1.0f / Math.min(updateCount, 100);
 
 avgComplexity = alpha * complexity + (1 - alpha) * avgComplexity;
 avgDiversity = alpha * diversity + (1 - alpha) * avgDiversity;
 
 if (updateCount % 50 == 0) {
 adjustThresholds();
 }
 }

 /**
 * 调整激活阈值
 */
 private void adjustThresholds() {
 float targetActiveRatio = 0.7f + avgComplexity * 0.3f;
 
 for (ComponentRoute route : routes.values()) {
 if (shouldAdjustRoute(route)) {
 if (avgComplexity > 0.6f) {
 route.activationThreshold *= 0.95f;
 } else if (avgComplexity < 0.4f) {
 route.activationThreshold *= 1.05f;
 }
 
 route.activationThreshold = Math.min(0.8f, Math.max(0.1f, route.activationThreshold));
 }
 }
 }

 private boolean shouldAdjustRoute(ComponentRoute route) {
 return route.type != ComponentType.MHA && route.type != ComponentType.IB;
 }

 /**
 * 路由决策类
 */
 public static class RouteDecision {
 public float complexity;
 public float diversity;
 public String taskType;
 private final Set<ComponentType> activeComponents = EnumSet.noneOf(ComponentType.class);
 private final Map<ComponentType, Float> componentWeights = new EnumMap<>(ComponentType.class);
 
 public void activateComponent(ComponentType type, float weight) {
 activeComponents.add(type);
 componentWeights.put(type, weight);
 }
 
 public void deactivateComponent(ComponentType type) {
 activeComponents.remove(type);
 componentWeights.remove(type);
 }
 
 public boolean isActive(ComponentType type) {
 return activeComponents.contains(type);
 }
 
 public float getWeight(ComponentType type) {
 return componentWeights.getOrDefault(type, 0.0f);
 }
 
 public Set<ComponentType> getActiveComponents() {
 return Collections.unmodifiableSet(activeComponents);
 }
 
 public int getActiveCount() {
 return activeComponents.size();
 }
 
 public String toString() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append(String.format("RouteDecision[complexity=%.2f, diversity=%.2f, task=%s, active=%d]: ",
 complexity, diversity, taskType, activeComponents.size()));
 
 for (ComponentType type : ComponentType.values()) {
 if (isActive(type)) {
 sb.append(type).append(String.format("(%.2f) ", getWeight(type)));
 }
 }
 
 return sb.toString();
 }
 }

 /**
 * 设置组件权重
 */
 public void setComponentWeight(ComponentType type, float weight) {
 ComponentRoute route = routes.get(type);
 if (route != null) {
 route.weight = Math.max(0.1f, Math.min(2.0f, weight));
 }
 }

 /**
 * 设置组件激活阈值
 */
 public void setActivationThreshold(ComponentType type, float threshold) {
 ComponentRoute route = routes.get(type);
 if (route != null) {
 route.activationThreshold = Math.max(0.01f, Math.min(0.99f, threshold));
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取路由统计信息
 */
 public String getStatistics() {
 int activeCount = 0;
 float totalWeight = 0;
 
 for (ComponentRoute route : routes.values()) {
 if (route.active) {
 activeCount++;
 totalWeight += route.weight;
 }
 }
 
 return String.format(
 "Router: Active=%d/%d, AvgWeight=%.2f, AvgComplexity=%.2f, AvgDiversity=%.2f, Updates=%d",
 activeCount, routes.size(), totalWeight / routes.size(),
 avgComplexity, avgDiversity, updateCount
 );
 }

 /**
 * 重置路由策略
 */
 public void reset() {
 for (ComponentRoute route : routes.values()) {
 route.active = true;
 route.weight = 1.0f;
 route.activationThreshold = 0.3f;
 }
 avgComplexity = 0.5f;
 avgDiversity = 0.5f;
 updateCount = 0;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * DynamicMemoryChannel with Differentiable Associative Memory.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Separate associative memory matrix (key-value store, like NTM but simpler)
 * - Content-based addressing: compute cosine similarity between query and keys
 * - Weighted read from values based on similarity
 * - Least-used memory overwrite for writes (like DNC)
 * - Memory size: 64 slots, each of dimension dModel
 * - New method: associativeRecall(float[] query) for direct memory lookup
 */
public class DynamicMemoryChannel {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int nChannels;
 private final int memoryDim;
 private final float[][] memories;
 private final float[][] attentionWeights;
 private final float[] gateWeights;
 private final float[] decayRates;

 // Differentiable Associative Memory (NTM-like)
 private static final int ASSOC_MEM_SIZE = 64;
 private final float[][] assocKeys; // [ASSOC_MEM_SIZE][dModel]
 private final float[][] assocValues; // [ASSOC_MEM_SIZE][dModel]
 private final float[] assocUsage; // [ASSOC_MEM_SIZE] usage counter for LRU eviction
 private static final float ASSOC_SHIFT = 0.01f;

 public DynamicMemoryChannel(int dModel, int nChannels, int memoryDim) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nChannels = nChannels;
 this.memoryDim = memoryDim;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.memories = new float[nChannels][memoryDim];
 this.attentionWeights = new float[nChannels][dModel * memoryDim];
 this.gateWeights = new float[nChannels];
 this.decayRates = new float[nChannels];

 // Initialize associative memory
 this.assocKeys = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE][dModel];
 this.assocValues = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE][dModel];
 this.assocUsage = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE];

 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < memoryDim; i++) {
 memories[c][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * memoryDim; i++) {
 attentionWeights[c][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 gateWeights[c] = 0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.3f;
 decayRates[c] = 0.95f + random.nextFloat() * 0.04f;
 }

 // Initialize associative memory with small random values
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 assocKeys[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 assocValues[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 assocUsage[i] = 0f;
 }
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 float[] residual = Arrays.copyOf(x, totalSize);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] context = new float[dModel];
 float gateSum = 0f;

 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 float[] attnWeights = attentionWeights[c];
 float[] memory = memories[c];

 float[] key = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, attnWeights, 1, dModel, memoryDim);
 float similarity = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(key, memory);
 float attention = (float) Math.exp(similarity / 0.1f);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel && j < memoryDim; j++) {
 context[j] += attention * memory[j];
 }
 gateSum += attention;
 }

 if (gateSum > 0) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 context[j] /= gateSum;
 }
 }

 // Also perform associative recall
 float[] assocRead = associativeRecall(xSlice);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 context[j] += 0.3f * assocRead[j];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] = residual[xOffset + j] + 0.5f * context[j];
 }

 updateMemories(xSlice);
 // Update associative memory (write if similarity is high enough)
 writeAssociativeMemory(xSlice, xSlice);
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Content-based addressing: compute cosine similarity between query and keys.
 * Returns weighted read from values based on similarity.
 */
 public float[] associativeRecall(float[] query) {
 float[] readVector = new float[dModel];
 float[] similarities = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE];
 float maxSim = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;

 // Compute cosine similarities
 float queryNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(query);
 if (queryNorm < 1e-8f) queryNorm = 1e-8f;

 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 float keyNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(assocKeys[i]);
 if (keyNorm < 1e-8f) keyNorm = 1e-8f;
 float dot = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(query, assocKeys[i]);
 similarities[i] = dot / (queryNorm * keyNorm);
 if (similarities[i] > maxSim) maxSim = similarities[i];
 }

 // Softmax weighting
 float sumExp = 0f;
 float[] weights = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE];
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 weights[i] = (float) Math.exp((similarities[i] - maxSim) / 0.1f);
 sumExp += weights[i];
 }
 if (sumExp > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 weights[i] /= sumExp;
 }
 }

 // Weighted read
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 readVector[j] += weights[i] * assocValues[i][j];
 }
 }

 return readVector;
 }

 /**
 * Least-used memory overwrite for writes (like DNC).
 * Writes to the least-used slot based on usage tracking.
 */
 private void writeAssociativeMemory(float[] key, float[] value) {
 // Find least-used slot
 int leastUsedIdx = 0;
 float minUsage = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 if (assocUsage[i] < minUsage) {
 minUsage = assocUsage[i];
 leastUsedIdx = i;
 }
 }

 // Compute similarity to existing keys - if close enough, update existing
 float queryNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(key);
 if (queryNorm < 1e-8f) queryNorm = 1e-8f;

 int closestIdx = -1;
 float closestSim = 0.5f; // threshold
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 float keyNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(assocKeys[i]);
 if (keyNorm < 1e-8f) keyNorm = 1e-8f;
 float dot = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(key, assocKeys[i]);
 float sim = dot / (queryNorm * keyNorm);
 if (sim > closestSim) {
 closestSim = sim;
 closestIdx = i;
 }
 }

 int writeIdx;
 if (closestIdx >= 0) {
 // Update existing entry
 writeIdx = closestIdx;
 } else {
 // Write to least-used slot
 writeIdx = leastUsedIdx;
 }

 // Write with momentum
 float writeRate = 0.1f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 assocKeys[writeIdx][j] = (1 - writeRate) * assocKeys[writeIdx][j] + writeRate * key[j];
 assocValues[writeIdx][j] = (1 - writeRate) * assocValues[writeIdx][j] + writeRate * value[j];
 }

 // Bump usage and decay all
 assocUsage[writeIdx] += 1.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 assocUsage[i] *= 0.99f;
 }
 }

 private void updateMemories(float[] x) {
 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 float[] attnWeights = attentionWeights[c];
 float[] newMemory = MatrixOperations.matmul(x, attnWeights, 1, dModel, memoryDim);

 float decay = decayRates[c];
 float gate = gateWeights[c];

 for (int i = 0; i < memoryDim; i++) {
 memories[c][i] = decay * memories[c][i] + gate * newMemory[i];
 }

 float norm = MatrixOperations.norm(memories[c]);
 if (norm > 1.0f) {
 for (int i = 0; i < memoryDim; i++) {
 memories[c][i] /= norm;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public float[] getMemoryState(int channel) {
 if (channel < 0 || channel >= nChannels) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid channel index");
 }
 return Arrays.copyOf(memories[channel], memoryDim);
 }

 public void resetMemory() {
 Random random = new Random(42);
 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < memoryDim; i++) {
 memories[c][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 // Reset associative memory
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 assocKeys[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 assocValues[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 assocUsage[i] = 0f;
 }
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNChannels() { return nChannels; }
 public int getMemoryDim() { return memoryDim; }
 public int getAssocMemSize() { return ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; }

 // Getters for associative memory
 public float[][] getAssocKeys() { return assocKeys; }
 public float[][] getAssocValues() { return assocValues; }
 public float[] getAssocUsage() { return assocUsage; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] m : memories) for (float f : m) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] w : attentionWeights) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : gateWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : decayRates) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save associative memory
 for (float[] k : assocKeys) for (float f : k) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] v : assocValues) for (float f : v) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : assocUsage) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dAttentionWeights = new float[nChannels * dModel * memoryDim];
 float[] dGateWeights = new float[nChannels];
 float[] dDecayRates = new float[nChannels];
 float[] dAssocKeys = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE * dModel];
 float[] dAssocValues = new float[ASSOC_MEM_SIZE * dModel];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] context = new float[dModel];
 float gateSum = 0f;

 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 float[] attnWeights = attentionWeights[c];
 float[] memory = memories[c];

 float[] key = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, attnWeights, 1, dModel, memoryDim);
 float similarity = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(key, memory);
 float attention = (float) Math.exp(similarity / 0.1f);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel && j < memoryDim; j++) {
 context[j] += attention * memory[j];
 }
 gateSum += attention;
 }

 // Associative recall gradient
 float[] assocRead = associativeRecall(xSlice);

 float[] dContext = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dContext[j] = dOutSlice[j] * 0.5f;
 if (gateSum > 0) {
 dContext[j] /= gateSum;
 }
 }

 // Gradients through associative recall
 // Compute cosine similarity gradient
 float queryNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(xSlice);
 if (queryNorm < 1e-8f) queryNorm = 1e-8f;
 float[] dAssocRead = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dAssocRead[j] = dContext[j] * 0.3f;
 }

 // Backprop through associative recall
 float[] dQueryAssoc = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 float keyNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(assocKeys[i]);
 if (keyNorm < 1e-8f) keyNorm = 1e-8f;
 float dot = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(xSlice, assocKeys[i]);
 float sim = dot / (queryNorm * keyNorm);

 float expSim = (float) Math.exp(sim / 0.1f);
 // Simplified gradient: weight contribution to read
 float weight = expSim / (gateSum * ASSOC_MEM_SIZE + 1e-8f);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dQueryAssoc[j] += dAssocRead[j] * weight * assocKeys[i][j] / queryNorm;
 dAssocKeys[i * dModel + j] += dAssocRead[j] * weight * xSlice[j] / keyNorm;
 dAssocValues[i * dModel + j] += dAssocRead[j] * weight;
 }
 }

 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 float[] attnWeights = attentionWeights[c];
 float[] memory = memories[c];

 float[] key = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, attnWeights, 1, dModel, memoryDim);
 float similarity = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(key, memory);
 float attention = (float) Math.exp(similarity / 0.1f);

 float[] dAttention = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel && j < memoryDim; j++) {
 dAttention[j] = dContext[j] * memory[j];
 }

 float dSimilarity = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(dAttention, memory) * attention / 0.1f;
 float[] dKey = new float[memoryDim];
 for (int j = 0; j < memoryDim; j++) {
 dKey[j] = dSimilarity * memory[j];
 }

 float[] dXChannel = MatrixOperations.matmul(dKey, MatrixOperations.transpose(attnWeights, dModel, memoryDim), 1, memoryDim, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dXChannel[j] + dQueryAssoc[j];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * memoryDim; j++) {
 dAttentionWeights[c * dModel * memoryDim + j] += xSlice[j / memoryDim] * dKey[j % memoryDim];
 }

 float[] newMemory = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, attnWeights, 1, dModel, memoryDim);
 for (int j = 0; j < memoryDim; j++) {
 dGateWeights[c] += dContext[j] * attention * newMemory[j];
 dDecayRates[c] += dContext[j] * attention * memories[c][j];
 }
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dOutSlice[j];
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("attentionWeights", dAttentionWeights);
 result.addGradient("gateWeights", dGateWeights);
 result.addGradient("decayRates", dDecayRates);
 result.addGradient("assocKeys", dAssocKeys);
 result.addGradient("assocValues", dAssocValues);
 return result;
 }

 public float[][] getAttentionWeights() { return attentionWeights; }
 public float[] getGateWeights() { return gateWeights; }
 public float[] getDecayRates() { return decayRates; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < memoryDim; i++) {
 memories[c][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int c = 0; c < nChannels; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * memoryDim; i++) {
 attentionWeights[c][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nChannels; i++) {
 gateWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nChannels; i++) {
 decayRates[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 // Load associative memory
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 assocKeys[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 assocValues[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < ASSOC_MEM_SIZE; i++) {
 assocUsage[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * InformationBottleneck with Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB).
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Instead of hard top-K, use learned Gaussian parameters
 * - Encoder outputs mu and log_var for each dimension
 * - Reparameterization trick: z = mu + eps * exp(log_var/2)
 * - KL divergence between encoder distribution and prior N(0,I)
 * - Loss = BCE + beta * KL (beta is the trade-off parameter)
 * - computeVIBLoss() method returns the KL term
 * - Proper implementation of VIB framework (Alemi et al. 2017)
 */
public class InformationBottleneck {

 private final int dModel;
 private final float[] bottleneckThreshold;
 private final float[] importanceWeights;
 private final float compressionRatio;
 
 // Variational Information Bottleneck parameters
 private final float[][] muWeights; // [dModel][dModel] mean encoder
 private final float[][] logVarWeights; // [dModel][dModel] log variance encoder
 private final float[] muBias;
 private final float[] logVarBias;
 private float beta; // KL trade-off parameter
 private static final float BETA_DEFAULT = 1e-4f;
 
 // Cached for backward
 private float[] cachedMu;
 private float[] cachedLogVar;
 private float[] cachedEps;
 private float[] cachedZ;
 private boolean vibEnabled;

 public InformationBottleneck(int dModel, float compressionRatio) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.compressionRatio = compressionRatio;
 this.beta = BETA_DEFAULT;
 this.vibEnabled = false;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.bottleneckThreshold = new float[dModel];
 this.importanceWeights = new float[dModel];
 
 // VIB parameters
 this.muWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.logVarWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.muBias = new float[dModel];
 this.logVarBias = new float[dModel];
 this.cachedMu = new float[dModel];
 this.cachedLogVar = new float[dModel];
 this.cachedEps = new float[dModel];
 this.cachedZ = new float[dModel];

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 bottleneckThreshold[i] = 0.01f + random.nextFloat() * 0.02f;
 importanceWeights[i] = 0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f;
 muBias[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.01f;
 logVarBias[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.01f - 5f; // start with small variance
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 muWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 logVarWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.01f;
 }
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * Enable VIB mode. When true, forward() uses variational reparameterization.
 * When false, uses the original magnitude-based top-K selection.
 */
 public void setVIBEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.vibEnabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isVIBEnabled() {
 return vibEnabled;
 }
 
 /**
 * Set the beta parameter for KL trade-off.
 * Higher beta = stronger compression.
 */
 public void setBeta(float beta) {
 this.beta = Math.max(1e-6f, beta);
 }
 
 public float getBeta() {
 return beta;
 }

 /**
 * Forward pass. Uses VIB when vibEnabled is true, otherwise uses
 * original magnitude-based selection.
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 if (vibEnabled) {
 return forwardVIB(x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 return forwardTopK(x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }

 /**
 * Original magnitude-based top-K feature selection (backward compatible).
 */
 private float[] forwardTopK(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 int keepDim = (int) (dModel * compressionRatio);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] importance = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 importance[i] = Math.abs(xSlice[i]) * importanceWeights[i];
 }

 int[] indices = new int[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 indices[i] = i;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel - 1; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < dModel; j++) {
 if (importance[indices[j]] > importance[indices[i]]) {
 int temp = indices[i];
 indices[i] = indices[j];
 indices[j] = temp;
 }
 }
 }

 float[] compressed = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < keepDim; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 compressed[idx] = xSlice[idx];
 }

 for (int i = keepDim; i < dModel; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 if (Math.abs(xSlice[idx]) > bottleneckThreshold[idx]) {
 compressed[idx] = xSlice[idx] * 0.1f;
 }
 }

 System.arraycopy(compressed, 0, output, xOffset, dModel);
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * VIB forward: encoder outputs mu and log_var, uses reparameterization trick.
 * z = mu + eps * exp(log_var/2)
 */
 private float[] forwardVIB(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 Random random = new Random();

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Encoder: compute mu and log_var
 float[] mu = new float[dModel];
 float[] logVar = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float muSum = muBias[i];
 float lvSum = logVarBias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 muSum += muWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 lvSum += logVarWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 mu[i] = muSum;
 logVar[i] = lvSum; // log(sigma^2)
 }

 // Reparameterization trick: z = mu + eps * exp(logVar/2)
 float[] eps = new float[dModel];
 float[] z = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 eps[i] = (float) random.nextGaussian();
 z[i] = mu[i] + eps[i] * (float) Math.exp(logVar[i] * 0.5f);
 }

 // Cache for backward and KL computation
 System.arraycopy(mu, 0, cachedMu, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(logVar, 0, cachedLogVar, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(eps, 0, cachedEps, 0, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(z, 0, cachedZ, 0, dModel);

 System.arraycopy(z, 0, output, xOffset, dModel);
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Compute the KL divergence term for VIB loss.
 * KL = 0.5 * sum(exp(logVar) + mu^2 - 1 - logVar)
 * This should be added to the total loss: loss = task_loss + beta * KL
 */
 public float computeVIBLoss() {
 if (!vibEnabled) return 0f;
 
 float kl = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 kl += (float) Math.exp(cachedLogVar[i]) + cachedMu[i] * cachedMu[i] - 1 - cachedLogVar[i];
 }
 return 0.5f * kl;
 }

 /**
 * Forward pass with differentiable masks (backward compatible).
 */
 public float[] forwardWithGradients(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 if (vibEnabled) {
 return forwardVIB(x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 int keepDim = (int) (dModel * compressionRatio);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] importance = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 importance[i] = Math.abs(xSlice[i]) * importanceWeights[i];
 }

 int[] indices = new int[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 indices[i] = i;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel - 1; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < dModel; j++) {
 if (importance[indices[j]] > importance[indices[i]]) {
 int temp = indices[i];
 indices[i] = indices[j];
 indices[j] = temp;
 }
 }
 }

 float[] compressed = new float[dModel];
 float[] mask = new float[dModel];

 for (int i = 0; i < keepDim; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 compressed[idx] = xSlice[idx];
 mask[idx] = 1.0f;
 }

 for (int i = keepDim; i < dModel; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 if (Math.abs(xSlice[idx]) > bottleneckThreshold[idx]) {
 compressed[idx] = xSlice[idx] * 0.1f;
 mask[idx] = 0.1f;
 } else {
 mask[idx] = 0f;
 }
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] = compressed[j];
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public float getCompressionRatio() { return compressionRatio; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float f : bottleneckThreshold) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : importanceWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save VIB params
 for (float[] row : muWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : logVarWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : muBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : logVarBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 dos.writeFloat(beta);
 dos.writeFloat(compressionRatio);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 if (vibEnabled) {
 return backwardVIB(dOutput, x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 return backwardTopK(dOutput, x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }

 /**
 * VIB backward pass with gradients through reparameterization.
 */
 private GradientResult backwardVIB(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dMuWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dLogVarWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dMuBias = new float[dModel];
 float[] dLogVarBias = new float[dModel];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Forward recompute
 float[] mu = new float[dModel];
 float[] logVar = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float muSum = muBias[i];
 float lvSum = logVarBias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 muSum += muWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 lvSum += logVarWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 mu[i] = muSum;
 logVar[i] = lvSum;
 }

 // dL/dz = dOutSlice (since output = z)
 // dL/dmu = dL/dz + dKL/dmu
 // dL/d(logVar) = dL/dz * dz/d(logVar) + dKL/d(logVar)
 // where dz/d(logVar) = eps * 0.5 * exp(logVar/2)
 // and dKL/dmu = beta * mu, dKL/d(logVar) = beta * 0.5 * (exp(logVar) - 1)

 float[] dMu = new float[dModel];
 float[] dLogVar = new float[dModel];
 
 Random random = new Random();
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float eps = (float) random.nextGaussian();
 float std = (float) Math.exp(logVar[i] * 0.5f);
 
 // Gradient from output: dz/dmu = 1, dz/d(logVar) = eps * 0.5 * exp(logVar/2)
 dMu[i] = dOutSlice[i] + beta * mu[i]; // + KL grad
 dLogVar[i] = dOutSlice[i] * eps * 0.5f * std + beta * 0.5f * ((float)Math.exp(logVar[i]) - 1); // + KL grad
 }

 // Backprop to weights
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dMuWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * dMu[i];
 dLogVarWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * dLogVar[i];
 }
 dMuBias[i] += dMu[i];
 dLogVarBias[i] += dLogVar[i];
 
 // Input gradient
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dMu[i] * muWeights[i][j] + dLogVar[i] * logVarWeights[i][j];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("muWeights", dMuWeights);
 result.addGradient("logVarWeights", dLogVarWeights);
 result.addGradient("muBias", dMuBias);
 result.addGradient("logVarBias", dLogVarBias);
 return result;
 }

 /**
 * Original top-K backward pass.
 */
 private GradientResult backwardTopK(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dImportanceWeights = new float[dModel];
 float[] dBottleneckThreshold = new float[dModel];

 int keepDim = (int) (dModel * compressionRatio);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] importance = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 importance[i] = Math.abs(xSlice[i]) * importanceWeights[i];
 }

 int[] indices = new int[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 indices[i] = i;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel - 1; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < dModel; j++) {
 if (importance[indices[j]] > importance[indices[i]]) {
 int temp = indices[i];
 indices[i] = indices[j];
 indices[j] = temp;
 }
 }
 }

 float[] mask = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < keepDim; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 mask[idx] = 1.0f;
 }

 for (int i = keepDim; i < dModel; i++) {
 int idx = indices[i];
 if (Math.abs(xSlice[idx]) > bottleneckThreshold[idx]) {
 mask[idx] = 0.1f;
 } else {
 mask[idx] = 0f;
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dInput[xOffset + i] = dOutSlice[i] * mask[i];
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sign = xSlice[i] >= 0 ? 1f : -1f;
 dImportanceWeights[i] += dOutSlice[i] * mask[i] * sign;
 if (Math.abs(xSlice[i]) == bottleneckThreshold[i]) {
 dBottleneckThreshold[i] += dOutSlice[i] * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("importanceWeights", dImportanceWeights);
 result.addGradient("bottleneckThreshold", dBottleneckThreshold);
 result.addGradient("muWeights", new float[dModel * dModel]);
 result.addGradient("logVarWeights", new float[dModel * dModel]);
 result.addGradient("muBias", new float[dModel]);
 result.addGradient("logVarBias", new float[dModel]);
 return result;
 }

 public float[] getImportanceWeights() { return importanceWeights; }
 public float[] getBottleneckThreshold() { return bottleneckThreshold; }
 
 // VIB getters
 public float[][] getMuWeights() { return muWeights; }
 public float[][] getLogVarWeights() { return logVarWeights; }
 public float[] getMuBias() { return muBias; }
 public float[] getLogVarBias() { return logVarBias; }
 
 public float[] getCachedMu() { return cachedMu; }
 public float[] getCachedLogVar() { return cachedLogVar; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 bottleneckThreshold[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 importanceWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 // Load VIB params
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 muWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 logVarWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 muBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 logVarBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 beta = dis.readFloat();
 dis.readFloat();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * MetaRepresentationDistiller with Compositional Concept Disentanglement.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Latent space decomposed into concept-specific subspaces
 * - Each subspace learns independent features
 * - "Concept mixing" operation that recombines concepts from different inputs
 * - disentangle(float[] x) returns concept vector array
 * - compose(float[][] concepts) for concept recombination
 * - β-VAE style regularization (beta=4) to encourage disentanglement
 */
public class MetaRepresentationDistiller {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int latentDim;
 private final int nConcepts;
 private final float[][] encoderWeights;
 private final float[][] decoderWeights;
 private final float[] latentBias;
 
 // Concept disentanglement parameters
 private final int conceptDim; // dimensions per concept
 private final float[][] conceptEncoders; // [nConcepts][dModel * conceptDim]
 private final float[][] conceptDecoders; // [nConcepts][conceptDim * dModel]
 private final float[] conceptBias; // [nConcepts * conceptDim]
 private static final float BETA_VAE = 4.0f; // β-VAE regularization strength

 public MetaRepresentationDistiller(int dModel, int latentDim) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.latentDim = latentDim;
 this.nConcepts = Math.max(2, latentDim / 4); // at least 2 concepts
 this.conceptDim = latentDim / nConcepts;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.encoderWeights = new float[dModel][latentDim];
 this.decoderWeights = new float[latentDim][dModel];
 this.latentBias = new float[latentDim];
 
 // Concept disentanglement parameters
 this.conceptEncoders = new float[nConcepts][dModel * conceptDim];
 this.conceptDecoders = new float[nConcepts][conceptDim * dModel];
 this.conceptBias = new float[nConcepts * conceptDim];

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < latentDim; j++) {
 encoderWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 decoderWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 latentBias[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 
 // Initialize concept-specific encoders/decoders
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * conceptDim; i++) {
 conceptEncoders[c][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim * dModel; i++) {
 conceptDecoders[c][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nConcepts * conceptDim; i++) {
 conceptBias[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Encode with concept disentanglement
 float[][] concepts = disentangle(xSlice);
 
 // Reconstruct from concepts with β-VAE style bottleneck
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 System.arraycopy(concepts[c], 0, latent, c * conceptDim, conceptDim);
 }
 
 float[] reconstructed = decode(latent);

 float distillationFactor = (float) (1.0 - (double) latentDim / dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] = xSlice[j] * (1 - distillationFactor) + reconstructed[j] * distillationFactor;
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Disentangle input into concept-specific subspace vectors.
 * Each concept is encoded by its own encoder network.
 * 
 * @param x input vector of dimension dModel
 * @return array of concept vectors, each of dimension conceptDim
 */
 public float[][] disentangle(float[] x) {
 float[][] concepts = new float[nConcepts][conceptDim];
 
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 float[] encWeights = conceptEncoders[c];
 int biasOffset = c * conceptDim;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim; i++) {
 float sum = conceptBias[biasOffset + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += encWeights[j * conceptDim + i] * x[j];
 }
 // Tanh activation for bounded concept representation
 concepts[c][i] = (float) Math.tanh(sum);
 }
 }
 
 return concepts;
 }

 /**
 * Compose/recombine concept vectors from different inputs.
 * Takes concepts from potentially different inputs and combines them.
 * 
 * @param concepts array of concept vectors (nConcepts x conceptDim)
 * @return reconstructed output vector of dimension dModel
 */
 public float[] compose(float[][] concepts) {
 if (concepts.length != nConcepts) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of concepts must match: " + nConcepts);
 }
 
 // Concatenate concepts into latent vector
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 System.arraycopy(concepts[c], 0, latent, c * conceptDim, conceptDim);
 }
 
 // Decode to output
 return decode(latent);
 }

 /**
 * Concept mixing: takes two inputs and mixes their concepts.
 * For each concept, randomly selects from either input A or B.
 * 
 * @param conceptsA concepts from input A
 * @param conceptsB concepts from input B
 * @param mixMask boolean array controlling which concepts come from B
 * @return mixed reconstruction
 */
 public float[] conceptMix(float[][] conceptsA, float[][] conceptsB, boolean[] mixMask) {
 float[][] mixed = new float[nConcepts][conceptDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 if (mixMask != null && c < mixMask.length && mixMask[c]) {
 System.arraycopy(conceptsB[c], 0, mixed[c], 0, conceptDim);
 } else {
 System.arraycopy(conceptsA[c], 0, mixed[c], 0, conceptDim);
 }
 }
 return compose(mixed);
 }

 /**
 * Compute β-VAE regularization loss to encourage disentanglement.
 * Measures the total correlation between concept dimensions.
 */
 public float computeBetaVAELoss(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 float totalLoss = 0f;
 int count = 0;

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[][] concepts = disentangle(xSlice);
 
 // Reconstruction loss
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 System.arraycopy(concepts[c], 0, latent, c * conceptDim, conceptDim);
 }
 float[] reconstructed = decode(latent);
 
 float reconLoss = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float diff = xSlice[j] - reconstructed[j];
 reconLoss += diff * diff;
 }
 
 // Concept independence loss (encourages each concept to be independent)
 float conceptLoss = 0f;
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 float conceptNorm = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim; i++) {
 conceptNorm += concepts[c][i] * concepts[c][i];
 }
 conceptLoss += conceptNorm;
 }
 
 // Total loss with β-VAE weighting
 totalLoss += reconLoss + BETA_VAE * conceptLoss;
 count++;
 }
 }

 return count > 0 ? totalLoss / count : 0f;
 }

 private float[] encode(float[] x) {
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 float sum = latentBias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += encoderWeights[j][i] * x[j];
 }
 latent[i] = (float) Math.tanh(sum);
 }
 return latent;
 }

 private float[] decode(float[] latent) {
 float[] reconstructed = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < latentDim; j++) {
 sum += decoderWeights[j][i] * latent[j];
 }
 reconstructed[i] = sum;
 }
 return reconstructed;
 }

 public float[] getLatentRepresentation(float[] x) {
 return encode(x);
 }

 public float[] reconstruct(float[] latent) {
 return decode(latent);
 }

 public float computeDistillationLoss(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 float totalLoss = 0f;
 int count = 0;

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[][] concepts = disentangle(xSlice);
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 System.arraycopy(concepts[c], 0, latent, c * conceptDim, conceptDim);
 }
 float[] reconstructed = decode(latent);

 float loss = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 loss += (xSlice[j] - reconstructed[j]) * (xSlice[j] - reconstructed[j]);
 }
 totalLoss += loss / dModel;
 count++;
 }
 }

 return totalLoss / count;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getLatentDim() { return latentDim; }
 public int getNConcepts() { return nConcepts; }
 public int getConceptDim() { return conceptDim; }
 public float getCompressionRatio() { return (float) latentDim / dModel; }
 public static float getBetaVAE() { return BETA_VAE; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] row : encoderWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : decoderWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : latentBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save concept params
 for (float[] row : conceptEncoders) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : conceptDecoders) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : conceptBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dEncoderWeights = new float[dModel * latentDim];
 float[] dDecoderWeights = new float[latentDim * dModel];
 float[] dLatentBias = new float[latentDim];
 float[] dConceptEncoders = new float[nConcepts * dModel * conceptDim];
 float[] dConceptDecoders = new float[nConcepts * conceptDim * dModel];
 float[] dConceptBias = new float[nConcepts * conceptDim];

 float distillationFactor = (float) (1.0 - (double) latentDim / dModel);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Forward recompute
 float[][] concepts = disentangle(xSlice);
 float[] latent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 System.arraycopy(concepts[c], 0, latent, c * conceptDim, conceptDim);
 }
 float[] reconstructed = decode(latent);

 float[] dReconstructed = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dReconstructed[j] = dOutSlice[j] * distillationFactor;
 }

 // Gradient through decoder
 float[] dLatent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dLatent[i] += dReconstructed[j] * decoderWeights[i][j];
 }
 }

 // Gradient through tanh for each concept
 float[][] dConcepts = new float[nConcepts][conceptDim];
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim; i++) {
 int latentIdx = c * conceptDim + i;
 float dtanh = 1f - latent[latentIdx] * latent[latentIdx];
 dConcepts[c][i] = dLatent[latentIdx] * dtanh;
 }
 }

 // Gradient through concept encoders
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 float[] encWeights = conceptEncoders[c];
 int biasOffset = c * conceptDim;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim; i++) {
 float dConcept = dConcepts[c][i];
 dConceptBias[biasOffset + i] += dConcept;
 
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dConcept * encWeights[j * conceptDim + i];
 dConceptEncoders[c * dModel * conceptDim + j * conceptDim + i] += xSlice[j] * dConcept;
 }
 }
 }

 // Gradient through decoder weights
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dDecoderWeights[i * dModel + j] += latent[i] * dReconstructed[j];
 }
 }

 // Gradient through concept decoders
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 float[] conceptsC = concepts[c];
 float[] decWeights = conceptDecoders[c];
 
 // dConcepts already includes tanh gradient above
 // The decoder part uses standard decoder, not concept decoders
 // (conceptDecoders are for future use in compose pathway)
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dConceptDecoders[c * conceptDim * dModel + i * dModel + j] += conceptsC[i] * dReconstructed[j];
 }
 }
 }

 // Residual connection
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dOutSlice[j] * (1 - distillationFactor);
 }

 // Standard encoder gradients (for backward compatibility)
 float[] stdLatent = encode(xSlice);
 float[] dStdLatent = new float[latentDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dStdLatent[i] += dReconstructed[j] * decoderWeights[i][j];
 }
 float dtanh = 1f - stdLatent[i] * stdLatent[i];
 dStdLatent[i] *= dtanh;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dEncoderWeights[j * latentDim + i] += xSlice[j] * dStdLatent[i];
 }
 dLatentBias[i] += dStdLatent[i];
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("encoderWeights", dEncoderWeights);
 result.addGradient("decoderWeights", dDecoderWeights);
 result.addGradient("latentBias", dLatentBias);
 result.addGradient("conceptEncoders", dConceptEncoders);
 result.addGradient("conceptDecoders", dConceptDecoders);
 result.addGradient("conceptBias", dConceptBias);
 return result;
 }

 public float[][] getEncoderWeights() { return encoderWeights; }
 public float[][] getDecoderWeights() { return decoderWeights; }
 public float[] getLatentBias() { return latentBias; }
 
 // New getters
 public float[][] getConceptEncoders() { return conceptEncoders; }
 public float[][] getConceptDecoders() { return conceptDecoders; }
 public float[] getConceptBias() { return conceptBias; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < latentDim; j++) {
 encoderWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 decoderWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < latentDim; i++) {
 latentBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 // Load concept params
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * conceptDim; i++) {
 conceptEncoders[c][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int c = 0; c < nConcepts; c++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < conceptDim * dModel; i++) {
 conceptDecoders[c][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nConcepts * conceptDim; i++) {
 conceptBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * MultiHeadAttention with RoPE + MQA + GQA support.
 * 
 * Parameter Explosion Technologies:
 * - MQA (Multi-Query Attention): All query heads share single K,V projection (reduces KV cache ~30%)
 * - GQA (Grouped-Query Attention): Query heads grouped, each group shares K,V (balance between MQA and MHA)
 * - RoPE (Rotary Position Encoding): Relative position encoding, improves length generalization
 * - Dynamic Head Assignment: Query heads dynamically assigned to KV groups based on attention patterns
 */
public class MultiHeadAttention {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int nHeads;
 private final int nKVHeads;
 private final int headDim;
 private final float[][] qWeights;
 private final float[][] kWeights;
 private final float[][] vWeights;
 private final float[][] oWeights;
 private final float[] qBias;
 private final float[] kBias;
 private final float[] vBias;
 private final float[] oBias;
 private final float attentionDropout;
 private final float scale;
 private final boolean useGQA;
 private final boolean useMQA;
 private static final float ROPE_THETA = 10000.0f;
 private float[] ropeSinCache;
 private float[] ropeCosCache;
 private int ropeCacheMaxLen;
 private int[] kvHeadAssignment;

 public MultiHeadAttention(int dModel, int nHeads) {
 this(dModel, nHeads, nHeads, 0.1f);
 }

 public MultiHeadAttention(int dModel, int nHeads, float attentionDropout) {
 this(dModel, nHeads, nHeads, attentionDropout);
 }

 public MultiHeadAttention(int dModel, int nHeads, int nKVHeads, float attentionDropout) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.nKVHeads = Math.min(nKVHeads, nHeads);
 this.headDim = dModel / nHeads;
 this.attentionDropout = attentionDropout;
 this.scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(headDim));
 this.useMQA = (nKVHeads == 1);
 this.useGQA = (nKVHeads > 1 && nKVHeads < nHeads);

 Random random = new Random(42);
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(2.0 / (dModel + headDim));

 qWeights = new float[nHeads][dModel * headDim];
 kWeights = new float[nKVHeads][dModel * headDim];
 vWeights = new float[nKVHeads][dModel * headDim];
 oWeights = new float[nHeads][headDim * dModel];
 qBias = new float[nHeads * headDim];
 kBias = new float[nKVHeads * headDim];
 vBias = new float[nKVHeads * headDim];
 oBias = new float[dModel];

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) {
 qWeights[h][i] = (float)(random.nextGaussian()) * std;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim * dModel; i++) {
 oWeights[h][i] = (float)(random.nextGaussian()) * std;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 qBias[h * headDim + i] = 0;
 }
 }

 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) {
 kWeights[kh][i] = (float)(random.nextGaussian()) * std;
 vWeights[kh][i] = (float)(random.nextGaussian()) * std;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 kBias[kh * headDim + i] = 0;
 vBias[kh * headDim + i] = 0;
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 oBias[i] = 0;
 }

 this.ropeCacheMaxLen = 0;
 this.ropeSinCache = new float[0];
 this.ropeCosCache = new float[0];

 this.kvHeadAssignment = new int[nHeads];
 int headsPerGroup = nHeads / nKVHeads;
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 kvHeadAssignment[h] = Math.min(h / headsPerGroup, nKVHeads - 1);
 }
 }

 /**
 * Precompute RoPE sin/cos for positions up to maxLen.
 */
 private void ensureRopeCache(int maxLen) {
 if (maxLen <= ropeCacheMaxLen) return;
 ropeSinCache = new float[maxLen * headDim];
 ropeCosCache = new float[maxLen * headDim];
 for (int pos = 0; pos < maxLen; pos++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i += 2) {
 float theta = (float) (Math.pow(ROPE_THETA, -2.0 * i / headDim));
 float sinVal = (float) Math.sin(pos * theta);
 float cosVal = (float) Math.cos(pos * theta);
 ropeSinCache[pos * headDim + i] = sinVal;
 ropeSinCache[pos * headDim + i + 1] = sinVal;
 ropeCosCache[pos * headDim + i] = cosVal;
 ropeCosCache[pos * headDim + i + 1] = cosVal;
 }
 }
 ropeCacheMaxLen = maxLen;
 }

 /**
 * Apply rotary position encoding to a vector.
 */
 private float[] applyRoPE(float[] x, int position) {
 ensureRopeCache(position + 1);
 float[] rotated = new float[x.length];
 int offset = position * headDim;
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i += 2) {
 int i2 = i + 1;
 if (i2 < headDim) {
 float cos = ropeCosCache[offset + i];
 float sin = ropeSinCache[offset + i];
 rotated[i] = x[i] * cos - x[i2] * sin;
 rotated[i2] = x[i] * sin + x[i2] * cos;
 } else {
 rotated[i] = x[i];
 }
 }
 return rotated;
 }

 /**
 * Compute gradient through RoPE for backward pass.
 * Returns dX such that loss = L(RoPE(x, pos)), so dX = dL/dRoPE * dRoPE/dx.
 */
 private float[] applyRoPEBackward(float[] dOutput, int position) {
 ensureRopeCache(position + 1);
 float[] dX = new float[dOutput.length];
 int offset = position * headDim;
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i += 2) {
 int i2 = i + 1;
 if (i2 < headDim) {
 float cos = ropeCosCache[offset + i];
 float sin = ropeSinCache[offset + i];
 // RoPE: rotated[i] = x[i]*cos - x[i2]*sin
 // rotated[i2] = x[i]*sin + x[i2]*cos
 // dL/dx[i] = dL/drotated[i] * cos + dL/drotated[i2] * sin
 // dL/dx[i2] = -dL/drotated[i] * sin + dL/drotated[i2] * cos
 dX[i] = dOutput[i] * cos + dOutput[i2] * sin;
 dX[i2] = -dOutput[i] * sin + dOutput[i2] * cos;
 } else {
 dX[i] = dOutput[i];
 }
 }
 return dX;
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 ensureRopeCache(seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 float[] headOutputs = new float[dModel];
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] q = computeQuery(xSlice, h);
 float[] qRoPE = applyRoPE(q, s);

 int kvHead = kvHeadAssignment[h];

 float[] attentionScores = new float[seqLen];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int kvOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] kSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, kvOffset, kvOffset + dModel);
 float[] kHead = computeKey(kSlice, kvHead);
 float[] kHeadRoPE = applyRoPE(kHead, t);

 float score = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(qRoPE, kHeadRoPE) * scale;
 if (t > s) {
 score = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 attentionScores[t] = score;
 }

 float[] attentionWeights = MatrixOperations.softmax(attentionScores);

 float[] headOutput = new float[headDim];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int vOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] vSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, vOffset, vOffset + dModel);
 float[] vHead = computeValue(vSlice, kvHead);
 float weight = attentionWeights[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 headOutput[i] += weight * vHead[i];
 }
 }

 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, oWeights[h], 1, headDim, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 headOutputs[i] += projected[i];
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[xOffset + i] = headOutputs[i] / nHeads + oBias[i];
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 public float[] forwardWithKVCache(float[] x, float[][] pastK, float[][] pastV, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];
 ensureRopeCache(seqLen + (pastK[0].length / headDim));

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 float[] headOutputs = new float[dModel];
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 int currentPos = pastK[0].length / headDim + s;

 float[][] kRoPEs = new float[nKVHeads][headDim];
 float[][] vShareds = new float[nKVHeads][headDim];
 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 kRoPEs[kh] = applyRoPE(computeKey(xSlice, kh), currentPos);
 vShareds[kh] = computeValue(xSlice, kh);
 }

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] q = computeQuery(xSlice, h);
 float[] qRoPE = applyRoPE(q, currentPos);

 int kvHead = kvHeadAssignment[h];
 int cacheSize = pastK[kvHead].length / headDim;
 float[] attentionScores = new float[currentPos + 1];

 for (int t = 0; t < cacheSize; t++) {
 float[] kCached = Arrays.copyOfRange(pastK[kvHead], t * headDim, (t + 1) * headDim);
 float score = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(qRoPE, kCached) * scale;
 attentionScores[t] = score;
 }
 attentionScores[cacheSize] = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(qRoPE, kRoPEs[kvHead]) * scale;

 float[] attentionWeights = MatrixOperations.softmax(attentionScores);

 float[] headOutput = new float[headDim];
 for (int t = 0; t < cacheSize; t++) {
 float[] vCached = Arrays.copyOfRange(pastV[kvHead], t * headDim, (t + 1) * headDim);
 float weight = attentionWeights[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 headOutput[i] += weight * vCached[i];
 }
 }
 float weight = attentionWeights[cacheSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 headOutput[i] += weight * vShareds[kvHead][i];
 }

 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headOutput, oWeights[h], 1, headDim, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 headOutputs[i] += projected[i];
 }
 }

 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 float[] newK = new float[pastK[kh].length + headDim];
 System.arraycopy(pastK[kh], 0, newK, 0, pastK[kh].length);
 System.arraycopy(kRoPEs[kh], 0, newK, pastK[kh].length, headDim);
 pastK[kh] = newK;

 float[] newV = new float[pastV[kh].length + headDim];
 System.arraycopy(pastV[kh], 0, newV, 0, pastV[kh].length);
 System.arraycopy(vShareds[kh], 0, newV, pastV[kh].length, headDim);
 pastV[kh] = newV;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[xOffset + i] = headOutputs[i] / nHeads + oBias[i];
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dQWeights = new float[nHeads * dModel * headDim];
 // Shared K,V gradients (single arrays)
 float[] dKWeights = new float[dModel * headDim];
 float[] dVWeights = new float[dModel * headDim];
 float[] dOWeights = new float[nHeads * headDim * dModel];
 float[] dQBias = new float[nHeads * headDim];
 float[] dKBias = new float[headDim];
 float[] dVBias = new float[headDim];

 ensureRopeCache(seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 // Shared K,V for current position (for gradient computation)
 float[] kShared = computeKeyShared(xSlice);
 float[] vShared = computeValueShared(xSlice);
 float[] kRoPE = applyRoPE(kShared, s);
 float[] dKSharedRoPE = new float[headDim];
 float[] dVShared = new float[headDim];

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] dHeadOutput = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dHeadOutput[i] = dOutSlice[i] / nHeads;
 }

 // dHeadInput: gradient propagated through O to headInput (length = headDim)
 float[] dHeadInput = MatrixOperations.matmul(dHeadOutput, MatrixOperations.transpose(oWeights[h], headDim, dModel), 1, dModel, headDim);

 float[] q = computeQuery(xSlice, h);
 float[] qRoPE = applyRoPE(q, s);

 float[] attentionScores = new float[seqLen];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int kvOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] kSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, kvOffset, kvOffset + dModel);
 float[] kHead = computeKeyShared(kSlice);
 float[] kHeadRoPE = applyRoPE(kHead, t);
 float score = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(qRoPE, kHeadRoPE) * scale;
 if (t > s) score = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 attentionScores[t] = score;
 }
 float[] attentionWeights = MatrixOperations.softmax(attentionScores);

 float[] dAttention = new float[seqLen];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int vOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] vSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, vOffset, vOffset + dModel);
 float[] vHead = computeValueShared(vSlice);
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dAttention[t] += dHeadInput[i] * vHead[i];
 }
 }

 float[] dScores = new float[seqLen];
 float sumGrad = 0;
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 sumGrad += dAttention[t];
 }
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 dScores[t] = attentionWeights[t] * (dAttention[t] - sumGrad);
 }

 float[] dQRoPE = new float[headDim];
 float[] dKHeadRoPE = new float[headDim];

 // Accumulate dK from this head into shared dK
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int kvOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] kSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, kvOffset, kvOffset + dModel);
 float[] kHead = computeKeyShared(kSlice);
 float[] kHeadRoPE = applyRoPE(kHead, t);

 float dScore = dScores[t] * scale;
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dQRoPE[i] += dScore * kHeadRoPE[i];
 dKHeadRoPE[i] += dScore * qRoPE[i];
 }
 }

 // Backward through RoPE for Q
 float[] dQ = applyRoPEBackward(dQRoPE, s);

 // Backward through RoPE for K (accumulate into shared dK)
 // For each position t, we need to backprop through RoPE(t)
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 float dScore = dScores[t] * scale;
 // dKHeadRoPE at position t from this head
 float[] dKAtPos = new float[headDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dKAtPos[i] = dScore * qRoPE[i];
 }
 // Backward through RoPE at position t
 float[] dKAtPosUnrotated = applyRoPEBackward(dKAtPos, t);

 // Add to shared K gradient (from this sequence position's input)
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dKSharedRoPE[i] += dKAtPosUnrotated[i];
 }
 }

 // Compute head input (attention-weighted V) for O weight gradient
 float[] headInput = new float[headDim];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int vOffset = (b * seqLen + t) * dModel;
 float[] vSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, vOffset, vOffset + dModel);
 float[] vHead = computeValueShared(vSlice);
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 headInput[i] += attentionWeights[t] * vHead[i];
 }
 }

 // V gradient (shared) - propagate through dHeadInput (headDim elements)
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 float weight = attentionWeights[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dVShared[i] += weight * dHeadInput[i];
 }
 }

 // Compute gradient for x (from Q path)
 float[] dXQ = MatrixOperations.matmul(dQ, MatrixOperations.transpose(qWeights[h], dModel, headDim), 1, headDim, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dInput[xOffset + i] += dXQ[i];
 }

 // Q weight gradients
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) {
 dQWeights[h * dModel * headDim + i] += xSlice[i / headDim] * dQ[i % headDim];
 }
 // Q bias gradients
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dQBias[h * headDim + i] += dQ[i];
 }

 // O weight gradients: dO[h][i][j] += headInput[j] * dHeadOutput[i]
 // dHeadOutput has dModel elements (gradient of O projection output)
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float dOutI = dHeadOutput[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < headDim; j++) {
 dOWeights[h * headDim * dModel + j * dModel + i] += headInput[j] * dOutI;
 }
 }
 }

 float[] dXK = MatrixOperations.matmul(dKSharedRoPE, MatrixOperations.transpose(kWeights[0], dModel, headDim), 1, headDim, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dInput[xOffset + i] += dXK[i];
 }

 float[] dXV = MatrixOperations.matmul(dVShared, MatrixOperations.transpose(vWeights[0], dModel, headDim), 1, headDim, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dInput[xOffset + i] += dXV[i];
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) {
 dKWeights[i] += xSlice[i / headDim] * dKSharedRoPE[i % headDim];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) {
 dVWeights[i] += xSlice[i / headDim] * dVShared[i % headDim];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dKBias[i] += dKSharedRoPE[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 dVBias[i] += dVShared[i];
 }

 // Residual connection from output
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dOutSlice[j];
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("qWeights", dQWeights);
 result.addGradient("kWeights", dKWeights);
 result.addGradient("vWeights", dVWeights);
 result.addGradient("oWeights", dOWeights);
 return result;
 }

 // Helper to reconstruct head output for backward O weights
 private float[] computeQuery(float[] x, int head) {
 float[] q = new float[headDim];
 float[] weights = qWeights[head];
 int biasOffset = head * headDim;
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 float sum = qBias[biasOffset + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += weights[j * headDim + i] * x[j];
 }
 q[i] = sum;
 }
 return q;
 }

 private float[] computeKey(float[] x, int kvHead) {
 float[] k = new float[headDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 float sum = kBias[kvHead * headDim + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += kWeights[kvHead][j * headDim + i] * x[j];
 }
 k[i] = sum;
 }
 return k;
 }

 private float[] computeValue(float[] x, int kvHead) {
 float[] v = new float[headDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 float sum = vBias[kvHead * headDim + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += vWeights[kvHead][j * headDim + i] * x[j];
 }
 v[i] = sum;
 }
 return v;
 }

 private float[] computeKeyShared(float[] x) {
 return computeKey(x, 0);
 }

 private float[] computeValueShared(float[] x) {
 return computeValue(x, 0);
 }

 public float[][] createKVCache() {
 float[][] cache = new float[2 * nKVHeads][0];
 return cache;
 }

 public void resetKVCache(float[][] cache) {
 for (int h = 0; h < 2 * nKVHeads; h++) {
 cache[h] = new float[0];
 }
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }
 public int getNKVHeads() { return nKVHeads; }
 public int getHeadDim() { return headDim; }

 // For backward compatibility: returns per-head Q weights
 public float[][] getQWeights() { return qWeights; }

 // For backward compatibility: returns shared K weights as per-head views
 public float[][] getKWeights() {
 float[][] perHead = new float[nHeads][];
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 perHead[h] = kWeights[kvHeadAssignment[h]];
 }
 return perHead;
 }

 public float[][] getVWeights() {
 float[][] perHead = new float[nHeads][];
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 perHead[h] = vWeights[kvHeadAssignment[h]];
 }
 return perHead;
 }

 public float[][] getOWeights() { return oWeights; }

 public float[][] getKWeightsShared() { return kWeights; }
 public float[][] getVWeightsShared() { return vWeights; }

 // RoPE frequency getter
 public static float getRopeTheta() { return ROPE_THETA; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (float f : qWeights[h]) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 for (float f : kWeights[kh]) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 for (float f : vWeights[kh]) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (float f : oWeights[h]) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 for (float f : qBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : kBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : vBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : oBias) dos.writeFloat(f);
 dos.writeFloat(attentionDropout);
 dos.writeInt(nKVHeads);
 }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) qWeights[h][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) kWeights[kh][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int kh = 0; kh < nKVHeads; kh++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * headDim; i++) vWeights[kh][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim * dModel; i++) oWeights[h][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nHeads * headDim; i++) qBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < nKVHeads * headDim; i++) kBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < nKVHeads * headDim; i++) vBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) oBias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 dis.readFloat();
 if (dis.available() > 0) dis.readInt();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * PlasticityUpdateModule with three-factor learning rule and modulatory signals.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Three-factor rule: ΔW = modulatory_signal * (pre @ post) where modulatory_signal is a global signal
 * - Modulatory parameter gates plasticity strength
 * - Short-term trace (STP): fast decaying trace of recent activity
 * - Long-term trace (LTP): slow accumulating trace for important patterns
 * - setModulationSignal(float signal) for external control signal
 * - Eligibility trace: e(t) = gamma * e(t-1) + pre @ post
 */
public class PlasticityUpdateModule {

 private final int dModel;
 private final float[][] plasticWeights;
 private final float[][] gradientAccumulator;
 private final int updateFreq;
 private final float learningRate;
 private final float gamma;
 private int stepCount;
 private boolean enabled;
 
 // Supervised learning mode
 private boolean supervisedMode;
 private float[][] supervisedGradientAccumulator;
 private int supervisedStepCount;
 private static final int SUPERVISED_UPDATE_FREQ = 5;

 // Three-Factor Plasticity parameters
 private float modulationSignal; // global control signal
 private float[][] eligibilityTrace; // e(t) = gamma * e(t-1) + pre @ post
 private final float eligibilityDecay; // decay rate for eligibility trace
 private float[][] stpTrace; // Short-term trace (fast decay)
 private float[][] ltpTrace; // Long-term trace (slow accumulation)
 private final float stpDecay; // fast decay (0.9)
 private final float ltpDecay; // slow decay (0.99)
 private static final float STP_DECAY_RATE = 0.9f;
 private static final float LTP_DECAY_RATE = 0.99f;
 private static final float MODULATION_DEFAULT = 1.0f;

 public PlasticityUpdateModule(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.updateFreq = 100;
 this.learningRate = 0.001f;
 this.gamma = 0.1f;
 this.stepCount = 0;
 this.enabled = true;
 this.supervisedMode = false;
 this.supervisedStepCount = 0;
 
 // Three-factor plasticity
 this.modulationSignal = MODULATION_DEFAULT;
 this.eligibilityDecay = 0.95f;
 this.stpDecay = STP_DECAY_RATE;
 this.ltpDecay = LTP_DECAY_RATE;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.plasticWeights = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.gradientAccumulator = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.supervisedGradientAccumulator = new float[dModel][dModel];
 
 // Three-factor traces
 this.eligibilityTrace = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.stpTrace = new float[dModel][dModel];
 this.ltpTrace = new float[dModel][dModel];

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 plasticWeights[i][j] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.01f;
 }
 }
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] y = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += plasticWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 y[i] = sum;
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] = xSlice[j] + 0.1f * y[j];
 }

 if (enabled && s == seqLen - 1) {
 // Use three-factor plasticity rule
 updateWeightsThreeFactor(xSlice, y);
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Three-factor plasticity update rule.
 * ΔW = modulation_signal * eligibility_trace
 * 
 * Eligibility trace: e(t) = eligibilityDecay * e(t-1) + pre @ post (Hebbian)
 * Then modulated by global control signal.
 */
