 private void updateWeightsThreeFactor(float[] x, float[] y) {
 // Compute Hebbian pre @ post
 float[][] hebbian = new float[dModel][dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 hebbian[i][j] = y[i] * x[j];
 }
 }

 // Update eligibility trace: e(t) = eligibilityDecay * e(t-1) + pre @ post
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 eligibilityTrace[i][j] = eligibilityDecay * eligibilityTrace[i][j] + hebbian[i][j];
 }
 }

 // Update STP trace (fast decay - captures recent activity)
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 stpTrace[i][j] = stpDecay * stpTrace[i][j] + hebbian[i][j];
 }
 }

 // Update LTP trace (slow decay - accumulates important patterns)
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 ltpTrace[i][j] = ltpDecay * ltpTrace[i][j] + hebbian[i][j];
 }
 }

 // Oja's normalization term
 float yVar = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 yVar += y[i] * y[i];
 }
 yVar /= dModel;

 // Apply three-factor rule: ΔW = modulation * eligibility - Oja_forget
 float effectiveLR = learningRate * modulationSignal;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float ojaForget = gamma * plasticWeights[i][j] * yVar;
 gradientAccumulator[i][j] += eligibilityTrace[i][j] - ojaForget;
 }
 }

 stepCount++;

 if (stepCount >= updateFreq) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float delta = gradientAccumulator[i][j] / stepCount;
 plasticWeights[i][j] += effectiveLR * delta;
 plasticWeights[i][j] = Math.max(-1f, Math.min(1f, plasticWeights[i][j]));
 gradientAccumulator[i][j] = 0f;
 }
 }
 stepCount = 0;
 }
 }

 /**
 * Set the modulation signal (global control signal).
 * This gates the three-factor plasticity update.
 * 
 * @param signal the modulation value (typically 0.0 to 2.0, default 1.0)
 */
 public void setModulationSignal(float signal) {
 this.modulationSignal = Math.max(0f, signal);
 }

 /**
 * Get current modulation signal value.
 */
 public float getModulationSignal() {
 return modulationSignal;
 }

 /**
 * Get the eligibility trace matrix (read-only diagnostic).
 */
 public float[][] getEligibilityTrace() {
 float[][] copy = new float[dModel][dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(eligibilityTrace[i], 0, copy[i], 0, dModel);
 }
 return copy;
 }

 /**
 * Get the STP trace (short-term trace).
 */
 public float[][] getSTPTrace() {
 float[][] copy = new float[dModel][dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(stpTrace[i], 0, copy[i], 0, dModel);
 }
 return copy;
 }

 /**
 * Get the LTP trace (long-term trace).
 */
 public float[][] getLTPTrace() {
 float[][] copy = new float[dModel][dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(ltpTrace[i], 0, copy[i], 0, dModel);
 }
 return copy;
 }

 public void setSupervisedMode(boolean supervised) {
 this.supervisedMode = supervised;
 if (supervised) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 supervisedGradientAccumulator[i][j] = 0;
 }
 }
 supervisedStepCount = 0;
 }
 }
 
 public boolean isSupervisedMode() { return supervisedMode; }
 
 public void accumulateSupervisedGradient(float[] flatGradients) {
 if (!supervisedMode || flatGradients == null) return;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i * dModel + j;
 if (idx < flatGradients.length) {
 supervisedGradientAccumulator[i][j] += flatGradients[idx];
 }
 }
 }
 supervisedStepCount++;
 
 if (supervisedStepCount >= SUPERVISED_UPDATE_FREQ) {
 applySupervisedGradients();
 }
 }
 
 private void applySupervisedGradients() {
 float supervisedLr = learningRate * 0.1f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float avgGrad = supervisedGradientAccumulator[i][j] / supervisedStepCount;
 plasticWeights[i][j] += supervisedLr * avgGrad;
 plasticWeights[i][j] = Math.max(-1f, Math.min(1f, plasticWeights[i][j]));
 supervisedGradientAccumulator[i][j] = 0;
 }
 }
 supervisedStepCount = 0;
 }

 /**
 * Reset all plasticity traces (eligibility, STP, LTP).
 */
 public void resetTraces() {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 Arrays.fill(eligibilityTrace[i], 0f);
 Arrays.fill(stpTrace[i], 0f);
 Arrays.fill(ltpTrace[i], 0f);
 }
 }

 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 }

 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }

 public float[][] getWeights() {
 float[][] copy = new float[dModel][dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(plasticWeights[i], 0, copy[i], 0, dModel);
 }
 return copy;
 }

 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getUpdateFreq() { return updateFreq; }
 public float getLearningRate() { return learningRate; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] row : plasticWeights) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : gradientAccumulator) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save three-factor traces
 for (float[] row : eligibilityTrace) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : stpTrace) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] row : ltpTrace) for (float f : row) dos.writeFloat(f);
 dos.writeInt(updateFreq);
 dos.writeFloat(learningRate);
 dos.writeFloat(gamma);
 dos.writeInt(stepCount);
 dos.writeBoolean(enabled);
 dos.writeFloat(modulationSignal);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dPlasticWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] y = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += plasticWeights[i][j] * xSlice[j];
 }
 y[i] = sum;
 }

 float[] dY = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dY[j] = dOutSlice[j] * 0.1f;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dY[i] * plasticWeights[i][j];
 dPlasticWeights[i * dModel + j] += xSlice[j] * dY[i];
 }
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dOutSlice[j];
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("plasticWeights", dPlasticWeights);
 return result;
 }

 public float[][] getPlasticWeights() { return plasticWeights; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 plasticWeights[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gradientAccumulator[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 // Load three-factor traces
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 eligibilityTrace[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 stpTrace[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 ltpTrace[i][j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 dis.readInt();
 dis.readFloat();
 dis.readFloat();
 stepCount = dis.readInt();
 enabled = dis.readBoolean();
 modulationSignal = dis.readFloat();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * TopologyAwareRouter with Meta-Cognitive Routing and uncertainty estimation.
 * 
 * Innovation:
 * - Each expert computes its own confidence score
 * - Router weights by confidence (not just top-K logits)
 * - Uncertainty path for low-confidence inputs (learned default transform)
 * - Gumbel-Softmax during training for exploration, deterministic top-K during inference
 * - Tracks routing statistics for load balancing
 */
public class TopologyAwareRouter {

 private final int dModel;
 private final int nPaths;
 private final int topK;
 private final float[][] pathWeights;
 private final float[] signatureWeights;
 private final float[] routingWeights;
 
 // Meta-Cognitive: expert confidence weights
 private final float[] expertConfidenceWeights; // [nPaths] per-expert confidence
 private final float[] uncertaintyPathWeights; // [dModel * dModel] default transform
 private final float uncertaintyThreshold; // threshold for uncertainty path
 
 // Gumbel-Softmax temperature for stochastic routing
 private float gumbelTemperature;
 private boolean trainingMode; // true = stochastic (Gumbel), false = deterministic
 
 // Routing statistics for load balancing
 private final int[] routingCounts;
 private int totalRoutingDecisions;
 private boolean trackStatistics;

 public TopologyAwareRouter(int dModel, int nPaths, int topK) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nPaths = nPaths;
 this.topK = topK;

 Random random = new Random(42);
 this.pathWeights = new float[nPaths][dModel * dModel];
 this.signatureWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.routingWeights = new float[dModel * nPaths];
 
 // Meta-cognitive parameters
 this.expertConfidenceWeights = new float[nPaths];
 this.uncertaintyPathWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 this.uncertaintyThreshold = 0.3f;
 this.gumbelTemperature = 1.0f;
 this.trainingMode = false;
 
 // Routing statistics
 this.routingCounts = new int[nPaths];
 this.totalRoutingDecisions = 0;
 this.trackStatistics = true;

 for (int p = 0; p < nPaths; p++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 pathWeights[p][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 expertConfidenceWeights[p] = 0.5f + random.nextFloat() * 0.5f;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 signatureWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 uncertaintyPathWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * nPaths; i++) {
 routingWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }

 /**
 * Set training mode: true enables Gumbel-Softmax stochastic routing,
 * false enables deterministic top-K routing.
 */
 public void setTrainingMode(boolean training) {
 this.trainingMode = training;
 }

 public boolean isTrainingMode() {
 return trainingMode;
 }

 /**
 * Set Gumbel-Softmax temperature (higher = more exploration).
 */
 public void setGumbelTemperature(float temp) {
 this.gumbelTemperature = Math.max(0.1f, temp);
 }

 /**
 * Enable/disable routing statistics tracking.
 */
 public void setTrackStatistics(boolean track) {
 this.trackStatistics = track;
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] output = new float[totalSize];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] signature = computeSignature(xSlice);
 float[] pathLogits = computePathLogits(signature);
 
 // Compute confidence scores
 float[] confidenceScores = computeConfidenceScores(pathLogits);
 
 // Check if max confidence exceeds threshold
 float maxConf = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float c : confidenceScores) {
 if (c > maxConf) maxConf = c;
 }

 float[] combinedOutput = new float[dModel];

 if (maxConf < uncertaintyThreshold) {
 // Uncertainty path: use learned default transform
 combinedOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, uncertaintyPathWeights, 1, dModel, dModel);
 } else {
 // Normal routing with confidence weighting
 int[] selectedPaths;
 if (trainingMode) {
 selectedPaths = selectPathsGumbel(pathLogits);
 } else {
 selectedPaths = selectPathsDeterministic(confidenceScores);
 }
 
 float[] pathScores = confidenceScores;
 float scoreSum = 0f;

 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 int pathIdx = selectedPaths[k];
 float score = pathScores[pathIdx];

 float[] pathWeight = pathWeights[pathIdx];
 float[] pathOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, pathWeight, 1, dModel, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 combinedOutput[j] += score * pathOutput[j];
 }
 scoreSum += score;
 }

 if (scoreSum > 0) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 combinedOutput[j] /= scoreSum;
 }
 }

 // Update routing statistics
 if (trackStatistics) {
 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 routingCounts[selectedPaths[k]]++;
 }
 totalRoutingDecisions++;
 }
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 output[xOffset + j] = xSlice[j] + combinedOutput[j];
 }
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * Compute expert confidence scores from routing logits.
 * Confidence = sigmoid(logit * expert_confidence_weight)
 */
 private float[] computeConfidenceScores(float[] logits) {
 float[] scores = new float[nPaths];
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 float weightedLogit = logits[i] * expertConfidenceWeights[i];
 scores[i] = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-weightedLogit)));
 }
 return scores;
 }

 private float[] computeSignature(float[] x) {
 float[] signature = MatrixOperations.matmul(x, signatureWeights, 1, dModel, dModel);
 signature = MatrixOperations.relu(signature);
 return MatrixOperations.normalize(signature);
 }

 private float[] computePathLogits(float[] signature) {
 return MatrixOperations.matmul(signature, routingWeights, 1, dModel, nPaths);
 }

 /**
 * Gumbel-Softmax routing for stochastic exploration during training.
 */
 private int[] selectPathsGumbel(float[] logits) {
 Random random = new Random();
 float[] gumbelLogits = new float[nPaths];
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 float u = random.nextFloat() + 1e-10f;
 float gumbel = (float) (-Math.log(-Math.log(u)));
 gumbelLogits[i] = (logits[i] + gumbel) / gumbelTemperature;
 }

 return topKIndices(gumbelLogits);
 }

 /**
 * Deterministic top-K routing for inference.
 */
 private int[] selectPathsDeterministic(float[] scores) {
 return topKIndices(scores);
 }

 private int[] topKIndices(float[] values) {
 int[] indices = new int[nPaths];
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 indices[i] = i;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths - 1; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < nPaths; j++) {
 if (values[indices[j]] > values[indices[i]]) {
 int temp = indices[i];
 indices[i] = indices[j];
 indices[j] = temp;
 }
 }
 }
 return Arrays.copyOf(indices, topK);
 }

 /**
 * Get load balancing statistics.
 */
 public float[] getRoutingDistribution() {
 float[] dist = new float[nPaths];
 if (totalRoutingDecisions == 0) return dist;
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 dist[i] = (float) routingCounts[i] / totalRoutingDecisions;
 }
 return dist;
 }

 /**
 * Compute load balancing loss (encourages uniform routing).
 */
 public float computeLoadBalancingLoss() {
 float[] dist = getRoutingDistribution();
 float uniform = 1.0f / nPaths;
 float loss = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 float diff = dist[i] - uniform;
 loss += diff * diff;
 }
 return loss * nPaths; // scaled by nPaths
 }

 public void resetRoutingStatistics() {
 Arrays.fill(routingCounts, 0);
 totalRoutingDecisions = 0;
 }

 // Backward compatible getters
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNPaths() { return nPaths; }
 public int getTopK() { return topK; }

 // New getters
 public float[] getExpertConfidenceWeights() { return expertConfidenceWeights; }
 public float[] getUncertaintyPathWeights() { return uncertaintyPathWeights; }
 public float getUncertaintyThreshold() { return uncertaintyThreshold; }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (float[] w : pathWeights) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : signatureWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : routingWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 // Save meta-cognitive params
 for (float f : expertConfidenceWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : uncertaintyPathWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 dos.writeFloat(uncertaintyThreshold);
 dos.writeFloat(gumbelTemperature);
 dos.writeBoolean(trainingMode);
 }

 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput, float[] x, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 float[] dPathWeights = new float[nPaths * dModel * dModel];
 float[] dSignatureWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dRoutingWeights = new float[dModel * nPaths];
 float[] dExpertConfidence = new float[nPaths];
 float[] dUncertaintyWeights = new float[dModel * dModel];

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int xOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] xSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(x, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);
 float[] dOutSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(dOutput, xOffset, xOffset + dModel);

 float[] signature = computeSignature(xSlice);
 float[] rawLogits = computePathLogits(signature);
 float[] confidenceScores = computeConfidenceScores(rawLogits);

 float maxConf = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float c : confidenceScores) {
 if (c > maxConf) maxConf = c;
 }

 if (maxConf < uncertaintyThreshold) {
 // Uncertainty path gradient
 float[] dCombined = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dCombined[j] = dOutSlice[j];
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * dModel; j++) {
 dUncertaintyWeights[j] += xSlice[j / dModel] * dCombined[j % dModel];
 }
 float[] dXUncertainty = MatrixOperations.matmul(dCombined, 
 MatrixOperations.transpose(uncertaintyPathWeights, dModel, dModel), 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dXUncertainty[j];
 }
 } else {
 int[] selectedPaths = selectPathsDeterministic(confidenceScores);
 float[] pathScores = confidenceScores;
 float scoreSum = 0f;
 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 scoreSum += pathScores[selectedPaths[k]];
 }

 float[] dCombined = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dCombined[j] = dOutSlice[j];
 }

 float[] dSignature = new float[dModel];
 float[] dLogits = new float[nPaths];

 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 int pathIdx = selectedPaths[k];
 float score = pathScores[pathIdx];
 float weight = scoreSum > 0 ? score / scoreSum : 1f / topK;

 float[] pathWeight = pathWeights[pathIdx];
 float[] pathOutput = MatrixOperations.matmul(xSlice, pathWeight, 1, dModel, dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float dPathOutput = dCombined[j] * weight;
 float[] dXPath = MatrixOperations.matmul(new float[]{dPathOutput}, 
 MatrixOperations.transpose(pathWeight, dModel, dModel), 1, 1, dModel);
 for (int jj = 0; jj < dModel; jj++) {
 dInput[xOffset + jj] += dXPath[jj];
 }

 for (int jj = 0; jj < dModel * dModel; jj++) {
 dPathWeights[pathIdx * dModel * dModel + jj] += xSlice[jj / dModel] * dPathOutput;
 }

 dLogits[pathIdx] += dCombined[j] * pathOutput[j] * 
 (scoreSum > 0 ? (1 - weight) / scoreSum : 0);
 }
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dOutSlice[j];
 }

 // Backprop through confidence scores
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 float sigmoid = confidenceScores[i];
 float dSig = sigmoid * (1 - sigmoid);
 dLogits[i] *= dSig * expertConfidenceWeights[i];
 dExpertConfidence[i] += dLogits[i] * rawLogits[i];
 }

 float[] dSigRaw = MatrixOperations.matmul(dLogits, 
 MatrixOperations.transpose(routingWeights, dModel, nPaths), 1, nPaths, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 float reluGrad = signature[j] > 0 ? 1 : 0;
 dSignature[j] += dSigRaw[j] * reluGrad;
 }

 float[] dSigNorm = new float[dModel];
 float sigNorm = MatrixOperations.norm(signature);
 if (sigNorm > 1e-8f) {
 float dot = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(dSignature, signature);
 float sigNorm3 = sigNorm * sigNorm * sigNorm;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dSigNorm[j] = dSignature[j] / sigNorm - dot * signature[j] / sigNorm3;
 }
 }

 float[] dxSig = MatrixOperations.matmul(dSigNorm, 
 MatrixOperations.transpose(signatureWeights, dModel, dModel), 1, dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dInput[xOffset + j] += dxSig[j];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * dModel; j++) {
 dSignatureWeights[j] += xSlice[j / dModel] * dSigNorm[j % dModel];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * nPaths; j++) {
 dRoutingWeights[j] += signature[j / nPaths] * dLogits[j % nPaths];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 result.addGradient("pathWeights", dPathWeights);
 result.addGradient("signatureWeights", dSignatureWeights);
 result.addGradient("routingWeights", dRoutingWeights);
 result.addGradient("expertConfidenceWeights", dExpertConfidence);
 result.addGradient("uncertaintyPathWeights", dUncertaintyWeights);
 return result;
 }

 public float[][] getPathWeights() { return pathWeights; }
 public float[] getSignatureWeights() { return signatureWeights; }
 public float[] getRoutingWeights() { return routingWeights; }

 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 for (int p = 0; p < nPaths; p++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 pathWeights[p][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 signatureWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * nPaths; i++) {
 routingWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 // Load meta-cognitive params
 for (int i = 0; i < nPaths; i++) {
 expertConfidenceWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 uncertaintyPathWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 dis.readFloat();
 dis.readFloat();
 trainingMode = dis.readBoolean();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.compression;

import java.util.*;

public class ModelCompression {
 
 public static class CompressionResult {
 public final String compressedModelId;
 public final long originalSize;
 public final long compressedSize;
 public final float compressionRatio;
 public final float accuracyLoss;
 public final String method;
 
 public CompressionResult(String compressedModelId, long originalSize, long compressedSize, 
 float compressionRatio, float accuracyLoss, String method) {
 this.compressedModelId = compressedModelId;
 this.originalSize = originalSize;
 this.compressedSize = compressedSize;
 this.compressionRatio = compressionRatio;
 this.accuracyLoss = accuracyLoss;
 this.method = method;
 }
 }
 
 public static class QuantizationConfig {
 public int bits;
 public boolean useGroupedQuantization;
 public int groupSize;
 public boolean enableActivationQuantization;
 
 public QuantizationConfig(int bits) {
 this.bits = bits;
 this.useGroupedQuantization = true;
 this.groupSize = 128;
 this.enableActivationQuantization = false;
 }
 }
 
 private final Map<String, Object> compressedModels;
 private volatile boolean enabled;
 
 public ModelCompression() {
 this.compressedModels = new HashMap<>();
 this.enabled = true;
 }
 
 public CompressionResult quantize(Object model, String modelId, QuantizationConfig config) {
 if (!enabled) {
 return new CompressionResult(modelId, 0, 0, 1.0f, 0.0f, "disabled");
 }
 
 long originalSize = estimateModelSize(model);
 float ratio = 32.0f / config.bits;
 long compressedSize = (long) (originalSize / ratio);
 float accuracyLoss = calculateAccuracyLoss(config.bits);
 
 compressedModels.put(modelId + "_quantized", model);
 
 return new CompressionResult(
 modelId + "_quantized",
 originalSize,
 compressedSize,
 ratio,
 accuracyLoss,
 "quantization_" + config.bits + "bit"
 );
 }
 
 public CompressionResult sparseify(Object model, String modelId, float sparsityRatio) {
 if (!enabled) {
 return new CompressionResult(modelId, 0, 0, 1.0f, 0.0f, "disabled");
 }
 
 long originalSize = estimateModelSize(model);
 long compressedSize = (long) (originalSize * (1 - sparsityRatio));
 float accuracyLoss = sparsityRatio * 0.05f;
 
 compressedModels.put(modelId + "_sparse", model);
 
 return new CompressionResult(
 modelId + "_sparse",
 originalSize,
 compressedSize,
 1.0f / (1 - sparsityRatio),
 accuracyLoss,
 "sparseify_" + (int)(sparsityRatio * 100) + "%"
 );
 }
 
 public CompressionResult distill(Object teacherModel, Object studentModel, String modelId) {
 if (!enabled) {
 return new CompressionResult(modelId, 0, 0, 1.0f, 0.0f, "disabled");
 }
 
 long teacherSize = estimateModelSize(teacherModel);
 long studentSize = estimateModelSize(studentModel);
 float ratio = (float) teacherSize / studentSize;
 float accuracyLoss = 0.02f;
 
 compressedModels.put(modelId + "_distilled", studentModel);
 
 return new CompressionResult(
 modelId + "_distilled",
 teacherSize,
 studentSize,
 ratio,
 accuracyLoss,
 "distillation"
 );
 }
 
 public CompressionResult applyMixedCompression(Object model, String modelId, 
 QuantizationConfig qConfig, 
 float sparsityRatio) {
 CompressionResult qResult = quantize(model, modelId, qConfig);
 CompressionResult sResult = sparseify(model, modelId + "_quantized", sparsityRatio);
 
 float combinedRatio = qResult.compressionRatio * sResult.compressionRatio;
 float combinedLoss = qResult.accuracyLoss + sResult.accuracyLoss;
 
 return new CompressionResult(
 modelId + "_mixed",
 qResult.originalSize,
 (long) (qResult.originalSize / combinedRatio),
 combinedRatio,
 combinedLoss,
 "mixed"
 );
 }
 
 public Object getCompressedModel(String compressedModelId) {
 return compressedModels.get(compressedModelId);
 }
 
 public Set<String> listCompressedModels() {
 return compressedModels.keySet();
 }
 
 public void removeCompressedModel(String compressedModelId) {
 compressedModels.remove(compressedModelId);
 }
 
 private long estimateModelSize(Object model) {
 return model != null ? model.toString().length() * 1024 : 0;
 }
 
 private float calculateAccuracyLoss(int bits) {
 if (bits >= 16) return 0.001f;
 if (bits >= 8) return 0.005f;
 if (bits >= 4) return 0.02f;
 return 0.05f;
 }
 
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "ModelCompression: enabled=%s, compressed_models=%d",
 enabled, compressedModels.size()
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.compute;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class AdaptiveComputeEngine {
 
 public static class ComputePlan {
 public final int computeLevel;
 public final int batchSize;
 public final int maxTokens;
 public final int parallelism;
 public final boolean useGPU;
 
 public ComputePlan(int computeLevel, int batchSize, int maxTokens, int parallelism, boolean useGPU) {
 this.computeLevel = computeLevel;
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
 this.parallelism = parallelism;
 this.useGPU = useGPU;
 }
 }
 
 private final ExecutorService executor;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService monitor;
 private volatile int currentLoad;
 private volatile int targetComputeLevel;
 private volatile boolean autoScaleEnabled;
 private final int maxComputeLevel;
 
 public AdaptiveComputeEngine(int maxComputeLevel) {
 this.maxComputeLevel = maxComputeLevel;
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(maxComputeLevel * 4);
 this.monitor = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1);
 this.currentLoad = 0;
 this.targetComputeLevel = 1;
 this.autoScaleEnabled = true;
 startLoadMonitoring();
 }
 
 public AdaptiveComputeEngine() {
 this(5);
 }
 
 private void startLoadMonitoring() {
 monitor.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (autoScaleEnabled) {
 adjustComputeLevel();
 }
 }, 0, 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 }
 
 private synchronized void adjustComputeLevel() {
 if (currentLoad < 20) {
 targetComputeLevel = Math.max(1, targetComputeLevel - 1);
 } else if (currentLoad < 50) {
 targetComputeLevel = 2;
 } else if (currentLoad < 70) {
 targetComputeLevel = 3;
 } else if (currentLoad < 90) {
 targetComputeLevel = 4;
 } else {
 targetComputeLevel = maxComputeLevel;
 }
 }
 
 public ComputePlan generatePlan(String input) {
 int complexity = analyzeComplexity(input);
 
 int batchSize = Math.max(1, 8 - complexity);
 int maxTokens = Math.max(100, 1024 - (complexity * 100));
 int parallelism = Math.min(8, complexity + 1);
 boolean useGPU = complexity >= 3;
 
 return new ComputePlan(targetComputeLevel, batchSize, maxTokens, parallelism, useGPU);
 }
 
 private int analyzeComplexity(String input) {
 int complexity = 1;
 
 if (input.length() > 1000) complexity++;
 if (input.length() > 5000) complexity++;
 if (input.length() > 10000) complexity++;
 
 if (input.contains("数学") || input.contains("计算") || input.contains("证明")) complexity++;
 if (input.contains("代码") || input.contains("编程") || input.contains("算法")) complexity++;
 if (input.contains("分析") || input.contains("推理") || input.contains("逻辑")) complexity++;
 
 return Math.min(maxComputeLevel, complexity);
 }
 
 public Future<String> executeWithPlan(String input, ComputePlan plan) {
 incrementLoad();
 
 return executor.submit(() -> {
 try {
 Thread.sleep(plan.computeLevel * 50);
 return "[Compute Level " + plan.computeLevel + "] Processed: " + input.substring(0, Math.min(50, input.length())) + "...";
 } finally {
 decrementLoad();
 }
 });
 }
 
 private synchronized void incrementLoad() {
 currentLoad = Math.min(100, currentLoad + 5);
 }
 
 private synchronized void decrementLoad() {
 currentLoad = Math.max(0, currentLoad - 5);
 }
 
 public void setAutoScaleEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.autoScaleEnabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isAutoScaleEnabled() {
 return autoScaleEnabled;
 }
 
 public synchronized int getCurrentLoad() {
 return currentLoad;
 }
 
 public int getTargetComputeLevel() {
 return targetComputeLevel;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 monitor.shutdown();
 executor.shutdown();
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "AdaptiveCompute: load=%d%%, level=%d/%d, autoScale=%s",
 currentLoad, targetComputeLevel, maxComputeLevel, autoScaleEnabled
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.concurrency;

import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public final class ThreadPoolManager {

 private static final ThreadPoolManager INSTANCE = new ThreadPoolManager();

 private final ThreadPoolExecutor computePool;
 private final ThreadPoolExecutor ioPool;
 private final ThreadPoolExecutor memoryPool;

 private ThreadPoolManager() {
 int cpuCores = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();

 computePool = new ThreadPoolExecutor(
 cpuCores,
 cpuCores * 2,
 60L, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
 new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(10000),
 new NamedThreadFactory("compute"),
 new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()
 );

 ioPool = new ThreadPoolExecutor(
 cpuCores,
 cpuCores * 4,
 30L, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
 new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(10000),
 new NamedThreadFactory("io"),
 new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()
 );

 memoryPool = new ThreadPoolExecutor(
 Math.max(1, cpuCores / 2),
 cpuCores,
 30L, TimeUnit.SECONDS,
 new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(1000),
 new NamedThreadFactory("memory"),
 new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()
 );
 }

 public static ThreadPoolManager getInstance() {
 return INSTANCE;
 }

 public ThreadPoolExecutor getComputePool() {
 return computePool;
 }

 public ThreadPoolExecutor getIoPool() {
 return ioPool;
 }

 public ThreadPoolExecutor getMemoryPool() {
 return memoryPool;
 }

 public <T> CompletableFuture<T> submitCompute(Callable<T> task) {
 return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
 try {
 return task.call();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new CompletionException(e);
 }
 }, computePool);
 }

 public CompletableFuture<Void> submitCompute(Runnable task) {
 return CompletableFuture.runAsync(task, computePool);
 }

 public <T> CompletableFuture<T> submitIo(Callable<T> task) {
 return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> {
 try {
 return task.call();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new CompletionException(e);
 }
 }, ioPool);
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 computePool.shutdown();
 ioPool.shutdown();
 memoryPool.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!computePool.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 computePool.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!ioPool.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 ioPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!memoryPool.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 memoryPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 computePool.shutdownNow();
 ioPool.shutdownNow();
 memoryPool.shutdownNow();
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }

 public PoolStats getStats() {
 return new PoolStats(
 computePool.getActiveCount(),
 computePool.getPoolSize(),
 computePool.getCompletedTaskCount(),
 ioPool.getActiveCount(),
 ioPool.getPoolSize(),
 ioPool.getCompletedTaskCount()
 );
 }

 public record PoolStats(
 int computeActive,
 int computePoolSize,
 long computeCompleted,
 int ioActive,
 int ioPoolSize,
 long ioCompleted
 ) {}

 private static class NamedThreadFactory implements ThreadFactory {
 private final String prefix;
 private final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);

 NamedThreadFactory(String prefix) {
 this.prefix = prefix;
 }

 @Override
 public Thread newThread(Runnable r) {
 Thread thread = new Thread(r, prefix + "-" + counter.incrementAndGet());
 thread.setDaemon(true);
 thread.setPriority(Thread.NORM_PRIORITY);
 return thread;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.config;

import java.util.*;

public class ModelConfiguration {
 
 private long targetParams;
 private int vocabSize;
 private int dModel;
 private int nLayers;
 private int nHeads;
 private int dFF;
 private int maxSeqLen;
 private float paramDensity;
 private boolean useSparse;
 private float hallucinationControl;
 private int verificationLayers;
 private int attentionSpanFactor;
 
 public static final Map<String, Long> PRESET_SCALES = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 static {
 PRESET_SCALES.put("tiny-1M", 1_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("small-10M", 10_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("base-100M", 100_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("medium-1B", 1_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("large-7B", 7_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("xlarge-13B", 13_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("xxlarge-33B", 33_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("giant-70B", 70_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("huge-100B", 100_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("massive-500B", 500_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("colossal-1T", 1_000_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("titan-5T", 5_000_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("cosmic-12T", 12_000_000_000_000L);
 PRESET_SCALES.put("universal-20T", 20_000_000_000_000L);
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration(long targetParams) {
 this.targetParams = targetParams;
 this.paramDensity = 1.0f;
 this.useSparse = false;
 this.hallucinationControl = 0.5f;
 this.verificationLayers = 2;
 this.attentionSpanFactor = 1;
 autoScale();
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration(String presetName) {
 this(PRESET_SCALES.getOrDefault(presetName, 1_000_000L));
 }
 
 private void autoScale() {
 double params = targetParams;
 
 if (params <= 10_000_000) {
 vocabSize = 512;
 dModel = 64;
 nLayers = 4;
 nHeads = 4;
 dFF = 256;
 maxSeqLen = 256;
 } else if (params <= 100_000_000) {
 vocabSize = 2048;
 dModel = 128;
 nLayers = 8;
 nHeads = 8;
 dFF = 512;
 maxSeqLen = 512;
 } else if (params <= 1_000_000_000) {
 vocabSize = 8192;
 dModel = 256;
 nLayers = 12;
 nHeads = 8;
 dFF = 1024;
 maxSeqLen = 1024;
 } else if (params <= 7_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 32768;
 dModel = 4096;
 nLayers = 32;
 nHeads = 32;
 dFF = 11008;
 maxSeqLen = 2048;
 } else if (params <= 13_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 32768;
 dModel = 5120;
 nLayers = 40;
 nHeads = 40;
 dFF = 13824;
 maxSeqLen = 2048;
 } else if (params <= 33_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 32768;
 dModel = 6144;
 nLayers = 60;
 nHeads = 48;
 dFF = 16384;
 maxSeqLen = 4096;
 } else if (params <= 70_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 65536;
 dModel = 8192;
 nLayers = 80;
 nHeads = 64;
 dFF = 22016;
 maxSeqLen = 4096;
 } else if (params <= 100_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 65536;
 dModel = 10240;
 nLayers = 100;
 nHeads = 80;
 dFF = 28672;
 maxSeqLen = 8192;
 } else if (params <= 500_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 131072;
 dModel = 16384;
 nLayers = 128;
 nHeads = 128;
 dFF = 49152;
 maxSeqLen = 16384;
 } else if (params <= 1_000_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 131072;
 dModel = 24576;
 nLayers = 160;
 nHeads = 192;
 dFF = 73728;
 maxSeqLen = 32768;
 } else if (params <= 5_000_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 262144;
 dModel = 32768;
 nLayers = 200;
 nHeads = 256;
 dFF = 98304;
 maxSeqLen = 65536;
 } else if (params <= 12_000_000_000_000L) {
 vocabSize = 262144;
 dModel = 40960;
 nLayers = 240;
 nHeads = 320;
 dFF = 122880;
 maxSeqLen = 131072;
 } else {
 vocabSize = 524288;
 dModel = 49152;
 nLayers = 280;
 nHeads = 384;
 dFF = 147456;
 maxSeqLen = 262144;
 hallucinationControl = 0.95f;
 verificationLayers = 8;
 attentionSpanFactor = 4;
 }
 
 if (useSparse) {
 dModel = (int) (dModel * 1.5);
 paramDensity = 0.4f;
 }
 
 if (targetParams >= 1_000_000_000_000L) {
 hallucinationControl = Math.min(0.9f + (float) Math.log10(targetParams / 1_000_000_000_000L) * 0.02f, 0.99f);
 verificationLayers = Math.min(2 + (int) (targetParams / 500_000_000_000L), 16);
 attentionSpanFactor = Math.min(1 + (int) (targetParams / 500_000_000_000L), 8);
 }
 }
 
 public long calculateActualParams() {
 long embParams = (long) vocabSize * dModel;
 long attnParams = (long) nLayers * (4L * dModel * dModel + 4L * dModel);
 long ffnParams = (long) nLayers * (2L * dModel * dFF + dFF + dModel);
 long lnParams = (long) nLayers * 2L * dModel * 2;
 
 return (long) ((embParams + attnParams + ffnParams + lnParams) * paramDensity);
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withVocabSize(int vocabSize) {
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 return this;
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withDModel(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 return this;
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withNLayers(int nLayers) {
 this.nLayers = nLayers;
 return this;
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withNHeads(int nHeads) {
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 return this;
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withMaxSeqLen(int maxSeqLen) {
 this.maxSeqLen = maxSeqLen;
 return this;
 }
 
 public ModelConfiguration withSparse(boolean useSparse) {
 this.useSparse = useSparse;
 autoScale();
 return this;
 }
 
 public long getTargetParams() { return targetParams; }
 public int getVocabSize() { return vocabSize; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNLayers() { return nLayers; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }
 public int getDFF() { return dFF; }
 public int getMaxSeqLen() { return maxSeqLen; }
 public float getParamDensity() { return paramDensity; }
 public boolean isSparse() { return useSparse; }
 public float getHallucinationControl() { return hallucinationControl; }
 public int getVerificationLayers() { return verificationLayers; }
 public int getAttentionSpanFactor() { return attentionSpanFactor; }
 
 public String getPresetName() {
 for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : PRESET_SCALES.entrySet()) {
 if (entry.getValue() == targetParams) {
 return entry.getKey();
 }
 }
 return "custom-" + targetParams;
 }
 
 public String toSummary() {
 return String.format(
 "ModelConfig: %s | Target: %.1fB | Actual: %.1fB | dModel=%d | Layers=%d | Heads=%d | SeqLen=%d | HallucinationControl=%.2f | VerificationLayers=%d",
 getPresetName(),
 targetParams / 1_000_000_000.0,
 calculateActualParams() / 1_000_000_000.0,
 dModel, nLayers, nHeads, maxSeqLen, hallucinationControl, verificationLayers
 );
 }
 
 public static List<String> listPresets() {
 return new ArrayList<>(PRESET_SCALES.keySet());
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.context;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class ContextWindowManager {
 
 public static class ContextEntry {
 public final String content;
 public final long timestamp;
 public final float importance;
 public final String type;
 
 public ContextEntry(String content, float importance, String type) {
 this.content = content;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 this.importance = importance;
 this.type = type;
 }
 }
 
 public static class ContextSnapshot {
 public final List<ContextEntry> entries;
 public final int totalTokens;
 public final long timestamp;
 
 public ContextSnapshot(List<ContextEntry> entries, int totalTokens) {
 this.entries = entries;
 this.totalTokens = totalTokens;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }
 }
 
 private final Deque<ContextEntry> contextHistory;
 private final int maxWindowSize;
 private final int maxTokens;
 private volatile int currentTokens;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
 private volatile boolean enabled;
 
 public ContextWindowManager(int maxWindowSize, int maxTokens) {
 this.maxWindowSize = maxWindowSize;
 this.maxTokens = maxTokens;
 this.contextHistory = new LinkedList<>();
 this.currentTokens = 0;
 this.scheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1);
 this.enabled = true;
 startCleanupTask();
 }
 
 public ContextWindowManager() {
 this(100, 8192);
 }
 
 private void startCleanupTask() {
 scheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (enabled) {
 cleanupOldContext();
 }
 }, 60, 60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 }
 
 public void addContext(String content, String type) {
 addContext(content, 0.5f, type);
 }
 
 public void addContext(String content, float importance, String type) {
 if (!enabled) return;
 
 ContextEntry entry = new ContextEntry(content, importance, type);
 
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 contextHistory.addLast(entry);
 currentTokens += content.length() / 2;
 
 while (contextHistory.size() > maxWindowSize || currentTokens > maxTokens) {
 ContextEntry removed = contextHistory.pollFirst();
 if (removed != null) {
 currentTokens -= removed.content.length() / 2;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public ContextSnapshot getContext(int maxEntries) {
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 List<ContextEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
 int tokens = 0;
 
 for (ContextEntry entry : contextHistory) {
 if (entries.size() >= maxEntries) break;
 entries.add(entry);
 tokens += entry.content.length() / 2;
 }
 
 return new ContextSnapshot(entries, tokens);
 }
 }
 
 public ContextSnapshot getRelevantContext(String query, int maxEntries) {
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 List<Map.Entry<ContextEntry, Float>> scored = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (ContextEntry entry : contextHistory) {
 float similarity = calculateSimilarity(query, entry.content);
 float score = similarity * entry.importance;
 if (score > 0.1f) {
 scored.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<>(entry, score));
 }
 }
 
 scored.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(b.getValue(), a.getValue()));
 
 List<ContextEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
 int tokens = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(maxEntries, scored.size()); i++) {
 ContextEntry entry = scored.get(i).getKey();
 entries.add(entry);
 tokens += entry.content.length() / 2;
 }
 
 return new ContextSnapshot(entries, tokens);
 }
 }
 
 private float calculateSimilarity(String query, String content) {
 String q = query.toLowerCase();
 String c = content.toLowerCase();
 
 if (q.isEmpty() || c.isEmpty()) return 0;
 
 Set<String> qWords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(q.split("\\s+")));
 Set<String> cWords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(c.split("\\s+")));
 
 if (qWords.isEmpty()) return 0;
 
 Set<String> intersection = new HashSet<>(qWords);
 intersection.retainAll(cWords);
 
 return (float) intersection.size() / qWords.size();
 }
 
 private void cleanupOldContext() {
 long threshold = System.currentTimeMillis() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L;
 
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 contextHistory.removeIf(entry -> entry.timestamp < threshold && entry.importance < 0.7f);
 }
 }
 
 public void clearContext() {
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 contextHistory.clear();
 currentTokens = 0;
 }
 }
 
 public void setWindowSize(int size) {
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 while (contextHistory.size() > size) {
 ContextEntry removed = contextHistory.pollFirst();
 if (removed != null) {
 currentTokens -= removed.content.length() / 2;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public int getContextSize() {
 synchronized (contextHistory) {
 return contextHistory.size();
 }
 }
 
 public int getCurrentTokens() {
 return currentTokens;
 }
 
 public int getMaxTokens() {
 return maxTokens;
 }
 
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 scheduler.shutdown();
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "ContextWindow: entries=%d, tokens=%d/%d, enabled=%s",
 getContextSize(), currentTokens, maxTokens, enabled
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.data;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class DataPipeline<T> {

 private List<DataProcessor<T>> processors;
 private DataSource<T> dataSource;
 private int batchSize;
 private boolean shuffle;
 private Random random;

 public DataPipeline() {
 this.processors = new ArrayList<>();
 this.batchSize = 32;
 this.shuffle = false;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 }

 public DataPipeline<T> setDataSource(DataSource<T> dataSource) {
 this.dataSource = dataSource;
 return this;
 }

 public DataPipeline<T> addProcessor(DataProcessor<T> processor) {
 this.processors.add(processor);
 return this;
 }

 public DataPipeline<T> setBatchSize(int batchSize) {
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 return this;
 }

 public DataPipeline<T> setShuffle(boolean shuffle) {
 this.shuffle = shuffle;
 return this;
 }

 public DataPipeline<T> setSeed(long seed) {
 this.random.setSeed(seed);
 return this;
 }

 public Iterator<List<T>> iterator() {
 List<T> data = dataSource.load();
 
 for (DataProcessor<T> processor : processors) {
 data = processor.process(data);
 }
 
 if (shuffle) {
 Collections.shuffle(data, random);
 }
 
 return new BatchIterator(data, batchSize);
 }

 public List<List<T>> collect() {
 List<List<T>> batches = new ArrayList<>();
 Iterator<List<T>> iterator = iterator();
 while (iterator.hasNext()) {
 batches.add(iterator.next());
 }
 return batches;
 }

 public int size() {
 return (int) Math.ceil((double) dataSource.load().size() / batchSize);
 }

 private static class BatchIterator<T> implements Iterator<List<T>> {
 private final List<T> data;
 private final int batchSize;
 private int index;

 public BatchIterator(List<T> data, int batchSize) {
 this.data = data;
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 this.index = 0;
 }

 @Override
 public boolean hasNext() {
 return index < data.size();
 }

 @Override
 public List<T> next() {
 int end = Math.min(index + batchSize, data.size());
 List<T> batch = data.subList(index, end);
 index = end;
 return new ArrayList<>(batch);
 }
 }

 public interface DataSource<T> {
 List<T> load();
 int size();
 }

 public interface DataProcessor<T> {
 List<T> process(List<T> data);
 }

 public static class TextTokenizer implements DataProcessor<String> {
 private final Tokenizer tokenizer;
 private final int maxLength;

 public TextTokenizer(Tokenizer tokenizer, int maxLength) {
 this.tokenizer = tokenizer;
 this.maxLength = maxLength;
 }

 @Override
 public List<String> process(List<String> data) {
 return data.stream()
 .map(text -> {
 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(text);
 if (tokens.length > maxLength) {
 int[] truncated = new int[maxLength];
 System.arraycopy(tokens, 0, truncated, 0, maxLength);
 return tokenizer.decode(truncated);
 }
 return text;
 })
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }
 }

 public static class TextNormalizer implements DataProcessor<String> {
 @Override
 public List<String> process(List<String> data) {
 return data.stream()
 .map(text -> text.toLowerCase().trim())
 .map(text -> text.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9\\s]", ""))
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }
 }

 public static class ImageResizer implements DataProcessor<float[]> {
 private final int targetWidth;
 private final int targetHeight;

 public ImageResizer(int targetWidth, int targetHeight) {
 this.targetWidth = targetWidth;
 this.targetHeight = targetHeight;
 }

 @Override
 public List<float[]> process(List<float[]> data) {
 return data.stream()
 .map(image -> resizeImage(image, targetWidth, targetHeight))
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }

 private float[] resizeImage(float[] image, int width, int height) {
 float[] resized = new float[width * height * 3];
 return resized;
 }
 }

 public static class ImageNormalizer implements DataProcessor<float[]> {
 @Override
 public List<float[]> process(List<float[]> data) {
 return data.stream()
 .map(image -> {
 float[] normalized = new float[image.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < image.length; i++) {
 normalized[i] = image[i] / 255.0f;
 }
 return normalized;
 })
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }
 }

 public static class DataAugmenter<T> implements DataProcessor<T> {
 private final List<Function<T, T>> augmentations;
 private final float probability;

 public DataAugmenter(List<Function<T, T>> augmentations, float probability) {
 this.augmentations = augmentations;
 this.probability = probability;
 }

 @Override
 public List<T> process(List<T> data) {
 Random rand = new Random();
 return data.stream()
 .map(item -> {
 T augmented = item;
 for (Function<T, T> augmentation : augmentations) {
 if (rand.nextFloat() < probability) {
 augmented = augmentation.apply(augmented);
 }
 }
 return augmented;
 })
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }
 }

 public static class PaddingProcessor implements DataProcessor<int[]> {
 private final int maxLength;
 private final int padValue;

 public PaddingProcessor(int maxLength, int padValue) {
 this.maxLength = maxLength;
 this.padValue = padValue;
 }

 @Override
 public List<int[]> process(List<int[]> data) {
 return data.stream()
 .map(sequence -> {
 int[] padded = new int[maxLength];
 Arrays.fill(padded, padValue);
 System.arraycopy(sequence, 0, padded, 0, Math.min(sequence.length, maxLength));
 return padded;
 })
 .collect(Collectors.toList());
 }
 }

 public static class LabelEncoder<T> implements DataProcessor<T> {
 private final Map<T, Integer> labelMap;

 public LabelEncoder(List<T> labels) {
 this.labelMap = new HashMap<>();
 int index = 0;
 for (T label : labels) {
 if (!labelMap.containsKey(label)) {
 labelMap.put(label, index++);
 }
 }
 }

 @Override
 public List<T> process(List<T> data) {
 return data;
 }

 public int encode(T label) {
 return labelMap.getOrDefault(label, -1);
 }

 public T decode(int index) {
 for (Map.Entry<T, Integer> entry : labelMap.entrySet()) {
 if (entry.getValue() == index) {
 return entry.getKey();
 }
 }
 return null;
 }

 public int numClasses() {
 return labelMap.size();
 }
 }

 public static class CsvDataSource implements DataSource<String[]> {
 private final String filePath;
 private final boolean hasHeader;

 public CsvDataSource(String filePath, boolean hasHeader) {
 this.filePath = filePath;
 this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
 }

 @Override
 public List<String[]> load() {
 List<String[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
 return rows;
 }

 @Override
 public int size() {
 return load().size();
 }
 }

 public static class TextFileDataSource implements DataSource<String> {
 private final String filePath;

 public TextFileDataSource(String filePath) {
 this.filePath = filePath;
 }

 @Override
 public List<String> load() {
 List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
 return lines;
 }

 @Override
 public int size() {
 return load().size();
 }
 }

 public static class Tokenizer {
 private final Map<String, Integer> vocab;
 private final Map<Integer, String> idxToToken;
 private final String bosToken = "<bos>";
 private final String eosToken = "<eos>";
 private final String padToken = "<pad>";
 private final String unkToken = "<unk>";

 public Tokenizer() {
 this.vocab = new HashMap<>();
 this.idxToToken = new HashMap<>();
 addSpecialTokens();
 }

 private void addSpecialTokens() {
 vocab.put(bosToken, 0);
 vocab.put(eosToken, 1);
 vocab.put(padToken, 2);
 vocab.put(unkToken, 3);
 idxToToken.put(0, bosToken);
 idxToToken.put(1, eosToken);
 idxToToken.put(2, padToken);
 idxToToken.put(3, unkToken);
 }

 public void fit(List<String> texts) {
 for (String text : texts) {
 String[] tokens = text.split("\\s+");
 for (String token : tokens) {
 if (!vocab.containsKey(token)) {
 int idx = vocab.size();
 vocab.put(token, idx);
 idxToToken.put(idx, token);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public int[] encode(String text) {
 List<Integer> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
 tokens.add(vocab.get(bosToken));
 for (String token : text.split("\\s+")) {
 tokens.add(vocab.getOrDefault(token, vocab.get(unkToken)));
 }
 tokens.add(vocab.get(eosToken));
 return tokens.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 }

 public String decode(int[] tokens) {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 for (int token : tokens) {
 String tokenStr = idxToToken.getOrDefault(token, unkToken);
 if (!tokenStr.equals(bosToken) && !tokenStr.equals(eosToken) && !tokenStr.equals(padToken)) {
 sb.append(tokenStr).append(" ");
 }
 }
 return sb.toString().trim();
 }

 public int getVocabSize() {
 return vocab.size();
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.data;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/**
 * 多线程数据加载器 - 支持预加载、数据缓存和动态序列长度处理。
 *
 * <p>功能特性：
 * <ul>
 * <li>多线程预加载：使用线程池在后台预取下一批数据</li>
 * <li>数据缓存：LRU缓存避免重复计算</li>
 * <li>动态序列长度：支持最长512 token的变长序列</li>
 * <li>批处理：自动将数据组织成mini-batch</li>
 * <li>数据打乱：每个epoch自动打乱数据顺序</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * <p>复杂度分析：
 * <ul>
 * <li>预加载开销: O(batch_size * seq_len) 每批，但异步执行不阻塞训练</li>
 * <li>缓存命中: O(1) 查找</li>
 * <li>内存开销: O(cache_size * batch_size * seq_len)</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * @author SC Architecture Team
 */
public class SCDataLoader {

 /** 最大序列长度 */
 public static final int MAX_SEQ_LEN = 512;
 /** 默认缓存大小 */
 private static final int DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE = 64;

 private final List<int[]> allSequences;
 private final int batchSize;
 private final int seqLen;
 private final boolean shuffle;
 private final int numWorkers;

 private final BlockingQueue<int[][]> prefetchQueue;
 private final ExecutorService prefetchExecutor;
 private final Map<Integer, int[][]> batchCache;
 private final int cacheSize;

 private List<int[]> currentOrder;
 private int currentBatchIndex;
 private int totalBatches;
 private volatile boolean prefetchRunning;

 /**
 * 创建数据加载器。
 *
 * @param sequences 所有数据序列列表
 * @param batchSize 每批大小
 * @param seqLen 序列长度（支持动态，最大512）
 * @param shuffle 是否打乱数据
 * @param numWorkers 预加载线程数
 */
 public SCDataLoader(List<int[]> sequences, int batchSize, int seqLen,
 boolean shuffle, int numWorkers) {
 this.allSequences = new ArrayList<>(sequences);
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 this.seqLen = Math.min(seqLen, MAX_SEQ_LEN);
 this.shuffle = shuffle;
 this.numWorkers = Math.max(1, numWorkers);
 this.prefetchQueue = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(numWorkers * 2);
 this.prefetchExecutor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(this.numWorkers);
 this.batchCache = new LinkedHashMap<Integer, int[][]>(DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE, 0.75f, true) {
 @Override
 protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<Integer, int[][]> eldest) {
 return size() > DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE;
 }
 };
 this.cacheSize = DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE;
 this.currentBatchIndex = 0;
 reset();
 }

 /**
 * 创建数据加载器（默认1个工作线程）。
 *
 * @param sequences 数据序列
 * @param batchSize 批大小
 * @param seqLen 序列长度
 */
 public SCDataLoader(List<int[]> sequences, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 this(sequences, batchSize, seqLen, true, 1);
 }

 /**
 * 重置数据迭代器，开始新epoch。
 */
 public void reset() {
 currentOrder = new ArrayList<>(allSequences);
 if (shuffle) {
 Collections.shuffle(currentOrder);
 }
 totalBatches = (int) Math.ceil((double) currentOrder.size() / batchSize);
 currentBatchIndex = 0;
 prefetchRunning = false;
 }

 /**
 * 启动后台预加载。
 */
 public void startPrefetch() {
 if (prefetchRunning) return;
 prefetchRunning = true;
 prefetchExecutor.submit(this::prefetchLoop);
 }

 /**
 * 预加载循环（在后台线程执行）。
 */
 private void prefetchLoop() {
 while (prefetchRunning && currentBatchIndex < totalBatches) {
 int batchIdx = currentBatchIndex;
 int[][] batch = loadBatch(batchIdx);

 try {
 prefetchQueue.put(batch);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 break;
 }
 }
 }

 /**
 * 加载指定批次的数据（带缓存）。
 *
 * @param batchIdx 批次索引
 * @return 批次数据数组
 */
 private int[][] loadBatch(int batchIdx) {
 // 检查缓存
 synchronized (batchCache) {
 int[][] cached = batchCache.get(batchIdx);
 if (cached != null) {
 return cached;
 }
 }

 // 加载批次
 int start = batchIdx * batchSize;
 int end = Math.min(start + batchSize, currentOrder.size());
 int actualBatchSize = end - start;

 int[][] batch = new int[actualBatchSize][];
 for (int i = 0; i < actualBatchSize; i++) {
 int[] seq = currentOrder.get(start + i);
 batch[i] = padOrTruncate(seq, seqLen);
 }

 // 存入缓存
 synchronized (batchCache) {
 batchCache.put(batchIdx, batch);
 }

 return batch;
 }

 /**
 * 获取下一个批次（同步）。
 *
 * @return 批次数据，如果没有更多数据返回null
 */
 public int[][] getNextBatch() {
 if (currentBatchIndex >= totalBatches) {
 return null;
 }

 // 优先从预加载队列获取
 if (prefetchRunning) {
 int[][] batch = prefetchQueue.poll();
 if (batch != null) {
 currentBatchIndex++;
 return batch;
 }
 }

 // 同步加载
 int[][] batch = loadBatch(currentBatchIndex);
 currentBatchIndex++;
 return batch;
 }

 /**
 * 填充或截断序列到指定长度。
 * 支持动态序列长度处理。
 *
 * @param seq 原始序列
 * @param targetLen 目标长度
 * @return 处理后的序列
 */
 public static int[] padOrTruncate(int[] seq, int targetLen) {
 int len = Math.min(seq.length, targetLen);
 int[] result = new int[len];

 System.arraycopy(seq, 0, result, 0, len);

 // 如果需要填充（仅在目标长度大于原始长度时）
 if (seq.length < targetLen) {
 int[] padded = new int[targetLen];
 System.arraycopy(seq, 0, padded, 0, seq.length);
 // 用0填充剩余部分
 for (int i = seq.length; i < targetLen; i++) {
 padded[i] = 0;
 }
 return padded;
 }

 return result;
 }

 /**
 * 是否还有更多批次。
 *
 * @return true如果还有数据
 */
 public boolean hasNext() {
 return currentBatchIndex < totalBatches;
 }

 /**
 * 获取总批次数。
 *
 * @return 批次总数
 */
 public int getTotalBatches() {
 return totalBatches;
 }

 /**
 * 获取当前批次索引。
 *
 * @return 当前批次索引
 */
 public int getCurrentBatchIndex() {
 return currentBatchIndex;
 }

 /**
 * 获取数据集大小。
 *
 * @return 序列总数
 */
 public int size() {
 return allSequences.size();
 }

 /**
 * 获取序列长度。
 *
 * @return 序列长度
 */
 public int getSeqLen() {
 return seqLen;
 }

 /**
 * 获取批大小。
 *
 * @return 批大小
 */
 public int getBatchSize() {
 return batchSize;
 }

 /**
 * 获取缓存命中率。
 *
 * @return 缓存命中率（0-1）
 */
 public float getCacheHitRate() {
 return batchCache.isEmpty() ? 0 : 1.0f; // 简化版
 }

 /**
 * 关闭数据加载器，释放资源。
 */
 public void close() {
 prefetchRunning = false;
 prefetchExecutor.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!prefetchExecutor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 prefetchExecutor.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 prefetchExecutor.shutdownNow();
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 batchCache.clear();
 prefetchQueue.clear();
 }

 /**
 * 从token数组创建滑动窗口序列。
 *
 * @param tokens 原始token数组
 * @param seqLen 序列长度
 * @param stride 滑动步长
 * @return 序列列表
 */
 public static List<int[]> createSlidingWindowSequences(int[] tokens, int seqLen, int stride) {
 List<int[]> sequences = new ArrayList<>();
 seqLen = Math.min(seqLen, MAX_SEQ_LEN);

 for (int i = 0; i + seqLen <= tokens.length; i += stride) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLen];
 System.arraycopy(tokens, i, seq, 0, seqLen);
 sequences.add(seq);
 }

 // 处理剩余部分
 if (tokens.length > 0 && (tokens.length - seqLen) % stride != 0) {
 int start = tokens.length - seqLen;
 if (start >= 0) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLen];
 System.arraycopy(tokens, start, seq, 0, seqLen);
 sequences.add(seq);
 }
 }

 return sequences;
 }

 /**
 * 将多个文本段落合并为token序列。
 *
 * @param tokenLists 多个token列表
 * @param separator 分隔符token ID
 * @return 合并后的token数组
 */
 public static int[] concatenateTokens(List<int[]> tokenLists, int separator) {
 int totalLen = 0;
 for (int[] tokens : tokenLists) {
 totalLen += tokens.length + 1; // +1 for separator
 }

 int[] result = new int[totalLen];
 int idx = 0;
 for (int[] tokens : tokenLists) {
 System.arraycopy(tokens, 0, result, idx, tokens.length);
 idx += tokens.length;
 result[idx++] = separator;
 }

 return result;
 }
}

 private final Random random;
 
 public SyntheticDataset() {
 this.random = new Random(42);
 }
 
 public SyntheticDataset(long seed) {
 this.random = new Random(seed);
 }
 
 public String[] generateLargeDataset(int size) {
 List<String> dataset = new ArrayList<>(size);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 String sentence = generateSentence();
 dataset.add(sentence);
 }
 
 return dataset.toArray(new String[0]);
 }
 
 public String[] generateDiverseDataset(int baseSize) {
 List<String> dataset = new ArrayList<>(baseSize * 5);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < baseSize; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateSentence());
 dataset.add(generateQuestion());
 dataset.add(generateStatement());
 dataset.add(generateInstruction());
 dataset.add(generateDescription());
 }
 
 Collections.shuffle(dataset, random);
 return dataset.toArray(new String[0]);
 }
 
 private String generateSentence() {
 String[] pattern = SENTENCE_PATTERNS[random.nextInt(SENTENCE_PATTERNS.length)];
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
 String token = pattern[i];
 String word;
 
 switch (token) {
 case "NOUN":
 word = NOUNS[random.nextInt(NOUNS.length)];
 break;
 case "VERB":
 word = VERBS[random.nextInt(VERBS.length)];
 break;
 case "ADJ":
 word = ADJECTIVES[random.nextInt(ADJECTIVES.length)];
 break;
 case "ADV":
 word = getAdverb();
 break;
 case "DAY":
 word = getDay();
 break;
 default:
 word = token;
 break;
 }
 
 if (i > 0 && !word.matches("[,.;!?]")) {
 sb.append(" ");
 }
 sb.append(word);
 }
 
 sb.append(".");
 return sb.toString();
 }
 
 private String generateQuestion() {
 String[] questionPatterns = {
 "What is a ADJ NOUN?",
 "How do you VERB the NOUN?",
 "Why is the NOUN ADJ?",
 "Where can I find a NOUN?",
 "When should we VERB?",
 "Which NOUN is more ADJ?",
 "Who VERB the NOUN?",
 "What does the NOUN do?"
 };
 
 return fillPattern(questionPatterns[random.nextInt(questionPatterns.length)]);
 }
 
 private String generateStatement() {
 String[] statementPatterns = {
 "The NOUN is a ADJ VERB.",
 "A good NOUN must VERB well.",
 "All ADJ NOUN VERB quickly.",
 "The process of VERBing takes time.",
 "NOUN helps us VERB better.",
 "ADJ NOUN are essential for VERBing."
 };
 
 return fillPattern(statementPatterns[random.nextInt(statementPatterns.length)]);
 }
 
 private String generateInstruction() {
 String[] instructionPatterns = {
 "To VERB, first ADJ the NOUN.",
 "Always keep the NOUN ADJ.",
 "Make sure to VERB before proceeding.",
 "Check the NOUN for ADJ issues.",
 "Use the ADJ method to VERB.",
 "Remember to VERB the ADJ NOUN."
 };
 
 return fillPattern(instructionPatterns[random.nextInt(instructionPatterns.length)]);
 }
 
 private String generateDescription() {
 String[] descriptionPatterns = {
 "A ADJ NOUN that VERBs quickly.",
 "The NOUN has ADJ properties.",
 "VERBing the NOUN requires ADJ skills.",
 "This NOUN is used for VERBing.",
 "An ADJ approach to VERBing.",
 "The process involves VERBing the ADJ NOUN."
 };
 
 return fillPattern(descriptionPatterns[random.nextInt(descriptionPatterns.length)]);
 }
 
 private String fillPattern(String pattern) {
 String result = pattern;
 
 result = result.replaceAll("\\bNOUN\\b", NOUNS[random.nextInt(NOUNS.length)]);
 
 result = result.replaceAll("\\bVERB\\b", VERBS[random.nextInt(VERBS.length)]);
 result = result.replaceAll("\\bVERBs\\b", VERBS[random.nextInt(VERBS.length)] + "s");
 result = result.replaceAll("\\bVERBing\\b", VERBS[random.nextInt(VERBS.length)] + "ing");
 
 result = result.replaceAll("\\bADJ\\b", ADJECTIVES[random.nextInt(ADJECTIVES.length)]);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private String getAdverb() {
 String[] adverbs = {
 "quickly", "slowly", "carefully", "easily", "happily",
 "sadly", "angrily", "calmly", "quietly", "loudly",
 "well", "badly", "hard", "softly", "warmly",
 "coldly", "brightly", "darkly", "clearly", "confidently"
 };
 return adverbs[random.nextInt(adverbs.length)];
 }
 
 private String getDay() {
 String[] days = {
 "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday",
 "Saturday", "Sunday", "morning", "afternoon", "evening",
 "day", "night", "week", "month", "year"
 };
 return days[random.nextInt(days.length)];
 }
 
 public String[] generateDomainSpecificData(int size, Domain domain) {
 List<String> dataset = new ArrayList<>(size);
 
 switch (domain) {
 case TECH:
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateTechSentence());
 }
 break;
 case SCIENCE:
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateScienceSentence());
 }
 break;
 case BUSINESS:
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateBusinessSentence());
 }
 break;
 case MEDICAL:
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateMedicalSentence());
 }
 break;
 case FINANCE:
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 dataset.add(generateFinanceSentence());
 }
 break;
 }
 
 return dataset.toArray(new String[0]);
 }

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.deployment;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class ModelDeployer {

 private final SimpCoreModel model;
 private final Tokenizer tokenizer;
 private ServerSocket serverSocket;
 private ExecutorService executorService;
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, String> config = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

 public static final String FORMAT_SIMPCORE = "simpcore";
 public static final String FORMAT_ONNX = "onnx";
 public static final String FORMAT_JSON = "json";

 public ModelDeployer(SimpCoreModel model, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 this.model = model;
 this.tokenizer = tokenizer;
 initDefaultConfig();
 }

 private void initDefaultConfig() {
 config.put("host", "localhost");
 config.put("port", "8080");
 config.put("timeout", "30000");
 config.put("maxConnections", "100");
 config.put("enableCORS", "true");
 config.put("apiPrefix", "/api");
 }

 public void setConfig(String key, String value) {
 config.put(key, value);
 }

 public String getConfig(String key) {
 return config.get(key);
 }

 public void exportModel(String filePath, String format) throws IOException {
 switch (format.toLowerCase()) {
 case FORMAT_SIMPCORE:
 exportSimpCoreFormat(filePath);
 break;
 case FORMAT_ONNX:
 exportONNXFormat(filePath);
 break;
 case FORMAT_JSON:
 exportJSONFormat(filePath);
 break;
 default:
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported format: " + format);
 }
 System.out.println("Model exported to: " + filePath);
 }

 private void exportSimpCoreFormat(String filePath) throws IOException {
 model.save(filePath);
 }

 private void exportONNXFormat(String filePath) throws IOException {
 StringBuilder onnx = new StringBuilder();
 onnx.append("ir_version: 8\n");
 onnx.append("opset_import: { version: 13 }\n");
 onnx.append("\n");
 onnx.append("graph {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"SimpCoreModel\"\n");
 onnx.append("\n");
 onnx.append(" input {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"input_ids\"\n");
 onnx.append(" type {\n");
 onnx.append(" tensor_type {\n");
 onnx.append(" elem_type: INT64\n");
 onnx.append(" shape: { dim: { dim_param: \"batch_size\" } }\n");
 onnx.append(" shape: { dim: { dim_param: \"seq_len\" } }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append("\n");
 onnx.append(" output {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"logits\"\n");
 onnx.append(" type {\n");
 onnx.append(" tensor_type {\n");
 onnx.append(" elem_type: FLOAT\n");
 onnx.append(" shape: { dim: { dim_param: \"batch_size\" } }\n");
 onnx.append(" shape: { dim: { dim_param: \"seq_len\" } }\n");
 onnx.append(" shape: { dim: " + model.getVocabSize() + " }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append("\n");
 onnx.append(" node {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"SimpCoreInference\"\n");
 onnx.append(" op_type: \"Custom\"\n");
 onnx.append(" input: \"input_ids\"\n");
 onnx.append(" output: \"logits\"\n");
 onnx.append(" attribute {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"model_type\"\n");
 onnx.append(" s: \"SimpCore\"\n");
 onnx.append(" type: STRING\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" attribute {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"d_model\"\n");
 onnx.append(" i: " + model.getDModel() + "\n");
 onnx.append(" type: INT\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" attribute {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"n_layers\"\n");
 onnx.append(" i: " + model.getNLayers() + "\n");
 onnx.append(" type: INT\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" attribute {\n");
 onnx.append(" name: \"vocab_size\"\n");
 onnx.append(" i: " + model.getVocabSize() + "\n");
 onnx.append(" type: INT\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append(" }\n");
 onnx.append("}\n");

 try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(filePath)) {
 writer.write(onnx.toString());
 }
 }

 private void exportJSONFormat(String filePath) throws IOException {
 StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder();
 json.append("{\n");
 json.append(" \"model_type\": \"SimpCore\",\n");
 json.append(" \"metadata\": {\n");
 json.append(" \"vocab_size\": " + model.getVocabSize() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"d_model\": " + model.getDModel() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"n_layers\": " + model.getNLayers() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"max_seq_len\": " + model.getMaxSeqLen() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"total_parameters\": " + model.getTotalParameters() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"export_time\": \"" + new Date().toString() + "\"\n");
 json.append(" },\n");
 json.append(" \"architecture\": {\n");
 json.append(" \"embedding\": {\n");
 json.append(" \"input_dim\": " + model.getVocabSize() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"output_dim\": " + model.getDModel() + "\n");
 json.append(" },\n");
 json.append(" \"layers\": [\n");

 for (int l = 0; l < model.getNLayers(); l++) {
 json.append(" {\n");
 json.append(" \"layer_type\": \"SimpCoreLayer\",\n");
 json.append(" \"index\": " + l + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"components\": [\n");
 json.append(" \"AdaptiveBasisLayer\",\n");
 json.append(" \"DynamicMemoryChannel\",\n");
 json.append(" \"TopologyAwareRouter\",\n");
 json.append(" \"CausalInterventionNetwork\",\n");
 json.append(" \"InformationBottleneck\",\n");
 json.append(" \"FeedForwardNetwork\",\n");
 json.append(" \"MetaRepresentationDistiller\",\n");
 json.append(" \"PlasticityUpdateModule\"\n");
 json.append(" ]\n");
 json.append(" }" + (l < model.getNLayers() - 1 ? "," : "") + "\n");
 }

 json.append(" ],\n");
 json.append(" \"output\": {\n");
 json.append(" \"input_dim\": " + model.getDModel() + ",\n");
 json.append(" \"output_dim\": " + model.getVocabSize() + "\n");
 json.append(" }\n");
 json.append(" },\n");
 json.append(" \"training_config\": {\n");
 json.append(" \"learning_rate\": 0.001,\n");
 json.append(" \"gradient_clipping\": 1.0\n");
 json.append(" }\n");
 json.append("}\n");

 try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(filePath)) {
 writer.write(json.toString());
 }
 }

 public void startServer() throws IOException {
 String host = config.get("host");
 int port = Integer.parseInt(config.get("port"));
 int maxConnections = Integer.parseInt(config.get("maxConnections"));

 serverSocket = new ServerSocket(port, maxConnections, InetAddress.getByName(host));
 executorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(maxConnections);
 running = true;

 System.out.println("SimpCore Server started on " + host + ":" + port);
 System.out.println("API endpoints:");
 System.out.println(" POST " + config.get("apiPrefix") + "/generate");
 System.out.println(" POST " + config.get("apiPrefix") + "/predict");
 System.out.println(" GET " + config.get("apiPrefix") + "/health");
 System.out.println(" GET " + config.get("apiPrefix") + "/info");

 new Thread(() -> {
 while (running) {
 try {
 Socket client = serverSocket.accept();
 executorService.submit(new RequestHandler(client));
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (!running) break;
 System.err.println("Error accepting connection: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }).start();
 }

 public void stopServer() {
 running = false;
 if (serverSocket != null) {
 try {
 serverSocket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Error closing server: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 if (executorService != null) {
 executorService.shutdown();
 }
 System.out.println("SimpCore Server stopped");
 }

 private class RequestHandler implements Runnable {
 private final Socket client;

 public RequestHandler(Socket client) {
 this.client = client;
 }

 @Override
 public void run() {
 try (BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(client.getInputStream()));
 PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(client.getOutputStream(), true)) {

 String line = in.readLine();
 if (line == null) return;

 String[] parts = line.split(" ");
 if (parts.length < 2) {
 sendError(out, 400, "Bad Request");
 return;
 }

 String method = parts[0];
 String path = parts[1];

 if (config.get("enableCORS").equals("true")) {
 out.println("Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *");
 out.println("Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS");
 out.println("Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type");
 }

 if (method.equals("OPTIONS")) {
 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println();
 return;
 }

 switch (path) {
 case "/api/generate":
 handleGenerate(in, out);
 break;
 case "/api/predict":
 handlePredict(in, out);
 break;
 case "/api/health":
 handleHealth(out);
 break;
 case "/api/info":
 handleInfo(out);
 break;
 default:
 sendError(out, 404, "Not Found");
 }

 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Error handling request: " + e.getMessage());
 } finally {
 try {
 client.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 // Ignore
 }
 }
 }

 private void handleGenerate(BufferedReader in, PrintWriter out) throws IOException {
 StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
 String line;
 while ((line = in.readLine()) != null && !line.isEmpty()) {
 body.append(line);
 }

 String json = body.toString();
 String prompt = extractField(json, "prompt");
 int maxTokens = extractIntField(json, "max_tokens", 50);
 int eosTokenId = extractIntField(json, "eos_token_id", tokenizer.getEosTokenId());

 String result = model.generateText(prompt, tokenizer, maxTokens, eosTokenId);

 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println();
 out.println("{\"generated_text\": \"" + escapeJson(result) + "\"}");
 }

 private void handlePredict(BufferedReader in, PrintWriter out) throws IOException {
 StringBuilder body = new StringBuilder();
 String line;
 while ((line = in.readLine()) != null && !line.isEmpty()) {
 body.append(line);
 }

 String json = body.toString();
 String text = extractField(json, "text");

 int[] inputIds = tokenizer.encode(text);
 float[] logits = model.forward(inputIds, 1, inputIds.length);

 StringBuilder logitsJson = new StringBuilder("[");
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(10, logits.length); i++) {
 logitsJson.append(logits[i]);
 if (i < Math.min(10, logits.length) - 1) logitsJson.append(",");
 }
 logitsJson.append("]");

 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println();
 out.println("{\"logits\": " + logitsJson + ", \"length\": " + logits.length + "}");
 }

 private void handleHealth(PrintWriter out) {
 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println();
 out.println("{\"status\": \"healthy\", \"model_loaded\": true}");
 }

 private void handleInfo(PrintWriter out) {
 out.println("HTTP/1.1 200 OK");
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println();
 out.println("{\n" +
 " \"model_type\": \"SimpCore\",\n" +
 " \"vocab_size\": " + model.getVocabSize() + ",\n" +
 " \"d_model\": " + model.getDModel() + ",\n" +
 " \"n_layers\": " + model.getNLayers() + ",\n" +
 " \"max_seq_len\": " + model.getMaxSeqLen() + ",\n" +
 " \"total_parameters\": " + model.getTotalParameters() + "\n" +
 "}");
 }

 private void sendError(PrintWriter out, int code, String message) {
 out.println("HTTP/1.1 " + code + " " + message);
 out.println("Content-Type: application/json");
 out.println();
 out.println("{\"error\": \"" + message + "\"}");
 }

 private String extractField(String json, String field) {
 int start = json.indexOf("\"" + field + "\":");
 if (start == -1) return "";
 start = json.indexOf("\"", start + field.length() + 3);
 if (start == -1) return "";
 int end = json.indexOf("\"", start + 1);
 if (end == -1) return "";
 return json.substring(start + 1, end);
 }

 private int extractIntField(String json, String field, int defaultValue) {
 int start = json.indexOf("\"" + field + "\":");
 if (start == -1) return defaultValue;
 start = json.indexOf(":", start + field.length() + 3);
 if (start == -1) return defaultValue;
 int end = json.indexOf(",", start + 1);
 if (end == -1) end = json.indexOf("}", start + 1);
 if (end == -1) return defaultValue;
 try {
 return Integer.parseInt(json.substring(start + 1, end).trim());
 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 return defaultValue;
 }
 }

 private String escapeJson(String str) {
 return str.replace("\\", "\\\\")
 .replace("\"", "\\\"")
 .replace("\n", "\\n")
 .replace("\r", "\\r");
 }
 }

 public static SimpCoreModel loadModel(String filePath) throws IOException {
 return SimpCoreModel.load(filePath);
 }

 public static ModelDeployer createAndStart(SimpCoreModel model, Tokenizer tokenizer, 
 String host, int port) throws IOException {
 ModelDeployer deployer = new ModelDeployer(model, tokenizer);
 deployer.setConfig("host", host);
 deployer.setConfig("port", String.valueOf(port));
 deployer.startServer();
 return deployer;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.Optimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUDeviceManager;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public final class AdvancedDistributedTrainingFramework {

 public static class TrainingConfig {
 public int worldSize = 1;
 public int rank = 0;
 public String masterHost = "localhost";
 public int port = DistributedCommunicationLayer.DEFAULT_PORT;
 public int epochs = 10;
 public int batchSize = 32;
 public float learningRate = 0.001f;
 public float weightDecay = 0.01f;
 public int gradientAccumulationSteps = 1;
 public boolean useGradientClipping = true;
 public float maxGradientNorm = 1.0f;
 public ParallelStrategy parallelStrategy = ParallelStrategy.DATA_PARALLEL;
 public boolean enableMixedPrecision = false;
 public int logInterval = 10;
 public int saveInterval = 100;
 }

 public enum ParallelStrategy {
 DATA_PARALLEL,
 MODEL_PARALLEL,
 PIPELINE_PARALLEL,
 HYBRID
 }

 public static class WorkerStats {
 public final int rank;
 public final String gpuName;
 public volatile float loss;
 public volatile float accuracy;
 public volatile int stepsCompleted;
 public volatile long bytesProcessed;
 public volatile boolean active;

 public WorkerStats(int rank, String gpuName) {
 this.rank = rank;
 this.gpuName = gpuName;
 this.loss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.accuracy = 0;
 this.stepsCompleted = 0;
 this.bytesProcessed = 0;
 this.active = true;
 }
 }

 private final TrainingConfig config;
 private final DistributedCommunicationLayer commLayer;
 private final Map<Integer, WorkerStats> workerStats = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private final AtomicInteger globalStep = new AtomicInteger(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalSamplesProcessed = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 private final ExecutorService trainingPool;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService statsScheduler;
 
 private SimpCoreModel globalModel;
 private Optimizer globalOptimizer;
 
 public AdvancedDistributedTrainingFramework(TrainingConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 this.commLayer = new DistributedCommunicationLayer(config.rank, config.worldSize, config.masterHost, config.port);
 
 int poolSize = config.parallelStrategy == ParallelStrategy.DATA_PARALLEL 
 ? config.worldSize 
 : Math.max(2, config.worldSize / 2);
 this.trainingPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(poolSize);
 this.statsScheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 }

 public void initialize(SimpCoreModel model, Optimizer optimizer) throws Exception {
 this.globalModel = model;
 this.globalOptimizer = optimizer;
 
 commLayer.initialize();
 
 if (config.rank == 0) {
 initializeWorkers();
 startStatsCollection();
 }
 
 GPUDeviceManager.initialize();
