 System.out.println("[Distributed] Framework initialized on rank " + config.rank);
 }

 private void initializeWorkers() {
 for (int i = 0; i < config.worldSize; i++) {
 if (i != config.rank) {
 String gpuName = "Unknown";
 if (GPUDeviceManager.isGPUAvailable()) {
 GPUDeviceManager.DeviceInfo device = GPUDeviceManager.getSelectedDevice();
 if (device != null) {
 gpuName = device.name;
 }
 }
 workerStats.put(i, new WorkerStats(i, gpuName));
 }
 }
 }

 private void startStatsCollection() {
 statsScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (!running) return;
 
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("[Distributed] Global Step ").append(globalStep.get()).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Samples: ").append(totalSamplesProcessed.get()).append("\n");
 
 for (WorkerStats stats : workerStats.values()) {
 sb.append(" Worker ").append(stats.rank).append(": ");
 sb.append("Loss=").append(String.format("%.4f", stats.loss)).append(", ");
 sb.append("Active=").append(stats.active).append("\n");
 }
 
 System.out.println(sb.toString());
 }, 10, config.logInterval, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 }

 public void train(Dataset dataset) {
 running = true;
 
 if (config.rank == 0) {
 trainMaster(dataset);
 } else {
 trainWorker(dataset);
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 private void trainMaster(Dataset dataset) {
 int totalBatches = dataset.size() / config.batchSize;
 int batchesPerWorker = totalBatches / config.worldSize;
 
 List<Future<TrainingResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 dataset.shuffle();
 
 for (int batchIdx = 0; batchIdx < batchesPerWorker; batchIdx++) {
 int globalBatchIdx = batchIdx * config.worldSize;
 
 for (int workerRank : workerStats.keySet()) {
 if (!workerStats.get(workerRank).active) continue;
 
 int start = globalBatchIdx * config.batchSize;
 int end = start + config.batchSize;
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(start, end);
 
 futures.add(trainingPool.submit(() -> {
 return executeWorkerStep(workerRank, batch);
 }));
 }
 
 aggregateAndUpdate(futures);
 futures.clear();
 
 if (globalStep.incrementAndGet() % config.logInterval == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[Distributed] Epoch %d, Step %d: Loss = %.6f%n",
 epoch, globalStep.get(), workerStats.values().stream()
 .mapToDouble(s -> s.loss).average().orElse(0));
 }
 
 if (globalStep.get() % config.saveInterval == 0) {
 saveCheckpoint(epoch);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private TrainingResult executeWorkerStep(int workerRank, Dataset batch) {
 try {
 float loss = computeLoss(globalModel, batch);
 float[] gradients = computeGradients(globalModel, batch);
 
 commLayer.allReduce(gradients, DistributedCommunicationLayer.ReduceOp.AVG);
 
 globalOptimizer.update(globalModel.getOutputWeights(), gradients);
 
 WorkerStats stats = workerStats.get(workerRank);
 if (stats != null) {
 stats.loss = loss;
 stats.stepsCompleted++;
 stats.bytesProcessed += batch.size() * config.batchSize * 4;
 }
 
 return new TrainingResult(loss, 0, workerRank);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Worker " + workerRank + " failed: " + e.getMessage());
 WorkerStats stats = workerStats.get(workerRank);
 if (stats != null) {
 stats.active = false;
 }
 return new TrainingResult(Float.MAX_VALUE, 0, workerRank);
 }
 }

 private void aggregateAndUpdate(List<Future<TrainingResult>> futures) {
 float totalLoss = 0;
 int count = 0;
 
 for (Future<TrainingResult> future : futures) {
 try {
 TrainingResult result = future.get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 totalLoss += result.averageLoss;
 count++;
 
 WorkerStats stats = workerStats.get(result.workerId);
 if (stats != null) {
 stats.loss = result.averageLoss;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Aggregation failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 if (count > 0) {
 float avgLoss = totalLoss / count;
 for (WorkerStats stats : workerStats.values()) {
 if (stats.active) {
 stats.loss = avgLoss;
 }
 }
 }
 
 broadcastModel();
 }

 private void broadcastModel() {
 if (config.worldSize > 1) {
 float[] modelParams = globalModel.getOutputWeights();
 commLayer.broadcast(modelParams);
 }
 }

 private void trainWorker(Dataset dataset) {
 int totalBatches = dataset.size() / config.batchSize;
 int batchesPerWorker = totalBatches / config.worldSize;
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 for (int batchIdx = 0; batchIdx < batchesPerWorker && running; batchIdx++) {
 int start = batchIdx * config.batchSize;
 int end = start + config.batchSize;
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(start, end);
 
 float loss = computeLoss(globalModel, batch);
 float[] gradients = computeGradients(globalModel, batch);
 
 commLayer.allReduce(gradients, DistributedCommunicationLayer.ReduceOp.AVG);
 globalOptimizer.update(globalModel.getOutputWeights(), gradients);
 
 globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 
 if (batchIdx % config.logInterval == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[Worker %d] Epoch %d, Batch %d: Loss = %.6f%n",
 config.rank, epoch, batchIdx, loss);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public void trainWithModelParallelism(Dataset dataset) {
 if (config.parallelStrategy != ParallelStrategy.MODEL_PARALLEL) {
 train(dataset);
 return;
 }
 
 running = true;
 
 int layersPerWorker = globalModel.getNLayers() / config.worldSize;
 int startLayer = config.rank * layersPerWorker;
 int endLayer = Math.min(startLayer + layersPerWorker, globalModel.getNLayers());
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Model Parallelism: Worker " + config.rank + 
 " handles layers " + startLayer + "-" + endLayer);
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 dataset.shuffle();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dataset.size(); i += config.batchSize) {
 int end = Math.min(i + config.batchSize, dataset.size());
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(i, end);
 
 float[] input = prepareBatch(batch);
 
 if (config.rank == 0) {
 input = globalModel.forwardPartial(input, startLayer, endLayer);
 for (int targetRank = 1; targetRank < config.worldSize; targetRank++) {
 commLayer.broadcast(input);
 }
 } else {
 CompletableFuture<float[]> receiveFuture = new CompletableFuture<>();
 try {
 input = receiveFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 input = globalModel.forwardPartial(input, startLayer, endLayer);
 
 if (config.rank < config.worldSize - 1) {
 commLayer.broadcast(input);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Model parallel forward failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 if (config.rank == config.worldSize - 1) {
 float loss = computeLossFromOutput(input, batch);
 float[] gradients = computeGradientsFromOutput(input, batch);
 
 for (int sourceRank = config.worldSize - 2; sourceRank >= 0; sourceRank--) {
 commLayer.broadcast(gradients);
 }
 
 globalOptimizer.update(globalModel.getOutputWeights(), gradients);
 } else {
 CompletableFuture<float[]> gradFuture = new CompletableFuture<>();
 try {
 float[] gradients = gradFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 gradients = globalModel.backwardPartial(gradients, endLayer, startLayer);
 
 if (config.rank > 0) {
 commLayer.broadcast(gradients);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Model parallel backward failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 totalSamplesProcessed.addAndGet(batch.size());
 }
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 public void trainWithPipelineParallelism(Dataset dataset) {
 if (config.parallelStrategy != ParallelStrategy.PIPELINE_PARALLEL) {
 train(dataset);
 return;
 }
 
 running = true;
 
 int stages = config.worldSize;
 int microBatches = 4;
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Pipeline Parallelism: " + stages + " stages, " + microBatches + " micro-batches");
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dataset.size(); i += config.batchSize) {
 List<Dataset> microBatchesList = splitIntoMicroBatches(dataset.slice(i, Math.min(i + config.batchSize, dataset.size())), microBatches);
 
 for (int microIdx = 0; microIdx < microBatches; microIdx++) {
 Dataset microBatch = microBatchesList.get(microIdx);
 
 int stage = microIdx % stages;
 
 if (stage == config.rank) {
 float[] input = prepareBatch(microBatch);
 input = processPipelineStage(input, stage);
 
 if (stage < stages - 1) {
 commLayer.broadcast(input);
 }
 }
 
 if (stage > 0 && stage - 1 == config.rank) {
 CompletableFuture<float[]> receiveFuture = new CompletableFuture<>();
 try {
 float[] input = receiveFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 input = processPipelineStage(input, stage);
 
 if (stage < stages - 1) {
 commLayer.broadcast(input);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Pipeline stage failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 if (stage == stages - 1 && stage == config.rank) {
 float loss = computeLossFromOutput(input, microBatch);
 float[] gradients = computeGradientsFromOutput(input, microBatch);
 globalOptimizer.update(globalModel.getOutputWeights(), gradients);
 
 globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 private List<Dataset> splitIntoMicroBatches(Dataset batch, int numMicroBatches) {
 List<Dataset> microBatches = new ArrayList<>();
 int microSize = batch.size() / numMicroBatches;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numMicroBatches; i++) {
 int start = i * microSize;
 int end = (i == numMicroBatches - 1) ? batch.size() : start + microSize;
 microBatches.add(batch.slice(start, end));
 }
 
 return microBatches;
 }

 private float[] processPipelineStage(float[] input, int stage) {
 int layersPerStage = globalModel.getNLayers() / config.worldSize;
 int startLayer = stage * layersPerStage;
 int endLayer = Math.min(startLayer + layersPerStage, globalModel.getNLayers());
 
 return globalModel.forwardPartial(input, startLayer, endLayer);
 }

 private float[] prepareBatch(Dataset batch) {
 List<float[]> data = batch.getData();
 float[] input = new float[data.size() * data.get(0).length];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
 System.arraycopy(data.get(i), 0, input, i * data.get(0).length, data.get(0).length);
 }
 
 return input;
 }

 private float computeLoss(SimpCoreModel model, Dataset batch) {
 float[] input = prepareBatch(batch);
 float[] output = model.forward(input, batch.size());
 
 float loss = 0;
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
 int label = labels.get(i);
 float predicted = output[i * model.getVocabSize() + label];
 loss -= Math.log(Math.max(predicted, 1e-10f));
 }
 
 return loss / labels.size();
 }

 private float[] computeGradients(SimpCoreModel model, Dataset batch) {
 float[] input = prepareBatch(batch);
 float[] output = model.forward(input, batch.size());
 
 int vocabSize = model.getVocabSize();
 float[] gradients = new float[output.length];
 
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
 int start = i * vocabSize;
 float[] logits = new float[vocabSize];
 System.arraycopy(output, start, logits, 0, vocabSize);
 
 float[] softmax = softmax(logits);
 int label = labels.get(i);
 
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 gradients[start + j] = softmax[j] - (j == label ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
 }
 }
 
 return gradients;
 }

 private float computeLossFromOutput(float[] output, Dataset batch) {
 float loss = 0;
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 int vocabSize = globalModel.getVocabSize();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
 int label = labels.get(i);
 float predicted = output[i * vocabSize + label];
 loss -= Math.log(Math.max(predicted, 1e-10f));
 }
 
 return loss / labels.size();
 }

 private float[] computeGradientsFromOutput(float[] output, Dataset batch) {
 int vocabSize = globalModel.getVocabSize();
 float[] gradients = new float[output.length];
 
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
 int start = i * vocabSize;
 float[] logits = new float[vocabSize];
 System.arraycopy(output, start, logits, 0, vocabSize);
 
 float[] softmax = softmax(logits);
 int label = labels.get(i);
 
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 gradients[start + j] = softmax[j] - (j == label ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
 }
 }
 
 return gradients;
 }
 
 private float[] softmax(float[] logits) {
 float max = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float val : logits) {
 max = Math.max(max, val);
 }
 
 float[] exp = new float[logits.length];
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[logits.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 result[i] = exp[i] / sum;
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 public void saveCheckpoint(int epoch) {
 if (config.rank != 0) return;
 
 try {
 String checkpointPath = String.format("checkpoint_epoch_%d_rank_%d.bin", epoch, config.rank);
 globalModel.save(checkpointPath);
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Saved checkpoint: " + checkpointPath);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to save checkpoint: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 public void loadCheckpoint(String path) {
 try {
 globalModel.load(path);
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Loaded checkpoint: " + path);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to load checkpoint: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 
 trainingPool.shutdown();
 statsScheduler.shutdown();
 
 try {
 if (!trainingPool.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 trainingPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!statsScheduler.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 statsScheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 trainingPool.shutdownNow();
 statsScheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 
 commLayer.shutdown();
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Framework shutdown complete");
 }

 public int getGlobalStep() {
 return globalStep.get();
 }

 public long getTotalSamplesProcessed() {
 return totalSamplesProcessed.get();
 }

 public WorkerStats getWorkerStats(int rank) {
 return workerStats.get(rank);
 }

 public Map<Integer, WorkerStats> getAllWorkerStats() {
 return Collections.unmodifiableMap(workerStats);
 }

 public static class Dataset {
 private final List<float[]> data;
 private final List<Integer> labels;
 
 public Dataset() {
 this.data = new ArrayList<>();
 this.labels = new ArrayList<>();
 }
 
 public void add(float[] item, int label) {
 data.add(item);
 labels.add(label);
 }
 
 public int size() {
 return data.size();
 }
 
 public Dataset slice(int start, int end) {
 Dataset slice = new Dataset();
 for (int i = start; i < end && i < data.size(); i++) {
 slice.add(data.get(i), labels.get(i));
 }
 return slice;
 }
 
 public void shuffle() {
 List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
 indices.add(i);
 }
 Collections.shuffle(indices);
 
 List<float[]> newData = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Integer> newLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int idx : indices) {
 newData.add(data.get(idx));
 newLabels.add(labels.get(idx));
 }
 
 data.clear();
 data.addAll(newData);
 labels.clear();
 labels.addAll(newLabels);
 }
 
 public List<float[]> getData() {
 return data;
 }
 
 public List<Integer> getLabels() {
 return labels;
 }
 }

 public static class TrainingResult {
 public final float averageLoss;
 public final float accuracy;
 public final int workerId;
 
 public TrainingResult(float averageLoss, float accuracy, int workerId) {
 this.averageLoss = averageLoss;
 this.accuracy = accuracy;
 this.workerId = workerId;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUDeviceManager;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public final class AutogradDistributedFramework {

 public static class TrainingConfig {
 public int worldSize = 1;
 public int rank = 0;
 public String masterHost = "localhost";
 public int port = DistributedCommunicationLayer.DEFAULT_PORT;
 public int epochs = 10;
 public int batchSize = 32;
 public int microBatchSize = 8;
 public float learningRate = 0.001f;
 public float weightDecay = 0.01f;
 public int gradientAccumulationSteps = 1;
 public boolean useGradientClipping = true;
 public float maxGradientNorm = 1.0f;
 public ParallelStrategy parallelStrategy = ParallelStrategy.DATA_PARALLEL;
 public boolean enableMixedPrecision = false;
 public int logInterval = 10;
 public int saveInterval = 100;
 public boolean useGPU = true;
 }

 public enum ParallelStrategy {
 DATA_PARALLEL,
 MODEL_PARALLEL,
 PIPELINE_PARALLEL,
 HYBRID
 }

 public static class WorkerStats {
 public final int rank;
 public final String gpuName;
 public volatile float loss;
 public volatile float gradNorm;
 public volatile float learningRate;
 public volatile int stepsCompleted;
 public volatile long bytesProcessed;
 public volatile boolean active;
 public volatile float gpuUtilization;
 public volatile long gpuMemoryUsed;

 public WorkerStats(int rank, String gpuName) {
 this.rank = rank;
 this.gpuName = gpuName;
 this.loss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.gradNorm = 0;
 this.learningRate = 0;
 this.stepsCompleted = 0;
 this.bytesProcessed = 0;
 this.active = true;
 this.gpuUtilization = 0;
 this.gpuMemoryUsed = 0;
 }
 }

 public static class TrainingMetrics {
 public final List<Float> lossHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 public final List<Float> gradNormHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 public final List<Float> lrHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 public final List<Long> stepTimes = new ArrayList<>();
 public final List<Float> gpuUtilHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 public final List<Long> memoryUsageHistory = new ArrayList<>();
 public volatile float currentLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 public volatile float currentGradNorm = 0;
 public volatile int globalStep = 0;
 public volatile long samplesProcessed = 0;

 public synchronized void record(float loss, float gradNorm, float lr, long stepTime, 
 float gpuUtil, long memoryUsage) {
 lossHistory.add(loss);
 gradNormHistory.add(gradNorm);
 lrHistory.add(lr);
 stepTimes.add(stepTime);
 gpuUtilHistory.add(gpuUtil);
 memoryUsageHistory.add(memoryUsage);
 currentLoss = loss;
 currentGradNorm = gradNorm;
 }

 public synchronized float getAverageLoss(int recentCount) {
 if (lossHistory.isEmpty()) return Float.MAX_VALUE;
 int start = Math.max(0, lossHistory.size() - recentCount);
 double sum = 0;
 int count = 0;
 for (int i = start; i < lossHistory.size(); i++) {
 sum += lossHistory.get(i);
 count++;
 }
 return (float) (sum / count);
 }

 public synchronized String getSummary() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("Training Metrics Summary:\n");
 sb.append(" Global Step: ").append(globalStep).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Samples Processed: ").append(samplesProcessed).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Current Loss: ").append(String.format("%.6f", currentLoss)).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Current Gradient Norm: ").append(String.format("%.4f", currentGradNorm)).append("\n");
 if (!lossHistory.isEmpty()) {
 sb.append(" Average Loss (last 100): ").append(String.format("%.6f", getAverageLoss(100))).append("\n");
 }
 if (!stepTimes.isEmpty()) {
 double avgTime = stepTimes.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).average().orElse(0);
 sb.append(" Average Step Time: ").append(String.format("%.2f ms", avgTime)).append("\n");
 }
 return sb.toString();
 }
 }

 private final TrainingConfig config;
 private final DistributedCommunicationLayer commLayer;
 private final Map<Integer, WorkerStats> workerStats = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final TrainingMetrics metrics = new TrainingMetrics();
 
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private final AtomicInteger globalStep = new AtomicInteger(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalSamplesProcessed = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalTrainingTime = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 private final ExecutorService trainingPool;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService statsScheduler;
 
 private float[] globalGradients;
 private float[] globalParameters;
 private int parameterCount = 0;
 
 public AutogradDistributedFramework(TrainingConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 this.commLayer = new DistributedCommunicationLayer(config.rank, config.worldSize, config.masterHost, config.port);
 
 int poolSize = config.parallelStrategy == ParallelStrategy.DATA_PARALLEL 
 ? Math.max(2, config.worldSize) 
 : Math.max(4, config.worldSize * 2);
 this.trainingPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(poolSize);
 this.statsScheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 }

 public void initialize(SimpCoreModel model) throws Exception {
 commLayer.initialize();
 
 if (config.rank == 0) {
 initializeWorkers();
 startStatsCollection();
 }
 
 GPUDeviceManager.initialize();
 
 parameterCount = model.getDModel() * model.getVocabSize();
 globalGradients = new float[parameterCount];
 globalParameters = new float[parameterCount];
 System.arraycopy(model.getOutputWeights(), 0, globalParameters, 0, parameterCount);
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Autograd framework initialized on rank " + config.rank);
 }

 private void initializeWorkers() {
 for (int i = 0; i < config.worldSize; i++) {
 if (i != config.rank) {
 String gpuName = "Unknown";
 if (GPUDeviceManager.isGPUAvailable()) {
 GPUDeviceManager.DeviceInfo device = GPUDeviceManager.getSelectedDevice();
 if (device != null) {
 gpuName = device.name;
 }
 }
 workerStats.put(i, new WorkerStats(i, gpuName));
 }
 }
 }

 private void startStatsCollection() {
 statsScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (!running) return;
 
 float gpuUtil = 0;
 long gpuMemory = 0;
 if (GPUDeviceManager.isGPUAvailable()) {
 GPUDeviceManager.DeviceInfo device = GPUDeviceManager.getSelectedDevice();
 if (device != null) {
 gpuMemory = device.memoryTotal;
 }
 }
 
 metrics.gpuUtilHistory.add(gpuUtil);
 metrics.memoryUsageHistory.add(gpuMemory);
 
 if (globalStep.get() % config.logInterval == 0) {
 System.out.println(metrics.getSummary());
 }
 }, 5, config.logInterval, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 }

 public void train(Dataset dataset) {
 running = true;
 
 if (config.parallelStrategy == ParallelStrategy.MODEL_PARALLEL) {
 trainWithModelParallelism(dataset);
 } else if (config.parallelStrategy == ParallelStrategy.PIPELINE_PARALLEL) {
 trainWithPipelineParallelism(dataset);
 } else {
 trainDataParallel(dataset);
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 private void trainDataParallel(Dataset dataset) {
 int totalBatches = dataset.size() / config.batchSize;
 int batchesPerWorker = totalBatches / config.worldSize;
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 dataset.shuffle();
 
 for (int batchIdx = 0; batchIdx < batchesPerWorker && running; batchIdx++) {
 long stepStartTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 int start = batchIdx * config.batchSize * config.worldSize + config.rank * config.batchSize;
 int end = start + config.batchSize;
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(start, end);
 
 Tensor loss = executeTrainingStep(batch);
 
 float[] gradients = computeGradientsFromTensor(loss);
 
 commLayer.allReduce(gradients, DistributedCommunicationLayer.ReduceOp.AVG);
 
 updateParameters(gradients, config.learningRate);
 
 long stepTime = (System.nanoTime() - stepStartTime) / 1_000_000;
 
 int step = globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 totalSamplesProcessed.addAndGet(batch.size());
 
 WorkerStats stats = workerStats.get(config.rank);
 if (stats != null) {
 stats.loss = loss.data[0];
 stats.gradNorm = computeGradientNorm(gradients);
 stats.stepsCompleted++;
 stats.learningRate = config.learningRate;
 }
 
 metrics.globalStep = step;
 metrics.samplesProcessed = totalSamplesProcessed.get();
 metrics.record(loss.data[0], stats != null ? stats.gradNorm : 0, 
 config.learningRate, stepTime, 0, 0);
 
 if (step % config.logInterval == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[Rank %d] Epoch %d, Step %d: Loss = %.6f, GradNorm = %.4f, Time = %.2f ms%n",
 config.rank, epoch, step, loss.data[0], 
 stats != null ? stats.gradNorm : 0, stepTime);
 }
 
 loss = null;
 gradients = null;
 }
 }
 }

 private Tensor executeTrainingStep(Dataset batch) {
 List<float[]> data = batch.getData();
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 int batchSize = data.size();
 int inputDim = data.get(0).length;
 
 float[] inputData = new float[batchSize * inputDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(data.get(i), 0, inputData, i * inputDim, inputDim);
 }
 
 int[] targetArray = new int[batchSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize; i++) {
 targetArray[i] = labels.get(i);
 }
 
 Tensor input = new Tensor(inputData, batchSize, inputDim);
 input.requiresGrad = false;
 
 Tensor weight = new Tensor(globalParameters.clone(), inputDim, 10);
 weight.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor logits = AutogradEngine.matmul(input, weight);
 
 return AutogradEngine.crossEntropyLossTensor(logits, targetArray);
 }

 private float[] computeGradientsFromTensor(Tensor loss) {
 loss.backward();
 
 float[] gradients = new float[parameterCount];
 Arrays.fill(gradients, 0);
 
 collectGradients(loss, gradients);
 
 return gradients;
 }

 private void collectGradients(Tensor tensor, float[] gradients) {
 if (tensor.gradFn != null) {
 for (Tensor input : tensor.gradFn.inputs) {
 if (input.requiresGrad && input.grad != null) {
 System.arraycopy(input.grad, 0, gradients, 0, Math.min(input.grad.length, gradients.length));
 }
 collectGradients(input, gradients);
 }
 }
 }

 private float computeGradientNorm(float[] gradients) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float g : gradients) {
 sum += g * g;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }

 private void updateParameters(float[] gradients, float lr) {
 for (int i = 0; i < parameterCount; i++) {
 globalParameters[i] -= lr * gradients[i];
 }
 }

 public void trainWithModelParallelism(Dataset dataset) {
 running = true;
 
 int layersPerWorker = 4;
 int startLayer = config.rank * layersPerWorker;
 int endLayer = Math.min(startLayer + layersPerWorker, 12);
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Model Parallelism: Worker " + config.rank + 
 " handles layers " + startLayer + "-" + endLayer);
 
 int totalBatches = dataset.size() / config.batchSize;
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 dataset.shuffle();
 
 for (int batchIdx = 0; batchIdx < totalBatches && running; batchIdx++) {
 int start = batchIdx * config.batchSize;
 int end = Math.min(start + config.batchSize, dataset.size());
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(start, end);
 
 float[] inputData = prepareBatchData(batch);
 Tensor inputTensor = new Tensor(inputData, config.batchSize, 64);
 inputTensor.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor output = forwardPassModelParallel(inputTensor, startLayer, endLayer);
 
 float[] targetArray = prepareTargets(batch);
 Tensor loss = AutogradEngine.crossEntropyLossTensor(output, convertToIntArray(targetArray));
 
 float[] gradients = backwardPassModelParallel(loss, startLayer, endLayer);
 
 if (config.rank == 0) {
 updateParameters(gradients, config.learningRate);
 broadcastParameters();
 } else {
 receiveParameters();
 }
 
 int step = globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 
 if (step % config.logInterval == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[Rank %d] Epoch %d, Step %d: Loss = %.6f%n",
 config.rank, epoch, step, loss.data[0]);
 }
 }
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 private Tensor forwardPassModelParallel(Tensor input, int startLayer, int endLayer) {
 Tensor x = input;
 
 for (int l = startLayer; l < endLayer; l++) {
 int hiddenDim = 256;
 Tensor w1 = new Tensor(new float[x.numel * hiddenDim], x.shape[1], hiddenDim);
 w1.requiresGrad = true;
 Tensor w2 = new Tensor(new float[hiddenDim * 10], hiddenDim, 10);
 w2.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor hidden = AutogradEngine.matmul(x, w1);
 hidden = AutogradEngine.silu(hidden);
 x = AutogradEngine.matmul(hidden, w2);
 
 if (l < endLayer - 1) {
 x = AutogradEngine.layerNorm(x, null, null);
 }
 }
 
 return x;
 }

 private float[] backwardPassModelParallel(Tensor loss, int startLayer, int endLayer) {
 loss.backward();
 
 float[] gradients = new float[parameterCount];
 
 if (config.rank == config.worldSize - 1) {
 gradients = collectAllGradients(loss);
 } else {
 float[] gradFromNext = receiveGradientFromNext();
 propagateGradients(loss, gradFromNext);
 gradients = collectAllGradients(loss);
 sendGradientToPrev(gradients);
 }
 
 return gradients;
 }

 private float[] collectAllGradients(Tensor tensor) {
 List<Float> allGradients = new ArrayList<>();
 collectGradientsRecursive(tensor, allGradients);
 
 float[] result = new float[Math.min(allGradients.size(), parameterCount)];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = allGradients.get(i);
 }
 return result;
 }

 private void collectGradientsRecursive(Tensor tensor, List<Float> gradients) {
 if (tensor.requiresGrad && tensor.grad != null) {
 for (float g : tensor.grad) {
 gradients.add(g);
 }
 }
 if (tensor.gradFn != null) {
 for (Tensor input : tensor.gradFn.inputs) {
 collectGradientsRecursive(input, gradients);
 }
 }
 }

 private float[] receiveGradientFromNext() {
 float[] grad = new float[parameterCount];
 try {
 commLayer.receive(grad);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to receive gradient: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 return grad;
 }

 private void sendGradientToPrev(float[] gradients) {
 try {
 commLayer.send(gradients, config.rank - 1);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to send gradient: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 private void broadcastParameters() {
 try {
 commLayer.broadcast(globalParameters);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to broadcast parameters: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 private void receiveParameters() {
 try {
 commLayer.receive(globalParameters);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to receive parameters: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 public void trainWithPipelineParallelism(Dataset dataset) {
 running = true;
 
 int stages = config.worldSize;
 int microBatches = Math.max(1, config.batchSize / config.microBatchSize);
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Pipeline Parallelism: " + stages + " stages, " + microBatches + " micro-batches");
 
 int totalBatches = dataset.size() / config.batchSize;
 
 float[][] accumulatedGradients = new float[stages][parameterCount];
 int[] processedMicroBatches = new int[stages];
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.epochs && running; epoch++) {
 dataset.shuffle();
 
 for (int batchIdx = 0; batchIdx < totalBatches && running; batchIdx++) {
 int start = batchIdx * config.batchSize;
 int end = Math.min(start + config.batchSize, dataset.size());
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(start, end);
 
 List<Dataset> microBatchesList = splitIntoMicroBatches(batch, microBatches);
 
 for (int microIdx = 0; microIdx < microBatches && running; microIdx++) {
 Dataset microBatch = microBatchesList.get(microIdx);
 
 int stage = microIdx % stages;
 
 if (stage == config.rank) {
 float[] inputData = prepareBatchData(microBatch);
 Tensor input = new Tensor(inputData, config.microBatchSize, 64);
 input.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor output = processPipelineStage(input, stage);
 
 if (stage < stages - 1) {
 sendActivationToNextStage(output.data);
 } else {
 float[] targetArray = prepareTargets(microBatch);
 Tensor loss = AutogradEngine.crossEntropyLossTensor(output, convertToIntArray(targetArray));
 
 float[] gradients = computeGradientsFromTensor(loss);
 accumulateGradients(accumulatedGradients, gradients, stage);
 processedMicroBatches[stage]++;
 
 if (processedMicroBatches[stage] >= microBatches) {
 float[] avgGradients = averageGradients(accumulatedGradients[stage], microBatches);
 updateParameters(avgGradients, config.learningRate);
 processedMicroBatches[stage] = 0;
 Arrays.fill(accumulatedGradients[stage], 0);
 }
 
 sendGradientToPrevStage(gradients);
 }
 }
 
 if (stage > 0 && stage - 1 == config.rank) {
 float[] inputData = receiveActivationFromPrevStage();
 Tensor input = new Tensor(inputData, config.microBatchSize, 64);
 input.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor output = processPipelineStage(input, stage);
 
 if (stage < stages - 1) {
 sendActivationToNextStage(output.data);
 } else {
 float[] targetArray = prepareTargets(microBatch);
 Tensor loss = AutogradEngine.crossEntropyLossTensor(output, convertToIntArray(targetArray));
 
 float[] gradients = computeGradientsFromTensor(loss);
 accumulateGradients(accumulatedGradients, gradients, stage);
 processedMicroBatches[stage]++;
 
 if (processedMicroBatches[stage] >= microBatches) {
 float[] avgGradients = averageGradients(accumulatedGradients[stage], microBatches);
 updateParameters(avgGradients, config.learningRate);
 processedMicroBatches[stage] = 0;
 Arrays.fill(accumulatedGradients[stage], 0);
 }
 
 sendGradientToPrevStage(gradients);
 }
 }
 
 if (stage > 0 && stage == config.rank) {
 float[] gradFromNext = receiveGradientFromNextStage();
 if (gradFromNext != null) {
 accumulateGradients(accumulatedGradients, gradFromNext, stage);
 processedMicroBatches[stage]++;
 
 if (processedMicroBatches[stage] >= microBatches) {
 float[] avgGradients = averageGradients(accumulatedGradients[stage], microBatches);
 updateParameters(avgGradients, config.learningRate);
 processedMicroBatches[stage] = 0;
 Arrays.fill(accumulatedGradients[stage], 0);
 }
 
 if (stage > 0) {
 sendGradientToPrevStage(gradFromNext);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 }
 }
 
 running = false;
 }

 private Tensor processPipelineStage(Tensor input, int stage) {
 int hiddenDim = 256;
 int layersPerStage = 2;
 
 Tensor x = input;
 for (int l = 0; l < layersPerStage; l++) {
 Tensor w1 = new Tensor(new float[x.numel * hiddenDim], x.shape[1], hiddenDim);
 w1.requiresGrad = true;
 Tensor w2 = new Tensor(new float[hiddenDim * (stage < config.worldSize - 1 ? hiddenDim : 10)], 
 hiddenDim, stage < config.worldSize - 1 ? hiddenDim : 10);
 w2.requiresGrad = true;
 
 Tensor hidden = AutogradEngine.matmul(x, w1);
 hidden = AutogradEngine.silu(hidden);
 x = AutogradEngine.matmul(hidden, w2);
 
 x = AutogradEngine.layerNorm(x, null, null);
 }
 
 return x;
 }

 private void sendActivationToNextStage(float[] activation) {
 try {
 commLayer.send(activation, config.rank + 1);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to send activation: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 private float[] receiveActivationFromPrevStage() {
 float[] activation = new float[config.microBatchSize * 64];
 try {
 commLayer.receive(activation);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to receive activation: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 return activation;
 }

 private void sendGradientToPrevStage(float[] gradients) {
 if (config.rank > 0) {
 try {
 commLayer.send(gradients, config.rank - 1);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to send gradient: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }

 private float[] receiveGradientFromNextStage() {
 if (config.rank < config.worldSize - 1) {
 float[] gradients = new float[parameterCount];
 try {
 commLayer.receive(gradients);
 return gradients;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to receive gradient: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 return null;
 }

 private void accumulateGradients(float[][] accumulated, float[] gradients, int stage) {
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(gradients.length, accumulated[stage].length); i++) {
 accumulated[stage][i] += gradients[i];
 }
 }

 private float[] averageGradients(float[] gradients, int count) {
 float[] result = new float[gradients.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 result[i] = gradients[i] / count;
 }
 return result;
 }

 private float[] prepareBatchData(Dataset batch) {
 List<float[]> data = batch.getData();
 int inputDim = data.get(0).length;
 float[] inputData = new float[data.size() * inputDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
 System.arraycopy(data.get(i), 0, inputData, i * inputDim, inputDim);
 }
 return inputData;
 }

 private float[] prepareTargets(Dataset batch) {
 List<Integer> labels = batch.getLabels();
 float[] targets = new float[labels.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.size(); i++) {
 targets[i] = labels.get(i);
 }
 return targets;
 }

 private int[] convertToIntArray(float[] floatArray) {
 int[] intArray = new int[floatArray.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < floatArray.length; i++) {
 intArray[i] = (int) floatArray[i];
 }
 return intArray;
 }

 private List<Dataset> splitIntoMicroBatches(Dataset batch, int numMicroBatches) {
 List<Dataset> microBatches = new ArrayList<>();
 int microSize = batch.size() / numMicroBatches;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numMicroBatches; i++) {
 int start = i * microSize;
 int end = (i == numMicroBatches - 1) ? batch.size() : start + microSize;
 microBatches.add(batch.slice(start, end));
 }
 
 return microBatches;
 }

 public void saveCheckpoint(int epoch) {
 if (config.rank != 0) return;
 
 try {
 String checkpointPath = String.format("autograd_checkpoint_epoch_%d.bin", epoch);
 java.io.DataOutputStream dos = new java.io.DataOutputStream(
 new java.io.FileOutputStream(checkpointPath));
 
 dos.writeInt(globalStep.get());
 dos.writeLong(totalSamplesProcessed.get());
 dos.writeInt(parameterCount);
 
 for (float param : globalParameters) {
 dos.writeFloat(param);
 }
 
 dos.close();
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Saved autograd checkpoint: " + checkpointPath);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to save checkpoint: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 
 trainingPool.shutdown();
 statsScheduler.shutdown();
 
 try {
 if (!trainingPool.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 trainingPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!statsScheduler.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 statsScheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 trainingPool.shutdownNow();
 statsScheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 
 commLayer.shutdown();
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Autograd framework shutdown complete");
 }

 public TrainingMetrics getMetrics() {
 return metrics;
 }

 public WorkerStats getWorkerStats(int rank) {
 return workerStats.get(rank);
 }

 public int getGlobalStep() {
 return globalStep.get();
 }

 public long getTotalSamplesProcessed() {
 return totalSamplesProcessed.get();
 }

 public static class Dataset {
 private final List<float[]> data;
 private final List<Integer> labels;
 
 public Dataset() {
 this.data = new ArrayList<>();
 this.labels = new ArrayList<>();
 }
 
 public void add(float[] item, int label) {
 data.add(item);
 labels.add(label);
 }
 
 public int size() {
 return data.size();
 }
 
 public Dataset slice(int start, int end) {
 Dataset slice = new Dataset();
 for (int i = start; i < end && i < data.size(); i++) {
 slice.add(data.get(i), labels.get(i));
 }
 return slice;
 }
 
 public void shuffle() {
 List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i++) {
 indices.add(i);
 }
 Collections.shuffle(indices);
 
 List<float[]> newData = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Integer> newLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int idx : indices) {
 newData.add(data.get(idx));
 newLabels.add(labels.get(idx));
 }
 
 data.clear();
 data.addAll(newData);
 labels.clear();
 labels.addAll(newLabels);
 }
 
 public List<float[]> getData() {
 return data;
 }
 
 public List<Integer> getLabels() {
 return labels;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public class CommunicationLayer {
 
 private static final int DEFAULT_PORT = 12345;
 private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 1 << 20;
 private static final int MAX_RETRIES = 60;
 private static final int RETRY_DELAY_MS = 1000;
 
 private final int rank;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final String masterHost;
 private final int masterPort;
 
 private ServerSocketChannel serverChannel;
 private final Map<Integer, SocketChannel> rankToChannel = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 private final ExecutorService sendPool;
 private final ExecutorService recvPool;
 
 private final AtomicLong bytesSent = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong bytesReceived = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong messagesSent = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong messagesReceived = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private final CyclicBarrier barrier;
 
 public CommunicationLayer(int rank, int worldSize) {
 this(rank, worldSize, "localhost", DEFAULT_PORT);
 }
 
 public CommunicationLayer(int rank, int worldSize, String masterHost, int masterPort) {
 if (rank < 0 || rank >= worldSize) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid rank: " + rank + " / " + worldSize);
 }
 this.rank = rank;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.masterHost = masterHost;
 this.masterPort = masterPort;
 this.sendPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(Math.min(4, worldSize),
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("comm-send-"));
 this.recvPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(Math.min(4, worldSize),
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("comm-recv-"));
 this.barrier = worldSize > 1 ? new CyclicBarrier(worldSize) : null;
 }
 
 public void init() throws Exception {
 if (worldSize == 1) {
 running = true;
 return;
 }
 
 serverChannel = ServerSocketChannel.open();
 serverChannel.socket().setReuseAddress(true);
 serverChannel.socket().bind(new InetSocketAddress(masterPort + rank));
 serverChannel.configureBlocking(false);
 
 new Thread(this::acceptLoop, "comm-accept-" + rank).start();
 
 for (int other = 0; other < worldSize; other++) {
 if (other != rank) {
 connectToRank(other);
 }
 }
 
 int expected = worldSize - 1;
 int waited = 0;
 while (rankToChannel.size() < expected && waited < MAX_RETRIES * RETRY_DELAY_MS) {
 Thread.sleep(100);
 waited += 100;
 }
 
 if (rankToChannel.size() < expected) {
 throw new RuntimeException(String.format("Failed to establish all connections: %d/%d",
 rankToChannel.size(), expected));
 }
 
 running = true;
 barrier();
 }
 
 private void acceptLoop() {
 try {
 while (running) {
 SocketChannel channel = serverChannel.accept();
 if (channel == null) {
 Thread.sleep(10);
 continue;
 }
 
 channel.configureBlocking(true);
 channel.socket().setTcpNoDelay(true);
 channel.socket().setReceiveBufferSize(BUFFER_SIZE);
 channel.socket().setSendBufferSize(BUFFER_SIZE);
 
 ByteBuffer headerBuf = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 while (headerBuf.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.read(headerBuf);
 }
 headerBuf.flip();
 int clientRank = headerBuf.getInt();
 
 ByteBuffer response = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 response.putInt(rank);
 response.flip();
 while (response.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.write(response);
 }
 
 rankToChannel.put(clientRank, channel);
 
 }
 } catch (ClosedByInterruptException e) {
 // normal shutdown
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (running) {
 System.err.println("[COMM] Accept error on rank " + rank + ": " + e.getMessage());
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 
 private void connectToRank(int otherRank) throws InterruptedException {
 int attempts = 0;
 while (attempts < MAX_RETRIES && !rankToChannel.containsKey(otherRank)) {
 try {
 SocketChannel channel = SocketChannel.open();
 channel.configureBlocking(true);
 channel.socket().setTcpNoDelay(true);
 channel.socket().setReceiveBufferSize(BUFFER_SIZE);
 channel.socket().setSendBufferSize(BUFFER_SIZE);
 
 channel.connect(new InetSocketAddress(masterHost, masterPort + otherRank));
 
 ByteBuffer headerBuf = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 headerBuf.putInt(rank);
 headerBuf.flip();
 while (headerBuf.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.write(headerBuf);
 }
 
 ByteBuffer responseBuf = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 while (responseBuf.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.read(responseBuf);
 }
 responseBuf.flip();
 int remoteRank = responseBuf.getInt();
 
 if (remoteRank == otherRank) {
 rankToChannel.put(otherRank, channel);
 return;
 }
 
 } catch (ConnectException e) {
 attempts++;
 Thread.sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 attempts++;
 Thread.sleep(RETRY_DELAY_MS);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void allReduce(float[] data, ReduceOp op) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 if (worldSize <= 8) {
 treeAllReduce(data, op);
 } else {
 ringAllReduce(data, op);
 }
 }
 
 public void ringAllReduce(float[] data, ReduceOp op) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 int leftNeighbor = (rank - 1 + worldSize) % worldSize;
 int rightNeighbor = (rank + 1) % worldSize;
 
 float[] sendBuf = Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length);
 float[] recvBuf = new float[data.length];
 
 for (int step = 0; step < worldSize - 1; step++) {
 final float[] finalSendBuf = sendBuf;
 
 Future<?> sendFuture = sendPool.submit(() -> 
 sendRaw(rightNeighbor, finalSendBuf));
 
 receiveRaw(leftNeighbor, recvBuf);
 
 applyReduce(sendBuf, recvBuf, op);
 
 try {
 sendFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Ring all-reduce send failed", e);
 }
 
 float[] temp = sendBuf;
 sendBuf = recvBuf;
 recvBuf = temp;
 }
 
 System.arraycopy(sendBuf, 0, data, 0, data.length);
 }
 
 private void treeAllReduce(float[] data, ReduceOp op) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 float[] temp = new float[data.length];
 
 for (int mask = 1; mask < worldSize; mask <<= 1) {
 int peer = rank ^ mask;
 
 if (peer < worldSize) {
 if ((rank & mask) == 0) {
 receiveRaw(peer, temp);
 applyReduce(data, temp, op);
 } else {
 sendRaw(peer, data);
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int mask = highestPowerOfTwo(worldSize) >> 1; mask > 0; mask >>= 1) {
 int peer = rank ^ mask;
 if (peer < worldSize && (rank & mask) == 0) {
 sendRaw(peer, data);
 }
 }
 }
 
 private static int highestPowerOfTwo(int n) {
 int p = 1;
 while (p < n) p <<= 1;
 return p;
 }
 
 public Future<Void> asyncAllReduce(float[] data, ReduceOp op) {
 return sendPool.submit(() -> {
 allReduce(data, op);
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public void broadcast(float[] data, int root) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 if (rank == root) {
 List<Future<?>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int target = 0; target < worldSize; target++) {
 if (target != root) {
 final int t = target;
 futures.add(sendPool.submit(() -> sendRaw(t, data)));
 }
 }
 for (Future<?> f : futures) {
 try {
 f.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Broadcast send failed", e);
 }
 }
 } else {
 receiveRaw(root, data);
 }
 }
 
 public void allGather(float[] sendData, float[][] recvData) {
 if (worldSize == 1) {
 System.arraycopy(sendData, 0, recvData[0], 0, sendData.length);
 return;
 }
 
 recvData[rank] = Arrays.copyOf(sendData, sendData.length);
 
 for (int step = 0; step < worldSize - 1; step++) {
 int sendTo = (rank + 1) % worldSize;
 int recvFrom = (rank - 1 + worldSize) % worldSize;
 
 float[] toSend = recvData[(rank - step + worldSize) % worldSize];
 float[] toRecv = recvData[(rank - step - 1 + worldSize) % worldSize];
 
 final float[] finalSend = toSend;
 Future<?> sendFuture = sendPool.submit(() -> sendRaw(sendTo, finalSend));
 
 receiveRaw(recvFrom, toRecv);
 
 try {
 sendFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("All-gather send failed", e);
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void sendRaw(int targetRank, float[] data) {
 SocketChannel channel = getChannel(targetRank);
 
 try {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 header.putInt(data.length);
 header.flip();
 while (header.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.write(header);
 }
 
 ByteBuffer body = ByteBuffer.allocate(data.length * 4);
 body.asFloatBuffer().put(data);
 while (body.hasRemaining()) {
 channel.write(body);
 }
 
 bytesSent.addAndGet((long) data.length * 4 + 4);
 messagesSent.incrementAndGet();
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Send failed to rank " + targetRank, e);
 }
 }
 
 private void receiveRaw(int sourceRank, float[] data) {
 SocketChannel channel = getChannel(sourceRank);
 
 try {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(4);
 while (header.hasRemaining()) {
 int read = channel.read(header);
 if (read == -1) throw new EOFException("Connection closed from rank " + sourceRank);
 }
 header.flip();
 int length = header.getInt();
 
 if (length != data.length) {
 throw new RuntimeException(String.format(
 "Length mismatch from rank %d: expected %d, got %d",
 sourceRank, data.length, length));
 }
 
 ByteBuffer body = ByteBuffer.allocate(length * 4);
 while (body.hasRemaining()) {
 int read = channel.read(body);
 if (read == -1) throw new EOFException("Connection closed from rank " + sourceRank);
 }
 body.flip();
 body.asFloatBuffer().get(data);
 
 bytesReceived.addAndGet((long) length * 4 + 4);
 messagesReceived.incrementAndGet();
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Receive failed from rank " + sourceRank, e);
 }
 }
 
 public void sendBlocking(int targetRank, float[] data) {
 sendRaw(targetRank, data);
 }
 
 public Future<Void> sendAsync(int targetRank, float[] data) {
 return sendPool.submit(() -> {
 sendRaw(targetRank, data);
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public void receiveBlocking(int sourceRank, float[] data) {
 receiveRaw(sourceRank, data);
 }
 
 public Future<float[]> receiveAsync(int sourceRank, int length) {
 return recvPool.submit(() -> {
 float[] data = new float[length];
 receiveRaw(sourceRank, data);
 return data;
 });
 }
 
 private SocketChannel getChannel(int targetRank) {
 SocketChannel channel = rankToChannel.get(targetRank);
 if (channel == null) {
 throw new IllegalStateException("No connection to rank " + targetRank);
 }
 return channel;
 }
 
 public void barrier() {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 try {
 barrier.await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Barrier failed", e);
 }
 }
 
 private void applyReduce(float[] result, float[] other, ReduceOp op) {
 switch (op) {
 case SUM:
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] += other[i];
 }
 break;
 case AVG:
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] += other[i];
 }
 break;
 case MAX:
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = Math.max(result[i], other[i]);
 }
 break;
 case MIN:
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = Math.min(result[i], other[i]);
 }
 break;
 }
 }
 
 public int getRank() {
 return rank;
 }
 
 public int getWorldSize() {
 return worldSize;
 }
 
 public boolean isMaster() {
 return rank == 0;
 }
 
 public Map<String, Long> getStats() {
 Map<String, Long> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 stats.put("bytesSent", bytesSent.get());
 stats.put("bytesReceived", bytesReceived.get());
 stats.put("messagesSent", messagesSent.get());
 stats.put("messagesReceived", messagesReceived.get());
 return stats;
 }
 
 public void resetStats() {
 bytesSent.set(0);
 bytesReceived.set(0);
 messagesSent.set(0);
 messagesReceived.set(0);
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 
 for (SocketChannel channel : rankToChannel.values()) {
 try {
 channel.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 // ignore
 }
 }
 rankToChannel.clear();
 
 if (serverChannel != null) {
 try {
 serverChannel.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 // ignore
 }
 }
 
 sendPool.shutdownNow();
 recvPool.shutdownNow();
 
 try {
 sendPool.awaitTermination(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 recvPool.awaitTermination(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 
 public enum ReduceOp {
 SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN
 }
 
 private static class ThreadFactoryBuilder implements ThreadFactory {
 private final String prefix;
 private final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 ThreadFactoryBuilder(String prefix) {
 this.prefix = prefix;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Thread newThread(Runnable r) {
 Thread t = new Thread(r, prefix + counter.incrementAndGet());
 t.setDaemon(true);
 return t;
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 if (args.length < 2) {
 System.err.println("Usage: CommunicationLayer <rank> <worldSize>");
 System.exit(1);
 }
 
 int rank = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);
 int worldSize = Integer.parseInt(args[1]);
 
 CommunicationLayer comm = new CommunicationLayer(rank, worldSize);
 
 try {
 comm.init();
 System.out.println("[COMM] Rank " + rank + " initialized, connections: " 
 + comm.rankToChannel.size());
 
 float[] data = new float[100];
 for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
 data[i] = rank + i * 0.01f;
 }
 
 System.out.println("[COMM] Rank " + rank + " before allReduce: data[0]=" + data[0]);
 
 comm.allReduce(data, ReduceOp.SUM);
 
 float expected = 0;
 for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; r++) expected += r;
 System.out.println("[COMM] Rank " + rank + " after allReduce: data[0]=" + data[0] 
 + " (expected: " + expected + ")");
 
 comm.barrier();
 
 if (rank == 0) {
 System.out.println("[COMM] Stats: " + comm.getStats());
 }
 
 } finally {
 comm.shutdown();
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public final class DistributedCommunicationLayer {

 public static final int DEFAULT_PORT = 29500;
 public static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024;
 public static final int HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL = 5000;
 public static final int HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT = 30000;

 private final int rank;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final String masterHost;
 private final int port;
 
 private ServerSocket serverSocket;
 private final Map<Integer, Socket> peerSockets = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final Map<Integer, DataOutputStream> peerOutputStreams = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final Map<Integer, DataInputStream> peerInputStreams = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final Map<Integer, String> peerAddresses = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 private final ExecutorService sendPool = Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
 private final ExecutorService receivePool = Executors.newCachedThreadPool();
 
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, CompletableFuture<float[]>> pendingRequests = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, List<float[]>> allReduceBuffers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, ReduceOp> allReduceOps = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 private final AtomicLong messageCounter = new AtomicLong(0);
 private volatile boolean running = true;
 
 private final ScheduledExecutorService heartbeatScheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, Long> lastHeartbeat = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, Integer> failureCount = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

 public DistributedCommunicationLayer(int rank, int worldSize, String masterHost) {
 this(rank, worldSize, masterHost, DEFAULT_PORT);
 }

 public DistributedCommunicationLayer(int rank, int worldSize, String masterHost, int port) {
 this.rank = rank;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.masterHost = masterHost;
 this.port = port;
 }

 public void initialize() throws IOException {
 if (rank == 0) {
 startMaster();
 } else {
 connectToMaster();
 }
 startHeartbeat();
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Communication layer initialized: rank=" + rank + ", worldSize=" + worldSize);
 }

 private void startMaster() throws IOException {
 serverSocket = new ServerSocket(port);
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Master listening on port " + port);
 
 receivePool.submit(() -> {
 while (running) {
 try {
 Socket client = serverSocket.accept();
 DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(client.getInputStream()));
 DataOutputStream out = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(client.getOutputStream()));
 
 int clientRank = in.readInt();
 peerSockets.put(clientRank, client);
 peerInputStreams.put(clientRank, in);
 peerOutputStreams.put(clientRank, out);
 peerAddresses.put(clientRank, client.getInetAddress().getHostAddress());
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Master accepted connection from rank " + clientRank);
 
 startReceiver(clientRank, in);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (running) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Master accept error: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }
 });
 }

 private void connectToMaster() throws IOException {
 Socket socket = new Socket(masterHost, port);
 DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(socket.getInputStream()));
 DataOutputStream out = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream()));
 
 out.writeInt(rank);
 out.flush();
 
 peerSockets.put(0, socket);
 peerInputStreams.put(0, in);
 peerOutputStreams.put(0, out);
 
 startReceiver(0, in);
 
 int peerCount = in.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < peerCount; i++) {
 int peerRank = in.readInt();
 if (peerRank != rank) {
 Socket peerSocket = new Socket(masterHost, port + peerRank);
 DataInputStream peerIn = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(peerSocket.getInputStream()));
 DataOutputStream peerOut = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(peerSocket.getOutputStream()));
 
 peerOut.writeInt(rank);
 peerOut.flush();
 
 peerSockets.put(peerRank, peerSocket);
 peerInputStreams.put(peerRank, peerIn);
 peerOutputStreams.put(peerRank, peerOut);
 
 startReceiver(peerRank, peerIn);
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Rank " + rank + " connected to rank " + peerRank);
 }
 }
 }

 private void startReceiver(int peerRank, DataInputStream in) {
 receivePool.submit(() -> {
 while (running) {
 try {
 int messageType = in.readInt();
 int length = in.readInt();
 
 byte[] data = new byte[length];
 in.readFully(data);
 
 processMessage(peerRank, messageType, data);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (running) {
 handleDisconnection(peerRank);
 }
 break;
 }
 }
 });
 }

 private void startHeartbeat() {
 heartbeatScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 sendHeartbeat(peerRank);
 }
 }, 0, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 
 heartbeatScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
 for (Map.Entry<Integer, Long> entry : lastHeartbeat.entrySet()) {
 if (now - entry.getValue() > HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Heartbeat timeout for rank " + entry.getKey());
 handleDisconnection(entry.getKey());
 }
 }
 }, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 }

 private void sendHeartbeat(int peerRank) {
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.HEARTBEAT.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(4);
 out.writeInt(rank);
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 }
 }

 private void handleDisconnection(int peerRank) {
 Socket socket = peerSockets.remove(peerRank);
 if (socket != null) {
 try {
 socket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {}
 }
 peerInputStreams.remove(peerRank);
 peerOutputStreams.remove(peerRank);
 failureCount.merge(peerRank, 1, Integer::sum);
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Rank " + peerRank + " disconnected");
 }

 private void processMessage(int fromRank, int messageType, byte[] data) {
 switch (MessageType.values()[messageType]) {
 case HEARTBEAT:
 lastHeartbeat.put(fromRank, System.currentTimeMillis());
 break;
 case ALL_REDUCE_REQUEST:
 handleAllReduceRequest(fromRank, data);
 break;
 case ALL_REDUCE_RESPONSE:
 handleAllReduceResponse(fromRank, data);
 break;
 case BROADCAST:
 handleBroadcast(fromRank, data);
 break;
 case SCATTER:
 handleScatter(fromRank, data);
 break;
 case GATHER:
 handleGather(fromRank, data);
 break;
 }
 }

 public void allReduce(float[] data, ReduceOp op) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 long requestId = messageCounter.incrementAndGet();
 CompletableFuture<float[]> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
 pendingRequests.put((int) requestId, future);
 
 allReduceBuffers.put((int) requestId, Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>()));
 allReduceOps.put((int) requestId, op);
 
 try {
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.ALL_REDUCE_REQUEST.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(4 + 4 + data.length * 4);
 out.writeInt((int) requestId);
 out.writeInt(op.ordinal());
 for (float val : data) {
 out.writeFloat(val);
 }
 out.flush();
 }
 }
 
 float[] result = future.get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 System.arraycopy(result, 0, data, 0, data.length);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("AllReduce failed", e);
 } finally {
 pendingRequests.remove((int) requestId);
 allReduceBuffers.remove((int) requestId);
 allReduceOps.remove((int) requestId);
 }
 }

 private void handleAllReduceRequest(int fromRank, byte[] data) {
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
 int requestId = buffer.getInt();
 int opOrdinal = buffer.getInt();
 
 float[] received = new float[(data.length - 8) / 4];
 for (int i = 0; i < received.length; i++) {
 received[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(fromRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.ALL_REDUCE_RESPONSE.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(4 + received.length * 4);
 out.writeInt(requestId);
 for (float val : received) {
 out.writeFloat(val);
 }
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Failed to send allReduce response: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 private void handleAllReduceResponse(int fromRank, byte[] data) {
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
 int requestId = buffer.getInt();
 
 CompletableFuture<float[]> future = pendingRequests.get(requestId);
 if (future == null) return;
 
 float[] received = new float[(data.length - 4) / 4];
 for (int i = 0; i < received.length; i++) {
 received[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 List<float[]> buffers = allReduceBuffers.get(requestId);
 if (buffers == null) return;
 
 buffers.add(received);
 
 if (buffers.size() == peerSockets.size()) {
 float[] result = new float[received.length];
 ReduceOp op = allReduceOps.get(requestId);
 if (op == null) op = ReduceOp.AVG;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 switch (op) {
 case SUM:
 result[i] = 0.0f;
 for (float[] buf : buffers) {
 result[i] += buf[i];
 }
 break;
 case AVG:
 result[i] = 0.0f;
 for (float[] buf : buffers) {
 result[i] += buf[i];
 }
 result[i] /= worldSize;
 break;
 case MAX:
 result[i] = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float[] buf : buffers) {
 result[i] = Math.max(result[i], buf[i]);
 }
 break;
 case MIN:
 result[i] = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float[] buf : buffers) {
 result[i] = Math.min(result[i], buf[i]);
 }
 break;
 }
 }
 future.complete(result);
 }
 }

 public void broadcast(float[] data) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 sendPool.submit(() -> {
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.BROADCAST.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(data.length * 4);
 for (float val : data) {
 out.writeFloat(val);
 }
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Broadcast to rank " + peerRank + " failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 });
 }
 }

 private void handleBroadcast(int fromRank, byte[] data) {
 float[] received = new float[data.length / 4];
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
 for (int i = 0; i < received.length; i++) {
 received[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 if (rank != 0) {
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 if (peerRank != fromRank) {
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.BROADCAST.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(data.length);
 out.write(data);
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Broadcast forward failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public void scatter(float[][] data, int[] sizes) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 
 int offset = 0;
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 int size = sizes[peerRank];
 float[] chunk = new float[size];
 System.arraycopy(data[0], offset, chunk, 0, size);
 offset += size;
 
 sendPool.submit(() -> {
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.SCATTER.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(4 + chunk.length * 4);
 out.writeInt(chunk.length);
 for (float val : chunk) {
 out.writeFloat(val);
 }
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Scatter to rank " + peerRank + " failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 });
 }
 }

 private void handleScatter(int fromRank, byte[] data) {
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
 int size = buffer.getInt();
 float[] chunk = new float[size];
 for (int i = 0; i < chunk.length; i++) {
 chunk[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 synchronized (this) {
 pendingRequests.put(fromRank, CompletableFuture.completedFuture(chunk));
 }
 }

 public float[] gather(float[] data) {
 if (worldSize == 1) return data;
 
 float[][] allData = new float[worldSize][data.length];
 System.arraycopy(data, 0, allData[rank], 0, data.length);
 
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 try {
 DataOutputStream out = peerOutputStreams.get(peerRank);
 if (out != null) {
 out.writeInt(MessageType.GATHER.ordinal());
 out.writeInt(data.length * 4);
 for (float val : data) {
 out.writeFloat(val);
 }
 out.flush();
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Gather to rank " + peerRank + " failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 for (int peerRank : peerSockets.keySet()) {
 CompletableFuture<float[]> future = new CompletableFuture<>();
 pendingRequests.put(peerRank + 1000, future);
 
 try {
 float[] peerData = future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 System.arraycopy(peerData, 0, allData[peerRank], 0, peerData.length);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Distributed] Gather from rank " + peerRank + " failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[data.length * worldSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 System.arraycopy(allData[i], 0, result, i * data.length, data.length);
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 private void handleGather(int fromRank, byte[] data) {
 float[] received = new float[data.length / 4];
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data);
 for (int i = 0; i < received.length; i++) {
 received[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 synchronized (this) {
 pendingRequests.put(fromRank + 1000, CompletableFuture.completedFuture(received));
 }
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 
 for (Socket socket : peerSockets.values()) {
 try {
 socket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {}
 }
 
 if (serverSocket != null) {
 try {
 serverSocket.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {}
 }
 
 sendPool.shutdown();
 receivePool.shutdown();
 heartbeatScheduler.shutdown();
 
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Communication layer shutdown");
 }

 public int getRank() {
 return rank;
 }

 public int getWorldSize() {
 return worldSize;
 }

 public boolean isPeerConnected(int peerRank) {
 return peerSockets.containsKey(peerRank);
 }

 public int getFailureCount(int peerRank) {
 return failureCount.getOrDefault(peerRank, 0);
 }

 public enum MessageType {
 HEARTBEAT,
 ALL_REDUCE_REQUEST,
 ALL_REDUCE_RESPONSE,
 BROADCAST,
 SCATTER,
 GATHER
 }

 public enum ReduceOp {
 SUM,
 AVG,
 MAX,
 MIN
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.Optimizer;

import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class DistributedOptimizer {

 private final Optimizer baseOptimizer;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final int rank;
 private final ExecutorService syncService;
 private final List<Future<?>> pendingFutures;
 private final AtomicInteger pendingCount;
 private final String[] hostnames;
 private final int basePort;
 private ServerSocket serverSocket;
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, Socket> connectionCache;

 public DistributedOptimizer(Optimizer baseOptimizer, int worldSize, int rank) {
 this(baseOptimizer, worldSize, rank, "localhost", 23456);
 }

 public DistributedOptimizer(Optimizer baseOptimizer, int worldSize, int rank, String hostname, int basePort) {
 this.baseOptimizer = baseOptimizer;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.basePort = basePort;
 this.hostnames = new String[worldSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 hostnames[i] = hostname;
 }
 this.syncService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(worldSize * 2);
 this.pendingFutures = new ArrayList<>();
 this.pendingCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
 this.connectionCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 if (worldSize > 1) {
 startServer();
 establishConnections();
 }
 }

 private void startServer() {
 try {
 serverSocket = new ServerSocket(basePort + rank);
 syncService.submit(() -> {
 while (!serverSocket.isClosed()) {
 try {
 Socket clientSocket = serverSocket.accept();
 DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(clientSocket.getInputStream());
 int sourceRank = dis.readInt();
 connectionCache.put(sourceRank, clientSocket);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 if (!serverSocket.isClosed()) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }
 }
 });
 Thread.sleep(500);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to start server on port " + (basePort + rank), e);
 }
 }

 private void establishConnections() {
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 if (i != rank) {
 int target = i;
 syncService.submit(() -> {
 try {
 Socket socket = new Socket(hostnames[target], basePort + target);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(rank);
 connectionCache.put(target, socket);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to connect to rank " + target, e);
 }
 });
 }
 }
 try {
 Thread.sleep(1000);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }

 public void update(float[] weights, float[] gradients) {
 if (worldSize > 1) {
 allReduce(gradients);
 }
 baseOptimizer.update(weights, gradients);
 }

 public void update(float[][] weights, float[][] gradients) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 update(weights[i], gradients[i]);
 }
 }

 private void allReduce(float[] gradients) {
 if (worldSize <= 1) return;

 float[] totalGradients = new float[gradients.length];
 System.arraycopy(gradients, 0, totalGradients, 0, gradients.length);

 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 if (i != rank) {
 int source = i;
 pendingFutures.add(syncService.submit(() -> {
 float[] received = receiveGradientsFrom(source);
 for (int j = 0; j < gradients.length; j++) {
 totalGradients[j] += received[j];
 }
 }));
 pendingCount.incrementAndGet();
 }
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 if (i != rank) {
 int target = i;
 float[] toSend = gradients.clone();
 pendingFutures.add(syncService.submit(() -> {
 sendGradientsTo(target, toSend);
 }));
 pendingCount.incrementAndGet();
 }
 }

 waitForPending();

 float invWorldSize = 1.0f / worldSize;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 gradients[i] = totalGradients[i] * invWorldSize;
 }
 }

 private float[] receiveGradientsFrom(int sourceRank) {
 try {
 Socket socket = connectionCache.get(sourceRank);
 if (socket == null || socket.isClosed()) {
 socket = new Socket(hostnames[sourceRank], basePort + sourceRank);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(rank);
 connectionCache.put(sourceRank, socket);
 }
 
 DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(socket.getInputStream());
 int length = dis.readInt();
 float[] gradients = new float[length];
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 gradients[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 return gradients;
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to receive gradients from rank " + sourceRank, e);
 }
 }

 private void sendGradientsTo(int targetRank, float[] gradients) {
 try {
 Socket socket = connectionCache.get(targetRank);
 if (socket == null || socket.isClosed()) {
 socket = new Socket(hostnames[targetRank], basePort + targetRank);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(rank);
 connectionCache.put(targetRank, socket);
 }
 
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(gradients.length);
 for (float grad : gradients) {
 dos.writeFloat(grad);
 }
 dos.flush();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to send gradients to rank " + targetRank, e);
 }
 }

 public void waitForPending() {
 for (Future<?> future : pendingFutures) {
 try {
 future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (InterruptedException | ExecutionException | TimeoutException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Distributed sync failed", e);
 }
 }
 pendingFutures.clear();
 pendingCount.set(0);
 }

 public void broadcastWeights(float[] weights) {
 if (worldSize <= 1) return;
 
 if (rank == 0) {
 for (int i = 1; i < worldSize; i++) {
 int target = i;
 float[] toSend = weights.clone();
 pendingFutures.add(syncService.submit(() -> {
 sendWeightsTo(target, toSend);
 }));
 }
 } else {
 float[] received = receiveWeightsFrom(0);
 System.arraycopy(received, 0, weights, 0, weights.length);
 }
 waitForPending();
 }

 private float[] receiveWeightsFrom(int sourceRank) {
 try {
 Socket socket = connectionCache.get(sourceRank);
 if (socket == null || socket.isClosed()) {
 socket = new Socket(hostnames[sourceRank], basePort + sourceRank);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(rank);
 connectionCache.put(sourceRank, socket);
 }
 
 DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(socket.getInputStream());
 int length = dis.readInt();
 float[] weights = new float[length];
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 weights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 return weights;
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to receive weights from rank " + sourceRank, e);
 }
 }

 private void sendWeightsTo(int targetRank, float[] weights) {
 try {
 Socket socket = connectionCache.get(targetRank);
 if (socket == null || socket.isClosed()) {
 socket = new Socket(hostnames[targetRank], basePort + targetRank);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(rank);
 connectionCache.put(targetRank, socket);
 }
 
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
 dos.writeInt(weights.length);
 for (float w : weights) {
 dos.writeFloat(w);
 }
 dos.flush();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to send weights to rank " + targetRank, e);
 }
 }

 public float getCurrentLearningRate() {
 return baseOptimizer.getCurrentLearningRate();
 }

 public float getBaseLearningRate() {
 return baseOptimizer.getBaseLearningRate();
 }

 public float getWeightDecay() {
 return baseOptimizer.getWeightDecay();
 }

 public float getMomentum() {
 return baseOptimizer.getMomentum();
 }

 public float getGradClip() {
 return baseOptimizer.getGradClip();
 }

 public int getWorldSize() {
 return worldSize;
 }

 public int getRank() {
 return rank;
 }

 public void shutdown() {
 for (Socket socket : connectionCache.values()) {
 try {
 socket.close();
 } catch (IOException ignored) {}
 }
 connectionCache.clear();
 
 if (serverSocket != null) {
 try {
 serverSocket.close();
 } catch (IOException ignored) {}
 }
 
 syncService.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!syncService.awaitTermination(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 syncService.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 syncService.shutdownNow();
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }

 public boolean isMaster() {
 return rank == 0;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.Optimizer;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public class DistributedTrainingFramework {

 private final ClusterManager clusterManager;
 private final DataParallelStrategy dataParallel;
 private final ModelParallelStrategy modelParallel;
 private final AutoBalancer loadBalancer;
 private final FaultTolerance tolerance;
 private final CommunicationLayer commLayer;
 
 private ExecutorService workerPool;
 private AtomicBoolean running;
 private AtomicInteger epochCounter;

 public DistributedTrainingFramework() {
 this.clusterManager = new ClusterManager();
 this.dataParallel = new DataParallelStrategy();
 this.modelParallel = new ModelParallelStrategy();
 this.loadBalancer = new AutoBalancer();
 this.tolerance = new FaultTolerance();
 this.commLayer = new CommunicationLayer();
 
 this.running = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 this.epochCounter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 }

 public void initialize(int numWorkers, String[] hosts) {
 clusterManager.initialize(numWorkers, hosts);
 commLayer.initialize(clusterManager.getWorkers());
 workerPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(numWorkers);
 System.out.println("[Distributed] Initialized with " + numWorkers + " workers");
 }

 public void train(Dataset dataset, SimpCoreModel model, Optimizer optimizer,
 int epochs, int batchSize) {
 
 running.set(true);
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs && running.get(); epoch++) {
 epochCounter.set(epoch);
 
 List<Future<TrainingResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Dataset> shards = dataParallel.distribute(dataset, clusterManager.getWorkerCount());
 
 for (int i = 0; i < clusterManager.getWorkerCount(); i++) {
 final int workerId = i;
 final Dataset shard = shards.get(i);
 
 futures.add(workerPool.submit(() -> {
 return trainOnWorker(workerId, model, optimizer, shard, batchSize);
 }));
 }
 
 TrainingResult aggregated = aggregateResults(futures);
 updateGlobalModel(model, aggregated);
 
 loadBalancer.rebalance(clusterManager, aggregated);
 
 if (epoch % 10 == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[Distributed] Epoch %d: Loss = %.6f, Perplexity = %.2f%n",
 epoch, aggregated.averageLoss, aggregated.perplexity);
 }
 }
 
 running.set(false);
 }

 private TrainingResult trainOnWorker(int workerId, SimpCoreModel model, 
 Optimizer optimizer, Dataset dataset, int batchSize) {
 float totalLoss = 0;
 int totalTokens = 0;
 
 try {
 for (int i = 0; i < dataset.size(); i += batchSize) {
 int end = Math.min(i + batchSize, dataset.size());
 Dataset batch = dataset.slice(i, end);
 
 float loss = computeBatchLoss(model, batch);
 totalLoss += loss;
 totalTokens += batch.size();
 
 float[] gradients = computeGradients(model, batch);
 commLayer.allReduce(gradients, CommunicationLayer.ReduceOp.AVG);
 
 optimizer.update(model.getOutputWeights(), gradients);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 tolerance.handleFailure(workerId, e);
 throw new RuntimeException("Worker " + workerId + " failed", e);
 }
 
 float avgLoss = totalLoss / (dataset.size() / (float) batchSize);
 float perplexity = (float) Math.exp(avgLoss);
 
 return new TrainingResult(avgLoss, perplexity, workerId);
 }

 private float computeBatchLoss(SimpCoreModel model, Dataset batch) {
 float totalLoss = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < batch.size(); i++) {
 float[] input = batch.getData().get(i);
 int target = batch.getLabels().get(i);
 
 float[] logits = model.forward(input);
 
 float maxLogit = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float logit : logits) {
 if (logit > maxLogit) maxLogit = logit;
 }
 
 float sumExp = 0;
 for (float logit : logits) {
 sumExp += (float) Math.exp(logit - maxLogit);
 }
 
 float loss = maxLogit + (float) Math.log(sumExp) - logits[target];
 totalLoss += loss;
 }
 
 return totalLoss / batch.size();
 }

 private float[] computeGradients(SimpCoreModel model, Dataset batch) {
 int paramCount = model.getOutputWeights().length;
 float[] gradients = new float[paramCount];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < batch.size(); i++) {
 float[] input = batch.getData().get(i);
 int target = batch.getLabels().get(i);
 
 float[] logits = model.forward(input);
 
 float maxLogit = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (float logit : logits) {
 if (logit > maxLogit) maxLogit = logit;
 }
 
 float sumExp = 0;
 float[] expLogits = new float[logits.length];
 for (int j = 0; j < logits.length; j++) {
 expLogits[j] = (float) Math.exp(logits[j] - maxLogit);
 sumExp += expLogits[j];
 }
 
 for (int j = 0; j < logits.length; j++) {
 float grad = expLogits[j] / sumExp;
 if (j == target) {
 grad -= 1.0f;
 }
 
 for (int k = 0; k < input.length; k++) {
 int idx = j * input.length + k;
 if (idx < gradients.length) {
 gradients[idx] += grad * input[k];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
