 float[][] matrix = new float[rows][cols];
 long bytes = (long) rows * cols * Float.BYTES;
 allocatedBytes.addAndGet(bytes);
 updatePeak();
 return matrix;
 }

 public void release(float[] array) {
 if (array != null) {
 long bytes = (long) array.length * Float.BYTES;
 allocatedBytes.addAndGet(-bytes);
 }
 }

 public void cacheArray(String key, float[] data) {
 if (cachedArrays.containsKey(key)) {
 releaseCached(key);
 }
 cachedArrays.put(key, data.clone());
 arraySizes.put(key, (long) data.length * Float.BYTES);
 allocatedBytes.addAndGet((long) data.length * Float.BYTES);
 updatePeak();
 }

 public float[] getCachedArray(String key) {
 float[] data = cachedArrays.get(key);
 return data != null ? data.clone() : null;
 }

 public void releaseCached(String key) {
 Long size = arraySizes.remove(key);
 if (size != null) {
 allocatedBytes.addAndGet(-size);
 }
 cachedArrays.remove(key);
 }

 public void clearCache() {
 for (String key : cachedArrays.keySet()) {
 releaseCached(key);
 }
 }

 public MemoryStats getStats() {
 return new MemoryStats(
 allocatedBytes.get(),
 peakBytes.get(),
 Runtime.getRuntime().totalMemory(),
 Runtime.getRuntime().freeMemory(),
 cachedArrays.size()
 );
 }

 private void updatePeak() {
 long current = allocatedBytes.get();
 long peak = peakBytes.get();
 while (current > peak) {
 if (peakBytes.compareAndSet(peak, current)) {
 break;
 }
 peak = peakBytes.get();
 }
 }

 public void resetStats() {
 allocatedBytes.set(0);
 peakBytes.set(0);
 }

 public record MemoryStats(
 long allocatedBytes,
 long peakBytes,
 long totalMemory,
 long freeMemory,
 int cachedSegments
 ) {
 public long usedMemory() {
 return totalMemory - freeMemory;
 }

 public double utilizationPercent() {
 return (double) usedMemory() / totalMemory * 100;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public final class MemoryOptimizer {

 private static final MemoryOptimizer INSTANCE = new MemoryOptimizer();
 
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[]>> floatArrayPool;
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[][]>> floatMatrixPool;
 private final AtomicInteger allocations;
 private final AtomicInteger poolHits;
 private final int maxPoolSize;

 private MemoryOptimizer() {
 this.floatArrayPool = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.floatMatrixPool = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.allocations = new AtomicInteger(0);
 this.poolHits = new AtomicInteger(0);
 this.maxPoolSize = 1000;
 }

 public static MemoryOptimizer getInstance() {
 return INSTANCE;
 }

 public float[] allocateFloatArray(int size) {
 allocations.incrementAndGet();
 ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[]> pool = floatArrayPool.computeIfAbsent(size, k -> new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>());
 
 float[] array = pool.poll();
 if (array != null) {
 poolHits.incrementAndGet();
 return array;
 }
 
 return new float[size];
 }

 public void releaseFloatArray(float[] array) {
 if (array == null) return;
 
 ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[]> pool = floatArrayPool.get(array.length);
 if (pool != null && pool.size() < maxPoolSize) {
 for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
 array[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 pool.offer(array);
 }
 }

 public float[][] allocateFloatMatrix(int rows, int cols) {
 allocations.incrementAndGet();
 int key = rows * 10000 + cols;
 ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[][]> pool = floatMatrixPool.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>());
 
 float[][] matrix = pool.poll();
 if (matrix != null) {
 poolHits.incrementAndGet();
 return matrix;
 }
 
 return new float[rows][cols];
 }

 public void releaseFloatMatrix(float[][] matrix) {
 if (matrix == null) return;
 
 int rows = matrix.length;
 int cols = rows > 0 ? matrix[0].length : 0;
 int key = rows * 10000 + cols;
 
 ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[][]> pool = floatMatrixPool.get(key);
 if (pool != null && pool.size() < maxPoolSize) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < cols; j++) {
 matrix[i][j] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 pool.offer(matrix);
 }
 }

 public float[] allocateAligned(int size) {
 return allocateFloatArray(size);
 }

 public void releaseAligned(float[] array) {
 releaseFloatArray(array);
 }

 public float[] copyAndRelease(float[] source) {
 if (source == null) return null;
 
 float[] copy = allocateFloatArray(source.length);
 System.arraycopy(source, 0, copy, 0, source.length);
 releaseFloatArray(source);
 
 return copy;
 }

 public void clearPool(int size) {
 floatArrayPool.remove(size);
 }

 public void clearAllPools() {
 floatArrayPool.clear();
 floatMatrixPool.clear();
 }

 public MemoryStats getStats() {
 int totalPooled = 0;
 for (ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[]> pool : floatArrayPool.values()) {
 totalPooled += pool.size();
 }
 for (ConcurrentLinkedQueue<float[][]> pool : floatMatrixPool.values()) {
 totalPooled += pool.size();
 }
 
 int totalAllocations = allocations.get();
 int hits = poolHits.get();
 double hitRate = totalAllocations > 0 ? (double) hits / totalAllocations * 100 : 0;
 
 return new MemoryStats(totalAllocations, hits, hitRate, totalPooled);
 }

 public void resetStats() {
 allocations.set(0);
 poolHits.set(0);
 }

 public record MemoryStats(
 int totalAllocations,
 int poolHits,
 double hitRatePercent,
 int totalPooledObjects
 ) {}

 public static class ScopedFloatArray implements AutoCloseable {
 private final float[] array;
 
 public ScopedFloatArray(int size) {
 this.array = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance().allocateFloatArray(size);
 }
 
 public float[] get() {
 return array;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void close() {
 MemoryOptimizer.getInstance().releaseFloatArray(array);
 }
 }

 public static class ScopedFloatMatrix implements AutoCloseable {
 private final float[][] matrix;
 
 public ScopedFloatMatrix(int rows, int cols) {
 this.matrix = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance().allocateFloatMatrix(rows, cols);
 }
 
 public float[][] get() {
 return matrix;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void close() {
 MemoryOptimizer.getInstance().releaseFloatMatrix(matrix);
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

public class ACTModule {
 private float[] haltingWeight;
 private float[] haltingBias;
 private int dim;
 private float threshold;
 
 public ACTModule(int dim, float threshold) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.threshold = threshold;
 initWeights();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 haltingWeight = new float[dim];
 haltingBias = new float[1];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 haltingWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 / dim;
 }
 haltingBias[0] = 0.0f;
 }
 
 public float computeHaltingProbability(float[] hiddenState) {
 float logit = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(haltingWeight, hiddenState) + haltingBias[0];
 return sigmoid(logit);
 }
 
 private float sigmoid(float x) {
 if (x > 0) {
 return 1.0f / (1.0f + (float) Math.exp(-x));
 } else {
 float expX = (float) Math.exp(x);
 return expX / (1.0f + expX);
 }
 }
 
 public int determineLoopCount(float[] initialState) {
 float[] h = initialState;
 float haltingCumulative = 0.0f;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < 100; t++) {
 float p = computeHaltingProbability(h);
 haltingCumulative += p;
 
 if (haltingCumulative >= threshold) {
 return t + 1;
 }
 
 h = MatrixOperations.relu(h);
 }
 
 return 100;
 }
 
 public float computePenalty(int actualLoops, float[] finalState) {
 float p = computeHaltingProbability(finalState);
 float remaining = Math.max(0, threshold - p);
 return (float) (remaining * actualLoops * 0.01);
 }
 
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < haltingWeight.length; i++) {
 haltingWeight[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * learningRate;
 }
 haltingBias[0] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * learningRate;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

public class DeepWiseLoRA {
 private int dim;
 private int rank;
 private float scaling;
 
 private float[] loraA;
 private float[] loraB;
 
 private float[] loraA_grad;
 private float[] loraB_grad;
 
 private float learningRate;
 private float[] loraA_m;
 private float[] loraA_v;
 private float[] loraB_m;
 private float[] loraB_v;
 private float beta1;
 private float beta2;
 private float epsilon;
 
 public DeepWiseLoRA(int dim, int rank) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.scaling = (float) rank;
 this.learningRate = 3e-4f;
 this.beta1 = 0.9f;
 this.beta2 = 0.999f;
 this.epsilon = 1e-8f;
 
 initWeights();
 initOptimizer();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(rank));
 loraA = new float[dim * rank];
 loraB = new float[rank * dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * rank; i++) {
 loraA[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < rank * dim; i++) {
 loraB[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 
 loraA_grad = new float[dim * rank];
 loraB_grad = new float[rank * dim];
 }
 
 private void initOptimizer() {
 loraA_m = new float[dim * rank];
 loraA_v = new float[dim * rank];
 loraB_m = new float[rank * dim];
 loraB_v = new float[rank * dim];
 }
 
 public float[] apply(float[] x) {
 float[] intermediate = new float[rank];
 for (int r = 0; r < rank; r++) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 sum += x[i] * loraA[i * rank + r];
 }
 intermediate[r] = sum;
 }
 
 float[] delta = new float[dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (int r = 0; r < rank; r++) {
 sum += intermediate[r] * loraB[r * dim + i];
 }
 delta[i] = sum * scaling;
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 result[i] = x[i] + delta[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public void update(float[] grad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rank; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 loraB_grad[i * dim + j] += grad[j];
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < rank; j++) {
 float gradSum = 0.0f;
 for (int k = 0; k < dim; k++) {
 gradSum += grad[k] * loraB[j * dim + k];
 }
 loraA_grad[i * rank + j] += gradSum * scaling;
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void step() {
 adamStep(loraA, loraA_grad, loraA_m, loraA_v);
 adamStep(loraB, loraB_grad, loraB_m, loraB_v);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < loraA_grad.length; i++) {
 loraA_grad[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < loraB_grad.length; i++) {
 loraB_grad[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 
 private void adamStep(float[] params, float[] grads, float[] m, float[] v) {
 for (int i = 0; i < params.length; i++) {
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1 - beta1) * grads[i];
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1 - beta2) * grads[i] * grads[i];
 
 float mHat = m[i] / (1 - beta1);
 float vHat = v[i] / (1 - beta2);
 
 params[i] -= learningRate * mHat / (float) (Math.sqrt(vHat) + epsilon);
 }
 }
 
 public long countParameters() {
 return (long) dim * rank * 2;
 }
 
 public int getRank() {
 return rank;
 }
 
 public void setLearningRate(float lr) {
 this.learningRate = lr;
 }
 
 public float getScaling() {
 return scaling;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

public class LTIInjection {
 private float[] A;
 private float[] B;
 private int dim;
 private float spectralBound;
 
 public LTIInjection(int dim, float spectralBound) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.spectralBound = spectralBound;
 initWeights();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 A = new float[dim * dim];
 B = new float[dim * dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 A[i * dim + j] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 / dim;
 B[i * dim + j] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 / dim;
 }
 }
 
 enforceSpectralBound();
 }
 
 private void enforceSpectralBound() {
 float[] Atemp = new float[dim * dim];
 System.arraycopy(A, 0, Atemp, 0, A.length);
 
 float spectralNorm = estimateSpectralNorm(Atemp);
 float scale = spectralBound / spectralNorm;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
 A[i] *= scale;
 }
 }
 
 private float estimateSpectralNorm(float[] mat) {
 float[] v = new float[dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 v[i] = (float) Math.random();
 }
 
 float norm = (float) Math.sqrt(MatrixOperations.dotProduct(v, v));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 v[i] /= norm;
 }
 
 for (int iter = 0; iter < 20; iter++) {
 float[] Av = MatrixOperations.matmul(A, v, dim, dim, 1);
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(MatrixOperations.dotProduct(Av, Av));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 v[i] = Av[i] / norm;
 }
 }
 
 return norm;
 }
 
 public float[] inject(float[] h, float[] e) {
 float[] Ah = MatrixOperations.matmul(A, h, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] Be = MatrixOperations.matmul(B, e, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 result[i] = Ah[i] + Be[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public float[] getA() {
 return A;
 }
 
 public float[] getB() {
 return B;
 }
 
 public float getSpectralRadius() {
 return estimateSpectralNorm(A);
 }
 
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < A.length; i++) {
 A[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * learningRate;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < B.length; i++) {
 B[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * learningRate;
 }
 enforceSpectralBound();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

public class MLAAttention {
 private int dim;
 private int nHeads;
 private int headDim;
 private int kvRank;
 private int compressionRatio;
 
 private float[] qWeight;
 private float[] kWeight;
 private float[] vWeight;
 private float[] oWeight;
 
 private float[] kDownWeight;
 private float[] vDownWeight;
 private float[] kUpWeight;
 private float[] vUpWeight;
 
 private float[] cachedK;
 private float[] cachedV;
 private int cacheSize;
 private int currentCachePos;
 
 public MLAAttention(int dim, int nHeads, int kvRank, int maxCacheSize) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.headDim = dim / nHeads;
 this.kvRank = kvRank;
 this.compressionRatio = headDim / kvRank;
 
 this.cacheSize = maxCacheSize;
 this.currentCachePos = 0;
 
 initWeights();
 initCache();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dim));
 
 qWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 kWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 vWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 oWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 
 kDownWeight = new float[dim * kvRank];
 vDownWeight = new float[dim * kvRank];
 kUpWeight = new float[kvRank * dim];
 vUpWeight = new float[kvRank * dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * dim; i++) {
 qWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 kWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 vWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 oWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 float loraScale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(kvRank));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * kvRank; i++) {
 kDownWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * loraScale;
 vDownWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * loraScale;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < kvRank * dim; i++) {
 kUpWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * loraScale;
 vUpWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * loraScale;
 }
 }
 
 private void initCache() {
 int compressedDim = nHeads * kvRank;
 cachedK = new float[cacheSize * compressedDim];
 cachedV = new float[cacheSize * compressedDim];
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] x) {
 float[] q = matmul(qWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] k = matmul(kWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] v = matmul(vWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 
 float[] compressedK = compressKV(k, kDownWeight, kUpWeight);
 float[] compressedV = compressKV(v, vDownWeight, vUpWeight);
 
 addToCache(compressedK, compressedV);
 
 float[] output = attention(q, compressedK, compressedV);
 
 return matmul(oWeight, output, dim, dim, 1);
 }
 
 private float[] compressKV(float[] x, float[] downWeight, float[] upWeight) {
 float[] down = matmul(downWeight, x, kvRank, dim, 1);
 
 down = applyGelu(down);
 
 float[] up = matmul(upWeight, down, dim, kvRank, 1);
 
 return up;
 }
 
 private float[] attention(float[] q, float[] k, float[] v) {
 float[] output = new float[dim];
 
 int compressedDim = nHeads * kvRank;
 int effectiveCacheSize = currentCachePos;
 
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] qh = new float[headDim];
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 qh[i] = q[h * headDim + i];
 }
 
 float[] scores = new float[effectiveCacheSize];
 float maxScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < effectiveCacheSize; t++) {
 float score = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < kvRank; i++) {
 float ki = k[t * compressedDim + h * kvRank + i];
 float qi = qh[i];
 score += ki * qi;
 }
 score /= (float) Math.sqrt(kvRank);
 scores[t] = score;
 if (score > maxScore) maxScore = score;
 }
 
 float[] probs = new float[effectiveCacheSize];
 float sumProbs = 0.0f;
 for (int t = 0; t < effectiveCacheSize; t++) {
 probs[t] = (float) Math.exp(scores[t] - maxScore);
 sumProbs += probs[t];
 }
 for (int t = 0; t < effectiveCacheSize; t++) {
 probs[t] /= sumProbs;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 float val = 0.0f;
 for (int t = 0; t < effectiveCacheSize; t++) {
 float vi = v[t * compressedDim + h * kvRank + Math.min(i, kvRank - 1)];
 val += probs[t] * vi;
 }
 output[h * headDim + i] = val;
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 private void addToCache(float[] k, float[] v) {
 int compressedDim = nHeads * kvRank;
 
 if (currentCachePos < cacheSize) {
 System.arraycopy(k, 0, cachedK, currentCachePos * compressedDim, compressedDim);
 System.arraycopy(v, 0, cachedV, currentCachePos * compressedDim, compressedDim);
 currentCachePos++;
 } else {
 System.arraycopy(cachedK, compressedDim, cachedK, 0, (cacheSize - 1) * compressedDim);
 System.arraycopy(cachedV, compressedDim, cachedV, 0, (cacheSize - 1) * compressedDim);
 System.arraycopy(k, 0, cachedK, (cacheSize - 1) * compressedDim, compressedDim);
 System.arraycopy(v, 0, cachedV, (cacheSize - 1) * compressedDim, compressedDim);
 }
 }
 
 private float[] matmul(float[] w, float[] x, int outDim, int inDim, int batch) {
 float[] result = new float[outDim * batch];
 for (int b = 0; b < batch; b++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < outDim; i++) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < inDim; j++) {
 sum += w[i * inDim + j] * x[b * inDim + j];
 }
 result[b * outDim + i] = sum;
 }
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] applyGelu(float[] x) {
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = x[i] * 0.5f * (1.0f + (float) Math.tanh(Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI) * (x[i] + 0.044715f * x[i] * x[i] * x[i])));
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 public long getOriginalCacheSize(int seqLen) {
 return (long) seqLen * nHeads * headDim * 2;
 }
 
 public long getCompressedCacheSize(int seqLen) {
 return (long) seqLen * nHeads * kvRank * 2;
 }
 
 public int getCompressionRatio() {
 return compressionRatio;
 }
 
 public void clearCache() {
 currentCachePos = 0;
 }
 
 public long countParameters() {
 long params = 0;
 params += (long) dim * dim * 4;
 params += (long) dim * kvRank * 4;
 return params;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

/**
 * MoE (Mixture of Experts) Layer - 多专家堆叠架构
 * 实现路由层和集成层
 */
public class MoELayer {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nExperts;
 private final int topK; // 每个token选择的专家数
 
 // 专家模型
 private TransformerBlock[] experts;
 
 // 路由参数
 private float[] routerWeight; // [dModel, nExperts]
 private float[] routerBias; // [nExperts]
 
 // GPU加速
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 // 缓存
 private float[][] routerLogits;
 private float[][] routerWeights;
 private int[][] expertAssignments;
 
 public MoELayer(int dModel, int nHeads, int nExperts, int topK) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.topK = topK;
 initExperts(nHeads);
 initRouter();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 private void initExperts(int nHeads) {
 experts = new TransformerBlock[nExperts];
 for (int i = 0; i < nExperts; i++) {
 experts[i] = new TransformerBlock(dModel, nHeads);
 }
 }
 
 private void initRouter() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 routerWeight = new float[dModel * nExperts];
 routerBias = new float[nExperts];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * nExperts; i++) {
 routerWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = OpenCLAccelerator.getInstance();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播
 * @param x 输入 [seqLen, dModel]
 * @return 输出 [seqLen, dModel]
 */
 public float[][] forward(float[][] x) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 
 // 计算路由logits
 routerLogits = new float[seqLen][nExperts];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 float[] logits = matvec(routerWeight, x[t], nExperts, dModel);
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 routerLogits[t][e] = logits[e] + routerBias[e];
 }
 }
 
 // 选择topK专家并计算权重
 routerWeights = new float[seqLen][nExperts];
 expertAssignments = new int[seqLen][topK];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 找出topK专家
 int[] indices = new int[nExperts];
 for (int i = 0; i < nExperts; i++) indices[i] = i;
 
 // 选择排序
 for (int i = 0; i < topK; i++) {
 int maxIdx = i;
 for (int j = i + 1; j < nExperts; j++) {
 if (routerLogits[t][j] > routerLogits[t][maxIdx]) {
 maxIdx = j;
 }
 }
 int temp = indices[i];
 indices[i] = indices[maxIdx];
 indices[maxIdx] = temp;
 }
 
 // 保存topK专家索引
 for (int i = 0; i < topK; i++) {
 expertAssignments[t][i] = indices[i];
 }
 
 // 计算softmax权重（只在topK专家上）
 float maxLogit = routerLogits[t][indices[0]];
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < topK; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(routerLogits[t][indices[i]] - maxLogit);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < topK; i++) {
 routerWeights[t][indices[i]] = (float) Math.exp(routerLogits[t][indices[i]] - maxLogit) / sum;
 }
 }
 
 // 专家前向传播
 float[][][] expertOutputs = new float[nExperts][][];
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 expertOutputs[e] = experts[e].forward(x);
 }
 
 // 集成专家输出
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 int expertIdx = expertAssignments[t][k];
 result[t][i] += routerWeights[t][expertIdx] * expertOutputs[expertIdx][t][i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public float[][] backward(float[][] dOutput) {
 int seqLen = dOutput.length;
 
 // 专家反向传播
 float[][] dInput = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 // 计算该专家的梯度
 float[][] dExpert = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int k = 0; k < topK; k++) {
 if (expertAssignments[t][k] == e) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dExpert[t][i] += routerWeights[t][e] * dOutput[t][i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 // 专家反向传播
 float[][] dExpertInput = experts[e].backward(dExpert);
 
 // 累加梯度
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dInput[t][i] += dExpertInput[t][i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 // 路由梯度（简化版）
 return dInput;
 }
 
 private float[] matvec(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N) {
 if (useGPU && gpu != null) {
 return gpu.matvec(A, x, M, N);
 }
 float[] y = new float[M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 y[i] += A[i * N + j] * x[j];
 }
 }
 return y;
 }
 
 public TransformerBlock[] getExperts() { return experts; }
 public float[] getRouterWeight() { return routerWeight; }
 public float[] getRouterBias() { return routerBias; }
 public int getNExperts() { return nExperts; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class ModelExportImport {
 
 public static class ModelData {
 String modelName;
 String architecture;
 int dModel;
 int nLayers;
 int nHeads;
 int vocabSize;
 long parameterCount;
 Map<String, float[]> weights;
 Map<String, float[]> biases;
 Map<String, Object> metadata;
 
 ModelData() {
 weights = new HashMap<>();
 biases = new HashMap<>();
 metadata = new HashMap<>();
 }
 }
 
 public static class ExportOptions {
 boolean includeWeights = true;
 boolean includeBiases = true;
 boolean includeMetadata = true;
 String format = "binary";
 float quantize = 0;
 
 public ExportOptions includeWeights(boolean val) { includeWeights = val; return this; }
 public ExportOptions includeBiases(boolean val) { includeBiases = val; return this; }
 public ExportOptions includeMetadata(boolean val) { includeMetadata = val; return this; }
 public ExportOptions format(String val) { format = val; return this; }
 public ExportOptions quantize(float bits) { quantize = bits; return this; }
 }
 
 public static boolean exportModel(ModelData model, String path, ExportOptions options) {
 try {
 FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(path);
 BufferedOutputStream bos = new BufferedOutputStream(fos);
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(bos);
 
 dos.writeUTF("SC_MODEL");
 dos.writeUTF(model.modelName);
 dos.writeUTF(model.architecture);
 dos.writeInt(model.dModel);
 dos.writeInt(model.nLayers);
 dos.writeInt(model.nHeads);
 dos.writeInt(model.vocabSize);
 dos.writeLong(model.parameterCount);
 
 if (options.includeMetadata) {
 dos.writeInt(model.metadata.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : model.metadata.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(entry.getKey());
 String valueStr = entry.getValue().toString();
 dos.writeUTF(valueStr);
 }
 } else {
 dos.writeInt(0);
 }
 
 if (options.includeWeights) {
 dos.writeInt(model.weights.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : model.weights.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(entry.getKey());
 float[] w = entry.getValue();
 dos.writeInt(w.length);
 for (float v : w) {
 dos.writeFloat(v);
 }
 }
 } else {
 dos.writeInt(0);
 }
 
 if (options.includeBiases) {
 dos.writeInt(model.biases.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : model.biases.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(entry.getKey());
 float[] b = entry.getValue();
 dos.writeInt(b.length);
 for (float v : b) {
 dos.writeFloat(v);
 }
 }
 } else {
 dos.writeInt(0);
 }
 
 dos.flush();
 dos.close();
 
 File file = new File(path);
 System.out.printf("Model exported successfully to %s (%.2f MB)%n", 
 path, file.length() / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
 return true;
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Failed to export model: " + e.getMessage());
 return false;
 }
 }
 
 public static ModelData importModel(String path) {
 try {
 FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(path);
 BufferedInputStream bis = new BufferedInputStream(fis);
 DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(bis);
 
 String magic = dis.readUTF();
 if (!"SC_MODEL".equals(magic)) {
 System.err.println("Invalid model file format");
 return null;
 }
 
 ModelData model = new ModelData();
 model.modelName = dis.readUTF();
 model.architecture = dis.readUTF();
 model.dModel = dis.readInt();
 model.nLayers = dis.readInt();
 model.nHeads = dis.readInt();
 model.vocabSize = dis.readInt();
 model.parameterCount = dis.readLong();
 
 int metaSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < metaSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 String value = dis.readUTF();
 model.metadata.put(key, value);
 }
 
 int weightsSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < weightsSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 int len = dis.readInt();
 float[] w = new float[len];
 for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
 w[j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 model.weights.put(key, w);
 }
 
 int biasesSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < biasesSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 int len = dis.readInt();
 float[] b = new float[len];
 for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
 b[j] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 model.biases.put(key, b);
 }
 
 dis.close();
 
 System.out.printf("Model imported successfully from %s%n", path);
 System.out.printf(" Name: %s%n", model.modelName);
 System.out.printf(" Architecture: %s%n", model.architecture);
 System.out.printf(" Parameters: %.2fM%n", model.parameterCount / 1_000_000.0);
 return model;
 
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("Failed to import model: " + e.getMessage());
 return null;
 }
 }
 
 public static ModelData createDummyModel(String name) {
 ModelData model = new ModelData();
 model.modelName = name;
 model.architecture = "SC-Transformer";
 model.dModel = 64;
 model.nLayers = 2;
 model.nHeads = 8;
 model.vocabSize = 35;
 
 Random r = new Random(42);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < model.nLayers; i++) {
 String prefix = "layer_" + i + "_";
 
 float[] w1 = new float[model.dModel * model.dModel];
 float[] b1 = new float[model.dModel];
 float[] w2 = new float[model.dModel * model.dModel];
 float[] b2 = new float[model.dModel];
 
 for (int j = 0; j < w1.length; j++) w1[j] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 for (int j = 0; j < b1.length; j++) b1[j] = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < w2.length; j++) w2[j] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 for (int j = 0; j < b2.length; j++) b2[j] = 0;
 
 model.weights.put(prefix + "attn_w", w1);
 model.biases.put(prefix + "attn_b", b1);
 model.weights.put(prefix + "ffn_w", w2);
 model.biases.put(prefix + "ffn_b", b2);
 }
 
 float[] embW = new float[model.vocabSize * model.dModel];
 float[] embB = new float[model.dModel];
 float[] outW = new float[model.dModel * model.vocabSize];
 float[] outB = new float[model.vocabSize];
 
 for (int j = 0; j < embW.length; j++) embW[j] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 for (int j = 0; j < embB.length; j++) embB[j] = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < outW.length; j++) outW[j] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 for (int j = 0; j < outB.length; j++) outB[j] = 0;
 
 model.weights.put("embedding_w", embW);
 model.biases.put("embedding_b", embB);
 model.weights.put("output_w", outW);
 model.biases.put("output_b", outB);
 
 long paramCount = 0;
 for (float[] w : model.weights.values()) paramCount += w.length;
 for (float[] b : model.biases.values()) paramCount += b.length;
 model.parameterCount = paramCount;
 
 model.metadata.put("created", new Date().toString());
 model.metadata.put("framework", "SC Architecture");
 model.metadata.put("version", "1.0");
 
 return model;
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC Architecture - Model Export/Import");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 String modelPath = "models/test-export.model";
 
 System.out.println("[1/3] Creating dummy model...");
 ModelData model = createDummyModel("Test-SC-Model");
 
 System.out.println("\n[2/3] Exporting model...");
 ExportOptions options = new ExportOptions()
 .includeWeights(true)
 .includeBiases(true)
 .includeMetadata(true)
 .format("binary");
 exportModel(model, modelPath, options);
 
 System.out.println("\n[3/3] Importing model...");
 ModelData imported = importModel(modelPath);
 
 if (imported != null) {
 System.out.println("\nModel verification:");
 System.out.printf(" Name matches: %s%n", imported.modelName.equals(model.modelName));
 System.out.printf(" Architecture matches: %s%n", imported.architecture.equals(model.architecture));
 System.out.printf(" Parameter count matches: %s%n", imported.parameterCount == model.parameterCount);
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Export/Import Complete!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class ModelManager {
 
 public static class ModelVersion {
 public final String versionId;
 public final long timestamp;
 public final String description;
 public final long paramCount;
 public final float accuracy;
 
 public ModelVersion(String versionId, long timestamp, String description, long paramCount, float accuracy) {
 this.versionId = versionId;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.description = description;
 this.paramCount = paramCount;
 this.accuracy = accuracy;
 }
 }
 
 public static class Checkpoint {
 public final String checkpointId;
 public final long timestamp;
 public final int epoch;
 public final float loss;
 public final float accuracy;
 public final String modelPath;
 
 public Checkpoint(String checkpointId, long timestamp, int epoch, float loss, float accuracy, String modelPath) {
 this.checkpointId = checkpointId;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.epoch = epoch;
 this.loss = loss;
 this.accuracy = accuracy;
 this.modelPath = modelPath;
 }
 }
 
 private final Map<String, Object> models;
 private final List<ModelVersion> versions;
 private final List<Checkpoint> checkpoints;
 private final String modelDir;
 private volatile String currentVersion;
 
 public ModelManager(String modelDir) {
 this.modelDir = modelDir;
 this.models = new HashMap<>();
 this.versions = new ArrayList<>();
 this.checkpoints = new ArrayList<>();
 this.currentVersion = "v1.0";
 new File(modelDir).mkdirs();
 loadVersions();
 }
 
 public ModelManager() {
 this("models");
 }
 
 public void saveModel(String name, Object model, String description) {
 try {
 File file = new File(modelDir, name + ".model");
 try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(file))) {
 oos.writeObject(model);
 }
 
 models.put(name, model);
 
 ModelVersion version = new ModelVersion(
 "v" + (versions.size() + 1),
 System.currentTimeMillis(),
 description,
 estimateParams(model),
 0.0f
 );
 versions.add(version);
 currentVersion = version.versionId;
 
 System.out.printf("[ModelManager] Saved model: %s (%d params)%n", name, version.paramCount);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[ModelManager] Save failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 public Object loadModel(String name) {
 if (models.containsKey(name)) {
 return models.get(name);
 }
 
 try {
 File file = new File(modelDir, name + ".model");
 if (!file.exists()) {
 return null;
 }
 
 try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(file))) {
 Object model = ois.readObject();
 models.put(name, model);
 return model;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[ModelManager] Load failed: " + e.getMessage());
 return null;
 }
 }
 
 public void saveCheckpoint(String name, Object model, int epoch, float loss, float accuracy) {
 String checkpointId = name + "_epoch_" + epoch + "_" + System.currentTimeMillis();
 String modelPath = modelDir + "/" + checkpointId + ".chkpt";
 
 try {
 try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(modelPath))) {
 oos.writeObject(model);
 }
 
 Checkpoint checkpoint = new Checkpoint(
 checkpointId,
 System.currentTimeMillis(),
 epoch,
 loss,
 accuracy,
 modelPath
 );
 checkpoints.add(checkpoint);
 
 System.out.printf("[ModelManager] Saved checkpoint: %s (epoch=%d, loss=%.4f)%n", 
 checkpointId, epoch, loss);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[ModelManager] Save checkpoint failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 public Object loadCheckpoint(String checkpointId) {
 for (Checkpoint cp : checkpoints) {
 if (cp.checkpointId.equals(checkpointId)) {
 try {
 File file = new File(cp.modelPath);
 if (!file.exists()) return null;
 
 try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(file))) {
 return ois.readObject();
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[ModelManager] Load checkpoint failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }
 return null;
 }
 
 public Checkpoint getLastCheckpoint(String name) {
 for (int i = checkpoints.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 if (checkpoints.get(i).checkpointId.startsWith(name)) {
 return checkpoints.get(i);
 }
 }
 return null;
 }
 
 public List<Checkpoint> listCheckpoints(String name) {
 List<Checkpoint> result = new ArrayList<>();
 for (Checkpoint cp : checkpoints) {
 if (cp.checkpointId.startsWith(name)) {
 result.add(cp);
 }
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 public List<ModelVersion> listVersions() {
 return new ArrayList<>(versions);
 }
 
 public ModelVersion getCurrentVersion() {
 for (ModelVersion v : versions) {
 if (v.versionId.equals(currentVersion)) {
 return v;
 }
 }
 return versions.isEmpty() ? null : versions.get(versions.size() - 1);
 }
 
 public void deleteModel(String name) {
 models.remove(name);
 File file = new File(modelDir, name + ".model");
 if (file.exists()) {
 file.delete();
 }
 }
 
 public void deleteCheckpoint(String checkpointId) {
 checkpoints.removeIf(cp -> cp.checkpointId.equals(checkpointId));
 File file = new File(modelDir, checkpointId + ".chkpt");
 if (file.exists()) {
 file.delete();
 }
 }
 
 public Set<String> listModels() {
 return models.keySet();
 }
 
 private long estimateParams(Object model) {
 return model != null ? model.toString().length() * 1000 : 0;
 }
 
 private void loadVersions() {
 versions.add(new ModelVersion("v1.0", System.currentTimeMillis(), "初始版本", 0, 0.0f));
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "ModelManager: models=%d, versions=%d, checkpoints=%d, current=%s",
 models.size(), versions.size(), checkpoints.size(), currentVersion
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

/**
 * Multi-Head Self-Attention层 - 真正的自注意力机制
 * 实现缩放点积注意力和多头并行计算
 */
public class MultiHeadAttention {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nHeads;
 private final int dHead;
 
 // 参数
 private float[] qWeight; // [dModel, dModel]
 private float[] qBias; // [dModel]
 private float[] kWeight; // [dModel, dModel]
 private float[] kBias; // [dModel]
 private float[] vWeight; // [dModel, dModel]
 private float[] vBias; // [dModel]
 private float[] oWeight; // [dModel, dModel]
 private float[] oBias; // [dModel]
 
 // GPU加速
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 // 缓存（用于反向传播）
 private float[][] q;
 private float[][] k;
 private float[][] v;
 private float[][] attention;
 private float[][] output;
 private float[][] input;
 
 public MultiHeadAttention(int dModel, int nHeads) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.dHead = dModel / nHeads;
 initWeights();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = OpenCLAccelerator.getInstance();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 
 qWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 qBias = new float[dModel];
 kWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 kBias = new float[dModel];
 vWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 vBias = new float[dModel];
 oWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 oBias = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 qWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 kWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 vWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 oWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播
 * @param x 输入 [seqLen, dModel]
 * @return 输出 [seqLen, dModel]
 */
 public float[][] forward(float[][] x) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 this.input = x;
 
 // Q, K, V投影
 q = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 k = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 v = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 q[t] = matvec(qWeight, x[t], dModel, dModel);
 k[t] = matvec(kWeight, x[t], dModel, dModel);
 v[t] = matvec(vWeight, x[t], dModel, dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 q[t][i] += qBias[i];
 k[t][i] += kBias[i];
 v[t][i] += vBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 多头注意力计算
 float[][] headsOutput = new float[nHeads][seqLen * dHead];
 
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 int offset = h * dHead;
 
 // 提取第h个头的Q, K, V
 float[][] qh = new float[seqLen][dHead];
 float[][] kh = new float[seqLen][dHead];
 float[][] vh = new float[seqLen][dHead];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 qh[t][i] = q[t][offset + i];
 kh[t][i] = k[t][offset + i];
 vh[t][i] = v[t][offset + i];
 }
 }
 
 // 计算注意力权重
 float[][] attn = scaledDotProductAttention(qh, kh, vh);
 
 // 保存注意力权重（用于可视化和正则化）
 if (h == 0) {
 this.attention = attn;
 }
 
 // 保存到headsOutput
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 System.arraycopy(attn[t], 0, headsOutput[h], t * dHead, dHead);
 }
 }
 
 // 合并多头输出
 output = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 int offset = h * dHead;
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 output[t][offset + i] = headsOutput[h][t * dHead + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 // 输出投影
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 result[t] = matvec(oWeight, output[t], dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[t][i] += oBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 缩放点积注意力
 */
 private float[][] scaledDotProductAttention(float[][] q, float[][] kh, float[][] vh) {
 int seqLen = q.length;
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dHead));
 
 // 计算注意力分数
 float[][] scores = new float[seqLen][seqLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 for (int k = 0; k < dHead; k++) {
 scores[i][j] += q[i][k] * kh[j][k];
 }
 scores[i][j] *= scale;
 }
 }
 
 // 因果掩码（只允许关注前面的token）
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 for (int j = i + 1; j < seqLen; j++) {
 scores[i][j] = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 }
 
 // Softmax
 float[][] attnWeights = new float[seqLen][seqLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 float maxScore = scores[i][0];
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 if (scores[i][j] > maxScore) maxScore = scores[i][j];
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 attnWeights[i][j] = (float) Math.exp(scores[i][j] - maxScore);
 sum += attnWeights[i][j];
 }
 
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 attnWeights[i][j] /= sum;
 }
 }
 
 // 加权求和V
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dHead];
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 for (int k = 0; k < dHead; k++) {
 result[i][k] += attnWeights[i][j] * vh[j][k];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public float[][] backward(float[][] dOutput) {
 int seqLen = dOutput.length;
 
 // 输出投影梯度
 float[][] dO = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 float[] dOWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dOBias = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 dO[t] = matvec(transpose(oWeight, dModel, dModel), dOutput[t], dModel, dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dOBias[i] += dOutput[t][i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dOWeight[i * dModel + j] += output[t][i] * dOutput[t][j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 // 多头反向传播
 float[][] dX = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 // 这里简化实现，实际需要更复杂的反向传播
 // 为了快速实现，我们使用一个简化版本
 
 // Q, K, V梯度
 float[] dQWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dKWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dVWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 
 // 计算输入梯度（简化版）
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 反向传播通过Q, K, V投影
 float[] dQ = matvec(transpose(qWeight, dModel, dModel), dO[t], dModel, dModel);
 float[] dK = matvec(transpose(kWeight, dModel, dModel), dO[t], dModel, dModel);
 float[] dV = matvec(transpose(vWeight, dModel, dModel), dO[t], dModel, dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dX[t][i] = dQ[i] + dK[i] + dV[i];
 }
 }
 
 return dX;
 }
 
 private float[] matvec(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N) {
 if (useGPU && gpu != null) {
 return gpu.matvec(A, x, M, N);
 }
 float[] y = new float[M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 y[i] += A[i * N + j] * x[j];
 }
 }
 return y;
 }
 
 private float[] transpose(float[] A, int M, int N) {
 float[] At = new float[N * M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 At[j * M + i] = A[i * N + j];
 }
 }
 return At;
 }
 
 public float[] getQWeight() { return qWeight; }
 public float[] getKWeight() { return kWeight; }
 public float[] getVWeight() { return vWeight; }
 public float[] getOWeight() { return oWeight; }
 public float[] getQBias() { return qBias; }
 public float[] getKBias() { return kBias; }
 public float[] getVBias() { return vBias; }
 public float[] getOBias() { return oBias; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

public class RDTConfig {
 public int vocabSize;
 public int dim;
 public int nHeads;
 public int nKvHeads;
 public int maxSeqLen;
 public int maxLoopIters;
 public int preludeLayers;
 public int codaLayers;
 
 public String attnType;
 public int kvLoraRank;
 public int qLoraRank;
 public int qkRopeHeadDim;
 public int qkNopeHeadDim;
 public int vHeadDim;
 
 public int nExperts;
 public int nSharedExperts;
 public int nExpertsPerTok;
 public int expertDim;
 
 public float actThreshold;
 public float ltiSpectralBound;
 public float dropoutRate;
 
 public RDTConfig() {}
 
 public RDTConfig(
 int vocabSize, int dim, int nHeads, int nKvHeads,
 int maxSeqLen, int maxLoopIters,
 int preludeLayers, int codaLayers,
 String attnType,
 int nExperts, int nSharedExperts, int nExpertsPerTok, int expertDim,
 float actThreshold, float ltiSpectralBound, float dropoutRate
 ) {
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 this.dim = dim;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.nKvHeads = nKvHeads;
 this.maxSeqLen = maxSeqLen;
 this.maxLoopIters = maxLoopIters;
 this.preludeLayers = preludeLayers;
 this.codaLayers = codaLayers;
 this.attnType = attnType;
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.nSharedExperts = nSharedExperts;
 this.nExpertsPerTok = nExpertsPerTok;
 this.expertDim = expertDim;
 this.actThreshold = actThreshold;
 this.ltiSpectralBound = ltiSpectralBound;
 this.dropoutRate = dropoutRate;
 this.kvLoraRank = dim / 4;
 this.qLoraRank = dim / 2;
 this.qkRopeHeadDim = 64;
 this.qkNopeHeadDim = 128;
 this.vHeadDim = 128;
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_1b() {
 return new RDTConfig(32000, 2048, 16, 4, 4096, 16, 2, 2, "mla", 64, 2, 4, 2048, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_3b() {
 return new RDTConfig(32000, 3072, 24, 6, 4096, 16, 2, 2, "mla", 64, 2, 4, 4096, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_10b() {
 return new RDTConfig(32000, 4096, 32, 8, 8192, 24, 3, 3, "mla", 128, 4, 4, 5632, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_50b() {
 return new RDTConfig(64000, 6144, 48, 12, 8192, 32, 4, 4, "mla", 256, 8, 4, 9728, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_100b() {
 return new RDTConfig(100000, 8192, 64, 16, 1000000, 32, 4, 4, "mla", 256, 8, 4, 13568, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.05f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_550b() {
 return new RDTConfig(100000, 12288, 96, 24, 1000000, 48, 6, 6, "mla", 512, 16, 6, 23040, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.05f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig mythos_v100_48x() {
 return new RDTConfig(100000, 4096, 32, 8, 8192, 32, 4, 4, "mla", 192, 8, 4, 8192, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.05f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig qingxiaotuan_100m() {
 // vocab=65536 (翻倍), dim=512, 12头MLA, 12专家(expertDim=1536)
 // 参数量: embedding+lmHead ~67M + 其他层 ~33M ≈ 100M
 return new RDTConfig(65536, 512, 12, 2, 2048, 8, 2, 2, "mla", 12, 3, 2, 1536, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public static RDTConfig prototype_mini() {
 return new RDTConfig(1000, 128, 4, 1, 128, 4, 1, 1, "mla", 4, 1, 2, 64, 0.99f, 0.95f, 0.1f);
 }
 
 public long estimateParams() {
 long params = 0;
 params += (long) vocabSize * dim;
 params += (long) dim * 3;
 int headDim = dim / nHeads;
 params += (long) nHeads * headDim * (headDim + dim) * 3;
 params += (long) nExperts * expertDim * dim * 2;
 params += (long) nSharedExperts * expertDim * dim * 2;
 params += (long) dim * dim * 2;
 params += (long) dim * vocabSize;
 return params;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Map;

public class RDTModel {
 private RDTConfig config;
 
 private float[] embedding;
 private float[] lmHeadWeight;
 private float[] lmHeadBias;
 
 private RDTTransformerBlock[] preludeBlocks;
 private RDTTransformerBlock recurrentBlock;
 private RDTTransformerBlock[] codaBlocks;
 
 private LTIInjection ltiInjection;
 private ACTModule actModule;
 
 // 前向传播缓存
 private float[] forwardEmbedding;
 private float[][] preludeOutputs;
 private float[][] recurrentOutputs;
 private float[][] codaOutputs;
 
 public RDTModel(RDTConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 initModel();
 }
 
 private void initModel() {
 embedding = new float[config.vocabSize * config.dim];
 lmHeadWeight = new float[config.dim * config.vocabSize];
 lmHeadBias = new float[config.vocabSize];
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(config.dim));
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize * config.dim; i++) {
 embedding[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 lmHeadWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 preludeBlocks = new RDTTransformerBlock[config.preludeLayers];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.preludeLayers; i++) {
 preludeBlocks[i] = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, false, 
 0, 0, 0, 0
 );
 }
 
 recurrentBlock = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, true,
 config.nExperts, config.nSharedExperts, 
 config.nExpertsPerTok, config.expertDim
 );
 
 codaBlocks = new RDTTransformerBlock[config.codaLayers];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.codaLayers; i++) {
 codaBlocks[i] = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, false,
 0, 0, 0, 0
 );
 }
 
 ltiInjection = new LTIInjection(config.dim, config.ltiSpectralBound);
 actModule = new ACTModule(config.dim, config.actThreshold);
 
 // 初始化缓存
 preludeOutputs = new float[config.preludeLayers][];
 recurrentOutputs = new float[config.maxLoopIters][];
 codaOutputs = new float[config.codaLayers][];
 }
 
 public float[] forward(int[] tokens, int nLoops) {
 float[] x = embed(tokens);
 forwardEmbedding = x;
 
 // Prelude层
 for (int i = 0; i < config.preludeLayers; i++) {
 x = preludeBlocks[i].forward(x);
 preludeOutputs[i] = x;
 }
 
 float[] e = x;
 
 if (nLoops <= 0) {
 nLoops = config.maxLoopIters;
 }
 
 // 循环层
 for (int t = 0; t < nLoops; t++) {
 float[] injection = ltiInjection.inject(x, e);
 float[] residual = x;
 
 float[] blockOut = recurrentBlock.forward(x);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 x[i] = injection[i] + blockOut[i];
 }
 
 x = elementwiseAdd(x, residual);
 x = applyLoopPositionalEncoding(x, t, nLoops);
 
 recurrentOutputs[t] = x;
 }
 
 // Coda层
 for (int i = 0; i < config.codaLayers; i++) {
 x = codaBlocks[i].forward(x);
 codaOutputs[i] = x;
 }
 
 float[] logits = MatrixOperations.matmul(lmHeadWeight, x, config.vocabSize, config.dim, 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 logits[i] += lmHeadBias[i];
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public GradientResult backward(float[] dLogits, int nLoops) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[config.dim]);
 
 if (nLoops <= 0) {
 nLoops = config.maxLoopIters;
 }
 
 // 默认使用空tokens（用于兼容旧代码）
 return backward(dLogits, nLoops, new int[0]);
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播（带输入tokens，用于计算embedding梯度）
 */
 public GradientResult backward(float[] dLogits, int nLoops, int[] tokens) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[config.dim]);
 
 if (nLoops <= 0) {
 nLoops = config.maxLoopIters;
 }
 
 // 1. LM Head梯度
 float[] dLmHeadWeight = new float[config.dim * config.vocabSize];
 float[] dLmHeadBias = new float[config.vocabSize];
 
 float[] lastCodaOutput = codaOutputs[config.codaLayers - 1];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 dLmHeadBias[i] += dLogits[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < config.dim; j++) {
 dLmHeadWeight[j * config.vocabSize + i] += lastCodaOutput[j] * dLogits[i];
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("lmHeadWeight", dLmHeadWeight);
 result.addGradient("lmHeadBias", dLmHeadBias);
 
 // 2. dX = W_lm^T * dLogits
 float[] dX = MatrixOperations.matmul(MatrixOperations.transpose(lmHeadWeight, config.dim, config.vocabSize), dLogits, config.dim, config.vocabSize, 1);
 
 // 3. Coda层反向传播
 for (int i = config.codaLayers - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 GradientResult blockGrad = codaBlocks[i].backward(dX);
 accumulateGradients(result, "coda_" + i, blockGrad);
 dX = blockGrad.getdInput();
 }
 
 // 4. 循环层反向传播（简化版）
 for (int t = nLoops - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
 GradientResult blockGrad = recurrentBlock.backward(dX);
 accumulateGradients(result, "recurrent_" + t, blockGrad);
 dX = blockGrad.getdInput();
 }
 
 // 5. Prelude层反向传播
 for (int i = config.preludeLayers - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 GradientResult blockGrad = preludeBlocks[i].backward(dX);
 accumulateGradients(result, "prelude_" + i, blockGrad);
 dX = blockGrad.getdInput();
 }
 
 // 6. Embedding梯度（真正的梯度！将dX scatter回对应token位置）
 float[] dEmbedding = new float[config.vocabSize * config.dim];
 
 // 将输入梯度dX累加到每个输入token对应的embedding位置
 if (tokens != null && tokens.length > 0) {
 for (int token : tokens) {
 if (token >= 0 && token < config.vocabSize) {
 int offset = token * config.dim;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 dEmbedding[offset + i] += dX[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("embedding", dEmbedding);
 
 // 输入梯度
 float[] dInput = result.getdInput();
 System.arraycopy(dX, 0, dInput, 0, config.dim);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private void accumulateGradients(GradientResult result, String prefix, GradientResult source) {
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : source.getParameterGradients().entrySet()) {
 // 不添加前缀，直接使用原始key，这样所有层的同名参数梯度会被累加
 // 这在简化版训练中是可以接受的
 String key = entry.getKey();
 float[] grad = entry.getValue();
 float[] existing = result.getGradient(key);
 if (existing == null) {
 result.addGradient(key, grad);
 } else {
 // 累加梯度
 for (int i = 0; i < existing.length; i++) {
 existing[i] += grad[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public float[] generate(int[] tokens, int maxNewTokens, int nLoops) {
 int[] currentTokens = tokens;
 float[] allLogits = new float[maxNewTokens * config.vocabSize];
 
 for (int step = 0; step < maxNewTokens; step++) {
 float[] logits = forward(currentTokens, nLoops);
 
 int nextToken = argmax(logits);
 
 int[] newTokens = new int[currentTokens.length + 1];
 System.arraycopy(currentTokens, 0, newTokens, 0, currentTokens.length);
 newTokens[currentTokens.length] = nextToken;
 currentTokens = newTokens;
 
 System.arraycopy(logits, 0, allLogits, step * config.vocabSize, config.vocabSize);
 }
 
 return allLogits;
 }
 
 /**
 * 将token序列转换为嵌入向量（使用真正的可学习嵌入层）
 */
 public float[] embed(int[] tokens) {
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 
 for (int token : tokens) {
 if (token >= 0 && token < config.vocabSize) {
 int offset = token * config.dim;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] += embedding[offset + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] applyLoopPositionalEncoding(float[] x, int t, int totalLoops) {
 float[] posEnc = new float[config.dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i += 2) {
 float theta = (float) (1.0 / Math.pow(10000.0, i / (double) config.dim));
 posEnc[i] = (float) Math.sin(t * theta);
 posEnc[i + 1] = (float) Math.cos(t * theta);
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] = x[i] + posEnc[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] elementwiseAdd(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a[i] + b[i];
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private int argmax(float[] x) {
 int idx = 0;
 float max = x[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] > max) {
 max = x[i];
 idx = i;
 }
 }
 return idx;
 }
 
 public float getSpectralRadius() {
 return ltiInjection.getSpectralRadius();
 }
 
 public long countParameters() {
 long params = 0;
 params += (long) config.vocabSize * config.dim;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.vocabSize;
 params += config.preludeLayers * (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += config.codaLayers * (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += (long) config.nExperts * config.expertDim * config.dim * 2;
 params += (long) config.nSharedExperts * config.expertDim * config.dim * 2;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.dim * 2;
 return params;
 }
 
 /**
 * 更新模型参数（简化的随机梯度下降）
 */
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 float scale = learningRate * 0.01f;
 
 // 更新embedding
 for (int i = 0; i < embedding.length; i++) {
 embedding[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale;
 }
 
 // 更新lmHeadWeight
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadWeight.length; i++) {
 lmHeadWeight[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale;
 }
 
 // 更新lmHeadBias
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadBias.length; i++) {
 lmHeadBias[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * scale;
 }
 
 // 更新Transformer块参数
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : preludeBlocks) {
 block.updateParameters(scale);
 }
 recurrentBlock.updateParameters(scale);
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : codaBlocks) {
 block.updateParameters(scale);
 }
 
 // 更新LTI注入和ACT模块
 ltiInjection.updateParameters(scale);
 actModule.updateParameters(scale);
 }
 
 /**
 * 使用真实梯度更新模型参数（关键改进！）
 */
 public void updateParametersWithGradient(com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult grad, float learningRate) {
 // 获取梯度
 float[] dInput = grad.getdInput();
 java.util.Map<String, float[]> paramGrads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 
 // 更新embedding（使用输入梯度）
 for (int i = 0; i < embedding.length && i < dInput.length; i++) {
 embedding[i] -= learningRate * dInput[i];
 }
 
 // 更新lmHeadWeight
 float[] dLmHeadWeight = paramGrads.get("lmHeadWeight");
 if (dLmHeadWeight != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadWeight.length && i < dLmHeadWeight.length; i++) {
 lmHeadWeight[i] -= learningRate * dLmHeadWeight[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 更新lmHeadBias
 float[] dLmHeadBias = paramGrads.get("lmHeadBias");
 if (dLmHeadBias != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadBias.length && i < dLmHeadBias.length; i++) {
 lmHeadBias[i] -= learningRate * dLmHeadBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 更新Transformer块参数
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : preludeBlocks) {
 block.updateParametersWithGradient(paramGrads, learningRate);
 }
 recurrentBlock.updateParametersWithGradient(paramGrads, learningRate);
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : codaBlocks) {
 block.updateParametersWithGradient(paramGrads, learningRate);
 }
 
 // 更新LTI注入和ACT模块
 ltiInjection.updateParameters(learningRate * 0.1f);
 actModule.updateParameters(learningRate * 0.1f);
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取所有权重数组用于优化器更新
 */
 public float[][] getAllWeightArrays() {
 java.util.List<float[]> allWeights = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 
 allWeights.add(embedding);
 allWeights.add(lmHeadWeight);
 allWeights.add(lmHeadBias);
 
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : preludeBlocks) {
 for (float[] w : block.getWeightArrays()) {
 allWeights.add(w);
 }
 }
 
 for (float[] w : recurrentBlock.getWeightArrays()) {
 allWeights.add(w);
 }
 
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : codaBlocks) {
 for (float[] w : block.getWeightArrays()) {
 allWeights.add(w);
 }
 }
 
 return allWeights.toArray(new float[0][]);
 }
 
 public RDTConfig getConfig() { return config; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

public class RDTModelEnhanced {
 private RDTConfig config;
 
 private float[] embedding;
 private float[] lmHeadWeight;
 private float[] lmHeadBias;
 
 private RDTTransformerBlock[] preludeBlocks;
 private RDTTransformerBlock recurrentBlock;
 private RDTTransformerBlock[] codaBlocks;
 
 private LTIInjection ltiInjection;
 private ACTModule actModule;
 private DeepWiseLoRA loraAdapter;
 
 private float[] driftHistory;
 private float[] normHistory;
 private float driftWarningThreshold;
 private float normWarningThreshold;
 private boolean driftWarningTriggered;
 
 public RDTModelEnhanced(RDTConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 this.driftWarningThreshold = 0.1f;
 this.normWarningThreshold = 10.0f;
 initModel();
 }
 
 private void initModel() {
 embedding = new float[config.vocabSize * config.dim];
 lmHeadWeight = new float[config.dim * config.vocabSize];
 lmHeadBias = new float[config.vocabSize];
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(config.dim));
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize * config.dim; i++) {
 embedding[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 lmHeadWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 preludeBlocks = new RDTTransformerBlock[config.preludeLayers];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.preludeLayers; i++) {
 preludeBlocks[i] = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, false, 
 0, 0, 0, 0
 );
 }
 
 recurrentBlock = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, true,
 config.nExperts, config.nSharedExperts, 
 config.nExpertsPerTok, config.expertDim
 );
 
 codaBlocks = new RDTTransformerBlock[config.codaLayers];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.codaLayers; i++) {
 codaBlocks[i] = new RDTTransformerBlock(
 config.dim, config.nHeads, false,
 0, 0, 0, 0
 );
 }
 
 ltiInjection = new LTIInjection(config.dim, config.ltiSpectralBound);
 actModule = new ACTModule(config.dim, config.actThreshold);
 loraAdapter = new DeepWiseLoRA(config.dim, config.dim / 16);
 
 driftHistory = new float[1000];
 normHistory = new float[1000];
 }
 
 public float[] forward(int[] tokens, int nLoops) {
 return forward(tokens, nLoops, false);
 }
 
 public float[] forward(int[] tokens, int nLoops, boolean enableDriftMonitoring) {
 float[] x = embed(tokens);
 
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : preludeBlocks) {
 x = block.forward(x);
 }
 
 float[] e = x;
 float initialNorm = computeL2Norm(x);
 
 if (nLoops <= 0) {
 nLoops = config.maxLoopIters;
 }
 
 driftWarningTriggered = false;
 float previousNorm = initialNorm;
 normHistory[0] = initialNorm;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < nLoops; t++) {
 float[] injection = ltiInjection.inject(x, e);
 float[] residual = x;
 
 float[] blockOut = recurrentBlock.forward(x);
 blockOut = loraAdapter.apply(blockOut);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 x[i] = injection[i] + blockOut[i];
 }
 
 x = elementwiseAdd(x, residual);
 x = applyLayerNorm(x);
 x = clipNorm(x, 5.0f);
 x = applyLoopPositionalEncoding(x, t, nLoops);
 
 if (enableDriftMonitoring && t < 1000) {
 float currentNorm = computeL2Norm(x);
 normHistory[t + 1] = currentNorm;
 
 float drift = Math.abs(currentNorm - previousNorm) / previousNorm;
 driftHistory[t] = drift;
 
 if (drift > driftWarningThreshold) {
 driftWarningTriggered = true;
 System.out.println("[WARN] Drift detected at iteration " + t + ": " + 
 String.format("%.4f", drift) + " (threshold: " + driftWarningThreshold + ")");
 }
 
 if (currentNorm > normWarningThreshold) {
 System.out.println("[WARN] Norm explosion at iteration " + t + ": " + 
 String.format("%.4f", currentNorm) + " (threshold: " + normWarningThreshold + ")");
 }
 
 previousNorm = currentNorm;
 }
 }
 
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : codaBlocks) {
 x = block.forward(x);
 }
 
 float[] logits = MatrixOperations.matmul(lmHeadWeight, x, config.vocabSize, config.dim, 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 logits[i] += lmHeadBias[i];
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 public StabilityReport runLongTermStabilityTest(int[] tokens, int nSteps) {
 float[] x = embed(tokens);
 
 for (RDTTransformerBlock block : preludeBlocks) {
 x = block.forward(x);
 }
 
 float[] e = x;
 float initialNorm = computeL2Norm(x);
 
 float[] norms = new float[nSteps];
 float[] drifts = new float[nSteps - 1];
 norms[0] = initialNorm;
 
 boolean stable = true;
 int instabilityPoint = -1;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < nSteps; t++) {
 float[] injection = ltiInjection.inject(x, e);
 float[] residual = x;
 
 float[] blockOut = recurrentBlock.forward(x);
 blockOut = loraAdapter.apply(blockOut);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 x[i] = injection[i] + blockOut[i];
 }
 
 x = elementwiseAdd(x, residual);
 x = applyLayerNorm(x);
 x = clipNorm(x, 5.0f);
 x = applyLoopPositionalEncoding(x, t, nSteps);
 
 if (t > 0) {
 norms[t] = computeL2Norm(x);
 drifts[t - 1] = Math.abs(norms[t] - norms[t - 1]) / norms[t - 1];
 
 if (drifts[t - 1] > driftWarningThreshold * 5 && instabilityPoint == -1) {
 instabilityPoint = t;
 stable = false;
 }
 
 if (norms[t] > normWarningThreshold * 10) {
 instabilityPoint = t;
 stable = false;
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 
 return new StabilityReport(norms, drifts, stable, instabilityPoint);
 }
 
 public float computeL2Norm(float[] x) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (float v : x) {
 sum += v * v;
 }
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }
 
 public float[] getDriftHistory() {
 return driftHistory;
 }
 
 public float[] getNormHistory() {
 return normHistory;
 }
 
 public boolean isDriftWarningTriggered() {
 return driftWarningTriggered;
 }
 
 public void setDriftWarningThreshold(float threshold) {
 this.driftWarningThreshold = threshold;
 }
 
 public float getSpectralRadius() {
 return ltiInjection.getSpectralRadius();
 }
 
 public long countParameters() {
 long params = 0;
 params += (long) config.vocabSize * config.dim;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.vocabSize;
 params += config.preludeLayers * (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += config.codaLayers * (long) config.dim * config.dim * 8;
 params += (long) config.nExperts * config.expertDim * config.dim * 2;
 params += (long) config.nSharedExperts * config.expertDim * config.dim * 2;
 params += (long) config.dim * config.dim * 2;
 params += loraAdapter.countParameters();
 return params;
 }
 
 public void tuneSpectralRadius(float targetRadius) {
 ltiInjection = new LTIInjection(config.dim, targetRadius);
 }
 
 public DeepWiseLoRA getLoraAdapter() {
 return loraAdapter;
 }
 
 private float[] embed(int[] tokens) {
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 
 for (int token : tokens) {
 if (token >= 0 && token < config.vocabSize) {
 int offset = token * config.dim;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] += embedding[offset + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] applyLoopPositionalEncoding(float[] x, int t, int totalLoops) {
 float[] posEnc = new float[config.dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i += 2) {
 float theta = (float) (1.0 / Math.pow(10000.0, i / (double) config.dim));
 posEnc[i] = (float) Math.sin(t * theta);
 posEnc[i + 1] = (float) Math.cos(t * theta);
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] = x[i] + posEnc[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] elementwiseAdd(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a[i] + b[i];
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] applyLayerNorm(float[] x) {
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 
 float mean = 0.0f;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= config.dim;
 
 float var = 0.0f;
 for (float v : x) {
 var += (v - mean) * (v - mean);
 }
 var /= config.dim;
 
 float eps = 1e-5f;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + eps);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] = (x[i] - mean) / std;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] clipNorm(float[] x, float maxNorm) {
 float norm = computeL2Norm(x);
 if (norm > maxNorm) {
 float scale = maxNorm / norm;
 float[] result = new float[config.dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dim; i++) {
 result[i] = x[i] * scale;
 }
 return result;
 }
 return x;
 }
 
 public static class StabilityReport {
 public float[] norms;
 public float[] drifts;
 public boolean stable;
 public int instabilityPoint;
 
 public StabilityReport(float[] norms, float[] drifts, boolean stable, int instabilityPoint) {
 this.norms = norms;
 this.drifts = drifts;
 this.stable = stable;
 this.instabilityPoint = instabilityPoint;
 }
 
 public float getMaxNorm() {
 float max = norms[0];
 for (float n : norms) {
 if (n > max) max = n;
 }
 return max;
 }
 
 public float getAvgDrift() {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (float d : drifts) {
 sum += d;
 }
 return sum / drifts.length;
 }
 
 public float getMaxDrift() {
 float max = drifts[0];
 for (float d : drifts) {
 if (d > max) max = d;
 }
 return max;
 }
 
 public String generateReport() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("Stability Report:\n");
 sb.append(" Stable: ").append(stable ? "YES" : "NO").append("\n");
 if (!stable) {
 sb.append(" Instability detected at step: ").append(instabilityPoint).append("\n");
 }
 sb.append(" Max norm: ").append(String.format("%.4f", getMaxNorm())).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Avg drift: ").append(String.format("%.6f", getAvgDrift())).append("\n");
 sb.append(" Max drift: ").append(String.format("%.6f", getMaxDrift())).append("\n");
 return sb.toString();
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

public class RDTTransformerBlock {
 private float[] qWeight, kWeight, vWeight;
 private float[] qBias, kBias, vBias;
 private float[] outputWeight, outputBias;
 
 private float[] ffnWeight1, ffnBias1;
 private float[] ffnWeight2, ffnBias2;
 
 private float[] ln1Weight, ln1Bias;
 private float[] ln2Weight, ln2Bias;
 
 private int dim;
 private int nHeads;
 private int headDim;
 
 private boolean useMoE;
 
 // GPU加速
 private static OpenCLAccelerator gpu = null;
 
 // 前向传播缓存（用于反向传播）
 private float[] forwardInput;
 private float[] ln1Output;
 private float[] attnOutput;
 private float[] ln2Output;
 private float[] ffnOutput;
 private float[] ffnActivation;
 
 /**
 * 设置GPU加速引擎
 */
 public static void setGPU(OpenCLAccelerator accelerator) {
 gpu = accelerator;
 }
 
 /**
 * 内部矩阵乘法（使用GPU加速）
 */
 private float[] matmul(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N, int colX) {
 if (gpu != null && gpu.isUsingGPU()) {
 return gpu.matvec(A, x, M, N);
 }
 return MatrixOperations.matmul(A, x, M, N, colX);
 }
 
 /**
 * 内部矩阵转置乘法（使用GPU加速）
 */
 private float[] matmulTranspose(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N, int colX) {
 float[] At = MatrixOperations.transpose(A, M, N);
 if (gpu != null && gpu.isUsingGPU()) {
 return gpu.matvec(At, x, N, M);
 }
 return MatrixOperations.matmul(At, x, N, M, colX);
 }
 
 public RDTTransformerBlock(int dim, int nHeads, boolean useMoE, int nExperts, int nSharedExperts, int nExpertsPerTok, int expertDim) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.headDim = dim / nHeads;
 this.useMoE = useMoE;
 
 // MoELayer暂时禁用，使用FFN替代
 initWeights();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dim));
 
 qWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 kWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 vWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * dim; i++) {
 qWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 kWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 vWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 qBias = new float[dim];
 kBias = new float[dim];
 vBias = new float[dim];
 
 outputWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 outputBias = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * dim; i++) {
 outputWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 // 始终初始化FFN权重（参数堆叠架构中由StackedTrainer处理专家选择）
 ffnWeight1 = new float[dim * dim * 4];
 ffnBias1 = new float[dim * 4];
 ffnWeight2 = new float[4 * dim * dim];
 ffnBias2 = new float[dim];
 
 float ffnScale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dim));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * dim * 4; i++) {
 ffnWeight1[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * ffnScale;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < 4 * dim * dim; i++) {
 ffnWeight2[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * ffnScale;
 }
 
 ln1Weight = new float[dim];
 ln1Bias = new float[dim];
 ln2Weight = new float[dim];
 ln2Bias = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 ln1Weight[i] = 1.0f;
 ln2Weight[i] = 1.0f;
 }
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] x) {
 // 保存输入
 forwardInput = x;
 
 float[] residual = x;
 
 ln1Output = layerNorm(x, ln1Weight, ln1Bias);
 attnOutput = attention(ln1Output);
 x = elementwiseAdd(residual, attnOutput);
 
 residual = x;
 ln2Output = layerNorm(x, ln2Weight, ln2Bias);
 
 // 暂时禁用MoE，使用FFN替代（参数堆叠架构中由StackedTrainer处理专家选择）
 float[] ffnResult = ffn(ln2Output);
 ffnOutput = ffnResult;
 
 x = elementwiseAdd(residual, ffnOutput);
 
 return x;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public GradientResult backward(float[] dOutput) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[dim]);
 
 // 1. 残差连接梯度
 float[] dResidual2 = dOutput;
 float[] dFfn = dOutput;
 
 // 2. FFN反向传播
 GradientResult ffnGrad = ffnBackward(dFfn);
 result.addGradient("ffnWeight1", ffnGrad.getGradient("ffnWeight1"));
 result.addGradient("ffnBias1", ffnGrad.getGradient("ffnBias1"));
 result.addGradient("ffnWeight2", ffnGrad.getGradient("ffnWeight2"));
 result.addGradient("ffnBias2", ffnGrad.getGradient("ffnBias2"));
 
 // 3. LayerNorm2反向传播
 GradientResult ln2Grad = layerNormBackward(ffnGrad.getdInput(), ln2Output, ln2Weight, ln2Bias, forwardInput.length);
 result.addGradient("ln2Weight", ln2Grad.getGradient("lnWeight"));
 result.addGradient("ln2Bias", ln2Grad.getGradient("lnBias"));
 
 // 4. 第一个残差连接梯度
 float[] dAttnOut = ln2Grad.getdInput();
 float[] dResidual1 = dAttnOut;
 
 // 5. Attention反向传播
 GradientResult attnGrad = attentionBackward(dAttnOut);
 result.addGradient("qWeight", attnGrad.getGradient("qWeight"));
 result.addGradient("qBias", attnGrad.getGradient("qBias"));
 result.addGradient("kWeight", attnGrad.getGradient("kWeight"));
 result.addGradient("kBias", attnGrad.getGradient("kBias"));
 result.addGradient("vWeight", attnGrad.getGradient("vWeight"));
 result.addGradient("vBias", attnGrad.getGradient("vBias"));
 result.addGradient("outputWeight", attnGrad.getGradient("outputWeight"));
 result.addGradient("outputBias", attnGrad.getGradient("outputBias"));
 
 // 6. LayerNorm1反向传播
 GradientResult ln1Grad = layerNormBackward(attnGrad.getdInput(), ln1Output, ln1Weight, ln1Bias, forwardInput.length);
 result.addGradient("ln1Weight", ln1Grad.getGradient("lnWeight"));
 result.addGradient("ln1Bias", ln1Grad.getGradient("lnBias"));
 
 // 7. 输入梯度
 float[] dInput = result.getdInput();
 System.arraycopy(ln1Grad.getdInput(), 0, dInput, 0, dim);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] attention(float[] x) {
 float[] Q = matmul(qWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] K = matmul(kWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 float[] V = matmul(vWeight, x, dim, dim, 1);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 Q[i] += qBias[i];
 K[i] += kBias[i];
 V[i] += vBias[i];
 }
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(headDim));
 float[] attnScore = new float[nHeads];
 
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 int offset = h * headDim;
 float[] qh = new float[headDim];
 float[] kh = new float[headDim];
 
 System.arraycopy(Q, offset, qh, 0, headDim);
 System.arraycopy(K, offset, kh, 0, headDim);
 
 float dot = MatrixOperations.dotProduct(qh, kh);
 attnScore[h] = dot * scale;
 }
 
 float[] attnProbs = softmax(attnScore);
 
 float[] out = new float[dim];
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 int offset = h * headDim;
 float[] vh = new float[headDim];
 System.arraycopy(V, offset, vh, 0, headDim);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim; i++) {
 out[offset + i] += vh[i] * attnProbs[h];
 }
 }
 
 out = matmul(outputWeight, out, dim, dim, 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 out[i] += outputBias[i];
 }
 
 return out;
 }
 
 private GradientResult attentionBackward(float[] dOutput) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[dim]);
 
 // 输出层梯度
 float[] dOutputWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 float[] dOutputBias = new float[dim];
 
 // 简化：假设attention输出为attnOutput
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 dOutputBias[i] += dOutput[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 dOutputWeight[j * dim + i] += attnOutput[j] * dOutput[i];
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("outputWeight", dOutputWeight);
 result.addGradient("outputBias", dOutputBias);
 
 // dAttn（简化版）
 float[] dAttn = matmulTranspose(outputWeight, dOutput, dim, dim, 1);
 
 // Q, K, V梯度（简化版）
 float[] dQ = new float[dim];
 float[] dK = new float[dim];
 float[] dV = new float[dim];
 System.arraycopy(dAttn, 0, dV, 0, dim);
 
 // 投影层梯度
 float[] dQWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 float[] dQBias = new float[dim];
 float[] dKWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 float[] dKBias = new float[dim];
 float[] dVWeight = new float[dim * dim];
 float[] dVBias = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 dQBias[i] += dQ[i];
 dKBias[i] += dK[i];
 dVBias[i] += dV[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 dQWeight[j * dim + i] += ln1Output[j] * dQ[i];
 dKWeight[j * dim + i] += ln1Output[j] * dK[i];
 dVWeight[j * dim + i] += ln1Output[j] * dV[i];
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("qWeight", dQWeight);
 result.addGradient("qBias", dQBias);
 result.addGradient("kWeight", dKWeight);
 result.addGradient("kBias", dKBias);
 result.addGradient("vWeight", dVWeight);
 result.addGradient("vBias", dVBias);
 
 // 输入梯度
 float[] dInput = result.getdInput();
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 dInput[i] += dQ[j] * qWeight[i * dim + j];
 dInput[i] += dK[j] * kWeight[i * dim + j];
 dInput[i] += dV[j] * vWeight[i * dim + j];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] ffn(float[] x) {
 float[] h = matmul(ffnWeight1, x, dim * 4, dim, 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * 4; i++) {
 h[i] += ffnBias1[i];
 }
 
 h = MatrixOperations.silu(h);
 ffnActivation = h;
 
 float[] out = matmul(ffnWeight2, h, dim, dim * 4, 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 out[i] += ffnBias2[i];
 }
 
 return out;
 }
 
 private GradientResult ffnBackward(float[] dOutput) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[dim]);
 
 // 第二层梯度
 float[] dFfnWeight2 = new float[4 * dim * dim];
 float[] dFfnBias2 = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 dFfnBias2[i] += dOutput[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dim * 4; j++) {
 dFfnWeight2[j * dim + i] += ffnActivation[j] * dOutput[i];
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("ffnWeight2", dFfnWeight2);
 result.addGradient("ffnBias2", dFfnBias2);
 
 // dH = W2^T * dOutput
 float[] dH = matmulTranspose(ffnWeight2, dOutput, dim, dim * 4, 1);
 
 // SiLU梯度
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * 4; i++) {
 float sigmoid = (float) (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-ffnActivation[i])));
 dH[i] *= ffnActivation[i] * sigmoid + sigmoid * (1 - sigmoid);
 }
 
 // 第一层梯度
 float[] dFfnWeight1 = new float[dim * dim * 4];
 float[] dFfnBias1 = new float[dim * 4];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * 4; i++) {
 dFfnBias1[i] += dH[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 dFfnWeight1[j * dim * 4 + i] += ln2Output[j] * dH[i];
 }
 }
 
 result.addGradient("ffnWeight1", dFfnWeight1);
 result.addGradient("ffnBias1", dFfnBias1);
 
 // 输入梯度
 float[] dInput = result.getdInput();
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dim * 4; j++) {
 dInput[i] += dH[j] * ffnWeight1[i * dim * 4 + j];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x, float[] weight, float[] bias) {
 float mean = 0.0f;
 for (float v : x) {
 mean += v;
 }
 mean /= x.length;
 
 float var = 0.0f;
 for (float v : x) {
 float diff = v - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= x.length;
 var += 1e-5f;
 
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var);
 
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = ((x[i] - mean) / std) * weight[i] + bias[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private GradientResult layerNormBackward(float[] dOutput, float[] output, float[] weight, float[] bias, int inputSize) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[inputSize]);
 
 float[] dWeight = new float[inputSize];
 float[] dBias = new float[inputSize];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < inputSize; i++) {
 dBias[i] += dOutput[i];
 // 简化版：dWeight直接使用dOutput
 dWeight[i] += dOutput[i] * (output[i] - bias[i]) / weight[i];
 }
 
 result.addGradient("lnWeight", dWeight);
 result.addGradient("lnBias", dBias);
 
 // 输入梯度（简化版）
 float[] dInput = result.getdInput();
 for (int i = 0; i < inputSize; i++) {
 dInput[i] = dOutput[i] * weight[i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] elementwiseAdd(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a[i] + b[i];
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] softmax(float[] x) {
 float max = x[0];
 for (float v : x) {
 if (v > max) max = v;
 }
 
 float sum = 0.0f;
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.exp(x[i] - max);
 sum += result[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取权重数组用于优化器更新
 */
 public float[][] getWeightArrays() {
 return new float[][]{
 qWeight, kWeight, vWeight, qBias, kBias, vBias,
 outputWeight, outputBias,
 ffnWeight1, ffnBias1, ffnWeight2, ffnBias2,
 ln1Weight, ln1Bias, ln2Weight, ln2Bias
 };
 }
 
 /**
 * 更新参数（简化的随机梯度下降）
 */
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 updateWeight(qWeight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(kWeight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(vWeight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(qBias, learningRate);
 updateWeight(kBias, learningRate);
 updateWeight(vBias, learningRate);
