 updateWeight(outputWeight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(outputBias, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ffnWeight1, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ffnBias1, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ffnWeight2, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ffnBias2, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ln1Weight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ln1Bias, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ln2Weight, learningRate);
 updateWeight(ln2Bias, learningRate);
 }
 
 private void updateWeight(float[] weight, float learningRate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weight.length; i++) {
 weight[i] += (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * learningRate;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 使用真实梯度更新参数（关键改进！）
 */
 public void updateParametersWithGradient(java.util.Map<String, float[]> paramGrads, float learningRate) {
 updateWeightWithGradient(qWeight, paramGrads.get("qWeight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(kWeight, paramGrads.get("kWeight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(vWeight, paramGrads.get("vWeight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(qBias, paramGrads.get("qBias"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(kBias, paramGrads.get("kBias"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(vBias, paramGrads.get("vBias"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(outputWeight, paramGrads.get("outputWeight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(outputBias, paramGrads.get("outputBias"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ffnWeight1, paramGrads.get("ffnWeight1"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ffnBias1, paramGrads.get("ffnBias1"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ffnWeight2, paramGrads.get("ffnWeight2"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ffnBias2, paramGrads.get("ffnBias2"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ln1Weight, paramGrads.get("ln1Weight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ln1Bias, paramGrads.get("ln1Bias"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ln2Weight, paramGrads.get("ln2Weight"), learningRate);
 updateWeightWithGradient(ln2Bias, paramGrads.get("ln2Bias"), learningRate);
 }
 
 private void updateWeightWithGradient(float[] weight, float[] grad, float learningRate) {
 if (grad != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weight.length && i < grad.length; i++) {
 weight[i] -= learningRate * grad[i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 public int getDim() { return dim; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * 序列模型 - 支持序列处理的简化Transformer模型
 * 使用循环方式处理序列中的每个token
 * 支持OpenCL GPU加速
 */
public class SequenceModel {
 
 private final int vocabSize;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nLayers;
 private final int nHeads;
 
 // 参数
 private float[] embedding; // [vocabSize, dModel]
 private float[] lmHeadWeight; // [dModel, vocabSize]
 private float[] lmHeadBias; // [vocabSize]
 
 // 循环层参数
 private float[][] rnnWeights; // [nLayers, dModel * dModel]
 private float[][] rnnBiases; // [nLayers, dModel]
 private float[][] rnnOutputWeights; // [nLayers, dModel * dModel]
 private float[][] rnnOutputBiases; // [nLayers, dModel]
 
 // 前向传播缓存
 private float[][] layerOutputs; // [nLayers+1, seqLength, dModel]
 private float[][] layerInputs; // [nLayers, seqLength, dModel]
 private int[] currentTokens;
 
 // GPU加速器
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 public SequenceModel(int vocabSize, int dModel, int nLayers, int nHeads) {
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nLayers = nLayers;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 initWeights();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 /**
 * 初始化GPU加速
 */
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = new OpenCLAccelerator();
 gpu.initialize();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 System.out.printf("[SequenceModel] GPU加速: %s\n", useGPU ? "已启用" : "未启用");
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("[SequenceModel] GPU初始化失败: " + e.getMessage());
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 
 // 嵌入层
 embedding = new float[vocabSize * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize * dModel; i++) {
 embedding[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 // LM Head
 lmHeadWeight = new float[dModel * vocabSize];
 lmHeadBias = new float[vocabSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * vocabSize; i++) {
 lmHeadWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 // RNN层
 rnnWeights = new float[nLayers][];
 rnnBiases = new float[nLayers][];
 rnnOutputWeights = new float[nLayers][];
 rnnOutputBiases = new float[nLayers][];
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 rnnWeights[l] = new float[dModel * dModel];
 rnnBiases[l] = new float[dModel];
 rnnOutputWeights[l] = new float[dModel * dModel];
 rnnOutputBiases[l] = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel; i++) {
 rnnWeights[l][i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 rnnOutputWeights[l][i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播 - 处理序列并返回最后一个token的logits
 */
 public float[] forward(int[] tokens) {
 currentTokens = tokens;
 int seqLen = tokens.length;
 
 // 初始化缓存
 layerOutputs = new float[nLayers + 1][seqLen * dModel];
 layerInputs = new float[nLayers][seqLen * dModel];
 
 // 嵌入层
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int token = tokens[t];
 if (token >= 0 && token < vocabSize) {
 System.arraycopy(embedding, token * dModel, 
 layerOutputs[0], t * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 
 // 循环层
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 获取前一层的输出
 float[] prevOutput = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(layerOutputs[l], t * dModel, prevOutput, 0, dModel);
 
 // 保存输入
 System.arraycopy(prevOutput, 0, layerInputs[l], t * dModel, dModel);
 
 // 仿射变换
 float[] hidden = matvec(rnnWeights[l], prevOutput, dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 hidden[i] += rnnBiases[l][i];
 }
 
 // ReLU激活
 relu(hidden);
 
 // 输出变换
 float[] output = matvec(rnnOutputWeights[l], hidden, dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] += rnnOutputBiases[l][i];
 }
 
 // 残差连接
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] += prevOutput[i];
 }
 
 // 保存输出
 System.arraycopy(output, 0, layerOutputs[l + 1], t * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 
 // 获取最后一个token的表示
 float[] lastOutput = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(layerOutputs[nLayers], (seqLen - 1) * dModel, lastOutput, 0, dModel);
 
 // LM Head
 float[] logits = matvec(lmHeadWeight, lastOutput, vocabSize, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 logits[i] += lmHeadBias[i];
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public GradientResult backward(float[] dLogits) {
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(new float[dModel]);
 
 int seqLen = currentTokens.length;
 Map<String, float[]> paramGrads = new HashMap<>();
 
 // 1. LM Head梯度
 float[] dLmHeadWeight = new float[dModel * vocabSize];
 float[] dLmHeadBias = new float[vocabSize];
 
 float[] lastOutput = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(layerOutputs[nLayers], (seqLen - 1) * dModel, lastOutput, 0, dModel);
 
 // dL/dW = lastOutput^T * dLogits
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 dLmHeadWeight[i * vocabSize + j] += lastOutput[i] * dLogits[j];
 }
 }
 
 // dL/db = dLogits
 System.arraycopy(dLogits, 0, dLmHeadBias, 0, vocabSize);
 
 paramGrads.put("lmHeadWeight", dLmHeadWeight);
 paramGrads.put("lmHeadBias", dLmHeadBias);
 
 // 2. 反向传播通过LM Head
 float[] dLastOutput = matvec(transpose(lmHeadWeight, dModel, vocabSize), dLogits, dModel, vocabSize);
 
 // 3. 反向传播通过循环层
 float[][] dLayerOutputs = new float[nLayers + 1][seqLen * dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dLastOutput, 0, dLayerOutputs[nLayers], (seqLen - 1) * dModel, dModel);
 
 for (int l = nLayers - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
 float[] dRnnWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dRnnBias = new float[dModel];
 float[] dOutputWeight = new float[dModel * dModel];
 float[] dOutputBias = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int t = seqLen - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
 float[] dOut = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dLayerOutputs[l + 1], t * dModel, dOut, 0, dModel);
 
 float[] prevOutput = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(layerOutputs[l], t * dModel, prevOutput, 0, dModel);
 
 float[] input = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(layerInputs[l], t * dModel, input, 0, dModel);
 
 // 残差连接梯度
 float[] dResidual = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dOut, 0, dResidual, 0, dModel);
 
 // 输出层梯度
 float[] dHidden = matvec(transpose(rnnOutputWeights[l], dModel, dModel), dOut, dModel, dModel);
 
 // 输出权重梯度
 float[] hidden = matvec(rnnWeights[l], input, dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 hidden[i] += rnnBiases[l][i];
 }
 relu(hidden);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dOutputWeight[i * dModel + j] += hidden[i] * dOut[j];
 }
 }
 System.arraycopy(dOut, 0, dOutputBias, 0, dModel);
 
 // ReLU梯度
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 if (hidden[i] <= 0) {
 dHidden[i] = 0;
 }
 }
 
 // RNN权重梯度
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dRnnWeight[i * dModel + j] += input[i] * dHidden[j];
 }
 }
 System.arraycopy(dHidden, 0, dRnnBias, 0, dModel);
 
 // 前一层梯度
 float[] dPrev = matvec(transpose(rnnWeights[l], dModel, dModel), dHidden, dModel, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dPrev[i] += dResidual[i];
 }
 
 System.arraycopy(dPrev, 0, dLayerOutputs[l], t * dModel, dModel);
 }
 
 paramGrads.put("rnnWeight_" + l, dRnnWeight);
 paramGrads.put("rnnBias_" + l, dRnnBias);
 paramGrads.put("outputWeight_" + l, dOutputWeight);
 paramGrads.put("outputBias_" + l, dOutputBias);
 }
 
 // 4. Embedding梯度
 float[] dEmbedding = new float[vocabSize * dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int token = currentTokens[t];
 if (token >= 0 && token < vocabSize) {
 float[] dIn = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dLayerOutputs[0], t * dModel, dIn, 0, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dEmbedding[token * dModel + i] += dIn[i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 paramGrads.put("embedding", dEmbedding);
 
 // 将梯度添加到result中
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : paramGrads.entrySet()) {
 result.addGradient(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取嵌入
 */
 public float[] embed(int[] tokens) {
 float[] result = new float[tokens.length * dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < tokens.length; t++) {
 int token = tokens[t];
 if (token >= 0 && token < vocabSize) {
 System.arraycopy(embedding, token * dModel, result, t * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 更新参数
 */
 public void updateParametersWithGradient(Map<String, float[]> grads, float learningRate) {
 // 更新embedding
 float[] dEmbedding = grads.get("embedding");
 if (dEmbedding != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < embedding.length && i < dEmbedding.length; i++) {
 embedding[i] -= learningRate * dEmbedding[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 更新LM Head
 float[] dLmHeadWeight = grads.get("lmHeadWeight");
 if (dLmHeadWeight != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadWeight.length && i < dLmHeadWeight.length; i++) {
 lmHeadWeight[i] -= learningRate * dLmHeadWeight[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dLmHeadBias = grads.get("lmHeadBias");
 if (dLmHeadBias != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < lmHeadBias.length && i < dLmHeadBias.length; i++) {
 lmHeadBias[i] -= learningRate * dLmHeadBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 更新RNN层
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] dRnnWeight = grads.get("rnnWeight_" + l);
 if (dRnnWeight != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rnnWeights[l].length && i < dRnnWeight.length; i++) {
 rnnWeights[l][i] -= learningRate * dRnnWeight[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dRnnBias = grads.get("rnnBias_" + l);
 if (dRnnBias != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rnnBiases[l].length && i < dRnnBias.length; i++) {
 rnnBiases[l][i] -= learningRate * dRnnBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dOutputWeight = grads.get("outputWeight_" + l);
 if (dOutputWeight != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rnnOutputWeights[l].length && i < dOutputWeight.length; i++) {
 rnnOutputWeights[l][i] -= learningRate * dOutputWeight[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dOutputBias = grads.get("outputBias_" + l);
 if (dOutputBias != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < rnnOutputBiases[l].length && i < dOutputBias.length; i++) {
 rnnOutputBiases[l][i] -= learningRate * dOutputBias[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取所有权重数组
 */
 public float[][] getAllWeightArrays() {
 java.util.List<float[]> allWeights = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
 allWeights.add(embedding);
 allWeights.add(lmHeadWeight);
 allWeights.add(lmHeadBias);
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 allWeights.add(rnnWeights[l]);
 allWeights.add(rnnBiases[l]);
 allWeights.add(rnnOutputWeights[l]);
 allWeights.add(rnnOutputBiases[l]);
 }
 
 return allWeights.toArray(new float[0][]);
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取参数的Map形式，用于Adam优化器
 */
 public java.util.Map<String, float[]> getParametersMap() {
 java.util.Map<String, float[]> params = new java.util.HashMap<>();
 params.put("embedding", embedding);
 params.put("lmHeadWeight", lmHeadWeight);
 params.put("lmHeadBias", lmHeadBias);
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 params.put("rnnWeight_" + l, rnnWeights[l]);
 params.put("rnnBias_" + l, rnnBiases[l]);
 params.put("outputWeight_" + l, rnnOutputWeights[l]);
 params.put("outputBias_" + l, rnnOutputBiases[l]);
 }
 
 return params;
 }
 
 private float[] matvec(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N) {
 if (useGPU && gpu != null) {
 return gpu.matvec(A, x, M, N);
 }
 float[] y = new float[M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 y[i] += A[i * N + j] * x[j];
 }
 }
 return y;
 }
 
 private float[] transpose(float[] A, int M, int N) {
 float[] At = new float[N * M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 At[j * M + i] = A[i * N + j];
 }
 }
 return At;
 }
 
 private void relu(float[] x) {
 if (useGPU && gpu != null) {
 gpu.relu(x);
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] < 0) {
 x[i] = 0;
 }
 }
 }
 
 public int getVocabSize() { return vocabSize; }
 public int getDim() { return dModel; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.cognition.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token.ZYLAttentionSystem;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Random;

public class SimpCoreModel {

 private final int vocabSize;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nLayers;
 private final int maxSeqLen;
 private float[] embeddingWeights;
 private float[] posEncoding;
 private MultiHeadAttention[] mhaLayers;
 private ZYLAttentionSystem[] zylLayers;
 private boolean useZYLAttention = false;
 private AdaptiveBasisLayer[] ablLayers;
 private DynamicMemoryChannel[] dmcLayers;
 private TopologyAwareRouter[] tarLayers;
 private CausalInterventionNetwork[] cinLayers;
 private InformationBottleneck[] ibLayers;
 private MetaRepresentationDistiller[] mrdLayers;
 private PlasticityUpdateModule[] pumLayers;
 private float[][] ffnWeights1;
 private float[][] ffnWeights2;
 private float[] outputWeights;
 private float[][] layerNormWeight;
 private float[][] layerNormBias;
 private final Random random;
 private boolean inferenceMode;
 
 private float[][] dFFNWeights1;
 private float[][] dFFNWeights2;
 private float[] dOutputWeights;
 
 // 认知架构组件
 private boolean enableCognition;
 private HierarchicalPerceptionModule hierarchicalPerception;
 private WorkingMemoryController workingMemory;
 private CognitiveReasoner cognitiveReasoner;
 private SchemaLearningModule schemaLearning;

 public SimpCoreModel(int vocabSize, int dModel, int nLayers, int nBases, int nHeads,
 int nChannels, int nPaths, int topK, int maxSeqLen) {
 this(vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, nBases, nHeads, nChannels, nPaths, topK, maxSeqLen, false);
 }

 public SimpCoreModel(int vocabSize, int dModel, int nLayers, int nBases, int nHeads,
 int nChannels, int nPaths, int topK, int maxSeqLen, boolean enableCognition) {
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nLayers = nLayers;
 this.maxSeqLen = maxSeqLen;
 this.enableCognition = enableCognition;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 initModel(nBases, nHeads, nChannels, nPaths, topK);
 if (enableCognition) {
 initCognitionComponents();
 }
 }

 public SimpCoreModel(int dModel, int nLayers, int nHeads, int vocabSize, int maxSeqLen) {
 this(vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, nHeads, nHeads, 4, 8, 2, maxSeqLen);
 }

 private void initModel(int nBases, int nHeads, int nChannels, int nPaths, int topK) {
 embeddingWeights = new float[vocabSize * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize * dModel; i++) {
 embeddingWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }

 posEncoding = new float[maxSeqLen * dModel];
 initPosEncoding();

 mhaLayers = new MultiHeadAttention[nLayers];
 ablLayers = new AdaptiveBasisLayer[nLayers];
 dmcLayers = new DynamicMemoryChannel[nLayers];
 tarLayers = new TopologyAwareRouter[nLayers];
 cinLayers = new CausalInterventionNetwork[nLayers];
 ibLayers = new InformationBottleneck[nLayers];
 mrdLayers = new MetaRepresentationDistiller[nLayers];
 pumLayers = new PlasticityUpdateModule[nLayers];

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 mhaLayers[l] = new MultiHeadAttention(dModel, nHeads);
 ablLayers[l] = new AdaptiveBasisLayer(dModel, nBases, nHeads);
 dmcLayers[l] = new DynamicMemoryChannel(dModel, nChannels, dModel);
 tarLayers[l] = new TopologyAwareRouter(dModel, nPaths, topK);
 cinLayers[l] = new CausalInterventionNetwork(dModel);
 ibLayers[l] = new InformationBottleneck(dModel, 0.8f);
 mrdLayers[l] = new MetaRepresentationDistiller(dModel, dModel / 4);
 pumLayers[l] = new PlasticityUpdateModule(dModel);
 }

 ffnWeights1 = new float[nLayers][dModel * dModel * 4];
 ffnWeights2 = new float[nLayers][dModel * 4 * dModel];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dModel * 4; i++) {
 ffnWeights1[l][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * 4 * dModel; i++) {
 ffnWeights2[l][i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }
 }

 outputWeights = new float[dModel * vocabSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * vocabSize; i++) {
 outputWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.05f;
 }

 layerNormWeight = new float[nLayers][dModel];
 layerNormBias = new float[nLayers][dModel];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 layerNormWeight[l][i] = 1.0f;
 layerNormBias[l][i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }

 this.inferenceMode = false;
 
 dFFNWeights1 = new float[nLayers][dModel * dModel * 4];
 dFFNWeights2 = new float[nLayers][dModel * 4 * dModel];
 dOutputWeights = new float[dModel * vocabSize];
 }
 
 private void initCognitionComponents() {
 hierarchicalPerception = new HierarchicalPerceptionModule(dModel);
 workingMemory = new WorkingMemoryController(dModel);
 cognitiveReasoner = new CognitiveReasoner(dModel);
 schemaLearning = new SchemaLearningModule(dModel);
 }

 private void initPosEncoding() {
 for (int pos = 0; pos < maxSeqLen; pos++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i += 2) {
 posEncoding[pos * dModel + i] = (float) Math.sin(pos / Math.pow(10000, i / (double) dModel));
 posEncoding[pos * dModel + i + 1] = (float) Math.cos(pos / Math.pow(10000, i / (double) dModel));
 }
 }
 }

 public float[] forward(int[] inputIds) {
 return forward(inputIds, 1, inputIds.length);
 }
 
 public float[] forward(int[] inputIds, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] hidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int tokenId = inputIds[b * seqLen + s];
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 int posIdx = Math.min(s, maxSeqLen - 1);
 hidden[offset + i] = embeddingWeights[tokenId * dModel + i] + posEncoding[posIdx * dModel + i];
 }
 }
 }

 // 认知增强：通过分层感知模块处理嵌入
 if (enableCognition && hierarchicalPerception != null) {
 float[] perceived = hierarchicalPerception.forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(perceived, 0, hidden, 0, totalSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(perceived);
 }

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] mhaOutput;
 if (useZYLAttention && zylLayers != null) {
 mhaOutput = zylLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen).output;
 } else {
 mhaOutput = mhaLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 
 float[] attentionResidual = new float[batchSize * seqLen * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen * dModel; i++) {
 attentionResidual[i] = hidden[i] + mhaOutput[i];
 }
 
 float[] mhaNorm = new float[batchSize * seqLen * dModel];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = attentionResidual[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mhaNorm[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] rfpOutput = ablLayers[l].forward(mhaNorm, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] dmcOutput = dmcLayers[l].forward(rfpOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] tarOutput = tarLayers[l].forward(dmcOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] cinOutput = cinLayers[l].forward(tarOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ibOutput = ibLayers[l].forward(cinOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ffnOutput = applyFFN(ibOutput, ffnWeights1[l], ffnWeights2[l], batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] mrdOutput = mrdLayers[l].forward(ffnOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] spmOutput = pumLayers[l].forward(mrdOutput, batchSize, seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = mhaNorm[offset + j] + spmOutput[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(layerInput, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 hidden[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(mhaOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rfpOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dmcOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(tarOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(cinOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(ibOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(ffnOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(mrdOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(spmOutput);
 }

 // 认知增强：通过推理器和模式学习处理Transformer输出
 if (enableCognition && cognitiveReasoner != null && workingMemory != null) {
 // 执行多步推理（利用工作记忆）
 float[] reasoned = cognitiveReasoner.reason(hidden, cognitiveReasoner.getDefaultSteps(), workingMemory);
 System.arraycopy(reasoned, 0, hidden, 0, totalSize);
 
 // 工作记忆衰减和巩固
 workingMemory.decay();
 workingMemory.consolidate();
 
 // 模式学习增强
 if (schemaLearning != null) {
 float[] schemed = schemaLearning.forward(hidden);
 System.arraycopy(schemed, 0, hidden, 0, totalSize);
 }
 }

 float[] logits = MatrixOperations.matmul(hidden, outputWeights, batchSize * seqLen, dModel, vocabSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hidden);
 return logits;
 }

 private float[] applyFFN(float[] x, float[] w1, float[] w2, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 
 float[] hidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(batchSize * seqLen * dModel * 4);

 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(x, i * dModel, rowData, 0, dModel);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w1, 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 hidden[i * dModel * 4 + j] = (float) (result[j] * (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-result[j]))));
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 }

 float[] output = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * 4);
 System.arraycopy(hidden, i * dModel * 4, rowData, 0, dModel * 4);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w2, 1, dModel * 4, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(result, 0, output, i * dModel, dModel);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hidden);
 return output;
 }

 private static final jdk.incubator.vector.VectorSpecies<Float> VECTOR_SPECIES = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.SPECIES_PREFERRED;
 
 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x, int layer) {
 float mean = 0f;
 int i = 0;
 
 for (; i + VECTOR_SPECIES.length() <= dModel; i += VECTOR_SPECIES.length()) {
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector vec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, x, i);
 mean += vec.reduceLanes(jdk.incubator.vector.VectorOperators.ADD);
 }
 for (; i < dModel; i++) {
 mean += x[i];
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0f;
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector meanVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.broadcast(VECTOR_SPECIES, mean);
 i = 0;
 
 for (; i + VECTOR_SPECIES.length() <= dModel; i += VECTOR_SPECIES.length()) {
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector vec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, x, i);
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector diff = vec.sub(meanVec);
 var += diff.mul(diff).reduceLanes(jdk.incubator.vector.VectorOperators.ADD);
 }
 for (; i < dModel; i++) {
 float diff = x[i] - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] output = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 float invStd = 1.0f / (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector invStdVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.broadcast(VECTOR_SPECIES, invStd);
 
 i = 0;
 for (; i + VECTOR_SPECIES.length() <= dModel; i += VECTOR_SPECIES.length()) {
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector xVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, x, i);
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector wVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, layerNormWeight[layer], i);
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector bVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, layerNormBias[layer], i);
 
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector normalized = xVec.sub(meanVec).mul(invStdVec);
 normalized.mul(wVec).add(bVec).intoArray(output, i);
 }
 for (; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) * invStd * layerNormWeight[layer][i] + layerNormBias[layer][i];
 }
 
 return output;
 }

 public int[] generate(int[] inputIds, int maxNewTokens, int eosTokenId) {
 int currentLen = inputIds.length;
 int[] outputIds = Arrays.copyOf(inputIds, currentLen + maxNewTokens);

 boolean prevInferenceMode = this.inferenceMode;
 this.inferenceMode = true;
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 pumLayers[l].setEnabled(false);
 dmcLayers[l].resetMemory();
 }

 try {
 for (int t = 0; t < maxNewTokens; t++) {
 int seqLen = Math.min(currentLen + t, maxSeqLen);
 int startIdx = currentLen + t - seqLen;
 int[] inputSlice = Arrays.copyOfRange(outputIds, startIdx, currentLen + t);

 float[] logits = forward(inputSlice, 1, seqLen);
 float[] lastLogits = Arrays.copyOfRange(logits, (seqLen - 1) * vocabSize, seqLen * vocabSize);

 float[] probs = MatrixOperations.softmax(lastLogits);

 int nextToken = sampleToken(probs);
 outputIds[currentLen + t] = nextToken;

 if (nextToken == eosTokenId) {
 return Arrays.copyOf(outputIds, currentLen + t + 1);
 }
 }
 } finally {
 this.inferenceMode = prevInferenceMode;
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 pumLayers[l].setEnabled(!prevInferenceMode);
 }
 }

 return Arrays.copyOf(outputIds, currentLen + maxNewTokens);
 }

 private int sampleToken(float[] probs) {
 float r = random.nextFloat();
 float cumsum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < probs.length; i++) {
 cumsum += probs[i];
 if (cumsum >= r) {
 return i;
 }
 }
 return probs.length - 1;
 }

 public void save(String filePath) {
 try {
 java.io.DataOutputStream dos = new java.io.DataOutputStream(
 new java.io.FileOutputStream(filePath));
 save(dos);
 dos.close();
 } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Save failed", e);
 }
 }

 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws java.io.IOException {
 dos.writeInt(vocabSize);
 dos.writeInt(dModel);
 dos.writeInt(nLayers);
 dos.writeInt(maxSeqLen);
 dos.writeInt(ablLayers[0].getNBases());
 dos.writeInt(ablLayers[0].getNHeads());
 dos.writeInt(dmcLayers[0].getNChannels());
 dos.writeInt(tarLayers[0].getNPaths());
 dos.writeInt(tarLayers[0].getTopK());

 for (float f : embeddingWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : posEncoding) dos.writeFloat(f);

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 mhaLayers[l].save(dos);
 ablLayers[l].save(dos);
 dmcLayers[l].save(dos);
 tarLayers[l].save(dos);
 cinLayers[l].save(dos);
 ibLayers[l].save(dos);
 mrdLayers[l].save(dos);
 pumLayers[l].save(dos);
 }

 for (float[] w : ffnWeights1) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] w : ffnWeights2) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : outputWeights) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] w : layerNormWeight) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float[] w : layerNormBias) for (float f : w) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }

 public static SimpCoreModel load(String filePath) {
 try {
 java.io.DataInputStream dis = new java.io.DataInputStream(
 new java.io.FileInputStream(filePath));
 SimpCoreModel model = loadFromStream(dis);
 dis.close();
 return model;
 } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Load failed", e);
 }
 }

 public static SimpCoreModel loadFromStream(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws java.io.IOException {
 int vocabSize = dis.readInt();
 int dModel = dis.readInt();
 int nLayers = dis.readInt();
 int maxSeqLen = dis.readInt();
 int nBases = dis.readInt();
 int nHeads = dis.readInt();
 int nChannels = dis.readInt();
 int nPaths = dis.readInt();
 int topK = dis.readInt();

 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, nBases, nHeads, nChannels, nPaths, topK, maxSeqLen);

 for (int i = 0; i < model.embeddingWeights.length; i++) {
 model.embeddingWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < model.posEncoding.length; i++) {
 model.posEncoding[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 model.mhaLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.ablLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.dmcLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.tarLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.cinLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.ibLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.mrdLayers[l].load(dis);
 model.pumLayers[l].load(dis);
 }

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < model.ffnWeights1[l].length; i++) {
 model.ffnWeights1[l][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < model.ffnWeights2[l].length; i++) {
 model.ffnWeights2[l][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < model.outputWeights.length; i++) {
 model.outputWeights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 model.layerNormWeight[l][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 model.layerNormBias[l][i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }

 return model;
 }

 public int getVocabSize() { return vocabSize; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNLayers() { return nLayers; }
 public int getMaxSeqLen() { return maxSeqLen; }

 public boolean isInferenceMode() { return inferenceMode; }

 public void setInferenceMode(boolean inferenceMode) {
 this.inferenceMode = inferenceMode;
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 pumLayers[l].setEnabled(!inferenceMode);
 }
 }

 public boolean isUseZYLAttention() { return useZYLAttention; }

 public void setUseZYLAttention(boolean useZYL) {
 this.useZYLAttention = useZYL;
 if (useZYL && zylLayers == null) {
 initializeZYLAttention();
 }
 }

 private void initializeZYLAttention() {
 zylLayers = new ZYLAttentionSystem[nLayers];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLConfig config = new ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLConfig();
 config.maxContextLength = maxSeqLen;
 config.nHeads = mhaLayers[0].getNHeads();
 config.dModel = dModel;
 config.headDim = mhaLayers[0].getHeadDim();
 config.slidingWindowSize = Math.min(4096, maxSeqLen);
 zylLayers[l] = new ZYLAttentionSystem(config);
 zylLayers[l].initialize();
 }
 }

 public float[] getEmbeddingWeights() { return embeddingWeights; }
 public float[] getPosEncoding() { return posEncoding; }
 public float[] getOutputWeights() { return outputWeights; }
 public float[][] getFfnWeights1() { return ffnWeights1; }
 public float[][] getFfnWeights2() { return ffnWeights2; }
 public float[][] getLayerNormWeight() { return layerNormWeight; }
 public float[][] getLayerNormBias() { return layerNormBias; }

 public MultiHeadAttention[] getMhaLayers() { return mhaLayers; }
 public ZYLAttentionSystem[] getZylLayers() { return zylLayers; }
 public AdaptiveBasisLayer[] getAblLayers() { return ablLayers; }
 public DynamicMemoryChannel[] getDmcLayers() { return dmcLayers; }
 public TopologyAwareRouter[] getTarLayers() { return tarLayers; }
 public CausalInterventionNetwork[] getCinLayers() { return cinLayers; }
 public InformationBottleneck[] getIbLayers() { return ibLayers; }
 public MetaRepresentationDistiller[] getMrdLayers() { return mrdLayers; }
 public PlasticityUpdateModule[] getPumLayers() { return pumLayers; }
 
 // 认知架构组件getters
 public boolean isEnableCognition() { return enableCognition; }
 public HierarchicalPerceptionModule getHierarchicalPerception() { return hierarchicalPerception; }
 public WorkingMemoryController getWorkingMemory() { return workingMemory; }
 public CognitiveReasoner getCognitiveReasoner() { return cognitiveReasoner; }
 public SchemaLearningModule getSchemaLearning() { return schemaLearning; }
 
 public void setEnableCognition(boolean enableCognition) {
 this.enableCognition = enableCognition;
 if (enableCognition && hierarchicalPerception == null) {
 initCognitionComponents();
 }
 }

 public float[] forwardPartial(float[] hidden, int startLayer, int endLayer) {
 int batchSize = hidden.length / (maxSeqLen * dModel);
 int seqLen = maxSeqLen;
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 
 for (int l = startLayer; l < endLayer && l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] mhaOutput;
 if (useZYLAttention && zylLayers != null) {
 mhaOutput = zylLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen).output;
 } else {
 mhaOutput = mhaLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 
 float[] attentionResidual = new float[totalSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 attentionResidual[i] = hidden[i] + mhaOutput[i];
 }
 
 float[] mhaNorm = new float[totalSize];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = attentionResidual[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mhaNorm[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] rfpOutput = ablLayers[l].forward(mhaNorm, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] dmcOutput = dmcLayers[l].forward(rfpOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] tarOutput = tarLayers[l].forward(dmcOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] cinOutput = cinLayers[l].forward(tarOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ibOutput = ibLayers[l].forward(cinOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ffnOutput = applyFFN(ibOutput, ffnWeights1[l], ffnWeights2[l], batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] mrdOutput = mrdLayers[l].forward(ffnOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] spmOutput = pumLayers[l].forward(mrdOutput, batchSize, seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = mhaNorm[offset + j] + spmOutput[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(layerInput, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 hidden[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 return hidden;
 }

 public float[] backwardPartial(float[] gradients, int startLayer, int endLayer) {
 int totalSize = gradients.length;
 if (totalSize == 0 || totalSize % dModel != 0) {
 return gradients;
 }
 int seqLen = (int) Math.sqrt((double) totalSize / dModel);
 if (seqLen == 0) {
 return gradients;
 }
 int batchSize = totalSize / (seqLen * dModel);
 return backwardPartial(gradients, startLayer, endLayer, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 
 public float[] backwardPartial(float[] gradients, int startLayer, int endLayer, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] dHidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 System.arraycopy(gradients, 0, dHidden, 0, totalSize);
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 Arrays.fill(dFFNWeights1[l], 0);
 Arrays.fill(dFFNWeights2[l], 0);
 }
 Arrays.fill(dOutputWeights, 0);
 
 for (int l = Math.min(endLayer - 1, nLayers - 1); l >= startLayer; l--) {
 float[] dLayerNorm2 = new float[totalSize];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = dHidden[offset + j];
 }
 float[] dNorm = backwardLayerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dLayerNorm2[offset + j] = dNorm[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] dSPM = pumLayers[l].backward(dLayerNorm2, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 float[] dMRD = mrdLayers[l].backward(dSPM, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 
 GradientResult ffnGrad = backwardFFN(dMRD, ffnWeights1[l], ffnWeights2[l], l, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] dIB = ibLayers[l].backward(ffnGrad.getdInput(), new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 float[] dCIN = cinLayers[l].backward(dIB, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 float[] dTAR = tarLayers[l].backward(dCIN, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 float[] dDMC = dmcLayers[l].backward(dTAR, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 float[] dRFP = ablLayers[l].backward(dDMC, new float[totalSize], batchSize, seqLen).getdInput();
 
 float[] dLayerNorm1 = new float[totalSize];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = dRFP[offset + j];
 }
 float[] dNorm = backwardLayerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dLayerNorm1[offset + j] = dNorm[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] dMHA;
 if (useZYLAttention && zylLayers != null) {
 dMHA = dLayerNorm1;
 } else {
 float[] dummyInput = new float[totalSize];
 GradientResult mhaGrad = mhaLayers[l].backward(dLayerNorm1, dummyInput, batchSize, seqLen);
 dMHA = mhaGrad.getdInput();
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 dHidden[i] = dMHA[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[totalSize];
 System.arraycopy(dHidden, 0, result, 0, totalSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dHidden);
 return result;
 }
 
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < ffnWeights1[l].length; i++) {
 ffnWeights1[l][i] -= learningRate * dFFNWeights1[l][i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < ffnWeights2[l].length; i++) {
 ffnWeights2[l][i] -= learningRate * dFFNWeights2[l][i];
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < outputWeights.length; i++) {
 outputWeights[i] -= learningRate * dOutputWeights[i];
 }
 }
 
 public void updateParametersDirect(float[] gradients, float learningRate, int seqLen) {
 int batchSize = gradients.length / (seqLen * vocabSize);
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen - 1; s++) {
 int gradOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * vocabSize;
 int hiddenOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 int idx = i * dModel + j;
 outputWeights[idx] -= learningRate * gradients[gradOffset + i] * 
 (hiddenOffset + j < gradients.length ? gradients[hiddenOffset + j] : 1);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private float[] backwardLayerNorm(float[] dOutput, int layer) {
 float[] result = new float[dModel];
 
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector dOutVec;
 jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector wVec;
 
 int i = 0;
 for (; i + VECTOR_SPECIES.length() <= dModel; i += VECTOR_SPECIES.length()) {
 dOutVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, dOutput, i);
 wVec = jdk.incubator.vector.FloatVector.fromArray(VECTOR_SPECIES, layerNormWeight[layer], i);
 dOutVec.mul(wVec).intoArray(result, i);
 }
 for (; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[i] = dOutput[i] * layerNormWeight[layer][i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private GradientResult backwardFFN(float[] dOutput, float[] w1, float[] w2, int layer, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dOutput, i * dModel, rowData, 0, dModel);
 float[] dW2 = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w2, 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 dFFNWeights2[layer][i * dModel * 4 + j] += dW2[j];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = new float[dModel * 4];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 rowData[j] = dFFNWeights2[layer][i * dModel * 4 + j];
 }
 float[] dW1 = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w1, 1, dModel * 4, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(dW1, 0, dInput, i * dModel, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * dModel * 4; j++) {
 dFFNWeights1[layer][j] += rowData[j / dModel] * dOutput[(i * dModel) + (j % dModel)];
 }
 }
 
 GradientResult result = new GradientResult(dInput);
 return result;
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] input, int batchSize) {
 int seqLen = input.length / (batchSize * dModel);
 return forward(input, batchSize, seqLen);
 }

 public float[] forward(float[] input, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] hidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 
 System.arraycopy(input, 0, hidden, 0, Math.min(input.length, totalSize));
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] mhaOutput;
 if (useZYLAttention && zylLayers != null) {
 mhaOutput = zylLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen).output;
 } else {
 mhaOutput = mhaLayers[l].forward(hidden, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 
 float[] attentionResidual = new float[totalSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 attentionResidual[i] = hidden[i] + mhaOutput[i];
 }
 
 float[] mhaNorm = new float[totalSize];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = attentionResidual[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mhaNorm[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] rfpOutput = ablLayers[l].forward(mhaNorm, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] dmcOutput = dmcLayers[l].forward(rfpOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] tarOutput = tarLayers[l].forward(dmcOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] cinOutput = cinLayers[l].forward(tarOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ibOutput = ibLayers[l].forward(cinOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] ffnOutput = applyFFN(ibOutput, ffnWeights1[l], ffnWeights2[l], batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] mrdOutput = mrdLayers[l].forward(ffnOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 float[] spmOutput = pumLayers[l].forward(mrdOutput, batchSize, seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = mhaNorm[offset + j] + spmOutput[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(layerInput, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 hidden[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 float[] logits = MatrixOperations.matmul(hidden, outputWeights, batchSize * seqLen, dModel, vocabSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hidden);
 return logits;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Tokenizer {

 private final Map<String, Integer> tokenToId;
 private final List<String> idToToken;
 private final int maxTokenLength;
 private final String bosToken = "<bos>";
 private final String eosToken = "<eos>";
 private final String padToken = "<pad>";
 private final String unkToken = "<unk>";

 public Tokenizer(int vocabSize) {
 this.tokenToId = new HashMap<>();
 this.idToToken = new ArrayList<>();
 this.maxTokenLength = 10;

 int id = 0;
 tokenToId.put(bosToken, id);
 idToToken.add(bosToken);
 id++;

 tokenToId.put(eosToken, id);
 idToToken.add(eosToken);
 id++;

 tokenToId.put(padToken, id);
 idToToken.add(padToken);
 id++;

 tokenToId.put(unkToken, id);
 idToToken.add(unkToken);
 id++;

 for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
 String token = String.valueOf(c);
 if (id < vocabSize) {
 tokenToId.put(token, id);
 idToToken.add(token);
 id++;
 }
 }

 for (char c = 'A'; c <= 'Z'; c++) {
 String token = String.valueOf(c);
 if (id < vocabSize) {
 tokenToId.put(token, id);
 idToToken.add(token);
 id++;
 }
 }

 for (char c = '0'; c <= '9'; c++) {
 String token = String.valueOf(c);
 if (id < vocabSize) {
 tokenToId.put(token, id);
 idToToken.add(token);
 id++;
 }
 }

 String[] specialChars = {" ", ".", ",", "!", "?", ":", ";", "-", "_", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}", "\"", "'", "\\", "/", "<", ">", "=", "+", "~", "`", "|"};
 for (String ch : specialChars) {
 if (id < vocabSize) {
 tokenToId.put(ch, id);
 idToToken.add(ch);
 id++;
 }
 }

 while (id < vocabSize) {
 String extraToken = "<extra_" + (id - 4 - 26 - 26 - 10 - 33) + ">";
 tokenToId.put(extraToken, id);
 idToToken.add(extraToken);
 id++;
 }
 }

 private String generateRandomToken(int seed) {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 Random rnd = new Random(seed);
 int length = 2 + rnd.nextInt(5);
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 sb.append((char) ('a' + rnd.nextInt(26)));
 }
 return sb.toString();
 }

 public int[] encode(String text) {
 List<Integer> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
 tokens.add(tokenToId.get(bosToken));

 int i = 0;
 while (i < text.length()) {
 boolean found = false;
 for (int len = Math.min(maxTokenLength, text.length() - i); len >= 1; len--) {
 String substr = text.substring(i, i + len);
 if (tokenToId.containsKey(substr)) {
 tokens.add(tokenToId.get(substr));
 i += len;
 found = true;
 break;
 }
 }
 if (!found) {
 tokens.add(tokenToId.get(unkToken));
 i++;
 }
 }

 tokens.add(tokenToId.get(eosToken));
 return tokens.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 }

 public String decode(int[] tokens) {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 for (int tokenId : tokens) {
 if (tokenId >= 0 && tokenId < idToToken.size()) {
 String token = idToToken.get(tokenId);
 if (!token.equals(bosToken) && !token.equals(eosToken) && !token.equals(padToken) && !token.equals(unkToken) && !token.startsWith("<extra_")) {
 sb.append(token);
 }
 }
 }
 return sb.toString();
 }

 public int getVocabSize() {
 return tokenToId.size();
 }

 public int getBosTokenId() {
 return tokenToId.get(bosToken);
 }

 public int getEosTokenId() {
 return tokenToId.get(eosToken);
 }

 public int getPadTokenId() {
 return tokenToId.get(padToken);
 }

 public int getUnkTokenId() {
 return tokenToId.get(unkToken);
 }

 public void save(String filePath) throws IOException {
 try (ObjectOutputStream oos = new ObjectOutputStream(new FileOutputStream(filePath))) {
 oos.writeObject(new HashMap<>(tokenToId));
 oos.writeObject(new ArrayList<>(idToToken));
 }
 }

 @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 public static Tokenizer load(String filePath) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException {
 try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(new FileInputStream(filePath))) {
 Map<String, Integer> tokenMap = (Map<String, Integer>) ois.readObject();
 List<String> idList = (List<String>) ois.readObject();

 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(0);
 tokenizer.tokenToId.clear();
 tokenizer.tokenToId.putAll(tokenMap);
 tokenizer.idToToken.clear();
 tokenizer.idToToken.addAll(idList);

 return tokenizer;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

/**
 * Transformer Block - 包含多头注意力、FFN、残差连接和层归一化
 */
public class TransformerBlock {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nHeads;
 
 // 组件
 private MultiHeadAttention attention;
 private FeedForwardNetwork ffn;
 private LayerNorm attnNorm;
 private LayerNorm ffnNorm;
 
 // GPU加速
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 // 缓存
 private float[][] attentionInput;
 private float[][] attentionOutput;
 private float[][] ffnInput;
 private float[][] ffnOutput;
 
 public TransformerBlock(int dModel, int nHeads) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 initComponents();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 private void initComponents() {
 attention = new MultiHeadAttention(dModel, nHeads);
 ffn = new FeedForwardNetwork(dModel);
 attnNorm = new LayerNorm(dModel);
 ffnNorm = new LayerNorm(dModel);
 }
 
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = OpenCLAccelerator.getInstance();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播
 */
 public float[][] forward(float[][] x) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 
 // 保存输入
 attentionInput = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 System.arraycopy(x[t], 0, attentionInput[t], 0, dModel);
 }
 
 // 层归一化 -> 注意力 -> 残差连接
 float[][] norm1 = attnNorm.forward(x);
 attentionOutput = attention.forward(norm1);
 
 float[][] attnResidual = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 attnResidual[t][i] = x[t][i] + attentionOutput[t][i];
 }
 }
 
 // 保存FFN输入
 ffnInput = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 System.arraycopy(attnResidual[t], 0, ffnInput[t], 0, dModel);
 }
 
 // 层归一化 -> FFN -> 残差连接
 float[][] norm2 = ffnNorm.forward(attnResidual);
 ffnOutput = ffn.forward(norm2);
 
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[t][i] = attnResidual[t][i] + ffnOutput[t][i];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 反向传播
 */
 public float[][] backward(float[][] dOutput) {
 int seqLen = dOutput.length;
 
 // FFN残差梯度
 float[][] dFFNResidual = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 System.arraycopy(dOutput[t], 0, dFFNResidual[t], 0, dModel);
 }
 
 // FFN反向传播
 float[][] dNorm2 = ffn.backward(dFFNResidual);
 float[][] dAttnResidual = ffnNorm.backward(dNorm2);
 
 // 注意力残差梯度
 float[][] dAttnResidualTotal = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dAttnResidualTotal[t][j] = dAttnResidual[t][j] + dFFNResidual[t][j];
 }
 }
 
 // 注意力反向传播
 float[][] dNorm1 = attention.backward(dAttnResidualTotal);
 float[][] dInput = attnNorm.backward(dNorm1);
 
 return dInput;
 }
 
 /**
 * Feed Forward Network
 */
 private static class FeedForwardNetwork {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private final int dFF;
 
 private float[] w1; // [dModel, dFF]
 private float[] b1; // [dFF]
 private float[] w2; // [dFF, dModel]
 private float[] b2; // [dModel]
 
 public FeedForwardNetwork(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.dFF = dModel * 4;
 initWeights();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 w1 = new float[dModel * dFF];
 b1 = new float[dFF];
 w2 = new float[dFF * dModel];
 b2 = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * dFF; i++) {
 w1[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < dFF * dModel; i++) {
 w2[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 public float[][] forward(float[][] x) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 第一层：线性 + ReLU
 float[] hidden = matvec(w1, x[t], dFF, dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < dFF; i++) {
 hidden[i] += b1[i];
 if (hidden[i] < 0) hidden[i] = 0; // ReLU
 }
 
 // 第二层：线性
 float[] output = matvec(w2, hidden, dModel, dFF);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 output[i] += b2[i];
 }
 
 result[t] = output;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public float[][] backward(float[][] dOutput) {
 int seqLen = dOutput.length;
 float[][] dInput = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 第二层梯度
 float[] dHidden = matvec(transpose(w2, dFF, dModel), dOutput[t], dFF, dModel);
 
 // ReLU梯度
 for (int i = 0; i < dFF; i++) {
 if (dHidden[i] < 0) dHidden[i] = 0;
 }
 
 // 第一层梯度
 dInput[t] = matvec(transpose(w1, dModel, dFF), dHidden, dModel, dFF);
 }
 
 return dInput;
 }
 
 private float[] matvec(float[] A, float[] x, int M, int N) {
 float[] y = new float[M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 y[i] += A[i * N + j] * x[j];
 }
 }
 return y;
 }
 
 private float[] transpose(float[] A, int M, int N) {
 float[] At = new float[N * M];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 At[j * M + i] = A[i * N + j];
 }
 }
 return At;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * Layer Normalization
 */
 private static class LayerNorm {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private float[] gamma;
 private float[] beta;
 private static final float eps = 1e-5f;
 
 public LayerNorm(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 gamma = new float[dModel];
 beta = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 gamma[i] = 1.0f;
 beta[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 
 public float[][] forward(float[][] x) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 计算均值
 float mean = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 mean += x[t][i];
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 // 计算方差
 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 var += (x[t][i] - mean) * (x[t][i] - mean);
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 // 归一化
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + eps);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[t][i] = gamma[i] * ((x[t][i] - mean) / std) + beta[i];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public float[][] backward(float[][] dOutput) {
 return dOutput; // 简化实现
 }
 }
 
 public MultiHeadAttention getAttention() { return attention; }
 public FeedForwardNetwork getFFN() { return ffn; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Transformer MoE Model - 完整的文本模型
 * 整合Multi-Head Attention、TransformerBlock和MoE专家堆叠架构
 */
public class TransformerMoEModel {
 
 // 模型配置
 private final int vocabSize;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int nLayers;
 private final int nHeads;
 private final int nExperts;
 private final int topK;
 
 // 组件
 private float[] embedding; // [vocabSize, dModel]
 private MoELayer[] moeLayers; // MoE层堆叠
 private float[] finalNormWeight; // [dModel]
 private float[] finalNormBias; // [dModel]
 private float[] lmHeadWeight; // [dModel, vocabSize]
 private float[] lmHeadBias; // [vocabSize]
 
 // GPU加速
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 // 缓存
 private float[][][] hiddenStates;
 private float[][] lastHiddenState;
 
 public TransformerMoEModel(int vocabSize, int dModel, int nLayers, int nHeads, int nExperts, int topK) {
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nLayers = nLayers;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.topK = topK;
 
 initEmbedding();
 initMoELayers();
 initFinalNorm();
 initLMHead();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 private void initEmbedding() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 embedding = new float[vocabSize * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize * dModel; i++) {
 embedding[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 private void initMoELayers() {
 moeLayers = new MoELayer[nLayers];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 moeLayers[l] = new MoELayer(dModel, nHeads, nExperts, topK);
 }
 }
 
 private void initFinalNorm() {
 finalNormWeight = new float[dModel];
 finalNormBias = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 finalNormWeight[i] = 1.0f;
 finalNormBias[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 
 private void initLMHead() {
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dModel));
 lmHeadWeight = new float[dModel * vocabSize];
 lmHeadBias = new float[vocabSize];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel * vocabSize; i++) {
 lmHeadWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = OpenCLAccelerator.getInstance();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播
 * @param inputIds 输入token序列 [seqLen]
 * @return logits [seqLen, vocabSize]
 */
 public float[][] forward(int[] inputIds) {
 int seqLen = inputIds.length;
 
 // 获取嵌入
 float[][] hidden = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int tokenId = inputIds[t];
 if (tokenId >= 0 && tokenId < vocabSize) {
 System.arraycopy(embedding, tokenId * dModel, hidden[t], 0, dModel);
 }
 }
 
 // 保存隐藏状态
 hiddenStates = new float[nLayers][][];
 
 // MoE层前向传播
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 hidden = moeLayers[l].forward(hidden);
 hiddenStates[l] = hidden;
 }
 
 // 最终层归一化
 lastHiddenState = layerNorm(hidden, finalNormWeight, finalNormBias);
 
 // LM头
 float[][] logits = new float[seqLen][vocabSize];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 logits[t][i] += lastHiddenState[t][j] * lmHeadWeight[j * vocabSize + i];
 }
 logits[t][i] += lmHeadBias[i];
 }
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 /**
 * 层归一化
 */
 private float[][] layerNorm(float[][] x, float[] weight, float[] bias) {
 int seqLen = x.length;
 float[][] result = new float[seqLen][dModel];
 float eps = 1e-5f;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 // 计算均值
 float mean = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 mean += x[t][i];
 }
 mean /= dModel;
 
 // 计算方差
 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 var += (x[t][i] - mean) * (x[t][i] - mean);
 }
 var /= dModel;
 
 // 归一化
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + eps);
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[t][i] = weight[i] * ((x[t][i] - mean) / std) + bias[i];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取参数的Map形式，用于Adam优化器
 */
 public Map<String, float[]> getParametersMap() {
 Map<String, float[]> params = new HashMap<>();
 params.put("embedding", embedding);
 params.put("lmHeadWeight", lmHeadWeight);
 params.put("lmHeadBias", lmHeadBias);
 params.put("finalNormWeight", finalNormWeight);
 params.put("finalNormBias", finalNormBias);
 
 // 添加MoE层参数
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 MoELayer moe = moeLayers[l];
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_routerWeight", moe.getRouterWeight());
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_routerBias", moe.getRouterBias());
 
 // 添加专家参数
 TransformerBlock[] experts = moe.getExperts();
 for (int e = 0; e < experts.length; e++) {
 MultiHeadAttention attn = experts[e].getAttention();
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_expert_" + e + "_qWeight", attn.getQWeight());
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_expert_" + e + "_kWeight", attn.getKWeight());
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_expert_" + e + "_vWeight", attn.getVWeight());
 params.put("moe_" + l + "_expert_" + e + "_oWeight", attn.getOWeight());
 }
 }
 
 return params;
 }
 
 /**
 * 计算参数总数
 */
 public long getParameterCount() {
 long count = 0;
 
 // 嵌入层
 count += (long) vocabSize * dModel;
 
 // LM头
 count += (long) dModel * vocabSize + vocabSize;
 
 // 最终归一化
 count += dModel * 2;
 
 // MoE层
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 // 路由参数
 count += (long) dModel * nExperts + nExperts;
 
 // 专家参数
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 // 每个专家：Q, K, V, Output投影
 count += (long) dModel * dModel * 4;
 }
 }
 
 return count;
 }
 
 /**
 * 生成文本（贪婪解码）
 */
 public int[] generate(int[] prompt, int maxLen) {
 int[] result = new int[prompt.length + maxLen];
 System.arraycopy(prompt, 0, result, 0, prompt.length);
 
 for (int i = prompt.length; i < result.length; i++) {
 int[] current = new int[i];
 System.arraycopy(result, 0, current, 0, i);
 
 float[][] logits = forward(current);
 float[] lastLogits = logits[i - 1];
 
 // 贪婪选择
 int nextToken = 0;
 float maxLogit = lastLogits[0];
 for (int j = 1; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 if (lastLogits[j] > maxLogit) {
 maxLogit = lastLogits[j];
 nextToken = j;
 }
 }
 
 result[i] = nextToken;
 
 // 检查结束
 if (nextToken == 0) break; // EOS
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 温度采样
 */
 public int sampleWithTemperature(float[] logits, float temperature) {
 // 温度缩放
 float[] scaled = new float[logits.length];
 float maxLogit = logits[0];
 for (float l : logits) {
 if (l > maxLogit) maxLogit = l;
 }
 
 // Softmax
 float sum = 0;
 float[] probs = new float[logits.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 probs[i] = (float) Math.exp((logits[i] - maxLogit) / temperature);
 sum += probs[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 probs[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 // 采样
 float r = (float) Math.random();
 float cum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < probs.length; i++) {
 cum += probs[i];
 if (r < cum) return i;
 }
 
 return 0;
 }
 
 public int getVocabSize() { return vocabSize; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNLayers() { return nLayers; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }
 public int getNExperts() { return nExperts; }
 public boolean isUsingGPU() { return useGPU; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;

/**
 * Vision Encoder - 视觉编码器
 * 基于卷积层的图像特征提取架构
 */
public class VisionEncoder {
 
 private final int dModel;
 private final int inputChannels;
 
 // 卷积层参数
 private int[][] filterSizes; // 每个卷积层的滤波器大小
 private int[][] strides; // 每个卷积层的步长
 private int[][] padding; // 每个卷积层的填充
 private int[] outputChannels; // 每个卷积层的输出通道数
 
 // 权重参数
 private float[][][][][] convWeights; // [layer][outCh][inCh][kh][kw]
 private float[][] convBiases; // [layer][outCh]
 
 // 注意力层
 private MultiHeadAttention attention;
 
 // GPU加速
 private OpenCLAccelerator gpu;
 private boolean useGPU = false;
 
 // 缓存
 private float[][][][] layerOutputs;
 
 public VisionEncoder(int dModel, int inputChannels) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.inputChannels = inputChannels;
 initArchitecture();
 initWeights();
 initAttention();
 initializeGPU();
 }
 
 private void initArchitecture() {
 // 4层卷积架构
 int nLayers = 4;
 filterSizes = new int[nLayers][2];
 strides = new int[nLayers][2];
 padding = new int[nLayers][2];
 outputChannels = new int[nLayers];
 
 // Layer 1: 64通道, 3x3卷积, stride 2
 filterSizes[0] = new int[]{3, 3};
 strides[0] = new int[]{2, 2};
 padding[0] = new int[]{1, 1};
 outputChannels[0] = 64;
 
 // Layer 2: 128通道, 3x3卷积, stride 2
 filterSizes[1] = new int[]{3, 3};
 strides[1] = new int[]{2, 2};
 padding[1] = new int[]{1, 1};
 outputChannels[1] = 128;
 
 // Layer 3: 256通道, 3x3卷积, stride 2
 filterSizes[2] = new int[]{3, 3};
 strides[2] = new int[]{2, 2};
 padding[2] = new int[]{1, 1};
 outputChannels[2] = 256;
 
 // Layer 4: 512通道, 3x3卷积, stride 2
 filterSizes[3] = new int[]{3, 3};
 strides[3] = new int[]{2, 2};
 padding[3] = new int[]{1, 1};
 outputChannels[3] = 512;
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 int nLayers = filterSizes.length;
 convWeights = new float[nLayers][][][][];
 convBiases = new float[nLayers][];
 
 int prevChannels = inputChannels;
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 int outCh = outputChannels[l];
 int inCh = prevChannels;
 int kh = filterSizes[l][0];
 int kw = filterSizes[l][1];
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(inCh * kh * kw));
 convWeights[l] = new float[outCh][inCh][kh][kw];
 convBiases[l] = new float[outCh];
 
 for (int oc = 0; oc < outCh; oc++) {
 for (int ic = 0; ic < inCh; ic++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < kh; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < kw; j++) {
 convWeights[l][oc][ic][i][j] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 prevChannels = outCh;
 }
 }
 
 private void initAttention() {
 attention = new MultiHeadAttention(dModel, 8);
 }
 
 private void initializeGPU() {
 try {
 gpu = OpenCLAccelerator.getInstance();
 useGPU = gpu.isUsingGPU() && gpu.isInitialized();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 前向传播
 * @param image 输入图像 [height, width, channels]
 * @return 视觉特征 [numPatches, dModel]
 */
 public float[][] forward(float[][][] image) {
 int nLayers = filterSizes.length;
 layerOutputs = new float[nLayers][][][];
 
 float[][][] current = image;
 
 // 卷积层前向传播
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 int inCh = current[0][0].length;
 int outCh = outputChannels[l];
 int kh = filterSizes[l][0];
 int kw = filterSizes[l][1];
 int sh = strides[l][0];
 int sw = strides[l][1];
 int ph = padding[l][0];
 int pw = padding[l][1];
 
 // 计算输出尺寸
 int h = current.length;
 int w = current[0].length;
 int outH = (h + 2 * ph - kh) / sh + 1;
 int outW = (w + 2 * pw - kw) / sw + 1;
 
 // 应用卷积
 float[][][] output = new float[outH][outW][outCh];
 
 for (int oh = 0; oh < outH; oh++) {
 for (int ow = 0; ow < outW; ow++) {
 for (int oc = 0; oc < outCh; oc++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int ic = 0; ic < inCh; ic++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < kh; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < kw; j++) {
 int ih = oh * sh + i - ph;
 int iw = ow * sw + j - pw;
 if (ih >= 0 && ih < h && iw >= 0 && iw < w) {
 sum += current[ih][iw][ic] * convWeights[l][oc][ic][i][j];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 output[oh][ow][oc] = ReLU(sum + convBiases[l][oc]);
 }
 }
 }
 
 current = output;
 layerOutputs[l] = output;
 }
 
 // 将特征图展平为序列
 int h = current.length;
 int w = current[0].length;
 int ch = current[0][0].length;
 int numPatches = h * w;
 
 float[][] patches = new float[numPatches][ch];
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < w; j++) {
 patches[idx++] = current[i][j];
 }
 }
 
 // 如果通道数不等于dModel，进行线性投影
 if (ch != dModel) {
 patches = projectToDModel(patches, ch, dModel);
 }
 
 // 应用自注意力
 float[][] result = attention.forward(patches);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 将特征投影到dModel维度
 */
 private float[][] projectToDModel(float[][] input, int inDim, int outDim) {
 int n = input.length;
 float[][] output = new float[n][outDim];
 
 // 创建投影矩阵
 float[] projWeight = new float[inDim * outDim];
 float[] projBias = new float[outDim];
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(inDim));
 
 for (int i = 0; i < inDim * outDim; i++) {
 projWeight[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < outDim; j++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int k = 0; k < inDim; k++) {
 sum += input[i][k] * projWeight[k * outDim + j];
 }
 output[i][j] = sum + projBias[j];
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 /**
 * ReLU激活函数
 */
 private float ReLU(float x) {
 return Math.max(0, x);
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取视觉特征的CLS标记（第一个token）
 */
 public float[] getCLSToken(float[][] features) {
 if (features.length > 0) {
 return features[0];
 }
 return new float[dModel];
 }
 
 public MultiHeadAttention getAttention() { return attention; }
 public int getOutputChannels(int layer) { return outputChannels[layer]; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.monitoring;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.lang.management.*;

public class Dashboard {
 
 public static class Metric {
 public final String name;
 public final double value;
 public final String unit;
 public final long timestamp;
 
 public Metric(String name, double value, String unit) {
 this.name = name;
 this.value = value;
 this.unit = unit;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }
 }
 
 public static class TrainingMetrics {
 public double loss;
 public double accuracy;
 public double learningRate;
 public int epoch;
 public long tokensProcessed;
 public double gradientNorm;
 }
 
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<Metric>> metricsHistory;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
 private final TrainingMetrics trainingMetrics;
 private final MemoryMXBean memoryBean;
 private final OperatingSystemMXBean osBean;
 private volatile boolean enabled;
 private final int historySize;
 
 public Dashboard() {
 this.metricsHistory = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.scheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 this.trainingMetrics = new TrainingMetrics();
 this.memoryBean = ManagementFactory.getMemoryMXBean();
 this.osBean = ManagementFactory.getOperatingSystemMXBean();
 this.enabled = true;
 this.historySize = 100;
 startMonitoring();
 }
 
 private void startMonitoring() {
 scheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (enabled) {
 collectSystemMetrics();
 }
 }, 0, 5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 }
 
 private void collectSystemMetrics() {
 addMetric("memory.used", memoryBean.getHeapMemoryUsage().getUsed() / (1024.0 * 1024.0), "MB");
 addMetric("memory.max", memoryBean.getHeapMemoryUsage().getMax() / (1024.0 * 1024.0), "MB");
 addMetric("cpu.load", osBean.getSystemLoadAverage(), "%");
 addMetric("process.cpu", getProcessCpuLoad(), "%");
 }
 
 private double getProcessCpuLoad() {
 try {
 com.sun.management.OperatingSystemMXBean bean = 
 (com.sun.management.OperatingSystemMXBean) osBean;
 return bean.getProcessCpuLoad() * 100;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 return 0;
 }
 }
 
 public void addMetric(String name, double value, String unit) {
 metricsHistory.computeIfAbsent(name, k -> new ArrayList<>());
 
 List<Metric> history = metricsHistory.get(name);
 synchronized (history) {
 history.add(new Metric(name, value, unit));
 while (history.size() > historySize) {
 history.remove(0);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void updateTrainingMetrics(double loss, double accuracy, double learningRate, 
 int epoch, long tokensProcessed, double gradientNorm) {
 trainingMetrics.loss = loss;
 trainingMetrics.accuracy = accuracy;
 trainingMetrics.learningRate = learningRate;
 trainingMetrics.epoch = epoch;
 trainingMetrics.tokensProcessed = tokensProcessed;
 trainingMetrics.gradientNorm = gradientNorm;
 
 addMetric("training.loss", loss, "");
 addMetric("training.accuracy", accuracy * 100, "%");
 addMetric("training.lr", learningRate, "");
 addMetric("training.gradientNorm", gradientNorm, "");
 }
 
 public List<Metric> getMetricHistory(String name) {
 return metricsHistory.getOrDefault(name, Collections.emptyList());
 }
 
 public TrainingMetrics getTrainingMetrics() {
 return trainingMetrics;
 }
 
 public Map<String, Double> getCurrentMetrics() {
 Map<String, Double> result = new HashMap<>();
 
 for (Map.Entry<String, List<Metric>> entry : metricsHistory.entrySet()) {
 List<Metric> history = entry.getValue();
 if (!history.isEmpty()) {
 result.put(entry.getKey(), history.get(history.size() - 1).value);
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public String generateReport() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 
 sb.append("========================================\n");
 sb.append(" SC Architecture Dashboard\n");
 sb.append("========================================\n\n");
 
 sb.append("--- System Metrics ---\n");
 sb.append(String.format("Memory Used: %.2f MB / %.2f MB\n",
 getMetricValue("memory.used"), getMetricValue("memory.max")));
 sb.append(String.format("CPU Load: %.2f%%\n", getMetricValue("cpu.load")));
 sb.append(String.format("Process CPU: %.2f%%\n", getMetricValue("process.cpu")));
 sb.append("\n");
 
 sb.append("--- Training Metrics ---\n");
 sb.append(String.format("Epoch: %d\n", trainingMetrics.epoch));
 sb.append(String.format("Loss: %.6f\n", trainingMetrics.loss));
 sb.append(String.format("Accuracy: %.4f%%\n", trainingMetrics.accuracy * 100));
 sb.append(String.format("Learning Rate: %.2e\n", trainingMetrics.learningRate));
 sb.append(String.format("Tokens Processed: %,d\n", trainingMetrics.tokensProcessed));
 sb.append(String.format("Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", trainingMetrics.gradientNorm));
 sb.append("\n");
 
 sb.append("--- Status ---\n");
 sb.append(String.format("Enabled: %s\n", enabled));
 sb.append(String.format("Metrics tracked: %d\n", metricsHistory.size()));
 sb.append(String.format("Timestamp: %s\n", new Date()));
 
 return sb.toString();
 }
 
 private double getMetricValue(String name) {
 List<Metric> history = metricsHistory.get(name);
 return history != null && !history.isEmpty() ? history.get(history.size() - 1).value : 0;
 }
 
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 scheduler.shutdown();
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "Dashboard: enabled=%s, metrics=%d, training_epoch=%d",
 enabled, metricsHistory.size(), trainingMetrics.epoch
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.monitoring;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUDeviceManager;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed.AutogradDistributedFramework;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public final class TrainingMonitor {

 public static class MonitorConfig {
 public int sampleIntervalMs = 100;
 public int historySize = 10000;
 public int alertThresholdLoss = 100;
 public float alertThresholdGradNorm = 10.0f;
 public boolean enableConsoleOutput = true;
 public boolean enableFileLogging = false;
 public String logFilePath = "training.log";
 public int consoleOutputInterval = 10;
 public boolean enableAnomalyDetection = true;
 public float anomalyThreshold = 3.0f;
 public boolean enableProgressBar = true;
 }

 public static class MetricSnapshot {
 public final long timestamp;
 public final int globalStep;
 public final float loss;
 public final float gradNorm;
 public final float learningRate;
 public final long stepTimeMs;
 public final float gpuUtilization;
 public final long gpuMemoryUsed;
 public final long gpuMemoryTotal;
 public final float cpuUtilization;
 public final long memoryUsed;
 public final long memoryTotal;
 public final double throughput;
 public final long samplesProcessed;
 public final long epoch;

 public MetricSnapshot(long timestamp, int globalStep, float loss, float gradNorm, float learningRate,
 long stepTimeMs, float gpuUtilization, long gpuMemoryUsed, long gpuMemoryTotal,
 float cpuUtilization, long memoryUsed, long memoryTotal, double throughput,
 long samplesProcessed, long epoch) {
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.globalStep = globalStep;
 this.loss = loss;
 this.gradNorm = gradNorm;
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 this.stepTimeMs = stepTimeMs;
 this.gpuUtilization = gpuUtilization;
 this.gpuMemoryUsed = gpuMemoryUsed;
 this.gpuMemoryTotal = gpuMemoryTotal;
 this.cpuUtilization = cpuUtilization;

 this.samplesProcessed = samplesProcessed;

 }

 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format(
 "Step=%d | Loss=%.6f | GradNorm=%.4f | LR=%.6f | Time=%.2fms | " +
 "GPU=%.1f%% (%d/%d MB) | CPU=%.1f%% | Memory=%d/%d MB | Throughput=%.2f/s",
 globalStep, loss, gradNorm, learningRate, stepTimeMs,
 gpuUtilization, gpuMemoryUsed / 1024 / 1024, gpuMemoryTotal / 1024 / 1024,
 cpuUtilization, memoryUsed / 1024 / 1024, memoryTotal / 1024 / 1024, throughput
 );
 }
 }

 public static class LossCurve {
 private final Deque<Float> lossHistory;
 private final Deque<Integer> stepHistory;
 private final int maxSize;
 private volatile float currentLoss;
 private volatile float minLoss;
 private volatile float maxLoss;
 private volatile float avgLoss;

 public LossCurve(int maxSize) {
 this.maxSize = maxSize;
 this.lossHistory = new LinkedList<>();
 this.stepHistory = new LinkedList<>();
 this.currentLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.minLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.maxLoss = Float.MIN_VALUE;
 this.avgLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }

 public synchronized void add(int step, float loss) {
 lossHistory.addLast(loss);
 stepHistory.addLast(step);
 
 if (lossHistory.size() > maxSize) {
 lossHistory.removeFirst();
 stepHistory.removeFirst();
 }
 
 currentLoss = loss;
 minLoss = Math.min(minLoss, loss);
 maxLoss = Math.max(maxLoss, loss);
 
 double sum = 0;
 for (float l : lossHistory) {
 sum += l;
 }
 avgLoss = (float) (sum / lossHistory.size());
 }

 public synchronized float[] getLossArray() {
 return lossHistory.stream().mapToFloat(Float::floatValue).toArray();
 }

 public synchronized int[] getStepArray() {
 return stepHistory.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 }

 public float getCurrentLoss() { return currentLoss; }
 public float getMinLoss() { return minLoss; }
 public float getMaxLoss() { return maxLoss; }
 public float getAvgLoss() { return avgLoss; }
 public int size() { return lossHistory.size(); }
 }

 public static class GradientNormTracker {
 private final Deque<Float> gradNormHistory;
 private final Deque<Integer> stepHistory;
 private final int maxSize;
 private volatile float currentGradNorm;
 private volatile float avgGradNorm;
 private volatile float maxGradNorm;
 private volatile boolean exploding;

 public GradientNormTracker(int maxSize) {
 this.maxSize = maxSize;
 this.gradNormHistory = new LinkedList<>();
 this.stepHistory = new LinkedList<>();
 this.currentGradNorm = 0;
 this.avgGradNorm = 0;
 this.maxGradNorm = 0;
 this.exploding = false;
 }

 public synchronized void add(int step, float gradNorm) {
 gradNormHistory.addLast(gradNorm);
 stepHistory.addLast(step);
 
 if (gradNormHistory.size() > maxSize) {
 gradNormHistory.removeFirst();
 stepHistory.removeFirst();
 }
 
 currentGradNorm = gradNorm;
 maxGradNorm = Math.max(maxGradNorm, gradNorm);
 
 double sum = 0;
 for (float g : gradNormHistory) {
 sum += g;
 }
 avgGradNorm = (float) (sum / gradNormHistory.size());
 
 exploding = gradNorm > 1000 || (gradNormHistory.size() > 10 && gradNorm > avgGradNorm * 10);
 }

 public float getCurrentGradNorm() { return currentGradNorm; }
 public float getAvgGradNorm() { return avgGradNorm; }
 public float getMaxGradNorm() { return maxGradNorm; }
 public boolean isExploding() { return exploding; }
 }

 public static class HardwareMonitor {
 private final AtomicReference<Float> gpuUtilization = new AtomicReference<>(0f);
 private final AtomicReference<Long> gpuMemoryUsed = new AtomicReference<>(0L);
 private final AtomicReference<Long> gpuMemoryTotal = new AtomicReference<>(0L);
 
 private final AtomicReference<Float> cpuUtilization = new AtomicReference<>(0f);
 private final AtomicReference<Long> memoryUsed = new AtomicReference<>(0L);
 private final AtomicReference<Long> memoryTotal = new AtomicReference<>(0L);
 
 private final AtomicReference<Double> throughput = new AtomicReference<>(0.0);
 private final AtomicLong samplesProcessed = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong lastThroughputTime = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis());

 public void updateGPU(float utilization, long memoryUsed, long memoryTotal) {
 gpuUtilization.set(utilization);
 this.gpuMemoryUsed.set(memoryUsed);
 this.gpuMemoryTotal.set(memoryTotal);
 }

 public void updateCPU(float utilization, long memoryUsed, long memoryTotal) {
 cpuUtilization.set(utilization);
 this.memoryUsed.set(memoryUsed);
 this.memoryTotal.set(memoryTotal);
 }

 public void updateThroughput(long samples) {
 long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
 long elapsed = now - lastThroughputTime.get();
 
 if (elapsed > 0) {
 throughput.set((samples * 1000.0) / elapsed);
 }
 
 samplesProcessed.addAndGet(samples);
 lastThroughputTime.set(now);
 }

 public float getGpuUtilization() { return gpuUtilization.get(); }
 public long getGpuMemoryUsed() { return gpuMemoryUsed.get(); }
 public long getGpuMemoryTotal() { return gpuMemoryTotal.get(); }
 public float getCpuUtilization() { return cpuUtilization.get(); }
 public long getMemoryUsed() { return memoryUsed.get(); }
 public long getMemoryTotal() { return memoryTotal.get(); }
 public double getThroughput() { return throughput.get(); }
 public long getSamplesProcessed() { return samplesProcessed.get(); }
 }

 private final MonitorConfig config;
 private final LossCurve lossCurve;
 private final GradientNormTracker gradNormTracker;
 private final HardwareMonitor hardwareMonitor;
 
 private final ScheduledExecutorService monitoringPool;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService statsPool;
