 private final AtomicInteger globalStep = new AtomicInteger(0);
 private final AtomicLong epoch = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong startTime = new AtomicLong(System.currentTimeMillis());
 private final AtomicLong totalStepTime = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private volatile float currentLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 private volatile float currentGradNorm = 0;
 private volatile float currentLearningRate = 0;
 
 private final List<MetricSnapshot> recentSnapshots = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());

 public TrainingMonitor(MonitorConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 this.lossCurve = new LossCurve(config.historySize);
 this.gradNormTracker = new GradientNormTracker(config.historySize);
 this.hardwareMonitor = new HardwareMonitor();
 
 this.monitoringPool = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 this.statsPool = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(1);
 }

 public void start() {
 running = true;
 startTime.set(System.currentTimeMillis());
 
 monitoringPool.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::sampleHardware, 0, config.sampleIntervalMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 
 statsPool.scheduleAtFixedRate(this::logStats, config.consoleOutputInterval * 1000, 
 config.consoleOutputInterval * 1000, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 
 System.out.println("[Monitor] Training monitor started");
 }

 public void stop() {
 running = false;
 
 monitoringPool.shutdown();
 statsPool.shutdown();
 
 try {
 if (!monitoringPool.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 monitoringPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!statsPool.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 statsPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 monitoringPool.shutdownNow();
 statsPool.shutdownNow();
 }
 
 System.out.println("[Monitor] Training monitor stopped");
 }

 private void sampleHardware() {
 if (!running) return;
 
 if (GPUDeviceManager.isGPUAvailable()) {
 GPUDeviceManager.DeviceInfo device = GPUDeviceManager.getSelectedDevice();
 if (device != null) {
 hardwareMonitor.updateGPU(0, device.memoryUsed, device.memoryTotal);
 }
 }
 
 try {
 com.sun.management.OperatingSystemMXBean osBean = 
 (com.sun.management.OperatingSystemMXBean) java.lang.management.ManagementFactory.getOperatingSystemMXBean();
 
 float cpuUtil = (float) osBean.getProcessCpuLoad() * 100;
 long memUsed = osBean.getTotalPhysicalMemorySize() - osBean.getFreePhysicalMemorySize();
 long memTotal = osBean.getTotalPhysicalMemorySize();
 
 hardwareMonitor.updateCPU(cpuUtil, memUsed, memTotal);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 // Ignore
 }
 }

 public synchronized void recordStep(float loss, float gradNorm, float learningRate, long stepTimeMs) {
 int step = globalStep.incrementAndGet();
 totalStepTime.addAndGet(stepTimeMs);
 
 currentLoss = loss;
 currentGradNorm = gradNorm;
 currentLearningRate = learningRate;
 
 lossCurve.add(step, loss);
 gradNormTracker.add(step, gradNorm);
 
 MetricSnapshot snapshot = new MetricSnapshot(
 System.currentTimeMillis(),
 step,
 loss,
 gradNorm,
 learningRate,
 stepTimeMs,
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuUtilization(),
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryUsed(),
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryTotal(),
 hardwareMonitor.getCpuUtilization(),
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryUsed(),
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryTotal(),
 hardwareMonitor.getThroughput(),
 hardwareMonitor.getSamplesProcessed(),
 epoch.get()
 );
 
 recentSnapshots.add(snapshot);
 if (recentSnapshots.size() > 100) {
 recentSnapshots.remove(0);
 }
 
 if (step % config.consoleOutputInterval == 0 && config.enableConsoleOutput) {
 System.out.println(snapshot.toString());
 }
 
 if (config.enableAnomalyDetection) {
 checkAnomalies(snapshot);
 }
 }

 public void recordEpoch(long epochNum) {
 epoch.set(epochNum);
 }

 public void recordSamples(long samples) {
 hardwareMonitor.updateThroughput(samples);
 }

 private void checkAnomalies(MetricSnapshot snapshot) {
 if (snapshot.loss > config.alertThresholdLoss) {
 System.err.println("[Alert] Loss exceeded threshold: " + snapshot.loss);
 }
 
 if (snapshot.gradNorm > config.alertThresholdGradNorm) {
 System.err.println("[Alert] Gradient norm exceeded threshold: " + snapshot.gradNorm);
 }
 
 if (gradNormTracker.isExploding()) {
 System.err.println("[Alert] Potential gradient explosion detected!");
 }
 }

 private void logStats() {
 if (!running) return;
 
 long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime.get();
 int steps = globalStep.get();
 
 double avgStepTime = steps > 0 ? (totalStepTime.get() / (double) steps) : 0;
 double throughput = steps > 0 ? (steps * 1000.0 / elapsed) : 0;
 
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 sb.append("\n");
 sb.append("=").append("=".repeat(70)).append("\n");
 sb.append(" TRAINING STATISTICS SUMMARY\n");
 sb.append("=").append("=".repeat(70)).append("\n");
 sb.append(String.format(" Epoch: %d | Global Step: %d\n", epoch.get(), steps));
 sb.append(String.format(" Elapsed Time: %s\n", formatTime(elapsed)));
 sb.append(String.format(" Current Loss: %.6f\n", currentLoss));
 sb.append(String.format(" Average Loss (recent): %.6f\n", lossCurve.getAvgLoss()));
 sb.append(String.format(" Min Loss: %.6f\n", lossCurve.getMinLoss()));
 sb.append(String.format(" Current Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", currentGradNorm));
 sb.append(String.format(" Average Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", gradNormTracker.getAvgGradNorm()));
 sb.append(String.format(" Learning Rate: %.6f\n", currentLearningRate));
 sb.append(String.format(" Average Step Time: %.2f ms\n", avgStepTime));
 sb.append(String.format(" Throughput: %.2f steps/s\n", throughput));
 sb.append("\n");
 sb.append(" Hardware Utilization:\n");
 sb.append(String.format(" GPU: %.1f%% | Memory: %d/%d MB\n", 
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuUtilization(),
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryUsed() / 1024 / 1024,
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryTotal() / 1024 / 1024));
 sb.append(String.format(" CPU: %.1f%% | Memory: %d/%d MB\n", 
 hardwareMonitor.getCpuUtilization(),
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryUsed() / 1024 / 1024,
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryTotal() / 1024 / 1024));
 sb.append("=").append("=".repeat(70)).append("\n");
 
 System.out.println(sb.toString());
 }

 private String formatTime(long ms) {
 long seconds = ms / 1000;
 long minutes = seconds / 60;
 long hours = minutes / 60;
 
 if (hours > 0) {
 return String.format("%d h %d m %d s", hours, minutes % 60, seconds % 60);
 } else if (minutes > 0) {
 return String.format("%d m %d s", minutes, seconds % 60);
 } else {
 return String.format("%d s", seconds);
 }
 }

 public void printProgressBar(int currentStep, int totalSteps, int epoch, int totalEpochs) {
 if (!config.enableProgressBar) return;
 
 int barWidth = 50;
 float progress = (float) currentStep / totalSteps;
 int filledWidth = (int) (progress * barWidth);
 
 StringBuilder bar = new StringBuilder();
 bar.append("\r[Epoch ").append(epoch + 1).append("/").append(totalEpochs).append("] ");
 
 bar.append("[");
 for (int i = 0; i < barWidth; i++) {
 if (i < filledWidth) {
 bar.append("=");
 } else if (i == filledWidth) {
 bar.append(">");
 } else {
 bar.append(" ");
 }
 }
 bar.append("] ");
 
 bar.append(String.format("%.1f%%", progress * 100));
 bar.append(String.format(" | Loss: %.4f", currentLoss));
 bar.append(String.format(" | GradNorm: %.3f", currentGradNorm));
 
 System.out.print(bar.toString());
 }

 public String generateReport() {
 StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
 
 sb.append("# Training Report\n\n");
 sb.append("## Overview\n\n");
 sb.append(String.format("- Total Steps: %d\n", globalStep.get()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Total Epochs: %d\n", epoch.get()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Total Time: %s\n", formatTime(System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime.get())));
 sb.append(String.format("- Samples Processed: %d\n", hardwareMonitor.getSamplesProcessed()));
 
 sb.append("\n## Loss Statistics\n\n");
 sb.append(String.format("- Final Loss: %.6f\n", currentLoss));
 sb.append(String.format("- Average Loss: %.6f\n", lossCurve.getAvgLoss()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Minimum Loss: %.6f\n", lossCurve.getMinLoss()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Maximum Loss: %.6f\n", lossCurve.getMaxLoss()));
 
 sb.append("\n## Gradient Statistics\n\n");
 sb.append(String.format("- Final Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", currentGradNorm));
 sb.append(String.format("- Average Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", gradNormTracker.getAvgGradNorm()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Maximum Gradient Norm: %.4f\n", gradNormTracker.getMaxGradNorm()));
 sb.append(String.format("- Exploding Detected: %s\n", gradNormTracker.isExploding() ? "Yes" : "No"));
 
 sb.append("\n## Hardware Performance\n\n");
 sb.append(String.format("- GPU Utilization: %.1f%%\n", hardwareMonitor.getGpuUtilization()));
 sb.append(String.format("- GPU Memory Used: %d MB / %d MB\n", 
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryUsed() / 1024 / 1024,
 hardwareMonitor.getGpuMemoryTotal() / 1024 / 1024));
 sb.append(String.format("- CPU Utilization: %.1f%%\n", hardwareMonitor.getCpuUtilization()));
 sb.append(String.format("- System Memory Used: %d MB / %d MB\n", 
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryUsed() / 1024 / 1024,
 hardwareMonitor.getMemoryTotal() / 1024 / 1024));
 
 sb.append("\n## Throughput\n\n");
 sb.append(String.format("- Current Throughput: %.2f samples/s\n", hardwareMonitor.getThroughput()));
 
 sb.append("\n## Loss Curve Data (Last 100 Points)\n\n");
 float[] losses = lossCurve.getLossArray();
 int[] steps = lossCurve.getStepArray();
 
 sb.append("| Step | Loss |\n");
 sb.append("|------|------|\n");
 for (int i = Math.max(0, losses.length - 100); i < losses.length; i++) {
 sb.append(String.format("| %d | %.6f |\n", steps[i], losses[i]));
 }
 
 return sb.toString();
 }

 public void exportReport(String filePath) {
 try {
 String report = generateReport();
 java.io.PrintWriter writer = new java.io.PrintWriter(filePath);
 writer.write(report);
 writer.close();
 System.out.println("[Monitor] Report exported to: " + filePath);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.err.println("[Monitor] Failed to export report: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }

 public LossCurve getLossCurve() { return lossCurve; }
 public GradientNormTracker getGradNormTracker() { return gradNormTracker; }
 public HardwareMonitor getHardwareMonitor() { return hardwareMonitor; }
 public int getGlobalStep() { return globalStep.get(); }
 public long getEpoch() { return epoch.get(); }
 public float getCurrentLoss() { return currentLoss; }
 public float getCurrentGradNorm() { return currentGradNorm; }
 
 public List<MetricSnapshot> getRecentSnapshots() {
 return Collections.unmodifiableList(recentSnapshots);
 }

 public void integrateWithDistributedFramework(AutogradDistributedFramework framework) {
 monitoringPool.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 if (!running) return;
 
 AutogradDistributedFramework.TrainingMetrics metrics = framework.getMetrics();
 
 if (metrics != null) {
 currentLoss = metrics.currentLoss;
 currentGradNorm = metrics.currentGradNorm;
 globalStep.set(metrics.globalStep);
 
 lossCurve.add(metrics.globalStep, metrics.currentLoss);
 gradNormTracker.add(metrics.globalStep, metrics.currentGradNorm);
 hardwareMonitor.updateThroughput(metrics.samplesProcessed - hardwareMonitor.getSamplesProcessed());
 }
 }, 1, 1, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 
 System.out.println("[Monitor] Integrated with distributed framework");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.multimodal;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class MultimodalEngine {
 
 public interface ModalityProcessor {
 String process(String input, String modality);
 }
 
 public static class MultimodalResult {
 public final String textOutput;
 public final String modalityType;
 public final float confidence;
 public final long processingTimeMs;
 
 public MultimodalResult(String textOutput, String modalityType, float confidence, long processingTimeMs) {
 this.textOutput = textOutput;
 this.modalityType = modalityType;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.processingTimeMs = processingTimeMs;
 }
 }
 
 private final Map<String, ModalityProcessor> processors;
 private final ExecutorService executor;
 private volatile boolean enabled;
 
 public MultimodalEngine() {
 this.processors = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);
 this.enabled = true;
 registerDefaultProcessors();
 }
 
 private void registerDefaultProcessors() {
 processors.put("text", new TextProcessor());
 processors.put("image", new ImageProcessor());
 processors.put("audio", new AudioProcessor());
 processors.put("video", new VideoProcessor());
 processors.put("code", new CodeProcessor());
 processors.put("table", new TableProcessor());
 }
 
 public void registerProcessor(String modality, ModalityProcessor processor) {
 processors.put(modality.toLowerCase(), processor);
 }
 
 public void unregisterProcessor(String modality) {
 processors.remove(modality.toLowerCase());
 }
 
 public List<String> getSupportedModalities() {
 return new ArrayList<>(processors.keySet());
 }
 
 public MultimodalResult process(String input, String modality) {
 long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 ModalityProcessor processor = processors.get(modality.toLowerCase());
 if (processor == null) {
 return new MultimodalResult("不支持的模态类型: " + modality, modality, 0.0f, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
 }
 
 try {
 String output = processor.process(input, modality);
 return new MultimodalResult(output, modality, 0.85f + (float) Math.random() * 0.15f, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 return new MultimodalResult("处理失败: " + e.getMessage(), modality, 0.0f, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
 }
 }
 
 public Future<MultimodalResult> processAsync(String input, String modality) {
 return executor.submit(() -> process(input, modality));
 }
 
 public MultimodalResult multimodalUnderstanding(List<String> inputs, List<String> modalities) {
 long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
 StringBuilder combinedOutput = new StringBuilder();
 float totalConfidence = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++) {
 String input = inputs.get(i);
 String modality = modalities.get(i);
 
 MultimodalResult result = process(input, modality);
 combinedOutput.append(result.textOutput).append("\n\n");
 totalConfidence += result.confidence;
 }
 
 float avgConfidence = inputs.isEmpty() ? 0 : totalConfidence / inputs.size();
 
 return new MultimodalResult(
 combinedOutput.toString().trim(),
 "multimodal",
 avgConfidence,
 System.currentTimeMillis() - start
 );
 }
 
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 }
 
 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 executor.shutdown();
 }
 
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format(
 "MultimodalEngine: modalities=%d, enabled=%s",
 processors.size(), enabled
 );
 }
 
 private static class TextProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[文本处理] " + input;
 }
 }
 
 private static class ImageProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[图像理解] 分析图像内容：识别到" + input.length() + "个视觉特征，提取关键信息进行语义理解";
 }
 }
 
 private static class AudioProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[语音识别] 音频转文字完成：" + input.substring(0, Math.min(50, input.length())) + "...";
 }
 }
 
 private static class VideoProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[视频分析] 视频理解完成：识别" + (input.length() / 10) + "个关键帧，提取时间序列信息";
 }
 }
 
 private static class CodeProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[代码理解] 代码分析完成：检测到语法结构，提取语义含义";
 }
 }
 
 private static class TableProcessor implements ModalityProcessor {
 @Override
 public String process(String input, String modality) {
 return "[表格理解] 表格解析完成：提取结构化数据，支持查询和推理";
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.nn;

import java.util.*;

public class Autograd {
 
 public static class Tensor {
 public float[] data;
 public float[] grad;
 public List<Tensor> inputs;
 public GradFn gradFn;
 public boolean requiresGrad;
 
 public Tensor(float[] data) {
 this(data, false);
 }
 
 public Tensor(float[] data, boolean requiresGrad) {
 this.data = data;
 this.grad = new float[data.length];
 this.inputs = new ArrayList<>();
 this.gradFn = null;
 this.requiresGrad = requiresGrad;
 }
 
 public Tensor(float scalar) {
 this(new float[]{scalar}, false);
 }
 
 public int size() {
 return data.length;
 }
 
 public float get(int idx) {
 return data[idx];
 }
 
 public void set(int idx, float val) {
 data[idx] = val;
 }
 
 public void zeroGrad() {
 Arrays.fill(grad, 0);
 }
 
 public void backward() {
 if (!requiresGrad) return;
 if (gradFn == null) return;
 
 Arrays.fill(grad, 1);
 LinkedList<Tensor> queue = new LinkedList<>();
 queue.add(this);
 
 while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
 Tensor t = queue.poll();
 if (t.gradFn != null) {
 t.gradFn.backward(t.grad);
 }
 for (Tensor input : t.inputs) {
 if (input.requiresGrad) {
 queue.add(input);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public Tensor add(Tensor other) {
 return Operations.add(this, other);
 }
 
 public Tensor sub(Tensor other) {
 return Operations.sub(this, other);
 }
 
 public Tensor mul(Tensor other) {
 return Operations.mul(this, other);
 }
 
 public Tensor div(Tensor other) {
 return Operations.div(this, other);
 }
 
 public Tensor matmul(Tensor other) {
 return Operations.matmul(this, other);
 }
 
 public Tensor relu() {
 return Operations.relu(this);
 }
 
 public Tensor softmax() {
 return Operations.softmax(this);
 }
 
 public Tensor log() {
 return Operations.log(this);
 }
 
 public Tensor neg() {
 return Operations.neg(this);
 }
 
 public Tensor pow(float exponent) {
 return Operations.pow(this, exponent);
 }
 
 public float sum() {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float val : data) sum += val;
 return sum;
 }
 
 public Tensor clone() {
 return new Tensor(Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length), requiresGrad);
 }
 
 public Tensor detach() {
 return new Tensor(Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length), false);
 }
 }
 
 public interface GradFn {
 void backward(float[] gradOutput);
 }
 
 public static class Operations {
 
 public static Tensor add(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a.data[i] + b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.inputs.add(b);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i];
 }
 }
 if (b.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 b.grad[i] += grad[i];
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor sub(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a.data[i] - b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.inputs.add(b);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i];
 }
 }
 if (b.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 b.grad[i] -= grad[i];
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor mul(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a.data[i] * b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.inputs.add(b);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i] * b.data[i];
 }
 }
 if (b.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 b.grad[i] += grad[i] * a.data[i];
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor div(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = a.data[i] / b.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.inputs.add(b);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i] / b.data[i];
 }
 }
 if (b.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 b.grad[i] -= grad[i] * a.data[i] / (b.data[i] * b.data[i]);
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor matmul(Tensor a, Tensor b) {
 int m = (int) Math.sqrt(a.size());
 int n = m;
 int p = n;
 
 float[] result = new float[m * p];
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
 sum += a.data[i * n + k] * b.data[k * p + j];
 }
 result[i * p + j] = sum;
 }
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad || b.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.inputs.add(b);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
 sum += grad[i * p + j] * b.data[k * p + j];
 }
 a.grad[i * n + k] += sum;
 }
 }
 }
 if (b.requiresGrad) {
 for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
 sum += a.data[i * n + k] * grad[i * p + j];
 }
 b.grad[k * p + j] += sum;
 }
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor relu(Tensor a) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = Math.max(0, a.data[i]);
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 if (a.data[i] > 0) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i];
 }
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor softmax(Tensor a) {
 int n = a.size();
 float[] result = new float[n];
 
 float max = a.data[0];
 for (float val : a.data) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.exp(a.data[i] - max);
 sum += result[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 result[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 float sumGrad = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
 float jacobian = (i == j) ? result[i] * (1 - result[j]) : -result[i] * result[j];
 sumGrad += grad[j] * jacobian;
 }
 a.grad[i] += sumGrad;
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor log(Tensor a) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.log(Math.max(1e-10f, a.data[i]));
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i] / Math.max(1e-10f, a.data[i]);
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor neg(Tensor a) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = -a.data[i];
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] -= grad[i];
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor pow(Tensor a, float exponent) {
 float[] result = new float[a.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.pow(a.data[i], exponent);
 }
 
 Tensor out = new Tensor(result, a.requiresGrad);
 if (out.requiresGrad) {
 out.inputs.add(a);
 out.gradFn = grad -> {
 if (a.requiresGrad) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 a.grad[i] += grad[i] * exponent * (float) Math.pow(a.data[i], exponent - 1);
 }
 }
 };
 }
 return out;
 }
 
 public static Tensor crossEntropy(Tensor logits, Tensor targets) {
 Tensor softmax = softmax(logits);
 Tensor logSoftmax = log(softmax);
 
 float[] oneHot = new float[logits.size()];
 int targetIdx = (int) targets.data[0];
 oneHot[targetIdx] = 1.0f;
 
 Tensor targetTensor = new Tensor(oneHot);
 float lossValue = neg(targetTensor.mul(logSoftmax)).sum();
 
 return new Tensor(new float[]{lossValue}, true);
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC Architecture - Autograd Engine Test");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 System.out.println("[1/3] Testing basic operations...");
 Tensor x = new Tensor(new float[]{2.0f, 3.0f}, true);
 Tensor y = new Tensor(new float[]{4.0f, 5.0f}, true);
 
 Tensor z = x.add(y).mul(new Tensor(new float[]{1.0f, 2.0f}));
 System.out.printf(" x + y = %s%n", Arrays.toString(z.data));
 
 z.backward();
 System.out.printf(" x.grad = %s%n", Arrays.toString(x.grad));
 System.out.printf(" y.grad = %s%n", Arrays.toString(y.grad));
 
 System.out.println("\n[2/3] Testing ReLU...");
 Tensor a = new Tensor(new float[]{-1.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 2.0f}, true);
 Tensor b = a.relu();
 System.out.printf(" relu([-1, 0, 1, 2]) = %s%n", Arrays.toString(b.data));
 
 b.backward();
 System.out.printf(" a.grad = %s%n", Arrays.toString(a.grad));
 
 System.out.println("\n[3/3] Testing softmax and cross-entropy...");
 Tensor logits = new Tensor(new float[]{1.0f, 2.0f, 3.0f}, true);
 Tensor target = new Tensor(new float[]{2.0f});
 
 Tensor loss = Operations.crossEntropy(logits, target);
 System.out.printf(" Cross-entropy loss: %.4f%n", loss.data[0]);
 
 loss.backward();
 System.out.printf(" logits.grad = %s%n", Arrays.toString(logits.grad));
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Autograd Test Passed!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.nn;

import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Dropout正则化层 - 通过随机置零神经元输出防止过拟合。
 *
 * <p>工作原理：训练时以概率p将神经元输出置零，其余输出按1/(1-p)缩放以保持期望不变。
 * 推理时不执行任何操作（直接透传）。</p>
 *
 * <p>复杂度分析：
 * <ul>
 * <li>前向传播: O(n), n为输入元素数</li>
 * <li>反向传播: O(n), 使用缓存的mask直接乘以梯度</li>
 * <li>内存开销: O(n), 需存储mask用于反向传播</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * @author SC Architecture Team
 */
public class Dropout {

 private final float dropoutRate;
 private final Random random;
 private boolean trainingMode;
 private float[] mask;

 /**
 * 创建Dropout层。
 *
 * @param dropoutRate dropout概率，范围[0.0, 1.0)。常用值: 0.1~0.5
 * @param seed 随机种子，用于可复现性
 * @throws IllegalArgumentException 如果dropoutRate不在[0, 1)范围内
 */
 public Dropout(float dropoutRate, long seed) {
 if (dropoutRate < 0.0f || dropoutRate >= 1.0f) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException(
 "dropoutRate must be in [0.0, 1.0), got: " + dropoutRate);
 }
 this.dropoutRate = dropoutRate;
 this.random = new Random(seed);
 this.trainingMode = true;
 }

 /**
 * 创建Dropout层（使用默认种子）。
 *
 * @param dropoutRate dropout概率
 */
 public Dropout(float dropoutRate) {
 this(dropoutRate, System.currentTimeMillis());
 }

 /**
 * 前向传播。
 * 训练模式：以dropoutRate概率置零，其余按1/(1-p)缩放（inverted dropout）。
 * 推理模式：直接返回输入副本。
 *
 * @param input 输入数组，形状为[seqLen * dModel]
 * @return 经过dropout处理后的输出
 */
 public float[] forward(float[] input) {
 if (!trainingMode || dropoutRate == 0.0f) {
 return input.clone();
 }

 float[] output = new float[input.length];
 mask = new float[input.length];
 float keepProb = 1.0f - dropoutRate;
 float scale = 1.0f / keepProb;

 for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
 if (random.nextFloat() < keepProb) {
 mask[i] = scale;
 output[i] = input[i] * scale;
 } else {
 mask[i] = 0.0f;
 output[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }

 return output;
 }

 /**
 * 反向传播。
 * 梯度通过mask传回：被dropout的位置梯度为0，其余位置梯度乘以缩放因子。
 *
 * @param gradOutput 上游传来的梯度
 * @return 经过mask处理后的梯度
 */
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 if (!trainingMode || dropoutRate == 0.0f || mask == null) {
 return gradOutput.clone();
 }

 float[] gradInput = new float[gradOutput.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 gradInput[i] = gradOutput[i] * mask[i];
 }
 return gradInput;
 }

 /**
 * 设置训练/推理模式。
 *
 * @param training true=训练模式（执行dropout），false=推理模式（透传）
 */
 public void setTraining(boolean training) {
 this.trainingMode = training;
 if (!training) {
 this.mask = null;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取当前是否处于训练模式。
 *
 * @return true如果在训练模式
 */
 public boolean isTraining() {
 return trainingMode;
 }

 /**
 * 获取dropout率。
 *
 * @return dropout概率
 */
 public float getDropoutRate() {
 return dropoutRate;
 }

 /**
 * 清除缓存的mask，释放内存。
 */
 public void clearCache() {
 this.mask = null;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.nn;

import java.util.*;

public class LinearLayer {
 float[] weights;
 float[] bias;
 float[] weightGrad;
 float[] biasGrad;
 float[] lastInput;
 int inFeatures;
 int outFeatures;
 
 public LinearLayer(int inFeatures, int outFeatures) {
 this.inFeatures = inFeatures;
 this.outFeatures = outFeatures;
 this.weights = new float[inFeatures * outFeatures];
 this.bias = new float[outFeatures];
 this.weightGrad = new float[inFeatures * outFeatures];
 this.biasGrad = new float[outFeatures];
 this.lastInput = null;
 
 Random r = new Random(42);
 float scale = (float) Math.sqrt(1.0 / inFeatures);
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] = (float) (r.nextGaussian()) * scale;
 }
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] input) {
 this.lastInput = input.clone();
 int seqLen = input.length / inFeatures;
 float[] output = new float[seqLen * outFeatures];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < outFeatures; i++) {
 output[t * outFeatures + i] = bias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < inFeatures; j++) {
 output[t * outFeatures + i] += input[t * inFeatures + j] * weights[j * outFeatures + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 int seqLen = gradOutput.length / outFeatures;
 float[] gradInput = new float[seqLen * inFeatures];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < inFeatures; j++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < outFeatures; i++) {
 gradInput[t * inFeatures + j] += gradOutput[t * outFeatures + i] * weights[j * outFeatures + i];
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < outFeatures; i++) {
 biasGrad[i] += gradOutput[t * outFeatures + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < inFeatures; j++) {
 weightGrad[j * outFeatures + i] += gradOutput[t * outFeatures + i] * lastInput[t * inFeatures + j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return gradInput;
 }
 
 public void update(float lr, float weightDecay) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] -= lr * (weightGrad[i] + weightDecay * weights[i]);
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < bias.length; i++) {
 bias[i] -= lr * biasGrad[i];
 }
 Arrays.fill(weightGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(biasGrad, 0);
 }

 /**
 * 使用Adam优化器更新参数。
 *
 * @param optimizer Adam优化器实例
 */
 public void updateWithAdam(com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer optimizer) {
 optimizer.update(weights, weightGrad);
 optimizer.update(bias, biasGrad);
 Arrays.fill(weightGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(biasGrad, 0);
 }
 
 public long getParameterCount() {
 return (long) inFeatures * outFeatures + outFeatures;
 }
 
 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws Exception {
 for (float v : weights) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : bias) dos.writeFloat(v);
 }
 
 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws Exception {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < bias.length; i++) {
 bias[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.nn;

import java.util.*;

public class MultiHeadAttention {
 
 public static class AttentionResult {
 public final float[] output;
 public final float[][] attentionWeights;
 public final float[] q, k, v;
 public final float[][] headsOutput;
 
 public AttentionResult(float[] output, float[][] attentionWeights, float[] q, float[] k, float[] v, float[][] headsOutput) {
 this.output = output;
 this.attentionWeights = attentionWeights;
 this.q = q;
 this.k = k;
 this.v = v;
 this.headsOutput = headsOutput;
 }
 }
 
 private final int nHeads;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int dHead;
 private final float[] wQ;
 private final float[] wK;
 private final float[] wV;
 private final float[] wO;
 private final float[] bQ;
 private final float[] bK;
 private final float[] bV;
 private final float[] bO;
 private final float[] wQGrad;
 private final float[] wKGrad;
 private final float[] wVGrad;
 private final float[] wOGrad;
 private final float[] bQGrad;
 private final float[] bKGrad;
 private final float[] bVGrad;
 private final float[] bOGrad;
 private final float scale;
 private float[] lastInput;
 private int lastSeqLen;
 
 public MultiHeadAttention(int dModel, int nHeads) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.nHeads = nHeads;
 this.dHead = dModel / nHeads;
 this.scale = (float) Math.sqrt(dHead);
 
 int paramSize = dModel * dModel;
 
 wQ = new float[paramSize];
 wK = new float[paramSize];
 wV = new float[paramSize];
 wO = new float[paramSize];
 bQ = new float[dModel];
 bK = new float[dModel];
 bV = new float[dModel];
 bO = new float[dModel];
 
 wQGrad = new float[paramSize];
 wKGrad = new float[paramSize];
 wVGrad = new float[paramSize];
 wOGrad = new float[paramSize];
 bQGrad = new float[dModel];
 bKGrad = new float[dModel];
 bVGrad = new float[dModel];
 bOGrad = new float[dModel];
 
 Random r = new Random(42);
 float weightScale = (float) Math.sqrt(1.0 / dModel);
 
 initWeights(wQ, weightScale, r);
 initWeights(wK, weightScale, r);
 initWeights(wV, weightScale, r);
 initWeights(wO, weightScale, r);
 }
 
 private void initWeights(float[] weights, float scale, Random r) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] = (float) (r.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * scale;
 }
 }
 
 public AttentionResult forward(float[] input, int seqLen) {
 this.lastInput = input.clone();
 this.lastSeqLen = seqLen;
 
 float[] q = linear(input, wQ, bQ, seqLen);
 float[] k = linear(input, wK, bK, seqLen);
 float[] v = linear(input, wV, bV, seqLen);
 
 float[][] headsOutput = new float[nHeads][seqLen * dHead];
 float[][] allWeights = new float[nHeads][seqLen * seqLen];
 
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] qHead = extractHead(q, h, seqLen);
 float[] kHead = extractHead(k, h, seqLen);
 float[] vHead = extractHead(v, h, seqLen);
 
 float[] attnWeights = computeAttentionWeights(qHead, kHead, seqLen);
 float[] attnOutput = applyAttention(vHead, attnWeights, seqLen);
 
 headsOutput[h] = attnOutput;
 allWeights[h] = attnWeights;
 }
 
 float[] concatenated = concatenateHeads(headsOutput, seqLen);
 float[] output = linear(concatenated, wO, bO, seqLen);
 
 return new AttentionResult(output, allWeights, q, k, v, headsOutput);
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput, AttentionResult result) {
 int seqLen = lastSeqLen;
 int actualSeqLen = gradOutput.length / dModel;
 
 float[] gradConcatenated = linearBackward(gradOutput, wO, bO, actualSeqLen, wOGrad, bOGrad);
 
 float[][] gradHeads = splitHeads(gradConcatenated, seqLen);
 
 float[] gradQ = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 float[] gradK = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 float[] gradV = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float[] qHead = extractHead(result.q, h, seqLen);
 float[] kHead = extractHead(result.k, h, seqLen);
 float[] vHead = extractHead(result.v, h, seqLen);
 
 float[] gradHead = attentionBackward(gradHeads[h], qHead, kHead, vHead, result.attentionWeights[h], seqLen);
 
 float[] gradQHead = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 float[] gradKHead = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 float[] gradVHead = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 gradQHead[t * dHead + i] = gradHead[t * dHead * 3 + i];
 gradKHead[t * dHead + i] = gradHead[t * dHead * 3 + dHead + i];
 gradVHead[t * dHead + i] = gradHead[t * dHead * 3 + dHead * 2 + i];
 }
 }
 
 mergeHead(gradQHead, gradQ, h, seqLen);
 mergeHead(gradKHead, gradK, h, seqLen);
 mergeHead(gradVHead, gradV, h, seqLen);
 }
 
 float[] gradInput = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 
 float[] gradQInput = linearBackward(gradQ, wQ, bQ, seqLen, wQGrad, bQGrad);
 float[] gradKInput = linearBackward(gradK, wK, bK, seqLen, wKGrad, bKGrad);
 float[] gradVInput = linearBackward(gradV, wV, bV, seqLen, wVGrad, bVGrad);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < gradInput.length; i++) {
 gradInput[i] = gradQInput[i] + gradKInput[i] + gradVInput[i];
 }
 
 return gradInput;
 }
 
 private float[] attentionBackward(float[] gradOutput, float[] q, float[] k, float[] v, float[] attnWeights, int seqLen) {
 float[] gradQ = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 float[] gradK = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 float[] gradV = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 
 float[] gradAttn = new float[seqLen * seqLen];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 gradAttn[t * seqLen + s] += gradOutput[t * dHead + i] * v[s * dHead + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 float g = gradAttn[t * seqLen + s];
 float p = attnWeights[t * seqLen + s];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 gradQ[t * dHead + i] += g * p * k[s * dHead + i] / scale;
 gradK[s * dHead + i] += g * p * q[t * dHead + i] / scale;
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 gradV[s * dHead + i] += gradOutput[t * dHead + i] * attnWeights[t * seqLen + s];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[seqLen * dHead * 3];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 result[t * dHead * 3 + i] = gradQ[t * dHead + i];
 result[t * dHead * 3 + dHead + i] = gradK[t * dHead + i];
 result[t * dHead * 3 + dHead * 2 + i] = gradV[t * dHead + i];
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] linear(float[] input, float[] weights, float[] bias, int seqLen) {
 float[] output = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 float sum = bias[i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 sum += input[t * dModel + j] * weights[j * dModel + i];
 }
 output[t * dModel + i] = sum;
 }
 }
 return output;
 }
 
 private float[] linearBackward(float[] gradOutput, float[] weights, float[] bias, int seqLen, float[] weightGrad, float[] biasGrad) {
 float[] gradInput = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gradInput[t * dModel + j] += gradOutput[t * dModel + i] * weights[j * dModel + i];
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 biasGrad[i] += gradOutput[t * dModel + i];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 weightGrad[j * dModel + i] += gradOutput[t * dModel + i] * lastInput[t * dModel + j];
 }
 }
 }
 
 return gradInput;
 }
 
 private float[] extractHead(float[] input, int headIdx, int seqLen) {
 float[] head = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 int offset = headIdx * dHead;
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 head[t * dHead + i] = input[t * dModel + offset + i];
 }
 }
 return head;
 }
 
 private void mergeHead(float[] head, float[] output, int headIdx, int seqLen) {
 int offset = headIdx * dHead;
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 output[t * dModel + offset + i] += head[t * dHead + i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 private float[][] splitHeads(float[] input, int seqLen) {
 float[][] heads = new float[nHeads][seqLen * dHead];
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 heads[h] = extractHead(input, h, seqLen);
 }
 return heads;
 }
 
 private float[] computeAttentionWeights(float[] q, float[] k, int seqLen) {
 float[] scores = new float[seqLen * seqLen];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 float score = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 score += q[t * dHead + i] * k[s * dHead + i];
 }
 scores[t * seqLen + s] = score / scale;
 }
 }
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int s = t + 1; s < seqLen; s++) {
 scores[t * seqLen + s] = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 }
 
 return softmax2D(scores, seqLen);
 }
 
 private float[] softmax2D(float[] scores, int seqLen) {
 float[] result = new float[seqLen * seqLen];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 float maxScore = scores[t * seqLen];
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 if (scores[t * seqLen + s] > maxScore) {
 maxScore = scores[t * seqLen + s];
 }
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 result[t * seqLen + s] = (float) Math.exp(scores[t * seqLen + s] - maxScore);
 sum += result[t * seqLen + s];
 }
 
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 result[t * seqLen + s] /= sum;
 }
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] applyAttention(float[] v, float[] weights, int seqLen) {
 float[] output = new float[seqLen * dHead];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 sum += weights[t * seqLen + s] * v[s * dHead + i];
 }
 output[t * dHead + i] = sum;
 }
 }
 return output;
 }
 
 private float[] concatenateHeads(float[][] heads, int seqLen) {
 float[] result = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 int offset = h * dHead;
 for (int i = 0; i < dHead; i++) {
 result[t * dModel + offset + i] = heads[h][t * dHead + i];
 }
 }
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 public void update(float lr, float weightDecay) {
 applyGradients(wQ, wQGrad, lr, weightDecay);
 applyGradients(wK, wKGrad, lr, weightDecay);
 applyGradients(wV, wVGrad, lr, weightDecay);
 applyGradients(wO, wOGrad, lr, weightDecay);
 
 applyBiasGradients(bQ, bQGrad, lr);
 applyBiasGradients(bK, bKGrad, lr);
 applyBiasGradients(bV, bVGrad, lr);
 applyBiasGradients(bO, bOGrad, lr);
 
 Arrays.fill(wQGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wKGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wVGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wOGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bQGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bKGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bVGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bOGrad, 0);
 }

 /**
 * 使用Adam优化器更新所有参数（wQ/wK/wV/wO/bQ/bK/bV/bO）。
 *
 * @param optimizer Adam优化器实例
 */
 public void updateWithAdam(com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer optimizer) {
 optimizer.update(wQ, wQGrad);
 optimizer.update(wK, wKGrad);
 optimizer.update(wV, wVGrad);
 optimizer.update(wO, wOGrad);
 optimizer.update(bQ, bQGrad);
 optimizer.update(bK, bKGrad);
 optimizer.update(bV, bVGrad);
 optimizer.update(bO, bOGrad);

 Arrays.fill(wQGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wKGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wVGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(wOGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bQGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bKGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bVGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(bOGrad, 0);
 }
 
 private void applyGradients(float[] weights, float[] grads, float lr, float weightDecay) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] -= lr * (grads[i] + weightDecay * weights[i]);
 }
 }
 
 private void applyBiasGradients(float[] bias, float[] grads, float lr) {
 for (int i = 0; i < bias.length; i++) {
 bias[i] -= lr * grads[i];
 }
 }
 
 public long getParameterCount() {
 return (long) dModel * dModel * 4 + dModel * 4;
 }
 
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getNHeads() { return nHeads; }
 public int getDHead() { return dHead; }
 
 public float[] getWeights() {
 float[] allWeights = new float[wQ.length * 4];
 System.arraycopy(wQ, 0, allWeights, 0, wQ.length);
 System.arraycopy(wK, 0, allWeights, wQ.length, wK.length);
 System.arraycopy(wV, 0, allWeights, wQ.length * 2, wV.length);
 System.arraycopy(wO, 0, allWeights, wQ.length * 3, wO.length);
 return allWeights;
 }
 
 public void save(java.io.DataOutputStream dos) throws Exception {
 for (float v : wQ) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : wK) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : wV) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : wO) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : bQ) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : bK) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : bV) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : bO) dos.writeFloat(v);
 }
 
 public void load(java.io.DataInputStream dis) throws Exception {
 for (int i = 0; i < wQ.length; i++) wQ[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < wK.length; i++) wK[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < wV.length; i++) wV[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < wO.length; i++) wO[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < bQ.length; i++) bQ[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < bK.length; i++) bK[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < bV.length; i++) bV[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < bO.length; i++) bO[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC Architecture - Multi-Head Attention Test");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 int dModel = 64;
 int nHeads = 8;
 int seqLen = 10;
 
 System.out.println("[1/3] Creating attention layer...");
 MultiHeadAttention attention = new MultiHeadAttention(dModel, nHeads);
 System.out.printf(" dModel: %d, nHeads: %d, dHead: %d%n", dModel, nHeads, dModel / nHeads);
 System.out.printf(" Parameters: %.2fM%n", attention.getParameterCount() / 1_000_000.0);
 
 System.out.println("\n[2/3] Forward pass...");
 float[] input = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 Random r = new Random(42);
 for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
 input[i] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.1f;
 }
 
 AttentionResult result = attention.forward(input, seqLen);
 System.out.printf(" Input shape: (%d, %d)%n", seqLen, dModel);
 System.out.printf(" Output shape: (%d, %d)%n", seqLen, dModel);
 System.out.printf(" Output norm: %.4f%n", computeNorm(result.output));
 
 System.out.println("\n[3/3] Backward pass...");
 float[] gradOutput = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 gradOutput[i] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.1f;
 }
 
 float[] gradInput = attention.backward(gradOutput, result);
 System.out.printf(" Gradient norm: %.4f%n", computeNorm(gradInput));
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Multi-Head Attention Test Passed!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
 
 private static float computeNorm(float[] arr) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float v : arr) sum += v * v;
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.nn;

import java.util.*;

public class Transformer {
 
 public static class TransformerConfig {
 public int dModel = 64;
 public int nLayers = 2;
 public int nHeads = 8;
 public int vocabSize = 256;
 public int seqLen = 32;
 public float dropout = 0.1f;
 
 public TransformerConfig dModel(int val) { dModel = val; return this; }
 public TransformerConfig nLayers(int val) { nLayers = val; return this; }
 public TransformerConfig nHeads(int val) { nHeads = val; return this; }
 public TransformerConfig vocabSize(int val) { vocabSize = val; return this; }
 public TransformerConfig seqLen(int val) { seqLen = val; return this; }
 public TransformerConfig dropout(float val) { dropout = val; return this; }
 }
 
 private final TransformerConfig config;
 private final float[] embeddings;
 private final float[] embGrad;
 private final MultiHeadAttention[] attentions;
 private final LinearLayer[] ffnLayers1;
 private final LinearLayer[] ffnLayers2;
 private final float[] lnGamma;
 private final float[] lnBeta;
 private final float[] lnGammaGrad;
 private final float[] lnBetaGrad;
 private final LinearLayer outputLayer;
 private final float[] posEncoding;
 private final Dropout[] attnDropouts;
 private final Dropout[] ffnDropouts;
 private boolean trainingMode = true;

 public Transformer(TransformerConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 
 this.embeddings = new float[config.vocabSize * config.dModel];
 this.embGrad = new float[config.vocabSize * config.dModel];
 initEmbeddings();
 
 this.attentions = new MultiHeadAttention[config.nLayers];
 this.ffnLayers1 = new LinearLayer[config.nLayers];
 this.ffnLayers2 = new LinearLayer[config.nLayers];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.nLayers; i++) {
 attentions[i] = new MultiHeadAttention(config.dModel, config.nHeads);
 ffnLayers1[i] = new LinearLayer(config.dModel, config.dModel * 4);
 ffnLayers2[i] = new LinearLayer(config.dModel * 4, config.dModel);
 }
 
 this.lnGamma = new float[config.dModel];
 this.lnBeta = new float[config.dModel];
 this.lnGammaGrad = new float[config.dModel];
 this.lnBetaGrad = new float[config.dModel];
 Arrays.fill(lnGamma, 1.0f);
 Arrays.fill(lnBeta, 0.0f);
 
 this.outputLayer = new LinearLayer(config.dModel, config.vocabSize);

 this.posEncoding = new float[config.seqLen * config.dModel];
 initPosEncoding();

 // 初始化Dropout层
 this.attnDropouts = new Dropout[config.nLayers];
 this.ffnDropouts = new Dropout[config.nLayers];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.nLayers; i++) {
 attnDropouts[i] = new Dropout(config.dropout, 42 + i);
 ffnDropouts[i] = new Dropout(config.dropout, 100 + i);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 设置训练/推理模式。
 *
 * @param training true=训练模式，false=推理模式
 */
 public void setTraining(boolean training) {
 this.trainingMode = training;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.nLayers; i++) {
 attnDropouts[i].setTraining(training);
 ffnDropouts[i].setTraining(training);
 }
 }
 
 private void initPosEncoding() {
 for (int pos = 0; pos < config.seqLen; pos++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i += 2) {
 float angle = pos / (float) Math.pow(10000, (2 * i) / (float) config.dModel);
 posEncoding[pos * config.dModel + i] = (float) Math.sin(angle);
 if (i + 1 < config.dModel) {
 posEncoding[pos * config.dModel + i + 1] = (float) Math.cos(angle);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void initEmbeddings() {
 Random r = new Random(42);
 float scale = (float) Math.sqrt(1.0 / config.dModel);
 for (int i = 0; i < embeddings.length; i++) {
 embeddings[i] = (float) (r.nextDouble() * 2 - 1) * scale;
 }
 }
 
 public float[] forward(int[] tokens) {
 int seqLen = Math.min(tokens.length, config.seqLen);
 float[] hidden = new float[seqLen * config.dModel];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int token = tokens[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 hidden[t * config.dModel + i] = embeddings[token * config.dModel + i] + posEncoding[t * config.dModel + i];
 }
 }
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 float[] attnInput = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 MultiHeadAttention.AttentionResult attnResult = attentions[l].forward(attnInput, seqLen);
 float[] attnOutput = attnResult.output;
 // 应用Attention Dropout
 attnOutput = attnDropouts[l].forward(attnOutput);

 for (int i = 0; i < hidden.length; i++) {
 hidden[i] = hidden[i] + attnOutput[i];
 }

 float[] ffnInput = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 float[] ffnHidden = relu(ffnLayers1[l].forward(ffnInput));
 float[] ffnOutput = ffnLayers2[l].forward(ffnHidden);
 // 应用FFN Dropout
 ffnOutput = ffnDropouts[l].forward(ffnOutput);

 for (int i = 0; i < hidden.length; i++) {
 hidden[i] = hidden[i] + ffnOutput[i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] finalNorm = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 float[] logits = outputLayer.forward(finalNorm);
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 private float[] layerNorm(float[] input, int seqLen) {
 float[] output = new float[seqLen * config.dModel];
 float eps = 1e-5f;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 mean += input[t * config.dModel + i];
 }
 mean /= config.dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 float diff = input[t * config.dModel + i] - mean;
 var += diff * diff;
 }
 var /= config.dModel;
 
 if (var < eps) {
 var = eps;
 }
 
 float sqrtVar = (float) Math.sqrt(var + eps);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 float x = input[t * config.dModel + i];
 output[t * config.dModel + i] = lnGamma[i] * (x - mean) / sqrtVar + lnBeta[i];
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 private float[] relu(float[] input) {
 float[] output = new float[input.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
 output[i] = Math.max(0, input[i]);
 }
 return output;
 }
 
 private float[] reluBackward(float[] gradOutput, float[] input) {
 float[] gradInput = new float[gradOutput.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutput.length; i++) {
 int idx = Math.min(i, input.length - 1);
 gradInput[i] = input[idx] > 0 ? gradOutput[i] : 0;
 }
 return gradInput;
 }
 
 private float[] layerNormBackward(float[] gradOutput, float[] input, int seqLen) {
 int actualSeqLen = gradOutput.length / config.dModel;
 float[] gradInput = new float[actualSeqLen * config.dModel];
 float eps = 1e-5f;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < actualSeqLen; t++) {
 float mean = 0;
 int inputIdx = Math.min(t, seqLen - 1);
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 mean += input[inputIdx * config.dModel + i];
 }
 mean /= config.dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 var += (input[inputIdx * config.dModel + i] - mean) * (input[inputIdx * config.dModel + i] - mean);
 }
 var /= config.dModel;
 
 float sqrtVar = (float) Math.sqrt(var + eps);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 float x = input[inputIdx * config.dModel + i];
 float dx = (x - mean) / sqrtVar;
 
 lnGammaGrad[i] += gradOutput[t * config.dModel + i] * dx;
 lnBetaGrad[i] += gradOutput[t * config.dModel + i];
 
 float dMean = -gradOutput[t * config.dModel + i] * lnGamma[i] / sqrtVar;
 float dVar = gradOutput[t * config.dModel + i] * lnGamma[i] * dx * (-0.5f) / (var + eps);
 
 gradInput[t * config.dModel + i] += gradOutput[t * config.dModel + i] * lnGamma[i] / sqrtVar;
 gradInput[t * config.dModel + i] += dMean / config.dModel;
 gradInput[t * config.dModel + i] += dVar * 2 * (x - mean) / config.dModel;
 }
 }
 
 return gradInput;
 }
 
 public float trainStep(int[] inputTokens, int[] targetTokens, float lr, float weightDecay) {
 int seqLen = Math.min(inputTokens.length, config.seqLen);
 
 float[] hidden = new float[seqLen * config.dModel];
 float[][] layerInputs = new float[config.nLayers][];
 float[][] layerHidden = new float[config.nLayers][];
 MultiHeadAttention.AttentionResult[] attnResults = new MultiHeadAttention.AttentionResult[config.nLayers];
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int token = inputTokens[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 hidden[t * config.dModel + i] = embeddings[token * config.dModel + i];
 }
 }
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 layerInputs[l] = hidden.clone();
 float[] attnInput = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 attnResults[l] = attentions[l].forward(attnInput, seqLen);
 // 训练时应用Attention Dropout
 float[] attnOut = trainingMode ? attnDropouts[l].forward(attnResults[l].output) : attnResults[l].output;

 for (int i = 0; i < hidden.length; i++) {
 hidden[i] = hidden[i] + attnOut[i];
 }

 layerHidden[l] = hidden.clone();
 float[] ffnInput = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 float[] ffnHidden = relu(ffnLayers1[l].forward(ffnInput));
 float[] ffnOutput = ffnLayers2[l].forward(ffnHidden);
 // 训练时应用FFN Dropout
 float[] ffnOut = trainingMode ? ffnDropouts[l].forward(ffnOutput) : ffnOutput;

 for (int i = 0; i < hidden.length; i++) {
 hidden[i] = hidden[i] + ffnOut[i];
 }
 }
 
 if (hasNaN(hidden)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in hidden");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 float[] finalNorm = layerNorm(hidden, seqLen);
 float[] logits = outputLayer.forward(finalNorm);
 
 if (hasNaN(logits)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in logits");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 float loss = 0;
 int count = 0;
 float[] gradLogits = new float[seqLen * config.vocabSize];
 Arrays.fill(gradLogits, 0);
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 if (t >= targetTokens.length) break;
 
 int target = targetTokens[t];
 
 float maxLogit = logits[t * config.vocabSize];
 for (int i = 1; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 if (logits[t * config.vocabSize + i] > maxLogit) {
 maxLogit = logits[t * config.vocabSize + i];
 }
 }
 
 float[] softmax = new float[config.vocabSize];
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 softmax[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[t * config.vocabSize + i] - maxLogit);
 sum += softmax[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 softmax[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 loss += (float) -Math.log(Math.max(1e-10f, softmax[target]));
 count++;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 gradLogits[t * config.vocabSize + i] = softmax[i];
 }
 gradLogits[t * config.vocabSize + target] -= 1.0f;
 }
 
 loss /= count;
 
 if (hasNaN(gradLogits)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in gradLogits");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 float[] gradFinalNorm = outputLayer.backward(gradLogits);
 clipGradient(gradFinalNorm, 1.0f);
 if (hasNaN(gradFinalNorm)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in gradFinalNorm");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 float[] gradHidden = layerNormBackward(gradFinalNorm, hidden, seqLen);
 clipGradient(gradHidden, 1.0f);
 if (hasNaN(gradHidden)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in gradHidden after first layerNormBackward");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 for (int l = config.nLayers - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
 float[] gradFFN = gradHidden.clone();
 // FFN Dropout反向传播
 if (trainingMode) {
 gradFFN = ffnDropouts[l].backward(gradFFN);
 clipGradient(gradFFN, 1.0f);
 }
 float[] gradFFNOutput = ffnLayers2[l].backward(gradFFN);
 clipGradient(gradFFNOutput, 1.0f);
 float[] gradFFNHidden = reluBackward(gradFFNOutput, ffnLayers1[l].lastInput);
 clipGradient(gradFFNHidden, 1.0f);
 float[] gradFFNInput = ffnLayers1[l].backward(gradFFNHidden);
 clipGradient(gradFFNInput, 1.0f);

 float[] gradAfterFFN = layerNormBackward(gradFFNInput, layerHidden[l], seqLen);
 clipGradient(gradAfterFFN, 1.0f);

 float[] gradAttn = gradAfterFFN.clone();
 for (int i = 0; i < gradAttn.length; i++) {
 gradAttn[i] += gradHidden[i];
 }
 // Attention Dropout反向传播
 if (trainingMode) {
 gradAttn = attnDropouts[l].backward(gradAttn);
 clipGradient(gradAttn, 1.0f);
 }

 float[] gradAttnOutput = attentions[l].backward(gradAttn, attnResults[l]);
 clipGradient(gradAttnOutput, 1.0f);
 gradHidden = layerNormBackward(gradAttnOutput, layerInputs[l], seqLen);
 clipGradient(gradHidden, 1.0f);
 }
 
 if (hasNaN(gradHidden)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in gradHidden");
 System.out.println(" gradHidden length: " + gradHidden.length);
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(10, gradHidden.length); i++) {
 System.out.println(" gradHidden[" + i + "]: " + gradHidden[i]);
 }
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int token = inputTokens[t];
 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 embGrad[token * config.dModel + i] += gradHidden[t * config.dModel + i];
 }
 }
 
 if (hasNaN(embGrad)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in embGrad before clip");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 clipGradients(1.0f);
 if (hasNaN(embGrad)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in embGrad after clip");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 updateParameters(lr, weightDecay);
 
 if (hasNaN(embeddings)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in embeddings after update");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 
 float maxEmb = 0;
 for (float v : embeddings) {
 maxEmb = Math.max(maxEmb, Math.abs(v));
 }
 if (maxEmb > 100) {
 System.out.println("WARNING: Embeddings have large values: " + maxEmb);
 }
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 if (hasNaN(attentions[l].getWeights())) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in attention weights after update");
 return Float.NaN;
 }
 }
 
 return loss;
 }
 
 private boolean hasNaN(float[] arr) {
 for (float v : arr) {
 if (Float.isNaN(v) || Float.isInfinite(v)) return true;
 }
 return false;
 }
 
 private void clipGradients(float maxNorm) {
 float norm = 0;
 for (float g : embGrad) norm += g * g;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 
 if (norm > maxNorm) {
 float scale = maxNorm / norm;
 for (int i = 0; i < embGrad.length; i++) {
 embGrad[i] *= scale;
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void clipGradient(float[] grad, float maxNorm) {
 float norm = 0;
 for (float g : grad) norm += g * g;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 
 if (norm > maxNorm) {
 float scale = maxNorm / norm;
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 grad[i] *= scale;
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void updateParameters(float lr, float weightDecay) {
 // 当lr=0且weightDecay=0时，跳过更新和梯度清零，保留梯度供Adam使用
 if (lr == 0.0f && weightDecay == 0.0f) {
 return;
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < embeddings.length; i++) {
 embeddings[i] -= lr * (embGrad[i] + weightDecay * embeddings[i]);
 }
 Arrays.fill(embGrad, 0);

 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 attentions[l].update(lr, weightDecay);
 ffnLayers1[l].update(lr, weightDecay);
 ffnLayers2[l].update(lr, weightDecay);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < config.dModel; i++) {
 lnGamma[i] -= lr * (lnGammaGrad[i] + weightDecay * lnGamma[i]);
 lnBeta[i] -= lr * lnBetaGrad[i];
 }
 Arrays.fill(lnGammaGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(lnBetaGrad, 0);

 outputLayer.update(lr, weightDecay);
 }

 /**
 * 使用Adam优化器更新参数。
 *
 * @param optimizer Adam优化器实例
 */
 public void updateParametersWithAdam(com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer optimizer) {
 // 更新embeddings
 optimizer.update(embeddings, embGrad);
 Arrays.fill(embGrad, 0);

 // 更新每层参数
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 attentions[l].updateWithAdam(optimizer);
 ffnLayers1[l].updateWithAdam(optimizer);
 ffnLayers2[l].updateWithAdam(optimizer);
 }

 // 更新LayerNorm参数
 optimizer.update(lnGamma, lnGammaGrad);
 optimizer.update(lnBeta, lnBetaGrad);
 Arrays.fill(lnGammaGrad, 0);
 Arrays.fill(lnBetaGrad, 0);

 // 更新输出层
 outputLayer.updateWithAdam(optimizer);
 }

 /**
 * 使用Adam优化器的trainStep。
 *
 * @param inputTokens 输入tokens
 * @param targetTokens 目标tokens
 * @param optimizer Adam优化器
 * @return 训练损失
 */
 public float trainStepWithAdam(int[] inputTokens, int[] targetTokens,
 com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer optimizer) {
 float loss = trainStepForwardBackward(inputTokens, targetTokens);
 if (Float.isNaN(loss)) return loss;

 // 使用Adam更新参数
 updateParametersWithAdam(optimizer);

 if (hasNaN(embeddings)) {
 System.out.println("ERROR: NaN in embeddings after Adam update");
 return Float.NaN;
 }

 return loss;
 }

 /**
 * 仅执行前向和反向传播，不更新参数。
 * 用于分离梯度计算和参数更新。
 *
 * @param inputTokens 输入tokens
 * @param targetTokens 目标tokens
 * @return 训练损失
 */
 public float trainStepForwardBackward(int[] inputTokens, int[] targetTokens) {
 return trainStep(inputTokens, targetTokens, 0.0f, 0.0f);
 }
 
 public int predictNext(int[] tokens) {
 float[] logits = forward(tokens);
 int lastPos = Math.min(tokens.length - 1, config.seqLen - 1);
 
 int maxIdx = 0;
 float maxVal = logits[lastPos * config.vocabSize];
 for (int i = 1; i < config.vocabSize; i++) {
 if (logits[lastPos * config.vocabSize + i] > maxVal) {
 maxVal = logits[lastPos * config.vocabSize + i];
 maxIdx = i;
 }
 }
 
 return maxIdx;
 }
 
 public int getVocabSize() {
 return config.vocabSize;
 }
 
 public long getParameterCount() {
 long count = (long) config.vocabSize * config.dModel;
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 count += attentions[l].getParameterCount();
 count += ffnLayers1[l].getParameterCount();
 count += ffnLayers2[l].getParameterCount();
 }
 
 count += outputLayer.getParameterCount();
 
 return count;
 }
 
 public TransformerConfig getConfig() { return config; }
 
 public void save(String filePath) throws Exception {
 try (java.io.DataOutputStream dos = new java.io.DataOutputStream(
 new java.io.FileOutputStream(filePath))) {
 dos.writeInt(config.dModel);
 dos.writeInt(config.nLayers);
 dos.writeInt(config.nHeads);
 dos.writeInt(config.vocabSize);
 dos.writeInt(config.seqLen);
 
 for (float v : embeddings) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : lnGamma) dos.writeFloat(v);
 for (float v : lnBeta) dos.writeFloat(v);
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 attentions[l].save(dos);
 ffnLayers1[l].save(dos);
 ffnLayers2[l].save(dos);
 }
 
 outputLayer.save(dos);
 }
 }
 
 public static Transformer load(String filePath) throws Exception {
 try (java.io.DataInputStream dis = new java.io.DataInputStream(
 new java.io.FileInputStream(filePath))) {
 int dModel = dis.readInt();
 int nLayers = dis.readInt();
 int nHeads = dis.readInt();
 int vocabSize = dis.readInt();
 int seqLen = dis.readInt();
 
 TransformerConfig config = new TransformerConfig()
 .dModel(dModel)
 .nLayers(nLayers)
 .nHeads(nHeads)
 .vocabSize(vocabSize)
 .seqLen(seqLen);
 
 Transformer model = new Transformer(config);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < model.embeddings.length; i++) {
 model.embeddings[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < model.lnGamma.length; i++) {
 model.lnGamma[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < model.lnBeta.length; i++) {
 model.lnBeta[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 
 for (int l = 0; l < config.nLayers; l++) {
 model.attentions[l].load(dis);
 model.ffnLayers1[l].load(dis);
 model.ffnLayers2[l].load(dis);
 }
 
 model.outputLayer.load(dis);
 
 return model;
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC Architecture - Transformer Model Test");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 TransformerConfig config = new TransformerConfig()
 .dModel(64)
 .nLayers(2)
 .nHeads(8)
 .vocabSize(128)
 .seqLen(32);
 
 System.out.println("[1/3] Creating Transformer...");
 Transformer model = new Transformer(config);
 System.out.printf(" Architecture: dModel=%d, nLayers=%d, nHeads=%d%n", 
 config.dModel, config.nLayers, config.nHeads);
 System.out.printf(" Parameters: %.2fM%n", model.getParameterCount() / 1_000_000.0);
 
 System.out.println("\n[2/3] Forward pass test...");
 int[] tokens = new int[10];
 Random r = new Random(42);
 for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
 tokens[i] = r.nextInt(config.vocabSize);
 }
 
 float[] logits = model.forward(tokens);
 System.out.printf(" Input tokens: %d%n", tokens.length);
 System.out.printf(" Output logits shape: (%d, %d)%n", tokens.length, config.vocabSize);
 System.out.printf(" Logits norm: %.4f%n", computeNorm(logits));
 
 System.out.println("\n[3/3] Prediction test...");
 int nextToken = model.predictNext(tokens);
 System.out.printf(" Predicted next token: %d%n", nextToken);
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Transformer Test Passed!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
 
 private static float computeNorm(float[] arr) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (float v : arr) sum += v * v;
 return (float) Math.sqrt(sum);
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.orchestration;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class DynamicOrchestrator {
 private ModuleAddressor addressor;
 private KnowledgeModuleSpace knowledgeSpace;
 
 private long totalLatency;
 private long queryCount;
 private long ragLatency;
 
 public DynamicOrchestrator(int dim, int maxModules) {
 this.addressor = new ModuleAddressor(dim, maxModules);
 this.knowledgeSpace = new KnowledgeModuleSpace(dim);
 this.totalLatency = 0;
 this.queryCount = 0;
 this.ragLatency = 0;
 }
 
 public void registerCapabilityModule(String moduleId, float[] activation, 
 String category, String description) {
 addressor.registerModule(moduleId, activation, category);
 knowledgeSpace.addModule(moduleId, activation, category, description);
 }
 
 public float[] orchestrate(float[] queryEmbedding, int nSteps, float temperature) {
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 List<ModuleAddressor.VectorActivation> candidates = addressor.query(queryEmbedding, 5, 0.3f);
 
 float[] combinedActivation = new float[queryEmbedding.length];
 float totalWeight = 0.0f;
 
 for (ModuleAddressor.VectorActivation va : candidates) {
 float weight = (float) Math.pow(va.getActivation()[0], 1.0 / temperature);
 totalWeight += weight;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < queryEmbedding.length; i++) {
 combinedActivation[i] += va.getActivation()[i] * weight;
 }
 }
 
 if (totalWeight > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < queryEmbedding.length; i++) {
 combinedActivation[i] /= totalWeight;
 }
 }
 
 float[] finalResult = executeMultiStepReasoning(queryEmbedding, combinedActivation, nSteps);
 
 long endTime = System.nanoTime();
 totalLatency += (endTime - startTime);
 queryCount++;
 
 return finalResult;
 }
 
 private float[] executeMultiStepReasoning(float[] query, float[] moduleActivation, int nSteps) {
 float[] state = new float[query.length];
 System.arraycopy(query, 0, state, 0, query.length);
 
 for (int step = 0; step < nSteps; step++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < query.length; i++) {
 state[i] = state[i] * 0.9f + moduleActivation[i] * 0.1f;
 }
 
 float[] context = knowledgeSpace.retrieveContext(state, 3);
 for (int i = 0; i < query.length; i++) {
 state[i] += context[i] * 0.05f;
 }
 }
 
 return state;
 }
 
 public float[] crossDocumentRetrieval(float[] query, List<String> documentIds) {
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 float[] result = new float[query.length];
 
 for (String docId : documentIds) {
 float[] docEmbedding = knowledgeSpace.getDocumentEmbedding(docId);
 if (docEmbedding != null) {
 float similarity = cosineSimilarity(query, docEmbedding);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < query.length; i++) {
 result[i] += docEmbedding[i] * similarity;
 }
 }
 }
 
 ragLatency += (System.nanoTime() - startTime);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0.0f, normA = 0.0f, normB = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }
 
 public LatencyReport getLatencyReport() {
 float avgLatency = queryCount > 0 ? (float) totalLatency / queryCount / 1_000_000.0f : 0;
 float avgRagLatency = queryCount > 0 ? (float) ragLatency / queryCount / 1_000_000.0f : 0;
 float improvement = avgRagLatency > 0 ? (1 - avgLatency / avgRagLatency) * 100 : 0;
 
 return new LatencyReport(avgLatency, avgRagLatency, improvement);
 }
 
 public static class LatencyReport {
 public float avgOrchestrationLatencyMs;
 public float avgRagLatencyMs;
 public float improvementPercent;
 
 public LatencyReport(float orchestration, float rag, float improvement) {
 this.avgOrchestrationLatencyMs = orchestration;
 this.avgRagLatencyMs = rag;
 this.improvementPercent = improvement;
 }
 
 public String toString() {
 return String.format(
 "Latency Report:\n Orchestration: %.2f ms\n Traditional RAG: %.2f ms\n Improvement: %.1f%%",
 avgOrchestrationLatencyMs, avgRagLatencyMs, improvementPercent
 );
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.orchestration;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class KnowledgeModuleSpace {
 private Map<String, KnowledgeModule> modules;
 private Map<String, float[]> documents;
 private int dim;
 
 public KnowledgeModuleSpace(int dim) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.modules = new HashMap<>();
 this.documents = new HashMap<>();
 }
 
 public void addModule(String moduleId, float[] activation, String category, String description) {
 KnowledgeModule module = new KnowledgeModule(moduleId, activation, category, description);
 modules.put(moduleId, module);
 }
 
 public void addDocument(String docId, float[] embedding) {
 documents.put(docId, embedding);
 }
 
 public float[] getDocumentEmbedding(String docId) {
 return documents.get(docId);
 }
 
 public float[] retrieveContext(float[] query, int topK) {
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 
 List<SimilarityEntry> similarities = new ArrayList<>();
 for (KnowledgeModule module : modules.values()) {
 float sim = cosineSimilarity(query, module.getActivation());
 similarities.add(new SimilarityEntry(module, sim));
 }
 
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : documents.entrySet()) {
 float sim = cosineSimilarity(query, entry.getValue());
 KnowledgeModule dummy = new KnowledgeModule(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue(), "document", "");
 similarities.add(new SimilarityEntry(dummy, sim));
 }
 
 similarities.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(b.similarity, a.similarity));
 
 float totalWeight = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(topK, similarities.size()); i++) {
 float weight = similarities.get(i).similarity;
 totalWeight += weight;
 
 float[] activation = similarities.get(i).module.getActivation();
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 result[j] += activation[j] * weight;
 }
 }
 
 if (totalWeight > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 result[i] /= totalWeight;
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0.0f, normA = 0.0f, normB = 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }
 
 public int getModuleCount() {
 return modules.size();
 }
 
 public int getDocumentCount() {
 return documents.size();
 }
 
 public static class KnowledgeModule {
 private String moduleId;
 private float[] activation;
 private String category;
 private String description;
 
 public KnowledgeModule(String moduleId, float[] activation, String category, String description) {
 this.moduleId = moduleId;
 this.activation = activation;
 this.category = category;
 this.description = description;
 }
 
 public String getModuleId() {
 return moduleId;
 }
 
 public float[] getActivation() {
 return activation;
 }
 
 public String getCategory() {
 return category;
 }
 
 public String getDescription() {
 return description;
 }
 }
 
 private static class SimilarityEntry {
 KnowledgeModule module;
 float similarity;
 
 SimilarityEntry(KnowledgeModule module, float similarity) {
 this.module = module;
 this.similarity = similarity;
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.orchestration;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ModuleAddressor {
 private List<VectorActivation> activationSpace;
 private int dim;
 private float[] projectionMatrix;
 
 public ModuleAddressor(int dim, int maxModules) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.activationSpace = new ArrayList<>(maxModules);
 this.projectionMatrix = new float[dim * dim];
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dim));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * dim; i++) {
 projectionMatrix[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 public void registerModule(String moduleId, float[] activation, String category) {
 VectorActivation va = new VectorActivation(moduleId, activation, category);
 va.setProjectedActivation(project(activation));
 activationSpace.add(va);
 }
 
 public List<VectorActivation> query(float[] query, int topK, float threshold) {
 float[] projectedQuery = project(query);
 
 List<ActivationScore> scores = new ArrayList<>();
 for (VectorActivation va : activationSpace) {
 float score = cosineSimilarity(projectedQuery, va.getProjectedActivation());
 if (score > threshold) {
 scores.add(new ActivationScore(va, score));
 }
 }
 
 scores.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(b.score, a.score));
 
 List<VectorActivation> results = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(topK, scores.size()); i++) {
 results.add(scores.get(i).activation);
 }
 
 return results;
 }
 
 public List<VectorActivation> queryByCategory(String category) {
 List<VectorActivation> results = new ArrayList<>();
 for (VectorActivation va : activationSpace) {
 if (va.getCategory().equals(category)) {
 results.add(va);
 }
 }
 return results;
 }
 
 private float[] project(float[] x) {
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 float sum = 0.0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 sum += projectionMatrix[i * dim + j] * x[j];
 }
 result[i] = sum;
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0.0f;
 float normA = 0.0f;
 float normB = 0.0f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }
 
 public int getModuleCount() {
 return activationSpace.size();
 }
 
 public static class VectorActivation {
 private String moduleId;
 private float[] activation;
 private float[] projectedActivation;
 private String category;
 
 public VectorActivation(String moduleId, float[] activation, String category) {
 this.moduleId = moduleId;
 this.activation = activation;
 this.category = category;
 }
 
 public String getModuleId() {
 return moduleId;
 }
 
 public float[] getActivation() {
 return activation;
 }
 
 public float[] getProjectedActivation() {
 return projectedActivation;
 }
 
 public void setProjectedActivation(float[] projected) {
 this.projectedActivation = projected;
 }
 
 public String getCategory() {
 return category;
 }
 }
 
 private static class ActivationScore {
 VectorActivation activation;
 float score;
 
 ActivationScore(VectorActivation activation, float score) {
 this.activation = activation;
 this.score = score;
 }
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.search;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.antihallucination.AntiHallucinationSystem.ValidationChainResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTConfig;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.tokenizer.BPETokenizer;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * 青小团助手 - 100M参数模型部署核心
 * 整合RDT模型推理 + 联网搜索 + 总结引擎 + 抗幻觉四层闸门
 * 
 * 工作流程：
 * 1. 输入结构闸门 → 验证输入合法性
 * 2. 边界约束闸门 → 判断场景类型
 * 3. 模型推理/联网搜索 → 生成候选回答
 * 4. 总结引擎 → 提炼关键信息
 * 5. 输入验证闸门 → 三层校验
 * 6. 输出最终回答
 */
public class QingxiaotuanAssistant {
 private RDTConfig config;
 private BPETokenizer tokenizer;
 private WebSearchEngine searchEngine;
 private SummarizationEngine summarizationEngine;
 private AntiHallucinationSystem antiHallucination;
 
 private boolean modelInitialized;
 private long modelParamCount;
 
 public QingxiaotuanAssistant() {
 System.out.println("[青小团] 正在初始化100M参数模型...");
 
 this.config = RDTConfig.qingxiaotuan_100m();
 this.modelParamCount = config.estimateParams();
 System.out.printf("[青小团] 模型参数量: %,d (%.1fM)%n", modelParamCount, modelParamCount / 1_000_000.0);
 System.out.printf("[青小团] 配置: dim=%d, vocab=%d, heads=%d, experts=%d, loops=%d%n",
 config.dim, config.vocabSize, config.nHeads, config.nExperts, config.maxLoopIters);
 
 this.tokenizer = new BPETokenizer();
 trainTokenizerSample();
 
 this.searchEngine = new WebSearchEngine();
 System.out.println("[青小团] 联网搜索: " + (searchEngine.isNetworkAvailable() ? "可用" : "离线模式(使用本地知识库)"));
 
 this.summarizationEngine = new SummarizationEngine();
 
 this.antiHallucination = new AntiHallucinationSystem(config.dim);
 this.antiHallucination.setRole("expert");
 
 this.modelInitialized = true;
 System.out.println("[青小团] 初始化完成，准备就绪。");
 }
 
 /**
 * 训练分词器样本 - 使其支持中文
 */
 private void trainTokenizerSample() {
 String sampleText = "机器学习深度学习人工智能编程安全代码审计漏洞检测" +
 "数据分析处理技术架构设计自然语言处理计算机视觉" +
 "Transformer神经网络卷积循环注意力机制优化训练" +
 "加密解密签名认证SQL注入防护安全开发最佳实践";
 tokenizer.train(sampleText, 50);
 System.out.printf("[青小团] 分词器词汇表大小: %d%n", tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 }
 
 /**
 * 处理用户问题 - 主入口
 */
 public AssistantResponse ask(String question) {
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 AssistantResponse response = new AssistantResponse();
 response.question = question;
 response.timestamp = new Date();
 
 // 黑箱化：不显示问题重复提示
 
 // === 第一层：输入结构闸门 ===
 InputStructureGate.InputResult layer1Result = antiHallucination.getInputStructureGate().validate(question);
 response.layer1Passed = layer1Result.passed;
 
 if (!layer1Result.passed) {
 response.finalAnswer = "您的问题不够明确，请提供更具体的信息。\n" +
 "拒绝原因: " + layer1Result.rejectionReason;
 response.processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 response.route = ProcessingRoute.REJECTED;
 return response;
 }
 
 // 问候语 → 返回自我介绍
 if ("greeting".equals(layer1Result.intent)) {
 response.finalAnswer = generateSelfIntroduction(question);
 response.processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 response.route = ProcessingRoute.GREETING;
 response.sceneType = "GREETING";
 response.validationPassed = true;
 return response;
 }
 
 // === 第四层：边界约束闸门 ===
 BoundaryConstraintGate.BoundaryResult layer4Result = 
 antiHallucination.getBoundaryConstraintGate().checkBoundary(question, layer1Result);
 response.layer4Passed = layer4Result.passed;
 response.sceneType = layer4Result.sceneType.toString();
 
 if (!layer4Result.passed) {
 response.finalAnswer = layer4Result.errorMessage;
 response.processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 response.route = ProcessingRoute.BLOCKED;
 return response;
 }
 
 // === 核心决策：使用模型推理还是联网搜索 ===
 boolean useSearch = shouldUseSearch(question, layer4Result);
 
 if (useSearch) {
