 private static List<int[]> createSlidingWindowSequences(int[] tokens, int seqLength, int stride) {
 List<int[]> sequences = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length - seqLength; i += stride) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLength];
 System.arraycopy(tokens, i, seq, 0, seqLength);
 sequences.add(seq);
 }
 return sequences;
 }
 
 private static float computeCrossEntropy(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 float loss = 0f;
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max) / sum;
 if (labels[i] > 0) {
 loss -= labels[i] * (float) Math.log(prob + 1e-8f);
 }
 }
 
 return loss;
 }
 
 private static float[] computeCrossEntropyGradient(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 float[] grad = new float[vocabSize];
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max) / sum;
 grad[i] = prob - labels[i];
 }
 
 return grad;
 }
 
 private static int argmax(float[] x) {
 int idx = 0;
 float max = x[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] > max) {
 max = x[i];
 idx = i;
 }
 }
 return idx;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SequenceModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 序列模型训练测试 - 直接使用SequenceModel验证序列处理能力
 */
public class SequenceTrainingTest {
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("===== 序列模型训练测试 =====");
 
 // 配置参数
 int vocabSize = 10;
 int dModel = 64;
 int nLayers = 2;
 int nHeads = 4;
 int seqLength = 8;
 float learningRate = 1e-3f; // 降低学习率避免梯度爆炸
 int totalSteps = 2000;
 
 System.out.printf("参数配置: vocab=%d, dModel=%d, layers=%d, lr=%.2e\n", 
 vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, learningRate);
 
 // 创建序列模型
 SequenceModel model = new SequenceModel(vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, nHeads);
 System.out.println("序列模型创建完成");
 
 // 生成简单序列数据
 List<int[]> sequences = generateSimpleSequences(vocabSize, seqLength, 1000);
 System.out.printf("生成训练样本: %d\n", sequences.size());
 
 // 训练
 System.out.println("\n开始训练...");
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 int stepCount = 0;
 float totalLoss = 0;
 float prevLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 
 while (stepCount < totalSteps) {
 // 随机选择一个序列
 int[] seq = sequences.get(stepCount % sequences.size());
 
 for (int i = 0; i < seq.length - 1; i++) {
 // 输入：前i+1个token
 int[] input = new int[i + 1];
 System.arraycopy(seq, 0, input, 0, i + 1);
 // 标签：下一个token（one-hot编码）
 float[] labels = new float[vocabSize];
 int target = seq[i + 1];
 labels[target] = 1.0f;
 
 // 前向传播
 float[] logits = model.forward(input);
 
 // 计算交叉熵损失和梯度
 float loss = computeCrossEntropy(logits, labels);
 float[] dLogits = computeCrossEntropyGradient(logits, labels);
 
 // 反向传播
 GradientResult gradResult = model.backward(dLogits);
 
 // 使用学习率更新参数
 model.updateParametersWithGradient(gradResult.getParameterGradients(), learningRate);
 
 totalLoss += loss;
 stepCount++;
 
 if (stepCount % 50 == 0) {
 long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 float avgLoss = totalLoss / 50;
 System.out.printf("[Step %d/%d] Loss: %.4f | LR: %.2e | Time: %ds\n", 
 stepCount, totalSteps, avgLoss, learningRate, elapsed / 1000);
 
 if (avgLoss < prevLoss * 0.99) {
 System.out.printf(" ↓ 损失下降: %.2f%%\n", (1 - avgLoss / prevLoss) * 100);
 }
 prevLoss = avgLoss;
 totalLoss = 0;
 }
 
 if (stepCount >= totalSteps) break;
 }
 }
 
 // 测试生成
 System.out.println("\n测试生成...");
 int[] prompt = {0, 1, 2};
 for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
 float[] logits = model.forward(prompt);
 int nextToken = argmax(logits);
 System.out.printf("输入: %s -> 预测: %d (期望: %d)\n", 
 Arrays.toString(prompt), nextToken, (prompt.length) % vocabSize);
 
 int[] newPrompt = new int[prompt.length + 1];
 System.arraycopy(prompt, 0, newPrompt, 0, prompt.length);
 newPrompt[prompt.length] = nextToken;
 prompt = newPrompt;
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n测试完成！");
 }
 
 private static List<int[]> generateSimpleSequences(int vocabSize, int seqLength, int count) {
 List<int[]> sequences = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLength];
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLength; j++) {
 seq[j] = j % vocabSize;
 }
 sequences.add(seq);
 }
 return sequences;
 }
 
 private static float computeCrossEntropy(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 float loss = 0f;
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max) / sum;
 if (labels[i] > 0) {
 loss -= labels[i] * (float) Math.log(prob + 1e-8f);
 }
 }
 
 return loss;
 }
 
 private static float[] computeCrossEntropyGradient(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 float[] grad = new float[vocabSize];
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max) / sum;
 grad[i] = prob - labels[i];
 }
 
 return grad;
 }
 
 private static int argmax(float[] x) {
 int idx = 0;
 float max = x[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] > max) {
 max = x[i];
 idx = i;
 }
 }
 return idx;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SequenceModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 简单专家模型集合 - 使用SequenceModel
 */
public class SimpleExpertCollection {
 
 private final int nExperts;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int vocabSize;
 private final SequenceModel[] experts;
 
 public SimpleExpertCollection(int nExperts, int dModel, int vocabSize) {
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.vocabSize = vocabSize;
 
 this.experts = new SequenceModel[nExperts];
 initializeExperts();
 }
 
 private void initializeExperts() {
 System.out.println("[SimpleExpertCollection] 初始化 " + nExperts + " 个专家模型...");
 
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 experts[e] = new SequenceModel(vocabSize, dModel, 2, 4);
 System.out.println("[SimpleExpertCollection] 专家 " + e + " 初始化完成");
 }
 
 System.out.println("[SimpleExpertCollection] 初始化完成");
 }
 
 /**
 * 专家推理
 */
 public float[][] infer(int[] tokens) {
 float[][] results = new float[nExperts][];
 for (int e = 0; e < nExperts; e++) {
 results[e] = experts[e].forward(tokens);
 }
 return results;
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取专家模型
 */
 public SequenceModel getExpert(int index) {
 if (index < 0 || index >= nExperts) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("专家索引越界: " + index);
 }
 return experts[index];
 }
 
 /**
 * 更新专家参数
 */
 public void updateExpert(int expertIdx, GradientResult grad, float learningRate) {
 experts[expertIdx].updateParametersWithGradient(grad.getParameterGradients(), learningRate);
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取总参数量
 */
 public long getTotalParameters() {
 long total = 0;
 for (SequenceModel expert : experts) {
 float[][] weights = expert.getAllWeightArrays();
 for (float[] w : weights) {
 total += w.length;
 }
 }
 return total;
 }
 
 public int getNExperts() { return nExperts; }
 public int getDModel() { return dModel; }
 public int getVocabSize() { return vocabSize; }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * 简单序列预测测试 - 验证训练管线是否正常工作
 * 使用重复序列数据：0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3,...
 */
public class SimpleSequenceTest {
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("===== 简单序列预测测试 =====");
 
 // 配置参数
 int vocabSize = 10;
 int dModel = 64;
 int seqLength = 8;
 int batchSize = 4;
 float learningRate = 1e-2f;
 int warmupSteps = 10;
 int totalSteps = 1000;
 
 System.out.printf("参数配置: vocab=%d, dModel=%d, seq=%d, lr=%.2e\n", 
 vocabSize, dModel, seqLength, learningRate);
 
 // 创建堆叠训练器
 StackedTrainer trainer = new StackedTrainer(1, dModel, vocabSize, 
 batchSize, learningRate, warmupSteps, totalSteps);
 
 // 生成简单序列数据
 List<int[]> sequences = generateSimpleSequences(vocabSize, seqLength, 1000);
 System.out.printf("生成训练样本: %d\n", sequences.size());
 
 // 训练
 System.out.println("\n开始训练...");
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 int stepCount = 0;
 float totalLoss = 0;
 float prevLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 
 while (stepCount < totalSteps) {
 // 随机选择一个序列
 int[] seq = sequences.get(stepCount % sequences.size());
 
 for (int i = 0; i < seq.length - 1; i++) {
 // 输入：前i+1个token
 int[] input = new int[i + 1];
 System.arraycopy(seq, 0, input, 0, i + 1);
 // 标签：下一个token
 float[] labels = new float[vocabSize];
 int target = seq[i + 1];
 labels[target] = 1.0f;
 
 StackedTrainer.TrainingStepResult result = trainer.trainStep(input, labels);
 totalLoss += result.loss;
 stepCount++;
 
 if (stepCount % 50 == 0) {
 long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 float avgLoss = totalLoss / 50;
 System.out.printf("[Step %d/%d] Loss: %.4f | LR: %.2e | Time: %ds\n", 
 stepCount, totalSteps, avgLoss, result.learningRate, elapsed / 1000);
 
 if (avgLoss < prevLoss * 0.99) {
 System.out.printf(" ↓ 损失下降: %.2f%%\n", (1 - avgLoss / prevLoss) * 100);
 }
 prevLoss = avgLoss;
 totalLoss = 0;
 }
 
 if (stepCount >= totalSteps) break;
 }
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n测试完成！");
 }
 
 private static List<int[]> generateSimpleSequences(int vocabSize, int seqLength, int count) {
 List<int[]> sequences = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLength];
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLength; j++) {
 seq[j] = j % vocabSize;
 }
 sequences.add(seq);
 }
 return sequences;
 }
 
 private static int argmax(float[] x) {
 int idx = 0;
 float max = x[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] > max) {
 max = x[i];
 idx = i;
 }
 }
 return idx;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.data.SCDataLoader;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.tokenizer.ChineseBPETokenizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.OpenCLAccelerator;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTTransformerBlock;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * 简单训练测试 - 验证训练管线是否正常工作
 * 使用1个专家模型，预测每个位置的token（全序列预测）
 */
public class SimpleTrainingTest {
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SimplCore 简单训练测试 - 验证训练管线");
 System.out.println("═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 // 配置参数
 int nExperts = 1;
 int dModel = 128;
 int vocabSize = 2000;
 int batchSize = 2;
 float learningRate = 1e-2f;
 int warmupSteps = 20;
 int totalSteps = 500;
 
 // 初始化GPU加速器
 System.out.println("[阶段1] 初始化OpenCL GPU加速器...");
 OpenCLAccelerator gpu = new OpenCLAccelerator();
 gpu.initialize();
 RDTTransformerBlock.setGPU(gpu);
 
 // 创建训练器
 System.out.println("\n[阶段2] 创建训练器...");
 StackedTrainer trainer = new StackedTrainer(nExperts, dModel, vocabSize, 
 batchSize, learningRate,
 warmupSteps, totalSteps);
 
 // 创建简单训练数据（重复模式）
 System.out.println("\n[阶段3] 创建简单训练数据...");
 List<int[]> sequences = createSimplePatternData(100, 32, vocabSize);
 System.out.printf(" 训练样本数: %d\n", sequences.size());
 
 SCDataLoader dataLoader = new SCDataLoader(sequences, batchSize, 32);
 
 // 开始训练（使用全序列预测）
 System.out.println("\n[阶段4] 开始训练...");
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 int stepCount = 0;
 float prevLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 
 while (stepCount < totalSteps && dataLoader.hasNext()) {
 int[][] batch = dataLoader.getNextBatch();
 if (batch == null) {
 dataLoader.reset();
 continue;
 }
 
 // 全序列预测：对每个位置训练
 float batchLoss = 0;
 for (int[] tokens : batch) {
 for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length - 1; i++) {
 // 输入：前i+1个token
 int[] inputTokens = Arrays.copyOf(tokens, i + 1);
 // 标签：第i+1个token
 float[] labels = new float[vocabSize];
 int targetToken = tokens[i + 1];
 if (targetToken >= 0 && targetToken < vocabSize) {
 labels[targetToken] = 1.0f;
 }
 
 StackedTrainer.TrainingStepResult result = trainer.trainStep(inputTokens, labels);
 batchLoss += result.loss;
 stepCount++;
 
 if (stepCount % 10 == 0) {
 long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 float avgLoss = batchLoss / 10;
 System.out.printf("[Step %d] Loss: %.4f | LR: %.2e | Time: %ds\n", 
 stepCount, avgLoss, result.learningRate, elapsed / 1000);
 
 // 检查损失是否下降
 if (avgLoss < prevLoss * 0.99) {
 System.out.printf(" ↓ 损失下降: %.2f%%\n", (1 - avgLoss / prevLoss) * 100);
 }
 prevLoss = avgLoss;
 batchLoss = 0;
 }
 
 if (stepCount >= totalSteps) break;
 }
 if (stepCount >= totalSteps) break;
 }
 }
 
 long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 System.out.printf("\n[阶段5] 训练完成！耗时: %.1fs\n", elapsed / 1000.0);
 
 // 测试生成（简化版）
 System.out.println("\n[阶段6] 测试文本生成...");
 System.out.println(" (generate方法需要String输入，跳过此测试)");
 
 gpu.release();
 }
 
 /**
 * 创建简单模式数据（重复序列）
 */
 private static List<int[]> createSimplePatternData(int numSequences, int seqLength, int vocabSize) {
 List<int[]> sequences = new ArrayList<>();
 Random rng = new Random(42);
 
 for (int s = 0; s < numSequences; s++) {
 int[] seq = new int[seqLength];
 // 创建重复模式
 int base = s % 10;
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLength; i++) {
 seq[i] = (base + i) % Math.min(vocabSize, 100);
 }
 sequences.add(seq);
 }
 
 return sequences;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTConfig;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.AdamOptimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.LearningRateScheduler;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.tokenizer.BPETokenizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.tokenizer.ChineseBPETokenizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.data.SCDataLoader;
import java.util.*;

public class StackedTrainer {
 
 private final ExpertModelCollection experts;
 private final EnsembleLayer ensemble;
 private final ModelRouter router;
 private final AdamOptimizer optimizer;
 private BPETokenizer tokenizer;
 
 private final int nExperts;
 private final int dModel;
 private final int batchSize;
 private final float learningRate;
 private final int warmupSteps;
 private final int totalSteps;
 
 private long totalStepsCompleted;
 private long totalTokens;
 private double totalLoss;
 private long startTime;
 
 private static final Random RNG = new Random(42);
 
 public StackedTrainer(int nExperts, int dModel, int vocabSize, 
 int batchSize, float learningRate) {
 this(nExperts, dModel, vocabSize, batchSize, learningRate, 1000, 100000);
 }
 
 public StackedTrainer(int nExperts, int dModel, int vocabSize, 
 int batchSize, float learningRate,
 int warmupSteps, int totalSteps) {
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.dModel = dModel;
 this.batchSize = batchSize;
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 this.warmupSteps = warmupSteps;
 this.totalSteps = totalSteps;
 
 // 创建专家集合（每个专家~100M参数）
 this.experts = new ExpertModelCollection(nExperts, dModel, vocabSize);
 
 // 创建集成层
 this.ensemble = new EnsembleLayer(dModel, vocabSize, nExperts);
 
 // 获取路由层
 this.router = experts.getRouter();
 
 // 创建优化器（预热后恒定学习率，加速收敛）
 LearningRateScheduler constantScheduler = new LearningRateScheduler.ConstantScheduler(learningRate);
 LearningRateScheduler scheduler = new LearningRateScheduler.LinearWarmupScheduler(
 learningRate, warmupSteps, constantScheduler);
 
 this.optimizer = new AdamOptimizer(learningRate, 0.01f);
 this.optimizer.setScheduler(scheduler);
 
 // 预注册集成层所有权重参数（避免运行时查找）
 float[][] ensembleWeights = ensemble.getWeightArrays();
 this.optimizer.registerWeights(ensembleWeights);
 
 // 创建Tokenizer（默认使用BPE）
 this.tokenizer = new BPETokenizer();
 
 // 初始化训练统计
 this.totalStepsCompleted = 0;
 this.totalTokens = 0;
 this.totalLoss = 0;
 this.startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 初始化完成");
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 专家数量: " + nExperts);
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 每个专家: ~100M 参数");
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 总参数量: ~" + (nExperts * 100) + "M (" + (nExperts * 0.1) + "B)");
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 集成层参数量: " + ensemble.getParameterCount());
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 学习率: " + learningRate + " (预热: " + warmupSteps + "步)");
 }
 
 /**
 * 训练步骤（完整的前向+反向+优化）
 */
 public TrainingStepResult trainStep(int[] tokens, float[] labels) {
 TrainingStepResult result = new TrainingStepResult();
 
 // 1. 获取当前学习率
 float lr = optimizer.getCurrentLearningRate();
 
 // 2. 计算输入嵌入
 float[] inputEmbedding = computeInputEmbedding(tokens);
 
 // 3. 路由选择专家
 ModelRouter.RoutingResult routing = router.route(inputEmbedding);
 
 // 4. 专家推理
 ExpertModelCollection.ExpertOutputCollection outputs = experts.infer(inputEmbedding, tokens);
 
 // 5. 集成输出
 float[] logits = ensemble.ensemble(outputs, inputEmbedding);
 
 // 6. 计算损失和梯度
 float loss = computeCrossEntropy(logits, labels);
 float[] dLogits = computeCrossEntropyGradient(logits, labels);
 
 // 7. 反向传播 - 集成层
 GradientResult ensembleGrad = ensemble.backward(dLogits, outputs, inputEmbedding);
 
 // 8. 更新集成层参数（使用真正的梯度，预注册索引）
 Map<String, float[]> paramGrads = ensembleGrad.getParameterGradients();
 float[][] weights = ensemble.getWeightArrays();
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 float[] grad = paramGrads.getOrDefault("weight_" + i, new float[weights[i].length]);
 optimizer.update(i, weights[i], grad);
 }
 
 // 9. 更新路由层参数（使用集成层梯度信号）
 updateRouterParameters(lr, ensembleGrad.getdInput(), inputEmbedding);
 
 // 10. 更新专家模型参数（使用真实梯度，关键改进！传入tokens用于embedding梯度）
 updateExpertParametersWithGradients(outputs, dLogits, lr, tokens);
 
 // 更新统计
 totalStepsCompleted++;
 totalTokens += tokens.length;
 totalLoss += loss;
 
 // 更新学习率调度器
 optimizer.stepScheduler();
 
 // 记录结果
 result.loss = loss;
 result.expertCount = outputs.size();
 result.learningRate = lr;
 result.selectedExperts = new int[routing.getSelectedCount()];
 System.arraycopy(routing.selectedIndices, 0, result.selectedExperts, 0, 
 routing.getSelectedCount());
 
 return result;
 }
 
 /**
 * 批量训练
 */
 public TrainingStats trainBatch(int[][] batch) {
 TrainingStats stats = new TrainingStats();
 double batchLoss = 0;
 int totalExperts = 0;
 
 for (int[] tokens : batch) {
 // 创建标签（下一个token预测）
 float[] labels = new float[ensemble.getVocabSize()];
 if (tokens.length > 0) {
 int targetToken = tokens[tokens.length - 1];
 if (targetToken >= 0 && targetToken < ensemble.getVocabSize()) {
 labels[targetToken] = 1.0f;
 }
 }
 
 TrainingStepResult stepResult = trainStep(tokens, labels);
 batchLoss += stepResult.loss;
 totalExperts += stepResult.expertCount;
 }
 
 stats.totalSteps = totalStepsCompleted;
 stats.totalTokens = totalTokens;
 stats.averageLoss = totalLoss / Math.max(1, totalStepsCompleted);
 stats.elapsedSeconds = (System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime) / 1000.0;
 stats.expertsCount = experts.getNExperts();
 stats.totalParameters = experts.getTotalParameters() + ensemble.getParameterCount();
 
 return stats;
 }
 
 /**
 * 完整训练循环
 */
 public TrainingStats train(SCDataLoader dataLoader, int steps) {
 System.out.println("\n[StackedTrainer] 开始训练...");
 
 int stepsToRun = (int) Math.min(steps, (long) totalSteps - totalStepsCompleted);
 
 for (int step = 0; step < stepsToRun; step++) {
 int[][] batch = dataLoader.getNextBatch();
 if (batch == null) {
 dataLoader.reset();
 batch = dataLoader.getNextBatch();
 if (batch == null) break;
 }
 
 TrainingStats stats = trainBatch(batch);
 
 // 打印进度
 if (step % 10 == 0) {
 printProgress();
 }
 
 // 检查是否达到目标损失（设置更低的阈值，允许更多训练步骤）
 if (stats.averageLoss < 0.0001) {
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 目标损失达成，提前终止训练");
 break;
 }
 }
 
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] 训练完成");
 return getStats();
 }
 
 /**
 * 生成文本
 */
 public String generate(String prompt, int maxLength) {
 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(prompt);
 float[] inputEmbedding = computeInputEmbedding(tokens);
 
 for (int step = 0; step < maxLength; step++) {
 ModelRouter.RoutingResult routing = router.route(inputEmbedding);
 ExpertModelCollection.ExpertOutputCollection outputs = experts.infer(inputEmbedding, tokens);
 float[] logits = ensemble.ensemble(outputs, inputEmbedding);
 
 int nextToken = argmax(logits);
 if (nextToken == tokenizer.encode("<|endoftext|>")[0]) {
 break;
 }
 
 int[] newTokens = new int[tokens.length + 1];
 System.arraycopy(tokens, 0, newTokens, 0, tokens.length);
 newTokens[tokens.length] = nextToken;
 tokens = newTokens;
 
 inputEmbedding = computeInputEmbedding(tokens);
 }
 
 return tokenizer.decode(tokens);
 }
 
 /**
 * 训练Tokenizer
 */
 public void trainTokenizer(String text, int iterations) {
 tokenizer.train(text, iterations);
 System.out.println("[StackedTrainer] Tokenizer训练完成，词汇量: " + tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 }
 
 private float getCurrentLearningRate() {
 return optimizer.getCurrentLearningRate();
 }
 
 private float[] computeInputEmbedding(int[] tokens) {
 // 使用专家模型的真正嵌入层（不再使用哈希映射！）
 // 从第一个专家获取嵌入（所有专家共享相同的嵌入矩阵）
 float[] embedding = experts.getExpert(0).embed(tokens);
 
 // 归一化
 float norm = 0f;
 for (float val : embedding) norm += val * val;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm + 1e-8f);
 for (int i = 0; i < embedding.length; i++) {
 embedding[i] /= norm;
 }
 
 return embedding;
 }
 
 private float computeCrossEntropy(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 float loss = 0f;
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 float[] exp = new float[vocabSize];
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = exp[i] / sum;
 if (labels[i] > 0) {
 loss -= labels[i] * (float) Math.log(prob + 1e-8f);
 }
 }
 
 return loss;
 }
 
 private float[] computeCrossEntropyGradient(float[] logits, float[] labels) {
 float[] grad = new float[logits.length];
 int vocabSize = logits.length;
 
 float max = logits[0];
 for (float val : logits) {
 if (val > max) max = val;
 }
 float[] exp = new float[vocabSize];
 float sum = 0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 exp[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[i] - max);
 sum += exp[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 float prob = exp[i] / sum;
 grad[i] = prob - labels[i];
 }
 
 return grad;
 }
 
 private void updateRouterParameters(float lr, float[] dInput, float[] inputEmbedding) {
 // 使用集成层梯度信号更新路由参数（真正的梯度下降）
 float[][] embeddings = router.getExpertEmbeddings();
 float[][] rWeights = router.getRoutingWeights();
 float[] rBias = router.getRoutingBias();
 
 // 更新路由权重
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < nExperts; j++) {
 rWeights[i][j] -= lr * dInput[i] * inputEmbedding[i];
 }
 }
 
 // 更新路由偏置
 for (int j = 0; j < nExperts; j++) {
 rBias[j] -= lr * dInput[j % dModel];
 }
 
 // 更新专家嵌入（基于输入和梯度的相关性）
 for (int j = 0; j < nExperts; j++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 embeddings[j][i] -= lr * dInput[i] * 0.01f;
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void updateExpertParametersWithGradients(ExpertModelCollection.ExpertOutputCollection outputs, 
 float[] dLogits, float lr, int[] tokens) {
 // 使用真实梯度更新专家模型参数（关键改进！）
 for (int i = 0; i < outputs.size(); i++) {
 int expertIdx = outputs.getExpertIndex(i);
 float weight = outputs.getWeight(i);
 
 if (weight > 0.01f) {
 // 将dLogits乘以专家权重，得到该专家的输出梯度
 float[] dExpertLogits = new float[dLogits.length];
 for (int j = 0; j < dLogits.length; j++) {
 dExpertLogits[j] = dLogits[j] * weight;
 }
 
 // 调用专家模型的反向传播获取真实梯度（传入tokens用于计算embedding梯度）
 GradientResult grad = experts.getExpert(expertIdx).backward(dExpertLogits, 2, tokens);
 
 // 使用真实梯度更新参数
 experts.getExpert(expertIdx).updateParametersWithGradient(grad, lr * weight);
 }
 }
 }
 
 private int argmax(float[] x) {
 int idx = 0;
 float max = x[0];
 for (int i = 1; i < x.length; i++) {
 if (x[i] > max) {
 max = x[i];
 idx = i;
 }
 }
 return idx;
 }
 
 public TrainingStats getStats() {
 TrainingStats stats = new TrainingStats();
 stats.totalSteps = totalStepsCompleted;
 stats.totalTokens = totalTokens;
 stats.averageLoss = totalLoss / Math.max(1, totalStepsCompleted);
 stats.elapsedSeconds = (System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime) / 1000.0;
 stats.expertsCount = experts.getNExperts();
 stats.totalParameters = experts.getTotalParameters() + ensemble.getParameterCount();
 
 return stats;
 }
 
 public void printProgress() {
 TrainingStats stats = getStats();
 
 System.out.printf("[StackedTrainer] Step: %,d/%d | ", stats.totalSteps, totalSteps);
 System.out.printf("Loss: %.4f | ", stats.averageLoss);
 System.out.printf("LR: %.2e | ", getCurrentLearningRate());
 System.out.printf("Tokens: %,d | ", stats.totalTokens);
 System.out.printf("Experts: %d | ", stats.expertsCount);
 System.out.printf("Params: %.2fB | ", stats.totalParameters / 1_000_000_000.0);
 System.out.printf("Time: %.1fs\n", stats.elapsedSeconds);
 }
 
 public ExpertModelCollection getExperts() { return experts; }
 public EnsembleLayer getEnsemble() { return ensemble; }
 public ModelRouter getRouter() { return router; }
 public BPETokenizer getTokenizer() { return tokenizer; }
 public void setTokenizer(BPETokenizer tokenizer) { this.tokenizer = tokenizer; }
 
 public static class TrainingStepResult {
 public float loss;
 public int expertCount;
 public float learningRate;
 public int[] selectedExperts;
 
 public TrainingStepResult() {
 this.loss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.expertCount = 0;
 this.learningRate = 0f;
 this.selectedExperts = new int[0];
 }
 }
 
 public static class TrainingStats {
 public long totalSteps;
 public long totalTokens;
 public double averageLoss;
 public double elapsedSeconds;
 public int expertsCount;
 public long totalParameters;
 }
}

 // 教育/学习
 {"教育", "学习", "知识", "技能", "学校", "大学", "学院", "课程", "考试", 
 "研究", "学术", "论文", "学位", "导师", "学生", "教师", "培训", "辅导", 
 "阅读", "写作", "思考", "实践", "创新", "创造", "探索", "发现", "理解"},
 
 // 健康/体育
 {"健康", "身体", "心理", "运动", "体育", "锻炼", "跑步", "游泳", "骑行",

 {"艺术", "文学", "音乐", "绘画", "雕塑", "建筑", "戏剧", "电影", "舞蹈",

 // 生成大量训练句子
 Random rng = new Random(42);
 for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
 int domainIdx = rng.nextInt(domains.length);
 String[] terms = domains[domainIdx];
 
 // 生成不同类型的句子

 switch (sentenceType) {
 case 0: // 定义句
 String term1 = terms[rng.nextInt(terms.length)];

 trainingData.append(term1).append("是").append(term2).append("的一个分支。");
 break;
 case 1: // 描述句
 String term3 = terms[rng.nextInt(terms.length)];
 String[] adjectives = {"重要的", "核心的", "基础的", "关键的", "现代的", "先进的", "创新的"};

 String[] applications = {"广泛应用于", "被用于", "可以用来", "能够实现", "有助于"};
 trainingData.append(term4).append(applications[rng.nextInt(applications.length)]).append("各个领域。");

 case 3: // 发展句

 case 4: // 关系句

 String term7 = terms[rng.nextInt(terms.length)];
 trainingData.append(term6).append("和").append(term7).append("密切相关，相辅相成。");

 case 5: // 知识句
 String term8 = terms[rng.nextInt(terms.length)];

 }
 
 trainingData.append(" ");
 }
 
 // 添加一些完整的段落
 String[] paragraphs = {

 "物理学是研究物质运动规律的科学，探索宇宙的基本法则。" +

 "基础教育是国民教育的基础，高等教育培养专业人才。" +

 for (String p : paragraphs) {

 // 训练Tokenizer（增加合并次数）

 List<int[]> sequences = SCDataLoader.createSlidingWindowSequences(allTokens, 128, 64);
 System.out.printf(" 训练样本数: %,d\n", sequences.size());

 String[] prompts = {

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.stacking;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.evaluation.BenchmarkEngine;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.evaluation.ModelEvaluator;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.inference.InferenceEngine;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.inference.AntiHallucinationEngine;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/**
 * 训练监控器
 * 功能：
 * 1. 实时监控训练进度
 * 2. 计算剩余时间
 * 3. 训练完成后自动启动跑分对比
 */
public class TrainingMonitor {
 
 private final StackedTrainer trainer;
 private final StackedTrainer smallModelTrainer; // 20个小模型对比
 private final ExecutorService monitorExecutor;
 private volatile boolean trainingComplete;
 private volatile boolean benchmarkDone;
 
 private long startTime;
 private long lastProgressTime;
 private int lastStep;
 private double lastLoss;
 
 public TrainingMonitor(StackedTrainer trainer) {
 this.trainer = trainer;
 this.smallModelTrainer = null;
 this.monitorExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
 this.trainingComplete = false;
 this.benchmarkDone = false;
 }
 
 public TrainingMonitor(StackedTrainer trainer, StackedTrainer smallModelTrainer) {
 this.trainer = trainer;
 this.smallModelTrainer = smallModelTrainer;
 this.monitorExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
 this.trainingComplete = false;
 this.benchmarkDone = false;
 }
 
 /**
 * 开始监控
 */
 public void startMonitoring() {
 startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 lastProgressTime = startTime;
 lastStep = 0;
 lastLoss = Double.MAX_VALUE;
 
 monitorExecutor.submit(() -> {
 while (!trainingComplete) {
 try {
 Thread.sleep(5000); // 每5秒检查一次
 printProgress();
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 break;
 }
 }
 
 // 训练完成，自动启动跑分
 System.out.println("\n=========================================");
 System.out.println("训练完成！开始跑分对比...");
 System.out.println("=========================================\n");
 
 runBenchmarkComparison();
 benchmarkDone = true;
 });
 }
 
 /**
 * 打印进度和预计剩余时间
 */
 private void printProgress() {
 StackedTrainer.TrainingStats stats = trainer.getStats();
 
 if (stats.totalSteps == lastStep && stats.averageLoss == lastLoss) {
 return; // 没有变化，跳过打印
 }
 
 long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 long elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
 long timeSinceLast = currentTime - lastProgressTime;
 
 // 计算速度（步/秒）
 double stepsPerSecond = (stats.totalSteps - lastStep) / (timeSinceLast / 1000.0);
 if (stepsPerSecond <= 0) stepsPerSecond = 0.1; // 避免除零
 
 // 计算剩余步数和时间
 int totalSteps = 3000; // 预计训练步数
 int remainingSteps = totalSteps - (int) stats.totalSteps;
 double remainingSeconds = remainingSteps / stepsPerSecond;
 
 // 格式化时间
 String remainingTime = formatTime((long) remainingSeconds);
 String elapsedTime = formatTime(elapsed / 1000);
 
 // 计算完成百分比
 double progress = (stats.totalSteps * 100.0) / totalSteps;
 
 // 打印进度条
 System.out.printf("\r[监控] 进度: %.1f%% | 步数: %,d/%d | 损失: %.6f | 速度: %.2f步/秒 | 已用: %s | 剩余: %s",
 progress, stats.totalSteps, totalSteps, stats.averageLoss, 
 stepsPerSecond, elapsedTime, remainingTime);
 System.out.flush();
 
 lastStep = (int) stats.totalSteps;
 lastLoss = stats.averageLoss;
 lastProgressTime = currentTime;
 
 // 如果损失变化明显，额外打印一行
 if (Math.abs(stats.averageLoss - lastLoss) > 0.001) {
 System.out.println();
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 格式化时间
 */
 private String formatTime(long seconds) {
 if (seconds < 60) {
 return seconds + "秒";
 } else if (seconds < 3600) {
 long minutes = seconds / 60;
 long secs = seconds % 60;
 return minutes + "分" + secs + "秒";
 } else {
 long hours = seconds / 3600;
 long minutes = (seconds % 3600) / 60;
 long secs = seconds % 60;
 return hours + "时" + minutes + "分" + secs + "秒";
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 标记训练完成
 */
 public void markTrainingComplete() {
 this.trainingComplete = true;
 }
 
 /**
 * 等待监控和跑分完成
 */
 public void waitForCompletion() throws InterruptedException {
 while (!benchmarkDone) {
 Thread.sleep(1000);
 }
 monitorExecutor.shutdown();
 }
 
 /**
 * 运行跑分对比（青小团-7B vs 20个小模型）
 */
 public void runBenchmarkComparison() {
 System.out.println("\n=== 青小团-7B 参数堆叠模型 ===");
 System.out.println("专家数量: " + trainer.getExperts().getNExperts());
 System.out.println("总参数: ~" + (trainer.getExperts().getNExperts() * 0.1) + "B");
 System.out.println();
 
 // 创建评估器
 ModelEvaluator evaluator = new ModelEvaluator();
 
 // 评估青小团-7B
 System.out.println("[1/2] 正在评估青小团-7B...");
 ModelEvaluator.BenchmarkResult qxtResult = evaluator.runFullBenchmark(trainer);
 System.out.println(evaluator.generateReport(qxtResult));
 
 // 如果有小模型训练器，也进行评估
 if (smallModelTrainer != null) {
 System.out.println("\n=== 20个小模型（对比组） ===");
 System.out.println("专家数量: " + smallModelTrainer.getExperts().getNExperts());
 System.out.println("总参数: ~" + (smallModelTrainer.getExperts().getNExperts() * 0.1) + "B");
 System.out.println();
 
 System.out.println("[2/2] 正在评估20个小模型...");
 ModelEvaluator.BenchmarkResult smallResult = evaluator.runFullBenchmark(smallModelTrainer);
 System.out.println(evaluator.generateReport(smallResult));
 
 // 生成对比报告
 generateComparisonReport(qxtResult, smallResult);
 }
 
 evaluator.shutdown();
 }
 
 /**
 * 生成对比报告
 */
 private void generateComparisonReport(ModelEvaluator.BenchmarkResult qxtResult, 
 ModelEvaluator.BenchmarkResult smallResult) {
 System.out.println("\n=========================================");
 System.out.println(" 青小团-7B vs 20个小模型");
 System.out.println("=========================================\n");
 
 System.out.println("| 数据集 | 青小团-7B | 20个小模型 | 差值 |");
 System.out.println("|--------|-----------|-------------|------|");
 
 float qxtTotal = 0, smallTotal = 0;
 int count = 0;
 
 for (ModelEvaluator.EvaluationResult qxtEval : qxtResult.results) {
 for (ModelEvaluator.EvaluationResult smallEval : smallResult.results) {
 if (qxtEval.dataset.equals(smallEval.dataset)) {
 float diff = qxtEval.accuracy - smallEval.accuracy;
 System.out.printf("| %-8s | %7.2f%% | %9.2f%% | %+6.2f%% |\n",
 qxtEval.dataset, qxtEval.accuracy * 100, 
 smallEval.accuracy * 100, diff * 100);
 qxtTotal += qxtEval.accuracy;
 smallTotal += smallEval.accuracy;
 count++;
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 
 float qxtAvg = count > 0 ? qxtTotal / count : 0;
 float smallAvg = count > 0 ? smallTotal / count : 0;
 float avgDiff = qxtAvg - smallAvg;
 
 System.out.println("|--------|-----------|-------------|------|");
 System.out.printf("| 平均分 | %7.2f%% | %9.2f%% | %+6.2f%% |\n",
 qxtAvg * 100, smallAvg * 100, avgDiff * 100);
 
 System.out.println("\n结论：");
 if (avgDiff > 0.05) {
 System.out.println(" ✓ 青小团-7B在综合性能上显著优于20个小模型！");
 } else if (avgDiff > 0) {
 System.out.println(" ~ 青小团-7B略优于20个小模型");
 } else {
 System.out.println(" ✗ 青小团-7B与20个小模型相当或略差");
 }
 
 // 参数效率对比
 double qxtParams = trainer.getExperts().getNExperts() * 0.1; // B
 double smallParams = smallModelTrainer.getExperts().getNExperts() * 0.1; // B
 double paramsRatio = qxtParams / smallParams;
 
 System.out.println("\n参数效率分析：");
 System.out.printf(" 青小团-7B参数: %.1fB | 20个小模型参数: %.1fB | 比例: %.1f倍\n",
 qxtParams, smallParams, paramsRatio);
 System.out.printf(" 每B参数得分: 青小团=%.2f%%/B | 小模型=%.2f%%/B | 效率提升: %.1f倍\n",
 qxtAvg * 100 / qxtParams, smallAvg * 100 / smallParams,
 (qxtAvg / qxtParams) / (smallAvg / smallParams));
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取当前状态
 */
 public String getStatus() {
 return String.format("TrainingMonitor: training=%s, benchmark=%s", 
 !trainingComplete, benchmarkDone);
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;
import java.util.*;

public class EfficientTokenEncoder {

 public enum ContentType {
 NATURAL_LANGUAGE(0.3),
 CODE(0.5),
 STRUCTURED_DATA(0.7),
 NUMERIC(0.8),
 MIXED(0.4);

 private final double compressionFactor;

 ContentType(double factor) {
 this.compressionFactor = factor;
 }

 public double getCompressionFactor() { return compressionFactor; }
 }

 public static class EncodingResult {
 public int[] encodedTokens;
 public double compressionRatio;
 public double semanticFidelity;
 public ContentType detectedType;
 public Map<String, Object> encodingMetrics = new HashMap<>();

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== Encoding Result ===");
 System.out.println("Content type: " + detectedType);
 System.out.println("Compression ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", compressionRatio * 100));
 System.out.println("Semantic fidelity: " + String.format("%.2f%%", semanticFidelity * 100));
 System.out.println("Original tokens: " + encodingMetrics.get("originalCount"));
 System.out.println("Encoded tokens: " + encodingMetrics.get("encodedCount"));
 }
 }

 private static final Set<String> CODE_KEYWORDS = Set.of("public", "private", "protected", "static", "final", "void", "int", "float", "double", "boolean", "char", "class", "interface", "extends", "implements", "override", "return", "if", "else", "for", "while", "do", "switch", "case", "break", "continue", "throw", "try", "catch", "finally", "new", "instanceof", "this", "super", "null", "true", "false", "import", "package", "enum", "abstract", "native", "synchronized", "volatile", "transient");
 private static final Set<String> DATA_KEYWORDS = Set.of("json", "xml", "yaml", "csv", "table", "field", "value", "key", "row", "column", "schema", "struct", "array", "object");

 public static ContentType detectContentType(String text) {
 String lower = text.toLowerCase();
 int codeScore = 0;
 int dataScore = 0;
 int numericScore = 0;
 int textScore = 0;

 for (String kw : CODE_KEYWORDS) {
 if (lower.contains(kw)) codeScore++;
 }
 for (String kw : DATA_KEYWORDS) {
 if (lower.contains(kw)) dataScore++;
 }

 int digitCount = 0;
 int letterCount = 0;
 int specialCount = 0;
 for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
 if (Character.isDigit(c)) digitCount++;
 else if (Character.isLetter(c)) letterCount++;
 else if (c == '{' || c == '}' || c == '[' || c == ']' || c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '"') specialCount++;
 }

 if (digitCount > letterCount * 2) numericScore = 10;
 if (specialCount > letterCount / 2) dataScore += 5;
 if (codeScore > 5) codeScore += 5;

 int total = codeScore + dataScore + numericScore + textScore;
 if (numericScore >= total * 0.4) return ContentType.NUMERIC;
 if (dataScore >= total * 0.4) return ContentType.STRUCTURED_DATA;
 if (codeScore >= total * 0.4) return ContentType.CODE;
 if (letterCount > digitCount * 3) return ContentType.NATURAL_LANGUAGE;
 return ContentType.MIXED;
 }

 public static EncodingResult encode(int[] tokens, Tokenizer tokenizer, ContentType type, double fidelityThreshold) {
 EncodingResult result = new EncodingResult();
 result.detectedType = type;

 List<String> tokenStrings = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int id : tokens) {
 String token = tokenizer.idToToken.get(id);
 tokenStrings.add(token != null ? token : "<unk>");
 }

 List<Integer> encoded = new ArrayList<>();
 Map<String, Integer> freqMap = new HashMap<>();
 for (String token : tokenStrings) {
 freqMap.put(token, freqMap.getOrDefault(token, 0) + 1);
 }

 List<String> frequentTokens = new ArrayList<>();
 freqMap.entrySet().stream()
 .filter(e -> e.getValue() > 1)
 .sorted((a, b) -> b.getValue().compareTo(a.getValue()))
 .limit(200)
 .forEach(e -> frequentTokens.add(e.getKey()));

 Map<String, Integer> tokenToCode = new HashMap<>();
 int codeId = tokenizer.getVocabSize();
 for (String token : frequentTokens) {
 tokenToCode.put(token, codeId++);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < tokenStrings.size(); i++) {
 String token = tokenStrings.get(i);

 if (token.equals("<bos>") || token.equals("<eos>") || token.equals("<pad>")) {
 encoded.add(tokens[i]);
 continue;
 }

 if (tokenToCode.containsKey(token) && freqMap.get(token) > 2) {
 encoded.add(tokenToCode.get(token));
 } else if (type == ContentType.CODE && isCodeToken(token)) {
 encoded.add(encodeCodeToken(token, tokenizer));
 } else if (type == ContentType.STRUCTURED_DATA && isStructuredToken(token)) {
 encoded.add(encodeStructuredToken(token, tokenizer));
 } else if (type == ContentType.NUMERIC && isNumericToken(token)) {
 encoded.add(encodeNumericToken(token, tokenizer));
 } else {
 encoded.add(tokens[i]);
 }
 }

 result.encodedTokens = encoded.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 result.compressionRatio = 1.0 - (double) encoded.size() / tokens.length;
 result.semanticFidelity = Math.min(1.0, 1.0 - result.compressionRatio * (1.0 - type.getCompressionFactor()));

 result.encodingMetrics.put("originalCount", tokens.length);
 result.encodingMetrics.put("encodedCount", encoded.size());
 result.encodingMetrics.put("dictionarySize", tokenToCode.size());
 result.encodingMetrics.put("frequencyCompression", frequentTokens.size());

 return result;
 }

 private static boolean isCodeToken(String token) {
 return CODE_KEYWORDS.contains(token) || token.matches("[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*") || token.matches("[{}()\\[\\]<>]");
 }

 private static boolean isStructuredToken(String token) {
 return token.matches("[{}]") || token.matches("\"[^\"]*\"") || token.matches("[,:]");
 }

 private static boolean isNumericToken(String token) {
 return token.matches("-?\\d+\\.?\\d*") || token.matches("[0-9]+");
 }

 private static int encodeCodeToken(String token, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 if (CODE_KEYWORDS.contains(token)) {
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + CODE_KEYWORDS.indexOf(token);
 }
 int hash = token.hashCode() % 1000;
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 100 + hash;
 }

 private static int encodeStructuredToken(String token, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 if (token.equals("{")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2000;
 if (token.equals("}")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2001;
 if (token.equals("[")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2002;
 if (token.equals("]")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2003;
 if (token.equals("\"")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2004;
 if (token.equals(":")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2005;
 if (token.equals(",")) return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2006;
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2007;
 }

 private static int encodeNumericToken(String token, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 try {
 double num = Double.parseDouble(token);
 if (num == Math.floor(num) && num >= 0 && num <= 1000) {
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 3000 + (int) num;
 }
 int magnitude = (int) Math.log10(Math.abs(num));
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 4000 + magnitude;
 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 return tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 4100;
 }
 }

 public static int[] decode(int[] encodedTokens, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 List<Integer> decoded = new ArrayList<>();

 for (int token : encodedTokens) {
 if (token < tokenizer.getVocabSize()) {
 decoded.add(token);
 } else if (token >= tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2000 && token < tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2008) {
 int offset = token - (tokenizer.getVocabSize() + 2000);
 String[] structTokens = {"{", "}", "[", "]", "\"", ":", ","};
 if (offset < structTokens.length) {
 decoded.add(tokenizer.tokenToId.get(structTokens[offset]));
 } else {
 decoded.add(tokenizer.getUnkTokenId());
 }
 } else {
 decoded.add(tokenizer.getUnkTokenId());
 }
 }

 return decoded.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 }

 public static double calculateEncodingEfficiency(String text, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 int[] original = tokenizer.encode(text);
 ContentType type = detectContentType(text);
 EncodingResult result = encode(original, tokenizer, type, 0.9);

 String decoded = tokenizer.decode(decode(result.encodedTokens, tokenizer));
 double similarity = RedundantTokenDetector.calculateSemanticSimilarity(text, decoded);

 return result.compressionRatio * similarity;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

import java.util.*;

public class MultiHeadCompression {

 public static class MHCConfig {
 public int compressionRatio = 2;
 public int minHeads = 4;
 public int maxHeads = 64;
 public double threshold = 0.1;
 public boolean enableAdaptive = true;
 public boolean enableSparsity = true;
 public int blockSize = 64;

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== MHC Configuration ===");
 System.out.println("Compression ratio: " + compressionRatio);
 System.out.println("Min heads: " + minHeads);
 System.out.println("Max heads: " + maxHeads);
 System.out.println("Threshold: " + threshold);
 System.out.println("Adaptive: " + enableAdaptive);
 System.out.println("Sparsity: " + enableSparsity);
 System.out.println("Block size: " + blockSize);
 }
 }

 public static class MHCResult {
 public float[] compressedOutput;
 public float[] headImportance;
 public int activeHeads;
 public double compressionRatio;
 public double reconstructionError;

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== MHC Result ===");
 System.out.println("Active heads: " + activeHeads);
 System.out.println("Compression ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", compressionRatio * 100));
 System.out.println("Reconstruction error: " + String.format("%.4f", reconstructionError));
 }
 }

 private final MHCConfig config;
 private float[][] projectionMatrix;
 private float[][] reconstructionMatrix;
 private float[] headBias;

 public MultiHeadCompression(MHCConfig config) {
 this.config = config;
 }

 public void initialize(int nHeads, int headDim, int dModel) {
 int compressedDim = dModel / config.compressionRatio;
 
 projectionMatrix = new float[nHeads][headDim * compressedDim];
 reconstructionMatrix = new float[nHeads][compressedDim * headDim];
 headBias = new float[nHeads];

 Random random = new Random(42);
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < headDim * compressedDim; i++) {
 projectionMatrix[h][i] = (float) (random.nextGaussian() / Math.sqrt(headDim));
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < compressedDim * headDim; i++) {
 reconstructionMatrix[h][i] = (float) (random.nextGaussian() / Math.sqrt(compressedDim));
 }
 headBias[h] = (float) random.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 }
 }

 public MHCResult compress(float[] input, int batchSize, int seqLen, int nHeads, int headDim, int dModel) {
 MHCResult result = new MHCResult();
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 int compressedDim = dModel / config.compressionRatio;
 int compressedSize = batchSize * seqLen * compressedDim;

 float[] headOutputs = new float[nHeads * batchSize * seqLen * headDim];
 float[] headNorms = new float[nHeads];

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 float norm = 0;
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int inputOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 int headOffset = h * batchSize * seqLen * headDim + (b * seqLen + s) * headDim;
 for (int d = 0; d < headDim; d++) {
 int sourceIdx = inputOffset + (h * headDim + d) % dModel;
 headOutputs[headOffset + d] = input[sourceIdx];
 norm += input[sourceIdx] * input[sourceIdx];
 }
 }
 }
 headNorms[h] = (float) Math.sqrt(norm / (batchSize * seqLen * headDim));
 }

 List<Integer> activeHeadIndices = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 if (headNorms[h] > config.threshold) {
 activeHeadIndices.add(h);
 }
 }

 if (activeHeadIndices.size() < config.minHeads) {
 activeHeadIndices.clear();
 for (int h = 0; h < Math.min(config.minHeads, nHeads); h++) {
 activeHeadIndices.add(h);
 }
 }

 if (activeHeadIndices.size() > config.maxHeads) {
 activeHeadIndices.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(headNorms[b], headNorms[a]));
 activeHeadIndices = activeHeadIndices.subList(0, config.maxHeads);
 }

 result.activeHeads = activeHeadIndices.size();
 result.compressionRatio = 1.0 - (double) result.activeHeads / nHeads;

 float[] headWeights = new float[nHeads];
 float totalWeight = 0;
 for (int h : activeHeadIndices) {
 headWeights[h] = headNorms[h];
 totalWeight += headNorms[h];
 }
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 headWeights[h] /= totalWeight;
 }
 result.headImportance = headWeights;

 float[] compressed = new float[compressedSize];
 Arrays.fill(compressed, 0);

 for (int h : activeHeadIndices) {
 float weight = headWeights[h];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int headOffset = h * batchSize * seqLen * headDim + (b * seqLen + s) * headDim;
 int compressedOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * compressedDim;

 float[] headSlice = new float[headDim];
 for (int d = 0; d < headDim; d++) {
 headSlice[d] = headOutputs[headOffset + d];
 }

 float[] projected = MatrixOperations.matmul(headSlice, projectionMatrix[h], 1, headDim, compressedDim);
 for (int d = 0; d < compressedDim; d++) {
 compressed[compressedOffset + d] += weight * projected[d];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 if (config.enableSparsity) {
 applySparsity(compressed, compressedSize, compressedDim);
 }

 result.compressedOutput = compressed;

 float[] reconstructed = reconstruct(compressed, batchSize, seqLen, nHeads, headDim, dModel, headWeights);
 double error = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 error += (input[i] - reconstructed[i]) * (input[i] - reconstructed[i]);
 }
 result.reconstructionError = error / totalSize;

 return result;
 }

 public float[] reconstruct(float[] compressed, int batchSize, int seqLen, int nHeads, int headDim, int dModel, float[] headWeights) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 int compressedDim = dModel / config.compressionRatio;

 float[] reconstructed = new float[totalSize];
 Arrays.fill(reconstructed, 0);

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 if (headWeights[h] < config.threshold) continue;

 float weight = headWeights[h];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int compressedOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * compressedDim;
 int outputOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;

 float[] compressedSlice = new float[compressedDim];
 for (int d = 0; d < compressedDim; d++) {
 compressedSlice[d] = compressed[compressedOffset + d];
 }

 float[] decompressed = MatrixOperations.matmul(compressedSlice, reconstructionMatrix[h], 1, compressedDim, headDim);
 for (int d = 0; d < headDim; d++) {
 int targetIdx = outputOffset + (h * headDim + d) % dModel;
 reconstructed[targetIdx] += weight * (decompressed[d] + headBias[h]);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 return reconstructed;
 }

 private void applySparsity(float[] data, int size, int dim) {
 int blocks = size / dim;
 for (int b = 0; b < blocks; b++) {
 int offset = b * dim;
 float norm = 0;
 for (int d = 0; d < dim; d++) {
 norm += data[offset + d] * data[offset + d];
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 if (norm < config.threshold) {
 for (int d = 0; d < dim; d++) {
 data[offset + d] = 0;
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public float[] backward(float[] dCompressed, float[] compressed, int batchSize, int seqLen, int nHeads, int headDim, int dModel, float[] headWeights) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 int compressedDim = dModel / config.compressionRatio;

 float[] dInput = new float[totalSize];
 Arrays.fill(dInput, 0);

 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 if (headWeights[h] < config.threshold) continue;

 float weight = headWeights[h];
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int dCompressedOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * compressedDim;
 int inputOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;

 float[] dCompressedSlice = new float[compressedDim];
 for (int d = 0; d < compressedDim; d++) {
 dCompressedSlice[d] = dCompressed[dCompressedOffset + d];
 }

 float[] dDecompressed = MatrixOperations.matmul(dCompressedSlice, MatrixOperations.transpose(reconstructionMatrix[h], compressedDim, headDim), 1, compressedDim, headDim);
 for (int d = 0; d < headDim; d++) {
 int targetIdx = inputOffset + (h * headDim + d) % dModel;
 dInput[targetIdx] += weight * dDecompressed[d];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 return dInput;
 }

 public MHCConfig getConfig() { return config; }
 public float[][] getProjectionMatrix() { return projectionMatrix; }
 public float[][] getReconstructionMatrix() { return reconstructionMatrix; }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;
import java.util.*;

public class RedundantTokenDetector {

 public enum RedundancyType {
 DUPLICATE(1, "重复Token", "连续出现的相同Token"),
 LOW_INFO(2, "低信息Token", "信息量低于阈值的Token"),
 COMPRESSIBLE(3, "可压缩Token", "可通过编码压缩的Token"),
 STRUCTURAL(4, "结构冗余", "语法结构导致的冗余"),
 FORMATTING(5, "格式冗余", "格式化符号导致的冗余");

 private final int priority;
 private final String name;
 private final String description;

 RedundancyType(int priority, String name, String description) {
 this.priority = priority;
 this.name = name;
 this.description = description;
 }

 public int getPriority() { return priority; }
 public String getName() { return name; }
 public String getDescription() { return description; }
 }

 public static class RedundancyReport {
 public List<RedundancyItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
 public Map<RedundancyType, Integer> typeCount = new HashMap<>();
 public double totalRedundancyRatio;
 public double estimatedCompressionRatio;

 public void addItem(RedundancyItem item) {
 items.add(item);
 typeCount.put(item.type, typeCount.getOrDefault(item.type, 0) + 1);
 }

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== Redundant Token Detection Report ===");
 System.out.println("Total redundancy ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", totalRedundancyRatio * 100));
 System.out.println("Estimated compression ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", estimatedCompressionRatio * 100));
 System.out.println("\nRedundancy by type:");
 Arrays.stream(RedundancyType.values())
 .sorted((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b.getPriority(), a.getPriority()))
 .forEach(type -> System.out.println(" " + type.getName() + ": " + typeCount.getOrDefault(type, 0)));
 System.out.println("\nTop redundant tokens:");
 items.stream()
 .sorted((a, b) -> Double.compare(b.redundancyScore, a.redundancyScore))
 .limit(10)
 .forEach(item -> System.out.println(" " + item.token + " [" + item.type.getName() + "] score: " + String.format("%.3f", item.redundancyScore)));
 }
 }

 public static class RedundancyItem {
 public String token;
 public RedundancyType type;
 public int position;
 public double redundancyScore;
 public double semanticPreservation;
 public String replacement;

 public RedundancyItem(String token, RedundancyType type, int position, double score, double preservation, String replacement) {
 this.token = token;
 this.type = type;
 this.position = position;
 this.redundancyScore = score;
 this.semanticPreservation = preservation;
 this.replacement = replacement;
 }
 }

 private static final Set<String> ARTICLES = Set.of("the", "a", "an");
 private static final Set<String> CONNECTORS = Set.of("and", "but", "or", "so", "yet", "for", "nor");
 private static final Set<String> PREPOSITIONS = Set.of("of", "in", "for", "on", "with", "at", "by", "from", "as", "into", "through", "during", "before", "after", "above", "below", "between", "under");
 private static final Set<String> AUXILIARIES = Set.of("is", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being", "have", "has", "had", "do", "does", "did", "will", "would", "could", "should", "may", "might", "must", "shall", "can");

 public static RedundancyReport detectRedundancy(int[] tokenIds, Tokenizer tokenizer, double semanticThreshold) {
 RedundancyReport report = new RedundancyReport();
 Map<String, Integer> tokenPositions = new HashMap<>();
 List<String> tokenStrings = new ArrayList<>();

 for (int id : tokenIds) {
 String token = tokenizer.idToToken.get(id);
 tokenStrings.add(token != null ? token : "<unk>");
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < tokenStrings.size(); i++) {
 String token = tokenStrings.get(i);

 if (token.equals("<bos>") || token.equals("<eos>") || token.equals("<pad>")) {
 continue;
 }

 double redundancyScore = 0;
 RedundancyType type = null;
 double preservation = 1.0;
 String replacement = null;

 if (i > 0 && token.equals(tokenStrings.get(i - 1))) {
 redundancyScore = 0.9;
 type = RedundancyType.DUPLICATE;
 preservation = 0.95;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (ARTICLES.contains(token.toLowerCase())) {
 redundancyScore = 0.7;
 type = RedundancyType.LOW_INFO;
 preservation = 0.85;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (CONNECTORS.contains(token.toLowerCase())) {
 redundancyScore = 0.6;
 type = RedundancyType.LOW_INFO;
 preservation = 0.9;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (PREPOSITIONS.contains(token.toLowerCase())) {
 redundancyScore = 0.55;
 type = RedundancyType.LOW_INFO;
 preservation = 0.88;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (AUXILIARIES.contains(token.toLowerCase())) {
 redundancyScore = 0.5;
 type = RedundancyType.LOW_INFO;
 preservation = 0.92;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (token.length() == 1 && Character.isWhitespace(token.charAt(0))) {
 redundancyScore = 0.4;
 type = RedundancyType.FORMATTING;
 preservation = 0.98;
 replacement = "";
 }

 else if (token.matches("[\\p{Punct}]+") && token.length() > 1) {
 redundancyScore = 0.35;
 type = RedundancyType.FORMATTING;
 preservation = 0.96;
 replacement = token.substring(0, 1);
 }

 else if (token.matches("\\d{4,}")) {
 redundancyScore = 0.3;
 type = RedundancyType.COMPRESSIBLE;
 preservation = 0.99;
 replacement = "NUM";
 }

 if (type != null && preservation >= semanticThreshold) {
 report.addItem(new RedundancyItem(token, type, i, redundancyScore, preservation, replacement));
 }
 }

 report.totalRedundancyRatio = (double) report.items.size() / tokenStrings.size();
 report.estimatedCompressionRatio = report.totalRedundancyRatio * 0.7;

 return report;
 }

 public static int[] applyCompression(int[] tokenIds, Tokenizer tokenizer, RedundancyReport report) {
 List<Integer> compressed = new ArrayList<>();
 Set<Integer> removedPositions = new HashSet<>();

 for (RedundancyItem item : report.items) {
 removedPositions.add(item.position);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
 if (!removedPositions.contains(i)) {
 compressed.add(tokenIds[i]);
 }
 }

 return compressed.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
 }

 public static double calculateSemanticSimilarity(String original, String compressed) {
 Set<String> originalWords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(original.toLowerCase().split("\\s+")));
 Set<String> compressedWords = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(compressed.toLowerCase().split("\\s+")));

 if (originalWords.isEmpty()) return 1.0;

 Set<String> intersection = new HashSet<>(originalWords);
 intersection.retainAll(compressedWords);

 return (double) intersection.size() / originalWords.size();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;
import java.util.*;

public class TokenAnalyzer {

 public static class TokenHeatmap {
 public Map<String, Integer> tokenFrequency = new HashMap<>();
 public Map<String, Double> tokenInformationContent = new HashMap<>();
 public Map<String, String> tokenCategory = new HashMap<>();
 public int totalTokens;
 public int uniqueTokens;
 public double averageTokenLength;
 public double entropy;

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== Token Heatmap ===");
 System.out.println("Total tokens: " + totalTokens);
 System.out.println("Unique tokens: " + uniqueTokens);
 System.out.println("Average token length: " + String.format("%.2f", averageTokenLength));
 System.out.println("Entropy: " + String.format("%.2f", entropy));
 System.out.println("Top 20 frequent tokens:");
 tokenFrequency.entrySet().stream()
 .sorted((a, b) -> b.getValue().compareTo(a.getValue()))
 .limit(20)
 .forEach(e -> System.out.println(" " + e.getKey() + ": " + e.getValue() + " (" + tokenCategory.get(e.getKey()) + ")"));
 }
 }

 public static class BottleneckReport {
 public List<String> bottlenecks = new ArrayList<>();
 public Map<String, Double> consumptionRatio = new HashMap<>();
 public Map<String, String> severity = new HashMap<>();

 public void addBottleneck(String stage, double ratio, String level) {
 bottlenecks.add(stage);
 consumptionRatio.put(stage, ratio);
 severity.put(stage, level);
 }

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== Token Consumption Bottleneck Report ===");
 bottlenecks.stream()
 .sorted((a, b) -> Double.compare(consumptionRatio.get(b), consumptionRatio.get(a)))
 .forEach(stage -> System.out.println(" [" + severity.get(stage) + "] " + stage + ": " + String.format("%.1f%%", consumptionRatio.get(stage) * 100)));
 }
 }

 private static final Set<String> FUNCTIONAL_TOKENS = Set.of(" ", ".", ",", "!", "?", ":", ";", "-", "_", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}", "\"", "'", "\\", "/", "<", ">", "=", "+", "~", "`", "|");
 private static final Set<String> LOW_INFO_TOKENS = Set.of("the", "a", "an", "is", "are", "was", "were", "be", "been", "being", "have", "has", "had", "do", "does", "did", "will", "would", "could", "should", "may", "might", "must", "shall", "can", "need", "dare", "ought", "used", "to", "of", "in", "for", "on", "with", "at", "by", "from", "as", "into", "through", "during", "before", "after", "above", "below", "between", "under", "again", "further", "then", "once", "here", "there", "when", "where", "why", "how", "all", "each", "few", "more", "most", "other", "some", "such", "no", "nor", "not", "only", "own", "same", "so", "than", "too", "very");

 public static TokenHeatmap analyzeTokens(int[] tokenIds, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 TokenHeatmap heatmap = new TokenHeatmap();
 Map<String, Integer> freq = new HashMap<>();
 int totalLength = 0;

 for (int id : tokenIds) {
 String token = tokenizer.idToToken.get(id);
 if (token == null) continue;
 freq.put(token, freq.getOrDefault(token, 0) + 1);
 totalLength += token.length();
 }

 heatmap.tokenFrequency = freq;
 heatmap.totalTokens = tokenIds.length;
 heatmap.uniqueTokens = freq.size();
 heatmap.averageTokenLength = (double) totalLength / tokenIds.length;

 double entropy = 0;
 for (int count : freq.values()) {
 double prob = (double) count / tokenIds.length;
 entropy -= prob * Math.log(prob) / Math.log(2);
 }
 heatmap.entropy = entropy;

 for (String token : freq.keySet()) {
 if (token.equals("<bos>") || token.equals("<eos>") || token.equals("<pad>") || token.equals("<unk>")) {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "SPECIAL");
 } else if (FUNCTIONAL_TOKENS.contains(token)) {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "FUNCTIONAL");
 } else if (LOW_INFO_TOKENS.contains(token.toLowerCase())) {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "LOW_INFO");
 } else if (token.matches("\\d+")) {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "NUMERIC");
 } else if (token.length() == 1 && Character.isLetter(token.charAt(0))) {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "SINGLE_CHAR");
 } else {
 heatmap.tokenCategory.put(token, "CONTENT");
 }
 }

 for (String token : freq.keySet()) {
 int freqCount = freq.get(token);
 double prob = (double) freqCount / tokenIds.length;
 double infoContent = -Math.log(prob) / Math.log(2);
 heatmap.tokenInformationContent.put(token, infoContent);
 }

 return heatmap;
 }

 public static BottleneckReport analyzeTokenFlow(String text, Tokenizer tokenizer, int maxSequenceLength) {
 BottleneckReport report = new BottleneckReport();

 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(text);
 int totalTokens = tokens.length;

 int preprocessingOverhead = 2;
 double preprocessingRatio = (double) preprocessingOverhead / totalTokens;
 report.addBottleneck("Preprocessing (BOS/EOS tokens)", preprocessingRatio, "LOW");

 int paddingNeeded = Math.max(0, maxSequenceLength - totalTokens);
 double paddingRatio = (double) paddingNeeded / Math.max(maxSequenceLength, totalTokens);
 String paddingSeverity = paddingRatio > 0.5 ? "HIGH" : paddingRatio > 0.2 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
 report.addBottleneck("Padding", paddingRatio, paddingSeverity);

 int truncationLoss = Math.max(0, totalTokens - maxSequenceLength);
 double truncationRatio = (double) truncationLoss / totalTokens;
 String truncationSeverity = truncationRatio > 0.3 ? "HIGH" : truncationRatio > 0.1 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
 report.addBottleneck("Truncation loss", truncationRatio, truncationSeverity);

 TokenHeatmap heatmap = analyzeTokens(tokens, tokenizer);
 int lowInfoCount = 0;
 for (String token : heatmap.tokenFrequency.keySet()) {
 if ("LOW_INFO".equals(heatmap.tokenCategory.get(token))) {
 lowInfoCount += heatmap.tokenFrequency.get(token);
 }
 }
 double lowInfoRatio = (double) lowInfoCount / totalTokens;
 String lowInfoSeverity = lowInfoRatio > 0.4 ? "HIGH" : lowInfoRatio > 0.2 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
 report.addBottleneck("Low-information tokens", lowInfoRatio, lowInfoSeverity);

 int functionalCount = 0;
 for (String token : heatmap.tokenFrequency.keySet()) {
 if ("FUNCTIONAL".equals(heatmap.tokenCategory.get(token))) {
 functionalCount += heatmap.tokenFrequency.get(token);
 }
 }
 double functionalRatio = (double) functionalCount / totalTokens;
 String functionalSeverity = functionalRatio > 0.3 ? "HIGH" : functionalRatio > 0.15 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
 report.addBottleneck("Functional tokens", functionalRatio, functionalSeverity);

 int singleCharCount = 0;
 for (String token : heatmap.tokenFrequency.keySet()) {
 if ("SINGLE_CHAR".equals(heatmap.tokenCategory.get(token))) {
 singleCharCount += heatmap.tokenFrequency.get(token);
 }
 }
 double singleCharRatio = (double) singleCharCount / totalTokens;
 String singleCharSeverity = singleCharRatio > 0.3 ? "HIGH" : singleCharRatio > 0.15 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW";
 report.addBottleneck("Single-character tokens", singleCharRatio, singleCharSeverity);

 return report;
 }

 public static double calculateCompressionPotential(String text, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 TokenHeatmap heatmap = analyzeTokens(tokenizer.encode(text), tokenizer);

 double lowInfoRatio = 0;
 double functionalRatio = 0;
 double singleCharRatio = 0;

 int total = heatmap.totalTokens;
 for (String token : heatmap.tokenFrequency.keySet()) {
 int count = heatmap.tokenFrequency.get(token);
 String category = heatmap.tokenCategory.get(token);
 if ("LOW_INFO".equals(category)) {
 lowInfoRatio += (double) count / total;
 } else if ("FUNCTIONAL".equals(category)) {
 functionalRatio += (double) count / total;
 } else if ("SINGLE_CHAR".equals(category)) {
 singleCharRatio += (double) count / total;
 }
 }

 double potential = lowInfoRatio * 0.8 + functionalRatio * 0.5 + singleCharRatio * 0.6;
 return Math.min(0.7, potential);
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;

import java.util.*;

public class TokenOptimizationBenchmark {

 public static class BenchmarkResult {
 public String testName;
 public long originalTokens;
 public long optimizedTokens;
 public double compressionRatio;
 public double semanticFidelity;
 public long responseTimeMs;
 public double accuracy;
 public double qualityScore;
 public long memoryBytes;
 public int throughput;

 public void print() {
 System.out.println("=== Benchmark: " + testName + " ===");
 System.out.println("Original tokens: " + originalTokens);
 System.out.println("Optimized tokens: " + optimizedTokens);
 System.out.println("Compression ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", compressionRatio * 100));
 System.out.println("Semantic fidelity: " + String.format("%.2f%%", semanticFidelity * 100));
 System.out.println("Response time: " + responseTimeMs + " ms");
 System.out.println("Accuracy: " + String.format("%.2f%%", accuracy * 100));
 System.out.println("Quality score: " + String.format("%.2f%%", qualityScore * 100));
 System.out.println("Memory: " + String.format("%.2f MB", memoryBytes / 1_000_000.0));
 System.out.println("Throughput: " + throughput + " tokens/s");
 }
 }

 public static class BenchmarkSuite {
 public List<BenchmarkResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
 public Map<String, Double> averages = new HashMap<>();

 public void addResult(BenchmarkResult result) {
 results.add(result);
 }

 public void calculateAverages() {
 if (results.isEmpty()) return;

 double avgCompression = 0;
 double avgFidelity = 0;
 double avgTime = 0;
 double avgAccuracy = 0;
 double avgQuality = 0;

 for (BenchmarkResult r : results) {
 avgCompression += r.compressionRatio;
 avgFidelity += r.semanticFidelity;
 avgTime += r.responseTimeMs;
 avgAccuracy += r.accuracy;
 avgQuality += r.qualityScore;
 }

 int count = results.size();
 averages.put("compressionRatio", avgCompression / count);
 averages.put("semanticFidelity", avgFidelity / count);
 averages.put("responseTimeMs", avgTime / count);
 averages.put("accuracy", avgAccuracy / count);
 averages.put("qualityScore", avgQuality / count);
 }

 public void printSummary() {
 calculateAverages();
 System.out.println("=== Benchmark Suite Summary ===");
 System.out.println("Total tests: " + results.size());
 System.out.println("Average compression ratio: " + String.format("%.1f%%", averages.get("compressionRatio") * 100));
 System.out.println("Average semantic fidelity: " + String.format("%.2f%%", averages.get("semanticFidelity") * 100));
 System.out.println("Average response time: " + String.format("%.2f ms", averages.get("responseTimeMs")));
 System.out.println("Average accuracy: " + String.format("%.2f%%", averages.get("accuracy") * 100));
 System.out.println("Average quality score: " + String.format("%.2f%%", averages.get("qualityScore") * 100));
 }
 }

 System.out.println("=== Running Natural Language Benchmark ===");
 for (int i = 0; i < TEST_TEXT_NL.length; i++) {

 }

 System.out.println("\n=== Running Code Benchmark ===");
 for (int i = 0; i < TEST_TEXT_CODE.length; i++) {
 BenchmarkResult result = runSingleTest("CODE_" + (i + 1), TEST_TEXT_CODE[i], tokenizer, EfficientTokenEncoder.ContentType.CODE);
 suite.addResult(result);
 result.print();
 }

 System.out.println("\n=== Running Structured Data Benchmark ===");
