 /**
 * 计算交叉熵损失
 */
 private float computeLoss(float[][] logits, int[] targets) {
 int seqLen = logits.length;
 int vocabSize = logits[0].length;
 float loss = 0;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int target = targets[t];
 if (target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;
 
 // Softmax with log
 float maxLogit = logits[t][0];
 for (int i = 1; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 if (logits[t][i] > maxLogit) maxLogit = logits[t][i];
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 sum += (float) Math.exp(logits[t][i] - maxLogit);
 }
 
 loss -= (logits[t][target] - maxLogit) - (float) Math.log(sum);
 }
 
 return loss / seqLen;
 }
 
 /**
 * 训练一步
 */
 private float trainStep() {
 // 生成训练数据
 int[] inputIds = generateTrainingData();
 
 // 准备目标（下一个token）
 int[] targets = new int[seqLen];
 System.arraycopy(inputIds, 1, targets, 0, seqLen - 1);
 targets[seqLen - 1] = 0; // 最后一个token的目标是EOS
 
 // 前向传播
 float[][] logits = textModel.forward(inputIds);
 
 // 计算损失
 float loss = computeLoss(logits, targets);
 
 // 计算梯度（简化版）
 Map<String, float[]> gradients = computeGradients(logits, targets);
 
 // 更新参数
 Map<String, float[]> params = textModel.getParametersMap();
 
 // 学习率衰减
 float lrScale = Math.max(0.1f, 1.0f - (float) currentStep / totalSteps);
 
 optimizer.update(params, gradients, lrScale);
 
 return loss;
 }
 
 /**
 * 计算梯度（简化版）
 */
 private Map<String, float[]> computeGradients(float[][] logits, int[] targets) {
 Map<String, float[]> params = textModel.getParametersMap();
 Map<String, float[]> gradients = new java.util.HashMap<>();
 
 // 初始化梯度为0
 for (String key : params.keySet()) {
 gradients.put(key, new float[params.get(key).length]);
 }
 
 // 简化的梯度计算：随机梯度下降
 float scale = 1e-4f; // 梯度缩放因子
 
 for (String key : gradients.keySet()) {
 float[] grad = gradients.get(key);
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 // 使用随机梯度作为简化方案
 grad[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 }
 
 // 添加基于损失的梯度
 float[] lmHeadGrad = gradients.get("lmHeadWeight");
 if (lmHeadGrad != null) {
 int vocabSize = textModel.getVocabSize();
 int dModel = textModel.getDModel();
 
 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen; t++) {
 int target = targets[t];
 if (target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;
 
 // 计算softmax
 float maxLogit = logits[t][0];
 for (int i = 1; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 if (logits[t][i] > maxLogit) maxLogit = logits[t][i];
 }
 
 float sum = 0;
 float[] probs = new float[vocabSize];
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 probs[i] = (float) Math.exp(logits[t][i] - maxLogit);
 sum += probs[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 probs[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 // 梯度：dLoss/dWeight = (prob - target) * hidden
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 float grad = (probs[j] - (j == target ? 1 : 0)) * scale;
 lmHeadGrad[i * vocabSize + j] += grad;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 return gradients;
 }
 
 /**
 * 开始训练
 */
 public void train() {
 System.out.println("=== 多模态训练器启动 ===");
 System.out.println("文本模型参数: " + textModel.getParameterCount() + " (约 " + 
 (textModel.getParameterCount() / 1000000) + "M)");
 System.out.println("GPU加速: " + useGPU);
 System.out.println("目标损失: < " + lossTarget);
 System.out.println("总步数: " + totalSteps);
 System.out.println("批次大小: " + batchSize);
 System.out.println("序列长度: " + seqLen);
 System.out.println("学习率: " + learningRate);
 System.out.println("========================\n");
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float bestLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 
 for (currentStep = 0; currentStep < totalSteps; currentStep++) {
 float stepLoss = 0;
 
 // 批量训练
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 stepLoss += trainStep();
 }
 stepLoss /= batchSize;
 
 // 记录损失
 totalLoss += stepLoss;
 recentLosses[currentStep % lossWindow] = stepLoss;
 
 // 计算平均损失
 float avgLoss = 0;
 int count = Math.min(currentStep + 1, lossWindow);
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 avgLoss += recentLosses[i];
 }
 avgLoss /= count;
 
 // 更新最佳损失
 if (stepLoss < bestLoss) {
 bestLoss = stepLoss;
 }
 
 // 计算进度
 float progress = ((float) currentStep / totalSteps) * 100;
 long elapsedTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 long estimatedRemaining = (long) (elapsedTime * (totalSteps - currentStep) / (currentStep + 1));
 
 // 打印进度信息
 if ((currentStep + 1) % 10 == 0) {
 System.out.printf("[步骤 %d/%d] 进度: %.1f%% | 损失: %.4f | 平均损失: %.4f | 最佳损失: %.4f | " +
 "耗时: %ds | 预计剩余: %ds\n",
 currentStep + 1, totalSteps, progress, stepLoss, avgLoss, bestLoss,
 elapsedTime / 1000, estimatedRemaining / 1000);
 }
 
 // 检查是否达到目标损失
 if (avgLoss < lossTarget) {
 System.out.println("\n🎉 目标损失达成！平均损失: " + avgLoss + " < " + lossTarget);
 System.out.println("达成步数: " + (currentStep + 1));
 break;
 }
 
 // 检查是否陷入困境
 if (currentStep > 100 && avgLoss > 10.0f) {
 System.out.println("⚠️ 训练进展缓慢，调整学习率...");
 learningRate *= 0.5f;
 optimizer = new AdamOptimizer(learningRate);
 System.out.println("新学习率: " + learningRate);
 }
 }
 
 long totalTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 System.out.println("\n=== 训练完成 ===");
 System.out.println("总耗时: " + (totalTime / 1000) + "秒");
 System.out.println("最终损失: " + (totalLoss / (currentStep + 1)));
 System.out.println("最佳损失: " + bestLoss);
 
 // 测试生成
 testGeneration();
 }
 
 /**
 * 测试文本生成
 */
 private void testGeneration() {
 System.out.println("\n=== 文本生成测试 ===");
 
 String[] prompts = {
 "你好，",
 "今天天气",
 "中国的首都",
 "我喜欢",
 "春天来了"
 };
 
 for (String prompt : prompts) {
 int[] inputIds = tokenizer.encode(prompt);
 
 // 生成
 int[] outputIds = textModel.generate(inputIds, 32);
 
 // 解码
 String output = tokenizer.decode(outputIds);
 System.out.println("输入: " + prompt);
 System.out.println("输出: " + output);
 System.out.println();
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 // 创建训练器并开始训练
 MultiModalTrainer trainer = new MultiModalTrainer(1870);
 trainer.train();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class AdamOptimizer {
 
 private final float learningRate;
 private final float beta1;
 private final float beta2;
 private final float epsilon;
 private int t;
 
 private Map<String, float[]> m; // 一阶矩
 private Map<String, float[]> v; // 二阶矩
 
 public AdamOptimizer(float learningRate) {
 this(learningRate, 0.9f, 0.999f, 1e-8f);
 }
 
 public AdamOptimizer(float learningRate, float beta1, float beta2, float epsilon) {
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 this.beta1 = beta1;
 this.beta2 = beta2;
 this.epsilon = epsilon;
 this.t = 0;
 this.m = new HashMap<>();
 this.v = new HashMap<>();
 }
 
 public void update(Map<String, float[]> parameters, Map<String, float[]> gradients, float lrScale) {
 t++;
 
 for (String key : gradients.keySet()) {
 float[] grad = gradients.get(key);
 float[] param = parameters.get(key);
 if (param == null || grad == null) continue;
 
 float[] mt = m.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new float[grad.length]);
 float[] vt = v.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new float[grad.length]);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length && i < param.length; i++) {
 // 更新一阶矩
 mt[i] = beta1 * mt[i] + (1 - beta1) * grad[i];
 // 更新二阶矩
 vt[i] = beta2 * vt[i] + (1 - beta2) * grad[i] * grad[i];
 
 // 偏差校正
 float mHat = mt[i] / (1 - (float) Math.pow(beta1, t));
 float vHat = vt[i] / (1 - (float) Math.pow(beta2, t));
 
 // 更新参数
 param[i] -= learningRate * lrScale * mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + epsilon);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void reset() {
 t = 0;
 m.clear();
 v.clear();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class AdamWOptimizer {
 
 private volatile float learningRate;
 private final float weightDecay;
 private final float beta1;
 private final float beta2;
 private final float eps;
 private final float gradClip;
 private LearningRateScheduler scheduler;
 
 private final Map<float[], float[]> mCache;
 private final Map<float[], float[]> vCache;
 private int step;
 
 private float[] currentGradients;
 private int gradientAccumulationSteps;
 private int accumulationCount;

 public AdamWOptimizer(float learningRate) {
 this(learningRate, 0.01f, 0.9f, 0.999f, 1e-8f, 1.0f);
 }

 public AdamWOptimizer(float learningRate, float weightDecay) {
 this(learningRate, weightDecay, 0.9f, 0.999f, 1e-8f, 1.0f);
 }

 public AdamWOptimizer(float learningRate, float weightDecay, float beta1, float beta2) {
 this(learningRate, weightDecay, beta1, beta2, 1e-8f, 1.0f);
 }

 public AdamWOptimizer(float learningRate, float weightDecay, float beta1, float beta2, float eps, float gradClip) {
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 this.weightDecay = weightDecay;
 this.beta1 = beta1;
 this.beta2 = beta2;
 this.eps = eps;
 this.gradClip = gradClip;
 this.mCache = new HashMap<>();
 this.vCache = new HashMap<>();
 this.step = 0;
 this.gradientAccumulationSteps = 1;
 this.accumulationCount = 0;
 }

 public void setScheduler(LearningRateScheduler scheduler) {
 this.scheduler = scheduler;
 }

 public void setGradientAccumulationSteps(int steps) {
 this.gradientAccumulationSteps = Math.max(1, steps);
 }

 public void accumulateGradients(float[] gradients) {
 if (currentGradients == null || currentGradients.length != gradients.length) {
 currentGradients = new float[gradients.length];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 currentGradients[i] += gradients[i];
 }
 accumulationCount++;
 }

 public boolean isAccumulationReady() {
 return accumulationCount >= gradientAccumulationSteps;
 }

 public void resetAccumulation() {
 if (currentGradients != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < currentGradients.length; i++) {
 currentGradients[i] = 0;
 }
 }
 accumulationCount = 0;
 }

 public void update(float[] weights, float[] gradients) {
 step++;
 float lr = getCurrentLearningRate();
 
 float[] gradToUse = gradients;
 if (gradientAccumulationSteps > 1) {
 gradToUse = new float[gradients.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 gradToUse[i] = gradients[i] / gradientAccumulationSteps;
 }
 }

 float norm = 0;
 for (float g : gradToUse) {
 norm += g * g;
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 float scale = 1.0f;
 if (norm > gradClip) {
 scale = gradClip / norm;
 }

 float[] m = mCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);
 float[] v = vCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);

 float biasCorrection1 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta1, step);
 float biasCorrection2 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta2, step);

 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 float grad = gradToUse[i] * scale;
 
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1 - beta1) * grad;
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1 - beta2) * grad * grad;
 
 float mHat = m[i] / biasCorrection1;
 float vHat = v[i] / biasCorrection2;
 
 float update = mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + eps);
 
 if (weightDecay > 0) {
 weights[i] -= lr * weightDecay * weights[i];
 }
 weights[i] -= lr * update;
 
 if (Float.isNaN(weights[i]) || Float.isInfinite(weights[i])) {
 weights[i] = 0;
 }
 }

 if (scheduler != null) {
 scheduler.step();
 }
 }

 public void updateWithAccumulated(float[] weights) {
 if (currentGradients == null) {
 return;
 }
 
 step++;
 float lr = getCurrentLearningRate();
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float g : currentGradients) {
 norm += g * g;
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 float scale = 1.0f;
 if (norm > gradClip) {
 scale = gradClip / norm;
 }

 float[] m = mCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);
 float[] v = vCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);
 
 float effectiveBatch = accumulationCount;

 float biasCorrection1 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta1, step);
 float biasCorrection2 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta2, step);

 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 float grad = (currentGradients[i] / effectiveBatch) * scale;
 
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1 - beta1) * grad;
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1 - beta2) * grad * grad;
 
 float mHat = m[i] / biasCorrection1;
 float vHat = v[i] / biasCorrection2;
 
 float update = mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + eps);
 
 if (weightDecay > 0) {
 weights[i] -= lr * weightDecay * weights[i];
 }
 weights[i] -= lr * update;
 
 if (Float.isNaN(weights[i]) || Float.isInfinite(weights[i])) {
 weights[i] = 0;
 }
 }

 resetAccumulation();
 
 if (scheduler != null) {
 scheduler.step();
 }
 }

 public void update(float[][] weights, float[][] gradients) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 update(weights[i], gradients[i]);
 }
 }

 public void update(float[] weights, float[] gradients, int offset, int length) {
 step++;
 float lr = getCurrentLearningRate();
 
 float[] gradToUse = new float[length];
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 gradToUse[i] = gradients[offset + i];
 }
 
 if (gradientAccumulationSteps > 1) {
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 gradToUse[i] /= gradientAccumulationSteps;
 }
 }

 float norm = 0;
 for (float g : gradToUse) {
 norm += g * g;
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 float scale = 1.0f;
 if (norm > gradClip) {
 scale = gradClip / norm;
 }

 float[] m = mCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);
 float[] v = vCache.computeIfAbsent(weights, k -> new float[weights.length]);

 float biasCorrection1 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta1, step);
 float biasCorrection2 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta2, step);

 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 float grad = gradToUse[i] * scale;
 
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1 - beta1) * grad;
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1 - beta2) * grad * grad;
 
 float mHat = m[i] / biasCorrection1;
 float vHat = v[i] / biasCorrection2;
 
 float update = mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + eps);
 
 if (weightDecay > 0) {
 weights[i] -= lr * weightDecay * weights[i];
 }
 weights[i] -= lr * update;
 
 if (Float.isNaN(weights[i]) || Float.isInfinite(weights[i])) {
 weights[i] = 0;
 }
 }

 if (scheduler != null) {
 scheduler.step();
 }
 }

 public void accumulateGradients(float[] gradients, int offset, int length) {
 if (currentGradients == null || currentGradients.length < offset + length) {
 currentGradients = new float[Math.max(currentGradients != null ? currentGradients.length : 0, offset + length)];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
 currentGradients[offset + i] += gradients[offset + i];
 }
 accumulationCount++;
 }

 public float getCurrentLearningRate() {
 if (scheduler != null) {
 return scheduler.getLearningRate();
 }
 return learningRate;
 }

 public void setLearningRate(float learningRate) {
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 }

 public float getBaseLearningRate() {
 return learningRate;
 }

 public float getWeightDecay() {
 return weightDecay;
 }

 public float getBeta1() {
 return beta1;
 }

 public float getBeta2() {
 return beta2;
 }

 public float getEps() {
 return eps;
 }

 public float getGradClip() {
 return gradClip;
 }

 public int getStep() {
 return step;
 }

 public void setStep(int step) {
 this.step = step;
 }

 public int getGradientAccumulationSteps() {
 return gradientAccumulationSteps;
 }

 public void clearCache() {
 mCache.clear();
 vCache.clear();
 }

 public int getCacheSize() {
 return mCache.size();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components.PlasticityUpdateModule;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Advanced Online Learning Manager — 集成EWC + 动态记忆回放的高级在线学习系统
 * 
 * 核心创新集成:
 * 1. EWC弹性权重巩固 — 防止灾难性遗忘
 * 2. 动态记忆回放缓冲区 — 定期巩固旧知识
 * 3. Hebbian + 监督双通道学习
 * 4. 参数重要性感知的自适应学习率
 * 
 * 工作流程:
 * 1. 输入处理 → 特征提取
 * 2. EWC正则化损失计算
 * 3. 记忆回放巩固
 * 4. 自监督学习更新
 * 5. EWC梯度应用（保护重要参数）
 * 6. 记忆更新（存储代表性样本）
 */
public class AdvancedOnlineLearningManager {

 private final SimpCoreModel model;
 private final Optimizer onlineOptimizer;
 private final PlasticityUpdateModule[] plasticEngines;
 
 private final EWCSystem ewcSystem;
 private final MemoryReplayBuffer memoryBuffer;
 
 private final float onlineLr;
 private final float plasticOnlineLr;
 private final int minInputLength;
 private final float maskRatio;
 private final int replayInterval;
 private final int ewcUpdateInterval;
 
 private int totalOnlineSteps;
 private float totalOnlineLoss;
 private int lossCount;
 private float[] recentLosses;
 private int lossIndex;
 
 private boolean learningEnabled;
 private int currentStep;
 private final Random random;
 
 private float[] frozenEmbeddingBackup;
 private boolean ewcInitialized;

 public AdvancedOnlineLearningManager(SimpCoreModel model, float onlineLr, int minInputLength) {
 this(model, onlineLr, minInputLength, 5, 10);
 }

 public AdvancedOnlineLearningManager(SimpCoreModel model, float onlineLr, int minInputLength,
 int replayInterval, int ewcUpdateInterval) {
 this.model = model;
 this.onlineLr = onlineLr;
 this.plasticOnlineLr = onlineLr * 10f;
 this.minInputLength = minInputLength;
 this.maskRatio = 0.15f;
 this.replayInterval = replayInterval;
 this.ewcUpdateInterval = ewcUpdateInterval;
 
 this.onlineOptimizer = new Optimizer(onlineLr, 0.01f, 0.9f, 5.0f);
 this.plasticEngines = model.getSpmLayers();
 
 this.ewcSystem = new EWCSystem(model, 500.0f, 0.001f);
 this.memoryBuffer = new MemoryReplayBuffer(model, 50, 200, 500);
 
 this.totalOnlineSteps = 0;
 this.totalOnlineLoss = 0;
 this.lossCount = 0;
 this.recentLosses = new float[100];
 this.lossIndex = 0;
 this.learningEnabled = true;
 this.currentStep = 0;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 
 this.frozenEmbeddingBackup = new float[model.getEmbeddingWeights().length];
 this.ewcInitialized = false;
 
 System.out.println("[AdvancedOnlineLearning] Initialized | lr=" + onlineLr 
 + " | replay=" + replayInterval + " | ewc=" + ewcUpdateInterval);
 }

 public boolean processInteraction(int[] inputTokens) {
 if (!learningEnabled || inputTokens == null || inputTokens.length < minInputLength) {
 return false;
 }
 
 if (!ewcInitialized) {
 initializeEWC(inputTokens);
 }
 
 float loss = selfSupervisedLearn(inputTokens);
 
 if (currentStep % ewcUpdateInterval == 0) {
 applyEWCProtection();
 }
 
 if (currentStep % replayInterval == 0) {
 performMemoryReplay();
 }
 
 float[] featureVector = extractFeatureVector(inputTokens);
 memoryBuffer.add(inputTokensToFloat(inputTokens), featureVector);
 
 currentStep++;
 totalOnlineSteps++;
 
 return true;
 }

 private void initializeEWC(int[] inputTokens) {
 ewcInitialized = true;
 System.arraycopy(model.getEmbeddingWeights(), 0, frozenEmbeddingBackup, 0, frozenEmbeddingBackup.length);
 
 List<float[]> validationData = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(10, inputTokens.length - 1); i++) {
 float[] sample = new float[2];
 sample[0] = inputTokens[i];
 sample[1] = inputTokens[i + 1];
 validationData.add(sample);
 }
 ewcSystem.initialize(validationData);
 
 System.out.println("[AdvancedOnlineLearning] EWC initialized | Fisher size: " + ewcSystem.getFisherMatrix().size());
 }

 private float selfSupervisedLearn(int[] tokens) {
 int seqLen = Math.min(tokens.length - 1, model.getMaxSeqLen());
 int[] inputIds = Arrays.copyOf(tokens, seqLen);
 int[] targetIds = new int[seqLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 targetIds[i] = tokens[i + 1];
 }
 
 int[] learningMask = new int[seqLen];
 int maskedCount = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 if (random.nextFloat() < maskRatio) {
 learningMask[i] = 1;
 maskedCount++;
 }
 }
 if (maskedCount == 0) {
 learningMask[random.nextInt(seqLen)] = 1;
 maskedCount = 1;
 }
 
 MemoryOptimizer mo = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 
 float[] logits = model.forward(inputIds, 1, seqLen);
 
 float baseLoss = CrossEntropyLoss.computeWithMask(logits, targetIds, learningMask, 1, seqLen, model.getVocabSize());
 
 float ewcLoss = ewcSystem.computeEWCLoss();
 float totalLoss = baseLoss + ewcLoss;
 
 trackLoss(totalLoss);
 
 float[] dLogits = computeMaskedGradients(logits, targetIds, learningMask, seqLen);
 
 performOnlineBackward(dLogits, inputIds, seqLen);
 
 Map<String, float[]> gradMap = new HashMap<>();
 gradMap.put("embed", new float[model.getEmbeddingWeights().length]);
 gradMap.put("output", new float[model.getOutputWeights().length]);
 gradMap.put("ffn1", new float[flatten(model.getFfnWeights1()).length]);
 gradMap.put("ffn2", new float[flatten(model.getFfnWeights2()).length]);
 gradMap.put("ln", new float[flatten(model.getLayerNormWeight()).length]);
 ewcSystem.onlineUpdateFisher(gradMap);
 
 mo.releaseFloatArray(logits);
 mo.releaseFloatArray(dLogits);
 
 return totalLoss;
 }

 private float[] computeMaskedGradients(float[] logits, int[] targets, int[] mask, int seqLen) {
 int vocabSize = model.getVocabSize();
 MemoryOptimizer mo = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] grads = mo.allocateFloatArray(logits.length);
 
 int count = 0;
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 if (mask[s] == 0) continue;
 
 int target = targets[s];
 if (target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;
 
 int logitOffset = s * vocabSize;
 float[] slice = mo.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(logits, logitOffset, slice, 0, vocabSize);
 
 float[] probs = MatrixOperations.softmax(slice);
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 grads[logitOffset + i] = probs[i];
 }
 grads[logitOffset + target] -= 1.0f;
 count++;
 
 mo.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 mo.releaseFloatArray(probs);
 }
 
 if (count > 0) {
 float scale = 1.0f / count;
 for (int i = 0; i < grads.length; i++) {
 grads[i] *= scale;
 }
 }
 
 return grads;
 }

 private void performOnlineBackward(float[] dLogits, int[] inputIds, int seqLen) {
 int nLayers = model.getNLayers();
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 int vocabSize = model.getVocabSize();
 int totalSize = seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer mo = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 
 float[][] layerHiddenStates = new float[nLayers + 1][];
 float[][] mhaOutputs = new float[nLayers][];
 float[][][] componentOutputs = new float[nLayers][][];
 
 float[] initialHidden = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int tokenId = inputIds[s];
 int offset = s * dModel;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 initialHidden[offset + i] = model.getEmbeddingWeights()[tokenId * dModel + i]
 + model.getPosEncoding()[s * dModel + i];
 }
 }
 layerHiddenStates[0] = initialHidden;
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] x = layerHiddenStates[l];
 
 float[] mhaOutput = model.getMhaLayers()[l].forward(x, 1, seqLen);
 mhaOutputs[l] = mhaOutput;
 
 float[] attentionResidual = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) attentionResidual[i] = x[i] + mhaOutput[i];
 
 float[] mhaNorm = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = s * dModel;
 float[] slice = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) slice[j] = attentionResidual[offset + j];
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) mhaNorm[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 
 float[] rfpOut = model.getRfpLayers()[l].forward(mhaNorm, 1, seqLen);
 float[] dmcOut = model.getDmcLayers()[l].forward(rfpOut, 1, seqLen);
 float[] tarOut = model.getTarLayers()[l].forward(dmcOut, 1, seqLen);
 float[] cinOut = model.getCinLayers()[l].forward(tarOut, 1, seqLen);
 float[] ibOut = model.getIbLayers()[l].forward(cinOut, 1, seqLen);
 float[] ffnOut = applyFFN(ibOut, model.getFfnWeights1()[l], model.getFfnWeights2()[l], seqLen);
 float[] mrdOut = model.getMrdLayers()[l].forward(ffnOut, 1, seqLen);
 float[] spmOut = model.getSpmLayers()[l].forward(mrdOut, 1, seqLen);
 
 componentOutputs[l] = new float[][]{mhaNorm, rfpOut, dmcOut, tarOut, cinOut, ibOut, ffnOut, mrdOut, spmOut};
 
 float[] layerOutput = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = s * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) layerInput[j] = mhaNorm[offset + j] + spmOut[offset + j];
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(layerInput, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) layerOutput[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 layerHiddenStates[l + 1] = layerOutput;
 }
 
 float[] dHidden = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 float[] slice = new float[vocabSize];
 System.arraycopy(dLogits, s * vocabSize, slice, 0, vocabSize);
 float[] grad = MatrixOperations.matmul(slice, model.getOutputWeights(), 1, vocabSize, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(grad, 0, dHidden, s * dModel, dModel);
 }
 
 for (int l = nLayers - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
 float[] dNext = mo.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = s * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = layerHiddenStates[l][offset + j] + componentOutputs[l][8][offset + j];
 }
 
 float mean = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) mean += layerInput[j];
 mean /= dModel;
 float var = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) var += (layerInput[j] - mean) * (layerInput[j] - mean);
 var /= dModel;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 
 float[] dNormalized = new float[dModel];
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) dNormalized[j] = dHidden[offset + j] * model.getLayerNormWeight()[l][j];
 
 float dMean = 0, dVar = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dMean -= dNormalized[j] / std;
 dVar += dNormalized[j] * (layerInput[j] - mean) / (2 * std * std * std);
 }
 
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dNext[offset + j] = dNormalized[j] / std + dVar * 2f * (layerInput[j] - mean) / dModel + dMean / dModel;
 }
 }
 
 GradientResult dSPM = model.getSpmLayers()[l].backward(dNext, componentOutputs[l][7], 1, seqLen);
 updatePlasticGradients(model.getSpmLayers()[l], dSPM);
 
 System.arraycopy(dNext, 0, dHidden, 0, totalSize);
 mo.releaseFloatArray(dNext);
 }
 
 updateFFNWeights(dHidden, componentOutputs, seqLen);
 
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getEmbeddingWeights(), "embed");
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getOutputWeights(), "output");
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getFfnWeights1()[l], "ffn1");
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getFfnWeights2()[l], "ffn2");
 }
 }

 private void updateFFNWeights(float[] dHidden, float[][][] componentOutputs, int seqLen) {
 int nLayers = model.getNLayers();
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 int dFFN = dModel * 4;
 
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] w1 = model.getFfnWeights1()[l];
 float[] w2 = model.getFfnWeights2()[l];
 float[] ffnOut = componentOutputs[l][6];
 float[] mhaNorm = componentOutputs[l][0];
 
 float[] gradW1 = new float[w1.length];
 float[] gradW2 = new float[w2.length];
 
 float[] hiddenPreGelu = new float[seqLen * dFFN];
 float[] hiddenPostGelu = new float[seqLen * dFFN];
 
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int inputOffset = s * dModel;
 int hiddenOffset = s * dFFN;
 
 float[] inputSlice = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(mhaNorm, inputOffset, inputSlice, 0, dModel);
 
 float[] preGelu = MatrixOperations.matmul(inputSlice, w1, 1, dModel, dFFN);
 System.arraycopy(preGelu, 0, hiddenPreGelu, hiddenOffset, dFFN);
 
 for (int j = 0; j < dFFN; j++) {
 hiddenPostGelu[hiddenOffset + j] = gelu(preGelu[j]);
 }
 }
 
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int inputOffset = s * dModel;
 int hiddenOffset = s * dFFN;
 int dOffset = s * dModel;
 
 float[] dOut = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(dHidden, dOffset, dOut, 0, dModel);
 
 float[] hiddenSlice = new float[dFFN];
 System.arraycopy(hiddenPostGelu, hiddenOffset, hiddenSlice, 0, dFFN);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dFFN; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gradW2[i * dModel + j] += hiddenSlice[i] * dOut[j];
 }
 }
 
 float[] dHiddenBeforeGelu = MatrixOperations.matmul(dOut, w2, 1, dModel, dFFN);
 
 float[] inputSlice = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(mhaNorm, inputOffset, inputSlice, 0, dModel);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dFFN; j++) {
 float geluDeriv = geluDerivative(hiddenPreGelu[hiddenOffset + j]);
 gradW1[i * dFFN + j] += inputSlice[i] * dHiddenBeforeGelu[j] * geluDeriv;
 }
 }
 }
 
 float scale = onlineLr / seqLen;
 for (int i = 0; i < w1.length && i < gradW1.length; i++) {
 w1[i] -= scale * gradW1[i];
 }
 for (int i = 0; i < w2.length && i < gradW2.length; i++) {
 w2[i] -= scale * gradW2[i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 private float gelu(float x) {
 return x * 0.5f * (1.0f + (float) Math.tanh(Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI) * (x + 0.044715 * x * x * x)));
 }
 
 private float geluDerivative(float x) {
 float sqrt2pi = (float) Math.sqrt(2.0 / Math.PI);
 float tanhArg = sqrt2pi * (x + 0.044715f * x * x * x);
 float tanhOut = (float) Math.tanh(tanhArg);
 float derivative = 0.5f * (1.0f + tanhOut) 
 + 0.5f * x * (1.0f - tanhOut * tanhOut) 
 * sqrt2pi * (1.0f + 0.134145f * x * x);
 return derivative;
 }

 private void applyEWCProtection() {
 if (!ewcInitialized) return;
 
 float ewcLoss = ewcSystem.computeEWCLoss();
 if (ewcLoss > 0.1f) {
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getEmbeddingWeights(), "embed");
 ewcSystem.applyEWCGradient(model.getOutputWeights(), "output");
 }
 }

 private void performMemoryReplay() {
 if (memoryBuffer.getTotalSize() < 5) return;
 
 List<float[]> replayBatch = memoryBuffer.getReplayBatch(3);
 if (replayBatch.isEmpty()) return;
 
 float totalReplayLoss = 0;
 for (float[] sample : replayBatch) {
 int[] tokens = floatToInputTokens(sample);
 if (tokens.length >= minInputLength) {
 float loss = selfSupervisedLearn(tokens);
 totalReplayLoss += loss;
 }
 }
 
 memoryBuffer.cleanup();
 }

 private float[] extractFeatureVector(int[] tokens) {
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 int seqLen = Math.min(tokens.length, model.getMaxSeqLen());
 float[] features = new float[dModel];
 
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int tokenId = tokens[s];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 features[i] += model.getEmbeddingWeights()[tokenId * dModel + i];
 }
 }
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float f : features) norm += f * f;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 if (norm > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) features[i] /= norm;
 }
 
 return features;
 }

 private float[] inputTokensToFloat(int[] tokens) {
 float[] result = new float[tokens.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
 result[i] = tokens[i];
 }
 return result;
 }

 private int[] floatToInputTokens(float[] floats) {
 int[] result = new int[floats.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < floats.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (int) floats[i];
 }
 return result;
 }

 private float[] applyFFN(float[] x, float[] w1, float[] w2, int seqLen) {
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 float[] result = new float[seqLen * dModel];
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = s * dModel;
 float[] row = new float[dModel];
 System.arraycopy(x, offset, row, 0, dModel);
 float[] hidden = MatrixOperations.matmul(row, w1, 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int i = 0; i < hidden.length; i++) {
 hidden[i] = Math.max(0, hidden[i]);
 }
 float[] out = MatrixOperations.matmul(hidden, w2, 1, dModel * 4, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(out, 0, result, offset, dModel);
 }
 return result;
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x, int layerIdx) {
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 float mean = 0;
 for (float f : x) mean += f;
 mean /= dModel;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (float f : x) var += (f - mean) * (f - mean);
 var /= dModel;
 
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5f);
 
 float[] result = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 result[i] = (x[i] - mean) / std * model.getLayerNormWeight()[layerIdx][i];
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 private void updatePlasticGradients(PlasticityUpdateModule engine, GradientResult grad) {
 float[][] weights = engine.getWeights();
 float[] dWeights = grad.getGradient("weights");
 if (dWeights != null) {
 int idx = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length && idx < dWeights.length; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < weights[i].length && idx < dWeights.length; j++) {
 weights[i][j] -= plasticOnlineLr * dWeights[idx++];
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private void trackLoss(float loss) {
 totalOnlineLoss += loss;
 lossCount++;
 recentLosses[lossIndex] = loss;
 lossIndex = (lossIndex + 1) % recentLosses.length;
 }
 
 private float[] flatten(float[][] matrix) {
 int size = 0;
 for (float[] row : matrix) size += row.length;
 float[] result = new float[size];
 int idx = 0;
 for (float[] row : matrix) {
 System.arraycopy(row, 0, result, idx, row.length);
 idx += row.length;
 }
 return result;
 }

 public float getAverageLoss() {
 return lossCount > 0 ? totalOnlineLoss / lossCount : Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }

 public float getRecentLoss() {
 int count = Math.min(lossCount, recentLosses.length);
 float sum = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) sum += recentLosses[i];
 return count > 0 ? sum / count : Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }

 public int getTotalOnlineSteps() { return totalOnlineSteps; }
 public boolean isLearningEnabled() { return learningEnabled; }
 public void setLearningEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.learningEnabled = enabled; }
 public EWCSystem getEwcSystem() { return ewcSystem; }
 public MemoryReplayBuffer getMemoryBuffer() { return memoryBuffer; }
 
 public String getStatistics() {
 return String.format(
 "AdvancedOnlineLearning[steps=%d, avgLoss=%.4f, recentLoss=%.4f, ewc=%s, memory=%s]",
 totalOnlineSteps, getAverageLoss(), getRecentLoss(),
 ewcSystem.isInitialized() ? "initialized" : "not initialized",
 memoryBuffer.getStatistics()
 );
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;

import java.io.PrintWriter;

public class AdvancedOnlineLearningTest {

 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 PrintWriter log = new PrintWriter(System.out, true);
 
 log.println("=== Advanced Online Learning System Test ===");
 log.println();
 
 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(128);
 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(128, 64, 2, 1, 4, 1, 1, 1, 32);
 
 AdvancedOnlineLearningManager manager = new AdvancedOnlineLearningManager(model, 5e-5f, 4, 5, 10);
 
 log.println("Model: D_MODEL=64, N_LAYERS=2, N_HEADS=4");
 log.println("Online LR: 5e-5");
 log.println("Replay interval: 5");
 log.println("EWC update interval: 10");
 log.println();
 
 String[] testData = {
 "hello world this is a test",
 "deep learning is amazing",
 "AI changes everything",
 "the quick brown fox jumps",
 "i love machine learning",
 "natural language processing",
 "transformer architecture",
 "attention is all you need",
 "neural networks are powerful",
 "reinforcement learning is cool"
 };
 
 log.println("[Phase 1] Base Training (30 steps)");
 log.println("----------------------------------");
 TrainingLoop loop = new TrainingLoop(model, tokenizer, new Optimizer(0.001f, 0.01f, 0.9f, Float.MAX_VALUE));
 
 for (int step = 1; step <= 30; step++) {
 String input = testData[(step - 1) % testData.length];
 float loss = loop.trainStep(input, 1);
 
 if (step % 10 == 0) {
 log.printf(" Step %d: loss=%.4f%n", step, loss);
 }
 }
 
 log.println();
 log.println("[Phase 2] Advanced Online Learning (40 steps)");
 log.println("---------------------------------------------");
 
 for (int step = 1; step <= 40; step++) {
 String input = testData[(step - 1) % testData.length];
 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(input);
 
 boolean learned = manager.processInteraction(tokens);
 
 if (step % 5 == 0) {
 log.printf(" Step %d: avgLoss=%.4f, recentLoss=%.4f, ewc=%s, memory=%s%n",
 step, manager.getAverageLoss(), manager.getRecentLoss(),
 manager.getEwcSystem().isInitialized() ? "ON" : "OFF",
 manager.getMemoryBuffer().getTotalSize());
 }
 }
 
 log.println();
 log.println("[Phase 3] Generation Test");
 log.println("-------------------------");
 
 String prompt = "hello";
 int[] promptTokens = tokenizer.encode(prompt);
 int[] generatedTokens = model.generate(promptTokens, 10, 0);
 String generated = tokenizer.decode(generatedTokens);
 
 log.printf(" Prompt: \"%s\"%n", prompt);
 log.printf(" Generated: \"%s\"%n", generated);
 
 log.println();
 log.println("[Phase 4] EWC Protection Check");
 log.println("------------------------------");
 
 if (manager.getEwcSystem().isInitialized()) {
 log.printf(" EWC initialized: YES%n");
 log.printf(" Fisher matrix size: %d%n", manager.getEwcSystem().getFisherMatrix().size());
 log.printf(" Samples for Fisher: %d%n", manager.getEwcSystem().getSamplesForFisher());
 log.printf(" Top 5 important params: %s%n", manager.getEwcSystem().getImportantParams(5));
 } else {
 log.println(" EWC initialized: NO");
 }
 
 log.println();
 log.println("[Phase 5] Memory Buffer Statistics");
 log.println("----------------------------------");
 log.println(" " + manager.getMemoryBuffer().getStatistics());
 
 log.println();
 log.println("=== Test Complete ===");
 log.println(manager.getStatistics());
 
 log.close();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd.Tensor;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed.CommunicationLayer;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

public class AsyncCheckpointer {
 
 private static final int MAGIC_NUMBER = 0x53433031;
 private static final int VERSION = 1;
 private static final int MAX_CHECKPOINTS = 10;
 
 private final String checkpointDir;
 private final int rank;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final CommunicationLayer comm;
 
 private final ExecutorService checkpointPool;
 private final ExecutorService restorePool;
 
 private final AtomicLong checkpointId = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final ReentrantLock checkpointLock = new ReentrantLock();
 private final ReentrantLock restoreLock = new ReentrantLock();
 
 private final Queue<Long> checkpointHistory = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
 
 private final boolean useIncrementalCheckpointing;
 private final boolean useCompression;
 private long lastCheckpointHash;
 
 private final AtomicLong totalBytesWritten = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalCheckpoints = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 public AsyncCheckpointer(String checkpointDir, int rank, int worldSize, CommunicationLayer comm) {
 this(checkpointDir, rank, worldSize, comm, false, false);
 }
 
 public AsyncCheckpointer(String checkpointDir, int rank, int worldSize, CommunicationLayer comm,
 boolean useIncrementalCheckpointing, boolean useCompression) {
 this.checkpointDir = checkpointDir;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.comm = comm;
 this.useIncrementalCheckpointing = useIncrementalCheckpointing;
 this.useCompression = useCompression;
 this.lastCheckpointHash = 0;
 
 File dir = new File(checkpointDir);
 if (!dir.exists()) {
 dir.mkdirs();
 }
 
 this.checkpointPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2,
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("ckpt-save-"));
 this.restorePool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2,
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("ckpt-restore-"));
 
 loadCheckpointId();
 }
 
 private void loadCheckpointId() {
 File[] files = new File(checkpointDir).listFiles((d, name) -> 
 name.startsWith("checkpoint_") && name.endsWith("_rank_" + rank + ".bin"));
 if (files != null) {
 long maxId = 0;
 for (File f : files) {
 try {
 String[] parts = f.getName().split("_");
 long id = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
 if (id > maxId) maxId = id;
 } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
 }
 checkpointId.set(maxId);
 }
 }
 
 public Future<CheckpointResult> saveAsync(List<Tensor> parameters, int epoch, int step) {
 return checkpointPool.submit(() -> {
 checkpointLock.lock();
 try {
 long id = checkpointId.incrementAndGet();
 String filename = String.format("checkpoint_%d_epoch_%d_step_%d_rank_%d.bin", 
 id, epoch, step, rank);
 String path = checkpointDir + File.separator + filename;
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 long bytesWritten;
 
 List<Tensor> paramsToSave = parameters;
 List<Integer> changedIndices = null;
 
 if (useIncrementalCheckpointing && lastCheckpointHash != 0) {
 changedIndices = computeChangedIndices(parameters);
 if (changedIndices.isEmpty()) {
 return new CheckpointResult(id, epoch, step, path, 0);
 }
 }
 
 bytesWritten = writeCheckpoint(path, id, epoch, step, paramsToSave, changedIndices);
 
 long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 long duration = endTime - startTime;
 
 totalBytesWritten.addAndGet(bytesWritten);
 totalCheckpoints.incrementAndGet();
 
 lastCheckpointHash = computeParamsHash(parameters);
 checkpointHistory.add(id);
 
 cleanupOldCheckpoints();
 
 if (comm != null && worldSize > 1) {
 comm.barrier();
 }
 
 if (rank == 0) {
 saveMetadata(id, epoch, step, paramsToSave.size(), duration, bytesWritten);
 }
 
 return new CheckpointResult(id, epoch, step, path, duration);
 
 } finally {
 checkpointLock.unlock();
 }
 });
 }
 
 private long writeCheckpoint(String path, long id, int epoch, int step,
 List<Tensor> parameters, List<Integer> changedIndices) throws IOException {
 long bytesWritten = 0;
 
 try (FileChannel channel = new FileOutputStream(path).getChannel()) {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(32);
 header.putInt(MAGIC_NUMBER);
 header.putInt(VERSION);
 header.putLong(id);
 header.putInt(epoch);
 header.putInt(step);
 header.putInt(parameters.size());
 header.flip();
 bytesWritten += channel.write(header);
 
 OutputStream os = Channels.newOutputStream(channel);
 if (useCompression) {
 os = new GZIPOutputStream(os, 65536);
 }
 
 DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(os, 65536));
 
 for (Tensor param : parameters) {
 dos.writeInt(param.shape.length);
 for (int dim : param.shape) {
 dos.writeInt(dim);
 }
 dos.writeInt(param.numel);
 
 byte[] floatBytes = new byte[param.numel * 4];
 ByteBuffer.wrap(floatBytes).asFloatBuffer().put(param.data);
 dos.write(floatBytes);
 bytesWritten += 4 + param.shape.length * 4 + 4 + param.numel * 4;
 }
 
 dos.flush();
 if (os instanceof GZIPOutputStream) {
 ((GZIPOutputStream) os).finish();
 }
 
 long checksum = computeParamsHash(parameters);
 ByteBuffer footer = ByteBuffer.allocate(8);
 footer.putLong(checksum);
 footer.flip();
 bytesWritten += channel.write(footer);
 }
 
 return bytesWritten;
 }
 
 private List<Integer> computeChangedIndices(List<Tensor> parameters) {
 List<Integer> changed = new ArrayList<>();
 long currentHash = computeParamsHash(parameters);
 
 if (currentHash != lastCheckpointHash) {
 for (int i = 0; i < parameters.size(); i++) {
 changed.add(i);
 }
 }
 return changed;
 }
 
 private long computeParamsHash(List<Tensor> parameters) {
 CRC32 crc = new CRC32();
 for (Tensor param : parameters) {
 byte[] bytes = new byte[param.numel * 4];
 ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).asFloatBuffer().put(param.data);
 crc.update(bytes);
 }
 return crc.getValue();
 }
 
 public Future<List<Tensor>> restoreAsync(long checkpointId) {
 return restorePool.submit(() -> {
 restoreLock.lock();
 try {
 String path = findCheckpointPath(checkpointId);
 if (path == null) {
 throw new FileNotFoundException("Checkpoint " + checkpointId + " not found for rank " + rank);
 }
 
 List<Tensor> parameters = new ArrayList<>();
 long storedChecksum = 0;
 
 try (FileChannel channel = new FileInputStream(path).getChannel()) {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(32);
 channel.read(header);
 header.flip();
 
 int magic = header.getInt();
 int version = header.getInt();
 
 if (magic != MAGIC_NUMBER) {
 throw new IOException("Invalid checkpoint file: bad magic number");
 }
 if (version != VERSION) {
 throw new IOException("Unsupported checkpoint version: " + version);
 }
 
 long id = header.getLong();
 int epoch = header.getInt();
 int step = header.getInt();
 int numParams = header.getInt();
 
 InputStream is = Channels.newInputStream(channel);
 if (useCompression) {
 is = new GZIPInputStream(is, 65536);
 }
 DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(is, 65536));
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numParams; i++) {
 int ndim = dis.readInt();
 int[] shape = new int[ndim];
 for (int j = 0; j < ndim; j++) {
 shape[j] = dis.readInt();
 }
 int numel = dis.readInt();
 
 byte[] floatBytes = new byte[numel * 4];
 dis.readFully(floatBytes);
 
 float[] data = new float[numel];
 ByteBuffer.wrap(floatBytes).asFloatBuffer().get(data);
 
 parameters.add(new Tensor(data, shape));
 }
 
 ByteBuffer footer = ByteBuffer.allocate(8);
 channel.read(footer);
 footer.flip();
 storedChecksum = footer.getLong();
 }
 
 long computedChecksum = computeParamsHash(parameters);
 if (storedChecksum != computedChecksum) {
 throw new IOException("Checkpoint checksum mismatch: stored=" + storedChecksum 
 + ", computed=" + computedChecksum);
 }
 
 lastCheckpointHash = storedChecksum;
 
 if (comm != null && worldSize > 1) {
 comm.barrier();
 }
 
 return parameters;
 
 } finally {
 restoreLock.unlock();
 }
 });
 }
 
 private String findCheckpointPath(long checkpointId) {
 File dir = new File(checkpointDir);
 File[] files = dir.listFiles((d, name) -> 
 name.startsWith("checkpoint_" + checkpointId + "_") && 
 name.endsWith("_rank_" + rank + ".bin"));
 
 if (files != null && files.length > 0) {
 return files[0].getAbsolutePath();
 }
 return null;
 }
 
 private void saveMetadata(long id, int epoch, int step, int numParams, 
 long duration, long bytesWritten) {
 String metadataPath = checkpointDir + File.separator + "metadata.json";
 
 try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(metadataPath, true))) {
 writer.write(String.format(
 "{\"id\":%d,\"epoch\":%d,\"step\":%d,\"numParams\":%d,\"duration\":%d,\"bytes\":%d,\"timestamp\":%d}\n",
 id, epoch, step, numParams, duration, bytesWritten, System.currentTimeMillis()));
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[CKPT] Failed to save metadata: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 public List<CheckpointInfo> listCheckpoints() {
 List<CheckpointInfo> checkpoints = new ArrayList<>();
 File dir = new File(checkpointDir);
 
 if (!dir.exists()) {
 return checkpoints;
 }
 
 File[] files = dir.listFiles((d, name) -> 
 name.startsWith("checkpoint_") && name.endsWith("_rank_0.bin"));
 if (files == null) {
 return checkpoints;
 }
 
 Arrays.sort(files, (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.lastModified(), a.lastModified()));
 
 for (File file : files) {
 String name = file.getName();
 try {
 String[] parts = name.split("_");
 long id = Long.parseLong(parts[1]);
 int epoch = Integer.parseInt(parts[3]);
 int step = Integer.parseInt(parts[5]);
 
 checkpoints.add(new CheckpointInfo(id, epoch, step, file.lastModified(), file.length()));
 } catch (NumberFormatException | ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
 continue;
 }
 }
 
 return checkpoints;
 }
 
 public CheckpointInfo getLatestCheckpoint() {
 List<CheckpointInfo> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 return checkpoints.isEmpty() ? null : checkpoints.get(0);
 }
 
 public void cleanupOldCheckpoints() {
 List<CheckpointInfo> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 
 if (checkpoints.size() <= MAX_CHECKPOINTS) {
 return;
 }
 
 for (int i = MAX_CHECKPOINTS; i < checkpoints.size(); i++) {
 CheckpointInfo info = checkpoints.get(i);
 
 for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; r++) {
 final int rankNum = r;
 File dir = new File(checkpointDir);
 File[] files = dir.listFiles((d, name) -> 
 name.startsWith("checkpoint_" + info.id + "_") && 
 name.endsWith("_rank_" + rankNum + ".bin"));
 
 if (files != null) {
 for (File f : files) {
 f.delete();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getStats() {
 Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 stats.put("totalCheckpoints", totalCheckpoints.get());
 stats.put("totalBytesWritten", totalBytesWritten.get());
 stats.put("currentCheckpointId", checkpointId.get());
 stats.put("incrementalCheckpointing", useIncrementalCheckpointing);
 stats.put("compression", useCompression);
 return stats;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 checkpointPool.shutdown();
 restorePool.shutdown();
 
 try {
 checkpointPool.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 restorePool.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 
 public static class CheckpointResult {
 public final long id;
 public final int epoch;
 public final int step;
 public final String path;
 public final long durationMs;
 
 public CheckpointResult(long id, int epoch, int step, String path, long durationMs) {
 this.id = id;
 this.epoch = epoch;
 this.step = step;
 this.path = path;
 this.durationMs = durationMs;
 }
 }
 
 public static class CheckpointInfo {
 public final long id;
 public final int epoch;
 public final int step;
 public final long timestamp;
 public final long sizeBytes;
 
 public CheckpointInfo(long id, int epoch, int step, long timestamp, long sizeBytes) {
 this.id = id;
 this.epoch = epoch;
 this.step = step;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.sizeBytes = sizeBytes;
 }
 }
 
 private static class ThreadFactoryBuilder implements ThreadFactory {
 private final String prefix;
 private final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 ThreadFactoryBuilder(String prefix) {
 this.prefix = prefix;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Thread newThread(Runnable r) {
 Thread t = new Thread(r, prefix + counter.incrementAndGet());
 t.setDaemon(true);
 return t;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUMatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import org.jocl.*;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.MappedByteBuffer;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;

import static org.jocl.CL.*;

/**
 * CPU卸载引擎 —— 实现ZeRO-1 + CPU Offloading混合策略
 * 
 * 核心策略：
 * 1. 模型参数：GPU ↔ CPU 按需传输（使用CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR零拷贝）
 * 2. 梯度：累积在CPU内存，量化压缩后传输到GPU
 * 3. 优化器状态（Adam的m/v）：完全驻留CPU，仅更新时同步到GPU
 * 4. 利用AMD APU统一内存特性，通过CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR实现零拷贝
 */
public class CPUOffloadEngine {

 private static final int OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE = 1024 * 1024; // 1M elements per block
 private static final float COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD = 1e-6f;
 
 private final boolean useUnifiedMemory;
 private final int deviceId;
 private final cl_context context;
 private final cl_command_queue queue;
 
 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, ParameterBlock[]> parameterBlocks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 private final AtomicLong totalParameters = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong gpuMemoryUsed = new AtomicLong(0);
 
 private long maxGPUMemory;
 private boolean enableCompression;
 private boolean enableAsyncTransfer;
 
 private Path swapDirectory;
 private boolean useDiskSwap;
 
 public CPUOffloadEngine() {
 this.deviceId = GPUMatrixOperations.getCurrentDevice();
 this.context = GPUMatrixOperations.getContext();
 this.queue = GPUMatrixOperations.getCommandQueue(deviceId);
 this.useUnifiedMemory = true;
 this.enableCompression = false;
 this.enableAsyncTransfer = true;
 this.useDiskSwap = false;
 
 long[] globalMem = new long[1];
 clGetDeviceInfo(GPUMatrixOperations.getDeviceId(deviceId), 
 CL_DEVICE_GLOBAL_MEM_SIZE, Sizeof.cl_long, Pointer.to(globalMem), null);
 this.maxGPUMemory = (long)(globalMem[0] * 0.8);
 
 System.out.println("[CPUOffload] Initialized. Max GPU memory: " + 
 (maxGPUMemory / (1024 * 1024)) + " MB");
 System.out.println("[CPUOffload] Unified memory: " + (useUnifiedMemory ? "enabled" : "disabled"));
 }
 
 public void setSwapDirectory(String path) {
 try {
 this.swapDirectory = Files.createTempDirectory("simpcore_swap_");
 this.useDiskSwap = true;
 System.out.println("[CPUOffload] Swap directory: " + swapDirectory);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[CPUOffload] Failed to create swap directory: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 public void enableCompression(boolean enable) {
 this.enableCompression = enable;
 }
 
 public void setMaxGPUMemory(long bytes) {
 this.maxGPUMemory = bytes;
 }
 
 /**
 * 注册一个参数张量并进行CPU卸载配置
 * @param paramName 参数名称
 * @param paramData 参数数据（CPU驻留）
 * @param numElements 参数元素数量
 */
 public void registerParameter(String paramName, float[] paramData, long numElements) {
 int numBlocks = (int)((numElements + OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE);
 ParameterBlock[] blocks = new ParameterBlock[numBlocks];
 
 long paramSizeBytes = numElements * 4;
 long gpuBudget = maxGPUMemory / 4; // 最多1/4 GPU内存用于参数
 
 for (int b = 0; b < numBlocks; b++) {
 int start = b * OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE;
 int end = (int)Math.min(start + OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE, numElements);
 int blockSize = end - start;
 
 boolean gpuResident = (b * blockSize * 4) < gpuBudget;
 
 ParameterBlock block = new ParameterBlock();
 block.name = paramName;
 block.blockIndex = b;
 block.start = start;
 block.size = blockSize;
 block.cpuData = paramData;
 block.cpuOffset = start;
 block.gpuResident = gpuResident;
 block.dirty = false;
 
 if (gpuResident && useUnifiedMemory) {
 block.gpuBuffer = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * blockSize, 
 Pointer.to(paramData).withByteOffset(start * 4), null);
 gpuMemoryUsed.addAndGet(blockSize * 4L);
 }
 
 blocks[b] = block;
 }
 
 parameterBlocks.put(paramName, blocks);
 totalParameters.addAndGet(numElements);
 
 System.out.println("[CPUOffload] Registered param '" + paramName + "': " + 
 numElements + " elements, " + numBlocks + " blocks");
 }
 
 /**
 * 注册优化器状态（m/v）—— 始终驻留CPU
 */
 public OptimizerState registerOptimizerState(String paramName, float[] m, float[] v) {
 OptimizerState state = new OptimizerState();
 state.m = m;
 state.v = v;
 state.paramName = paramName;
 state.deviceId = deviceId;
 state.queue = queue;
 state.context = context;
 
 if (useDiskSwap && m.length > OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE * 10) {
 try {
 state.swapFile = Files.createTempFile(swapDirectory, paramName + "_opt_", ".swap");
 state.useSwap = true;
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[CPUOffload] Failed to create swap for optimizer state: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 return state;
 }
 
 /**
 * 确保参数块在GPU上，必要时从CPU传输
 */
 public cl_mem ensureOnGPU(String paramName, int elementOffset, int numElements) {
 ParameterBlock[] blocks = parameterBlocks.get(paramName);
 if (blocks == null) return null;
 
 int startBlock = elementOffset / OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE;
 int endBlock = (elementOffset + numElements - 1) / OFFLOAD_BLOCK_SIZE;
 
 for (int b = startBlock; b <= endBlock && b < blocks.length; b++) {
 ParameterBlock block = blocks[b];
 if (!block.gpuResident) {
 evictBlock(findEvictionCandidate());
 transferToGPU(block);
 } else if (block.dirty && block.gpuBuffer == null) {
 transferToGPU(block);
 }
 }
 
 ParameterBlock firstBlock = blocks[startBlock];
 if (firstBlock.gpuBuffer != null) {
 return firstBlock.gpuBuffer;
 }
 return null;
 }
 
 /**
 * 从CPU传输参数块到GPU
 */
 private void transferToGPU(ParameterBlock block) {
 if (block.gpuBuffer != null) {
 clReleaseMemObject(block.gpuBuffer);
 }
 
 block.gpuBuffer = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_COPY_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * block.size,
 Pointer.to(block.cpuData).withByteOffset(block.cpuOffset * 4), null);
 block.gpuResident = true;
 block.dirty = false;
 gpuMemoryUsed.addAndGet(block.size * 4L);
 }
 
 /**
 * 从GPU回传参数块到CPU
 */
 public void syncToCPU(String paramName) {
 ParameterBlock[] blocks = parameterBlocks.get(paramName);
 if (blocks == null) return;
 
 for (ParameterBlock block : blocks) {
 if (block.gpuResident && block.gpuBuffer != null && block.dirty) {
 clEnqueueReadBuffer(queue, block.gpuBuffer, CL_TRUE, 0,
 Sizeof.cl_float * block.size,
 Pointer.to(block.cpuData).withByteOffset(block.cpuOffset * 4),
 0, null, null);
 block.dirty = false;
 }
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 将所有参数同步回CPU
 */
 public void syncAllToCPU() {
 for (String paramName : parameterBlocks.keySet()) {
 syncToCPU(paramName);
 }
 clFinish(queue);
 }
 
 /**
 * 查找可驱逐的块
 */
 private ParameterBlock findEvictionCandidate() {
 ParameterBlock candidate = null;
 for (ParameterBlock[] blocks : parameterBlocks.values()) {
 for (ParameterBlock block : blocks) {
 if (!block.gpuResident) continue;
 if (candidate == null || block.lastAccessTime < candidate.lastAccessTime) {
 candidate = block;
 }
 }
 }
 return candidate;
 }
 
 /**
 * 驱逐GPU块到CPU
 */
 private void evictBlock(ParameterBlock block) {
 if (block == null || !block.gpuResident || block.gpuBuffer == null) return;
 
 if (block.dirty) {
 clEnqueueReadBuffer(queue, block.gpuBuffer, CL_TRUE, 0,
 Sizeof.cl_float * block.size,
 Pointer.to(block.cpuData).withByteOffset(block.cpuOffset * 4),
 0, null, null);
 }
 
 clReleaseMemObject(block.gpuBuffer);
 block.gpuBuffer = null;
 block.gpuResident = false;
 block.dirty = false;
 gpuMemoryUsed.addAndGet(-block.size * 4L);
 }
 
 /**
 * 使用ZeRO-1优化器更新（优化器状态驻留CPU）
 * @param weights 模型参数
 * @param gradients 梯度
 * @param m Adam一阶矩
 * @param v Adam二阶矩
 * @param lr 学习率
 * @param weightDecay 权重衰减
 * @param beta1 Adam beta1
 * @param beta2 Adam beta2
 * @param eps Adam eps
 * @param step 当前步数
 */
 public void zeroOffloadUpdate(float[] weights, float[] gradients, 
 float[] m, float[] v,
 float lr, float weightDecay,
 float beta1, float beta2, float eps, int step) {
 float biasCorrection1 = 1.0f - (float)Math.pow(beta1, step);
 float biasCorrection2 = 1.0f - (float)Math.pow(beta2, step);
 float correctedLr = lr * (float)Math.sqrt(biasCorrection2) / biasCorrection1;
 
 int blockSize = 256 * 1024; // 256K elements per batch
 
 if (GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable() && useUnifiedMemory) {
 zeroOffloadUpdateGPU(weights, gradients, m, v, 
 correctedLr, weightDecay, beta1, beta2, eps, blockSize);
 } else {
 zeroOffloadUpdateCPU(weights, gradients, m, v, 
 correctedLr, weightDecay, beta1, beta2, eps);
 }
 }
 
 private void zeroOffloadUpdateCPU(float[] weights, float[] gradients,
 float[] m, float[] v,
 float lr, float weightDecay,
 float beta1, float beta2, float eps) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 float grad = gradients[i];
 
 if (Float.isNaN(grad) || Float.isInfinite(grad)) {
 grad = 0;
 }
 
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1.0f - beta1) * grad;
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1.0f - beta2) * grad * grad;
 
 float denom = (float)Math.sqrt(v[i]) + eps;
 float update = lr * m[i] / denom;
 
 weights[i] -= update;
 
 if (weightDecay > 0) {
 weights[i] -= lr * weightDecay * weights[i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 private cl_kernel cachedZeroAdamKernel;
 private cl_program cachedZeroAdamProgram;
 
 private void ensureZeroAdamKernel() {
 if (cachedZeroAdamKernel != null) return;
 String kernelSource = 
 "__kernel void zero_adam_update(" +
 " __global float* w, __global const float* g," +
 " __global float* m, __global float* v," +
 " float lr, float wd, float b1, float b2, float eps_val, int len) {" +
 " int i = get_global_id(0);" +
 " if (i >= len) return;" +
 " float grad = g[i];" +
 " if (!isnan(grad) && !isinf(grad)) {" +
 " m[i] = b1 * m[i] + (1.0f - b1) * grad;" +
 " v[i] = b2 * v[i] + (1.0f - b2) * grad * grad;" +
 " float denom = sqrt(v[i]) + eps_val;" +
 " w[i] -= lr * m[i] / denom;" +
 " if (wd > 0.0f) w[i] -= lr * wd * w[i];" +
 " }" +
 "}";
 cachedZeroAdamProgram = clCreateProgramWithSource(context, 1, 
 new String[]{kernelSource}, null, null);
 clBuildProgram(cachedZeroAdamProgram, 0, null, null, null, null);
 cachedZeroAdamKernel = clCreateKernel(cachedZeroAdamProgram, "zero_adam_update", null);
 }

 private void zeroOffloadUpdateGPU(float[] weights, float[] gradients,
 float[] m, float[] v,
 float lr, float weightDecay,
 float beta1, float beta2, float eps,
 int blockSize) {
 ensureZeroAdamKernel();
 if (cachedZeroAdamKernel == null) {
 zeroOffloadUpdateCPU(weights, gradients, m, v, lr, weightDecay, beta1, beta2, eps);
 return;
 }
 
 int numBlocks = (weights.length + blockSize - 1) / blockSize;
 
 for (int b = 0; b < numBlocks; b++) {
 int start = b * blockSize;
 int end = Math.min(start + blockSize, weights.length);
 int size = end - start;
 
 cl_mem d_weights = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * size, 
 Pointer.to(weights).withByteOffset(start * 4), null);
 cl_mem d_grad = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_ONLY | CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * size, 
 Pointer.to(gradients).withByteOffset(start * 4), null);
 cl_mem d_m = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * size, 
 Pointer.to(m).withByteOffset(start * 4), null);
 cl_mem d_v = clCreateBuffer(context, 
 CL_MEM_READ_WRITE | CL_MEM_USE_HOST_PTR,
 Sizeof.cl_float * size, 
 Pointer.to(v).withByteOffset(start * 4), null);
 
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 0, Sizeof.cl_mem, Pointer.to(d_weights));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 1, Sizeof.cl_mem, Pointer.to(d_grad));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 2, Sizeof.cl_mem, Pointer.to(d_m));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 3, Sizeof.cl_mem, Pointer.to(d_v));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 4, Sizeof.cl_float, Pointer.to(new float[]{lr}));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 5, Sizeof.cl_float, Pointer.to(new float[]{weightDecay}));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 6, Sizeof.cl_float, Pointer.to(new float[]{beta1}));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 7, Sizeof.cl_float, Pointer.to(new float[]{beta2}));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 8, Sizeof.cl_float, Pointer.to(new float[]{eps}));
 clSetKernelArg(cachedZeroAdamKernel, 9, Sizeof.cl_int, Pointer.to(new int[]{size}));
 
 long[] globalWorkSize = new long[]{((size + 255) / 256) * 256};
 long[] localWorkSize = new long[]{256};
 clEnqueueNDRangeKernel(queue, cachedZeroAdamKernel, 1, null, globalWorkSize, localWorkSize, 
 0, null, null);
 
 clEnqueueReadBuffer(queue, d_weights, CL_TRUE, 0,
 Sizeof.cl_float * size,
 Pointer.to(weights).withByteOffset(start * 4), 0, null, null);
 
 clReleaseMemObject(d_weights);
 clReleaseMemObject(d_grad);
 clReleaseMemObject(d_m);
 clReleaseMemObject(d_v);
 }
 }
 
 /**
 * 梯度压缩（Top-k稀疏化）
 */
 public float[] compressGradients(float[] gradients, float compressionRatio) {
 if (!enableCompression || compressionRatio >= 1.0f) {
 return gradients;
 }
 
 int k = Math.max(1, (int)(gradients.length * compressionRatio));
 
 float[][] topK = new float[2][k];
 float[] values = new float[k];
 int[] indices = new int[k];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 values[i] = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 indices[i] = -1;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 float abs = Math.abs(gradients[i]);
 if (abs > values[0]) {
 values[0] = abs;
 indices[0] = i;
 for (int j = 0; j < k - 1 && values[j] > values[j + 1]; j++) {
 float tmpVal = values[j];
 values[j] = values[j + 1];
 values[j + 1] = tmpVal;
 int tmpIdx = indices[j];
 indices[j] = indices[j + 1];
 indices[j + 1] = tmpIdx;
 }
 }
 }
 
 float[] compressed = new float[gradients.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 if (indices[i] >= 0) {
 compressed[indices[i]] = gradients[indices[i]];
 }
 }
 
 return compressed;
 }
 
 /**
 * 获取GPU内存使用统计
 */
 public String getMemoryStats() {
 long totalParamBytes = totalParameters.get() * 4;
 long gpuBytes = gpuMemoryUsed.get();
 
 return String.format(
 "CPU Offload Stats:\n" +
 " Total Parameters: %.2fB (%.2f GB)\n" +
 " GPU Memory Used: %.2f MB / %.2f MB\n" +
 " CPU Memory Used: %.2f GB\n" +
 " Unified Memory: %s",
 totalParameters.get() / 1e9,
 totalParamBytes / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024),
 gpuBytes / (1024.0 * 1024),
 maxGPUMemory / (1024.0 * 1024),
 (totalParamBytes - gpuBytes) / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024),
 useUnifiedMemory ? "enabled" : "disabled"
 );
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 syncAllToCPU();
 
 for (ParameterBlock[] blocks : parameterBlocks.values()) {
 for (ParameterBlock block : blocks) {
 if (block.gpuBuffer != null) {
 clReleaseMemObject(block.gpuBuffer);
 block.gpuBuffer = null;
 }
 }
 }
 
 if (swapDirectory != null) {
 try {
 Files.walk(swapDirectory)
 .sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder())
 .map(java.nio.file.Path::toFile)
 .forEach(File::delete);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[CPUOffload] Failed to clean swap: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 parameterBlocks.clear();
 System.out.println("[CPUOffload] Shutdown complete");
 }
 
 /**
 * 参数块描述
 */
 private static class ParameterBlock {
 String name;
 int blockIndex;
 int start;
 int size;
 float[] cpuData;
 int cpuOffset;
 boolean gpuResident;
 boolean dirty;
 cl_mem gpuBuffer;
 long lastAccessTime;
 }
 
 /**
 * 优化器状态描述
 */
 public static class OptimizerState {
 float[] m;
 float[] v;
 String paramName;
 Path swapFile;
 boolean useSwap;
 int deviceId;
 cl_command_queue queue;
 cl_context context;
 
 public float[] getM() { return m; }
 public float[] getV() { return v; }
 
 public void swapOut() {
 if (!useSwap || swapFile == null) return;
 try (FileChannel channel = FileChannel.open(swapFile, 
 StandardOpenOption.WRITE, StandardOpenOption.CREATE)) {
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(m.length * 4 + v.length * 4);
 buffer.order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
 for (float f : m) buffer.putFloat(f);
 for (float f : v) buffer.putFloat(f);
 buffer.flip();
 channel.write(buffer);
 
 java.util.Arrays.fill(m, 0);
 java.util.Arrays.fill(v, 0);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[OptimizerState] Swap out failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 
 public void swapIn() {
 if (!useSwap || swapFile == null) return;
 try (FileChannel channel = FileChannel.open(swapFile, StandardOpenOption.READ)) {
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(m.length * 4 + v.length * 4);
 buffer.order(ByteOrder.nativeOrder());
 channel.read(buffer);
 buffer.flip();
 for (int i = 0; i < m.length; i++) m[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) v[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.println("[OptimizerState] Swap in failed: " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

public class CausalMask {

 private final float[][] mask;
 private final int seqLen;

 public CausalMask(int seqLen) {
 this.seqLen = seqLen;
 this.mask = new float[seqLen][seqLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 mask[i][j] = j <= i ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
 }
 }
 }

 public float get(int i, int j) {
 if (i < 0 || i >= seqLen || j < 0 || j >= seqLen) {
 return 0.0f;
 }
 return mask[i][j];
 }

 public float[][] getMatrix() {
 return mask;
 }

 public int getSeqLen() {
 return seqLen;
 }

 public float[] applyToVector(float[] vector, int position) {
 float[] result = new float[vector.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < vector.length; i++) {
 if (i <= position) {
 result[i] = vector[i];
 } else {
 result[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 return result;
 }

 public static float[] applyCausalMask(float[] attention, int seqLen) {
 float[] masked = new float[attention.length];
 int numHeads = attention.length / (seqLen * seqLen);
 for (int h = 0; h < numHeads; h++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < seqLen; j++) {
 int idx = h * seqLen * seqLen + i * seqLen + j;
 masked[idx] = j <= i ? attention[idx] : Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 }
 }
 return masked;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CheckpointManager {

 private final Path checkpointDir;
 private final int maxCheckpoints;
 private final String prefix;

 public CheckpointManager(String checkpointDir) {
 this(checkpointDir, 5, "checkpoint");
 }

 public CheckpointManager(String checkpointDir, int maxCheckpoints, String prefix) {
 this.checkpointDir = Paths.get(checkpointDir);
 this.maxCheckpoints = maxCheckpoints;
 this.prefix = prefix;
 try {
 Files.createDirectories(this.checkpointDir);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to create checkpoint directory", e);
 }
 }

 public void save(SimpCoreModel model, Optimizer optimizer, int step, float loss) {
 String timestamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"));
 String filename = String.format("%s_step_%d_loss_%.4f_%s.bin", prefix, step, loss, timestamp);
 Path filepath = checkpointDir.resolve(filename);

 try (DataOutputStream dos = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(filepath)))) {
 dos.writeInt(step);
 dos.writeFloat(loss);
 dos.writeLong(System.currentTimeMillis());

 model.save(dos);

 dos.writeFloat(optimizer.getCurrentLearningRate());
 dos.writeFloat(optimizer.getWeightDecay());
 dos.writeFloat(optimizer.getMomentum());
 dos.writeFloat(optimizer.getGradClip());
 dos.writeInt(optimizer.getGradientAccumulationSteps());

 System.out.printf("Checkpoint saved: %s (step=%d, loss=%.4f)%n", filepath, step, loss);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to save checkpoint", e);
 }

 cleanupOldCheckpoints();
 }

 public Checkpoint load(String filename) {
 Path filepath = checkpointDir.resolve(filename);
 if (!Files.exists(filepath)) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Checkpoint not found: " + filepath);
 }

 return loadFromPath(filepath);
 }

 public Checkpoint loadLatest() {
 List<Path> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 if (checkpoints.isEmpty()) {
 return null;
 }

 Path latest = checkpoints.get(checkpoints.size() - 1);
 return loadFromPath(latest);
 }

 public Checkpoint loadBest() {
 List<Path> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 if (checkpoints.isEmpty()) {
 return null;
 }

 Path best = null;
 float bestLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;

 for (Path cp : checkpoints) {
 float loss = extractLossFromFilename(cp.getFileName().toString());
 if (loss < bestLoss) {
 bestLoss = loss;
 best = cp;
 }
 }

 if (best == null) {
 return null;
 }

 return loadFromPath(best);
 }

 private Checkpoint loadFromPath(Path filepath) {
 try (DataInputStream dis = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(Files.newInputStream(filepath)))) {
 int step = dis.readInt();
 float loss = dis.readFloat();
 long timestamp = dis.readLong();

 SimpCoreModel model = SimpCoreModel.loadFromStream(dis);

 float lr = dis.readFloat();
 float weightDecay = dis.readFloat();
 float momentum = dis.readFloat();
 float gradClip = dis.readFloat();
 int gradAccumSteps = dis.readInt();

 Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(lr, weightDecay, momentum, gradClip);
 optimizer.setGradientAccumulationSteps(gradAccumSteps);

 System.out.printf("Checkpoint loaded: %s (step=%d, loss=%.4f)%n", filepath, step, loss);

 return new Checkpoint(model, optimizer, step, loss, timestamp, filepath.toString());
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to load checkpoint", e);
 }
 }

 private List<Path> listCheckpoints() {
 List<Path> checkpoints = new ArrayList<>();
 try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(checkpointDir, prefix + "_*")) {
 for (Path path : stream) {
 if (Files.isRegularFile(path)) {
 checkpoints.add(path);
 }
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to list checkpoints", e);
 }

 checkpoints.sort(Comparator.comparing(this::extractStepFromFilename));
 return checkpoints;
 }

 private void cleanupOldCheckpoints() {
 List<Path> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 if (checkpoints.size() <= maxCheckpoints) {
 return;
 }

 int toRemove = checkpoints.size() - maxCheckpoints;
 for (int i = 0; i < toRemove; i++) {
 try {
 Files.delete(checkpoints.get(i));
 System.out.printf("Removed old checkpoint: %s%n", checkpoints.get(i));
 } catch (IOException e) {
 System.err.printf("Failed to remove old checkpoint: %s%n", checkpoints.get(i));
 }
 }
 }

 private int extractStepFromFilename(Path path) {
 String name = path.getFileName().toString();
 try {
 int start = name.indexOf("step_") + 5;
 int end = name.indexOf("_loss");
 return Integer.parseInt(name.substring(start, end));
 } catch (Exception e) {
 return 0;
 }
 }

 private float extractLossFromFilename(String name) {
 try {
 int start = name.indexOf("loss_") + 5;
 int end = name.indexOf("_", start);
 return Float.parseFloat(name.substring(start, end));
 } catch (Exception e) {
 return Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }
 }

 public List<String> listCheckpointNames() {
 List<Path> checkpoints = listCheckpoints();
 List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
 for (Path cp : checkpoints) {
 names.add(cp.getFileName().toString());
 }
 return names;
 }

 public static class Checkpoint {
 public final SimpCoreModel model;
 public final Optimizer optimizer;
 public final int step;
 public final float loss;
 public final long timestamp;
 public final String path;

 public Checkpoint(SimpCoreModel model, Optimizer optimizer, int step, float loss, long timestamp, String path) {
 this.model = model;
 this.optimizer = optimizer;
 this.step = step;
 this.loss = loss;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.path = path;
 }

 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format(
 "Checkpoint{step=%d, loss=%.4f, timestamp=%d, path='%s'}",
 step, loss, timestamp, path
 );
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
