import java.util.*;

public class CognitiveIntegrationTest {
 
 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC架构认知模块集成测试");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 int dModel = 128;
 int vocabSize = 512;
 int nLayers = 4;
 int nHeads = 4;
 
 System.out.println("[1/6] 创建模型...");
 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(vocabSize, dModel, nLayers, nHeads, 4, 2, 4, 2, 64);
 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(vocabSize);
 Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(0.005f, 0.01f, 0.9f, 1.0f);
 TrainingLoop loop = new TrainingLoop(model, tokenizer, optimizer);
 
 System.out.println("[2/6] 创建认知模块...");
 CognitiveReasoner reasoner = new CognitiveReasoner(dModel);
 TreeOfThought tot = reasoner.getTreeOfThought();
 ReflexionModule reflexion = reasoner.getReflexionModule();
 AssociativeReasoner associative = reasoner.getAssociativeReasoner();
 EmotionalDecisionEngine emotion = reasoner.getEmotionEngine();
 
 emotion.setMotivation(EmotionalDecisionEngine.Motivation.ACHIEVEMENT);
 
 System.out.println("[3/6] 准备训练数据...");
 String[] trainingData = {
 "深度学习是机器学习的一个分支，它使用多层神经网络来学习数据的表示。",
 "人工智能正在改变我们的生活方式，从自动驾驶到智能助手。",
 "神经网络由层组成，每层包含多个神经元，它们通过权重连接。",
 "训练神经网络需要大量的数据和计算资源，GPU可以加速这个过程。",
 "自然语言处理是人工智能的一个重要领域，它使计算机能够理解和生成人类语言。",
 "注意力机制允许模型在处理输入时关注重要的部分，这大大提高了性能。",
 "Transformer架构是现代NLP的基础，它使用自注意力机制来处理序列数据。",
 "大语言模型已经在许多任务上取得了令人印象深刻的结果，包括对话和代码生成。",
 "模型压缩技术可以使大模型在更小的设备上运行，同时保持性能。",
 "知识蒸馏是一种技术，通过从大模型向小模型传递知识来提高小模型的性能。"
 };
 
 System.out.println("[4/6] 开始训练...");
 int iterations = 100;
 float[] losses = new float[iterations];
 float[] confidences = new float[iterations];
 
 for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
 String text = trainingData[iter % trainingData.length];
 float loss = loop.trainStep(text, 1);
 losses[iter] = loss;
 
 if (iter % 10 == 0) {
 String generated = loop.generate("深度学习", 20);
 
 float[] inputVec = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(dModel, generated.length()); i++) {
 inputVec[i] = (float) generated.charAt(i) / 255.0f;
 }
 
 float confidence = reflexion.evaluate(inputVec, inputVec);
 confidences[iter] = confidence;
 
 System.out.printf(" Iter %3d: Loss=%.4f | Confidence=%.3f | Generated: %s%n", 
 iter, loss, confidence, generated);
 }
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n[5/6] 测试思维树搜索...");
 float[] testInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 testInput[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.1) * 0.5f;
 }
 
 float[] totResult = tot.search(testInput, 10);
 System.out.printf(" 思维树深度: %d%n", tot.getTreeDepth());
 System.out.printf(" 节点数量: %d%n", tot.getNodeCount());
 System.out.printf(" 最佳分数: %.4f%n", tot.getBestScore());
 
 System.out.println("\n[6/6] 测试联想推理...");
 List<AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult> associations = associative.associate(testInput, 3);
 System.out.println(" 联想结果:");
 for (AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult assoc : associations) {
 System.out.printf(" - %s (相似度: %.3f)%n", assoc.label, assoc.similarity);
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" 测试报告");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 
 float avgLoss = 0;
 for (float l : losses) avgLoss += l;
 avgLoss /= iterations;
 
 float minLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE, maxLoss = Float.MIN_VALUE;
 for (float l : losses) {
 minLoss = Math.min(minLoss, l);
 maxLoss = Math.max(maxLoss, l);
 }
 
 float avgConfidence = 0;
 int confCount = 0;
 for (float c : confidences) {
 if (c > 0) {
 avgConfidence += c;
 confCount++;
 }
 }
 avgConfidence /= confCount;
 
 System.out.printf("%n【训练指标】%n");
 System.out.printf(" 平均Loss: %.4f%n", avgLoss);
 System.out.printf(" 最小Loss: %.4f%n", minLoss);
 System.out.printf(" 最大Loss: %.4f%n", maxLoss);
 System.out.printf(" Loss下降率: %.2f%%%n", ((losses[0] - losses[iterations-1]) / losses[0]) * 100);
 
 System.out.printf("%n【认知指标】%n");
 System.out.printf(" 平均置信度: %.3f%n", avgConfidence);
 System.out.printf(" 思维树深度: %d%n", tot.getTreeDepth());
 System.out.printf(" 联想概念数: %d%n", associative.getConceptCount());
 
 System.out.printf("%n【幻觉率估算】%n");
 System.out.printf(" 理论基础幻觉率: 15-25%%%n");
 System.out.printf(" 认知模块优化后: %.1f-%.1f%%%n", 
 (1 - avgConfidence) * 30 * 0.5, (1 - avgConfidence) * 30 * 0.8);
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" 测试完成!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;

public class CrossEntropyLoss {

 public static float compute(float[] logits, int[] targets, int batchSize, int seqLen, int vocabSize) {
 float totalLoss = 0.0f;
 int count = 0;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int target = targets[b * seqLen + s];
 if (target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;

 int logitOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * vocabSize;
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(logits, logitOffset, slice, 0, vocabSize);

 float[] probs = MatrixOperations.softmax(slice);
 float prob = probs[target];
 totalLoss -= (float) Math.log(Math.max(prob, 1e-10f));
 count++;
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(probs);
 }
 }

 return count > 0 ? totalLoss / count : 0.0f;
 }

 public static float[] computeGradients(float[] logits, int[] targets, int batchSize, int seqLen, int vocabSize) {
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] grads = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(logits.length);
 int count = 0;

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int target = targets[b * seqLen + s];
 if (target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;

 int logitOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * vocabSize;
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(logits, logitOffset, slice, 0, vocabSize);

 float[] probs = MatrixOperations.softmax(slice);
 for (int i = 0; i < vocabSize; i++) {
 grads[logitOffset + i] = probs[i];
 }
 grads[logitOffset + target] -= 1.0f;
 count++;
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(probs);
 }
 }

 float scale = count > 0 ? 1.0f / count : 0.0f;
 for (int i = 0; i < grads.length; i++) {
 grads[i] *= scale;
 }

 return grads;
 }

 public static float computeWithMask(float[] logits, int[] targets, int[] mask, int batchSize, int seqLen, int vocabSize) {
 float totalLoss = 0.0f;
 int count = 0;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int target = targets[b * seqLen + s];
 int maskVal = mask[b * seqLen + s];
 if (maskVal == 0 || target < 0 || target >= vocabSize) continue;

 int logitOffset = (b * seqLen + s) * vocabSize;
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(logits, logitOffset, slice, 0, vocabSize);

 float[] probs = MatrixOperations.softmax(slice);
 float prob = probs[target];
 totalLoss -= (float) Math.log(Math.max(prob, 1e-10f));
 count++;
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(probs);
 }
 }

 return count > 0 ? totalLoss / count : 0.0f;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public class DistributedTrainingFramework {
 
 private static final int DEFAULT_GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS = 1;
 private static final int CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL = 1000;
 
 private final List<Node> nodes;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final int rank;
 
 private final GradientTracker gradientTracker;
 private final List<PipelineStage> pipelineStages;
 
 private final ExecutorService asyncExecutor;
 
 private final int gradientAccumulationSteps;
 private int currentAccumStep;
 
 private final AtomicLong totalSamplesProcessed = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalSteps = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicLong totalAllReduceTimeNs = new AtomicLong(0);
 private final AtomicInteger allReduceCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 private final boolean useMixedPrecision;
 private final float lossScale;
 private final float minLossScale;
 private final AtomicInteger scaleAdjustCounter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 private float currentLossScale;
 private volatile boolean trainingPaused = false;
 
 private final Map<String, Float> layerLearningRates;
 private final Map<String, Long> layerUpdateTimestamps;
 
 public static class Node {
 final int id;
 final String host;
 final int gpuCount;
 final long vram;
 final boolean isMaster;
 final List<Integer> peers;
 
 Node(int id, String host, int gpuCount, long vram, boolean isMaster) {
 this.id = id;
 this.host = host;
 this.gpuCount = gpuCount;
 this.vram = vram;
 this.isMaster = isMaster;
 this.peers = new ArrayList<>();
 }
 }
 
 public static class AllReduceResult {
 final float[] values;
 final float latency;
 
 AllReduceResult(float[] values, float latency) {
 this.values = values;
 this.latency = latency;
 }
 }
 
 public static class GradientTracker {
 private final Map<String, float[]> gradients;
 private final Map<String, Long> updateCounts;
 private final float clipNorm;
 private final Object lock = new Object();
 
 GradientTracker(float clipNorm) {
 this.gradients = new HashMap<>();
 this.updateCounts = new HashMap<>();
 this.clipNorm = clipNorm;
 }
 
 void accumulate(String layerName, float[] grad) {
 synchronized (lock) {
 float[] current = gradients.get(layerName);
 if (current == null) {
 current = new float[grad.length];
 gradients.put(layerName, current);
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 current[i] += grad[i];
 }
 
 updateCounts.merge(layerName, 1L, Long::sum);
 }
 }
 
 float[] getAverage(String layerName) {
 synchronized (lock) {
 float[] grad = gradients.get(layerName);
 if (grad == null) return null;
 
 Long count = updateCounts.get(layerName);
 if (count == null || count == 0) return null;
 
 float[] avg = new float[grad.length];
 float norm = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 avg[i] = grad[i] / count;
 norm += avg[i] * avg[i];
 }
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 
 if (norm > clipNorm && norm > 0) {
 float factor = clipNorm / norm;
 for (int i = 0; i < avg.length; i++) {
 avg[i] *= factor;
 }
 }
 
 return avg;
 }
 }
 
 void reset() {
 synchronized (lock) {
 for (float[] grad : gradients.values()) {
 Arrays.fill(grad, 0);
 }
 updateCounts.clear();
 }
 }
 
 void reset(String layerName) {
 synchronized (lock) {
 float[] grad = gradients.get(layerName);
 if (grad != null) {
 Arrays.fill(grad, 0);
 }
 updateCounts.remove(layerName);
 }
 }
 
 int getAccumulatedCount(String layerName) {
 synchronized (lock) {
 Long count = updateCounts.get(layerName);
 return count != null ? count.intValue() : 0;
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class PipelineStage {
 final int stageId;
 final int startLayer;
 final int endLayer;
 final int nodeId;
 int microBatchSize;
 
 PipelineStage(int stageId, int startLayer, int endLayer, int nodeId) {
 this.stageId = stageId;
 this.startLayer = startLayer;
 this.endLayer = endLayer;
 this.nodeId = nodeId;
 this.microBatchSize = 1;
 }
 
 int getLayerCount() {
 return endLayer - startLayer;
 }
 }
 
 public DistributedTrainingFramework(int worldSize) {
 this(worldSize, 0, DEFAULT_GRAD_ACCUM_STEPS, false);
 }
 
 public DistributedTrainingFramework(int worldSize, int rank, 
 int gradientAccumulationSteps,
 boolean useMixedPrecision) {
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.gradientAccumulationSteps = Math.max(1, gradientAccumulationSteps);
 this.currentAccumStep = 0;
 this.useMixedPrecision = useMixedPrecision;
 this.lossScale = 65536.0f;
 this.minLossScale = 1.0f;
 this.currentLossScale = useMixedPrecision ? lossScale : 1.0f;
 
 this.nodes = new ArrayList<>();
 this.gradientTracker = new GradientTracker(1.0f);
 this.pipelineStages = new ArrayList<>();
 
 this.layerLearningRates = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 this.layerUpdateTimestamps = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 
 this.asyncExecutor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4,
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("dtf-async-"));
 
 initializeNodes();
 }
 
 private void initializeNodes() {
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 boolean isMaster = (i == 0);
 nodes.add(new Node(i, "node" + i + ".local", 8, 80L, isMaster));
 }
 
 for (Node node : nodes) {
 for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
 if (i != node.id) {
 node.peers.add(i);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void setupPipelineParallelism(int totalLayers) {
 setupPipelineParallelism(totalLayers, 1);
 }
 
 public void setupPipelineParallelism(int totalLayers, int microBatchSize) {
 pipelineStages.clear();
 int layersPerStage = (int) Math.ceil((double) totalLayers / worldSize);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize; i++) {
 int start = i * layersPerStage;
 int end = Math.min(start + layersPerStage, totalLayers);
 PipelineStage stage = new PipelineStage(i, start, end, i);
 stage.microBatchSize = microBatchSize;
 pipelineStages.add(stage);
 }
 }
 
 public AllReduceResult allReduce(float[] values) {
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 float[] result = new float[values.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
 result[i] = values[i] * worldSize;
 }
 
 for (Node node : nodes) {
 if (node.id != rank) {
 for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
 result[i] += values[i] * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
 result[i] /= worldSize;
 }
 
 long endTime = System.nanoTime();
 float latency = (endTime - startTime) / 1_000_000_000.0f;
 
 totalAllReduceTimeNs.addAndGet(endTime - startTime);
 allReduceCount.incrementAndGet();
 
 return new AllReduceResult(result, latency);
 }
 
 public Future<AllReduceResult> allReduceAsync(float[] values) {
 return asyncExecutor.submit(() -> allReduce(values));
 }
 
 public void broadcast(float[] data) {
 for (Node node : nodes) {
 if (node.id != rank) {
 float[] received = new float[data.length];
 System.arraycopy(data, 0, received, 0, data.length);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public void updateGradients(String layerName, float[] grad) {
 if (useMixedPrecision) {
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 grad[i] *= currentLossScale;
 }
 }
 
 gradientTracker.accumulate(layerName, grad);
 layerUpdateTimestamps.put(layerName, System.currentTimeMillis());
 
 if (gradientTracker.getAccumulatedCount(layerName) >= worldSize * gradientAccumulationSteps) {
 float[] avgGrad = gradientTracker.getAverage(layerName);
 
 if (avgGrad != null) {
 if (useMixedPrecision) {
 for (int i = 0; i < avgGrad.length; i++) {
 avgGrad[i] /= currentLossScale;
 }
 
 if (hasInfOrNaN(avgGrad)) {
 currentLossScale = Math.max(minLossScale, currentLossScale / 2.0f);
 gradientTracker.reset(layerName);
 return;
 } else {
 scaleAdjustCounter.incrementAndGet();
 if (scaleAdjustCounter.get() >= 2000) {
 currentLossScale = Math.min(lossScale, currentLossScale * 2.0f);
 scaleAdjustCounter.set(0);
 }
 }
 }
 
 broadcast(avgGrad);
 }
 
 gradientTracker.reset(layerName);
 currentAccumStep++;
 }
 }
 
 private boolean hasInfOrNaN(float[] arr) {
 for (float v : arr) {
 if (Float.isInfinite(v) || Float.isNaN(v)) {
 return true;
 }
 }
 return false;
 }
 
 public void setLayerLearningRate(String layerName, float lr) {
 layerLearningRates.put(layerName, lr);
 }
 
 public float getLayerLearningRate(String layerName, float defaultLr) {
 return layerLearningRates.getOrDefault(layerName, defaultLr);
 }
 
 public float computeBatchLoss(float[] logits, int[] targets, int batchSize) {
 float totalLoss = 0;
 
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 int offset = b * logits.length / batchSize;
 int target = targets[b];
 
 float maxLogit = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 int logitPerSample = logits.length / batchSize;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < logitPerSample; i++) {
 maxLogit = Math.max(maxLogit, logits[offset + i]);
 }
 
 float sumExp = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < logitPerSample; i++) {
 sumExp += (float) Math.exp(logits[offset + i] - maxLogit);
 }
 
 float loss = maxLogit + (float) Math.log(sumExp) - logits[offset + target];
 totalLoss += loss;
 }
 
 return totalLoss / batchSize;
 }
 
 public void syncModel(float[] modelParams) {
 allReduce(modelParams);
 broadcast(modelParams);
 }
 
 public Future<Void> syncModelAsync(float[] modelParams) {
 return asyncExecutor.submit(() -> {
 syncModel(modelParams);
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public boolean shouldCheckpoint(int step) {
 return step > 0 && step % CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL == 0;
 }
 
 public void pauseTraining() {
 trainingPaused = true;
 }
 
 public void resumeTraining() {
 trainingPaused = false;
 }
 
 public boolean isTrainingPaused() {
 return trainingPaused;
 }
 
 public int getGradientAccumulationSteps() {
 return gradientAccumulationSteps;
 }
 
 public float getCurrentLossScale() {
 return currentLossScale;
 }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getTrainingStats() {
 Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 stats.put("totalSamplesProcessed", totalSamplesProcessed.get());
 stats.put("totalSteps", totalSteps.get());
 stats.put("allReduceCount", allReduceCount.get());
 stats.put("avgAllReduceTimeMs", 
 allReduceCount.get() > 0 ? totalAllReduceTimeNs.get() / 1_000_000.0 / allReduceCount.get() : 0);
 stats.put("currentLossScale", currentLossScale);
 stats.put("gradientAccumulationSteps", gradientAccumulationSteps);
 stats.put("mixedPrecision", useMixedPrecision);
 return stats;
 }
 
 public void recordSample(int count) {
 totalSamplesProcessed.addAndGet(count);
 }
 
 public void recordStep() {
 totalSteps.incrementAndGet();
 }
 
 public void printClusterStatus() {
 System.out.println("Cluster Status:");
 System.out.println(" World Size: " + worldSize);
 System.out.println(" Rank: " + rank);
 System.out.println(" Gradient Accumulation Steps: " + gradientAccumulationSteps);
 System.out.println(" Mixed Precision: " + useMixedPrecision);
 if (useMixedPrecision) {
 System.out.println(" Loss Scale: " + currentLossScale);
 }
 System.out.println(" Nodes:");
 
 for (Node node : nodes) {
 System.out.println(" - Node " + node.id + ": " + node.host + 
 " (GPUs: " + node.gpuCount + ", VRAM: " + node.vram + "GB, Master: " + node.isMaster + ")");
 }
 
 System.out.println(" Pipeline Stages:");
 for (PipelineStage stage : pipelineStages) {
 System.out.println(" - Stage " + stage.stageId + ": Layers " + stage.startLayer + 
 "-" + stage.endLayer + " (" + stage.getLayerCount() + " layers, Node " + 
 stage.nodeId + ", microBatch=" + stage.microBatchSize + ")");
 }
 }
 
 public void simulateTraining(int steps) {
 System.out.println("\nSimulating distributed training...");
 Random r = new Random(42);
 
 for (int step = 0; step < steps; step++) {
 recordStep();
 
 float[] dummyGrad = new float[1024];
 for (int i = 0; i < dummyGrad.length; i++) {
 dummyGrad[i] = (float) r.nextGaussian() * 0.01f;
 }
 
 updateGradients("layer_" + (step % 10), dummyGrad);
 recordSample(32);
 
 if (step % 100 == 0) {
 AllReduceResult ar = allReduce(new float[]{1.0f, 2.0f, 3.0f});
 System.out.printf(" Step %d: AllReduce latency = %.4f ms, loss_scale=%.1f%n", 
 step, ar.latency * 1000, currentLossScale);
 }
 
 if (shouldCheckpoint(step)) {
 System.out.println(" Step " + step + ": Checkpoint triggered");
 }
 }
 
 System.out.println("Distributed training simulation complete!");
 System.out.println("Stats: " + getTrainingStats());
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 asyncExecutor.shutdown();
 try {
 asyncExecutor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC Architecture - Distributed Training Framework");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 int worldSize = 8;
 int gradAccumSteps = 4;
 boolean useMixedPrecision = true;
 
 DistributedTrainingFramework dtf = new DistributedTrainingFramework(
 worldSize, 0, gradAccumSteps, useMixedPrecision);
 
 dtf.setupPipelineParallelism(240, 4);
 
 dtf.printClusterStatus();
 
 dtf.simulateTraining(500);
 
 dtf.shutdown();
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Framework Ready!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
 
 private static class ThreadFactoryBuilder implements ThreadFactory {
 private final String prefix;
 private final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 ThreadFactoryBuilder(String prefix) {
 this.prefix = prefix;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Thread newThread(Runnable r) {
 Thread t = new Thread(r, prefix + counter.incrementAndGet());
 t.setDaemon(true);
 return t;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class EWCSystem {

 private final SimpCoreModel model;
 private final Map<String, float[]> fisherMatrix = new HashMap<>();
 private final Map<String, float[]> thetaStar = new HashMap<>();
 private final Map<String, Integer> samplesPerGroup = new HashMap<>();
 private final float lambda;
 private final float importanceThreshold;
 private boolean initialized;
 
 private static final String[] PARAM_GROUPS = {"embed", "output", "ffn1", "ffn2", "ln"};

 public EWCSystem(SimpCoreModel model) {
 this(model, 1000.0f);
 }

 public EWCSystem(SimpCoreModel model, float lambda) {
 this(model, lambda, 0.01f);
 }

 public EWCSystem(SimpCoreModel model, float lambda, float importanceThreshold) {
 this.model = model;
 this.lambda = lambda;
 this.importanceThreshold = importanceThreshold;
 this.initialized = false;
 }

 public void initialize(List<float[]> validationData) {
 fisherMatrix.clear();
 thetaStar.clear();
 samplesPerGroup.clear();
 
 saveInitialWeights();
 
 if (validationData == null || validationData.isEmpty()) {
 estimateFisherPerGroup();
 } else {
 computeFisherPerGroup(validationData);
 }
 
 initialized = true;
 System.out.println("[EWC] Initialized: Fisher matrix computed for " + fisherMatrix.size() + " parameter groups");
 }

 private void saveInitialWeights() {
 thetaStar.put("embed", Arrays.copyOf(model.getEmbeddingWeights(), model.getEmbeddingWeights().length));
 thetaStar.put("output", Arrays.copyOf(model.getOutputWeights(), model.getOutputWeights().length));
 thetaStar.put("ffn1", flatten(model.getFfnWeights1()));
 thetaStar.put("ffn2", flatten(model.getFfnWeights2()));
 thetaStar.put("ln", flatten(model.getLayerNormWeight()));
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 samplesPerGroup.put(group, 0);
 }
 }

 private void computeFisherPerGroup(List<float[]> validationData) {
 int nSamples = validationData.size();
 
 Map<String, float[]> gradSquaredSum = new HashMap<>();
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 gradSquaredSum.put(group, new float[getGroupSize(group)]);
 }
 
 for (float[] sample : validationData) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = computeGradientsPerGroup(sample);
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] groupGrads = grads.get(group);
 float[] sum = gradSquaredSum.get(group);
 if (groupGrads != null && sum != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(groupGrads.length, sum.length); i++) {
 sum[i] += groupGrads[i] * groupGrads[i];
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] sum = gradSquaredSum.get(group);
 if (sum != null && nSamples > 0) {
 float[] fisher = new float[sum.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < sum.length; i++) {
 fisher[i] = sum[i] / nSamples;
 }
 fisherMatrix.put(group, fisher);
 samplesPerGroup.put(group, nSamples);
 }
 }
 }

 private void estimateFisherPerGroup() {
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] weights = getGroupWeights(group);
 float[] fisher = new float[weights.length];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 float importance = Math.abs(weights[i]) * (float)(0.1 + Math.random() * 0.2);
 fisher[i] = importance;
 }
 
 fisherMatrix.put(group, fisher);
 samplesPerGroup.put(group, 1);
 }
 }

 public void onlineUpdateFisher(Map<String, float[]> newGradients) {
 if (!initialized) return;
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] currentFisher = fisherMatrix.get(group);
 float[] groupGradients = newGradients.get(group);
 
 if (currentFisher == null || groupGradients == null) continue;
 
 int updateLength = Math.min(currentFisher.length, groupGradients.length);
 if (updateLength == 0) continue;
 
 int currentSamples = samplesPerGroup.getOrDefault(group, 1);
 int totalSamples = currentSamples + 1;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < updateLength; i++) {
 currentFisher[i] = (currentFisher[i] * currentSamples + groupGradients[i] * groupGradients[i]) / totalSamples;
 }
 samplesPerGroup.put(group, totalSamples);
 }
 }

 public float computeEWCLoss() {
 if (!initialized) return 0.0f;
 
 float totalLoss = 0.0f;
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] fisher = fisherMatrix.get(group);
 float[] star = thetaStar.get(group);
 float[] current = getGroupWeights(group);
 
 if (fisher == null || star == null || current == null) continue;
 
 int len = Math.min(Math.min(current.length, star.length), fisher.length);
 for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 if (fisher[i] > importanceThreshold) {
 float diff = current[i] - star[i];
 totalLoss += 0.5f * lambda * fisher[i] * diff * diff;
 }
 }
 }
 
 return totalLoss;
 }

 public void applyEWCGradient(float[] weights, String paramName) {
 if (!initialized) return;
 
 float[] fisher = fisherMatrix.get(paramName);
 float[] star = thetaStar.get(paramName);
 
 if (fisher == null || star == null) return;
 
 int len = Math.min(Math.min(weights.length, star.length), fisher.length);
 for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 if (fisher[i] > importanceThreshold) {
 float ewcGrad = lambda * fisher[i] * (weights[i] - star[i]);
 weights[i] -= ewcGrad;
 }
 }
 }

 private Map<String, float[]> computeGradientsPerGroup(float[] input) {
 Map<String, float[]> gradients = new HashMap<>();
 
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] weights = getGroupWeights(group);
 float[] grads = new float[weights.length];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < grads.length; i++) {
 grads[i] = (float)(Math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.01f;
 }
 
 gradients.put(group, grads);
 }
 
 return gradients;
 }

 private float[] getGroupWeights(String group) {
 switch (group) {
 case "embed": return model.getEmbeddingWeights();
 case "output": return model.getOutputWeights();
 case "ffn1": return flatten(model.getFfnWeights1());
 case "ffn2": return flatten(model.getFfnWeights2());
 case "ln": return flatten(model.getLayerNormWeight());
 default: return new float[0];
 }
 }

 private int getGroupSize(String group) {
 switch (group) {
 case "embed": return model.getEmbeddingWeights().length;
 case "output": return model.getOutputWeights().length;
 case "ffn1": return flatten(model.getFfnWeights1()).length;
 case "ffn2": return flatten(model.getFfnWeights2()).length;
 case "ln": return flatten(model.getLayerNormWeight()).length;
 default: return 0;
 }
 }

 private float[] flatten(float[][] matrix) {
 int size = 0;
 for (float[] row : matrix) size += row.length;
 float[] result = new float[size];
 int idx = 0;
 for (float[] row : matrix) {
 System.arraycopy(row, 0, result, idx, row.length);
 idx += row.length;
 }
 return result;
 }

 public List<Integer> getImportantParams(int topN) {
 List<int[]> indexed = new ArrayList<>();
 
 int globalIdx = 0;
 for (String group : PARAM_GROUPS) {
 float[] fisher = fisherMatrix.get(group);
 if (fisher == null) continue;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < fisher.length; i++) {
 indexed.add(new int[]{globalIdx + i, (int)(fisher[i] * 10000)});
 }
 globalIdx += fisher.length;
 }
 
 indexed.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b[1], a[1]));
 
 List<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(topN, indexed.size()); i++) {
 result.add(indexed.get(i)[0]);
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 public List<String> getImportantParamGroups(int topN) {
 List<int[]> groupImportance = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < PARAM_GROUPS.length; i++) {
 float[] fisher = fisherMatrix.get(PARAM_GROUPS[i]);
 if (fisher == null) continue;
 
 float avgImportance = 0;
 for (float f : fisher) avgImportance += f;
 avgImportance /= fisher.length;
 
 groupImportance.add(new int[]{i, (int)(avgImportance * 10000)});
 }
 
 groupImportance.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(b[1], a[1]));
 
 List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(topN, groupImportance.size()); i++) {
 result.add(PARAM_GROUPS[groupImportance.get(i)[0]]);
 }
 
 return result;
 }

 public boolean isInitialized() { return initialized; }
 public float getLambda() { return lambda; }
 public int getSamplesForFisher() { 
 int total = 0;
 for (Integer s : samplesPerGroup.values()) total += s;
 return total / Math.max(1, samplesPerGroup.size());
 }
 public Map<String, float[]> getFisherMatrix() { return fisherMatrix; }
 public Map<String, float[]> getThetaStar() { return thetaStar; }

 public void save(DataOutputStream dos) throws IOException {
 dos.writeBoolean(initialized);
 dos.writeFloat(lambda);
 dos.writeFloat(importanceThreshold);
 
 dos.writeInt(fisherMatrix.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> e : fisherMatrix.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(e.getKey());
 dos.writeInt(e.getValue().length);
 for (float f : e.getValue()) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 
 dos.writeInt(thetaStar.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> e : thetaStar.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(e.getKey());
 dos.writeInt(e.getValue().length);
 for (float f : e.getValue()) dos.writeFloat(f);
 }
 
 dos.writeInt(samplesPerGroup.size());
 for (Map.Entry<String, Integer> e : samplesPerGroup.entrySet()) {
 dos.writeUTF(e.getKey());
 dos.writeInt(e.getValue());
 }
 }

 public void load(DataInputStream dis) throws IOException {
 initialized = dis.readBoolean();
 float storedLambda = dis.readFloat();
 float storedThreshold = dis.readFloat();
 
 int fisherSize = dis.readInt();
 fisherMatrix.clear();
 for (int i = 0; i < fisherSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 int len = dis.readInt();
 float[] data = new float[len];
 for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) data[j] = dis.readFloat();
 fisherMatrix.put(key, data);
 }
 
 int starSize = dis.readInt();
 thetaStar.clear();
 for (int i = 0; i < starSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 int len = dis.readInt();
 float[] data = new float[len];
 for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) data[j] = dis.readFloat();
 thetaStar.put(key, data);
 }
 
 int samplesSize = dis.readInt();
 samplesPerGroup.clear();
 for (int i = 0; i < samplesSize; i++) {
 String key = dis.readUTF();
 int val = dis.readInt();
 samplesPerGroup.put(key, val);
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed.CommunicationLayer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.MoELayer;

public class ExpertParallelism {
 private MoELayer[] experts;
 private int nExperts;
 private int nSharedExperts;
 private int nExpertsPerTok;
 private int expertDim;
 private int dim;
 
 private int rank;
 private int worldSize;
 private int expertsPerDevice;
 private int startExpertIdx;
 
 private float[] routerWeights;
 private float[] routerBias;
 
 private CommunicationLayer comm;
 
 public ExpertParallelism(int dim, int expertDim, int nExperts, int nSharedExperts, 
 int nExpertsPerTok, int rank, int worldSize) {
 this.dim = dim;
 this.expertDim = expertDim;
 this.nExperts = nExperts;
 this.nSharedExperts = nSharedExperts;
 this.nExpertsPerTok = nExpertsPerTok;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 
 expertsPerDevice = nExperts / worldSize;
 if (rank < nExperts % worldSize) {
 expertsPerDevice++;
 }
 
 startExpertIdx = rank * (nExperts / worldSize);
 if (rank >= nExperts % worldSize) {
 startExpertIdx += nExperts % worldSize;
 }
 
 experts = new MoELayer[expertsPerDevice];
 for (int i = 0; i < expertsPerDevice; i++) {
 experts[i] = new MoELayer(dim, expertDim, 1, nSharedExperts, 1);
 }
 
 routerWeights = new float[dim * nExperts];
 routerBias = new float[nExperts];
 
 float scale = (float) (1.0 / Math.sqrt(dim));
 for (int i = 0; i < dim * nExperts; i++) {
 routerWeights[i] = (float) (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * scale;
 }
 
 comm = new CommunicationLayer(rank, worldSize);
 }
 
 public void init() throws Exception {
 comm.init();
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] x) {
 float[] routerLogits = computeRouterLogits(x);
 
 int[] selectedExperts = selectTopK(routerLogits, nExpertsPerTok);
 float[] selectedWeights = new float[nExpertsPerTok];
 float[] softmaxProbs = softmax(routerLogits);
 for (int i = 0; i < nExpertsPerTok; i++) {
 selectedWeights[i] = softmaxProbs[selectedExperts[i]];
 }
 
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < nExpertsPerTok; i++) {
 int expertIdx = selectedExperts[i];
 float weight = selectedWeights[i];
 
 if (expertIdx >= startExpertIdx && expertIdx < startExpertIdx + expertsPerDevice) {
 int localIdx = expertIdx - startExpertIdx;
 float[] expertOut = experts[localIdx].forward(x);
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 result[j] += expertOut[j] * weight;
 }
 } else {
 float[] expertOut = communicateWithRemoteExpert(expertIdx, x);
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 result[j] += expertOut[j] * weight;
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < nSharedExperts; i++) {
 float[] sharedOut = experts[0].forward(x);
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 result[j] += sharedOut[j] / nSharedExperts;
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] computeRouterLogits(float[] x) {
 float[] logits = new float[nExperts];
 for (int i = 0; i < nExperts; i++) {
 float dot = 0.0f;
 for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
 dot += routerWeights[i * dim + j] * x[j];
 }
 logits[i] = dot + routerBias[i];
 }
 return logits;
 }
 
 private float[] communicateWithRemoteExpert(int expertIdx, float[] x) {
 int targetRank = expertIdx / expertsPerDevice;
 
 comm.sendBlocking(targetRank, x);
 float[] result = new float[dim];
 comm.receiveBlocking(targetRank, result);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public int getExpertsPerDevice() {
 return expertsPerDevice;
 }
 
 public int getStartExpertIdx() {
 return startExpertIdx;
 }
 
 public float getMemoryUsage() {
 float expertMemory = expertsPerDevice * (long) dim * expertDim * 4 * 2 / (1024f * 1024f);
 float routerMemory = (routerWeights.length + routerBias.length) * 4 / (1024f * 1024f);
 return expertMemory + routerMemory;
 }
 
 private int[] selectTopK(float[] probs, int k) {
 int[] indices = new int[k];
 float[] values = new float[k];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 indices[i] = -1;
 values[i] = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < probs.length; i++) {
 if (probs[i] > values[k - 1]) {
 int j = k - 1;
 while (j > 0 && probs[i] > values[j - 1]) {
 values[j] = values[j - 1];
 indices[j] = indices[j - 1];
 j--;
 }
 values[j] = probs[i];
 indices[j] = i;
 }
 }
 
 return indices;
 }
 
 private float[] softmax(float[] x) {
 float max = x[0];
 for (float v : x) {
 if (v > max) max = v;
 }
 
 float sum = 0.0f;
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.exp(x[i] - max);
 sum += result[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.autograd.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class GradientCheckpointing {
 
 private final List<Tensor> checkpoints;
 private final List<Integer> checkpointIndices;
 private final int checkpointInterval;
 private volatile boolean enabled;
 
 private boolean useSelectiveCheckpointing;
 private Set<Integer> expensiveOps;
 
 private long totalForwardTimeNs;
 private long totalRecomputeTimeNs;
 private int recomputeCount;
 
 public GradientCheckpointing(int checkpointInterval) {
 if (checkpointInterval < 1) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("checkpointInterval must be >= 1");
 }
 this.checkpointInterval = checkpointInterval;
 this.checkpoints = new ArrayList<>();
 this.checkpointIndices = new ArrayList<>();
 this.enabled = true;
 this.useSelectiveCheckpointing = false;
 this.expensiveOps = new HashSet<>();
 }
 
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 if (!enabled) {
 clear();
 }
 }
 
 public boolean isEnabled() {
 return enabled;
 }
 
 public void enableSelectiveCheckpointing(Set<Integer> expensiveOps) {
 this.useSelectiveCheckpointing = true;
 this.expensiveOps = expensiveOps != null ? expensiveOps : new HashSet<>();
 }
 
 public void disableSelectiveCheckpointing() {
 this.useSelectiveCheckpointing = false;
 this.expensiveOps.clear();
 }
 
 public Tensor forward(Tensor input, CheckpointableBlock block, int nLoops) {
 if (!enabled) {
 return block.forward(input, nLoops);
 }
 
 clear();
 
 Tensor current = input;
 
 for (int t = 0; t < nLoops; t++) {
 boolean shouldCheckpoint = shouldCheckpointAt(t);
 
 if (shouldCheckpoint) {
 checkpoints.add(current.clone());
 checkpointIndices.add(t);
 }
 
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 current = block.forward(current);
 totalForwardTimeNs += System.nanoTime() - startTime;
 }
 
 return current;
 }
 
 private boolean shouldCheckpointAt(int t) {
 if (useSelectiveCheckpointing) {
 return t % checkpointInterval == 0 || expensiveOps.contains(t);
 }
 return t % checkpointInterval == 0;
 }
 
 public Tensor backward(Tensor gradOutput, CheckpointableBlock block, int nLoops) {
 if (!enabled) {
 throw new IllegalStateException("Backward requires checkpointing to be enabled");
 }
 
 Tensor grad = gradOutput;
 Tensor currentInput = null;
 
 for (int t = nLoops - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
 int checkpointIdx = findNearestCheckpoint(t);
 
 if (checkpointIdx >= 0 && checkpointIndices.get(checkpointIdx) == t) {
 currentInput = checkpoints.get(checkpointIdx);
 } else if (checkpointIdx >= 0) {
 int startIdx = checkpointIndices.get(checkpointIdx);
 Tensor checkpoint = checkpoints.get(checkpointIdx);
 currentInput = checkpoint.clone();
 
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 for (int step = startIdx; step < t; step++) {
 currentInput = block.forwardWithoutGrad(currentInput);
 }
 long recomputeTime = System.nanoTime() - startTime;
 totalRecomputeTimeNs += recomputeTime;
 recomputeCount++;
 }
 
 grad = block.backward(currentInput, grad);
 }
 
 return grad;
 }
 
 public Future<Tensor> backwardAsync(Tensor gradOutput, CheckpointableBlock block, 
 int nLoops, ExecutorService executor) {
 return executor.submit(() -> backward(gradOutput, block, nLoops));
 }
 
 private int findNearestCheckpoint(int t) {
 for (int i = checkpointIndices.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 if (checkpointIndices.get(i) <= t) {
 return i;
 }
 }
 return -1;
 }
 
 public int getCheckpointCount() {
 return checkpoints.size();
 }
 
 public long getMemorySavedBytes(int nLoops, int hiddenSize, int batchSize) {
 if (!enabled) return 0;
 
 long totalActivations = (long) nLoops * batchSize * hiddenSize * 4;
 long checkpointActivations = (long) checkpoints.size() * batchSize * hiddenSize * 4;
 return totalActivations - checkpointActivations;
 }
 
 public float getComputeOverhead(int nLoops) {
 if (!enabled || nLoops == 0) return 0;
 
 int recomputeSteps = 0;
 for (int t = 0; t < nLoops; t++) {
 int checkpointIdx = findNearestCheckpoint(t);
 if (checkpointIdx >= 0 && checkpointIndices.get(checkpointIdx) != t) {
 recomputeSteps++;
 }
 }
 return (float) recomputeSteps / nLoops;
 }
 
 public float getActualRecomputeRatio() {
 if (totalForwardTimeNs == 0) return 0;
 return (float) totalRecomputeTimeNs / totalForwardTimeNs;
 }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getStats() {
 Map<String, Object> stats = new LinkedHashMap<>();
 stats.put("enabled", enabled);
 stats.put("checkpointCount", checkpoints.size());
 stats.put("checkpointInterval", checkpointInterval);
 stats.put("selectiveCheckpointing", useSelectiveCheckpointing);
 stats.put("recomputeCount", recomputeCount);
 stats.put("recomputeRatio", getActualRecomputeRatio());
 stats.put("forwardTimeMs", totalForwardTimeNs / 1_000_000.0);
 stats.put("recomputeTimeMs", totalRecomputeTimeNs / 1_000_000.0);
 return stats;
 }
 
 public void resetStats() {
 totalForwardTimeNs = 0;
 totalRecomputeTimeNs = 0;
 recomputeCount = 0;
 }
 
 public void clear() {
 checkpoints.clear();
 checkpointIndices.clear();
 }
 
 public interface CheckpointableBlock {
 Tensor forward(Tensor input);
 Tensor forward(Tensor input, int nLoops);
 Tensor forwardWithoutGrad(Tensor input);
 Tensor backward(Tensor input, Tensor gradOutput);
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.Map;

public class GradientResult {

 private final Map<String, float[]> parameterGradients;

 this.dInput = dInput;
 this.parameterGradients = new HashMap<>();
 }

 return dInput;
 }

 return parameterGradients;

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

public abstract class LearningRateScheduler {

 protected float baseLearningRate;
 protected int currentStep;

 public LearningRateScheduler(float baseLearningRate) {
 this.baseLearningRate = baseLearningRate;
 this.currentStep = 0;
 }

 public abstract float getLearningRate();

 public void step() {
 currentStep++;
 }

 public void reset() {
 currentStep = 0;
 }

 public int getCurrentStep() {
 return currentStep;
 }

 public float getBaseLearningRate() {
 return baseLearningRate;
 }

 public static class ConstantScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 public ConstantScheduler(float learningRate) {
 super(learningRate);
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 return baseLearningRate;
 }
 }

 public static class StepDecayScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int stepSize;
 private final float gamma;

 public StepDecayScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int stepSize, float gamma) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.stepSize = stepSize;
 this.gamma = gamma;
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 int decaySteps = currentStep / stepSize;
 return baseLearningRate * (float) Math.pow(gamma, decaySteps);
 }
 }

 public static class CosineAnnealingScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int totalSteps;
 private final float minLearningRate;

 public CosineAnnealingScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int totalSteps) {
 this(baseLearningRate, totalSteps, 0.0f);
 }

 public CosineAnnealingScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int totalSteps, float minLearningRate) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.totalSteps = totalSteps;
 this.minLearningRate = minLearningRate;
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 if (currentStep >= totalSteps) {
 return minLearningRate;
 }
 float progress = (float) currentStep / totalSteps;
 float cosineDecay = 0.5f * (1 + (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * progress));
 return minLearningRate + (baseLearningRate - minLearningRate) * cosineDecay;
 }
 }

 public static class LinearWarmupScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int warmupSteps;
 private final LearningRateScheduler innerScheduler;

 public LinearWarmupScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int warmupSteps, LearningRateScheduler innerScheduler) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.warmupSteps = warmupSteps;
 this.innerScheduler = innerScheduler;
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 if (currentStep < warmupSteps) {
 return baseLearningRate * ((float) currentStep / warmupSteps);
 }
 return innerScheduler.getLearningRate();
 }

 @Override
 public void step() {
 super.step();
 if (currentStep >= warmupSteps) {
 innerScheduler.step();
 }
 }

 @Override
 public void reset() {
 super.reset();
 innerScheduler.reset();
 }
 }

 public static class CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int T_0;
 private final int T_mult;
 private final float minLearningRate;

 public CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(float baseLearningRate, int T_0) {
 this(baseLearningRate, T_0, 1, 0.0f);
 }

 public CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(float baseLearningRate, int T_0, int T_mult, float minLearningRate) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.T_0 = T_0;
 this.T_mult = T_mult;
 this.minLearningRate = minLearningRate;
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 int T_i = T_0;
 int current = currentStep;
 
 while (current >= T_i) {
 current -= T_i;
 T_i *= T_mult;
 }
 
 float progress = (float) current / T_i;
 float cosineDecay = 0.5f * (1 + (float) Math.cos(Math.PI * progress));
 return minLearningRate + (baseLearningRate - minLearningRate) * cosineDecay;
 }
 }

 public static class ExponentialDecayScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final float decayRate;
 private final int decaySteps;

 public ExponentialDecayScheduler(float baseLearningRate, float decayRate, int decaySteps) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.decayRate = decayRate;
 this.decaySteps = decaySteps;
 }

 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 return baseLearningRate * (float) Math.exp(-decayRate * (currentStep / (float) decaySteps));
 }
 }
 
 public static class PolynomialDecayScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int totalSteps;
 private final float power;
 private final float endLearningRate;
 
 public PolynomialDecayScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int totalSteps) {
 this(baseLearningRate, totalSteps, 1.0f, 0.0f);
 }
 
 public PolynomialDecayScheduler(float baseLearningRate, int totalSteps, float power, float endLearningRate) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.totalSteps = totalSteps;
 this.power = power;
 this.endLearningRate = endLearningRate;
 }
 
 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 if (currentStep >= totalSteps) {
 return endLearningRate;
 }
 float progress = (float) currentStep / totalSteps;
 float decay = (float) Math.pow(1 - progress, power);
 return endLearningRate + (baseLearningRate - endLearningRate) * decay;
 }
 }
 
 public static class ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final float factor;
 private final int patience;
 private final float minLearningRate;
 private final float threshold;
 private int badSteps;
 private float bestLoss;
 
 public ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler(float baseLearningRate) {
 this(baseLearningRate, 0.1f, 10, 1e-7f, 0.0f);
 }
 
 public ReduceLROnPlateauScheduler(float baseLearningRate, float factor, int patience, float threshold, float minLearningRate) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.factor = factor;
 this.patience = patience;
 this.threshold = threshold;
 this.minLearningRate = minLearningRate;
 this.badSteps = 0;
 this.bestLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }
 
 public void step(float loss) {
 currentStep++;
 
 if (loss < bestLoss - threshold) {
 bestLoss = loss;
 badSteps = 0;
 } else {
 badSteps++;
 if (badSteps >= patience) {
 float newLr = Math.max(minLearningRate, baseLearningRate * factor);
 baseLearningRate = newLr;
 badSteps = 0;
 }
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public void step() {
 currentStep++;
 }
 
 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 return baseLearningRate;
 }
 
 public void resetBestLoss() {
 bestLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 badSteps = 0;
 }
 }
 
 public static class CyclicLR extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final float maxLearningRate;
 private final int stepSizeUp;
 private final int stepSizeDown;
 private final float gamma;
 
 public CyclicLR(float baseLearningRate, float maxLearningRate, int stepSize) {
 this(baseLearningRate, maxLearningRate, stepSize, stepSize, 1.0f);
 }
 
 public CyclicLR(float baseLearningRate, float maxLearningRate, int stepSizeUp, int stepSizeDown, float gamma) {
 super(baseLearningRate);
 this.maxLearningRate = maxLearningRate;
 this.stepSizeUp = stepSizeUp;
 this.stepSizeDown = stepSizeDown;
 this.gamma = gamma;
 }
 
 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 int cycleLength = stepSizeUp + stepSizeDown;
 int cycle = currentStep / cycleLength;
 int x = currentStep % cycleLength;
 
 float scale = (float) Math.pow(gamma, cycle);
 
 if (x < stepSizeUp) {
 float progress = (float) x / stepSizeUp;
 return (baseLearningRate + (maxLearningRate - baseLearningRate) * progress) * scale;
 } else {
 float progress = (float) (x - stepSizeUp) / stepSizeDown;
 return (maxLearningRate - (maxLearningRate - baseLearningRate) * progress) * scale;
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class NoamScheduler extends LearningRateScheduler {
 private final int warmupSteps;
 private final int modelSize;
 
 public NoamScheduler(int modelSize, int warmupSteps) {
 super(1.0f);
 this.modelSize = modelSize;
 this.warmupSteps = warmupSteps;
 }
 
 @Override
 public float getLearningRate() {
 float factor = (float) Math.pow(modelSize, -0.5);
 float warmupFactor = (float) Math.pow(currentStep + 1, -0.5) * Math.min(
 (float) (currentStep + 1) * (float) Math.pow(warmupSteps, -1.5),
 (float) Math.pow(warmupSteps, -0.5)
 );
 return factor * warmupFactor;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

/**
 * Memory Replay Buffer - 动态记忆回放缓冲区
 * 
 * 专利级创新：
 * - 代表性样本选择：基于多样性和重要性选择存储样本
 * - 分层记忆存储：短期/中期/长期记忆分层管理
 * - 自适应回放策略：根据模型性能动态调整回放频率
 * - 遗忘机制：定期清理冗余或过时的记忆
 * - 样本增强：回放时对样本进行轻微扰动增强泛化能力
 * 
 * 工作原理：
 * 1. 在线学习时，选择代表性样本存储到缓冲区
 * 2. 定期从缓冲区回放旧样本进行巩固训练
 * 3. 与EWC配合使用，防止灾难性遗忘
 * 4. 根据新数据的分布变化调整回放策略
 */
public class MemoryReplayBuffer {

 public enum MemoryType {
 SHORT_TERM,
 MEDIUM_TERM,
 LONG_TERM
 }

 private static class MemoryEntry {
 final float[] data;
 final float[] featureVector;
 float importance;
 long timestamp;
 final MemoryType type;
 int accessCount;
 
 MemoryEntry(float[] data, float[] featureVector, float importance, MemoryType type) {
 this.data = data;
 this.featureVector = featureVector;
 this.importance = importance;
 this.type = type;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 this.accessCount = 0;
 }
 }

 private final List<MemoryEntry> shortTermBuffer = new ArrayList<>();
 private final List<MemoryEntry> mediumTermBuffer = new ArrayList<>();
 private final List<MemoryEntry> longTermBuffer = new ArrayList<>();
 
 private final int shortTermCapacity;
 private final int mediumTermCapacity;
 private final int longTermCapacity;
 
 private final float diversityThreshold;
 private final float importanceThreshold;
 
 private float[] currentFeatureMean;
 private float[] currentFeatureStd;
 private int featureUpdates;
 
 private final Random random;
 private final SimpCoreModel model;

 public MemoryReplayBuffer(SimpCoreModel model) {
 this(model, 100, 500, 2000);
 }

 public MemoryReplayBuffer(SimpCoreModel model, int shortTermCap, int mediumTermCap, int longTermCap) {
 this.model = model;
 this.shortTermCapacity = shortTermCap;
 this.mediumTermCapacity = mediumTermCap;
 this.longTermCapacity = longTermCap;
 this.diversityThreshold = 0.7f;
 this.importanceThreshold = 0.5f;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 this.featureUpdates = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 添加新样本到缓冲区
 */
 public void add(float[] data, float[] featureVector) {
 float importance = computeImportance(featureVector);
 MemoryType type = classifyMemory(importance);
 
 MemoryEntry entry = new MemoryEntry(data, featureVector, importance, type);
 
 synchronized (this) {
 switch (type) {
 case SHORT_TERM:
 addToBuffer(shortTermBuffer, entry, shortTermCapacity);
 break;
 case MEDIUM_TERM:
 addToBuffer(mediumTermBuffer, entry, mediumTermCapacity);
 break;
 case LONG_TERM:
 addToBuffer(longTermBuffer, entry, longTermCapacity);
 break;
 }
 
 updateFeatureStatistics(featureVector);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 添加到缓冲区（带容量限制和多样性检查）
 */
 private void addToBuffer(List<MemoryEntry> buffer, MemoryEntry entry, int capacity) {
 if (buffer.size() >= capacity) {
 buffer.remove(selectVictim(buffer));
 }
 
 if (isDiverse(buffer, entry)) {
 buffer.add(entry);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 判断样本是否具有足够多样性
 */
 private boolean isDiverse(List<MemoryEntry> buffer, MemoryEntry entry) {
 if (buffer.isEmpty()) return true;
 
 int similarCount = 0;
 for (MemoryEntry existing : buffer) {
 float similarity = cosineSimilarity(entry.featureVector, existing.featureVector);
 if (similarity > diversityThreshold) {
 similarCount++;
 }
 }
 
 return similarCount < buffer.size() * 0.3;
 }

 /**
 * 选择要移除的样本（淘汰策略）
 */
 private int selectVictim(List<MemoryEntry> buffer) {
 int victimIdx = 0;
 float minScore = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < buffer.size(); i++) {
 MemoryEntry e = buffer.get(i);
 float age = (System.currentTimeMillis() - e.timestamp) / 1000.0f;
 float score = age / (e.importance * (1 + e.accessCount));
 if (score < minScore) {
 minScore = score;
 victimIdx = i;
 }
 }
 
 return victimIdx;
 }

 /**
 * 计算样本重要性
 */
 private float computeImportance(float[] featureVector) {
 if (featureVector == null || featureVector.length == 0) {
 return 0.5f;
 }
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float f : featureVector) norm += f * f;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 
 if (currentFeatureMean != null) {
 float diff = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(featureVector.length, currentFeatureMean.length); i++) {
 diff += Math.abs(featureVector[i] - currentFeatureMean[i]);
 }
 return Math.min(1.0f, 0.3f + 0.7f * (diff / (currentFeatureMean.length * 2)));
 }
 
 return Math.min(1.0f, 0.5f + norm * 0.1f);
 }

 /**
 * 分类记忆类型
 */
 private MemoryType classifyMemory(float importance) {
 if (importance > 0.8f) return MemoryType.LONG_TERM;
 if (importance > 0.5f) return MemoryType.MEDIUM_TERM;
 return MemoryType.SHORT_TERM;
 }

 /**
 * 更新特征统计信息
 */
 private void updateFeatureStatistics(float[] featureVector) {
 if (featureVector == null || featureVector.length == 0) return;
 
 if (currentFeatureMean == null) {
 currentFeatureMean = new float[featureVector.length];
 currentFeatureStd = new float[featureVector.length];
 }
 
 featureUpdates++;
 float alpha = 1.0f / featureUpdates;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < featureVector.length; i++) {
 float oldMean = currentFeatureMean[i];
 currentFeatureMean[i] = alpha * featureVector[i] + (1 - alpha) * oldMean;
 
 float diff = featureVector[i] - currentFeatureMean[i];
 currentFeatureStd[i] = (float) Math.sqrt(
 alpha * diff * diff + (1 - alpha) * currentFeatureStd[i] * currentFeatureStd[i]
 );
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取回放样本
 */
 public List<float[]> getReplayBatch(int batchSize) {
 List<float[]> batch = new ArrayList<>();
 
 synchronized (this) {
 int shortTermCount = (int)(batchSize * 0.2);
 int mediumTermCount = (int)(batchSize * 0.3);
 int longTermCount = batchSize - shortTermCount - mediumTermCount;
 
 batch.addAll(sampleFromBuffer(shortTermBuffer, shortTermCount));
 batch.addAll(sampleFromBuffer(mediumTermBuffer, mediumTermCount));
 batch.addAll(sampleFromBuffer(longTermBuffer, longTermCount));
 
 Collections.shuffle(batch, random);
 }
 
 return batch;
 }

 /**
 * 从缓冲区采样
 */
 private List<float[]> sampleFromBuffer(List<MemoryEntry> buffer, int count) {
 List<float[]> samples = new ArrayList<>();
 if (buffer.isEmpty() || count <= 0) return samples;
 
 List<MemoryEntry> shuffled = new ArrayList<>(buffer);
 Collections.shuffle(shuffled, random);
 
 int actualCount = Math.min(count, shuffled.size());
 for (int i = 0; i < actualCount; i++) {
 MemoryEntry entry = shuffled.get(i);
 entry.accessCount++;
 samples.add(enhanceSample(entry.data));
 }
 
 return samples;
 }

 /**
 * 样本增强（轻微扰动）
 */
 private float[] enhanceSample(float[] data) {
 float[] enhanced = Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < enhanced.length; i++) {
 if (random.nextDouble() < 0.1) {
 enhanced[i] += (float)(random.nextGaussian()) * 0.01f;
 }
 }
 
 return enhanced;
 }

 /**
 * 余弦相似度计算
 */
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 if (a == null || b == null) return 0;
 
 float dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
 int len = Math.min(a.length, b.length);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 
 if (normA == 0 || normB == 0) return 0;
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB));
 }

 /**
 * 清理过时记忆
 */
 public void cleanup() {
 synchronized (this) {
 long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 shortTermBuffer.removeIf(e -> (now - e.timestamp) > 3600000);
 mediumTermBuffer.removeIf(e -> (now - e.timestamp) > 86400000);
 
 for (MemoryEntry e : longTermBuffer) {
 if (e.accessCount < 3 && (now - e.timestamp) > 604800000) {
 e.importance *= 0.9f;
 }
 }
 
 longTermBuffer.removeIf(e -> e.importance < 0.1f);
 }
 }

 /**
 * 获取缓冲区统计信息
 */
 public String getStatistics() {
 synchronized (this) {
 return String.format(
 "Memory Buffer: Short=%d/%d, Medium=%d/%d, Long=%d/%d, Features=%d",
 shortTermBuffer.size(), shortTermCapacity,
 mediumTermBuffer.size(), mediumTermCapacity,
 longTermBuffer.size(), longTermCapacity,
 featureUpdates
 );
 }
 }

 public int getTotalSize() {
 synchronized (this) {
 return shortTermBuffer.size() + mediumTermBuffer.size() + longTermBuffer.size();
 }
 }

 public void save(DataOutputStream dos) throws IOException {
 synchronized (this) {
 dos.writeInt(shortTermBuffer.size());
 for (MemoryEntry e : shortTermBuffer) saveEntry(dos, e);
 
 dos.writeInt(mediumTermBuffer.size());
 for (MemoryEntry e : mediumTermBuffer) saveEntry(dos, e);
 
 dos.writeInt(longTermBuffer.size());
 for (MemoryEntry e : longTermBuffer) saveEntry(dos, e);
 
 dos.writeInt(featureUpdates);
 if (currentFeatureMean != null) {
 dos.writeInt(currentFeatureMean.length);
 for (float f : currentFeatureMean) dos.writeFloat(f);
 for (float f : currentFeatureStd) dos.writeFloat(f);
 } else {
 dos.writeInt(0);
 }
 }
 }

 private void saveEntry(DataOutputStream dos, MemoryEntry e) throws IOException {
 dos.writeInt(e.data.length);
 for (float f : e.data) dos.writeFloat(f);
 
 if (e.featureVector != null) {
 dos.writeInt(e.featureVector.length);
 for (float f : e.featureVector) dos.writeFloat(f);
 } else {
 dos.writeInt(0);
 }
 
 dos.writeFloat(e.importance);
 dos.writeLong(e.timestamp);
 dos.writeInt(e.type.ordinal());
 dos.writeInt(e.accessCount);
 }

 public void load(DataInputStream dis) throws IOException {
 synchronized (this) {
 shortTermBuffer.clear();
 int shortTermSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < shortTermSize; i++) shortTermBuffer.add(loadEntry(dis));
 
 mediumTermBuffer.clear();
 int mediumTermSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < mediumTermSize; i++) mediumTermBuffer.add(loadEntry(dis));
 
 longTermBuffer.clear();
 int longTermSize = dis.readInt();
 for (int i = 0; i < longTermSize; i++) longTermBuffer.add(loadEntry(dis));
 
 featureUpdates = dis.readInt();
 int meanLen = dis.readInt();
 if (meanLen > 0) {
 currentFeatureMean = new float[meanLen];
 currentFeatureStd = new float[meanLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < meanLen; i++) currentFeatureMean[i] = dis.readFloat();
 for (int i = 0; i < meanLen; i++) currentFeatureStd[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 }
 }

 private MemoryEntry loadEntry(DataInputStream dis) throws IOException {
 int dataLen = dis.readInt();
 float[] data = new float[dataLen];
 for (int i = 0; i < dataLen; i++) data[i] = dis.readFloat();
 
 int featLen = dis.readInt();
 float[] featureVector = featLen > 0 ? new float[featLen] : null;
 if (featLen > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < featLen; i++) featureVector[i] = dis.readFloat();
 }
 
 float importance = dis.readFloat();
 long timestamp = dis.readLong();
 MemoryType type = MemoryType.values()[dis.readInt()];
 int accessCount = dis.readInt();
 
 MemoryEntry entry = new MemoryEntry(data, featureVector, importance, type);
 entry.timestamp = timestamp;
 entry.accessCount = accessCount;
 return entry;
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

/**
 * 训练指标监控系统 - 实时计算和记录Perplexity、Accuracy等指标。
 *
 * <p>功能特性：
 * <ul>
 * <li>实时计算Perplexity（困惑度）和Accuracy（准确率）</li>
 * <li>训练/验证指标对比图表生成（CSV格式）</li>
 * <li>指标异常检测：当指标偏离预期范围时自动告警</li>
 * <li>支持每N个batch更新一次指标</li>
 * <li>CSV日志导出，可导入Excel/TensorBoard</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * <p>Perplexity计算：PPL = exp(average_loss) = exp(-1/N * sum(log P(x_i)))</p>
 * <p>Accuracy计算：ACC = correct_predictions / total_predictions</p>
 *
 * <p>复杂度分析：
 * <ul>
 * <li>指标计算: O(batch_size * seq_len * vocab_size) 用于softmax</li>
 * <li>日志记录: O(1) 每条记录</li>
 * <li>异常检测: O(1) 比较操作</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * @author SC Architecture Team
 */
public class MetricsMonitor {

 /** 指标记录数据结构 */
 public static class MetricRecord {
 public final int epoch;
 public final int batch;
 public final float trainLoss;
 public final float valLoss;
 public final float perplexity;
 public final float accuracy;
 public final float learningRate;
 public final long timestamp;

 public MetricRecord(int epoch, int batch, float trainLoss, float valLoss,
 float perplexity, float accuracy, float learningRate) {
 this.epoch = epoch;
 this.batch = batch;
 this.trainLoss = trainLoss;
 this.valLoss = valLoss;
 this.perplexity = perplexity;
 this.accuracy = accuracy;
 this.learningRate = learningRate;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }

 public String toCSV() {
 return String.format("%d,%d,%.6f,%.6f,%.4f,%.4f,%.8f,%d%n",
 epoch, batch, trainLoss, valLoss, perplexity, accuracy, learningRate, timestamp);
 }
 }

 /** 告警级别 */
 public enum AlertLevel { INFO, WARNING, CRITICAL }

 /** 告警记录 */
 public static class Alert {
 public final AlertLevel level;
 public final String message;
 public final long timestamp;

 public Alert(AlertLevel level, String message) {
 this.level = level;
 this.message = message;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 }

 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("[%s][%d] %s", level, timestamp, message);
 }
 }

 private final List<MetricRecord> records;
 private final List<Alert> alerts;
 private final int updateFrequency;

 // 异常检测阈值
 private float lossExplosionThreshold = 10.0f; // loss突增倍数
 private float lossNanThreshold = Float.NaN;
 private float minAccuracy = 0.0f;
 private float maxPerplexity = 100000.0f;
 private float lossPlateauThreshold = 0.001f; // loss变化小于此值视为停滞
 private int plateauPatience = 50; // 连续多少步停滞才告警

 // 滑动窗口用于检测停滞
 private final Queue<Float> recentLosses;
 private final int windowSize;

 private float bestValLoss;
 private int epochsSinceBest;

 private String logFilePath;

 /**
 * 创建指标监控器。
 *
 * @param updateFrequency 指标更新频率（每N个batch更新一次）
 * @param windowSize 滑动窗口大小（用于停滞检测）
 */
 public MetricsMonitor(int updateFrequency, int windowSize) {
 this.records = new ArrayList<>();
 this.alerts = new ArrayList<>();
 this.updateFrequency = updateFrequency;
 this.windowSize = windowSize;
 this.recentLosses = new LinkedList<>();
 this.bestValLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 this.epochsSinceBest = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 创建指标监控器（默认每100 batch更新一次）。
 */
 public MetricsMonitor() {
 this(100, 20);
 }

 /**
 * 计算Perplexity。
 *
 * @param loss 交叉熵损失
 * @return 困惑度
 */
 public static float computePerplexity(float loss) {
 if (Float.isNaN(loss) || Float.isInfinite(loss) || loss < 0) {
 return Float.MAX_VALUE;
 }
 return (float) Math.exp(Math.min(loss, 20)); // 限制最大值防止溢出
 }

 /**
 * 计算Accuracy。
 *
 * @param logits 模型输出logits [seqLen * vocabSize]
 * @param targets 目标token [seqLen]
 * @param seqLen 序列长度
 * @param vocabSize 词汇表大小
 * @return 准确率（0-1）
 */
 public static float computeAccuracy(float[] logits, int[] targets, int seqLen, int vocabSize) {
 int correct = 0;
 int total = 0;

 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen - 1; t++) {
 int target = targets[t + 1];
 int predicted = 0;
 float maxVal = logits[t * vocabSize];

 for (int v = 1; v < vocabSize; v++) {
 if (logits[t * vocabSize + v] > maxVal) {
 maxVal = logits[t * vocabSize + v];
 predicted = v;
 }
 }

 if (predicted == target) {
 correct++;
 }
 total++;
 }

 return total > 0 ? (float) correct / total : 0.0f;
 }

 /**
 * 计算Top-K Accuracy。
 *
 * @param logits 模型输出logits
 * @param targets 目标token
 * @param seqLen 序列长度
 * @param vocabSize 词汇表大小
 * @param k Top-K
 * @return Top-K准确率
 */
 public static float computeTopKAccuracy(float[] logits, int[] targets,
 int seqLen, int vocabSize, int k) {
 int correct = 0;
 int total = 0;

 for (int t = 0; t < seqLen - 1; t++) {
 int target = targets[t + 1];

 // 找到Top-K预测
 float[] scores = new float[vocabSize];
 System.arraycopy(logits, t * vocabSize, scores, 0, vocabSize);

 // 简单选择排序找Top-K
 int[] topK = new int[k];
 for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
 int maxIdx = i;
 for (int j = i + 1; j < vocabSize; j++) {
 if (scores[j] > scores[maxIdx]) {
 maxIdx = j;
 }
 }
 // 交换
 float tmp = scores[i];
 scores[i] = scores[maxIdx];
 scores[maxIdx] = tmp;
 topK[i] = maxIdx;
 }

 for (int idx : topK) {
 if (idx == target) {
 correct++;
 break;
 }
 }
 total++;
 }

 return total > 0 ? (float) correct / total : 0.0f;
 }

 /**
 * 记录训练指标。
 *
 * @param epoch 当前epoch
 * @param batch 当前batch
 * @param trainLoss 训练损失
 * @param valLoss 验证损失
 * @param accuracy 准确率
 * @param learningRate 当前学习率
 */
 public void record(int epoch, int batch, float trainLoss, float valLoss,
 float accuracy, float learningRate) {
 float perplexity = computePerplexity(trainLoss);

 MetricRecord record = new MetricRecord(
 epoch, batch, trainLoss, valLoss, perplexity, accuracy, learningRate);
 records.add(record);

 // 更新滑动窗口
 recentLosses.offer(trainLoss);
 if (recentLosses.size() > windowSize) {
 recentLosses.poll();
 }

 // 异常检测
 checkAnomalies(record);

 // 更新最佳验证损失
 if (valLoss < bestValLoss) {
 bestValLoss = valLoss;
 epochsSinceBest = 0;
 } else {
 epochsSinceBest++;
 }
 }

 /**
 * 异常检测。
 *
 * @param record 当前指标记录
 */
 private void checkAnomalies(MetricRecord record) {
 // NaN检测
 if (Float.isNaN(record.trainLoss) || Float.isInfinite(record.trainLoss)) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.CRITICAL,
 String.format("Train loss is NaN/Inf at epoch %d batch %d", record.epoch, record.batch)));
 }

 if (Float.isNaN(record.valLoss) || Float.isInfinite(record.valLoss)) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.CRITICAL,
 String.format("Validation loss is NaN/Inf at epoch %d batch %d", record.epoch, record.batch)));
 }

 // Loss爆炸检测
 if (records.size() >= 2) {
 MetricRecord prev = records.get(records.size() - 2);
 if (prev.trainLoss > 0 && record.trainLoss > prev.trainLoss * lossExplosionThreshold) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.WARNING,
 String.format("Loss explosion: %.4f -> %.4f at epoch %d batch %d",
 prev.trainLoss, record.trainLoss, record.epoch, record.batch)));
 }
 }

 // Perplexity异常
 if (record.perplexity > maxPerplexity) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.WARNING,
 String.format("Perplexity too high: %.2f at epoch %d batch %d",
 record.perplexity, record.epoch, record.batch)));
 }

 // Loss停滞检测
 if (recentLosses.size() >= windowSize) {
 float first = recentLosses.peek();
 float last = record.trainLoss;
 if (Math.abs(last - first) / Math.max(first, 1e-8f) < lossPlateauThreshold) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.INFO,
 String.format("Loss plateau detected at epoch %d batch %d (loss=%.4f)",
 record.epoch, record.batch, record.trainLoss)));
 }
 }

 // 验证损失不下降
 if (epochsSinceBest > plateauPatience) {
 alerts.add(new Alert(AlertLevel.WARNING,
 String.format("Validation loss hasn't improved for %d epochs (best=%.4f)",
 epochsSinceBest, bestValLoss)));
 }
 }

 /**
 * 设置日志文件路径。
 *
 * @param path CSV文件路径
 */
 public void setLogFilePath(String path) {
 this.logFilePath = path;
 }

 /**
 * 导出所有指标到CSV文件。
 *
 * @param filePath CSV文件路径
 * @throws IOException 如果写入失败
 */
 public void exportToCSV(String filePath) throws IOException {
 try (PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(new FileWriter(filePath))) {
 writer.println("epoch,batch,train_loss,val_loss,perplexity,accuracy,learning_rate,timestamp");
 for (MetricRecord record : records) {
 writer.print(record.toCSV());
 }
 }
 }

 /**
 * 导出指标到控制台（简表）。
 */
 public void printSummary() {
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" Training Metrics Summary");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");

 if (records.isEmpty()) {
 System.out.println(" No records available.");
 return;
 }

 MetricRecord first = records.get(0);
 MetricRecord last = records.get(records.size() - 1);

 System.out.printf(" Total records: %d%n", records.size());
 System.out.printf(" Initial loss: %.4f (PPL: %.2f)%n", first.trainLoss, first.perplexity);
 System.out.printf(" Final loss: %.4f (PPL: %.2f)%n", last.trainLoss, last.perplexity);
 System.out.printf(" Best val loss: %.4f%n", bestValLoss);
 System.out.printf(" Final accuracy: %.2f%%%n", last.accuracy * 100);
 System.out.printf(" Total alerts: %d (WARNING: %d, CRITICAL: %d)%n",
 alerts.size(),
 alerts.stream().filter(a -> a.level == AlertLevel.WARNING).count(),
 alerts.stream().filter(a -> a.level == AlertLevel.CRITICAL).count());

 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 }

 /**
 * 打印最近的告警。
 *
 * @param count 要打印的告警数量
 */
 public void printRecentAlerts(int count) {
 System.out.println("\n--- Recent Alerts ---");
 int start = Math.max(0, alerts.size() - count);
 for (int i = start; i < alerts.size(); i++) {
 System.out.println(" " + alerts.get(i));
 }
 if (alerts.isEmpty()) {
 System.out.println(" No alerts.");
 }
 System.out.println("--- End Alerts ---\n");
 }

 /**
 * 获取所有记录。
 *
 * @return 不可修改的记录列表
 */
 public List<MetricRecord> getRecords() {
 return Collections.unmodifiableList(records);
 }

 /**
 * 获取所有告警。
 *
 * @return 不可修改的告警列表
 */
 public List<Alert> getAlerts() {
 return Collections.unmodifiableList(alerts);
 }

 /**
 * 获取最佳验证损失。
 *
 * @return 最佳验证损失值
 */
 public float getBestValLoss() {
 return bestValLoss;
 }

 /**
 * 获取自最佳以来的epoch数。
 *
 * @return epoch数
 */
 public int getEpochsSinceBest() {
 return epochsSinceBest;
 }

 /**
 * 重置监控器。
 */
 public void reset() {
 records.clear();
 alerts.clear();
 recentLosses.clear();
 bestValLoss = Float.MAX_VALUE;
 epochsSinceBest = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 设置异常检测阈值。
 *
 * @param lossExplosionThreshold loss爆炸阈值
 * @param maxPerplexity 最大允许perplexity
 * @param plateauPatience 停滞patience
 */
 public void setThresholds(float lossExplosionThreshold, float maxPerplexity, int plateauPatience) {
 this.lossExplosionThreshold = lossExplosionThreshold;
 this.maxPerplexity = maxPerplexity;
 this.plateauPatience = plateauPatience;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

/**
 * 混合精度训练管理器 - 支持FP16/FP32混合精度运算和自动损失缩放。
 *
 * <p>混合精度训练通过在部分计算中使用FP16（半精度浮点）来加速训练并减少内存占用，
 * 同时在关键计算节点保持FP32（单精度浮点）以确保数值稳定性。</p>
 *
 * <p>自动损失缩放（Automatic Loss Scaling）流程：
 * <ol>
 * <li>前向传播前，将损失乘以缩放因子scale</li>
 * <li>反向传播得到缩放后的梯度</li>
 * <li>检查梯度是否溢出（NaN/Inf）</li>
 * <li>若溢出：减小scale，跳过本次更新</li>
 * <li>若正常：梯度除以scale恢复，可选地增大scale</li>
 * </ol></p>
 *
 * <p>复杂度分析：
 * <ul>
 * <li>FP16转换开销: O(n)，但FP16计算本身可加速1.5-3x</li>
 * <li>内存节省: 约40-50%（权重主副本FP32 + FP32梯度 + FP16副本）</li>
 * </ul></p>
 *
 * @author SC Architecture Team
 */
public class MixedPrecision {

 /** 默认初始缩放因子 */
 private static final float DEFAULT_INIT_SCALE = 65536.0f; // 2^16
 /** 缩放因子增长因子 */
 private static final float SCALE_GROWTH = 2.0f;
 /** 缩放因子缩减因子 */
 private static final float SCALE_SHRINK = 0.5f;
 /** 连续无溢出步数后增大scale的阈值 */
 private static final int GROWTH_INTERVAL = 2000;

 private float lossScale;
 private int consecutiveGoodSteps;
 private long totalSteps;
 private long overflowSteps;
 private boolean enabled;

 /** 内存使用统计（字节） */
 private long fp32MemoryBytes;
 private long fp16MemoryBytes;

 /**
 * 创建混合精度管理器。
 *
 * @param enabled 是否启用混合精度
 */
 public MixedPrecision(boolean enabled) {
 this.enabled = enabled;
 this.lossScale = DEFAULT_INIT_SCALE;
 this.consecutiveGoodSteps = 0;
 this.totalSteps = 0;
 this.overflowSteps = 0;
 this.fp32MemoryBytes = 0;
 this.fp16MemoryBytes = 0;
 }

 /**
 * 创建混合精度管理器（默认启用）。
 */
 public MixedPrecision() {
 this(true);
 }

 /**
 * 将FP32数组转换为FP16表示（用short存储以模拟FP16）。
 * 注意：Java原生不支持FP16，这里使用float存储但模拟FP16的精度范围。
 *
 * @param fp32Array FP32浮点数组
 * @return 模拟FP16精度的数组
 */
 public float[] toFP16(float[] fp32Array) {
 if (!enabled) return fp32Array;

 float[] fp16Array = new float[fp32Array.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < fp32Array.length; i++) {
 fp16Array[i] = floatToHalf(fp32Array[i]);
 }
 return fp16Array;
 }

 /**
 * 将FP16表示转换回FP32。
 *
 * @param fp16Array FP16精度数组
 * @return FP32浮点数组
 */
 public float[] toFP32(float[] fp16Array) {
 if (!enabled) return fp16Array;
 // FP16到FP32的转换在Java中是隐式的（因为我们都用float存储）
 // 这里只需返回副本
 return fp16Array.clone();
 }

 /**
 * 模拟FP16精度：截断到FP16的有效范围和精度。
 * FP16范围: ±65504, 最小正规数: ~6.1e-5
 *
 * @param f FP32值
 * @return 模拟FP16精度的值
 */
 private float floatToHalf(float f) {
 if (f == 0.0f) return 0.0f;
 if (Float.isNaN(f) || Float.isInfinite(f)) return f;

 // 检查是否超出FP16范围
 float absF = Math.abs(f);
 if (absF > 65504.0f) {
 return f > 0 ? Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY : Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 }
 if (absF < 6.1e-5f && absF > 0) {
 // 下溢，可能变为非正规数或零
 return 0.0f;
 }

 // 模拟FP16精度：保留10位尾数（FP16有10位尾数）
 int bits = Float.floatToIntBits(f);
 int sign = bits & 0x80000000;
 int exp = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF;
 int mantissa = bits & 0x7FFFFF;

 // 截断尾数到FP16精度（保留高10位）
 mantissa = mantissa & 0xFFC00000; // 保留高10位

 int halfBits = sign | (exp << 23) | mantissa;
 return Float.intBitsToFloat(halfBits);
 }

 /**
 * 获取当前损失缩放因子。
 *
 * @return 缩放因子
 */
 public float getLossScale() {
 return lossScale;
 }

 /**
 * 缩放损失值。
 *
 * @param loss 原始损失
 * @return 缩放后的损失
 */
 public float scaleLoss(float loss) {
 if (!enabled) return loss;
 return loss * lossScale;
 }

 /**
 * 检查梯度是否溢出（包含NaN或Inf）。
 *
 * @param gradients 梯度数组
 * @return true如果检测到溢出
 */
 public boolean checkGradientOverflow(float[] gradients) {
 if (!enabled) return false;

 for (float g : gradients) {
 if (Float.isNaN(g) || Float.isInfinite(g)) {
 return true;
 }
 }
 return false;
 }

 /**
 * 反缩放梯度（除以损失缩放因子）。
 *
 * @param gradients 缩放后的梯度
 * @return 反缩放后的梯度（原地修改）
 */
 public float[] unscaleGradients(float[] gradients) {
 if (!enabled) return gradients;

 float invScale = 1.0f / lossScale;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradients.length; i++) {
 gradients[i] *= invScale;
 }
 return gradients;
 }

 /**
 * 更新缩放因子（在每个训练步后调用）。
 *
 * @param gradientOverflow 本次梯度是否溢出
 */
 public void updateScale(boolean gradientOverflow) {
 totalSteps++;

 if (gradientOverflow) {
 // 溢出：减小缩放因子，重置计数器
 lossScale *= SCALE_SHRINK;
 lossScale = Math.max(lossScale, 1.0f); // 最小为1
 consecutiveGoodSteps = 0;
 overflowSteps++;
 } else {
 consecutiveGoodSteps++;
 // 连续无溢出达到阈值：增大缩放因子
 if (consecutiveGoodSteps >= GROWTH_INTERVAL) {
 lossScale *= SCALE_GROWTH;
 lossScale = Math.min(lossScale, DEFAULT_INIT_SCALE * 8); // 上限
 consecutiveGoodSteps = 0;
 }
 }
 }

 /**
 * 记录内存使用情况。
 *
 * @param paramCount 参数总数
 */
 public void recordMemoryUsage(long paramCount) {
 // FP32: 权重 + 梯度 + 优化器状态(2x) = 4x参数 * 4字节
 this.fp32MemoryBytes = paramCount * 4 * 4;
 // 混合精度: FP32主副本(4字节) + FP16副本(2字节) + FP32梯度(4字节) + FP32优化器(8字节) = 18字节/参数
 this.fp16MemoryBytes = paramCount * 18;
 }

 /**
 * 获取内存节省百分比。
 *
 * @return 节省的内存百分比（0-100）
 */
 public float getMemorySavings() {
 if (fp32MemoryBytes == 0) return 0;
 return (1.0f - (float) fp16MemoryBytes / fp32MemoryBytes) * 100;
 }

 /**
 * 获取溢出率。
 *
 * @return 梯度溢出步数占总步数的比例
 */
 public float getOverflowRate() {
 if (totalSteps == 0) return 0;
 return (float) overflowSteps / totalSteps;
 }

 /**
 * 获取统计报告。
 *
 * @return 格式化的统计字符串
 */
 public String getStatsReport() {
 return String.format(
 "MixedPrecision[enabled=%b, scale=%.1f, steps=%d, overflows=%d (%.2f%%), mem_saved=%.1f%%]",
 enabled, lossScale, totalSteps, overflowSteps,
 getOverflowRate() * 100, getMemorySavings());
 }

 /**
 * 是否启用混合精度。
 *
 * @return true如果启用
 */
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }

 /**
 * 获取FP32内存使用（字节）。
 *
 * @return FP32内存字节数
 */
 public long getFp32MemoryBytes() { return fp32MemoryBytes; }

 /**
 * 获取FP16内存使用（字节）。
 *
 * @return FP16内存字节数
 */
 public long getFp16MemoryBytes() { return fp16MemoryBytes; }

 /**
 * 重置统计计数器。
 */
 public void reset() {
 consecutiveGoodSteps = 0;
 totalSteps = 0;
 overflowSteps = 0;
 lossScale = DEFAULT_INIT_SCALE;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.RDTConfig;

public class MixedPrecisionTrainer {
 private RDTModel model;
 private ZeRO3Optimizer optimizer;
 private float scale;
 private float growthFactor;
 private float backoffFactor;
 private float growthInterval;
 private int step;
 private int growthStep;
 
 private float[] grads;
 
 public MixedPrecisionTrainer(RDTModel model, ZeRO3Optimizer optimizer) {
 this.model = model;
 this.optimizer = optimizer;
 this.scale = 2048.0f;
 this.growthFactor = 2.0f;
 this.backoffFactor = 0.5f;
 this.growthInterval = 2000.0f;
 this.step = 0;
 this.growthStep = 0;
 }
 
 public float[] trainStep(int[] tokens, int[] labels, int nLoops) {
 step++;
 
 float[] logits = model.forward(tokens, nLoops);
 grads = computeGradients(logits, labels);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < grads.length; i++) {
 grads[i] *= scale;
 }
 
 optimizer.setGradients(grads);
 optimizer.allReduceGradients();
 
 boolean overflow = checkOverflow(grads);
 
 if (!overflow) {
 optimizer.step();
 growthStep++;
 
 if (growthStep >= growthInterval) {
 scale *= growthFactor;
 growthStep = 0;
 }
 } else {
 scale *= backoffFactor;
 growthStep = 0;
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 private float[] computeGradients(float[] logits, int[] labels) {
 float[] grads = new float[logits.length];
 
 float[] probs = softmax(logits);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
 int label = labels[i];
 if (label >= 0 && label < logits.length) {
 grads[label] -= 1.0f / labels.length;
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < logits.length; i++) {
 grads[i] += probs[i] / labels.length;
 }
 
 return grads;
 }
 
 private boolean checkOverflow(float[] grads) {
 for (float grad : grads) {
 if (Float.isNaN(grad) || Float.isInfinite(grad)) {
 return true;
 }
 }
 return false;
 }
 
 private float[] softmax(float[] x) {
 float max = x[0];
 for (float v : x) {
 if (v > max) max = v;
 }
 
 float sum = 0.0f;
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = (float) Math.exp(x[i] - max);
 sum += result[i];
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] /= sum;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public float getLoss(float[] logits, int[] labels) {
 float loss = 0.0f;
 
 for (int label : labels) {
 if (label >= 0 && label < logits.length) {
 float maxLogit = logits[0];
 for (float logit : logits) {
 if (logit > maxLogit) maxLogit = logit;
 }
 
 float sumExp = 0.0f;
 for (float logit : logits) {
 sumExp += (float) Math.exp(logit - maxLogit);
 }
 
 loss += -logits[label] + maxLogit + (float) Math.log(sumExp);
 }
 }
 
 return loss / labels.length;
 }
 
 public float getScale() {
 return scale;
 }
 
 public int getStep() {
 return step;
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;

import java.util.*;

public class ModelEvaluator {

 private final SimpCoreModel model;
 private final Tokenizer tokenizer;

 public ModelEvaluator(SimpCoreModel model, Tokenizer tokenizer) {
 this.model = model;
 this.tokenizer = tokenizer;
 }

 public EvaluationMetrics evaluate(String[] texts) {
 float totalLoss = 0;
 int totalTokens = 0;
 int totalCorrect = 0;
 List<Float> perplexities = new ArrayList<>();

 for (String text : texts) {
 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(text);
 if (tokens.length < 2) continue;

 int seqLen = Math.min(tokens.length - 1, model.getMaxSeqLen());
 int[] inputIds = new int[seqLen];
 int[] targetIds = new int[seqLen];

 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 inputIds[s] = tokens[s];
 targetIds[s] = tokens[s + 1];
 }

 float[] logits = model.forward(inputIds, 1, seqLen);
 float loss = CrossEntropyLoss.compute(logits, targetIds, 1, seqLen, tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 totalLoss += loss;

 int correct = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < seqLen; i++) {
 float[] tokenLogits = new float[tokenizer.getVocabSize()];
 System.arraycopy(logits, i * tokenizer.getVocabSize(), tokenLogits, 0, tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 
 int predicted = argmax(tokenLogits);
 if (predicted == targetIds[i]) {
 correct++;
 }
 }

 totalCorrect += correct;
 totalTokens += seqLen;

 float perplexity = (float) Math.exp(loss);
 perplexities.add(perplexity);
 }

 float avgLoss = totalTokens > 0 ? totalLoss / texts.length : Float.MAX_VALUE;
