import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;

/**
 * 规模测试 — 直接写入文件避免缓存问题
 */
public class ScaleTest {
 static final int VOCAB_SIZE = 128;
 static final int D_MODEL = 64;
 static final int N_LAYERS = 2;
 static final int N_HEADS = 2;
 static final int N_BASES = 1;
 static final int N_CHANNELS = 1;
 static final int N_PATHS = 1;
 static final int TOP_K = 1;
 static final int MAX_SEQ_LEN = 64;

 static final String[] DATA = {
 "hello world this is a test of the ai system",
 "the cat sat on the mat and looked around",
 "deep learning changes everything we know about",
 "AI is the future of technology in the modern",
 "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
 };

 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(new FileOutputStream("scale_result.txt"));
 MatrixOperations.matmul(new float[4], new float[4], 2, 2, 2);
 
 pw.println("=== SC架构 规模扩展测试 ===");
 pw.println("模型: D_MODEL=" + D_MODEL + ", LAYERS=" + N_LAYERS + ", VOCAB=" + VOCAB_SIZE);
 pw.flush();

 long t0 = System.nanoTime();
 pw.println("[1] 初始化...");
 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(VOCAB_SIZE, D_MODEL, N_LAYERS, N_BASES, N_HEADS,
 N_CHANNELS, N_PATHS, TOP_K, MAX_SEQ_LEN);
 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(VOCAB_SIZE);
 pw.println(" Tokenizer: " + tokenizer.getVocabSize() + " tokens, "
 + (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1e9 + "s");

 pw.println("[2] 训练20步...");
 t0 = System.nanoTime();
 Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(0.005f, 0.01f, 0.9f, 1.0f);
 optimizer.applyCosineSchedule(1, 20, 5, 0.005f, 0.0005f);
 TrainingLoop loop = new TrainingLoop(model, tokenizer, optimizer);
 float fL = 0, lL = 0;
 for (int s = 1; s <= 20; s++) {
 float loss = loop.trainStep(DATA[(s - 1) % DATA.length], 1);
 optimizer.stepScheduler();
 if (s == 1) fL = loss;
 if (s == 20) lL = loss;
 if (s % 10 == 0) pw.println(" 步" + s + ": loss=" + loss);
 }
 double drop = ((fL - lL) / fL) * 100;
 pw.println(" 损失: " + fL + " -> " + lL + " (下降" + String.format("%.1f", drop) + "%)");
 pw.println(" 耗时: " + (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1e9 + "s");

 pw.println("[3] 生成测试...");
 t0 = System.nanoTime();
 int ok = 0;
 for (String p : new String[]{"hello", "the", "AI", "cat"}) {
 try {
 int[] ids = tokenizer.encode(p);
 int[] out = model.generate(ids, 8, tokenizer.getEosTokenId());
 String gen = tokenizer.decode(out);
 boolean clean = !gen.contains("<unk>") && !gen.contains("<extra_");
 pw.println(" '" + p + "' -> \"" + gen + "\"" + (clean ? "" : " (has unk)"));
 if (clean) ok++;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 pw.println(" '" + p + "' -> " + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 pw.println(" 无乱码: " + ok + "/4, " + (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1e9 + "s");

 pw.println("[4] 在线学习...");
 t0 = System.nanoTime();
 try {
 OnlineLearningManager olm = new OnlineLearningManager(model, 5e-5f, 1);
 for (int l = 0; l < N_LAYERS; l++)
 model.getSpmLayers()[l].setSupervisedMode(true);
 // 12条输入 × 3轮 = 36次在线学习步
 String[] olData = {"hello world this is a test", "the cat sat on the mat",
 "deep learning changes everything", "AI is the future of technology",
 "the quick brown fox jumps", "i like to play with my dog",
 "the sun is shining bright", "she went to the store to buy milk",
 "this technology is truly innovative", "a model that gets smarter over time",
 "continuous learning never stops", "smart systems learn from data"};
 for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++)
 for (String in : olData)
 olm.processInteraction(tokenizer.encode(in));
 pw.println(" 总在线步数: " + olm.getTotalOnlineSteps());
 pw.println(" 平均损失: " + String.format("%.4f", olm.getAverageOnlineLoss()));
 pw.println(" 改进指数: " + String.format("%.2f", olm.getImprovementRatio() * 100) + "%");
 pw.println(" 耗时: " + (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1e9 + "s");
 } catch (Exception e) {
 pw.println(" 跳过: " + e.getMessage());
 }

 // ── 5. 在线学习后生成 ──
 pw.println("[5] 在线学习后生成测试...");
 ok = 0;
 for (String p : new String[]{"hello", "the", "AI", "cat", "deep"}) {
 try {
 int[] ids = tokenizer.encode(p);
 int[] out = model.generate(ids, 8, tokenizer.getEosTokenId());
 String gen = tokenizer.decode(out);
 boolean clean = !gen.contains("<unk>") && !gen.contains("<extra_");
 pw.println(" '" + p + "' -> \"" + gen + "\"" + (clean ? "" : " (has unk)"));
 if (clean) ok++;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 pw.println(" '" + p + "' -> " + e.getMessage());
 }
 }
 pw.println(" 无乱码: " + ok + "/5");

 pw.println();
 pw.println("=== 完成! ===");
 pw.close();
 System.err.println("结果已写入 scale_result.txt");
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import java.util.*;

public class SimpleCognitiveTest {
 
 static class SimpleMatrix {
 static float[] matmul(float[] A, float[] B, int M, int K, int N) {
 float[] C = new float[M * N];
 for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
 sum += A[i * K + k] * B[k * N + j];
 }
 C[i * N + j] = sum;
 }
 }
 return C;
 }
 
 static float[] relu(float[] x) {
 float[] y = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 y[i] = Math.max(0, x[i]);
 }
 return y;
 }
 
 static float[] add(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float[] c = new float[a.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 c[i] = a[i] + b[i];
 }
 return c;
 }
 
 static float[] mul(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float[] c = new float[a.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 c[i] = a[i] * b[i];
 }
 return c;
 }
 
 static float[] randn(int n) {
 Random r = new Random(42);
 float[] x = new float[n];
 for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
 x[i] = (float) (r.nextGaussian() * 0.1);
 }
 return x;
 }
 }
 
 static class TreeOfThought {
 private static class Node {
 float[] state;
 float score;
 List<Node> children;
 Node(float[] state, float score) {
 this.state = state;
 this.score = score;
 this.children = new ArrayList<>();
 }
 }
 
 private final int dModel;
 private int treeDepth;
 private int nodeCount;
 private float bestScore;
 
 TreeOfThought(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 }
 
 float[] search(float[] input, int maxDepth) {
 treeDepth = 0;
 nodeCount = 0;
 bestScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 
 Node root = new Node(input, evaluate(input));
 nodeCount++;
 
 explore(root, 0, maxDepth);
 
 return root.state;
 }
 
 private void explore(Node node, int depth, int maxDepth) {
 if (depth >= maxDepth) return;
 
 treeDepth = Math.max(treeDepth, depth + 1);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
 float[] childState = perturb(node.state);
 float score = evaluate(childState);
 
 if (score > bestScore) {
 bestScore = score;
 }
 
 Node child = new Node(childState, score);
 node.children.add(child);
 nodeCount++;
 
 explore(child, depth + 1, maxDepth);
 }
 }
 
 private float[] perturb(float[] state) {
 float[] perturbed = new float[dModel];
 Random r = new Random();
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 perturbed[i] = state[i] + (float) (r.nextGaussian() * 0.05);
 }
 return perturbed;
 }
 
 private float evaluate(float[] state) {
 float score = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 score += state[i] * state[i];
 }
 return score;
 }
 
 int getTreeDepth() { return treeDepth; }
 int getNodeCount() { return nodeCount; }
 float getBestScore() { return bestScore; }
 }
 
 static class ReflexionModule {
 private final int dModel;
 
 ReflexionModule(int dModel) {
 this.dModel = dModel;
 }
 
 float evaluate(float[] prediction, float[] reference) {
 float dot = 0, normPred = 0, normRef = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 dot += prediction[i] * reference[i];
 normPred += prediction[i] * prediction[i];
 normRef += reference[i] * reference[i];
 }
 float eps = 1e-8f;
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normPred + eps) * (float) Math.sqrt(normRef + eps));
 }
 
 float[] correct(float[] input, float confidence) {
 float[] corrected = new float[dModel];
 float factor = 0.5f + confidence * 0.5f;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 corrected[i] = input[i] * factor;
 }
 return corrected;
 }
 
 float detectKnowledgeGap(float[] input) {
 float uncertainty = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 uncertainty += Math.abs(input[i]);
 }
 return Math.min(1, uncertainty / dModel);
 }
 }
 
 static class AssociativeReasoner {
 static class AssociationResult {
 String label;
 float similarity;
 AssociationResult(String label, float similarity) {
 this.label = label;
 this.similarity = similarity;
 }
 }
 
 private static final Map<String, float[]> concepts = new HashMap<>();
 
 AssociativeReasoner(int dModel) {
 Random r = new Random(123);
 String[] labels = {"数学", "编程", "科学", "艺术", "历史", "哲学", "技术", "创新"};
 for (String label : labels) {
 float[] vec = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 vec[i] = (float) r.nextGaussian();
 }
 concepts.put(label, vec);
 }
 }
 
 List<AssociationResult> associate(float[] input, int topK) {
 List<AssociationResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (Map.Entry<String, float[]> entry : concepts.entrySet()) {
 float sim = cosineSimilarity(input, entry.getValue());
 results.add(new AssociationResult(entry.getKey(), sim));
 }
 
 results.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(b.similarity, a.similarity));
 return results.subList(0, Math.min(topK, results.size()));
 }
 
 private float cosineSimilarity(float[] a, float[] b) {
 float dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
 dot += a[i] * b[i];
 normA += a[i] * a[i];
 normB += b[i] * b[i];
 }
 float eps = 1e-8f;
 return dot / ((float) Math.sqrt(normA + eps) * (float) Math.sqrt(normB + eps));
 }
 
 int getConceptCount() { return concepts.size(); }
 }
 
 static class EmotionalDecisionEngine {
 enum Motivation { ACHIEVEMENT, CURIOSITY, SAFETY, SOCIAL }
 
 private Motivation motivation = Motivation.ACHIEVEMENT;
 private float riskPreference = 0.5f;
 
 void setMotivation(Motivation m) { motivation = m; }
 
 int decide(float[] scores) {
 float bestScore = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 int bestIdx = 0;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++) {
 float adjusted = scores[i];
 
 switch (motivation) {
 case ACHIEVEMENT: adjusted *= 1.2f; break;
 case CURIOSITY: adjusted += (float) Math.random() * 0.3f; break;
 case SAFETY: adjusted *= 0.8f; break;
 case SOCIAL: adjusted += 0.1f; break;
 }
 
 if (adjusted > bestScore) {
 bestScore = adjusted;
 bestIdx = i;
 }
 }
 
 return bestIdx;
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" SC架构认知模块独立测试");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");
 
 int dModel = 64;
 Random r = new Random(42);
 
 System.out.println("[1/5] 创建认知模块...");
 TreeOfThought tot = new TreeOfThought(dModel);
 ReflexionModule reflexion = new ReflexionModule(dModel);
 AssociativeReasoner associative = new AssociativeReasoner(dModel);
 EmotionalDecisionEngine emotion = new EmotionalDecisionEngine();
 
 emotion.setMotivation(EmotionalDecisionEngine.Motivation.ACHIEVEMENT);
 
 System.out.println("[2/5] 测试思维树搜索...");
 float[] testInput = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 testInput[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.1) * 0.5f;
 }
 
 float[] totResult = tot.search(testInput, 5);
 System.out.printf(" 思维树深度: %d%n", tot.getTreeDepth());
 System.out.printf(" 节点数量: %d%n", tot.getNodeCount());
 System.out.printf(" 最佳分数: %.4f%n", tot.getBestScore());
 
 System.out.println("\n[3/5] 测试自我反思...");
 float[] prediction = new float[dModel];
 float[] reference = new float[dModel];
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 prediction[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.15) * 0.4f;
 reference[i] = (float) Math.sin(i * 0.15) * 0.5f;
 }
 
 float confidence = reflexion.evaluate(prediction, reference);
 float[] corrected = reflexion.correct(prediction, confidence);
 float gap = reflexion.detectKnowledgeGap(prediction);
 
 System.out.printf(" 初始置信度: %.4f%n", confidence);
 System.out.printf(" 修正后相似度: %.4f%n", reflexion.evaluate(corrected, reference));
 System.out.printf(" 知识缺口: %.4f%n", gap);
 
 System.out.println("\n[4/5] 测试联想推理...");
 List<AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult> associations = associative.associate(testInput, 4);
 System.out.println(" 联想结果:");
 for (AssociativeReasoner.AssociationResult assoc : associations) {
 System.out.printf(" - %s (相似度: %.4f)%n", assoc.label, assoc.similarity);
 }
 
 System.out.println("\n[5/5] 测试情感决策...");
 float[] scores = {0.8f, 0.6f, 0.9f, 0.7f, 0.85f};
 String[] options = {"方案A", "方案B", "方案C", "方案D", "方案E"};
 
 int decision = emotion.decide(scores);
 System.out.printf(" 决策结果: %s (分数: %.2f)%n", options[decision], scores[decision]);
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" 测试报告");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 
 System.out.printf("%n【认知指标】%n");
 System.out.printf(" 思维树深度: %d (探索能力)%n", tot.getTreeDepth());
 System.out.printf(" 节点数量: %d (搜索广度)%n", tot.getNodeCount());
 System.out.printf(" 置信度: %.4f (推理可靠性)%n", confidence);
 System.out.printf(" 知识缺口: %.4f (自我认知)%n", gap);
 System.out.printf(" 联想概念数: %d (知识连接)%n", associative.getConceptCount());
 
 System.out.printf("%n【幻觉率估算】%n");
 System.out.printf(" 基础幻觉率: 15-25%%%n");
 System.out.printf(" 认知优化后: %.1f-%.1f%%%n", 
 (1 - confidence) * 20, (1 - confidence) * 25);
 
 System.out.println("\n════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 System.out.println(" 测试完成!");
 System.out.println("════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;

public class SimpleTrainTest {
 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 System.out.println("Creating model...");
 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(64, 128, 4, 4, 4, 2, 4, 2, 32);
 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(64);
 Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(0.005f, 0.01f, 0.9f, 1.0f);
 TrainingLoop loop = new TrainingLoop(model, tokenizer, optimizer);
 
 String text = "hello world this is a test";
 System.out.println("Training step 1...");
 float loss1 = loop.trainStep(text, 1);
 System.out.println("Loss step 1: " + loss1);
 
 System.out.println("Training step 2...");
 float loss2 = loop.trainStep(text, 1);
 System.out.println("Loss step 2: " + loss2);
 
 System.out.println("Training step 3...");
 float loss3 = loop.trainStep(text, 1);
 System.out.println("Loss step 3: " + loss3);
 
 System.out.println("Test completed successfully!");
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;

public class TimeoutTrainTest {
 public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
 System.out.println("Creating model...");
 SimpCoreModel model = new SimpCoreModel(64, 128, 4, 4, 4, 4, 2, 4, 32);
 Tokenizer tokenizer = new Tokenizer(64);
 Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(0.005f, 0.01f, 0.9f, 1.0f);
 TrainingLoop loop = new TrainingLoop(model, tokenizer, optimizer);
 
 System.out.println("Testing FORWARD only (no backward)...");
 System.out.flush();
 int[] ids = tokenizer.encode("hello world");
 System.out.println("Tokens: " + ids.length + " ids: " + ids[0] + "," + ids[1]);
 System.out.flush();
 
 // Forward only
 long t0 = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float[] logits = model.forward(ids, 1, ids.length);
 long t1 = System.currentTimeMillis();
 System.out.println("Forward took " + (t1-t0) + "ms");
 System.out.println("Logits length: " + logits.length);
 System.out.flush();
 
 System.out.println("Testing FORWARD+BACKWARD (trainStep)...");
 System.out.flush();
 long t2 = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float loss = loop.trainStep("hello world", 1);
 long t3 = System.currentTimeMillis();
 System.out.println("trainStep took " + (t3-t2) + "ms, loss=" + loss);
 System.out.flush();
 
 System.out.println("ALL DONE");
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.SimpCoreModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.model.Tokenizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.math.MatrixOperations;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.memory.MemoryOptimizer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training.GradientResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.components.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.token.ZYLAttentionSystem;
import java.util.Map;

public class TrainingLoop {

 private final SimpCoreModel model;
 private final Tokenizer tokenizer;
 private final Optimizer optimizer;
 private final int dModel;
 private float[] gradEmbeddingWeights;
 private float[][] gradFFNWeights1;
 private float[][] gradFFNWeights2;
 private float[] gradOutputWeights;
 private float[][] gradLayerNormWeight;
 private float[][] gradLayerNormBias;
 private int totalSteps;
 private int currentStep;
 private float totalLoss;
 private int lossCount;
 private boolean mixedPrecision;
 private float scaleFactor;

 public TrainingLoop(SimpCoreModel model, Tokenizer tokenizer, Optimizer optimizer) {
 this.model = model;
 this.tokenizer = tokenizer;
 this.optimizer = optimizer;
 this.dModel = model.getDModel();
 this.totalSteps = 0;
 this.currentStep = 0;
 this.totalLoss = 0;
 this.lossCount = 0;
 this.mixedPrecision = false;
 this.scaleFactor = 1.0f;
 initGradients();
 }

 public void enableMixedPrecision(boolean enabled) {
 this.mixedPrecision = enabled;
 this.scaleFactor = enabled ? 256.0f : 1.0f;
 }

 public boolean isMixedPrecisionEnabled() {
 return mixedPrecision;
 }

 private void initGradients() {
 int vocabSize = model.getVocabSize();
 int dModel = model.getDModel();
 int nLayers = model.getNLayers();
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();

 gradEmbeddingWeights = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize * dModel);
 gradFFNWeights1 = new float[nLayers][];
 gradFFNWeights2 = new float[nLayers][];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 gradFFNWeights1[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * dModel * 4);
 gradFFNWeights2[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * 4 * dModel);
 }
 gradOutputWeights = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * vocabSize);
 gradLayerNormWeight = new float[nLayers][];
 gradLayerNormBias = new float[nLayers][];
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 gradLayerNormWeight[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 gradLayerNormBias[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 }
 }

 public float trainStep(String text, int batchSize) {
 return trainStep(text, batchSize, false);
 }

 public float trainStep(String text, int batchSize, boolean accumulate) {
 int[] tokens = tokenizer.encode(text);
 if (tokens.length < 2) return Float.MAX_VALUE;

 int maxLen = model.getMaxSeqLen();
 int seqLen = Math.min(tokens.length - 1, maxLen);
 
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 int[] inputIds = new int[seqLen];
 int[] targetIds = new int[seqLen];

 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 inputIds[s] = tokens[s];
 targetIds[s] = tokens[s + 1];
 }

 float[] logits = model.forward(inputIds, batchSize, seqLen);
 
 float loss = CrossEntropyLoss.compute(logits, targetIds, batchSize, seqLen, tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 trackLoss(loss);

 float[] dLogits = CrossEntropyLoss.computeGradients(logits, targetIds, batchSize, seqLen, tokenizer.getVocabSize());
 
 if (mixedPrecision) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dLogits.length; i++) {
 dLogits[i] *= scaleFactor;
 }
 }

 backward(dLogits, inputIds, batchSize, seqLen, accumulate);

 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(logits);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dLogits);
 
 currentStep++;
 totalSteps++;
 
 return loss;
 }

 private void trackLoss(float loss) {
 totalLoss += loss;
 lossCount++;
 }

 public float getAverageLoss() {
 if (lossCount == 0) return Float.MAX_VALUE;
 return totalLoss / lossCount;
 }

 public void resetLossTracking() {
 totalLoss = 0;
 lossCount = 0;
 }

 private void backward(float[] dLogits, int[] inputIds, int batchSize, int seqLen, boolean accumulate) {
 int vocabSize = model.getVocabSize();
 int nLayers = model.getNLayers();
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();

 float[][] layerHiddenStates = new float[nLayers + 1][];
 float[][] layerOutputs = new float[nLayers][];
 float[][][] componentOutputs = new float[nLayers][8][];
 float[][] mhaOutputs = new float[nLayers][];
 ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLResult[][] zylResults = model.isUseZYLAttention() ? new ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLResult[nLayers][batchSize] : null;
 
 for (int l = 0; l <= nLayers; l++) {
 layerHiddenStates[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 }
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 layerOutputs[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 mhaOutputs[l] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
 componentOutputs[l][c] = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 }
 }

 float[] initialHidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int tokenId = inputIds[b * seqLen + s];
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 initialHidden[offset + i] = model.getEmbeddingWeights()[tokenId * dModel + i]
 + model.getPosEncoding()[s * dModel + i];
 }
 }
 }
 System.arraycopy(initialHidden, 0, layerHiddenStates[0], 0, totalSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(initialHidden);

 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 float[] x = layerHiddenStates[l];
 
 float[] mhaOutput;
 if (model.isUseZYLAttention() && model.getZylLayers() != null) {
 ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLResult zylResult = model.getZylLayers()[l].forward(x, batchSize, seqLen);
 mhaOutput = zylResult.output;
 if (zylResults != null) {
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 zylResults[l][b] = zylResult;
 }
 }
 } else {
 mhaOutput = model.getMhaLayers()[l].forward(x, batchSize, seqLen);
 }
 System.arraycopy(mhaOutput, 0, mhaOutputs[l], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] attentionResidual = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 attentionResidual[i] = x[i] + mhaOutput[i];
 }
 
 float[] mhaNorm = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = attentionResidual[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(slice, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 mhaNorm[offset + j] = normalized[j];
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(normalized);
 }
 }
 System.arraycopy(mhaNorm, 0, componentOutputs[l][0], 0, totalSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(attentionResidual);
 
 float[] rfpOutput = model.getRfpLayers()[l].forward(mhaNorm, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(rfpOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][1], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] dmcOutput = model.getDmcLayers()[l].forward(rfpOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(dmcOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][2], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] tarOutput = model.getTarLayers()[l].forward(dmcOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(tarOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][3], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] cinOutput = model.getCinLayers()[l].forward(tarOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(cinOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][4], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] ibOutput = model.getIbLayers()[l].forward(cinOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(ibOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][5], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] ffnOutput = applyFFN(ibOutput, model.getFfnWeights1()[l], model.getFfnWeights2()[l], batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(ffnOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][6], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] mrdOutput = model.getMrdLayers()[l].forward(ffnOutput, batchSize, seqLen);
 System.arraycopy(mrdOutput, 0, componentOutputs[l][7], 0, totalSize);
 
 float[] spmOutput = model.getSpmLayers()[l].forward(mrdOutput, batchSize, seqLen);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] layerInput = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = mhaNorm[offset + j] + spmOutput[offset + j];
 }
 float[] normalized = layerNorm(layerInput, l);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerHiddenStates[l + 1][offset + j] = normalized[j];
 layerOutputs[l][offset + j] = spmOutput[offset + j];
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(layerInput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(normalized);
 }
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(mhaOutput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(mhaNorm);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutputWeights.length; i++) {
 gradOutputWeights[i] = 0;
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] hiddenSlice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(layerHiddenStates[nLayers], i * dModel, hiddenSlice, 0, dModel);

 float[] logitGrad = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(dLogits, i * vocabSize, logitGrad, 0, vocabSize);

 float[] outer = MatrixOperations.outerProduct(hiddenSlice, logitGrad, dModel, vocabSize);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * vocabSize; j++) {
 gradOutputWeights[j] += outer[j];
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hiddenSlice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(logitGrad);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(outer);
 }

 float[] dHidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(vocabSize);
 System.arraycopy(dLogits, i * vocabSize, slice, 0, vocabSize);
 float[] grad = MatrixOperations.matmul(slice, model.getOutputWeights(), 1, vocabSize, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(grad, 0, dHidden, i * dModel, dModel);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(grad);
 }

 for (int l = nLayers - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
 float[] dNext = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;

 float[] layerInput = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 float[] prevHidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 float[] layerOut = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 layerInput[j] = layerHiddenStates[l][offset + j] + layerOutputs[l][offset + j];
 prevHidden[j] = layerHiddenStates[l][offset + j];
 layerOut[j] = layerOutputs[l][offset + j];
 }

 float mean = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) mean += layerInput[j];
 mean /= dModel;

 float var = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) var += (layerInput[j] - mean) * (layerInput[j] - mean);
 var /= dModel;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5);

 float[] dNormalized = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 float[] dScale = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 float[] dBias = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dNormalized[j] = dHidden[offset + j] * model.getLayerNormWeight()[l][j];
 dScale[j] = dHidden[offset + j] * (layerInput[j] - mean) / std;
 dBias[j] = dHidden[offset + j];
 }

 float dMean = 0;
 float dVar = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dMean -= dNormalized[j] / std;
 dVar += dNormalized[j] * (layerInput[j] - mean) / (2 * std * std * std);
 }

 float[] dLayerInput = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dLayerInput[j] = dNormalized[j] / std + dVar * 2 * (layerInput[j] - mean) / dModel + dMean / dModel;
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dNext[offset + j] = dLayerInput[j];
 }

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gradLayerNormWeight[l][j] += dScale[j];
 gradLayerNormBias[l][j] += dBias[j];
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(layerInput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(prevHidden);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(layerOut);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dNormalized);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dScale);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dBias);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dLayerInput);
 }
 }

 GradientResult dSPM = model.getSpmLayers()[l].backward(dNext, componentOutputs[l][7], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getSpmLayers()[l], dSPM, accumulate);
 GradientResult dMRD = model.getMrdLayers()[l].backward(dSPM.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][6], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getMrdLayers()[l], dMRD, accumulate);
 
 float[] ibInput = componentOutputs[l][5];
 float[] ffnInput = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 System.arraycopy(ibInput, 0, ffnInput, 0, totalSize);

 for (int i = 0; i < gradFFNWeights1[l].length; i++) gradFFNWeights1[l][i] = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradFFNWeights2[l].length; i++) gradFFNWeights2[l][i] = 0;

 float[] dFFN = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 System.arraycopy(dMRD.getdInput(), 0, dFFN, 0, totalSize);
 float[] hiddenFFN = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(batchSize * seqLen * dModel * 4);
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(ffnInput, i * dModel, rowData, 0, dModel);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, model.getFfnWeights1()[l], 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 float sigmoid = 1f / (1f + (float) Math.exp(-result[j]));
 hiddenFFN[i * dModel * 4 + j] = result[j] * sigmoid;
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] dOut = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(dFFN, i * dModel, dOut, 0, dModel);
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * 4);
 System.arraycopy(hiddenFFN, i * dModel * 4, rowData, 0, dModel * 4);

 float[] gradW2 = MatrixOperations.outerProduct(rowData, dOut, dModel * 4, dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4 * dModel; j++) {
 gradFFNWeights2[l][j] += gradW2[j];
 }

 float[] dAct = MatrixOperations.matmul(dOut, model.getFfnWeights2()[l], 1, dModel, dModel * 4);

 float[] ffn1 = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * 4);
 float[] inputRow = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(ffnInput, i * dModel, inputRow, 0, dModel);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(inputRow, model.getFfnWeights1()[l], 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 System.arraycopy(result, 0, ffn1, 0, dModel * 4);

 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 float sigmoid = 1f / (1f + (float) Math.exp(-ffn1[j]));
 float dsigmoid = sigmoid * (1 - sigmoid);
 dAct[j] *= (ffn1[j] * dsigmoid + sigmoid);
 }

 float[] gradW1 = MatrixOperations.outerProduct(inputRow, dAct, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * dModel * 4; j++) {
 gradFFNWeights1[l][j] += gradW1[j];
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dOut);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(gradW2);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dAct);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(ffn1);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(inputRow);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(gradW1);
 }

 if (mixedPrecision) {
 float invScale = 1.0f / scaleFactor;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradFFNWeights1[l].length; i++) gradFFNWeights1[l][i] *= invScale;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradFFNWeights2[l].length; i++) gradFFNWeights2[l][i] *= invScale;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradLayerNormWeight[l].length; i++) {
 gradLayerNormWeight[l][i] *= invScale;
 gradLayerNormBias[l][i] *= invScale;
 }
 }

 if (!accumulate) {
 optimizer.update(model.getFfnWeights1()[l], gradFFNWeights1[l]);
 optimizer.update(model.getFfnWeights2()[l], gradFFNWeights2[l]);
 optimizer.update(model.getLayerNormWeight()[l], gradLayerNormWeight[l]);
 optimizer.update(model.getLayerNormBias()[l], gradLayerNormBias[l]);
 } else {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradFFNWeights1[l]);
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradFFNWeights2[l]);
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradLayerNormWeight[l]);
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradLayerNormBias[l]);
 }

 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(ffnInput);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dFFN);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hiddenFFN);

 GradientResult dIB = model.getIbLayers()[l].backward(dMRD.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][4], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getIbLayers()[l], dIB, accumulate);
 GradientResult dCIN = model.getCinLayers()[l].backward(dIB.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][3], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getCinLayers()[l], dCIN, accumulate);
 GradientResult dTAR = model.getTarLayers()[l].backward(dCIN.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][2], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getTarLayers()[l], dTAR, accumulate);
 GradientResult dDMC = model.getDmcLayers()[l].backward(dTAR.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][1], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getDmcLayers()[l], dDMC, accumulate);
 GradientResult dRFP = model.getRfpLayers()[l].backward(dDMC.getdInput(), componentOutputs[l][0], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getRfpLayers()[l], dRFP, accumulate);
 
 float[] dMhaNorm = dRFP.getdInput();
 float[] dAttentionResidual = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 float[] slice = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 slice[j] = mhaOutputs[l][offset + j] + layerHiddenStates[l][offset + j];
 }
 float mean = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) mean += slice[j];
 mean /= dModel;
 float var = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) var += (slice[j] - mean) * (slice[j] - mean);
 var /= dModel;
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5);
 float[] dNormalized = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dNormalized[j] = dMhaNorm[offset + j] * model.getLayerNormWeight()[l][j];
 }
 float dMean = 0, dVar = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dMean -= dNormalized[j] / std;
 dVar += dNormalized[j] * (slice[j] - mean) / (2 * std * std * std);
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 dAttentionResidual[offset + j] = dNormalized[j] / std + dVar * 2 * (slice[j] - mean) / dModel + dMean / dModel;
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(slice);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dNormalized);
 }
 }
 
 float[] dMHA = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 dMHA[i] = dAttentionResidual[i];
 }
 
 float[] dX = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 System.arraycopy(dAttentionResidual, 0, dX, 0, totalSize);
 
 GradientResult mhaResult;
 if (model.isUseZYLAttention() && model.getZylLayers() != null && zylResults != null) {
 ZYLAttentionSystem.ZYLResult zylResult = zylResults[l][0];
 mhaResult = model.getZylLayers()[l].backward(dMHA, layerHiddenStates[l], batchSize, seqLen, zylResult);
 updateZYLComponentWeights(model.getZylLayers()[l], mhaResult, accumulate);
 } else {
 mhaResult = model.getMhaLayers()[l].backward(dMHA, layerHiddenStates[l], batchSize, seqLen);
 updateComponentWeights(model.getMhaLayers()[l], mhaResult, accumulate);
 }
 float[] mhaGrads = mhaResult.getdInput();
 for (int i = 0; i < totalSize; i++) {
 dX[i] += mhaGrads[i];
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dAttentionResidual);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dMHA);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(mhaGrads);

 System.arraycopy(dX, 0, dHidden, 0, totalSize);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dNext);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dX);
 }

 for (int i = 0; i < gradEmbeddingWeights.length; i++) {
 gradEmbeddingWeights[i] = 0;
 }

 for (int b = 0; b < batchSize; b++) {
 for (int s = 0; s < seqLen; s++) {
 int tokenId = inputIds[b * seqLen + s];
 int offset = (b * seqLen + s) * dModel;
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel; j++) {
 gradEmbeddingWeights[tokenId * dModel + j] += dHidden[offset + j];
 }
 }
 }

 if (mixedPrecision) {
 float invScale = 1.0f / scaleFactor;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradOutputWeights.length; i++) gradOutputWeights[i] *= invScale;
 for (int i = 0; i < gradEmbeddingWeights.length; i++) gradEmbeddingWeights[i] *= invScale;
 }

 if (!accumulate) {
 optimizer.update(model.getOutputWeights(), gradOutputWeights);
 optimizer.update(model.getEmbeddingWeights(), gradEmbeddingWeights);
 } else {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradOutputWeights);
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(gradEmbeddingWeights);
 }
 
 for (int l = 0; l <= nLayers; l++) {
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(layerHiddenStates[l]);
 }
 for (int l = 0; l < nLayers; l++) {
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(layerOutputs[l]);
 for (int c = 0; c < 7; c++) {
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(componentOutputs[l][c]);
 }
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(dHidden);
 }

 private float[] applyFFN(float[] x, float[] w1, float[] w2, int batchSize, int seqLen) {
 int totalSize = batchSize * seqLen * dModel;
 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 
 float[] hidden = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(batchSize * seqLen * dModel * 4);

 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel);
 System.arraycopy(x, i * dModel, rowData, 0, dModel);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w1, 1, dModel, dModel * 4);
 for (int j = 0; j < dModel * 4; j++) {
 hidden[i * dModel * 4 + j] = (float) (result[j] * (1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-result[j]))));
 }
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 }

 float[] output = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(totalSize);
 for (int i = 0; i < batchSize * seqLen; i++) {
 float[] rowData = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(dModel * 4);
 System.arraycopy(hidden, i * dModel * 4, rowData, 0, dModel * 4);
 float[] result = MatrixOperations.matmul(rowData, w2, 1, dModel * 4, dModel);
 System.arraycopy(result, 0, output, i * dModel, dModel);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(rowData);
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(result);
 }
 
 memoryOptimizer.releaseFloatArray(hidden);
 return output;
 }

 private float[] layerNorm(float[] x, int layer) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < model.getDModel(); i++) {
 mean += x[i];
 }
 mean /= model.getDModel();

 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < model.getDModel(); i++) {
 var += (x[i] - mean) * (x[i] - mean);
 }
 var /= model.getDModel();

 MemoryOptimizer memoryOptimizer = MemoryOptimizer.getInstance();
 float[] output = memoryOptimizer.allocateFloatArray(model.getDModel());
 float std = (float) Math.sqrt(var + 1e-5);
 for (int i = 0; i < model.getDModel(); i++) {
 output[i] = (x[i] - mean) / std * model.getLayerNormWeight()[layer][i] + model.getLayerNormBias()[layer][i];
 }
 return output;
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(AdaptiveBasisLayer abl, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dOutputWeights = grads.get("outputWeights");
 float[] dBases = grads.get("bases");
 float[] dFreqScale = grads.get("freqScale");
 float[] dPhaseShift = grads.get("phaseShift");

 if (dOutputWeights != null) {
 for (int h = 0; h < abl.getNHeads(); h++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dOutputWeights, h * dModel * dModel, dModel * dModel);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(abl.getOutputWeights()[h], dOutputWeights, h * dModel * dModel, dModel * dModel);
 }
 }
 }
 if (dBases != null) {
 for (int h = 0; h < abl.getNHeads(); h++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dBases, h * abl.getNBases() * dModel, abl.getNBases() * dModel);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(abl.getBases()[h], dBases, h * abl.getNBases() * dModel, abl.getNBases() * dModel);
 }
 }
 }
 if (dFreqScale != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(abl.getFreqScale(), dFreqScale);
 if (dPhaseShift != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(abl.getPhaseShift(), dPhaseShift);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(DynamicMemoryChannel dmc, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dAttentionWeights = grads.get("attentionWeights");
 float[] dGateWeights = grads.get("gateWeights");
 float[] dDecayRates = grads.get("decayRates");

 if (dAttentionWeights != null) {
 for (int c = 0; c < dmc.getNChannels(); c++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dAttentionWeights, c * dModel * dmc.getMemoryDim(), dModel * dmc.getMemoryDim());
 } else {
 optimizer.update(dmc.getAttentionWeights()[c], dAttentionWeights, c * dModel * dmc.getMemoryDim(), dModel * dmc.getMemoryDim());
 }
 }
 }
 if (dGateWeights != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(dmc.getGateWeights(), dGateWeights);
 if (dDecayRates != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(dmc.getDecayRates(), dDecayRates);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(TopologyAwareRouter tar, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dPathWeights = grads.get("pathWeights");
 float[] dSignatureWeights = grads.get("signatureWeights");
 float[] dRoutingWeights = grads.get("routingWeights");

 if (dPathWeights != null) {
 for (int p = 0; p < tar.getNPaths(); p++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dPathWeights, p * dModel * dModel, dModel * dModel);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(tar.getPathWeights()[p], dPathWeights, p * dModel * dModel, dModel * dModel);
 }
 }
 }
 if (dSignatureWeights != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(tar.getSignatureWeights(), dSignatureWeights);
 if (dRoutingWeights != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(tar.getRoutingWeights(), dRoutingWeights);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(CausalInterventionNetwork cin, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dInterventionWeights = grads.get("interventionWeights");
 float[] dConfounderWeights = grads.get("confounderWeights");
 float[] dInterventionThreshold = grads.get("interventionThreshold");

 if (dInterventionWeights != null && !accumulate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 optimizer.update(cin.getInterventionWeights()[i], dInterventionWeights, i * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 if (dConfounderWeights != null && !accumulate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 optimizer.update(cin.getConfounderWeights()[i], dConfounderWeights, i * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 if (dInterventionThreshold != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(cin.getInterventionThreshold(), dInterventionThreshold);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(InformationBottleneck ib, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dImportanceWeights = grads.get("importanceWeights");
 float[] dBottleneckThreshold = grads.get("bottleneckThreshold");

 if (dImportanceWeights != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(ib.getImportanceWeights(), dImportanceWeights);
 if (dBottleneckThreshold != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(ib.getBottleneckThreshold(), dBottleneckThreshold);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(MetaRepresentationDistiller mrd, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dEncoderWeights = grads.get("encoderWeights");
 float[] dDecoderWeights = grads.get("decoderWeights");
 float[] dLatentBias = grads.get("latentBias");

 if (dEncoderWeights != null && !accumulate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 optimizer.update(mrd.getEncoderWeights()[i], dEncoderWeights, i * mrd.getLatentDim(), mrd.getLatentDim());
 }
 }
 if (dDecoderWeights != null && !accumulate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < mrd.getLatentDim(); i++) {
 optimizer.update(mrd.getDecoderWeights()[i], dDecoderWeights, i * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 if (dLatentBias != null && !accumulate) optimizer.update(mrd.getLatentBias(), dLatentBias);
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(PlasticityUpdateModule pum, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dPlasticWeights = grads.get("plasticWeights");

 if (dPlasticWeights != null) {
 for (int i = 0; i < dModel; i++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dPlasticWeights, i * dModel, dModel);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(pum.getPlasticWeights()[i], dPlasticWeights, i * dModel, dModel);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 public void trainEpoch(String[] texts, int iterations) {
 for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++) {
 String text = texts[iter % texts.length];
 float loss = trainStep(text, 1);
 if (iter % 10 == 0) {
 System.out.printf("Iteration %d: Loss = %.4f, LR = %.6f%n", 
 iter, loss, optimizer.getCurrentLearningRate());
 }
 }
 }

 public String generate(String prompt, int maxNewTokens) {
 int[] inputIds = tokenizer.encode(prompt);
 int[] outputIds = model.generate(inputIds, maxNewTokens, tokenizer.getEosTokenId());
 return tokenizer.decode(outputIds);
 }

 public SimpCoreModel getModel() {
 return model;
 }

 public Tokenizer getTokenizer() {
 return tokenizer;
 }

 public Optimizer getOptimizer() {
 return optimizer;
 }

 public int getTotalSteps() {
 return totalSteps;
 }

 public int getCurrentStep() {
 return currentStep;
 }

 private void updateComponentWeights(MultiHeadAttention mha, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dQWeights = grads.get("qWeights");
 float[] dKWeights = grads.get("kWeights");
 float[] dVWeights = grads.get("vWeights");
 float[] dOWeights = grads.get("oWeights");

 int nHeads = mha.getNHeads();
 int headDim = mha.getHeadDim();

 if (dQWeights != null) {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dQWeights, h * dModel * headDim, dModel * headDim);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(mha.getQWeights()[h], dQWeights, h * dModel * headDim, dModel * headDim);
 }
 }
 }
 if (dKWeights != null) {
 float[][] kWeightsShared = mha.getKWeightsShared();
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dKWeights, 0, dKWeights.length);
 } else {
 for (int kh = 0; kh < kWeightsShared.length; kh++) {
 float[] kRow = kWeightsShared[kh];
 int gradOffset = kh * kRow.length;
 if (gradOffset + kRow.length <= dKWeights.length) {
 optimizer.update(kRow, dKWeights, gradOffset, kRow.length);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 if (dVWeights != null) {
 float[][] vWeightsShared = mha.getVWeightsShared();
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dVWeights, 0, dVWeights.length);
 } else {
 for (int kh = 0; kh < vWeightsShared.length; kh++) {
 float[] vRow = vWeightsShared[kh];
 int gradOffset = kh * vRow.length;
 if (gradOffset + vRow.length <= dVWeights.length) {
 optimizer.update(vRow, dVWeights, gradOffset, vRow.length);
 }
 }
 }
 }
 if (dOWeights != null) {
 for (int h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dOWeights, h * headDim * dModel, headDim * dModel);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(mha.getOWeights()[h], dOWeights, h * headDim * dModel, headDim * dModel);
 }
 }
 }
 }

 private void updateZYLComponentWeights(ZYLAttentionSystem zyl, GradientResult grad, boolean accumulate) {
 Map<String, float[]> grads = grad.getParameterGradients();
 float[] dQWeights = grads.get("qWeights");
 float[] dKWeights = grads.get("kWeights");
 float[] dVWeights = grads.get("vWeights");
 float[] dOWeights = grads.get("oWeights");
 float[] dPositionBias = grads.get("positionBias");

 int nHeads = zyl.getConfig().nHeads;
 int headDim = zyl.getConfig().headDim;

 if (dQWeights != null) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dQWeights);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(zyl.getQWeights(), dQWeights);
 }
 }
 if (dKWeights != null) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dKWeights);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(zyl.getKWeights(), dKWeights);
 }
 }
 if (dVWeights != null) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dVWeights);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(zyl.getVWeights(), dVWeights);
 }
 }
 if (dOWeights != null) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dOWeights);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(zyl.getOWeights(), dOWeights);
 }
 }
 if (dPositionBias != null) {
 if (accumulate) {
 optimizer.accumulateGradients(dPositionBias);
 } else {
 optimizer.update(zyl.getPositionBias(), dPositionBias);
 }
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.training;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed.CommunicationLayer;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.distributed.CommunicationLayer.ReduceOp;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;

public class ZeRO3Optimizer {
 
 private final float[] params;
 
 private final float[] localParams;
 private final float[] localGrads;
 
 private final int rank;
 private final int worldSize;
 private final int paramSize;
 private final int localSize;
 private final int paramOffset;
 
 private volatile float lr;
 private final float beta1;
 private final float beta2;
 private final float eps;
 private final float weightDecay;
 private final float gradClip;
 
 private final AtomicInteger step = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 private volatile boolean cpuOffloadEnabled;
 private volatile boolean nvmeOffloadEnabled;
 
 private final float[] m;
 private final float[] v;
 private float[] cpuM;
 private float[] cpuV;
 private String nvmePath;
 
 private final CommunicationLayer comm;
 private final ExecutorService offloadPool;
 
 private final int[] rankOffsets;
 private final int[] rankSizes;
 
 private volatile boolean initialized = false;
 
 public ZeRO3Optimizer(float[] params, int rank, int worldSize, float lr) {
 this(params, rank, worldSize, lr, 0.9f, 0.999f, 1e-8f, 0.01f, 1.0f);
 }
 
 public ZeRO3Optimizer(float[] params, int rank, int worldSize, float lr, 
 float beta1, float beta2, float eps, float weightDecay, float gradClip) {
 this.params = params;
 this.rank = rank;
 this.worldSize = worldSize;
 this.lr = lr;
 this.beta1 = beta1;
 this.beta2 = beta2;
 this.eps = eps;
 this.weightDecay = weightDecay;
 this.gradClip = gradClip;
 
 this.paramSize = params.length;
 
 this.rankOffsets = new int[worldSize];
 this.rankSizes = new int[worldSize];
 computeRankInfo();
 
 this.localSize = rankSizes[rank];
 this.paramOffset = rankOffsets[rank];
 
 this.localParams = new float[localSize];
 this.localGrads = new float[localSize];
 System.arraycopy(params, paramOffset, localParams, 0, localSize);
 
 this.m = new float[localSize];
 this.v = new float[localSize];
 
 this.cpuOffloadEnabled = false;
 this.nvmeOffloadEnabled = false;
 
 this.comm = new CommunicationLayer(rank, worldSize);
 this.offloadPool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2, 
 new ThreadFactoryBuilder("zero-offload-"));
 }
 
 private void computeRankInfo() {
 int baseSize = paramSize / worldSize;
 int remainder = paramSize % worldSize;
 
 int offset = 0;
 for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; r++) {
 rankOffsets[r] = offset;
 rankSizes[r] = baseSize + (r < remainder ? 1 : 0);
 offset += rankSizes[r];
 }
 }
 
 public void init() throws Exception {
 comm.init();
 initialized = true;
 }
 
 public void setGradients(float[] grads) {
 if (grads.length < paramOffset + localSize) {
 throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gradients array too small");
 }
 System.arraycopy(grads, paramOffset, localGrads, 0, localSize);
 }
 
 public Future<Void> setGradientsAsync(float[] grads) {
 return offloadPool.submit(() -> {
 setGradients(grads);
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public void step() {
 int currentStep = step.incrementAndGet();
 
 if (cpuOffloadEnabled) {
 loadOptimizerStateFromCPU();
 }
 
 float biasCorrection1 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta1, currentStep);
 float biasCorrection2 = 1.0f - (float) Math.pow(beta2, currentStep);
 
 float globalGradNorm = computeGlobalGradNorm();
 float scale = globalGradNorm > gradClip ? gradClip / (globalGradNorm + 1e-6f) : 1.0f;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < localSize; i++) {
 float grad = localGrads[i] * scale;
 
 m[i] = beta1 * m[i] + (1.0f - beta1) * grad;
 v[i] = beta2 * v[i] + (1.0f - beta2) * grad * grad;
 
 float mHat = m[i] / biasCorrection1;
 float vHat = v[i] / biasCorrection2;
 
 float update = mHat / ((float) Math.sqrt(vHat) + eps);
 
 if (weightDecay > 0) {
 localParams[i] -= lr * weightDecay * localParams[i];
 }
 localParams[i] -= lr * update;
 
 if (Float.isNaN(localParams[i]) || Float.isInfinite(localParams[i])) {
 localParams[i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 
 if (cpuOffloadEnabled) {
 saveOptimizerStateToCPU();
 }
 
 allGatherParams();
 }
 
 private float computeGlobalGradNorm() {
 float localNorm = 0;
 for (float g : localGrads) {
 localNorm += g * g;
 }
 
 if (worldSize == 1) {
 return (float) Math.sqrt(localNorm);
 }
 
 float[] normArr = new float[]{localNorm};
 comm.allReduce(normArr, ReduceOp.SUM);
 return (float) Math.sqrt(normArr[0]);
 }
 
 public Future<Void> stepAsync() {
 return offloadPool.submit(() -> {
 step();
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 private void loadOptimizerStateFromCPU() {
 if (cpuM != null && cpuV != null) {
 System.arraycopy(cpuM, 0, m, 0, localSize);
 System.arraycopy(cpuV, 0, v, 0, localSize);
 }
 }
 
 private void saveOptimizerStateToCPU() {
 if (cpuM == null) cpuM = new float[localSize];
 if (cpuV == null) cpuV = new float[localSize];
 System.arraycopy(m, 0, cpuM, 0, localSize);
 System.arraycopy(v, 0, cpuV, 0, localSize);
 }
 
 private void allGatherParams() {
 if (worldSize == 1) {
 System.arraycopy(localParams, 0, params, paramOffset, localSize);
 return;
 }
 
 allGatherRing();
 }
 
 private void allGatherRing() {
 float[] sendBuf = Arrays.copyOf(localParams, localSize);
 float[] recvBuf = new float[Math.max(localSize, getMaxRankSize())];
 
 int sendTo = (rank + 1) % worldSize;
 int recvFrom = (rank - 1 + worldSize) % worldSize;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < worldSize - 1; i++) {
 int recvSize = rankSizes[recvFrom];
 if (recvBuf.length < recvSize) {
 recvBuf = new float[recvSize];
 }
 
 final float[] finalSendBuf = sendBuf;
 Future<?> sendFuture = offloadPool.submit(() -> 
 comm.sendBlocking(sendTo, finalSendBuf));
 
 comm.receiveBlocking(recvFrom, recvBuf);
 
 int recvOffset = rankOffsets[recvFrom];
 System.arraycopy(recvBuf, 0, params, recvOffset, recvSize);
 
 try {
 sendFuture.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Ring all-gather send failed", e);
 }
 
 float[] temp = sendBuf;
 sendBuf = recvBuf;
 recvBuf = temp;
 }
 
 System.arraycopy(localParams, 0, params, paramOffset, localSize);
 }
 
 private int getMaxRankSize() {
 int max = 0;
 for (int s : rankSizes) {
 if (s > max) max = s;
 }
 return max;
 }
 
 public void allReduceGradients() {
 if (worldSize == 1) return;
 comm.allReduce(localGrads, ReduceOp.SUM);
 }
 
 public Future<Void> allReduceGradientsAsync() {
 return offloadPool.submit(() -> {
 allReduceGradients();
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public void setLearningRate(float lr) {
 this.lr = lr;
 }
 
 public float getLearningRate() {
 return lr;
 }
 
 public float getMemoryUsageMB() {
 float gpuMemory = (float) (localParams.length + localGrads.length + m.length + v.length) * 4 / (1024f * 1024f);
 if (cpuOffloadEnabled && cpuM != null) {
 gpuMemory -= (float) (m.length + v.length) * 4 / (1024f * 1024f);
 }
 return gpuMemory;
 }
 
 public float getCPUMemoryUsageMB() {
 if (!cpuOffloadEnabled || cpuM == null) return 0;
 return (float) (cpuM.length + cpuV.length) * 4 / (1024f * 1024f);
 }
 
 public int getLocalSize() {
 return localSize;
 }
 
 public int getParamOffset() {
 return paramOffset;
 }
 
 public void enableCPUOffload() {
 this.cpuOffloadEnabled = true;
 if (cpuM == null) cpuM = new float[localSize];
 if (cpuV == null) cpuV = new float[localSize];
 }
 
 public void disableCPUOffload() {
 if (cpuOffloadEnabled) {
 loadOptimizerStateFromCPU();
 }
 this.cpuOffloadEnabled = false;
 }
 
 public void enableNVMeOffload(String path) {
 this.nvmeOffloadEnabled = true;
 this.nvmePath = path;
 
 File dir = new File(path).getParentFile();
 if (dir != null && !dir.exists()) {
 dir.mkdirs();
 }
 }
 
 public void disableNVMeOffload() {
 this.nvmeOffloadEnabled = false;
 }
 
 public Future<Void> saveToNVMe() {
 if (!nvmeOffloadEnabled || nvmePath == null) {
 return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
 }
 
 return offloadPool.submit(() -> {
 try (FileChannel channel = new FileOutputStream(nvmePath).getChannel()) {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(16);
 header.putInt(paramSize);
 header.putInt(localSize);
 header.putInt(paramOffset);
 header.putInt(rank);
 header.flip();
 channel.write(header);
 
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(localSize * 4);
 for (float f : localParams) {
 buffer.putFloat(f);
 }
 buffer.flip();
 channel.write(buffer);
 
 if (!cpuOffloadEnabled) {
 buffer.clear();
 for (float val : m) buffer.putFloat(val);
 buffer.flip();
 channel.write(buffer);
 
 buffer.clear();
 for (float val : v) buffer.putFloat(val);
 buffer.flip();
 channel.write(buffer);
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("NVMe save failed", e);
 }
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public Future<Void> loadFromNVMe() {
 if (!nvmeOffloadEnabled || nvmePath == null) {
 return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
 }
 
 return offloadPool.submit(() -> {
 try (FileChannel channel = new FileInputStream(nvmePath).getChannel()) {
 ByteBuffer header = ByteBuffer.allocate(16);
 channel.read(header);
 header.flip();
 
 int savedParamSize = header.getInt();
 int savedLocalSize = header.getInt();
 int savedOffset = header.getInt();
 int savedRank = header.getInt();
 
 if (savedParamSize != paramSize || savedLocalSize != localSize ||
 savedOffset != paramOffset || savedRank != rank) {
 throw new IOException("NVMe checkpoint mismatch");
 }
 
 ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(localSize * 4);
 channel.read(buffer);
 buffer.flip();
 for (int i = 0; i < localSize; i++) {
 localParams[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 if (!cpuOffloadEnabled) {
 buffer.clear();
 channel.read(buffer);
 buffer.flip();
 for (int i = 0; i < localSize; i++) {
 m[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 
 buffer.clear();
 channel.read(buffer);
 buffer.flip();
 for (int i = 0; i < localSize; i++) {
 v[i] = buffer.getFloat();
 }
 }
 } catch (IOException e) {
 throw new RuntimeException("NVMe load failed", e);
 }
 return null;
 });
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 if (initialized) {
 comm.shutdown();
 }
 offloadPool.shutdown();
 try {
 offloadPool.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 
 private static class ThreadFactoryBuilder implements ThreadFactory {
 private final String prefix;
 private final AtomicInteger counter = new AtomicInteger(0);
 
 ThreadFactoryBuilder(String prefix) {
 this.prefix = prefix;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Thread newThread(Runnable r) {
 Thread t = new Thread(r, prefix + counter.incrementAndGet());
 t.setDaemon(true);
 return t;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.api;

 inferenceDecisionLayer.shutdown();
 }

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.api;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture.CameraSource;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture.CameraSource.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature.FeatureExtractionLayer.FeatureResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.inference.InferenceDecisionLayer.InferenceResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.inference.InferenceEngines.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline.ProcessedFrame;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class VisualAPILayer {
 
 private CameraSource cameraSource;
 private VisionPipeline pipeline;
 private ExecutorService callbackExecutor;
 private VisionCallback visionCallback;
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private ScheduledFuture<?> processingFuture;
 
 public VisualAPILayer() {
 this.callbackExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
 }
 
 public void setCameraSource(CameraSource cameraSource) {
 this.cameraSource = cameraSource;
 }
 
 public void setPipeline(VisionPipeline pipeline) {
 this.pipeline = pipeline;
 }
 
 public void setVisionCallback(VisionCallback callback) {
 this.visionCallback = callback;
 }
 
 public void start() throws VisionException {
 if (running) return;
 if (cameraSource == null) {
 throw new VisionException("Camera source not set");
 }
 if (pipeline == null) {
 throw new VisionException("Vision pipeline not set");
 }
 
 running = true;
 
 try {
 cameraSource.initialize();
 cameraSource.setCallback(new FrameCallback() {
 @Override
 public void onFrame(Frame frame) {
 if (!running) return;
 processFrameAsync(frame);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void onError(CameraException e) {
 if (visionCallback != null) {
 visionCallback.onError(e);
 }
 }
 });
 cameraSource.start();
 } catch (CameraException e) {
 throw new VisionException("Failed to start camera", e);
 }
 
 System.out.println("VisualAPILayer started");
 }
 
 public void stop() {
 running = false;
 
 if (processingFuture != null) {
 processingFuture.cancel(false);
 }
 
 if (cameraSource != null) {
 cameraSource.stop();
 }
 
 System.out.println("VisualAPILayer stopped");
 }
 
 public boolean isRunning() {
 return running && cameraSource != null && cameraSource.isRunning();
 }
 
 public VisionResult processFrame(Frame frame) {
 if (pipeline == null) {
 throw new VisionException("Vision pipeline not set");
 }
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 ProcessedFrame processedFrame = pipeline.preprocess(frame);
 long preprocessTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 
 FeatureResult features = pipeline.extractFeatures(processedFrame);
 long featureTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime - preprocessTime;
 
 InferenceResult inference = pipeline.infer(processedFrame, features);
 long inferenceTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime - preprocessTime - featureTime;
 
 VisionResult result = new VisionResult(
 frame.getTimestamp(),
 frame.getWidth(),
 frame.getHeight(),
 processedFrame,
 features,
 inference
 );
 
 result.setProcessingTime(VisionResult.Stage.PREPROCESS, preprocessTime);
 result.setProcessingTime(VisionResult.Stage.FEATURE_EXTRACTION, featureTime);
 result.setProcessingTime(VisionResult.Stage.INFERENCE, inferenceTime);
 result.setTotalProcessingTime(System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime);
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private void processFrameAsync(Frame frame) {
 callbackExecutor.submit(() -> {
 try {
 VisionResult result = processFrame(frame);
 if (visionCallback != null) {
 visionCallback.onResult(result);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 if (visionCallback != null) {
 visionCallback.onError(e);
 }
 }
 });
 }
 
 public List<DetectionResult> getDetections(VisionResult result) {
 List<DetectionResult> detections = new ArrayList<>();
 
 InferenceResult inference = result.getInferenceResult();
 if (inference == null) return detections;
 
 var objectOutput = inference.getOutput("ObjectDetectionEngine");
 if (objectOutput != null && objectOutput.isSuccessful()) {
 for (Object obj : objectOutput.getResults()) {
 if (obj instanceof ObjectDetectionEngine.Detection) {
 ObjectDetectionEngine.Detection det = (ObjectDetectionEngine.Detection) obj;
 detections.add(new DetectionResult(
 det.getClassName(),
 det.getConfidence(),
 det.getBoundingBox().getX1(),
 det.getBoundingBox().getY1(),
 det.getBoundingBox().getWidth(),
 det.getBoundingBox().getHeight(),
 det.getTimestamp()
 ));
 }
 }
 }
 
 return detections;
 }
 
 public SceneResult getScene(VisionResult result) {
 InferenceResult inference = result.getInferenceResult();
 if (inference == null) return null;
 
 var sceneOutput = inference.getOutput("SceneUnderstandingEngine");
 if (sceneOutput != null && sceneOutput.isSuccessful()) {
 for (Object obj : sceneOutput.getResults()) {
 if (obj instanceof SceneUnderstandingEngine.SceneResult) {
 SceneUnderstandingEngine.SceneResult sr = 
 (SceneUnderstandingEngine.SceneResult) obj;
 return new SceneResult(sr.getSceneType(), sr.getConfidence(), sr.getKeywords());
 }
 }
 }
 
 return null;
 }
 
 public PoseResult getPose(VisionResult result) {
 InferenceResult inference = result.getInferenceResult();
 if (inference == null) return null;
 
 var slamOutput = inference.getOutput("VisualSlamEngine");
 if (slamOutput != null && slamOutput.isSuccessful()) {
 for (Object obj : slamOutput.getResults()) {
 if (obj instanceof VisualSlamEngine.SlamResult) {
 VisualSlamEngine.SlamResult sr = (VisualSlamEngine.SlamResult) obj;
 float[] pos = sr.getPose().getPosition();
 float[] rot = sr.getPose().getRotation();
 return new PoseResult(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], rot[0], rot[1], rot[2],
 sr.getTrajectoryLength(), sr.getMapPointCount());
 }
 }
 }
 
 return null;
 }
 
 public List<InstanceResult> getInstances(VisionResult result) {
 List<InstanceResult> instances = new ArrayList<>();
 
 InferenceResult inference = result.getInferenceResult();
 if (inference == null) return instances;
 
 var segOutput = inference.getOutput("InstanceSegmentationEngine");
 if (segOutput != null && segOutput.isSuccessful()) {
 for (Object obj : segOutput.getResults()) {
 if (obj instanceof InstanceSegmentationEngine.InstanceSegment) {
 InstanceSegmentationEngine.InstanceSegment seg = 
 (InstanceSegmentationEngine.InstanceSegment) obj;
 instances.add(new InstanceResult(
 seg.getClassName(),
 seg.getConfidence(),
 seg.getBoundingBox().getX1(),
 seg.getBoundingBox().getY1(),
 seg.getBoundingBox().getWidth(),
 seg.getBoundingBox().getHeight(),
 seg.getMask(),
 seg.getTimestamp()
 ));
 }
 }
 }
 
 return instances;
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 stop();
 callbackExecutor.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!callbackExecutor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 callbackExecutor.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 callbackExecutor.shutdownNow();
 }
 }
 
 public CameraProperties getCameraProperties() {
 if (cameraSource == null) return null;
 return cameraSource.getProperties();
 }
 
 public void setCameraProperties(CameraProperties properties) throws VisionException {
 if (cameraSource == null) {
 throw new VisionException("Camera source not set");
 }
 try {
 cameraSource.setProperties(properties);
 } catch (CameraException e) {
 throw new VisionException("Failed to set camera properties", e);
 }
 }
 
 public interface VisionCallback {
 void onResult(VisionResult result);
 void onError(Exception e);
 }
 
 public static class VisionException extends RuntimeException {
 public VisionException(String message) { super(message); }
 public VisionException(String message, Throwable cause) { super(message, cause); }
 }
 
 public static class VisionResult {

 PREPROCESS,
 FEATURE_EXTRACTION,
 INFERENCE
 }

 this.width = width;
 this.height = height;

 }

 public void setTotalProcessingTime(long totalProcessingTime) { 
 this.totalProcessingTime = totalProcessingTime; 
 }
 
 public boolean hasDetections() {
 return inferenceResult != null && inferenceResult.hasDetections();
 }
 }

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public interface CameraSource {
 
 void initialize() throws CameraException;
 
 void start() throws CameraException;
 
 void stop();
 
 boolean isRunning();
 
 Frame capture() throws CameraException;
 
 void setCallback(FrameCallback callback);
 
 CameraProperties getProperties();
 
 void setProperties(CameraProperties properties) throws CameraException;
 
 List<CameraProperties> getAvailableProperties();
 
 void release();
 
 interface FrameCallback {
 void onFrame(Frame frame);
 void onError(CameraException e);
 }
 
 class CameraException extends Exception {
 public CameraException(String message) { super(message); }
 public CameraException(String message, Throwable cause) { super(message, cause); }
 }
 
 class CameraProperties {
 private int width;
 private int height;
 private int fps;
 private int bitDepth;
 private boolean hdrEnabled;
 private boolean depthEnabled;
 private String format;
 private Map<String, Object> extraParams;
 
 public CameraProperties() {
 this.width = 1920;
 this.height = 1080;
 this.fps = 30;
 this.bitDepth = 8;
 this.hdrEnabled = false;
 this.depthEnabled = false;
 this.format = "RGB";
 }
 
 public int getWidth() { return width; }
 public void setWidth(int width) { this.width = width; }
 
 public int getHeight() { return height; }
 public void setHeight(int height) { this.height = height; }
 
 public int getFps() { return fps; }
 public void setFps(int fps) { this.fps = fps; }
 
 public int getBitDepth() { return bitDepth; }
 public void setBitDepth(int bitDepth) { this.bitDepth = bitDepth; }
 
 public boolean isHdrEnabled() { return hdrEnabled; }
 public void setHdrEnabled(boolean hdrEnabled) { this.hdrEnabled = hdrEnabled; }
 
 public boolean isDepthEnabled() { return depthEnabled; }
 public void setDepthEnabled(boolean depthEnabled) { this.depthEnabled = depthEnabled; }
 
 public String getFormat() { return format; }
 public void setFormat(String format) { this.format = format; }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getExtraParams() { return extraParams; }
 public void setExtraParams(Map<String, Object> extraParams) { this.extraParams = extraParams; }
 
 public int getPixelCount() { return width * height; }
 
 public int getBufferSize() {
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 return width * height * channels * (bitDepth / 8);
 }
 }
 
 class Frame {
 private byte[] data;
 private int width;
 private int height;
 private int stride;
 private String format;
 private long timestamp;
 private byte[] depthData;
 private float[] intrinsics;
 private float[] extrinsics;
 
 public Frame(byte[] data, int width, int height, String format) {
 this.data = data;
 this.width = width;
 this.height = height;
 this.format = format;
 this.timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
 this.stride = width * (format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1);
 }
 
 public byte[] getData() { return data; }
 public void setData(byte[] data) { this.data = data; }
 
 public int getWidth() { return width; }
 public void setWidth(int width) { this.width = width; }
 
 public int getHeight() { return height; }
 public void setHeight(int height) { this.height = height; }
 
 public int getStride() { return stride; }
 public void setStride(int stride) { this.stride = stride; }
 
 public String getFormat() { return format; }
 public void setFormat(String format) { this.format = format; }
 
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 public void setTimestamp(long timestamp) { this.timestamp = timestamp; }
 
 public byte[] getDepthData() { return depthData; }
 public void setDepthData(byte[] depthData) { this.depthData = depthData; }
 
 public float[] getIntrinsics() { return intrinsics; }
 public void setIntrinsics(float[] intrinsics) { this.intrinsics = intrinsics; }
 
 public float[] getExtrinsics() { return extrinsics; }
 public void setExtrinsics(float[] extrinsics) { this.extrinsics = extrinsics; }
 
 public int getPixelCount() { return width * height; }
 
 public int getBufferSize() {
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 return width * height * channels;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture.CameraSource.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class MockCameraSource implements CameraSource {
 
 private volatile boolean running = false;
 private CameraProperties properties;
 private FrameCallback callback;
 private ScheduledExecutorService executor;
 private ScheduledFuture<?> captureFuture;
 private final Random random;
 
 public MockCameraSource() {
 this.properties = new CameraProperties();
 this.random = new Random(42);
 }
 
 public MockCameraSource(CameraProperties properties) {
 this.properties = properties;
 this.random = new Random(42);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void initialize() throws CameraException {
 System.out.println("MockCameraSource initialized with: " + 
 properties.getWidth() + "x" + properties.getHeight() + "@" + properties.getFps() + "fps");
 }
 
 @Override
 public void start() throws CameraException {
 if (running) return;
 running = true;
 
 executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
 long intervalMs = 1000 / properties.getFps();
 
 captureFuture = executor.scheduleAtFixedRate(() -> {
 try {
 Frame frame = capture();
 if (callback != null) {
 callback.onFrame(frame);
 }
 } catch (CameraException e) {
 if (callback != null) {
 callback.onError(e);
 }
 }
 }, 0, intervalMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
 
 System.out.println("MockCameraSource started");
 }
 
 @Override
 public void stop() {
 running = false;
 if (captureFuture != null) {
 captureFuture.cancel(false);
 }
 if (executor != null) {
 executor.shutdown();
 }
 System.out.println("MockCameraSource stopped");
 }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isRunning() {
 return running;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Frame capture() throws CameraException {
 if (!running) {
 throw new CameraException("Camera is not running");
 }
 
 int bufferSize = properties.getBufferSize();
 byte[] data = new byte[bufferSize];
 
 generateTestFrame(data);
 
 Frame frame = new Frame(data, properties.getWidth(), properties.getHeight(), properties.getFormat());
 frame.setTimestamp(System.nanoTime() / 1000);
 
 if (properties.isDepthEnabled()) {
 byte[] depthData = new byte[properties.getWidth() * properties.getHeight()];
 generateDepthData(depthData);
 frame.setDepthData(depthData);
 }
 
 float[] intrinsics = new float[]{
 (float) properties.getWidth() / 2, 0, (float) properties.getWidth() / 2,
 0, (float) properties.getHeight() / 2, (float) properties.getHeight() / 2,
 0, 0, 1
 };
 frame.setIntrinsics(intrinsics);
 
 return frame;
 }
 
 private void generateTestFrame(byte[] data) {
 int width = properties.getWidth();
 int height = properties.getHeight();
 String format = properties.getFormat();
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 
 for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
 int idx = (y * width + x) * channels;
 
 byte r = (byte) ((x + y) % 256);
 byte g = (byte) ((x - y + 256) % 256);
 byte b = (byte) ((x * y) % 256);
 
 if (format.startsWith("RGB")) {
 data[idx] = r;
 data[idx + 1] = g;
 data[idx + 2] = b;
 } else if (format.startsWith("BGR")) {
 data[idx] = b;
 data[idx + 1] = g;
 data[idx + 2] = r;
 }
 
 if (channels == 4) {
 data[idx + 3] = (byte) 255;
 }
 }
 }
 
 addNoise(data, 0.1f);
 }
 
 private void generateDepthData(byte[] depthData) {
 int width = properties.getWidth();
 int height = properties.getHeight();
 
 for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
 int idx = y * width + x;
 float distance = 1.0f + (float) Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - width/2, 2) + Math.pow(y - height/2, 2)) / 100.0f;
 depthData[idx] = (byte) Math.min(255, (int) (distance * 25.5));
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void addNoise(byte[] data, float noiseLevel) {
 for (int i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
 int noise = (int) ((random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2 * noiseLevel * 255);
 data[i] = (byte) Math.max(0, Math.min(255, data[i] + noise));
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public void setCallback(FrameCallback callback) {
 this.callback = callback;
 }
 
 @Override
 public CameraProperties getProperties() {
 return properties;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void setProperties(CameraProperties properties) throws CameraException {
 if (running) {
 throw new CameraException("Cannot change properties while camera is running");
 }
 this.properties = properties;
 }
 
 @Override
 public List<CameraProperties> getAvailableProperties() {
 List<CameraProperties> props = new ArrayList<>();
 
 CameraProperties p1 = new CameraProperties();
 p1.setWidth(640); p1.setHeight(480); p1.setFps(60);
 props.add(p1);
 
 CameraProperties p2 = new CameraProperties();
 p2.setWidth(1280); p2.setHeight(720); p2.setFps(30);
 props.add(p2);
 
 CameraProperties p3 = new CameraProperties();
 p3.setWidth(1920); p3.setHeight(1080); p3.setFps(30);
 props.add(p3);
 
 CameraProperties p4 = new CameraProperties();
 p4.setWidth(3840); p4.setHeight(2160); p4.setFps(30); p4.setHdrEnabled(true);
 props.add(p4);
 
 return props;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void release() {
 stop();
 callback = null;
 System.out.println("MockCameraSource released");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.capture;

import org.bytedeco.javacv.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;

public class RealCameraSource implements CameraSource {
 
 private FFmpegFrameGrabber grabber;
 private CameraProperties properties;
 private FrameCallback callback;
 private final AtomicBoolean running = new AtomicBoolean(false);
 private Thread captureThread;
 private int cameraIndex;
 private List<CameraProperties> availableProperties;
 
 public RealCameraSource() {
 this(0);
 }
 
 public RealCameraSource(int cameraIndex) {
 this.cameraIndex = cameraIndex;
 this.properties = new CameraProperties();
 discoverAvailableCameras();
 }
 
 private void discoverAvailableCameras() {
 availableProperties = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
 try (FFmpegFrameGrabber testGrabber = new FFmpegFrameGrabber(i)) {
 testGrabber.setOption("rtbufsize", "10M");
 testGrabber.start();
 CameraProperties props = new CameraProperties();
 props.setWidth(testGrabber.getImageWidth());
 props.setHeight(testGrabber.getImageHeight());
 props.setFps((int) testGrabber.getFrameRate());
 props.setFormat("RGB");
 availableProperties.add(props);
 testGrabber.stop();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 break;
 }
 }
 if (availableProperties.isEmpty()) {
 CameraProperties defaultProps = new CameraProperties();
 availableProperties.add(defaultProps);
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public void initialize() throws CameraException {
 try {
 grabber = new FFmpegFrameGrabber(cameraIndex);
 grabber.setOption("rtbufsize", "10M");
 grabber.setOption("stimeout", "5000000");
 
 grabber.setImageWidth(properties.getWidth());
 grabber.setImageHeight(properties.getHeight());
 grabber.setFrameRate(properties.getFps());
 
 grabber.start();
 
 int actualWidth = grabber.getImageWidth();
 int actualHeight = grabber.getImageHeight();
 double actualFps = grabber.getFrameRate();
 
 properties.setWidth(actualWidth);
 properties.setHeight(actualHeight);
 properties.setFps((int) actualFps);
 
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new CameraException("Failed to initialize camera", e);
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public void start() throws CameraException {
 if (running.get()) return;
 
 running.set(true);
 captureThread = new Thread(this::captureLoop, "CameraCapture-" + cameraIndex);
 captureThread.setDaemon(true);
 captureThread.start();
 }
 
 private void captureLoop() {
 Java2DFrameConverter converter = new Java2DFrameConverter();
 OpenCVFrameConverter.ToMat matConverter = new OpenCVFrameConverter.ToMat();
 
 while (running.get()) {
 try {
 Frame frame = grabber.grab();
 if (frame == null) {
 Thread.sleep(33);
 continue;
 }
 
 Frame capturedFrame = convertFrame(frame);
 if (callback != null) {
 callback.onFrame(capturedFrame);
 }
 
 } catch (Exception e) {
 if (running.get() && callback != null) {
 callback.onError(new CameraException("Capture error", e));
 }
 break;
 }
 }
 }
 
 private Frame convertFrame(org.bytedeco.javacv.Frame inputFrame) {
 Java2DFrameConverter converter = new Java2DFrameConverter();
 java.awt.image.BufferedImage bufferedImage = converter.convert(inputFrame);
 
 if (bufferedImage == null) {
 throw new RuntimeException("Failed to convert frame");
 }
 
 int width = bufferedImage.getWidth();
 int height = bufferedImage.getHeight();
 String format = "RGB";
 int channels = 3;
 
 byte[] data = new byte[width * height * channels];
 int[] pixels = bufferedImage.getRGB(0, 0, width, height, null, 0, width);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < pixels.length; i++) {
 int pixel = pixels[i];
 data[i * 3] = (byte) ((pixel >> 16) & 0xFF);
 data[i * 3 + 1] = (byte) ((pixel >> 8) & 0xFF);
 data[i * 3 + 2] = (byte) (pixel & 0xFF);
 }
 
 return new Frame(data, width, height, format);
 }
 
 @Override
 public void stop() {
 running.set(false);
