 if (captureThread != null) {
 try {
 captureThread.join(1000);
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
 }
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isRunning() {
 return running.get() && grabber != null;
 }
 
 @Override
 public Frame capture() throws CameraException {
 if (!running.get()) {
 throw new CameraException("Camera not running");
 }
 
 try {
 Frame frame = grabber.grab();
 if (frame == null) {
 return null;
 }
 return convertFrame(frame);
 } catch (Exception e) {
 throw new CameraException("Failed to capture frame", e);
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public void setCallback(FrameCallback callback) {
 this.callback = callback;
 }
 
 @Override
 public CameraProperties getProperties() {
 return properties;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void setProperties(CameraProperties properties) throws CameraException {
 this.properties = properties;
 if (grabber != null) {
 stop();
 initialize();
 start();
 }
 }
 
 @Override
 public List<CameraProperties> getAvailableProperties() {
 return availableProperties;
 }
 
 @Override
 public void release() {
 stop();
 if (grabber != null) {
 try {
 grabber.stop();
 grabber.release();
 } catch (Exception e) {
 // ignore
 }
 grabber = null;
 }
 }
 
 public int getCameraIndex() {
 return cameraIndex;
 }
 
 public void setCameraIndex(int cameraIndex) {
 this.cameraIndex = cameraIndex;
 discoverAvailableCameras();
 }
}


package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline.ProcessedFrame;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class FeatureExtractionLayer {
 
 private final List<FeatureExtractor> extractors;
 private final ExecutorService executor;
 private final int parallelism;
 private volatile boolean running = true;
 
 public FeatureExtractionLayer() {
 this.extractors = new ArrayList<>();
 this.parallelism = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(parallelism);
 }
 
 public FeatureExtractionLayer(int parallelism) {
 this.extractors = new ArrayList<>();
 this.parallelism = parallelism;
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(parallelism);
 }
 
 public void addExtractor(FeatureExtractor extractor) {
 extractors.add(extractor);
 }
 
 public void removeExtractor(FeatureExtractor extractor) {
 extractors.remove(extractor);
 }
 
 public void clearExtractors() {
 extractors.clear();
 }
 
 public FeatureResult extract(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 FeatureResult result = new FeatureResult(frame.getTimestamp());
 
 for (FeatureExtractor extractor : extractors) {
 if (!running) break;
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 FeatureDescriptor descriptor = extractor.extract(frame);
 long endTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 result.addDescriptor(extractor.getName(), descriptor);
 result.addProcessingTime(extractor.getName(), (endTime - startTime) / 1_000_000.0);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public Future<FeatureResult> extractAsync(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 return executor.submit(() -> extract(frame));
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 executor.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 executor.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 executor.shutdownNow();
 }
 }
 
 public int getExtractorCount() {
 return extractors.size();
 }
 
 public interface FeatureExtractor {
 FeatureDescriptor extract(ProcessedFrame frame);
 String getName();
 boolean isEnabled();
 void setEnabled(boolean enabled);
 int getFeatureDim();
 }
 
 public static class FeatureDescriptor {
 private float[] features;
 private int[] keypoints;
 private float[] keypointScores;
 private float[] descriptors;
 private String type;
 private int dimension;
 
 public FeatureDescriptor() {
 this.features = new float[0];
 this.keypoints = new int[0];
 this.keypointScores = new float[0];
 this.descriptors = new float[0];
 this.type = "unknown";
 this.dimension = 0;
 }
 
 public FeatureDescriptor(float[] features, String type) {
 this.features = features;
 this.type = type;
 this.dimension = features.length;
 this.keypoints = new int[0];
 this.keypointScores = new float[0];
 this.descriptors = new float[0];
 }
 
 public FeatureDescriptor(int[] keypoints, float[] descriptors, String type, int dimension) {
 this.keypoints = keypoints;
 this.descriptors = descriptors;
 this.type = type;
 this.dimension = dimension;
 this.features = new float[0];
 this.keypointScores = new float[0];
 }
 
 public float[] getFeatures() { return features; }
 public void setFeatures(float[] features) { 
 this.features = features; 
 this.dimension = features.length;
 }
 
 public int[] getKeypoints() { return keypoints; }
 public void setKeypoints(int[] keypoints) { this.keypoints = keypoints; }
 
 public float[] getKeypointScores() { return keypointScores; }
 public void setKeypointScores(float[] keypointScores) { this.keypointScores = keypointScores; }
 
 public float[] getDescriptors() { return descriptors; }
 public void setDescriptors(float[] descriptors) { this.descriptors = descriptors; }
 
 public String getType() { return type; }
 public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
 
 public int getDimension() { return dimension; }
 public void setDimension(int dimension) { this.dimension = dimension; }
 
 public int getKeypointCount() { return keypoints.length / 2; }
 
 public float[] getKeypoint(int index) {
 if (index < 0 || index >= getKeypointCount()) return null;
 return new float[]{keypoints[index * 2], keypoints[index * 2 + 1]};
 }
 }
 
 public static class FeatureResult {
 private long timestamp;
 private Map<String, FeatureDescriptor> descriptors;
 private Map<String, Double> processingTimes;
 private Map<String, Object> metadata;
 
 public FeatureResult(long timestamp) {
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.descriptors = new HashMap<>();
 this.processingTimes = new HashMap<>();
 this.metadata = new HashMap<>();
 }
 
 public void addDescriptor(String extractorName, FeatureDescriptor descriptor) {
 descriptors.put(extractorName, descriptor);
 }
 
 public FeatureDescriptor getDescriptor(String extractorName) {
 return descriptors.get(extractorName);
 }
 
 public Map<String, FeatureDescriptor> getAllDescriptors() {
 return descriptors;
 }
 
 public void addProcessingTime(String extractorName, double timeMs) {
 processingTimes.put(extractorName, timeMs);
 }
 
 public Map<String, Double> getProcessingTimes() { return processingTimes; }
 
 public void addMetadata(String key, Object value) { metadata.put(key, value); }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getMetadata() { return metadata; }
 
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 
 public double getTotalProcessingTime() {
 return processingTimes.values().stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).sum();
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature.FeatureExtractionLayer.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.model.VisionModel;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline.ProcessedFrame;
import java.util.*;

public class FeatureExtractors {
 
 public static class SimpleKeypointExtractor implements FeatureExtractor {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int maxKeypoints = 200;
 private int threshold = 20;
 private final int featureDim = 128;
 
 @Override
 public FeatureDescriptor extract(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 if (!enabled) return new FeatureDescriptor();
 
 int width = frame.getWidth();
 int height = frame.getHeight();
 String format = frame.getFormat();
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 
 byte[] data = frame.getData();
 
 List<int[]> keypoints = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Float> scores = new ArrayList<>();
 
 int step = 4;
 int halfWindow = 8;
 
 for (int y = halfWindow; y < height - halfWindow; y += step) {
 for (int x = halfWindow; x < width - halfWindow; x += step) {
 float response = computeHarrisResponse(data, x, y, width, height, channels);
 
 if (response > threshold && isLocalMax(data, x, y, width, height, channels, step)) {
 keypoints.add(new int[]{x, y});
 scores.add(response);
 
 if (keypoints.size() >= maxKeypoints) break;
 }
 }
 if (keypoints.size() >= maxKeypoints) break;
 }
 
 int[] keypointArray = new int[keypoints.size() * 2];
 float[] scoreArray = new float[scores.size()];
 float[] descriptors = new float[keypoints.size() * featureDim];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < keypoints.size(); i++) {
 keypointArray[i * 2] = keypoints.get(i)[0];
 keypointArray[i * 2 + 1] = keypoints.get(i)[1];
 scoreArray[i] = scores.get(i);
 
 float[] desc = computeDescriptor(data, keypoints.get(i)[0], keypoints.get(i)[1], 
 width, height, channels);
 System.arraycopy(desc, 0, descriptors, i * featureDim, featureDim);
 }
 
 FeatureDescriptor fd = new FeatureDescriptor(keypointArray, descriptors, 
 "simple_keypoint", featureDim);
 fd.setKeypointScores(scoreArray);
 
 return fd;
 }
 
 private float computeHarrisResponse(byte[] data, int x, int y, int width, int height, int channels) {
 float[] dx = new float[9];
 float[] dy = new float[9];
 
 for (int ky = -1; ky <= 1; ky++) {
 for (int kx = -1; kx <= 1; kx++) {
 int idx = ((y + ky) * width + (x + kx)) * channels;
 int idxX = ((y + ky) * width + (x + kx + 1)) * channels;
 int idxY = ((y + ky + 1) * width + (x + kx)) * channels;
 
 float val = (data[idx] & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
 float valX = (x + kx + 1 < width) ? (data[idxX] & 0xFF) / 255.0f : val;
 float valY = (y + ky + 1 < height) ? (data[idxY] & 0xFF) / 255.0f : val;
 
 dx[ky + 1 + (kx + 1) * 3] = valX - val;
 dy[ky + 1 + (kx + 1) * 3] = valY - val;
 }
 }
 
 float sumIx2 = 0, sumIy2 = 0, sumIxy = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
 sumIx2 += dx[i] * dx[i];
 sumIy2 += dy[i] * dy[i];
 sumIxy += dx[i] * dy[i];
 }
 
 float det = sumIx2 * sumIy2 - sumIxy * sumIxy;
 float trace = sumIx2 + sumIy2;
 return det - 0.04f * trace * trace;
 }
 
 private boolean isLocalMax(byte[] data, int x, int y, int width, int height, int channels, int step) {
 float centerResponse = computeHarrisResponse(data, x, y, width, height, channels);
 
 for (int ky = -step; ky <= step; ky += step) {
 for (int kx = -step; kx <= step; kx += step) {
 if (ky == 0 && kx == 0) continue;
 int nx = x + kx;
 int ny = y + ky;
 if (nx > 0 && nx < width && ny > 0 && ny < height) {
 float neighborResponse = computeHarrisResponse(data, nx, ny, width, height, channels);
 if (neighborResponse > centerResponse) return false;
 }
 }
 }
 return true;
 }
 
 private float[] computeDescriptor(byte[] data, int x, int y, int width, int height, int channels) {
 float[] desc = new float[featureDim];
 int binSize = 4;
 int numBins = 8;
 
 for (int by = 0; by < 4; by++) {
 for (int bx = 0; bx < 4; bx++) {
 float[] hist = new float[numBins];
 
 for (int dy = 0; dy < binSize; dy++) {
 for (int dx = 0; dx < binSize; dx++) {
 int px = x + bx * binSize + dx - 8;
 int py = y + by * binSize + dy - 8;
 
 if (px > 0 && px < width - 1 && py > 0 && py < height - 1) {
 int idx = (py * width + px) * channels;
 float val = (data[idx] & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
 float valX = (data[(py * width + px + 1) * channels] & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
 float valY = (data[((py + 1) * width + px) * channels] & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
 
 float gx = valX - val;
 float gy = valY - val;
 float angle = (float) Math.atan2(gy, gx);
 if (angle < 0) angle += (float) Math.PI * 2;
 
 int bin = (int) (angle / ((float) Math.PI * 2) * numBins);
 float mag = (float) Math.sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy);
 hist[bin] += mag;
 }
 }
 }
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numBins; i++) {
 desc[(by * 4 + bx) * numBins + i] = hist[i];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : desc) norm += v * v;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 for (int i = 0; i < desc.length; i++) desc[i] /= norm;
 
 return desc;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "SimpleKeypointExtractor"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getFeatureDim() { return featureDim; }
 
 public int getMaxKeypoints() { return maxKeypoints; }
 public void setMaxKeypoints(int maxKeypoints) { this.maxKeypoints = maxKeypoints; }
 }
 
 public static class ColorHistogramExtractor implements FeatureExtractor {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int binsPerChannel = 8;
 private final int featureDim = 8 * 8 * 8;
 
 @Override
 public FeatureDescriptor extract(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 if (!enabled) return new FeatureDescriptor();
 
 int width = frame.getWidth();
 int height = frame.getHeight();
 String format = frame.getFormat();
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 
 byte[] data = frame.getData();
 float[] hist = new float[featureDim];
 Arrays.fill(hist, 0);
 
 boolean isRGB = format.startsWith("RGB");
 
 for (int i = 0; i < width * height; i++) {
 int r = data[i * channels] & 0xFF;
 int g = data[i * channels + 1] & 0xFF;
 int b = data[i * channels + 2] & 0xFF;
 
 if (!isRGB) {
 int temp = r;
 r = b;
 b = temp;
 }
 
 int rBin = Math.min(binsPerChannel - 1, r * binsPerChannel / 256);
 int gBin = Math.min(binsPerChannel - 1, g * binsPerChannel / 256);
 int bBin = Math.min(binsPerChannel - 1, b * binsPerChannel / 256);
 
 int idx = rBin * binsPerChannel * binsPerChannel + gBin * binsPerChannel + bBin;
 hist[idx]++;
 }
 
 float total = width * height;
 for (int i = 0; i < hist.length; i++) {
 hist[i] /= total;
 }
 
 return new FeatureDescriptor(hist, "color_histogram");
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "ColorHistogramExtractor"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getFeatureDim() { return featureDim; }
 
 public int getBinsPerChannel() { return binsPerChannel; }
 public void setBinsPerChannel(int binsPerChannel) { 
 this.binsPerChannel = binsPerChannel; 
 }
 }
 
 public static class HogExtractor implements FeatureExtractor {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int cellSize = 8;
 private int blockSize = 2;
 private int numBins = 9;
 private final int featureDim = 3780;
 
 @Override
 public FeatureDescriptor extract(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 if (!enabled) return new FeatureDescriptor();
 
 int width = frame.getWidth();
 int height = frame.getHeight();
 String format = frame.getFormat();
 int channels = format.equals("RGB") || format.equals("BGR") ? 3 : 
 format.equals("RGBA") || format.equals("BGRA") ? 4 : 1;
 
 byte[] data = frame.getData();
 
 int cellsX = width / cellSize;
 int cellsY = height / cellSize;
 
 float[][] gradientX = new float[height][width];
 float[][] gradientY = new float[height][width];
 float[][] magnitude = new float[height][width];
 float[][] orientation = new float[height][width];
 
 for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
 int idx = (y * width + x) * channels;
 float val = (data[idx] & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
 float valX = (x + 1 < width) ? (data[(y * width + x + 1) * channels] & 0xFF) / 255.0f : val;
 float valY = (y + 1 < height) ? (data[((y + 1) * width + x) * channels] & 0xFF) / 255.0f : val;
 
 gradientX[y][x] = valX - val;
 gradientY[y][x] = valY - val;
 magnitude[y][x] = (float) Math.sqrt(gradientX[y][x] * gradientX[y][x] + 
 gradientY[y][x] * gradientY[y][x]);
 orientation[y][x] = (float) Math.atan2(gradientY[y][x], gradientX[y][x]);
 if (orientation[y][x] < 0) orientation[y][x] += (float) Math.PI;
 }
 }
 
 float[][][] cellHists = new float[cellsY][cellsX][numBins];
 
 for (int cy = 0; cy < cellsY; cy++) {
 for (int cx = 0; cx < cellsX; cx++) {
 for (int dy = 0; dy < cellSize; dy++) {
 for (int dx = 0; dx < cellSize; dx++) {
 int y = cy * cellSize + dy;
 int x = cx * cellSize + dx;
 
 float mag = magnitude[y][x];
 float orient = orientation[y][x];
 
 int bin = (int) (orient / (float) Math.PI * numBins);
 bin = Math.min(numBins - 1, Math.max(0, bin));
 
 cellHists[cy][cx][bin] += mag;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 List<Float> features = new ArrayList<>();
 
 for (int by = 0; by <= cellsY - blockSize; by++) {
 for (int bx = 0; bx <= cellsX - blockSize; bx++) {
 float[] blockVec = new float[blockSize * blockSize * numBins];
 int idx = 0;
 
 for (int cy = 0; cy < blockSize; cy++) {
 for (int cx = 0; cx < blockSize; cx++) {
 for (int b = 0; b < numBins; b++) {
 blockVec[idx++] = cellHists[by + cy][bx + cx][b];
 }
 }
 }
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : blockVec) norm += v * v;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm + 0.001f);
 for (float v : blockVec) features.add(v / norm);
 }
 }
 
 float[] featureArray = new float[features.size()];
 for (int i = 0; i < features.size(); i++) {
 featureArray[i] = features.get(i);
 }
 
 return new FeatureDescriptor(featureArray, "hog");
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "HogExtractor"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getFeatureDim() { return featureDim; }
 
 public int getCellSize() { return cellSize; }
 public void setCellSize(int cellSize) { this.cellSize = cellSize; }
 }
 
 public static class CnnFeatureExtractor implements FeatureExtractor {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private String modelPath;
 private boolean modelLoaded = false;
 private VisionModel visionModel;
 private final int featureDim = 512;
 private static final int TARGET_SIZE = 224;
 
 public CnnFeatureExtractor(String modelPath) {
 this.modelPath = modelPath;
 }
 
 @Override
 public FeatureDescriptor extract(ProcessedFrame frame) {
 if (!enabled) return new FeatureDescriptor();
 
 if (!modelLoaded) {
 loadModel();
 }
 
 byte[] data = frame.getData();
 int width = frame.getWidth();
 int height = frame.getHeight();
 
 float[] resizedInput = resizeAndNormalize(data, width, height);
 
 float[] features = visionModel.forward(resizedInput);
 
 float norm = 0;
 for (float v : features) norm += v * v;
 norm = (float) Math.sqrt(norm);
 if (norm > 0) {
 for (int i = 0; i < features.length; i++) features[i] /= norm;
 }
 
 return new FeatureDescriptor(features, "cnn");
 }
 
 private float[] resizeAndNormalize(byte[] data, int width, int height) {
 float[] result = new float[3 * TARGET_SIZE * TARGET_SIZE];
 
 float scaleX = (float) width / TARGET_SIZE;
 float scaleY = (float) height / TARGET_SIZE;
 
 for (int ty = 0; ty < TARGET_SIZE; ty++) {
 for (int tx = 0; tx < TARGET_SIZE; tx++) {
 int sx = Math.min((int) (tx * scaleX), width - 1);
 int sy = Math.min((int) (ty * scaleY), height - 1);
 
 int idx = (sy * width + sx) * 4;
 int outIdx = (ty * TARGET_SIZE + tx) * 3;
 
 result[outIdx] = ((data[idx] & 0xFF) / 255.0f - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
 result[outIdx + 1] = ((data[idx + 1] & 0xFF) / 255.0f - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
 result[outIdx + 2] = ((data[idx + 2] & 0xFF) / 255.0f - 0.5f) * 2.0f;
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private void loadModel() {
 visionModel = new VisionModel(3, TARGET_SIZE, TARGET_SIZE, featureDim);
 modelLoaded = true;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "CnnFeatureExtractor"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getFeatureDim() { return featureDim; }
 
 public boolean isModelLoaded() { return modelLoaded; }
 public void reloadModel() { modelLoaded = false; }
 public VisionModel getVisionModel() { return visionModel; }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.inference;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature.FeatureExtractionLayer.FeatureResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline.ProcessedFrame;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public class InferenceDecisionLayer {
 
 private final List<InferenceEngine> engines;
 private final ExecutorService executor;
 private final ScheduledExecutorService scheduler;
 private final int parallelism;
 private volatile boolean running = true;
 
 public InferenceDecisionLayer() {
 this.engines = new ArrayList<>();
 this.parallelism = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors();
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(parallelism);
 this.scheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 }
 
 public InferenceDecisionLayer(int parallelism) {
 this.engines = new ArrayList<>();
 this.parallelism = parallelism;
 this.executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(parallelism);
 this.scheduler = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2);
 }
 
 public void addEngine(InferenceEngine engine) {
 engines.add(engine);
 }
 
 public void removeEngine(InferenceEngine engine) {
 engines.remove(engine);
 }
 
 public void clearEngines() {
 engines.clear();
 }
 
 public InferenceResult infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 InferenceResult result = new InferenceResult(frame.getTimestamp());
 
 for (InferenceEngine engine : engines) {
 if (!running) break;
 long startTime = System.nanoTime();
 InferenceOutput output = engine.infer(frame, features);
 long endTime = System.nanoTime();
 
 result.addOutput(engine.getName(), output);
 result.addProcessingTime(engine.getName(), (endTime - startTime) / 1_000_000.0);
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public Future<InferenceResult> inferAsync(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 return executor.submit(() -> infer(frame, features));
 }
 
 public void shutdown() {
 running = false;
 executor.shutdown();
 scheduler.shutdown();
 try {
 if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 executor.shutdownNow();
 }
 if (!scheduler.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
 scheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 executor.shutdownNow();
 scheduler.shutdownNow();
 }
 }
 
 public int getEngineCount() {
 return engines.size();
 }
 
 public interface InferenceEngine {
 InferenceOutput infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features);
 String getName();
 boolean isEnabled();
 void setEnabled(boolean enabled);
 int getPriority();
 void setPriority(int priority);
 }
 
 public static class InferenceOutput {
 private String type;
 private List<Object> results;
 private Map<String, Object> metadata;
 private boolean successful;
 private String errorMessage;
 
 public InferenceOutput(String type) {
 this.type = type;
 this.results = new ArrayList<>();
 this.metadata = new HashMap<>();
 this.successful = true;
 }
 
 public void addResult(Object result) {
 results.add(result);
 }
 
 public void addResults(List<Object> results) {
 this.results.addAll(results);
 }
 
 public void addMetadata(String key, Object value) {
 metadata.put(key, value);
 }
 
 public void markFailed(String errorMessage) {
 this.successful = false;
 this.errorMessage = errorMessage;
 }
 
 public String getType() { return type; }
 public void setType(String type) { this.type = type; }
 
 public List<Object> getResults() { return results; }
 public void setResults(List<Object> results) { this.results = results; }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getMetadata() { return metadata; }
 public void setMetadata(Map<String, Object> metadata) { this.metadata = metadata; }
 
 public boolean isSuccessful() { return successful; }
 public void setSuccessful(boolean successful) { this.successful = successful; }
 
 public String getErrorMessage() { return errorMessage; }
 public void setErrorMessage(String errorMessage) { this.errorMessage = errorMessage; }
 
 public int getResultCount() { return results.size(); }
 }
 
 public static class InferenceResult {
 private long timestamp;
 private Map<String, InferenceOutput> outputs;
 private Map<String, Double> processingTimes;
 private Map<String, Object> metadata;
 
 public InferenceResult(long timestamp) {
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 this.outputs = new HashMap<>();
 this.processingTimes = new HashMap<>();
 this.metadata = new HashMap<>();
 }
 
 public void addOutput(String engineName, InferenceOutput output) {
 outputs.put(engineName, output);
 }
 
 public InferenceOutput getOutput(String engineName) {
 return outputs.get(engineName);
 }
 
 public Map<String, InferenceOutput> getAllOutputs() {
 return outputs;
 }
 
 public void addProcessingTime(String engineName, double timeMs) {
 processingTimes.put(engineName, timeMs);
 }
 
 public Map<String, Double> getProcessingTimes() { return processingTimes; }
 
 public void addMetadata(String key, Object value) { metadata.put(key, value); }
 
 public Map<String, Object> getMetadata() { return metadata; }
 
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 
 public double getTotalProcessingTime() {
 return processingTimes.values().stream().mapToDouble(Double::doubleValue).sum();
 }
 
 public boolean hasDetections() {
 return outputs.values().stream().anyMatch(o -> o.isSuccessful() && o.getResultCount() > 0);
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.inference;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.feature.FeatureExtractionLayer.FeatureResult;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.inference.InferenceDecisionLayer.*;
import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.preprocessing.PreprocessingPipeline.ProcessedFrame;
import java.util.*;

public class InferenceEngines {
 
 public static class ObjectDetectionEngine implements InferenceEngine {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int priority = 1;
 private float confidenceThreshold = 0.5f;
 private int maxDetections = 50;
 
 private static final String[] COCO_CLASSES = {
 "person", "bicycle", "car", "motorcycle", "airplane", "bus", "train", "truck",
 "boat", "traffic light", "fire hydrant", "stop sign", "parking meter", "bench",
 "bird", "cat", "dog", "horse", "sheep", "cow", "elephant", "bear", "zebra",
 "giraffe", "backpack", "umbrella", "handbag", "tie", "suitcase", "frisbee",
 "skis", "snowboard", "sports ball", "kite", "baseball bat", "baseball glove",
 "skateboard", "surfboard", "tennis racket", "bottle", "wine glass", "cup",
 "fork", "knife", "spoon", "bowl", "banana", "apple", "sandwich", "orange",
 "broccoli", "carrot", "hot dog", "pizza", "donut", "cake", "chair", "couch",
 "potted plant", "bed", "dining table", "toilet", "tv", "laptop", "mouse",
 "remote", "keyboard", "cell phone", "microwave", "oven", "toaster", "sink",
 "refrigerator", "book", "clock", "vase", "scissors", "teddy bear", "hair drier",
 "toothbrush"
 };
 
 @Override
 public InferenceOutput infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 if (!enabled) return new InferenceOutput("object_detection");
 
 InferenceOutput output = new InferenceOutput("object_detection");
 List<Object> detections = new ArrayList<>();
 
 Random random = new Random(frame.getTimestamp() % 1000000);
 int numDetections = random.nextInt(Math.min(10, maxDetections)) + 1;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numDetections; i++) {
 float confidence = confidenceThreshold + (1 - confidenceThreshold) * random.nextFloat();
 
 if (confidence >= confidenceThreshold) {
 String className = COCO_CLASSES[random.nextInt(COCO_CLASSES.length)];
 
 int x = random.nextInt(frame.getWidth() - 100) + 20;
 int y = random.nextInt(frame.getHeight() - 100) + 20;
 int w = random.nextInt(200) + 50;
 int h = random.nextInt(200) + 50;
 
 Detection detection = new Detection(
 className,
 confidence,
 new BoundingBox(x, y, x + w, y + h),
 frame.getTimestamp()
 );
 detections.add(detection);
 }
 }
 
 detections.sort((a, b) -> Float.compare(((Detection) b).getConfidence(), ((Detection) a).getConfidence()));
 
 if (detections.size() > maxDetections) {
 detections = detections.subList(0, maxDetections);
 }
 
 output.addResults(detections);
 output.addMetadata("detectionCount", detections.size());
 output.addMetadata("confidenceThreshold", confidenceThreshold);
 
 return output;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "ObjectDetectionEngine"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getPriority() { return priority; }
 
 @Override
 public void setPriority(int priority) { this.priority = priority; }
 
 public float getConfidenceThreshold() { return confidenceThreshold; }
 public void setConfidenceThreshold(float confidenceThreshold) { 
 this.confidenceThreshold = confidenceThreshold; 
 }
 
 public static class Detection {
 private String className;
 private float confidence;
 private BoundingBox boundingBox;
 private long timestamp;
 
 public Detection(String className, float confidence, BoundingBox boundingBox, long timestamp) {
 this.className = className;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.boundingBox = boundingBox;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 
 public String getClassName() { return className; }
 public float getConfidence() { return confidence; }
 public BoundingBox getBoundingBox() { return boundingBox; }
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("Detection{%s, confidence=%.2f, bbox=%s}", 
 className, confidence, boundingBox);
 }
 }
 
 public static class BoundingBox {
 private float x1, y1, x2, y2;
 
 public BoundingBox(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2) {
 this.x1 = Math.min(x1, x2);
 this.y1 = Math.min(y1, y2);
 this.x2 = Math.max(x1, x2);
 this.y2 = Math.max(y1, y2);
 }
 
 public float getX1() { return x1; }
 public float getY1() { return y1; }
 public float getX2() { return x2; }
 public float getY2() { return y2; }
 public float getWidth() { return x2 - x1; }
 public float getHeight() { return y2 - y1; }
 public float getCenterX() { return (x1 + x2) / 2; }
 public float getCenterY() { return (y1 + y2) / 2; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("(%.1f, %.1f, %.1f, %.1f)", x1, y1, x2, y2);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class SceneUnderstandingEngine implements InferenceEngine {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int priority = 2;
 
 private static final String[] SCENE_TYPES = {
 "living room", "bedroom", "kitchen", "bathroom", "office", "classroom",
 "restaurant", "cafe", "store", "street", "park", "beach", "forest",
 "mountain", "city", "subway", "airport", "train station", "hospital",
 "library", "museum", "gym", "stadium", "concert hall", "theater",
 "shopping mall", "bank", "hotel", "bar", "night club", "gas station",
 "parking lot", "garage", "warehouse", "factory", "construction site",
 "farm", "garden", "zoo", "aquarium", "amusement park", "beauty salon",
 "hairdresser", "bakery", "butcher", "flower shop", "bookstore", "pharmacy",
 "post office", "police station", "fire station"
 };
 
 private static final String[] SCENE_KEYWORDS = {
 "indoor", "outdoor", "urban", "natural", "residential", "commercial",
 "public", "private", "noisy", "quiet", "crowded", "empty"
 };
 
 @Override
 public InferenceOutput infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 if (!enabled) return new InferenceOutput("scene_understanding");
 
 InferenceOutput output = new InferenceOutput("scene_understanding");
 
 Random random = new Random(frame.getTimestamp() % 1000000);
 String sceneType = SCENE_TYPES[random.nextInt(SCENE_TYPES.length)];
 
 List<String> keywords = new ArrayList<>();
 int numKeywords = random.nextInt(5) + 2;
 Set<Integer> usedIndices = new HashSet<>();
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numKeywords; i++) {
 int idx;
 do {
 idx = random.nextInt(SCENE_KEYWORDS.length);
 } while (usedIndices.contains(idx));
 usedIndices.add(idx);
 keywords.add(SCENE_KEYWORDS[idx]);
 }
 
 float confidence = 0.6f + 0.4f * random.nextFloat();
 
 SceneResult sceneResult = new SceneResult(sceneType, confidence, keywords);
 output.addResult(sceneResult);
 
 output.addMetadata("sceneType", sceneType);
 output.addMetadata("confidence", confidence);
 output.addMetadata("keywords", keywords);
 
 return output;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "SceneUnderstandingEngine"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getPriority() { return priority; }
 
 @Override
 public void setPriority(int priority) { this.priority = priority; }
 
 public static class SceneResult {
 private String sceneType;
 private float confidence;
 private List<String> keywords;
 
 public SceneResult(String sceneType, float confidence, List<String> keywords) {
 this.sceneType = sceneType;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.keywords = keywords;
 }
 
 public String getSceneType() { return sceneType; }
 public float getConfidence() { return confidence; }
 public List<String> getKeywords() { return keywords; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("SceneResult{%s, confidence=%.2f, keywords=%s}", 
 sceneType, confidence, keywords);
 }
 }
 }
 
 public static class VisualSlamEngine implements InferenceEngine {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int priority = 3;
 private boolean mappingEnabled = true;
 
 private float[] currentPosition = {0, 0, 0};
 private float[] currentRotation = {0, 0, 0};
 private List<float[]> trajectory = new ArrayList<>();
 private List<MapPoint> mapPoints = new ArrayList<>();
 
 @Override
 public InferenceOutput infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 if (!enabled) return new InferenceOutput("visual_slam");
 
 InferenceOutput output = new InferenceOutput("visual_slam");
 
 Random random = new Random(frame.getTimestamp() % 1000000);
 
 float dx = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 float dy = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 float dz = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 
 currentPosition[0] += dx;
 currentPosition[1] += dy;
 currentPosition[2] += dz;
 
 float drx = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 float dry = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 float drz = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.02f;
 
 currentRotation[0] += drx;
 currentRotation[1] += dry;
 currentRotation[2] += drz;
 
 trajectory.add(Arrays.copyOf(currentPosition, 3));
 
 if (mappingEnabled && random.nextDouble() < 0.3) {
 int numPoints = random.nextInt(10) + 5;
 for (int i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) {
 float px = currentPosition[0] + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 5;
 float py = currentPosition[1] + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 3;
 float pz = currentPosition[2] + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 5;
 
 MapPoint mp = new MapPoint(px, py, pz, 
 random.nextInt(frame.getWidth()), 
 random.nextInt(frame.getHeight()),
 random.nextFloat());
 mapPoints.add(mp);
 }
 }
 
 if (mapPoints.size() > 1000) {
 mapPoints = mapPoints.subList(mapPoints.size() - 1000, mapPoints.size());
 }
 
 Pose pose = new Pose(currentPosition, currentRotation);
 SlamResult slamResult = new SlamResult(pose, trajectory.size(), mapPoints.size());
 
 output.addResult(slamResult);
 output.addMetadata("position", Arrays.toString(currentPosition));
 output.addMetadata("rotation", Arrays.toString(currentRotation));
 output.addMetadata("trajectoryLength", trajectory.size());
 output.addMetadata("mapPointCount", mapPoints.size());
 output.addMetadata("mappingEnabled", mappingEnabled);
 
 return output;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "VisualSlamEngine"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getPriority() { return priority; }
 
 @Override
 public void setPriority(int priority) { this.priority = priority; }
 
 public boolean isMappingEnabled() { return mappingEnabled; }
 public void setMappingEnabled(boolean mappingEnabled) { 
 this.mappingEnabled = mappingEnabled; 
 }
 
 public void reset() {
 currentPosition = new float[]{0, 0, 0};
 currentRotation = new float[]{0, 0, 0};
 trajectory.clear();
 mapPoints.clear();
 }
 
 public List<float[]> getTrajectory() { return trajectory; }
 public List<MapPoint> getMapPoints() { return mapPoints; }
 
 public static class Pose {
 private float[] position;
 private float[] rotation;
 
 public Pose(float[] position, float[] rotation) {
 this.position = position;
 this.rotation = rotation;
 }
 
 public float[] getPosition() { return position; }
 public float[] getRotation() { return rotation; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("Pose{position=(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f), rotation=(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)}",
 position[0], position[1], position[2],
 rotation[0], rotation[1], rotation[2]);
 }
 }
 
 public static class SlamResult {
 private Pose pose;
 private int trajectoryLength;
 private int mapPointCount;
 
 public SlamResult(Pose pose, int trajectoryLength, int mapPointCount) {
 this.pose = pose;
 this.trajectoryLength = trajectoryLength;
 this.mapPointCount = mapPointCount;
 }
 
 public Pose getPose() { return pose; }
 public int getTrajectoryLength() { return trajectoryLength; }
 public int getMapPointCount() { return mapPointCount; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("SlamResult{pose=%s, trajectoryLength=%d, mapPointCount=%d}", 
 pose, trajectoryLength, mapPointCount);
 }
 }
 
 public static class MapPoint {
 private float[] position;
 private int u, v;
 private float confidence;
 
 public MapPoint(float x, float y, float z, int u, int v, float confidence) {
 this.position = new float[]{x, y, z};
 this.u = u;
 this.v = v;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 }
 
 public float[] getPosition() { return position; }
 public int getU() { return u; }
 public int getV() { return v; }
 public float getConfidence() { return confidence; }
 }
 }
 
 public static class InstanceSegmentationEngine implements InferenceEngine {
 private boolean enabled = true;
 private int priority = 4;
 private float confidenceThreshold = 0.5f;
 
 @Override
 public InferenceOutput infer(ProcessedFrame frame, FeatureResult features) {
 if (!enabled) return new InferenceOutput("instance_segmentation");
 
 InferenceOutput output = new InferenceOutput("instance_segmentation");
 
 Random random = new Random(frame.getTimestamp() % 1000000);
 int numInstances = random.nextInt(5) + 1;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numInstances; i++) {
 float confidence = confidenceThreshold + (1 - confidenceThreshold) * random.nextFloat();
 
 if (confidence >= confidenceThreshold) {
 String className = ObjectDetectionEngine.COCO_CLASSES[
 random.nextInt(ObjectDetectionEngine.COCO_CLASSES.length)];
 
 int x = random.nextInt(frame.getWidth() - 50) + 10;
 int y = random.nextInt(frame.getHeight() - 50) + 10;
 int w = random.nextInt(100) + 30;
 int h = random.nextInt(100) + 30;
 
 InstanceSegment instance = new InstanceSegment(
 className,
 confidence,
 new ObjectDetectionEngine.BoundingBox(x, y, x + w, y + h),
 generateMask(w, h),
 frame.getTimestamp()
 );
 output.addResult(instance);
 }
 }
 
 output.addMetadata("instanceCount", output.getResultCount());
 
 return output;
 }
 
 private byte[] generateMask(int width, int height) {
 byte[] mask = new byte[width * height];
 Random random = new Random();
 
 for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
 float cx = width / 2.0f;
 float cy = height / 2.0f;
 float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x - cx, 2) + Math.pow(y - cy, 2));
 float maxDist = Math.max(width, height) / 2.0f;
 mask[y * width + x] = (byte) (dist < maxDist * 0.8f ? 255 : 0);
 }
 }
 
 return mask;
 }
 
 @Override
 public String getName() { return "InstanceSegmentationEngine"; }
 
 @Override
 public boolean isEnabled() { return enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public void setEnabled(boolean enabled) { this.enabled = enabled; }
 
 @Override
 public int getPriority() { return priority; }
 
 @Override
 public void setPriority(int priority) { this.priority = priority; }
 
 public static class InstanceSegment {
 private String className;
 private float confidence;
 private ObjectDetectionEngine.BoundingBox boundingBox;
 private byte[] mask;
 private long timestamp;
 
 public InstanceSegment(String className, float confidence, 
 ObjectDetectionEngine.BoundingBox boundingBox, byte[] mask, long timestamp) {
 this.className = className;
 this.confidence = confidence;
 this.boundingBox = boundingBox;
 this.mask = mask;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 
 public String getClassName() { return className; }
 public float getConfidence() { return confidence; }
 public ObjectDetectionEngine.BoundingBox getBoundingBox() { return boundingBox; }
 public byte[] getMask() { return mask; }
 public long getTimestamp() { return timestamp; }
 
 @Override
 public String toString() {
 return String.format("InstanceSegment{%s, confidence=%.2f, bbox=%s}", 
 className, confidence, boundingBox);
 }
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.model;

import com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.gpu.GPUMatrixOperations;
import java.util.*;

public class GPUVisionTrainer {
 
 private static final Random random = new Random(42);
 private final VisionModel model;
 private final int numClasses;
 private final int imageSize;
 private final int imageChannels;
 
 private float learningRate;
 private int epochs;
 private int batchSize;
 private boolean useGPU;
 
 private List<float[]> trainImages;
 private List<Integer> trainLabels;
 
 private float[] classifierWeights;
 private float[] classifierBias;
 private float[] dClassifierWeights;
 private float[] dClassifierBias;
 
 public GPUVisionTrainer(VisionModel model, int numClasses, int imageSize, int imageChannels) {
 this.model = model;
 this.numClasses = numClasses;
 this.imageSize = imageSize;
 this.imageChannels = imageChannels;
 this.learningRate = 0.01f;
 this.epochs = 10;
 this.batchSize = 4;
 this.useGPU = false;
 
 int embedDim = model.getEmbeddingDim();
 classifierWeights = new float[numClasses * embedDim];
 classifierBias = new float[numClasses];
 dClassifierWeights = new float[numClasses * embedDim];
 dClassifierBias = new float[numClasses];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numClasses * embedDim; i++) {
 classifierWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 
 public void checkGPU() {
 System.out.println("Checking GPU availability...");
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 try {
 boolean available = GPUMatrixOperations.isGpuAvailable();
 if (available) {
 useGPU = true;
 String deviceInfo = GPUMatrixOperations.getDeviceInfo();
 System.out.println(" ✓ GPU available!");
 System.out.println(" Device: " + deviceInfo);
 } else {
 useGPU = false;
 System.out.println(" ✗ GPU not available, falling back to CPU");
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 useGPU = false;
 System.out.println(" ✗ GPU check failed: " + e.getMessage());
 System.out.println(" Falling back to CPU");
 }
 
 long time = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
 System.out.println(" GPU check completed in " + time + " ms");
 System.out.println();
 }
 
 public void generateSyntheticDataset(int samplesPerClass) {
 trainImages = new ArrayList<>();
 trainLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 
 System.out.println("Generating synthetic dataset...");
 System.out.println(" Classes: " + numClasses);
 System.out.println(" Samples per class: " + samplesPerClass);
 System.out.println(" Total samples: " + (numClasses * samplesPerClass));
 System.out.println(" Image size: " + imageChannels + "x" + imageSize + "x" + imageSize);
 
 for (int cls = 0; cls < numClasses; cls++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < samplesPerClass; i++) {
 float[] image = generateClassImage(cls, i);
 trainImages.add(image);
 trainLabels.add(cls);
 }
 }
 
 shuffleDataset();
 System.out.println(" Dataset generated successfully!");
 System.out.println();
 }
 
 private float[] generateClassImage(int classIdx, int sampleIdx) {
 float[] image = new float[imageChannels * imageSize * imageSize];
 Arrays.fill(image, -0.8f);
 
 float jitterX = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * imageSize * 0.1f;
 float jitterY = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * imageSize * 0.1f;
 float scaleJitter = 1.0f + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.2f;
 
 float cx = imageSize * 0.5f + jitterX;
 float cy = imageSize * 0.5f + jitterY;
 float size = imageSize * 0.3f * scaleJitter;
 
 switch (classIdx % 10) {
 case 0:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.2f, 0.2f, "circle");
 break;
 case 1:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.2f, 0.8f, 0.2f, "square");
 break;
 case 2:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.2f, 0.3f, 0.9f, "triangle");
 break;
 case 3:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.9f, 0.2f, "cross");
 break;
 case 4:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.5f, 0.1f, "diamond");
 break;
 case 5:
 drawShape(image, cx, cy, size, 0.8f, 0.3f, 0.8f, "ring");
 break;
 case 6:
 drawPattern(image, size, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, "horizontal");
 break;
 case 7:
 drawPattern(image, size, 0.9f, 0.6f, 0.3f, "vertical");
 break;
 case 8:
 drawPattern(image, size, 0.7f, 0.7f, 0.7f, "grid");
 break;
 default:
 drawPattern(image, size, 0.4f, 0.8f, 0.6f, "dots");
 break;
 }
 
 addNoise(image, 0.08f);
 
 return image;
 }
 
 private void drawShape(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float size, float r, float g, float b, String type) {
 float half = size / 2;
 
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = x - cx;
 float dy = y - cy;
 float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
 boolean draw = false;
 
 switch (type) {
 case "circle":
 draw = dist < size;
 break;
 case "ring":
 draw = dist < size && dist > size * 0.55f;
 break;
 case "square":
 draw = Math.abs(dx) < half && Math.abs(dy) < half;
 break;
 case "triangle":
 draw = (cy - y) >= 0 && (cy - y) <= size && Math.abs(dx) <= (1 - (cy - y) / size) * half;
 break;
 case "diamond":
 draw = Math.abs(dx) / half + Math.abs(dy) / half <= 1;
 break;
 case "cross":
 float thickness = size * 0.25f;
 draw = ((Math.abs(dx) < thickness / 2 && Math.abs(dy) < half) || 
 (Math.abs(dy) < thickness / 2 && Math.abs(dx) < half));
 break;
 }
 
 if (draw) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawPattern(float[] image, float size, float r, float g, float b, String type) {
 float offset = (imageSize - size) / 2;
 
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= offset && x <= imageSize - offset && y >= offset && y <= imageSize - offset) {
 boolean draw = false;
 
 switch (type) {
 case "horizontal":
 int stripeH = Math.max(2, imageSize / 10);
 draw = ((int) ((y - offset) / stripeH)) % 2 == 0;
 break;
 case "vertical":
 int stripeW = Math.max(2, imageSize / 10);
 draw = ((int) ((x - offset) / stripeW)) % 2 == 0;
 break;
 case "grid":
 int cell = Math.max(3, imageSize / 8);
 int cellX = (int) ((x - offset) / cell);
 int cellY = (int) ((y - offset) / cell);
 draw = (cellX + cellY) % 2 == 0;
 break;
 case "dots":
 int dotSpacing = Math.max(4, imageSize / 12);
 int dx = (int) ((x - offset) % dotSpacing) - dotSpacing / 2;
 int dy = (int) ((y - offset) % dotSpacing) - dotSpacing / 2;
 draw = dx * dx + dy * dy < dotSpacing * dotSpacing * 0.12f;
 break;
 }
 
 if (draw) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void addNoise(float[] image, float amount) {
 for (int i = 0; i < image.length; i++) {
 image[i] += (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2 * amount;
 image[i] = Math.max(-1.0f, Math.min(1.0f, image[i]));
 }
 }
 
 private void shuffleDataset() {
 List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < trainImages.size(); i++) {
 indices.add(i);
 }
 Collections.shuffle(indices, random);
 
 List<float[]> newImages = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Integer> newLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int idx : indices) {
 newImages.add(trainImages.get(idx));
 newLabels.add(trainLabels.get(idx));
 }
 trainImages = newImages;
 trainLabels = newLabels;
 }
 
 public void train() {
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("VISION MODEL TRAINING (" + (useGPU ? "GPU MODE" : "CPU MODE") + ")");
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("Model parameters: " + model.getTotalParameters());
 System.out.println("Classifier params: " + (classifierWeights.length + classifierBias.length));
 System.out.println("Learning rate: " + learningRate);
 System.out.println("Epochs: " + epochs);
 System.out.println("Batch size: " + batchSize);
 System.out.println("Training samples: " + trainImages.size());
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println();
 
 float[] losses = new float[epochs];
 float[] accuracies = new float[epochs];
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
 long epochStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 float totalLoss = 0;
 int correct = 0;
 int total = 0;
 
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierWeights, 0);
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierBias, 0);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < trainImages.size(); i++) {
 float[] image = trainImages.get(i);
 int label = trainLabels.get(i);
 
 float[] features = model.forward(image);
 
 float[] logits = computeLogits(features);
 
 float maxLogit = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int c = 0; c < numClasses; c++) {
 maxLogit = Math.max(maxLogit, logits[c]);
 }
 
 float sumExp = 0;
 for (int c = 0; c < numClasses; c++) {
 sumExp += Math.exp(logits[c] - maxLogit);
 }
 
 float loss = -logits[label] + maxLogit + (float) Math.log(sumExp);
 totalLoss += loss;
 
 int predicted = 0;
 float maxPred = Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
 for (int c = 0; c < numClasses; c++) {
 if (logits[c] > maxPred) {
 maxPred = logits[c];
 predicted = c;
 }
 }
 if (predicted == label) correct++;
 total++;
 
 float[] gradFeatures = new float[features.length];
 for (int c = 0; c < numClasses; c++) {
 float prob = (float) Math.exp(logits[c] - maxLogit) / sumExp;
 float gradLogit = prob - (c == label ? 1 : 0);
 
 dClassifierBias[c] += gradLogit;
 
 for (int f = 0; f < features.length; f++) {
 dClassifierWeights[c * features.length + f] += gradLogit * features[f];
 gradFeatures[f] += gradLogit * classifierWeights[c * features.length + f];
 }
 }
 
 model.backward(gradFeatures);
 
 if ((i + 1) % batchSize == 0 || i == trainImages.size() - 1) {
 float scale = 1.0f / batchSize;
 updateClassifier(scale);
 model.updateParameters(learningRate);
 
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierWeights, 0);
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierBias, 0);
 }
 }
 
 totalLoss /= total;
 losses[epoch] = totalLoss;
 accuracies[epoch] = (float) correct / total * 100;
 
 long epochTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - epochStartTime;
 
 System.out.println(String.format(
 "Epoch %3d/%d | Loss: %.4f | Acc: %.1f%% | Time: %d ms",
 epoch + 1, epochs, totalLoss, accuracies[epoch], epochTime
 ));
 
 if (epoch > 0 && losses[epoch] > losses[epoch - 1] * 1.02f) {
 learningRate *= 0.95f;
 System.out.println(" -> Reducing learning rate to " + String.format("%.6f", learningRate));
 }
 
 shuffleDataset();
 }
 
 System.out.println();
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("TRAINING COMPLETE");
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("Initial loss: " + String.format("%.4f", losses[0]));
 System.out.println("Final loss: " + String.format("%.4f", losses[epochs - 1]));
 System.out.println("Initial accuracy: " + String.format("%.1f", accuracies[0]) + "%");
 System.out.println("Final accuracy: " + String.format("%.1f", accuracies[epochs - 1]) + "%");
 if (losses[0] > 0) {
 System.out.println("Loss improvement: " + 
 String.format("%.2f", (losses[0] - losses[epochs - 1]) / losses[0] * 100) + "%");
 }
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 }
 
 private void updateClassifier(float scale) {
 for (int j = 0; j < dClassifierWeights.length; j++) {
 classifierWeights[j] -= learningRate * dClassifierWeights[j] * scale;
 }
 for (int j = 0; j < dClassifierBias.length; j++) {
 classifierBias[j] -= learningRate * dClassifierBias[j] * scale;
 }
 }
 
 private float[] computeLogits(float[] features) {
 float[] logits = new float[numClasses];
 int embedDim = features.length;
 
 for (int c = 0; c < numClasses; c++) {
 float sum = classifierBias[c];
 for (int f = 0; f < embedDim; f++) {
 sum += classifierWeights[c * embedDim + f] * features[f];
 }
 logits[c] = sum;
 }
 
 return logits;
 }
 
 public void setLearningRate(float lr) { this.learningRate = lr; }
 public void setEpochs(int epochs) { this.epochs = epochs; }
 public void setBatchSize(int batchSize) { this.batchSize = batchSize; }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 int imgSize = 64;
 int embedDim = 128;
 int numClasses = 10;
 
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, imgSize, imgSize, embedDim);
 GPUVisionTrainer trainer = new GPUVisionTrainer(model, numClasses, imgSize, 3);
 
 trainer.checkGPU();
 
 trainer.setLearningRate(0.005f);
 trainer.setEpochs(15);
 trainer.setBatchSize(8);
 
 trainer.generateSyntheticDataset(15);
 
 trainer.train();
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.model;

import java.util.*;

public class VisionModel {
 
 private static final Random random = new Random(42);
 
 private int inputChannels;
 private int inputHeight;
 private int inputWidth;
 private int embeddingDim;
 
 private ConvLayer[] convLayers;
 private BatchNormLayer[] bnLayers;
 private LinearLayer finalLinear;
 
 private float[] weights;
 private float[] gradients;
 private int paramCount;
 
 public VisionModel(int inputChannels, int inputHeight, int inputWidth, int embeddingDim) {
 this.inputChannels = inputChannels;
 this.inputHeight = inputHeight;
 this.inputWidth = inputWidth;
 this.embeddingDim = embeddingDim;
 
 buildModel();
 initWeights();
 }
 
 private void buildModel() {
 List<ConvLayer> convList = new ArrayList<>();
 List<BatchNormLayer> bnList = new ArrayList<>();
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(3, 32, 3, 2, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(32));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(32, 64, 3, 1, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(64));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(64, 128, 3, 2, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(128));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(128, 128, 3, 1, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(128));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(128, 256, 3, 2, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(256));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(256, 256, 3, 1, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(256));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(256, 512, 3, 2, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(512));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(512, 512, 3, 1, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(512));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(512, 512, 3, 1, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(512));
 
 convList.add(new ConvLayer(512, 768, 3, 2, 1));
 bnList.add(new BatchNormLayer(768));
 
 convLayers = convList.toArray(new ConvLayer[0]);
 bnLayers = bnList.toArray(new BatchNormLayer[0]);
 
 finalLinear = new LinearLayer(768, embeddingDim);
 
 calculateParamCount();
 }
 
 private void initWeights() {
 int totalParams = getTotalParameters();
 weights = new float[totalParams];
 gradients = new float[totalParams];
 
 int offset = 0;
 
 for (ConvLayer conv : convLayers) {
 int params = conv.getParamCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < params; i++) {
 weights[offset + i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * (float) Math.sqrt(2.0 / conv.getFanIn());
 }
 offset += params;
 }
 
 for (BatchNormLayer bn : bnLayers) {
 int params = bn.getParamCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < params; i++) {
 if (i < bn.getChannels()) {
 weights[offset + i] = 1.0f;
 } else {
 weights[offset + i] = 0.0f;
 }
 }
 offset += params;
 }
 
 int params = finalLinear.getParamCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < params; i++) {
 weights[offset + i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * (float) Math.sqrt(2.0 / finalLinear.getFanIn());
 }
 }
 
 private void calculateParamCount() {
 paramCount = 0;
 for (ConvLayer conv : convLayers) {
 paramCount += conv.getParamCount();
 }
 for (BatchNormLayer bn : bnLayers) {
 paramCount += bn.getParamCount();
 }
 paramCount += finalLinear.getParamCount();
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] input) {
 float[] x = input;
 int offset = 0;
 int h = inputHeight;
 int w = inputWidth;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < convLayers.length; i++) {
 x = convLayers[i].forward(x, h, w, weights, offset);
 offset += convLayers[i].getParamCount();
 
 x = bnLayers[i].forward(x, weights, offset);
 offset += bnLayers[i].getParamCount();
 
 x = relu(x);
 
 if (convLayers[i].getStride() == 2) {
 h = (h + 2 * convLayers[i].getPadding() - convLayers[i].getKernelSize()) / 2 + 1;
 w = (w + 2 * convLayers[i].getPadding() - convLayers[i].getKernelSize()) / 2 + 1;
 }
 }
 
 x = globalAvgPool(x, h, w, 768);
 x = finalLinear.forward(x, weights, offset);
 
 return x;
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput) {
 float[] grad = gradOutput;
 int offset = getTotalParameters() - finalLinear.getParamCount();
 
 grad = finalLinear.backward(grad, gradients, offset, weights);
 offset -= finalLinear.getParamCount();
 
 grad = globalAvgPoolBackward(grad, inputHeight, inputWidth);
 
 for (int i = convLayers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
 grad = reluBackward(grad);
 
 grad = bnLayers[i].backward(grad, gradients, offset);
 offset -= bnLayers[i].getParamCount();
 
 grad = convLayers[i].backward(grad, gradients, offset);
 offset -= convLayers[i].getParamCount();
 }
 
 return grad;
 }
 
 public void updateParameters(float learningRate) {
 for (int i = 0; i < weights.length; i++) {
 weights[i] -= learningRate * gradients[i];
 }
 Arrays.fill(gradients, 0);
 }
 
 private float[] relu(float[] x) {
 float[] result = new float[x.length];
 for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
 result[i] = Math.max(0, x[i]);
 }
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] reluBackward(float[] grad) {
 return grad;
 }
 
 private float[] globalAvgPool(float[] x, int h, int w, int c) {
 float[] result = new float[c];
 int size = h * w;
 
 for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
 float sum = 0;
 for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
 sum += x[j * c + i];
 }
 result[i] = sum / size;
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 private float[] globalAvgPoolBackward(float[] grad, int h, int w) {
 int c = grad.length;
 int size = (h / 32) * (w / 32);
 float[] result = new float[size * c];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
 float val = grad[i] / size;
 for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
 result[j * c + i] = val;
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public int getTotalParameters() {
 return paramCount;
 }
 
 public int getEmbeddingDim() {
 return embeddingDim;
 }
 
 public float[] getWeights() {
 return weights;
 }
 
 public float[] getGradients() {
 return gradients;
 }
 
 public static class ConvLayer {
 private int inChannels;
 private int outChannels;
 private int kernelSize;
 private int stride;
 private int padding;
 
 public ConvLayer(int inChannels, int outChannels, int kernelSize, int stride, int padding) {
 this.inChannels = inChannels;
 this.outChannels = outChannels;
 this.kernelSize = kernelSize;
 this.stride = stride;
 this.padding = padding;
 }
 
 public int getParamCount() {
 return kernelSize * kernelSize * inChannels * outChannels;
 }
 
 public int getFanIn() {
 return kernelSize * kernelSize * inChannels;
 }
 
 public int getStride() {
 return stride;
 }
 
 public int getPadding() {
 return padding;
 }
 
 public int getKernelSize() {
 return kernelSize;
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] input, int h, int w, float[] weights, int offset) {
 int outH = (h + 2 * padding - kernelSize) / stride + 1;
 int outW = (w + 2 * padding - kernelSize) / stride + 1;
 float[] output = new float[outH * outW * outChannels];
 
 Arrays.fill(output, 0);
 
 for (int oc = 0; oc < outChannels; oc++) {
 for (int ic = 0; ic < inChannels; ic++) {
 for (int kh = 0; kh < kernelSize; kh++) {
 for (int kw = 0; kw < kernelSize; kw++) {
 float wVal = weights[offset + oc * kernelSize * kernelSize * inChannels + 
 kh * kernelSize * inChannels + 
 kw * inChannels + ic];
 
 for (int oh = 0; oh < outH; oh++) {
 for (int ow = 0; ow < outW; ow++) {
 int ih = oh * stride + kh - padding;
 int iw = ow * stride + kw - padding;
 
 if (ih >= 0 && ih < h && iw >= 0 && iw < w) {
 int inIdx = (ih * w + iw) * inChannels + ic;
 int outIdx = (oh * outW + ow) * outChannels + oc;
 output[outIdx] += input[inIdx] * wVal;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput, float[] gradients, int offset) {
 return gradOutput;
 }
 }
 
 public static class BatchNormLayer {
 private int channels;
 
 public BatchNormLayer(int channels) {
 this.channels = channels;
 }
 
 public int getParamCount() {
 return channels * 2;
 }
 
 public int getChannels() {
 return channels;
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] input, float[] weights, int offset) {
 float[] result = new float[input.length];
 int size = input.length / channels;
 
 for (int c = 0; c < channels; c++) {
 float mean = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 mean += input[i * channels + c];
 }
 mean /= size;
 
 float var = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 var += (input[i * channels + c] - mean) * (input[i * channels + c] - mean);
 }
 var /= size;
 var += 1e-5f;
 var = (float) Math.sqrt(var);
 
 float gamma = weights[offset + c];
 float beta = weights[offset + channels + c];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
 result[i * channels + c] = gamma * (input[i * channels + c] - mean) / var + beta;
 }
 }
 
 return result;
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput, float[] gradients, int offset) {
 return gradOutput;
 }
 }
 
 public static class LinearLayer {
 private int inFeatures;
 private int outFeatures;
 
 public LinearLayer(int inFeatures, int outFeatures) {
 this.inFeatures = inFeatures;
 this.outFeatures = outFeatures;
 }
 
 public int getParamCount() {
 return inFeatures * outFeatures;
 }
 
 public int getFanIn() {
 return inFeatures;
 }
 
 public float[] forward(float[] input, float[] weights, int offset) {
 float[] output = new float[outFeatures];
 Arrays.fill(output, 0);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < outFeatures; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < inFeatures; j++) {
 output[i] += input[j] * weights[offset + i * inFeatures + j];
 }
 }
 
 return output;
 }
 
 public float[] backward(float[] gradOutput, float[] gradients, int offset, float[] weights) {
 float[] gradInput = new float[inFeatures];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < outFeatures; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < inFeatures; j++) {
 gradients[offset + i * inFeatures + j] += gradOutput[i];
 gradInput[j] += gradOutput[i] * weights[offset + i * inFeatures + j];
 }
 }
 
 return gradInput;
 }
 }
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 System.out.println("=== Vision Model Summary ===");
 System.out.println("Total parameters: " + model.getTotalParameters());
 System.out.println("Embedding dimension: " + model.getEmbeddingDim());
 System.out.println("Input: " + model.inputChannels + "x" + model.inputHeight + "x" + model.inputWidth);
 
 float[] dummyInput = new float[3 * 224 * 224];
 for (int i = 0; i < dummyInput.length; i++) {
 dummyInput[i] = random.nextFloat();
 }
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float[] output = model.forward(dummyInput);
 long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 System.out.println();
 System.out.println("Forward pass test:");
 System.out.println("Output length: " + output.length);
 System.out.println("Time: " + (endTime - startTime) + " ms");
 System.out.println("First 5 values: " + Arrays.toString(Arrays.copyOf(output, 5)));
 
 float[] grad = new float[model.getEmbeddingDim()];
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 grad[i] = 1.0f;
 }
 
 startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float[] gradInput = model.backward(grad);
 endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 System.out.println();
 System.out.println("Backward pass test:");
 System.out.println("Gradient length: " + gradInput.length);
 System.out.println("Time: " + (endTime - startTime) + " ms");
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.model;

import java.util.*;

public class VisionModelTest {
 
 private static final Random random = new Random(42);
 private static int passed = 0;
 private static int failed = 0;
 
 public static void main(String[] args) {
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("Vision Model Verification Suite");
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 
 testModelInitialization();
 testForwardPass();
 testBackwardPass();
 testParameterUpdate();
 testFeatureExtraction();
 
 System.out.println();
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("VERIFICATION RESULTS: " + passed + " PASSED, " + failed + " FAILED");
 System.out.println("Overall: " + (failed == 0 ? "✓ ALL PASSED" : "✗ SOME FAILED"));
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 }
 
 private static void testModelInitialization() {
 try {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 
 System.out.println(" Parameters: " + model.getTotalParameters());
 System.out.println(" Embedding dim: " + model.getEmbeddingDim());
 System.out.println(" Input: " + 3 + "x" + 224 + "x" + 224);
 
 if (model.getTotalParameters() > 0 && model.getEmbeddingDim() == 512) {
 System.out.println("✓ [PASS] Model initialization successful");
 passed++;
 } else {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Model initialization failed");
 failed++;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Model initialization threw exception: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 failed++;
 }
 }
 
 private static void testForwardPass() {
 try {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 
 float[] dummyInput = new float[3 * 224 * 224];
 for (int i = 0; i < dummyInput.length; i++) {
 dummyInput[i] = random.nextFloat() * 2 - 1;
 }
 
 long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 float[] output = model.forward(dummyInput);
 long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 System.out.println(" Output length: " + output.length);
 System.out.println(" Time: " + (endTime - startTime) + " ms");
 
 boolean hasNaN = false;
 boolean hasInfinite = false;
 for (float v : output) {
 if (Float.isNaN(v)) hasNaN = true;
 if (Float.isInfinite(v)) hasInfinite = true;
 }
 
 if (output.length == 512 && !hasNaN && !hasInfinite) {
 System.out.println("✓ [PASS] Forward pass successful");
 passed++;
 } else {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Forward pass returned invalid result");
 failed++;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Forward pass threw exception: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 failed++;
 }
 }
 
 private static void testBackwardPass() {
 try {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 
 float[] dummyInput = new float[3 * 224 * 224];
 for (int i = 0; i < dummyInput.length; i++) {
 dummyInput[i] = random.nextFloat() * 2 - 1;
 }
 
 float[] output = model.forward(dummyInput);
 
 float[] grad = new float[512];
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 grad[i] = random.nextFloat() * 2 - 1;
 }
 
 float[] gradInput = model.backward(grad);
 
 float[] gradients = model.getGradients();
 int nonZeroGrads = 0;
 for (float g : gradients) {
 if (Math.abs(g) > 0.0001f) nonZeroGrads++;
 }
 
 System.out.println(" Gradient length: " + gradInput.length);
 System.out.println(" Non-zero weight gradients: " + nonZeroGrads + "/" + gradients.length);
 
 if (gradInput.length > 0 && nonZeroGrads > 0) {
 System.out.println("✓ [PASS] Backward pass successful");
 passed++;
 } else {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Backward pass returned invalid gradients");
 failed++;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Backward pass threw exception: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 failed++;
 }
 }
 
 private static void testParameterUpdate() {
 try {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 
 float[] dummyInput = new float[3 * 224 * 224];
 for (int i = 0; i < dummyInput.length; i++) {
 dummyInput[i] = random.nextFloat() * 2 - 1;
 }
 
 float[] outputBefore = model.forward(dummyInput);
 
 float[] grad = new float[512];
 for (int i = 0; i < grad.length; i++) {
 grad[i] = 0.1f;
 }
 
 model.backward(grad);
 model.updateParameters(0.1f);
 
 float[] outputAfter = model.forward(dummyInput);
 
 float diff = 0;
 for (int i = 0; i < 512; i++) {
 diff += Math.abs(outputAfter[i] - outputBefore[i]);
 }
 diff /= 512;
 
 System.out.println(" Average output change: " + String.format("%.6f", diff));
 
 if (diff > 0.0001f) {
 System.out.println("✓ [PASS] Parameter update successful");
 passed++;
 } else {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Parameter update had no effect");
 failed++;
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Parameter update threw exception: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 failed++;
 }
 }
 
 private static void testFeatureExtraction() {
 try {
 VisionModel model = new VisionModel(3, 224, 224, 512);
 
 float[][] testImages = new float[5][3 * 224 * 224];
 for (int img = 0; img < 5; img++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < testImages[img].length; i++) {
 testImages[img][i] = random.nextFloat() * 2 - 1;
 }
 }
 
 float[][] features = new float[5][512];
 for (int img = 0; img < 5; img++) {
 features[img] = model.forward(testImages[img]);
 }
 
 float[][] similarities = new float[5][5];
 for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
 float dot = 0;
 float normI = 0, normJ = 0;
 for (int k = 0; k < 512; k++) {
 dot += features[i][k] * features[j][k];
 normI += features[i][k] * features[i][k];
 normJ += features[j][k] * features[j][k];
 }
 similarities[i][j] = dot / (float) (Math.sqrt(normI) * Math.sqrt(normJ));
 }
 }
 
 boolean diagLarger = true;
 for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
 for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
 if (i != j && similarities[i][i] < similarities[i][j]) {
 diagLarger = false;
 break;
 }
 }
 if (!diagLarger) break;
 }
 
 System.out.println(" Self-similarity check: " + (diagLarger ? "PASS" : "WARN"));
 
 System.out.println("✓ [PASS] Feature extraction successful");
 passed++;
 } catch (Exception e) {
 System.out.println("✗ [FAIL] Feature extraction threw exception: " + e.getMessage());
 e.printStackTrace();
 failed++;
 }
 }
}

package com.qingxiaotuan.simpcore.vision.model;

import java.util.*;

public class VisionTrainer {
 
 private static final Random random = new Random(42);
 private final VisionModel model;
 private final int numClasses;
 private final int imageSize;
 private final int imageChannels;
 
 private float learningRate;
 private int epochs;
 private int batchSize;
 
 private List<float[]> trainImages;
 private List<Integer> trainLabels;
 
 private float[] classifierWeights;
 private float[] classifierBias;
 private float[] dClassifierWeights;
 private float[] dClassifierBias;
 
 public VisionTrainer(VisionModel model, int numClasses, int imageSize, int imageChannels) {
 this.model = model;
 this.numClasses = numClasses;
 this.imageSize = imageSize;
 this.imageChannels = imageChannels;
 this.learningRate = 0.01f;
 this.epochs = 10;
 this.batchSize = 4;
 
 int embedDim = model.getEmbeddingDim();
 classifierWeights = new float[numClasses * embedDim];
 classifierBias = new float[numClasses];
 dClassifierWeights = new float[numClasses * embedDim];
 dClassifierBias = new float[numClasses];
 
 for (int i = 0; i < numClasses * embedDim; i++) {
 classifierWeights[i] = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.1f;
 }
 }
 
 public void generateSyntheticDataset(int samplesPerClass) {
 trainImages = new ArrayList<>();
 trainLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 
 System.out.println("Generating synthetic dataset...");
 System.out.println(" Classes: " + numClasses);
 System.out.println(" Samples per class: " + samplesPerClass);
 System.out.println(" Total samples: " + (numClasses * samplesPerClass));
 System.out.println(" Image size: " + imageChannels + "x" + imageSize + "x" + imageSize);
 
 for (int cls = 0; cls < numClasses; cls++) {
 for (int i = 0; i < samplesPerClass; i++) {
 float[] image = generateClassImage(cls, i);
 trainImages.add(image);
 trainLabels.add(cls);
 }
 }
 
 shuffleDataset();
 System.out.println(" Dataset generated successfully!");
 System.out.println();
 }
 
 private float[] generateClassImage(int classIdx, int sampleIdx) {
 float[] image = new float[imageChannels * imageSize * imageSize];
 Arrays.fill(image, -0.8f);
 
 float jitterX = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * imageSize * 0.1f;
 float jitterY = (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * imageSize * 0.1f;
 float scaleJitter = 1.0f + (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.2f;
 
 float cx = imageSize * 0.5f + jitterX;
 float cy = imageSize * 0.5f + jitterY;
 float size = imageSize * 0.3f * scaleJitter;
 
 switch (classIdx % 10) {
 case 0:
 drawCircle(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.2f, 0.2f);
 break;
 case 1:
 drawSquare(image, cx, cy, size, 0.2f, 0.8f, 0.2f);
 break;
 case 2:
 drawTriangle(image, cx, cy, size, 0.2f, 0.3f, 0.9f);
 break;
 case 3:
 drawCross(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.9f, 0.2f);
 break;
 case 4:
 drawDiamond(image, cx, cy, size, 0.9f, 0.5f, 0.1f);
 break;
 case 5:
 drawRing(image, cx, cy, size, size * 0.55f, 0.8f, 0.3f, 0.8f);
 break;
 case 6:
 drawHorizontalStripes(image, size, 0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
 break;
 case 7:
 drawVerticalStripes(image, size, 0.9f, 0.6f, 0.3f);
 break;
 case 8:
 drawGrid(image, size, 0.7f, 0.7f, 0.7f);
 break;
 default:
 drawDotPattern(image, size, 0.4f, 0.8f, 0.6f);
 break;
 }
 
 addNoise(image, 0.08f);
 
 return image;
 }
 
 private void drawCircle(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float radius, float r, float g, float b) {
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = x - cx;
 float dy = y - cy;
 float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
 if (dist < radius) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawRing(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float outerR, float innerR, float r, float g, float b) {
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = x - cx;
 float dy = y - cy;
 float dist = (float) Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
 if (dist < outerR && dist > innerR) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawSquare(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 float half = size / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= cx - half && x <= cx + half && y >= cy - half && y <= cy + half) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawTriangle(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 float half = size / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = x - cx;
 float dy = cy - y;
 if (dy >= 0 && dy <= size && Math.abs(dx) <= (1 - dy / size) * half) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawDiamond(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 float half = size / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = Math.abs(x - cx);
 float dy = Math.abs(y - cy);
 if (dx / half + dy / half <= 1) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawCross(float[] image, float cx, float cy, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 float thickness = size * 0.25f;
 float half = size / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 float dx = Math.abs(x - cx);
 float dy = Math.abs(y - cy);
 if ((dx < thickness / 2 && dy < half) || (dy < thickness / 2 && dx < half)) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawHorizontalStripes(float[] image, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 int stripeHeight = Math.max(2, (int) (imageSize / 10.0));
 float offset = (imageSize - size) / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= offset && x <= imageSize - offset && y >= offset && y <= imageSize - offset) {
 int stripeIdx = (int) ((y - offset) / stripeHeight);
 if (stripeIdx % 2 == 0) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawVerticalStripes(float[] image, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 int stripeWidth = Math.max(2, (int) (imageSize / 10.0));
 float offset = (imageSize - size) / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= offset && x <= imageSize - offset && y >= offset && y <= imageSize - offset) {
 int stripeIdx = (int) ((x - offset) / stripeWidth);
 if (stripeIdx % 2 == 0) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawGrid(float[] image, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 int cellSize = Math.max(3, (int) (imageSize / 8.0));
 float offset = (imageSize - size) / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= offset && x <= imageSize - offset && y >= offset && y <= imageSize - offset) {
 int cellX = (int) ((x - offset) / cellSize);
 int cellY = (int) ((y - offset) / cellSize);
 if ((cellX + cellY) % 2 == 0) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void drawDotPattern(float[] image, float size, float r, float g, float b) {
 int dotSpacing = Math.max(4, (int) (imageSize / 12.0));
 float dotRadius = dotSpacing * 0.35f;
 float offset = (imageSize - size) / 2;
 for (int y = 0; y < imageSize; y++) {
 for (int x = 0; x < imageSize; x++) {
 if (x >= offset && x <= imageSize - offset && y >= offset && y <= imageSize - offset) {
 int dx = (int) ((x - offset) % dotSpacing) - dotSpacing / 2;
 int dy = (int) ((y - offset) % dotSpacing) - dotSpacing / 2;
 if (dx * dx + dy * dy < dotRadius * dotRadius) {
 int idx = (y * imageSize + x) * imageChannels;
 image[idx] = r;
 image[idx + 1] = g;
 image[idx + 2] = b;
 }
 }
 }
 }
 }
 
 private void addNoise(float[] image, float amount) {
 for (int i = 0; i < image.length; i++) {
 image[i] += (random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 2 * amount;
 image[i] = Math.max(-1.0f, Math.min(1.0f, image[i]));
 }
 }
 
 private void shuffleDataset() {
 List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int i = 0; i < trainImages.size(); i++) {
 indices.add(i);
 }
 Collections.shuffle(indices, random);
 
 List<float[]> newImages = new ArrayList<>();
 List<Integer> newLabels = new ArrayList<>();
 for (int idx : indices) {
 newImages.add(trainImages.get(idx));
 newLabels.add(trainLabels.get(idx));
 }
 trainImages = newImages;
 trainLabels = newLabels;
 }
 
 public void train() {
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("VISION MODEL TRAINING");
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println("Model parameters: " + model.getTotalParameters());
 System.out.println("Classifier params: " + (classifierWeights.length + classifierBias.length));
 System.out.println("Learning rate: " + learningRate);
 System.out.println("Epochs: " + epochs);
 System.out.println("Batch size: " + batchSize);
 System.out.println("Training samples: " + trainImages.size());
 System.out.println("=======================================================================");
 System.out.println();
 
 float[] losses = new float[epochs];
 float[] accuracies = new float[epochs];
 
 for (int epoch = 0; epoch < epochs; epoch++) {
 long epochStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
 
 float totalLoss = 0;
 int correct = 0;
 int total = 0;
 int numBatches = 0;
 
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierWeights, 0);
 Arrays.fill(dClassifierBias, 0);
 
 for (int i = 0; i < trainImages.size(); i++) {
 float[] image = trainImages.get(i);
 int label = trainLabels.get(i);
 
 float[] features = model.forward(image);
