 p.add_argument("--layers", type=int, default=None, help="override the number of blocks")
 p.add_argument("--vocab-size", type=int, default=None, help="override the vocabulary size")
 p.add_argument("--num-bases", type=int, default=None, help="override the oscillator-bank size")
 p.add_argument("--local-kernel", type=int, default=None, help="override the local conv width")
 p.add_argument("--device", default="auto", help="cpu | cuda | auto (default: auto)")
 p.add_argument("--dtype", default="float32",
 choices=["float32", "float64", "bfloat16", "float16"])
 p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
 p.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="write the full JSON report here")

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
 ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
 prog="python -m simplcore.core.eval",
 description="Evaluation harness for simplcore.core (accounted memory, fitted "
 "throughput scaling, constructively-solvable long-range probes).")
 sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

 pe = sub.add_parser("evaluate", help="token-weighted loss / perplexity")
 _add_common(pe)

 help="synthetic (uniform random tokens) -- a stand-in until data.py exists")
 pe.add_argument("--dataset-module", default=None,
 help="import path 'pkg.mod:attr' of a real dataset (len/getitem -> (T,) LongTensor)")
 pe.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
 pe.add_argument("--seq-len", type=int, default=None)
 pe.add_argument("--max-batches", type=int, default=None)
 pe.add_argument("--n-sequences", type=int, default=512)

 pp = sub.add_parser("probe", help="long-range capability probes")
 _add_common(pp)
 _add_probe_opts(pp)

 pt = sub.add_parser("throughput", help="latency / tokens/s / accounted peak memory")
 _add_common(pt)
 pt.add_argument("--seq-lens", default="64,128,256,512")
 pt.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
 pt.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=3)
 pt.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=7)
 pt.add_argument("--backward", action="store_true")
 pt.add_argument("--reduce", default="min", choices=["min", "median"],
 help="latency aggregate across iterations (default: min, the low-noise one)")
 pt.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=None,
 help="torch.set_num_threads() for this run; a single thread gives a much "
 "cleaner scaling curve on a contended CPU")

 ps = sub.add_parser("streaming", help="constant streaming state vs sequence length")
 _add_common(ps)
 ps.add_argument("--lengths", default="64,256,1024")
 ps.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=1)
 ps.add_argument("--iters", type=int, default=16)

 pc = sub.add_parser("compare", help="same protocol across all four mixers")
 _add_common(pc)
 pc.add_argument("--mixers", default=",".join(MIXER_KINDS))
 pc.add_argument("--protocols", default="ppl")
 pc.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
 pc.add_argument("--eval-batches", type=int, default=8)
 pc.add_argument("--train-probes", action="store_true")
 pc.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=300)
 pc.add_argument("--probe-lr", type=float, default=1e-2)
 pc.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=1024)

 pst = sub.add_parser("self-test", help="prove the memory instrumentation works")
 _add_common(pst)
 return ap


def _cmd_evaluate(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 cfg = _resolve_config(args, device, dtype)
 model = SimplCoreModel(cfg).to(device, dtype=dtype).eval()
 if args.dataset_module:
 mod_name, _, attr = args.dataset_module.partition(":")
 import importlib
 ds = getattr(importlib.import_module(mod_name), attr or "DATASET")
 seq_len = args.seq_len
 else:
 seq_len = args.seq_len or 32
 ds = SyntheticDataset(cfg.vocab_size, seq_len, length=args.n_sequences, seed=args.seed)
 res = evaluate_lm(model, ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, seq_len=seq_len,
 device=device, max_batches=args.max_batches)
 res["dataset"] = (args.dataset_module or
 f"synthetic uniform tokens (seq_len {seq_len}, {args.n_sequences} seqs)")
 res["config"] = cfg.to_dict()
 res["n_params"] = int(model.num_params())
 return res


def _cmd_probe(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 cfg = _resolve_config(args, device, dtype)
 model = None
 model_eval: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 if args.model_steps > 0:
 model, model_eval = _train_sgc_on_task(
 cfg, args.task, device, dtype, steps=args.model_steps,
 batch_size=args.probe_batch, lr=args.probe_lr, seed=args.seed,
 loss=args.probe_loss, n_content=args.n_content, seq_len=args.seq_len,
 num_kv=args.num_kv, num_queries=args.num_queries, n_values=args.n_values,
 gaps_default=args.gaps)
 common = dict(train=not args.no_train, steps=args.steps, batch_size=args.probe_batch,
 lr=args.probe_lr, dim=args.probe_dim, num_layers=args.probe_layers,
 seed=args.seed, device=device, n_samples=args.n_samples, loss=args.probe_loss)
 out: Dict[str, Any] = {"config": cfg.to_dict()}
 tasks = (["selective-copy", "associative-recall", "interval-recall"]
 if args.task == "all" else [args.task])
 for t in tasks:
 if t == "selective-copy":
 out[t] = probe_selective_copy(model, n_content=args.n_content, seq_len=args.seq_len,
 **common)
 elif t == "associative-recall":
 out[t] = probe_associative_recall(model, num_kv=args.num_kv,
 num_queries=args.num_queries,
 vocab_key=args.num_kv, vocab_value=args.num_kv,
 **common)
 else:
 gaps = tuple(int(x) for x in args.gaps.split(",") if x.strip())
 out[t] = probe_interval_recall(model, gaps=gaps, n_values=args.n_values,
 train_all_gaps=args.train_all_gaps, **common)
 if model_eval:
 out["sgc_model_trained_on_probe"] = model_eval
 return out


def _task_for_train(name: str, **kw: Any) -> ProbeTask:
 if name == "selective-copy":
 return SelectiveCopyTask(n_content=kw["n_content"], seq_len=kw["seq_len"])
 if name == "associative-recall":
 return AssociativeRecallTask(num_kv=kw["num_kv"], num_queries=kw["num_queries"],
 vocab_key=kw["num_kv"], vocab_value=kw["num_kv"])
 if name == "interval-recall":
 gaps = tuple(int(x) for x in str(kw["gaps_default"]).split(",") if x.strip())
 return IntervalRecallTask(distractor_gap=gaps[-1], n_values=kw["n_values"])
 raise ValueError(f"unknown task {name!r}")


def _train_sgc_on_task(cfg: SimplCoreConfig, task_name: str, device: torch.device,
 dtype: torch.dtype, steps: int, batch_size: int, lr: float,
 seed: int, loss: str, **kw: Any) -> Tuple[nn.Module, Dict[str, Any]]:
 """Train a small SimplCore model *on a probe task* and report its accuracy.

 This is the honest end-to-end check: it shows whether the actual SGC mixer
 (not the probe's attention model) can learn the task at a given budget.
 """
 task = _task_for_train(task_name, **kw)
 full = _cfg_from_base(cfg, cfg.mixer, vocab_size=task.vocab_size)
 torch.manual_seed(seed)
 model = SimplCoreModel(full).to(device, dtype=dtype)
 opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=0.01, betas=(0.9, 0.98))
 sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(opt, max_lr=lr, total_steps=max(1, steps),
 pct_start=0.1)
 gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed + 5)
 curve: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 t0 = time.perf_counter()
 for s in range(steps):
 inputs, targets = task.sample(batch_size, gen, device=device)
 lg = _answer_logits(model, inputs, task.answer_pos)
 tg = _answer_targets(targets, task.answer_pos)
 l = _answer_loss(lg, tg, loss)
 opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 l.backward()
 torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
 opt.step()
 sched.step()
 if (s + 1) % max(1, steps // 4) == 0 or s == steps - 1:
 with torch.no_grad():
 xe, ye = task.sample(512, gen, device=device)
 lge = _answer_logits(model, xe, task.answer_pos)
 tge = _answer_targets(ye, task.answer_pos)
 curve.append({"step": int(s + 1), "train_loss": float(l.detach().cpu()),
 "eval_accuracy": float((lge.argmax(-1) == tge).float().mean())})
 print(f" sgc[{cfg.mixer}] step {s+1}/{steps} loss={float(l):.4f} "
 f"acc={curve[-1]['eval_accuracy']:.4f}", flush=True)
 ev = evaluate_probe(model, task, n_samples=2048, device=device)
 best = max(curve, key=lambda c: c["eval_accuracy"]) if curve else {"eval_accuracy": 0.0, "step": 0}
 out = {
 "task": task.describe(),
 "chance": float(task.chance),
 "steps": int(steps),
 "lr": float(lr),
 "loss": loss,
 "seconds": time.perf_counter() - t0,
 "curve": curve,
 "final": ev,
 "best_eval_accuracy": best["eval_accuracy"],
 "best_step": best["step"],
 "solvable_at_this_budget": bool(best["eval_accuracy"] >= max(1.5 * task.chance,
 task.chance + 0.05)),
 }
 return model, out


def _cmd_throughput(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 if getattr(args, "threads", None):
 torch.set_num_threads(int(args.threads))
 cfg = _resolve_config(args, device, dtype)
 model = SimplCoreModel(cfg).to(device, dtype=dtype)
 seq_lens = tuple(int(x) for x in args.seq_lens.split(",") if x.strip())
 rows, scaling = bench_throughput(model, seq_lens=seq_lens, batch_size=args.batch_size,
 device=device, warmup=args.warmup, iters=args.iters,
 backward=args.backward, dtype=dtype,
 vocab_size=cfg.vocab_size, reduce=args.reduce)
 body = _flatten_scaling(rows, scaling)
 body["config"] = cfg.to_dict()
 body["n_params"] = int(model.num_params())
 body["param_bytes"] = int(state_dict_bytes(model))
 body["memory_self_check"] = assert_memory_probe_works(device=str(device),
 dtype=str(dtype).replace("torch.", ""))
 return body


def _cmd_streaming(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 cfg = _resolve_config(args, device, dtype)
 if cfg.mixer not in ("sgc", "sgc-nogate", "sgc-nolocal", "srf"):
 raise SystemExit("bench_streaming needs an O(1) streaming mixer "
 "(sgc / sgc-nogate / sgc-nolocal / srf)")
 model = SimplCoreModel(cfg).to(device, dtype=dtype)
 lengths = tuple(int(x) for x in args.lengths.split(",") if x.strip())
 body = bench_streaming(model, lengths=lengths, batch_size=args.batch_size, device=device,
 iters=args.iters, dtype=dtype)
 body["config"] = cfg.to_dict()
 body["n_params"] = int(model.num_params())
 return body


def _cmd_compare(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 base = (SimplCoreConfig.from_json(args.config_json) if args.config_json
 else SimplCoreConfig.from_dict(SIMPLCORE_PRESETS[args.preset].to_dict()))
 mixers = [m.strip() for m in args.mixers.split(",") if m.strip()]
 protocols = [p.strip() for p in args.protocols.split(",") if p.strip()]
 return compare_mixers(base=base, mixers=mixers, protocols=protocols, device=device,
 dtype=dtype, batch_size=args.batch_size, train_probes=args.train_probes,
 steps=args.steps, lr=args.probe_lr, probe_samples=args.n_samples,
 eval_batches=args.eval_batches, seed=args.seed)


def _cmd_self_test(args: argparse.Namespace, device: torch.device, dtype: torch.dtype) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 return assert_memory_probe_works(device=str(device), dtype=str(dtype).replace("torch.", ""),
 verbose=True)


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
 ap = build_parser()
 args = ap.parse_args(list(argv) if argv is not None else None)
 global _CLI_COMMAND
 if argv is not None:
 _CLI_COMMAND = " ".join([Path(sys.executable).name, "-m", "simplcore.core.eval"] + list(argv))
 device = resolve_device(args.device)
 dtype = resolve_dtype(args.dtype)
 dispatch = {"evaluate": _cmd_evaluate, "probe": _cmd_probe, "throughput": _cmd_throughput,
 "streaming": _cmd_streaming, "compare": _cmd_compare, "self-test": _cmd_self_test}
 body = dispatch[args.cmd](args, device, dtype)
 report = _emit(args, body, device, dtype)
 if args.cmd in ("evaluate", "self-test"):
 print(json.dumps(report["result"], indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)[:4000])
 return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
 raise SystemExit(main())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""SimplCore 长上下文外推 + 衰减消融工具.

SimplCore 的核心差异化主张：**没有位置嵌入表、没有 ``max_len``**，因果卷积本身
编码位置，因此训练长度之外的长度"天然有定义"。但此前（``docs/SGC_CORE.md``
§9.4）只有"输出有限"的证据，没有质量证据。本模块提供两把可复现的尺子，
全部复用 :mod:`simplcore.core.eval` 的探针任务 + 可解性协议（``chance`` 水平
+ 训练对照），不把"输出有限"当成"质量保持"：

1. 长度外推探针 :func:`extrapolation_probe`
 -----------------------------------------
 在**固定**的短训练长度 L0 上训练一个可解任务，然后在 L0 的 1/2/4/8/16 倍
 长度上**零微调**评测，报告每个外推倍率下的准确率 + 困惑度 + 流式状态字节数
 （应恒为常数，与 L 无关）。曲线平坦即外推证据。

2. 衰减消融 :func:`decay_ablation`
 --------------------------------
 扫描 ``decay_max``（振荡基时间尺度先验），报告训练困惑度 + 2×外推准确率，
 回答 SGC_SPEC §9.5 的未证明项。

设计约束
--------
* 纯 torch，零第三方；训练/评测循环直接复用 ``eval.train_probe`` /
 ``eval.evaluate_probe``，不重造轮子；
* 可复现：固定 seed，报告记录全部超参；
* ``model_fn`` 钩子让你把任意模型（SGC / 混合 / 注意力基线）喂进同一把尺子，
 做公平的"外推能力"对照。

用法::

 python -m simplcore.core.extrapolation probe --preset debug --train-len 64 \\
 --scale 1,2,4,8 --task selective-copy --out x.json
 python -m simplcore.core.extrapolation decay --preset debug --train-len 64 \\
 --decay-maxes 64,256,1024,4096 --out d.json
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

from ..model.config import SimplCoreConfig, get_preset
from ..model.model import SimplCoreModel
from . import eval as _eval

__all__ = [
 "ExtrapolationResult",
 "DecayPoint",
 "extrapolation_probe",
 "decay_ablation",
 "sgc_model_factory",
 "main",
]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 探针任务构造（复用 eval 包）
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _make_task(task_name: str, seq_len: Optional[int] = None, **kw: Any):
 """按名字构造 eval 包里的探针任务；``seq_len`` 在构造时传入。"""
 from .eval import SelectiveCopyTask, IntervalRecallTask, AssociativeRecallTask
 if task_name in ("selective-copy", "selective_copy"):
 if seq_len is not None:
 return SelectiveCopyTask(seq_len=int(seq_len), **kw)
 return SelectiveCopyTask(**kw)
 if task_name in ("interval-recall", "interval_recall"):
 return IntervalRecallTask(**kw)
 if task_name in ("associative-recall", "mqar"):
 return AssociativeRecallTask(**kw)
 raise ValueError(f"unknown task {task_name!r}")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. 长度外推探针
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class ExtrapolationResult:
 """一次外推评测的结果。"""
 train_len: int
 scale: int # 外推倍率 k
 eval_len: int # L0 * k
 task: str
 chance: float
 acc: float # 零微调准确率
 ppl: Optional[float] # 任务可评测位置上的困惑度
 solvable_at_L0: Optional[bool] # L0 训练是否达到可解水平（对照基准）
 stream_bytes: int # 该长度下流式状态字节（应恒为常数）
 wall_ms: float


def extrapolation_probe(model_fn: Callable[[], nn.Module], *,
 task_name: str = "selective-copy",
 task_kw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
 train_len: int = 64, scales: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8),
 steps: int = 300, batch_size: int = 64, lr: float = 3e-3,
 n_samples: int = 512, seed: int = 0,
 device: Any = "cpu", verbose: bool = True,
 solvability_check: bool = True) -> List[ExtrapolationResult]:
 """长度外推探针。

 Args:
 model_fn: ``callable() -> model``，每次调用构造一个新模型（SGC / 混合 /
 注意力基线皆可）。训练用第一个实例，评测用它。
 task_name: selective-copy / interval-recall / associative-recall。
 train_len: 训练长度 L0（任务的 seq_len）。
 scales: 外推倍率 k，评测长度 = L0 * k。
 solvability_check: 是否在 L0 上做一次可解性检查（复用 eval 协议），
 作为"该任务在此预算下确实可解"的对照基准。

 协议（与 eval.py 一致）：
 * 在 L0 上训练 model_fn() 得到的模型；
 * 对每个 k，构造 seq_len=L0*k 的同任务评测集，**零微调**评测准确率/困惑度；
 * 报告 ``stream_bytes``（应恒为常数，与 L 无关——这是 SimplCore 的 O(1) 主张）。
 """
 results: List[ExtrapolationResult] = []
 kw = dict(task_kw or {})
 task0 = _make_task(task_name, seq_len=train_len, **kw)
 chance = float(task0.chance)

 model = model_fn()
 t0 = time.time()
 _eval.train_probe(task0, steps=steps, batch_size=batch_size, lr=lr,
 seed=seed, device=device, model_fn=lambda: model,
 final_eval_samples=min(n_samples, 1024), log=False,
 progress=False, eval_batches=1)
 model.eval()
 solvable = None
 if solvability_check:
 sol = _eval.evaluate_probe(model, task0, n_samples=min(n_samples, 1024),
 seed=seed, device=device)
 solvable = bool(sol["probe_accuracy"] >= max(1.5 * chance, chance + 0.05))
 if verbose:
 print(f"[extrap] trained on {task_name} @ L={train_len} ({steps} steps, "
 f"{time.time() - t0:.1f}s); solvable={solvable}", flush=True)

 for k in scales:
 eval_len = train_len * k
 task_k = _make_task(task_name, seq_len=eval_len, **kw)
 rep = _eval.evaluate_probe(model, task_k, n_samples=n_samples,
 seed=seed + 1000 * k, device=device)
 sbytes = int(model.stream_bytes(1)) if hasattr(model, "stream_bytes") else 0
 r = ExtrapolationResult(
 train_len=train_len, scale=k, eval_len=eval_len, task=task_name,
 chance=chance, acc=float(rep["probe_accuracy"]),
 ppl=(float(rep["probe_ppl"]) if rep.get("probe_ppl") else None),
 solvable_at_L0=solvable, stream_bytes=sbytes,
 wall_ms=(time.time() - t0) * 1000.0,
 )
 results.append(r)
 if verbose:
 print(f"[extrap] k={k:2d} L={eval_len:4d} acc={r.acc:.4f} "
 f"chance={chance:.4f} ppl={r.ppl if r.ppl else float('nan'):.3f} "
 f"stream_bytes={sbytes}", flush=True)
 return results


def sgc_model_factory(config: SimplCoreConfig) -> Callable[[], SimplCoreModel]:
 """返回 ``() -> SimplCoreModel``，每次构造一个新模型（同 config）。"""
 def factory() -> SimplCoreModel:
 return SimplCoreModel(config)
 return factory


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 衰减消融
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class DecayPoint:
 decay_max: float
 train_ppl: float
 extrap_ppl: float # 2x 长度下的困惑度（外推质量指标）
 acc: float
 extrap_acc: float
 note: str


def decay_ablation(config: SimplCoreConfig, *,
 decay_maxes: Sequence[float] = (64, 256, 1024, 4096),
 task_name: str = "selective-copy", train_len: int = 64,
 steps: int = 300, batch_size: int = 64, lr: float = 3e-3,
 n_samples: int = 256, seed: int = 0,
 device: Any = "cpu", verbose: bool = True,
 ) -> List[DecayPoint]:
 """扫描 ``decay_max``，报告各取值的训练困惑度 + 2×外推准确率/困惑度。

 这是 SGC_SPEC §9.5 的未证明项：默认 8192/16384 是按目标训练长度
 设定的先验，本函数给出"不同时间尺度先验 → 最终质量 + 外推保持"的实测曲线。
 """
 from ..model.config import SimplCoreConfig
 points: List[DecayPoint] = []
 for dm in decay_maxes:
 cfg = SimplCoreConfig.from_dict({**config.to_dict(), "decay_max": float(dm)})
 m = SimplCoreModel(cfg).to(device)
 task0 = _make_task(task_name, seq_len=train_len)
 _eval.train_probe(task0, steps=steps, batch_size=batch_size, lr=lr,
 seed=seed, device=device, model_fn=lambda: m,
 final_eval_samples=n_samples, log=False, progress=False,
 eval_batches=1)
 m.eval()
 rep0 = _eval.evaluate_probe(m, task0, n_samples=n_samples, seed=seed, device=device)
 task2 = _make_task(task_name, seq_len=train_len * 2)
 rep2 = _eval.evaluate_probe(m, task2, n_samples=n_samples, seed=seed + 1,
 device=device)
 p = DecayPoint(
 decay_max=float(dm),
 train_ppl=float(rep0["probe_ppl"] or 0.0),
 extrap_ppl=float(rep2["probe_ppl"] or 0.0),
 acc=float(rep0["probe_accuracy"]),
 extrap_acc=float(rep2["probe_accuracy"]),
 note=f"L={train_len}, scales=2x",
 )
 points.append(p)
 if verbose:
 print(f"[decay] decay_max={dm:6g} train_ppl={p.train_ppl:.4f} "
 f"extrap_ppl={p.extrap_ppl:.4f} acc={p.acc:.4f} "
 f"extrap_acc={p.extrap_acc:.4f}", flush=True)
 return points


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
 ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
 sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

 p_probe = sub.add_parser("probe", help="length-extrapolation probe")
 p_probe.add_argument("--preset", default="debug")
 p_probe.add_argument("--task", default="selective-copy",
 choices=["selective-copy", "interval-recall",
 "associative-recall"])
 p_probe.add_argument("--train-len", type=int, default=64)
 p_probe.add_argument("--scale", default="1,2,4,8")
 p_probe.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=300)
 p_probe.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=512)
 p_probe.add_argument("--out", default=None)

 p_decay = sub.add_parser("decay", help="decay_max ablation")
 p_decay.add_argument("--preset", default="debug")
 p_decay.add_argument("--task", default="selective-copy")
 p_decay.add_argument("--train-len", type=int, default=64)
 p_decay.add_argument("--decay-maxes", default="64,256,1024,4096")
 p_decay.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=300)
 p_decay.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=256)
 p_decay.add_argument("--out", default=None)

 args = ap.parse_args(argv)
 cfg = get_preset(args.preset)

 if args.cmd == "probe":
 scales = tuple(int(x) for x in args.scale.split(","))
 factory = sgc_model_factory(cfg)
 res = extrapolation_probe(factory, task_name=args.task, train_len=args.train_len,
 scales=scales, steps=args.steps,
 n_samples=args.n_samples)
 report = {"command": "probe", "config": cfg.to_dict(),
 "results": [asdict(r) for r in res]}
 _dump(report, args.out)
 elif args.cmd == "decay":
 dms = tuple(float(x) for x in args.decay_maxes.split(","))
 pts = decay_ablation(cfg, decay_maxes=dms, task_name=args.task,
 train_len=args.train_len, steps=args.steps,
 n_samples=args.n_samples)
 report = {"command": "decay", "config": cfg.to_dict(),
 "points": [asdict(p) for p in pts]}
 _dump(report, args.out)
 return 0


def _dump(report: Dict[str, Any], out: Optional[str]) -> None:
 s = json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
 print(s)
 if out:
 Path(out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 Path(out).write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
 print(f"\n[saved] {out}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
 raise SystemExit(main())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""长上下文检索评测（验收协议 ``X-longctx-retrieval`` + ``X-stream-consistency``）.

(Long-context needle retrieval eval: X-longctx-retrieval, X-stream-consistency.)

战役协议中两条必须用**真实输出**验收的闸门::

 Gate("X-longctx-retrieval", "1M / 2M / 4M 长上下文检索准确率 ≥ 基线")
 Gate("X-stream-consistency", "全部评测在流式与整段两种模式下结果一致")
 ShowcaseItem("S5-longctx-4m", "1M/2M/4M 检索+摘要综合 ≥ YaRN 扩展 TS-5B")
 ShowcaseItem("S7-honest-needle", "1M needle 精确召回 < TS-2B —— 信息论边界主动呈现")

设计原则
--------
1. **needle 任务是结构化、确定性、可审计的**。每条 trial 的语料由 seed
 完全决定：干扰序列 + ``K`` 个 needle（``[开标, key₂, key₁, 闭标, value]``）
 插在指定深度 + 查询后缀（``[开标, key₂, key₁, 闭标]``）。答案 =
 末位 argmax 是否等于目标 value —— 机器可判、无自报自评（forbidden 第 3 条）。
 多 needle 不同深度防"只记最后一个"；逐深度分桶 + 最差桶入报告
 （forbidden 第 4 条，禁 average-only）。
2. **流式==整段是闸门，不是注释**。同一模型对同一 trial 分别跑并行前向与
 O(1) 流式（``init_stream``/``stream_step``），argmax 必须逐 trial 相同、
 logit 差必须 < 容差 —— ``X-stream-consistency`` 是协议的一部分，因为
 "1M 检索"如果只在整段模式成立而流式掉点，部署口径就是假的。
3. **长 L 的账先于跑**。TS 臂 KV cache = ``2·L·layers·D·2B``（bf16 K+V），
 随 L 线性；1M 时 3B 级 TS ~32 GB（§5.13 口径）。给定 ``max_device_mem``
 （默认 80 GiB）后，放不下的臂**如实标记不可跑**，账面照报、闸门给
 ``insufficient_device_memory`` 而不是假装比过 —— 不跑假对照。
4. **S7 的诚实呈现是结构性的**。报告永久携带信息论账：needle 原文字节、
 O(1) 流式状态字节、TS KV 字节三行并列。若 SimplCore 检索不如基线，
 ``unqualified_claim_permitted`` 就是 False，且 S7 字段把边界数字直接给出
 —— 主动呈现弱点与呈现优点是同一个协议。

用法 (usage)::

 python -m simplcore.core.longctx_eval --preset smoke --lengths 512 --out runs/eval_longctx.json
 python -m simplcore.core.longctx_eval --lengths 8192 --trials-per-depth 4
 python -m simplcore.core.longctx_eval --lengths 1048576,2097152,4194304 --ledger-only

Copyright 2026 (C) 六安市青奈科技有限责任公司
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

import torch

__all__ = [
 "NeedleCorpus",
 "NeedleTrial",
 "run_longctx_eval",
 "score_trial",
]

PROTOCOL = "X-longctx-retrieval"
REPORT_VERSION = 1

MARK_OPEN = 0 # needle/查询块开始
MARK_CLOSE = 1 # key 与 value 的分界（查询块以它结尾，答案 = 其后一位）


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# needle 语料（确定性）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class NeedleTrial:
 """一条检索 trial 的全部机器可判信息。"""

 tokens: torch.Tensor # (L,) 完整序列（含查询后缀）
 value_token: int # 正确答案
 depth: float # query key 的插入深度 ∈ (0,1)
 key_id: int # 被查询的 key
 all_key_depths: List[float] # 全部 needle 的（key_id, 深度）账
 n_values: int


class NeedleCorpus:
 """确定性 needle 语料生成器。

 词表布局（``vocab_size`` 由本类划定，建模方照抄）::

 [0] MARK_OPEN [1] MARK_CLOSE
 [2 .. 2+2K) key tokens（key i = (2+2i, 3+2i)，各 2 token）
 [2+2K .. 2+2K+V) value tokens（value j = 2+2K+j）
 其余 haystack fillers

 序列布局（定长 L）::

 haystack(L-4-q) 每隔一段插一个 needle 块(5 token，slice 替换)，
 末尾 append 查询后缀 (4 token) = [OPEN, k1, k2, CLOSE]
 答案 = 末位 logits 的 argmax（预测 CLOSE 之后那一位）。
 """

 def __init__(self, seq_len: int, *, n_keys: int = 4, n_values: int = 8,
 needles_per_seq: int = 4, seed: int = 2026) -> None:
 if seq_len < 64:
 raise ValueError(f"seq_len must be >= 64, got {seq_len}")
 if needles_per_seq < 1 or needles_per_seq > n_keys:
 raise ValueError("needles_per_seq in [1, n_keys]")
 self.seq_len = int(seq_len)
 self.n_keys = int(n_keys)
 self.n_values = int(n_values)
 self.needles_per_seq = int(needles_per_seq)
 self.seed = int(seed)
 self.vocab_size = 2 + 2 * self.n_keys + self.n_values + 16 # +16 fillers

 # -- 词表映射 -------------------------------------------------------------
 def key_tokens(self, key_id: int) -> Tuple[int, int]:
 return 2 + 2 * key_id, 3 + 2 * key_id

 def value_token(self, value_id: int) -> int:
 return 2 + 2 * self.n_keys + value_id

 def _filler(self, g: torch.Generator) -> int:
 return 2 + 2 * self.n_keys + self.n_values + int(
 torch.randint(0, self.vocab_size - (2 + 2 * self.n_keys + self.n_values),
 (1,), generator=g))

 # -- 生成一条 trial --------------------------------------------------------
 def make_trial(self, index: int, depth: float) -> NeedleTrial:
 """第 ``index`` 条 trial，query key 的 needle 落在相对深度 ``depth``。"""
 if not 0.0 < depth < 1.0:
 raise ValueError(f"depth must be in (0,1), got {depth}")
 g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(self.seed * 100003 + index)
 L, body = self.seq_len, self.seq_len - 4 # 去掉查询后缀
 seq = [self._filler(g) for _ in range(body)]
 # K 个 needle：query key 落 depth（精确配对，不排序打乱），其余均匀散布
 rest_keys = [k for k in range(self.n_keys) if k != index % self.n_keys]
 chosen = rest_keys[:self.needles_per_seq - 1]
 filler_depths = [0.05 + 0.18 * i for i in range(len(chosen))]
 keyed = [(index % self.n_keys, depth)] + list(zip(chosen, filler_depths))
 # value 分配：每个 key 一个固定 value（seed 决定映射，全语料一致）
 key2value = {k: self.value_token((self.seed + k) % self.n_values)
 for k, _ in keyed}
 for k, d in keyed:
 pos = min(max(int(d * (body - 5)), 0), body - 5)
 k1, k2 = self.key_tokens(k)
 seq[pos:pos + 5] = [MARK_OPEN, k1, k2, MARK_CLOSE, key2value[k]]
 k1, k2 = self.key_tokens(index % self.n_keys)
 seq += [MARK_OPEN, k1, k2, MARK_CLOSE] # 查询后缀
 return NeedleTrial(tokens=torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long),
 value_token=key2value[index % self.n_keys],
 depth=depth, key_id=index % self.n_keys,
 all_key_depths=[[k, round(d, 4)] for k, d in keyed],
 n_values=self.n_values)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 评分（并行 + 流式两模式）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def score_trial(model: Any, trial: NeedleTrial, *, mode: str,
 consistency_tol: float = 4e-5,
 chunk_size: int = 4096
 ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 """对一条 trial 计分，返回 argmax 正确性 + value NLL +（流式时）一致性账。

 * ``mode="parallel"``：整段前向，取末位 logits。
 * ``mode="streaming"``：逐 token ``stream_step``（O(1) 状态）；
 若模型同时支持并行，则附带回算整段 logits 做一致性核验
 （argmax 相等 + max|Δlogit| < ``consistency_tol``）。
 * ``mode="chunked"``：分块前向（截断状态、无梯度），4M 长度下不会
 把 ``(L, D)`` 核与激活一次性物化。训练中途的 GATE-2 用这条路径。
 """
 x = trial.tokens.unsqueeze(0)
 with torch.no_grad():
 if mode == "parallel":
 res = model(x, None)
 logits = res[0] if isinstance(res, tuple) else res
 last = logits[0, -1]
 extra: Dict[str, Any] = {}
 elif mode == "chunked":
 if not hasattr(model, "forward_chunked"):
 raise ValueError("model does not support forward_chunked")
 logits = model.forward_chunked(x, chunk_size=int(chunk_size))
 last = logits[0, -1]
 extra = {"chunk_size": int(chunk_size)}
 elif mode == "streaming":
 if not getattr(model, "supports_streaming", False):
 raise ValueError("model does not support O(1) streaming")
 # 状态 dtype 取模型参数精度（fp32/bf16），绝不能传 token id 的
 # int64——递推状态 dtype 是浮点语义（v1.1.2 勘误：int64 曾被
 # recurrent_dtype 原样接受，递推在整数域进行 → 数值垃圾）
 state = model.init_stream(
 1, device=x.device,
 dtype=next(model.parameters()).dtype)
 last = None
 for t in x[0].tolist():
 last, state = model.stream_step(torch.tensor([t]), state)
 last = last[0]
 # 一致性核验（有并行能力才算 —— 这是闸门数据，不是装饰）
 if hasattr(model, "forward"):
 res = model(x, None)
 par = (res[0] if isinstance(res, tuple) else res)[0, -1]
 extra = {
 "stream_consistent": bool(torch.equal(last.argmax(), par.argmax())),
 "max_logit_diff": float((last - par).abs().max()),
 "tolerance": consistency_tol,
 }
 extra["within_tol"] = extra["max_logit_diff"] <= consistency_tol
 else:
 extra = {}
 else:
 raise ValueError(f"mode must be parallel|streaming, got {mode!r}")
 logp = torch.log_softmax(last.float(), dim=-1)
 return {
 "argmax": int(last.argmax()),
 "correct": bool(int(last.argmax()) == trial.value_token),
 "value_nll": float(-logp[trial.value_token]),
 "rank_of_value": int((logp > logp[trial.value_token]).sum()),
 **extra,
 }


def _ts_kv_bytes(layers: int, dim: int, seq_len: int,
 bytes_per_elm: int = 2) -> int:
 """TS 臂 KV cache 字节：K+V × layers × L × dim × 元素字节（bf16=2）。"""
 return 2 * layers * int(seq_len) * dim * bytes_per_elm


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 主入口
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_longctx_eval(*, preset: str = "smoke",
 lengths: Sequence[int] = (512,),
 trials_per_depth: int = 2,
 depths: Sequence[float] = (0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9),
 seed: int = 2026, max_device_mem_gb: float = 80.0,
 ledger_only: bool = False, out_path: Any = None
 ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 """跑长上下文检索评测，返回报告 dict（``out_path`` 不为 None 时落盘）。

 Args:
 preset: ``smoke`` / ``small`` / ``1b``（同 :mod:`equal_budget` 的配置族）。
 lengths: 评估的序列长度阶梯（如 ``512`` 或 ``1048576,2097152,4194304``）。
 trials_per_depth: 每个深度的 trial 数（总 trial = ×len(depths)）。
 ledger_only: 只算账不跑模型 —— 1M/2M/4M 的可行性账 + S7 信息论边界，
 CPU 上跑 1M 整段不现实时用它；正式实机评测才关掉。
 """
 from ..model.config import SimplCoreConfig
 from ..model.model import SimplCoreModel

 if preset == "smoke":
 sc_kw = dict(vocab_size=None, dim=32, num_layers=2, num_bases=8,
 ffn_ratio=2.0, local_kernel=4, decay_max=512.0,
 tie_embeddings=False)
 elif preset == "small":
 sc_kw = dict(vocab_size=None, dim=256, num_layers=8, num_bases=32,
 ffn_ratio=4.0, local_kernel=4, decay_max=65536.0,
 tie_embeddings=True)
 elif preset == "1b":
 from ..model.config import get_preset
 sc_cfg = get_preset("tuan-1b")
 sc_kw = None
 else:
 raise ValueError(f"unknown preset {preset!r}")

 max_dev = int(max_device_mem_gb * (1 << 30))
 length_rows = []
 for L in lengths:
 L = int(L)
 corpus = NeedleCorpus(L, seed=seed)
 if sc_kw is not None:
 cfg = SimplCoreConfig(**{**sc_kw, "vocab_size": corpus.vocab_size})
 else:
 cfg = sc_cfg
 # ---- 账本（先于跑：TS 放不下就不跑假对照） -------------------------
 from .scaling import stream_state_bytes, non_embedding_params
 sc_state = int(stream_state_bytes(cfg))
 ts_layers = cfg.num_layers # 参数对齐由 equal_budget 证明可行，
 ts_dim = cfg.dim # 此处账本按同形 TS 记（口径注明）
 ts_kv = _ts_kv_bytes(ts_layers, ts_dim, L)
 ts_runnable = ts_kv <= max_dev
 # S7 信息论账：needle 原文（5 token/needle × bf16）vs 状态字节
 needle_bytes = 5 * corpus.needles_per_seq * 2
 row = {
 "seq_len": L,
 "simplcore_stream_state_bytes": sc_state,
 "simplcore_state_over_needle_bytes": round(sc_state / max(needle_bytes, 1), 1),
 "ts_kv_cache_bytes": ts_kv,
 "ts_kv_over_sc_state": round(ts_kv / max(sc_state, 1), 1),
 "ts_runnable_on_device": bool(ts_runnable),
 "needle_original_bytes": needle_bytes,
 "chance_level": 1.0 / corpus.n_values,
 }
 if ledger_only or not ts_runnable:
 row["evaluated"] = False
 row["reason"] = ("ledger_only" if ledger_only
 else f"TS KV cache {ts_kv} bytes > device {max_dev} bytes")
 length_rows.append(row)
 continue

 # ---- 实跑两臂 -------------------------------------------------------
 torch.manual_seed(seed)
 sc_model = SimplCoreModel(cfg).eval()
 from .equal_budget import TSConfig, TransformerBaseline
 ts_cfg = TSConfig(vocab_size=corpus.vocab_size, dim=cfg.dim,
 num_layers=cfg.num_layers,
 ffn_hidden=int(cfg.ffn_hidden or cfg.ffn_ratio * cfg.dim),
 num_heads=max(1, cfg.dim // 16))
 torch.manual_seed(seed + 1)
 ts_model = TransformerBaseline(ts_cfg).eval()

 def run_arm(model: Any, mode: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 per_depth: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
 n_ok = n_tot = 0
 max_diff = 0.0
 all_consistent = True
 t0 = time.time()
 for di, d in enumerate(depths):
 bucket: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
 for j in range(int(trials_per_depth)):
 idx = di * int(trials_per_depth) + j
 tr = corpus.make_trial(idx, d)
 r = score_trial(model, tr, mode=mode)
 if "max_logit_diff" in r:
 max_diff = max(max_diff, r["max_logit_diff"])
 all_consistent = all_consistent and r["stream_consistent"] and r["within_tol"]
 bucket.append(r)
 n_ok += int(r["correct"])
 n_tot += 1
 per_depth[f"{d:.2f}"] = bucket
 acc = n_ok / max(n_tot, 1)
 worst = min(
 sum(int(r["correct"]) for r in b) / max(len(b), 1)
 for b in per_depth.values())
 return {
 "accuracy": acc,
 "worst_depth_accuracy": worst,
 "per_depth_accuracy": {k: sum(int(r["correct"]) for r in b) / max(len(b), 1)
 for k, b in per_depth.items()},
 "mean_value_nll": sum(r["value_nll"] for b in per_depth.values()
 for r in b) / max(n_tot, 1),
 "n_trials": n_tot,
 "stream_consistency_all": (all_consistent if mode == "streaming" else None),
 "max_logit_diff_parallel_vs_stream": (max_diff if mode == "streaming" else None),
 "wall_seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 3),
 }

 sc_res = run_arm(sc_model, "streaming") # SC 主口径 = 流式（部署口径）
 sc_par = run_arm(sc_model, "parallel") # 整段复核（一致性账）
 ts_res = run_arm(ts_model, "parallel")
 row.update({
 "evaluated": True,
 "simplcore": sc_res,
 "transformer": ts_res,
 "stream_consistency": {
 "X-stream-consistency_passed": bool(sc_res["stream_consistency_all"]),
 "parallel_accuracy": sc_par["accuracy"],
 "streaming_accuracy": sc_res["accuracy"],
 "max_logit_diff": sc_res["max_logit_diff_parallel_vs_stream"],
 },
 })
 length_rows.append(row)

 # ---- 闸门 ------------------------------------------------------------
 ev = [r for r in length_rows if r.get("evaluated")]
 consistency_pass = bool(ev) and all(
 r["stream_consistency"]["X-stream-consistency_passed"] for r in ev)
 retrieval_rows = [r for r in ev if "transformer" in r]
 retrieval_pass = bool(retrieval_rows) and all(
 r["simplcore"]["accuracy"] >= r["transformer"]["accuracy"]
 for r in retrieval_rows)
 # 未训练/近 chance 的"≥基线"没有意义 —— 如实标注供人工复核
 near_chance = all(r["simplcore"]["accuracy"] <= 2.0 * r["chance_level"]
 for r in retrieval_rows)
 gates = {
 "X-longctx-retrieval": {
 "passed": bool(retrieval_pass),
 "evaluated_lengths": [r["seq_len"] for r in retrieval_rows],
 "not_evaluated": [{"seq_len": r["seq_len"], "reason": r.get("reason")}
 for r in length_rows if not r.get("evaluated")],
 "near_chance_warning": bool(near_chance),
 "note": ("未实跑的长度不参与判定 —— 账面不可行就是不可行，不假装比过"
 + ("；当前准确率处于 chance 附近，任何 PASS 不构成能力证据"
 if near_chance else "")),
 },
 "X-stream-consistency": {
 "passed": bool(consistency_pass),
 "scope": "全部 trial 的流式 argmax == 整段 argmax 且 logit 差在容差内",
 },
 }
 unqualified = bool(retrieval_pass and consistency_pass and ev
 and len(length_rows) == len(ev) and not near_chance)
 report = {
 "protocol": PROTOCOL,
 "report_version": REPORT_VERSION,
 "created_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
 "preset": preset,
 "depths": list(depths),
 "trials_per_depth": int(trials_per_depth),
 "max_device_mem_gb": max_device_mem_gb,
 "lengths": length_rows,
 "gates": gates,
 "honesty": {
 "unqualified_claim_permitted": unqualified,
 "S7_honest_needle": {
 "definition": "信息论边界主动呈现：O(1) 状态字节 vs 上下文原文字节 vs TS KV",
 "rows": [{k: r[k] for k in ("seq_len", "simplcore_stream_state_bytes",
 "ts_kv_cache_bytes", "needle_original_bytes",
 "simplcore_state_over_needle_bytes",
 "ts_kv_over_sc_state")} for r in length_rows],
 },
 "forbidden_checks": {
 "no_attention_internal_comparison": True,
 "equal_budget_qualifier_present": True,
 "no_self_reported_scores": True, # argmax==value 机器可判
 "distribution_not_average_only": True, # 逐深度分桶 + 最差桶
 },
 "notes": [
 "TS 臂 KV 账按与 SC 同形（同 layers/dim）计；参数量对齐见 equal_budget",
 "SMOKE/合成结果不可替代 1M 实机验收；ledger_only 行只记账不判定",
 ],
 },
 }
 if out_path is not None:
 out = Path(out_path)
 out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
 encoding="utf-8")
 return report


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_arg_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
 p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
 prog="python -m simplcore.core.longctx_eval",
 description="长上下文检索评测（X-longctx-retrieval + X-stream-consistency）。")
 p.add_argument("--preset", default="smoke", choices=("smoke", "small", "1b"))
 p.add_argument("--lengths", default="512",
 help="逗号分隔的序列长度阶梯，如 512,8192 或 1048576,2097152,4194304")
 p.add_argument("--trials-per-depth", type=int, default=2)
 p.add_argument("--max-device-mem-gb", type=float, default=80.0)
 p.add_argument("--ledger-only", action="store_true",
 help="只算可行性账与 S7 信息论边界，不跑模型")
 p.add_argument("--out", default="runs/eval_longctx.json")
 return p


def main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None) -> int:
 args = build_arg_parser().parse_args(argv)
 lengths = [int(x) for x in str(args.lengths).split(",") if x.strip()]
 rep = run_longctx_eval(preset=args.preset, lengths=lengths,
 trials_per_depth=args.trials_per_depth,
 max_device_mem_gb=args.max_device_mem_gb,
 ledger_only=args.ledger_only, out_path=args.out)
 print(f"protocol={rep['protocol']} preset={rep['preset']} lengths={lengths}")
 for r in rep["lengths"]:
 if r.get("evaluated"):
 sc, ts = r["simplcore"], r["transformer"]
 print(f"L={r['seq_len']}: sc_acc={sc['accuracy']:.3f} "
 f"(worst {sc['worst_depth_accuracy']:.3f}) "
 f"ts_acc={ts['accuracy']:.3f} "
 f"stream_consistent={r['stream_consistency']['X-stream-consistency_passed']}")
 else:
 print(f"L={r['seq_len']}: ledger-only state={r['simplcore_stream_state_bytes']}B "
 f"ts_kv={r['ts_kv_cache_bytes']}B ({r['reason']})")
 for name, g in rep["gates"].items():
 print(f"gate {name}: {'PASS' if g['passed'] else 'FAIL'}")
 print(f"report: {args.out}")
 return 0


if __name__ == "__main__": # pragma: no cover
 raise SystemExit(main())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""mathproof —— 架构数学主张的机器可验证证明（符号 + fp64 数值）。

与 ``theory.py`` 的分工
-----------------------
``theory.py`` 守护"模块行为符合文档主张"（工程断言，fp32 口径）；
本模块证明"数学本身成立"（derivations，fp64 / 符号口径）：

* 闭式阻尼振荡核 ↔ 二阶 IIR 递推的**等价性**（sympy 符号 + fp64）；
* 伴随矩阵幂 = 闭式解；特征值模长 = ρ（稳定性谱）；
* **分块携带律**（``chunked_iir_scan`` 的数学基础）与叠加原理；
* FFT 零填充 N=2L 的**无混叠**精确性（对照 O(L²) 直接卷积）；
* BIBO 稳定性与核 ℓ₁ 界 ``Σ|ψ| ≤ 1/(1−ρ)``；
* 流式 == 并行（mixer 级，fp64，gates 开/关两种口径）；
* 证据门 cumsum / 运行和恒等式；闸门有界性（三角不等式）；
* 时移协变性（门关）与非协变性（门开，设计使然）；
* O(1) 状态的**充分性**（马尔可夫性：同状态 ⇒ 未来逐位一致）；
* 复杂度公式的逐项重推导审计；HBM 账本代数；冻结基座梯度隔离。

全部证明**不依赖任何硬件**：符号部分用 sympy（缺省时退化为 fp64 数值），
数值部分统一 fp64、容差按推导给出。CLI：``python -m simplcore.core.mathproof``。

诚实边界
--------
数值证明在 fp64 与小尺寸上进行 —— 它证明**数学结构**正确，
不证明 1B 实机精度/吞吐（那需要卡，见 ``campaign.py`` Phase 0）。
"""

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 结果容器
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProofResult:
 """一项数学证明的结果。"""

 pid: str # 证明编号，如 "P03"
 claim: str # 被证明的数学命题
 method: str # symbolic / numeric-fp64 / algebraic / numeric-fp32-impl
 passed: bool
 residual: str # 残差或关键量（人类可读）
 note: str = ""


def _frac(a: float, b: float) -> float:
 """相对残差。"""
 return abs(a) / max(abs(b), 1e-300)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P01 闭式核 ↔ 二阶递推（sympy 符号 + fp64 数值）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_closed_form() -> ProofResult:
 """ψ_τ = ρ^τ·sin((τ+1)θ) 满足 y_τ = 2ρcosθ·y_{τ−1} − ρ²·y_{τ−2} + sinθ·δ_τ。

 初条件：ψ_0 = sinθ（脉冲驱动），ψ_1 = 2ρcosθ·ψ_0 = ρ·sin2θ。
 符号部分：令 x = e^{iθ}，sin(kθ) = (x^k − x^{−k})/(2i)，cosθ = (x + x^{−1})/2，
 则递推残差是 (ρ, x) 的 Laurent 多项式 —— 对 t = 1..12 逐个 ``cancel`` 到恒 0。
 """
 # --- 符号证明（整数 t，符号 rho/x） -------------------------------------
 symbolic = "unavailable"
 sym_ok = True
 try:
 import sympy as sp
 rho, x = sp.symbols("rho x", positive=True)
 iu = sp.I

 def psi(t: int):
 return rho ** t * (x ** (t + 1) - x ** (-(t + 1))) / (2 * iu)

 a = 2 * rho * (x + 1 / x) / 2
 b = -rho ** 2
 # 初条件 ψ_1 = a·ψ_0（t=1 时 y_{-1}:=0，脉冲在 t=0）
 r1 = sp.cancel(sp.together(psi(1) - a * psi(0)))
 sym_ok = sym_ok and (sp.simplify(r1) == 0)
 # 递推 t = 2..12（无输入）
 for t in range(2, 13):
 res = psi(t) - a * psi(t - 1) - b * psi(t - 2)
 sym_ok = sym_ok and (sp.simplify(sp.cancel(sp.together(res))) == 0)
 symbolic = "proved" if sym_ok else "FAILED"
 except ImportError:
 sym_ok = True # 无 sympy 时由数值部分独立承担

 # --- fp64 数值证明（网格 × 长序列） -------------------------------------
 torch.manual_seed(11)
 grid = [(0.30, math.pi / 7), (0.70, math.pi / 3), (0.95, 2 * math.pi / 3),
 (0.99, 5 * math.pi / 6), (0.999, math.pi / 2)]
 worst = 0.0
 for r, th in grid:
 a = 2.0 * r * math.cos(th)
 b = -(r ** 2)
 c = math.sin(th)
 T = 4096
 u = torch.zeros(T, dtype=torch.float64)
 u[0] = 1.0 # 单位脉冲
 y1 = y2 = 0.0
 for t in range(T):
 y_new = a * y1 + b * y2 + c * u[t].item()
 y2, y1 = y1, y_new
 closed = (r ** t) * math.sin((t + 1) * th)
 worst = max(worst, abs(y_new - closed))
 ok = sym_ok and worst < 1e-9
 method = "symbolic(sympy)+numeric-fp64" if symbolic == "proved" else "numeric-fp64"
 return ProofResult("P01", "闭式阻尼振荡核满足二阶 IIR 递推（含初条件）",
 method, ok, f"符号={symbolic}, fp64 最大残差={worst:.3e}",
 "grid ρ∈{0.3..0.999}, θ∈(0,π), T=4096")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P02 伴随矩阵幂 = 闭式解；特征值模长 = ρ
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_companion_matrix() -> ProofResult:
 """A = [[2ρcosθ, −ρ²],[1,0]]，s_t=[y_t; y_{t−1}]。

 (a) A^n·[sinθ; 0] = [ρⁿ·sin((n+1)θ); ρ^{n−1}·sin(nθ)]（n ≤ 128）；
 (b) eig(A) = ρ·e^{±iθ}，模长恰为 ρ < 1（谱半径 = 衰减率）。
 这是分块扫描状态转移 A^c 的数学基础（P03 直接使用）。
 """
 torch.manual_seed(12)
 grid = [(0.30, math.pi / 7), (0.70, math.pi / 3), (0.95, 2 * math.pi / 3),
 (0.99, 5 * math.pi / 6), (0.999, math.pi / 2)]
 worst_pow, worst_eig = 0.0, 0.0
 for r, th in grid:
 a, b = 2.0 * r * math.cos(th), -(r ** 2)
 A = torch.tensor([[a, b], [1.0, 0.0]], dtype=torch.float64)
 s0 = torch.tensor([math.sin(th), 0.0], dtype=torch.float64)
 for n in range(1, 129):
 lhs = torch.matrix_power(A, n) @ s0
 rhs = torch.tensor([r ** n * math.sin((n + 1) * th),
 r ** (n - 1) * math.sin(n * th)], dtype=torch.float64)
 worst_pow = max(worst_pow, (lhs - rhs).abs().max().item())
 eigs = torch.linalg.eigvals(A)
 worst_eig = max(worst_eig, (eigs.abs() - r).abs().max().item())
 ok = worst_pow < 1e-9 and worst_eig < 1e-12
 return ProofResult("P02", "伴随矩阵幂给出闭式解；谱半径 |eig(A)| = ρ < 1",
 "numeric-fp64", ok,
 f"矩阵幂最大残差={worst_pow:.3e}, 特征值模长残差={worst_eig:.3e}",
 "grid 5×(ρ,θ), n=1..128")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P03 分块携带律 + 叠加原理（chunked_iir_scan 的数学基础）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_chunk_carry_law() -> ProofResult:
 """对常系数二阶递推 s_t = A·s_{t−1} + [c·u_t; 0]：

 (a) 闭式分块计算 y_t = (A^t·s₀)₁ + Σ_{j≤t} (A^{t−j}·[c·u_j; 0])₁
 == 逐步模拟（fp64, 残差 ~1e-12）；
 (b) **叠加原理**：out(s₀, u) − out(0, u) == 齐次响应 (A^t·s₀)₁（线性）；
 (c) **两块组合**：state(c₁+c₂) = state(c₂) ∘ state(c₁)，
 输出逐位一致（同一算子序列 → torch.equal）。

 这就是后端 ``chunked_iir_scan`` + ``stream_state_*`` 必须满足的合同数学。
 """
 torch.manual_seed(13)
 grid = [(0.85, math.pi / 5), (0.98, 2.3), (0.60, 0.7)]
 worst_closed, worst_super = 0.0, 0.0
 bit_exact = True
 for r, th in grid:
 a, b, c = 2.0 * r * math.cos(th), -(r ** 2), math.sin(th)
 A = torch.tensor([[a, b], [1.0, 0.0]], dtype=torch.float64)
 Bv = torch.tensor([c, 0.0], dtype=torch.float64)
 T1, T2 = 13, 9
 u1 = torch.randn(T1, dtype=torch.float64)
 u2 = torch.randn(T2, dtype=torch.float64)
 s0 = torch.randn(2, dtype=torch.float64)

 def run(inputs: torch.Tensor, st: torch.Tensor):
 ys = []
 for t in range(inputs.shape[0]):
 st = A @ st + Bv * inputs[t].item()
 ys.append(st[0].item())
 return ys, st

 # (i) 逐步模拟（携带 s0）
 ys_seq, s_end = run(torch.cat([u1, u2]), s0.clone())
 # (ii) 闭式分块：齐次 + 特解
 ys_closed = []
 uu = torch.cat([u1, u2])
 for t in range(uu.shape[0]):
 y = (torch.matrix_power(A, t + 1) @ s0)[0].item()
 for j in range(t + 1):
 y += (torch.matrix_power(A, t - j) @ (Bv * uu[j].item()))[0].item()
 ys_closed.append(y)
 worst_closed = max(worst_closed, max(abs(p - q) for p, q in zip(ys_seq, ys_closed)))
 # (iii) 叠加：out(s0,u) − out(0,u) == 齐次响应
 ys_zero, _ = run(torch.cat([u1, u2]), torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float64))
 hom = [(torch.matrix_power(A, t + 1) @ s0)[0].item() for t in range(uu.shape[0])]
 sup = [p - q for p, q in zip(ys_seq, ys_zero)]
 worst_super = max(worst_super, max(abs(p - q) for p, q in zip(sup, hom)))
 # (iv) 两块组合：逐位一致（第二块的输出与拼接运行的后 T2 个位置比较）
 _, s1 = run(u1, s0.clone())
 ys_c2, s_c2 = run(u2, s1.clone())
 ys_cat, s_cat = run(torch.cat([u1, u2]), s0.clone())
 if ys_c2 != ys_cat[T1:] or not torch.equal(s_c2, s_cat):
 bit_exact = False
 ok = worst_closed < 1e-9 and worst_super < 1e-9 and bit_exact
 return ProofResult("P03", "分块携带律：闭式分块==逐步模拟；叠加原理成立；两块组合逐位一致",
 "numeric-fp64", ok,
 f"闭式残差={worst_closed:.3e}, 叠加残差={worst_super:.3e}, "
 f"组合逐位一致={bit_exact}",
 "这是 backend_contract.chunked_iir_scan 的合同数学")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P04 FFT 因果卷积无混叠（N=2L 零填充）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_fft_no_aliasing() -> ProofResult:
 """fft_causal_conv == 直接 O(L²) 因果卷积（fp64），对 L∈{1,2,3,5,8,17,64,257}。

 命题：长度 2L 的圆周卷积在"输入长 L、核长 ≤ L、均因果"时无回绕污染，
 故截断前 L 个位置给出**精确**线性卷积 —— 零填充倍数 2 是充分的（紧下界）。
 """
 torch.manual_seed(14)
 worst = 0.0
 for L in (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 17, 64, 257):
 u = torch.randn(2, L, 3, dtype=torch.float64)
 k = torch.randn(L, 3, dtype=torch.float64)
 y_fft = fft_causal_conv(u, k, torch.float64)
 y_ref = torch.zeros_like(u)
 for t in range(L):
 # y[t] = Σ_{s≤t} k[t−s]·u[s]
 y_ref[:, t] = (k[:t + 1].flip(0).unsqueeze(0) * u[:, :t + 1]).sum(dim=1)
 worst = max(worst, (y_fft - y_ref).abs().max().item())
 ok = worst < 1e-9
 return ProofResult("P04", "FFT 因果卷积（N=2L 零填充）== 直接卷积，无混叠",
 "numeric-fp64", ok, f"最大残差={worst:.3e}",
 "L∈{1,2,3,5,8,17,64,257}（含素数与非 2 幂）")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P05 BIBO 稳定性与核 ℓ₁ 界
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_bibo_stability() -> ProofResult:
 """ρ = σ(raw) < 1（fp64 数学层对任意有限 raw 严格成立）；
 |ψ_τ| ≤ ρ^τ（包络）；Σ_τ |ψ_τ| ≤ 1/(1−ρ)（|sin| ≤ 1 的几何和）→ BIBO 稳定。

 **实现层卫兵（0.1-α，阈值口径对齐）**：torch fp32 的 sigmoid 在
 raw ≳ **16.636**（= 24·ln2，``exp(x)/(1+exp(x))`` 实现路径**实测**，
 见 ``test_audit_guards.py`` 的饱和测试）时精确饱和到 1.0，极点会落到
 单位圆上（递推失去衰减）；**25·ln2 ≈ 17.33 是解析舍入的充分界**
 （证明按此口径放缩，两数字关系：实测紧界 16.636 < 充分界 17.33）。
 ``SpectralGlobalConv.oscillator_params`` 已加 ``clamp(max=1−1e-6)`` ——
 此处验证：把 raw_rho 推到 ±30，ρ 仍严格 < 1。

 **θ 卫兵（P1）**：命题 5 修正后的误差界含 1/|sinθ_m|，θ→0/π 时界发散。
 ``oscillator_params`` 已加 ``θ ∈ [1e-3, π−1e-3]`` 参数级钳制——此处验证：
 把 raw_theta 推到 ±30，θ 仍严格落在钳制区间内（|sinθ| ≥ sin(1e-3)）。
 """
 # (a) fp64 数学层：sigmoid 严格开区间
 raw = torch.tensor([0.0, 5.0, -5.0, 20.0, -20.0], dtype=torch.float64)
 sig = torch.sigmoid(raw)
 math_ok = bool((sig < 1.0).all() and (sig > 0.0).all())
 # (b) 包络与 ℓ₁ 界
 worst_env, worst_l1 = 0.0, 0.0
 tau = torch.arange(65536, dtype=torch.float64)
 for r in (0.3, 0.7, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999):
 for th in (math.pi / 7, math.pi / 3, 2 * math.pi / 3):
 psi = (r ** tau) * torch.sin((tau + 1) * th)
 worst_env = max(worst_env, (psi.abs() - r ** tau).max().item())
 l1 = psi.abs().sum().item()
 worst_l1 = max(worst_l1, l1 - 1.0 / (1.0 - r))
 # (c) 实现层：极端 raw_rho 下 ρ 仍严格 < 1（卫兵生效）
 mx = SpectralGlobalConv(dim=4, num_bases=4, decay_max=64, local_kernel=1,
 content_gate=False, evidence_gate=False,
 uncertainty_gate=False)
 with torch.no_grad():
 mx.raw_rho.fill_(30.0)
 rho_hi = mx.oscillator_params()[0]
 mx.raw_rho.fill_(-30.0)
 rho_lo = mx.oscillator_params()[0]
 # (d) θ 钳制卫兵：raw_theta 推到极端，θ 仍严格落在 [1e-3, π−1e-3]
 mx.raw_theta.fill_(30.0)
 theta_hi = mx.oscillator_params()[1]
 mx.raw_theta.fill_(-30.0)
 theta_lo = mx.oscillator_params()[1]
 guard_ok = bool((rho_hi < 1.0).all() and (rho_lo > 0.0).all()
 and (rho_hi <= 1.0 - 1e-6).all())
 theta_ok = bool((theta_hi <= math.pi - 1e-3).all()
 and (theta_lo >= 1e-3).all()
 and torch.sin(theta_hi).abs().min() >= math.sin(1e-3) - 1e-9
 and torch.sin(theta_lo).abs().min() >= math.sin(1e-3) - 1e-9)
 ok = math_ok and worst_env <= 0.0 and worst_l1 <= 1e-9 and guard_ok and theta_ok
 return ProofResult("P05", "BIBO 稳定：|ψ_τ| ≤ ρ^τ, Σ|ψ| ≤ 1/(1−ρ)；fp32 饱和与 θ 漂移均被卫兵拦截",
 "numeric-fp64 + fp32-impl", ok,
 f"fp64 sigmoid 严格={math_ok}, 包络违反={worst_env:.1e}, "
 f"ℓ₁ 超界={worst_l1:.1e}, raw=±30 时 ρ<1={guard_ok}, "
 f"θ 钳制 [1e-3, π−1e-3] 生效={theta_ok}",
 "饱和阈值：实测 16.636（24·ln2）为紧界、25·ln2≈17.33 为解析充分界；"
 "卫兵阈值 1−1e-6 高于 ρ₀≈0.99988（decay_max=8192），不影响初始化")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P06 流式 == 并行（mixer 级，fp64）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _mixer(gates: bool) -> SpectralGlobalConv:
 torch.manual_seed(15)
 return SpectralGlobalConv(dim=16, num_bases=32, decay_max=256, local_kernel=4,
 content_gate=True, evidence_gate=gates,
 uncertainty_gate=gates,
 fft_dtype=torch.float64).double()


def _proof_stream_equals_parallel() -> ProofResult:
 """SpectralGlobalConv 整段前向（FFT 形式）与逐 token 流式（IIR 形式）一致。

 门关：纯线性路径，fp64 下残差应 ~1e-12（FFT 与递推的舍入差）；
 门开：证据门能量和在 fp32 内做 cumsum vs 运行和（**结合顺序不同**），
 残差抬到 ~1e-6 —— 数学上仍是同一和，工程上由 theory.py 的 4e-5 口径守护。
 """
 out = []
 for gates, tol in ((False, 1e-8), (True, 1e-4)):
 mx = _mixer(gates)
 x = torch.randn(2, 65, 16, dtype=torch.float64) # 奇数长度
 with torch.no_grad():
 y_par = mx(x)
 st = mx.init_state(2, x.device, torch.float64)
 ys = []
 for t in range(x.shape[1]):
 yt, st = mx.step(x[:, t:t + 1, :], st)
 ys.append(yt)
 y_seq = torch.cat(ys, dim=1)
 rel = _frac((y_par - y_seq).abs().max().item(), y_par.abs().max().item())
 out.append((gates, rel, rel < tol))
 ok = all(p for _, _, p in out)
 det = "; ".join(f"gates={'on' if g else 'off'} rel={r:.2e}" for g, r, _ in out)
 return ProofResult("P06", "mixer 级 流式(IIR) == 并行(FFT)（fp64）",
 "numeric-fp64", ok, det,
 "门开时残差来自 fp32 能量和的结合顺序，非数学差异")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P07 证据门 cumsum / 运行和恒等式
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_evidence_identity() -> ProofResult:
 """c_t = (1/t)·Σ_{s≤t}‖u_s‖² 的两种计算是**同一个和**：

 (a) fp64 数学层：cumsum vs 逐次折叠，残差 ≤ 1e-12（纯结合顺序舍入）；
 (b) fp64 下闸门权重逐位置相等；
 (c) 实现级（gates.py，fp32 口径）：并行 evidence_weights 与流式
 evidence_weight_step 循环一致（≤ 1e-5）。
 """
 torch.manual_seed(16)
 u = torch.randn(2, 128, 8, dtype=torch.float64)
 e = (u ** 2).sum(dim=-1)
 cs = e.cumsum(dim=1)
 tvec = torch.arange(1, 129, dtype=torch.float64).unsqueeze(0)
 c_par = cs / tvec
 # 逐次折叠
 run = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float64)
 worst = 0.0
 for t in range(128):
 run = run + e[:, t]
 worst = max(worst, (run / (t + 1) - c_par[:, t]).abs().max().item())
 # fp64 闸门权重逐位置相等（手推流式公式对照并行实现）
 g = torch.tensor(1.3, dtype=torch.float64)
 pg = torch.tensor(0.2, dtype=torch.float64)
 bs = torch.tensor(-0.1, dtype=torch.float64)
 w_par = torch.sigmoid(g * torch.log1p(c_par) + pg * torch.log1p(tvec) + bs)
 worst_w = 0.0
 run = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.float64)
 for t in range(128):
 run = run + e[:, t]
 c_t = run / (t + 1)
 w_t = torch.sigmoid(g * torch.log1p(c_t) + pg * math.log1p(t + 1) + bs)
 worst_w = max(worst_w, (w_t - w_par[:, t]).abs().max().item())
 # 实现级 fp32 一致性
 u32 = u.float()
 g32, pg32, bs32 = g.float(), pg.float(), bs.float()
 w_impl_par = evidence_weights(u32, g32, pg32, bs32) # (B,L,1)
 esum = None
 worst_impl = 0.0
 for t in range(128):
 w_t, esum = evidence_weight_step(u32[:, t:t + 1, :], esum, t, g32, pg32, bs32)
 worst_impl = max(worst_impl, (w_t - w_impl_par[:, t:t + 1, :]).abs().max().item())
 ok = worst < 1e-12 and worst_w < 1e-12 and worst_impl < 1e-5
 return ProofResult("P07", "证据门 cumsum==运行和（fp64 恒等；fp32 实现一致）",
 "numeric-fp64 + fp32-impl", ok,
 f"数学残差={worst:.2e}, 权重残差={worst_w:.2e}, "
 f"实现残差={worst_impl:.2e}",
 "FFT↔IIR 对偶形式在闸门层保持的前提")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P08 闸门有界性与 RMSNorm 归一化
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_gate_bounds() -> ProofResult:
 """三角不等式 ⇒ d_t = ‖a−b‖₁/(‖a‖₁+‖b‖₁+ε) ≤ 1，且在精确算术下**严格** < 1：

 (a) fp64 数学层：d < 1 严格（含对抗情形 local = −long，d = 2L/(2L+ε)）；
 (b) fp32 实现层：‖a‖₁ ≫ ε 时 d 可舍入到**精确 1.0**（2L/(2L+ε) 与 1
 之差低于 fp32 半精度）—— 闭界 [0,1] 仍成立且无 NaN 风险：
 w = 1 − σ(λ)·d ∈ [1−σ(λ), 1]，对一切 λ 有界。故实现层断言闭界。
 另：d 关于 (a,b) 对称；evidence ∈ (0,1)；RMSNorm 输出均方 ≈ 1。
 """
 torch.manual_seed(17)
 # (a) fp64 严格界
 long64 = torch.randn(4, 64, 32, dtype=torch.float64)
 d64 = joint_disagreement(long64, torch.randn(4, 64, 32, dtype=torch.float64))
 d64_adv = joint_disagreement(long64, -long64)
 strict64 = bool((d64 >= 0).all() and (d64 < 1).all()
 and (d64_adv > 0.99).all() and (d64_adv < 1).all())
 # (b) fp32 实现层：闭界 + 对称 + 对抗到达上界
 long = long64.float()
 local = torch.randn(4, 64, 32)
 d = joint_disagreement(long, local)
 d_rev = joint_disagreement(local, long)
 sym = bool(torch.equal(d, d_rev))
 bounded32 = bool((d >= 0).all() and (d <= 1).all())
 d_adv = joint_disagreement(long, -long)
 adv = bool((d_adv > 0.99).all() and (d_adv <= 1).all())
 ev = evidence_weights(torch.randn(2, 32, 8), torch.tensor(1.5), torch.tensor(0.3),
 torch.tensor(-0.2))
 ev_ok = bool((ev > 0).all() and (ev < 1).all())
 w = uncertainty_weights(long, local, torch.tensor(5.0))
 w_ok = bool((w > 0).all() and (w <= 1).all())
 n = RMSNorm(64)
 x = torch.randn(8, 7, 64)
 rms = n(x).pow(2).mean(-1)
 rms_ok = bool((rms - 1).abs().max() < 1e-4)
 ok = strict64 and sym and bounded32 and adv and ev_ok and w_ok and rms_ok
 return ProofResult("P08", "闸门有界性：fp64 严格 d<1（三角不等式）；fp32 实现闭界 [0,1]",
 "numeric-fp64 + fp32-impl", ok,
 f"fp64严格={strict64}, 对称={sym}, fp32闭界={bounded32}, "
 f"对抗d→1⁻={adv}, evidence∈(0,1)={ev_ok}, w∈(0,1]={w_ok}, "
 f"rms偏差={(rms - 1).abs().max().item():.2e}",
 "fp32 下 d 精确到 1.0 是舍入而非越界：w 仍有界、无 NaN")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P09 时移协变性（门关）/ 非协变性（门开，设计使然）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_shift_covariance() -> ProofResult:
 """闸门全关时 mixer 是（逐点 + LTI）因果系统：输入右移 s ⇒ 输出右移 s
 （t ≥ s 处逐位相等，fp64 ≤1e-10）。无位置嵌入表的时序感全部来自
 因果核本身 —— 这是"位置由因果核编码"主张的可验证形式。
 证据门开启时系统**故意**依赖绝对位置 t（c_t 的 1/t 归一化、log1p(t) 项），
 此时不再协变 —— 如实验证并记录该边界。
 """
 mx = _mixer(gates=False)
 x = torch.randn(1, 48, 16, dtype=torch.float64)
 s = 7
 x2 = torch.cat([torch.zeros(1, s, 16, dtype=torch.float64), x[:, :-s, :]], dim=1)
 with torch.no_grad():
 y1 = mx(x)
 y2 = mx(x2)
 off = (y2[:, s:] - y1[:, :-s]).abs().max().item()
 mx_on = _mixer(gates=True)
 with torch.no_grad():
 z1 = mx_on(x)
 z2 = mx_on(x2)
 on = (z2[:, s:] - z1[:, :-s]).abs().max().item()
 ok = off < 1e-10 and on > 1e-4
 return ProofResult("P09", "门关：时移协变（位置由因果核编码）；门开：故意非协变",
 "numeric-fp64", ok,
 f"门关残差={off:.2e}, 门开差异={on:.2e}",
 "非协变来自证据门的绝对位置项（1/t 归一化），非缺陷")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P10 O(1) 状态充分性（马尔可夫性）
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_state_sufficiency() -> ProofResult:
 """两条**不同**历史只要收敛到同一 (y1, y2, conv_buf, energy_sum, length)，
 一切未来输出**逐位相同** —— O(1) 状态是未来的充分统计量，
 "无 KV cache 不丢信息"的严格形式。"""
 mx = _mixer(gates=True)
 fut = torch.randn(1, 30, 16, dtype=torch.float64)
 with torch.no_grad():
 states = []
 for seed in (0, 1):
 torch.manual_seed(100 + seed)
 pre = torch.randn(1, 20, 16, dtype=torch.float64)
 st = mx.init_state(1, fut.device, torch.float64)
 for t in range(20):
 _, st = mx.step(pre[:, t:t + 1, :], st)
 states.append(st)
 st_a, st_b = states
 # 把 B 的状态整体替换为 A 的（历史不同，状态相同）
 st_b.y1 = st_a.y1.clone()
 st_b.y2 = st_a.y2.clone()
 st_b.conv_buf = st_a.conv_buf.clone()
 st_b.energy_sum = st_a.energy_sum.clone()
 st_b.length = st_a.length
 outs = []
 for st in (st_a, st_b):
 ys = []
 for t in range(fut.shape[1]):
 yt, st = mx.step(fut[:, t:t + 1, :], st)
 ys.append(yt)
 outs.append(torch.cat(ys, dim=1))
 same = bool(torch.equal(outs[0], outs[1]))
 return ProofResult("P10", "O(1) 状态充分性：同状态 ⇒ 未来逐位一致（马尔可夫性）",
 "numeric-fp64", same,
 f"逐位一致={same}",
 "两条随机历史在状态替换后对相同未来输入输出完全相同")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P11 复杂度公式逐项重推导审计
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_complexity_audit() -> ProofResult:
 """(a) ``_long_range_flops`` 与独立逐项推导一致（不同结合顺序）；
 (b) attention 每 token 随 L **精确翻倍**，SGC 长程项同倍增下 < +5%（亚线性）；
 (c) ``infer_flops_per_token`` 与 L 无关，且 mixer 项恰为 layers·D·(5M+22)
 —— v3.1 修正（旧版 6·D 漏乘基数 M）的防回归断言。"""
 cfg = SimplCoreConfig(vocab_size=8192, dim=256, num_layers=4, num_bases=16,
 local_kernel=4, num_heads=4, ffn_ratio=2.0)
 d, m = float(cfg.dim), float(cfg.num_bases)

 def derive_long_range(s: float) -> float:
 """独立逐项推导（每 token 摊销：FFT/复乘项除以 s）。"""
 n = 2.0 * s
 return (2.0 * d * m # 核构建（本就是每 token）
 + 2.5 * n * math.log2(n) * d / s # rfft，摊到每 token
 + 2.5 * n * math.log2(n) * d / s # irfft，摊到每 token
 + 6.0 * (n / 2.0) * d / s # 频域复乘，摊到每 token
 + 22.0 * d) # 逐点激活

 worst = 0.0
 for s in (512, 4096, 65536, 1048576):
 code = _long_range_flops(cfg, int(s))
 worst = max(worst, abs(code - derive_long_range(s)) / max(abs(code), 1e-300))
 # (b) 增长口径
 att = lambda L: 4.0 * float(L) * d
 att_ratio = att(2 ** 20) / att(2 ** 19)
 sgc_ratio = _long_range_flops(cfg, 2 ** 20) / _long_range_flops(cfg, 2 ** 19)
 growth_ok = (att_ratio == 2.0) and (sgc_ratio < 1.05)
 # (c) infer：与 L 无关 + mixer 项精确等式
 L_free = infer_flops_per_token(cfg, 1024) == infer_flops_per_token(cfg, 4 * 1024 * 1024)
 mixer_term = infer_flops_per_token(cfg, 4096) - 2.0 * non_embedding_params(cfg)
 mixer_exact = mixer_term == cfg.num_layers * cfg.dim * (5.0 * cfg.num_bases + 22.0)
 ok = worst < 1e-9 and growth_ok and L_free and mixer_exact
 return ProofResult("P11", "复杂度公式逐项重推导一致；attention×2 vs SGC 亚线性；infer 含基数 M",
 "algebraic", ok,
 f"推导残差={worst:.2e}, att比={att_ratio:.1f}, sgc比={sgc_ratio:.4f}, "
 f"L无关={L_free}, mixer项精确={mixer_exact}",
 "v3.1 修正：infer mixer 6·D → (5M+22)·D；训练式补核构建 2·D·M")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P12 HBM 账本代数
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_ledger_algebra() -> ProofResult:
 """部署/训练账本从组件公式**独立重推**并逐字节相等：

 (a) deploy：权重(bf16) + 流式状态 + 单chunk workspace + logits == deploy_bytes；
 总量 ≤ 2 GiB（1M 指标）；公式结构上不含 L（签名审计）。
 (b) campaign 分块训练：16 B/参数 × P + 单 chunk 激活 == chunked_train_bytes。
 (c) WeightBudget：allocate 守卫（2B 可学 / 3B 总上限）+ 显存只算可学。
 """
 cfg = get_preset("tuan-1b")
 P = embedding_params(cfg) + non_embedding_params(cfg)
 total = deploy_bytes(cfg, params=P)
 # v1.1.1：融合单缓冲——激活 workspace 与 logits 复用同一块（峰值取较大者）；
 # 状态公式含 M 因子（2·M·D/层）
 buffer = max(cfg.num_layers * DEFAULT_CHUNK * cfg.dim * DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_TENSORS * 2,
 DEFAULT_CHUNK * cfg.vocab_size * 2)
 mine = (P * 2
 + stream_state_bytes(cfg, 1)
 + buffer)
 deploy_exact = mine == total
 deploy_cap = total <= DEPLOY_HBM_CAP_1M
 no_l = "seq" not in str(inspect.signature(deploy_bytes))
 cb = chunked_train_bytes(cfg, P, chunk=8192)
 cb_mine = OPTIMIZER_BYTES_PER_PARAM * P + cfg.num_layers * 8192 * cfg.dim * 8 * 2
 chunked_exact = cb == cb_mine
 opt_ok = optimizer_state_bytes(1_000_000_000) == 16 * 1_000_000_000
 b = WeightBudget()
 vram0 = b.vram_params() == b.learned_params == 0
 b.allocate(1_500_000_000)
 vram1 = b.vram_params() == 1_500_000_000
 refuse = not b.can_allocate(600_000_000) # 1.5B + 0.6B > 2B 可学上限
 try:
 b.allocate(600_000_000)
 raises = False
 except ValueError:
 raises = True
 ok = (deploy_exact and deploy_cap and no_l and chunked_exact and opt_ok
 and vram0 and vram1 and refuse and raises)
 return ProofResult("P12", "HBM 账本代数：deploy/campaign 逐字节重推一致；预算守卫正确",
 "algebraic", ok,
 f"deploy精确={deploy_exact}({total / GIB:.3f} GiB), ≤2GiB={deploy_cap}, "
 f"无L={no_l}, chunked精确={chunked_exact}, opt16B={opt_ok}, "
 f"vram只算可学={vram0 and vram1}, 拒绝超2B={refuse and raises}",
 "1M ≤ 2 GiB 与翻倍增量恒 0 的代数根源：四项均与 L 无关")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# P13 冻结基座梯度隔离
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _proof_frozen_base_gradient() -> ProofResult:
 """ForwardAdapter 反传一次：基座（含 head）所有参数 .grad 均为 None
 （梯度在结构上不可能流向基座），适配器参数全部有梯度且非全零。"""
 from ..training.envlearn import ForwardAdapter, LearnedAdapter
 from ..model.model import SimplCoreModel
 from ..model.tokenization import CharTokenizer

 torch.manual_seed(0)
 codec = CharTokenizer(limit="abcd")
 cfg = SimplCoreConfig.from_codec(codec, dim=32, num_layers=2, num_bases=8,
 decay_max=128, local_kernel=3, num_heads=2,
 ffn_ratio=2.0, mixer="sgc")
 base = SimplCoreModel(cfg)
 adapter = LearnedAdapter(dim=32, num_blocks=2)
 fa = ForwardAdapter(base, adapter, codec)
 idx = torch.randint(0, cfg.vocab_size, (2, 12))
 _, loss = fa(idx, targets=idx)
 loss.backward()
 base_clean = all(p.grad is None for p in fa.base.parameters())
 grads = [p.grad for p in fa.adapter.parameters()]
 adapter_has = all(g is not None for g in grads)
 adapter_live = any(g.abs().sum().item() > 0 for g in grads)
 ok = base_clean and adapter_has and adapter_live
 n_base = sum(1 for _ in fa.base.parameters())
 return ProofResult("P13", "梯度隔离：基座 .grad 全 None，梯度只流向适配器",
 "numeric-fp32-impl", ok,
 f"基座参数 {n_base} 个 grad 全 None={base_clean}, "
 f"适配器有梯度={adapter_has and adapter_live}",
 "Phase 2 \"显存只吃 2B、不碰 1B\" 的结构保证")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_PROOFS: Tuple[Callable[[], ProofResult], ...] = (
 _proof_closed_form,
 _proof_companion_matrix,
 _proof_chunk_carry_law,
 _proof_fft_no_aliasing,
 _proof_bibo_stability,

 _proof_evidence_identity,

 _proof_frozen_base_gradient,
)


def run_all() -> List[ProofResult]:
 """跑完全部数学证明，返回逐项结果。"""
 return [fn() for fn in _PROOFS]


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
 del argv
 results = run_all()
 print("SimplCore 数学证明（symbolic / fp64，无硬件依赖）")
 print("=" * 78)
 for r in results:
 flag = "PASS" if r.passed else "FAIL"
 print(f"[{flag}] {r.pid} {r.claim}")
 print(f" 方法={r.method} {r.residual}")
 if r.note:
 print(f" 注: {r.note}")
 n_ok = sum(1 for r in results if r.passed)
 print("=" * 78)
 print(f"{n_ok}/{len(results)} 项证明通过")
 return 0 if n_ok == len(results) else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
 raise SystemExit(main())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Accounted (not sampled) memory instrumentation, split out of ``eval.py``.

``GetProcessMemoryInfo`` is broken on the reference host (returns 0 with
``GetLastError() == 122``), so every number here is computed exactly as
``sum(t.numel() * t.element_size())`` over tensors that are alive and
materialised during the measured step -- never sampled from an OS counter."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

from ..common import _jsonable, resolve_device, resolve_dtype
from ..model.config import SimplCoreConfig
from ..model.model import SimplCoreModel


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tensor-accounting memory instrumentation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class _TensorAudit(torch.autograd.Function):
 """Autograd Function that records the device bytes of its live activations.

 Registered on three autograd nodes written by one measured training step:
 the embedding output, the LM-head output (inside the model) and the loss
 (by this module). Because the counters are filled by hooks rather than by
 sampling the process working set, the result is exact for the tensors that
 actually exist and can never silently read zero.
 """

 acc: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None

 @staticmethod
 def forward(ctx, x: torch.Tensor):
 acc = _TensorAudit.acc
 if acc is not None:
 acc["fwd"] = acc.get("fwd", 0) + _bytes_of(x)
 return x

 @staticmethod
 def backward(ctx, grad):
 acc = _TensorAudit.acc
 if acc is not None and grad is not None:
 acc["bwd"] = acc.get("bwd", 0) + _bytes_of(grad)
 return grad


def _bytes_of(t: torch.Tensor) -> int:
 return int(t.numel()) * int(t.element_size())


def _register_audit(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 # Autograd Functions are only valid on floating point tensors that require
 # grad; skip everything else rather than crashing a measurement.
 if t.requires_grad and t.is_floating_point():
 return _TensorAudit.apply(t)
 return t


def state_dict_bytes(obj: Any) -> int:
 """Exact bytes of every tensor in ``obj.state_dict()`` (params + buffers)."""
 if not hasattr(obj, "state_dict"):
 return 0
 sd = obj.state_dict()
 total = 0
 for v in sd.values():
 if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
 total += _bytes_of(v)
 elif isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
 for u in v:
 if isinstance(u, torch.Tensor):
 total += _bytes_of(u)
 return total


def _discover_tensors(stop_at_modules: bool = True) -> List[torch.Tensor]:
 """All tensors reachable from live objects in ``gc.get_objects()``.

 Parameters and buffers of an ``nn.Module`` are skipped (they are counted
 exactly once by :func:`state_dict_bytes`); everything else -- in-flight
 activations, gradient buffers, temporaries -- is returned.
 """
 import gc
 import warnings

 out: List[torch.Tensor] = []
 # The interpreter may hold arbitrary third-party objects whose *metaclass*
 # `__instancecheck__` raises deprecation warnings (torch.distributed.reduce_op
 # is one on torch 2.4). Scanning the heap is a measurement, not a use of those
 # APIs, so warnings raised by other libraries while we inspect them are
 # suppressed -- scoped to this block only, and only FutureWarning/DeprecationWarning.
 with warnings.catch_warnings():
 warnings.simplefilter("ignore", FutureWarning)
 warnings.simplefilter("ignore", DeprecationWarning)
 for o in gc.get_objects():
 if stop_at_modules and isinstance(o, nn.Module):
 continue
 if isinstance(o, torch.Tensor):
 out.append(o)
 return out


def live_tensor_bytes(stop_at_modules: bool = True, gc_collect: bool = True) -> int:
 """Bytes of all live tensors except module state (see :func:`_discover_tensors`)."""
 if gc_collect:
 import gc

 gc.collect()
 return sum(_bytes_of(t) for t in _discover_tensors(stop_at_modules))


def tensor_peak_bytes(model: nn.Module, batch: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor,
 backward: bool = True, extra: Any = None,
 gc_collect: bool = True) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 """Accounted device bytes for one forward (+ backward) step.

 Returns a dict with

 * ``param_bytes`` -- exact ``state_dict()`` bytes at measure time,
 * ``grad_bytes`` -- exact bytes of every ``p.grad`` after backward,
 * ``fwd_bytes`` -- exact sum of the activations autograd wrote while the
 model's own forward ran,
 * ``bwd_bytes`` -- exact sum of the gradient tensors autograd wrote while
 the backward ran,
 * ``live_bytes`` -- bytes of every other live tensor reachable in the
 interpreter (transient temporaries from the FFT/conv kernels, which are
 *not* surfaced by autograd hooks),
 * ``accounted_bytes`` -- ``param + grad + fwd + bwd`` (never 0 for a real model),
 * ``tensor_peak_bytes`` -- ``param + max(total_fwd, total_bwd) + live``: the
 high-water mark of the accounted tensors,
 * ``cuda_max_memory_allocated`` -- the real allocator peak when CUDA is
 available, else ``None`` (never fabricated).

 This is *accounting*, not a working-set sample: it is the honest replacement
 for the broken ``PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS`` path.
 """
 if extra is not None:
 extra = tuple(x for x in extra if x is not None)
 acc: Dict[str, int] = {"fwd": 0, "bwd": 0}
 _TensorAudit.acc = acc

 param_bytes = state_dict_bytes(model)
 live_before = live_tensor_bytes(gc_collect=gc_collect)

 h_emb = model.tok_emb.register_forward_hook(lambda m, i, o: _register_audit(o))
 h_head = model.head.register_forward_hook(lambda m, i, o: _register_audit(o))

 cuda_before = None
 if torch.cuda.is_available() and batch.is_cuda:
 torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
 cuda_before = int(torch.cuda.memory_allocated())

 grad_bytes = 0
 try:
 model.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
 logits = model(batch)
 if extra:
 h_extra = [e.register_hook(lambda g: _register_audit(g)) for e in extra if e.requires_grad]
 else:
 h_extra = []
 loss = F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, logits.size(-1)),
 targets.reshape(-1), ignore_index=-100)
 acc["fwd"] += _bytes_of(loss)
 if backward:
 loss.backward()
 grad_bytes = int(sum(_bytes_of(p.grad) for p in model.parameters() if p.grad is not None))
 else:
 logits = logits.detach()
 live_after = live_tensor_bytes(gc_collect=gc_collect)
 finally:
 h_emb.remove()
 h_head.remove()
 if extra:
 for h in h_extra:
 h.remove()
 _TensorAudit.acc = None

 live = max(0, live_after - live_before)
 accounted = param_bytes + grad_bytes + acc["fwd"] + acc["bwd"]
 peak = param_bytes + max(acc["fwd"], acc["bwd"]) + live
 cuda_peak = None
 if cuda_before is not None:
 cuda_peak = int(torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated())
 return {
 "param_bytes": int(param_bytes),
 "grad_bytes": int(grad_bytes),
 "fwd_bytes": int(acc["fwd"]),
 "bwd_bytes": int(acc["bwd"]),
 "live_bytes": int(live),
 "accounted_bytes": int(accounted),
 "tensor_peak_bytes": int(peak),
 "cuda_max_memory_allocated": cuda_peak,
 "n_params": int(sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())),
 }


def mb(nbytes: Any) -> Optional[float]:
 if nbytes is None:
 return None
 return round(float(nbytes) / (1024.0 * 1024.0), 6)


def _smoke_stub_model() -> nn.Module:
 class _Stub(nn.Module):
 def __init__(self) -> None:
 super().__init__()
 self.tok_emb = nn.Embedding(8, 4)
 self.head = nn.Linear(4, 8, bias=False)

 def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 return self.head(self.tok_emb(x))

 return _Stub()


def assert_memory_probe_works(device: str = "cpu", dtype: str = "float32",
 verbose: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 """Prove the instrumentation is live, or raise ``AssertionError``.

 Three independent checks:

 1. a tiny model must report a strictly positive accounted byte count,
 2. the count must grow when the model gets wider (width 32 -> 64),
 3. the accounting must be exact: it must reproduce ``state_dict()`` bytes
 plus the audited activations, and a hand-built tensor of known size must
 be reported exactly.

 A measurement that can silently read 0 is a bug, so a zero or non-growing
 number fails here instead of being printed.
 """
 dev = resolve_device(device)
 dt = resolve_dtype(dtype)
 results: Dict[str, Any] = {"checks": {}}

 x = torch.randint(0, 8, (2, 8), device=dev)
 m = _smoke_stub_model().to(dev, dtype=dt)
 m.train()
 r = tensor_peak_bytes(m, x, x, backward=True)
 assert r["accounted_bytes"] > 0, f"accounted_bytes must be > 0, got {r['accounted_bytes']}"
 assert r["tensor_peak_bytes"] > 0, f"tensor_peak_bytes must be > 0, got {r['tensor_peak_bytes']}"
 # exactness: embedding output + head output + loss + grads
 emb_b = 2 * 8 * 4 * 4
 head_b = 2 * 8 * 8 * 4
 loss_b = 4
 grad_b = sum(_bytes_of(p.grad) for p in m.parameters() if p.grad is not None)
 assert r["fwd_bytes"] == emb_b + head_b + loss_b, (
 f"fwd accounting inexact: {r['fwd_bytes']} != {emb_b + head_b + loss_b}")
 assert r["grad_bytes"] == grad_b, f"grad accounting inexact: {r['grad_bytes']} != {grad_b}"
 results["checks"]["stub_exact"] = {
 "fwd_bytes": r["fwd_bytes"], "expected": emb_b + head_b + loss_b,
 "grad_bytes": r["grad_bytes"], "expected_grad": grad_b,
 }

 # width scaling: same depth/seq, wider model must account for more bytes
 peaks = {}
 for width in (32, 64):
 cfg = SimplCoreConfig(vocab_size=64, dim=width, num_layers=2, num_bases=8,
 decay_max=64, local_kernel=4, num_heads=4, ffn_ratio=2.0)
 model = SimplCoreModel(cfg).to(dev, dtype=dt).train()
 xb = torch.randint(0, 64, (2, 32), device=dev)
 rb = tensor_peak_bytes(model, xb, xb, backward=True)
 peaks[width] = rb
 assert rb["accounted_bytes"] > 0, f"width {width}: accounted_bytes == 0"
 assert rb["tensor_peak_bytes"] > 0, f"width {width}: tensor_peak_bytes == 0"
 assert peaks[64]["accounted_bytes"] > peaks[32]["accounted_bytes"], (
 "accounted bytes did not grow with model width: "
 f"{peaks[32]['accounted_bytes']} -> {peaks[64]['accounted_bytes']}")
 assert peaks[64]["param_bytes"] > peaks[32]["param_bytes"], (
 "param bytes did not grow with model width: "
 f"{peaks[32]['param_bytes']} -> {peaks[64]['param_bytes']}")
 results["checks"]["width_scaling"] = {
 "accounted_bytes_32": peaks[32]["accounted_bytes"],
 "accounted_bytes_64": peaks[64]["accounted_bytes"],
 "param_bytes_32": peaks[32]["param_bytes"],
 "param_bytes_64": peaks[64]["param_bytes"],
 }

 # a hand-built tensor of known size must be reported exactly
 probe = torch.zeros(1000, 4, dtype=torch.float32)
 assert _bytes_of(probe) == 16000, _bytes_of(probe)
 del probe

 results["ok"] = True
 results["cuda_available"] = bool(torch.cuda.is_available())
 if verbose:
 print(json.dumps(_jsonable(results), indent=2))
 return results
